title_en: Life detection alarm device in automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a life detection alarm device in an automobile, which comprises a lock control module, a temperature detector, a time delay module, a life body detection sensor, a reminding module, a sound warning module and a control interface module, wherein the temperature detector receives command signals of the lock control module to open/close an automobile door and an automobile window and sends a temperature value and a delay time command; the life body detection sensor sends a life body information detection instruction after receiving the temperature value and the delay time instruction, the reminding module receives the life body information detection instruction to carry out acousto-optic reminding, the sound warning module receives the acousto-optic reminding to carry out reminding alarm or cancel operation outside the vehicle, and the control interface module receives the acousto-optic reminding to turn off the alarm device. When an accident life body appears in the automobile, the automobile gives an alarm, calls a telephone, sends a short message and the like to send a distress to a preset number, and a person receiving the distress carries out remote control operation on the automobile through the short message or the telephone to help the trapped person to escape, can talk with the inside of the automobile and monitor sound, images and the like.

title_en: Emergency notification system for mobile devices
abstract_en: An emergency notification system for a mobile device. The system includes a mobile device application that is adapted to be stored in memory on the mobile device. The application, upon activation during an emergency, determines the GPS coordinates of the mobile device, records digital images over a period of time, sends a preset message from the mobile device to at least one recipient, preferably a emergency responder, and sends the GPS coordinates and the digital images. The coordinates and images may be sent to a remote server for storage and which can be accessed by the emergency provider. The coordinates and images are periodically updated and sent while the program is activated, The application can be hidden during operation.

title_en: Safety warning device for coal mine underground personnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety warning device for coal mine underground personnel which comprises a ground controller, a voice gateway and a plurality of safety warning devices, relay splitters and terminals arranged underground, wherein the ground controller is connected with the voice gateway, the voice gateway is connected with telephone lines inside underground roadways, the safety warning devices are arranged at intervals inside the underground roadways via CAN bus lines, one relay splitter is arranged at each roadway intersection and communicated with roadway lines, and each terminal is connected at the two ends of each roadway. The safety warning device for coal mine underground personnel can accurately and promptly warn the underground working staff to withdraw when an abnormal condition or a mine disaster occurs underground; the system thereof can play the prestored digital audios, release daily notices and the like in the normal working hours; the functions of underground-ground voice communications and voice record/storage can be realized in the manner of talkback; and the existing scheduling telephone cable can be adopted as the CAN bus so as to reduce the cost and facilitate the system upgrading. The safety warning device for coal mine underground personnel has the advantages of simple structure, wide warning range, easy installation and good practicability.

title_en: Digital locking device for windows and doors
title_ko: 창호용 디지털 잠금장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a digital locking device for windows and doors according to an embodiment of the present invention. It locks or unlocks a sliding window consisting of a windowframe (5) and a window (3) sliding thereon. The present invention comprises a locking unit (100), an electric driving unit (200) and a control unit (300). The locking unit (100) includes: a holding unit (110) which is formed in the window frame (5); a latching unit (130) which locks the window (3) in the windowframe (5) when it is held in the holding unit (110); and a rotation prevention unit (150) which secures the latching unit (130) held in the holding unit (110). The electric driving unit (200) includes: a driving motor (210) which is connected with the locking unit (100) and drives the rotation prevention unit (150); a power supply unit (220) which supplies power to the driving motor (210); a manipulation jog dial (230) which is connected to a connection shaft (237) with a turning gear (235) that is meshed with a shaft (233) which manipulates the rotation prevention unit(150), and; a release button which disables the rotation prevention unit (150). The control unit (300) electrically controls and is connected with the electric driving unit (200) and includes a PCB (310) and a magnetic sensor (320) connected thereto. According to the present invention, when the sliding window is closed and locked, it drives the driving motor and maintains automatically the locked state of the sliding window after sensing the locked state with the magnetic sensor. In addition, the locked state is released with a simple manipulation when opening the sliding window. Accordingly, since a manipulating action for locking or opening the sliding window and an additional action for maintaining the locked state of the sliding window are not necessary, using and locking of the sliding window are simplified. In the homeowner’s absence, break-ins are prevented beforehand by closing the sliding window and locking it at the same time and breaking into the house after the sliding window is locked is prevented by sounding an alarm when the sliding window is forced opened.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 창호용 디지털 잠금장치는, 창틀(5)과 이에 슬라이딩되는 창문(3)으로 이루어지는 미서기창을 잠금 또는 잠금을 해제시키기 위한 창호용 잠금장치에 있어서, 상기 창틀(5)에 구비되는 걸림수단(110)과, 상기 걸림수단에 걸림결합되어 상기 창틀(5)에 설치되는 창문(3)을 잠금시키기 위한 잠금수단(130) 및 상기 걸림수단(110)에 걸림결합된 잠금수단(130)을 고정시키기 위한 회전 방지수단(150)을 포함하는 록킹부(100); 상기 록킹부(100)에 연결되되, 상기 회전 방지수단(150)을 구동시키기 위한 구동 모터(210)와, 상기 구동 모터에 전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부(220)와, 상기 회전 방지수단(150)을 수동으로 조작하되, 회전가능하게 이루어지는 샤프트(233) 및 상기 샤프트(233)에 회전 기어(235)로 치합되는 연결 샤프트(237)가 연결되는 수동작동 조그다이얼(230)과, 상기 회전 방지수단(150)의 구동을 해제하기 위한 해제 버튼(240)을 포함하는 전동 구동부(200); 및 상기 전동 구동부(200)에 전기적으로 제어가능하게 연결되되, PCB(310)와 상기 PCB(310)에 연결되는 자력 센서(320)를 포함하는 제어부(300);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 창틀과 이에 슬라이딩되는 창문으로 이루어지는 미서기창의 닫힘 시 미서기창이 잠금상태로 전환됨과 동시에 자력 센서가 닫힘상태를 감지한 후 구동 모터를 구동시켜 자동으로 미서기창의 잠금상태를 유지시키도록 이루어지고, 미서기창의 개방 시 간단한 버튼 조작에 의해 잠금상태가 해제되도록 이루어짐으로써 미서기창의 잠금 또는 개방을 위한 작동동작과 미서기창의 잠금상태를 유지시키기 위한 별도의 동작을 취할 필요가 없어 미서기창의 사용 및 잠금이 간편하고, 외출 시 또는 부재 중일 경우, 미서기창이 닫힘과 동시에 자동으로 잠김으로써 가정 내에 발생될 수 있는 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있으며, 미서기창의 잠금 설정 후 외부 침입등에 의해 미서기창이 강제 개방시 경보음이 울려서 외부의 침입을 사전에 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Multipurpose tv converter system
title_ko: 다목적 tv 컨버터 시스템
abstract_en: Recently, there has been a change from an analog television broadcasting system to a digital television broadcasting system, and a need therefore continues to exist for a DA (Digital to Analog) converter which enables owners of analog televisions of each nation of the world to watch digital television broadcasts even when a broadcasting system is changed. The present invention relates to a multipurpose converter system in which an address is assigned to a DA converter through the card of a user to classify users by regions or groups, and a computer of the national emergency management office controls the DA converter in a remote location through the data signal input to a TV broadcast signal and transmits an alert signal directively, such that publications including newspapers can be delivered in the form of a file online. Alternatively, the multipurpose converter system of the present invention provides motion picture VOD and Internet services through a bidirectional communication service network established between a host computer of a broadcasting station and a DA converter. The multipurpose TV converter system of the present invention is advantageous in that the same avoids generation of a waste of converters which may otherwise occur when an analog TV broadcasting system is changed into a digital TV broadcasting system.
abstract_ko: TV방송 시스템이 아날로그에서 디지털 TV방송으로 변환되는 추세이며 방송시스템이 변경되더라도 세계 각국의 아날로그 TV소지자가 디지털 TV방송을 시청할 수 있도록 하는 DA(Digital to Analog)컨버터가 필요하다. 본 발명은 사용자가 소지하고 있는 카드로 DA 컨버터에 어드레스를 부여하여 지역별 또는 그룹별로 구분하여 국가비상재난기구의 컴퓨터가 TV방송신호에 삽입된 데이터 신호로 DA 컨버터를 원격 제어하여 경보신호를 지향적으로 전송하는 기능을 구현하며 신문 등의 간행물을 파일형태로 온라인으로 배달하거나 또는 DA 컨버터를 통한 방송국의 호스트컴퓨터와 DA 컨버터간의 쌍방향 통신서비스망의 구성으로 동영상 VOD 및 인터넷 서비스를 겸용으로 제공하는 다목적 컨버터 시스템을 제공한다. 이로서 TV 방송 시스템이 디지털로 전환될 시 발생하는 수억개의 컨버터 폐기물 발생을 억제하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KIM JONG HAE;HAN KYOUNG JA;KIM MICHAEL JITAE;KIM TOMMY Y

title_en: Multifunctional GSM&GPS vehicle anti-theft alert control system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional GSM and GPS automobile anti-theft alarm control system, which is characterized in that the utility model comprises a signal detecting circuit, a CPU control center, a GPS position signal collecting circuit, a driving executive circuit, a GSM communication module, a voice circuit, an audio detecting circuit, a remote control receiver, an incoming call detection, a start-up detection, a monitoring apparatus and a power circuit; and the power circuit provides a stable-voltage DC power for various circuits; the utility model carries out the transmission through the GSM communication module so as to ensure that an owner of the automobile can directly control the oil interruption or power cut-off of the automobile through a cellphone or a telephone and monitor the condition in the automobile, and set the warning telephone of the system, carry out the positioning and tracking, set the speed limitation and cancel the setting, set the electronic fence, turn on and off the receiving of the signal of a vibration inductor and set the reduction by sending the short messages. The utility model further has the function of the emergency warning. The utility model is an automobile anti-theft alarm control device having strong functions and ensures that the owner of the automobile can control the running state of the automobile according to the information of the automobile at any time.

title_en: Sleepiness canceller
abstract_en: The utility model supplies a sleepy eliminator which includes a sensor detector, a detection controller, a sleepiness eliminating warning device, a display device, a power supply and a shell. Each component part is connected by the circuit and the signal; the sensor detector is on bottom of the shell; the display device is on surface of the shell. The utility model has the advantages of being accuracy and reliability in measured value, which can monitor the physiologic index of users in real time, monitor the mental state of users on duty, on hot line work and on driving who are required to remove the potential safety hazard or to concentrate the energy, a plurality of prediction awaking modes (a buzzer, a shaking, a wireless sound box, an electric impulse), and give remind to avoid accidents. The utility model is convenient in usage and wearing, which is especially suitable for the driving.

title_en: Personal security device
abstract_en: A portable security device with locator provides emergency alert and location information to a predetermined location. The security device uses wireless transmissions, a locator device, and a portable telephone to transmit an emergency signal and burst packet transmissions to an operator at a predetermined location. Location information updates are constantly sent to the operator until the security device is turned off with a paired key. Portable security device provides beneficial emergency service for potential personal threats, medical emergencies and other situations that require immediate attention.

title_en: Space object alert management and user interfaces
abstract_en: A display system can be configured to identify a space object and an object alert associated with a change in one or more movement parameters of the space object. The system can generate data configured to display a display region and an object alert indicator within the display region. The system can display the object alert indicator at a location within the display region and display, within a second display region, a listing of a plurality of alerts comprising the object alert. The system can receive a user selection of an alert from the plurality of alerts configured to be displayed in the second display region and automatically generate updated data configured to display an updated display region based on the user selection of the alert. The updated display region can include a panned, rotated, and/or zoomed perspective of the display region.

title_en: Indoor earthquake alarming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor earthquake warning device capable of quickly giving a warn to inform the human of withdrawing from the danger area when the earthquake happens. The indoor earthquake warning device comprises a shell (1), a baffle (5) in the shell (1), a retainer (4) on the baffle, a plurality of support balls (6) in the retainer, a support plate (3) on the retainer, a shake ball (2) on the support plate (3), two set of the above structures are set in the shell (1) and a suspension shaft (9) is set at the inferior part of the shell and a balance plate (7) is connected on the suspension shaft (9) by a sliding sleeve (8) and two shock warning devices (10) are set in the shell. The indoor earthquake warning device is mainly used for making a warning when the earthquake happens.

title_en: Method for pre-detecting abnormality sign of nuclear power plant device including processor for determining device importance and warning validity, and system therefor
Vehicle beacon mode
abstract_en: Method of using a vehicle to alert to potential risks includes determining that a user of the vehicle will be absent; determining an estimated absence time; and sending an alert to authorities, via a control system, if the user does not return within the estimated absence time. The method may include receiving the estimated absence time from the user, or the control system of the vehicle determines the absence and the estimated absence time. The user may define the absence and input the estimated absence time through a centralized location, such that the alert is sent from the centralized location. Following expiration of the estimated absence time, detecting a pedestrian near the vehicle, and then playing a pre-recorded emergency message through speakers, such that the pedestrian is made aware of the pre-recorded emergency message. Vehicle lights/horn may operate to guide the user, possibly in decaying fashion.

title_en: Medical alert system
abstract_en: Systems and methods for providing medical identification tags wearable by a person that include barcodes (e.g., Quick Response (QR) barcodes, or the like) to provide personal medical information to users (e.g., first responders) with mobile devices capable of scanning the barcodes. The system also facilitates automatic notifications to relatives or others associated with the wearer of the medical identification tag when the barcode is scanned, which may indicate an emergency condition. Wearers of the medical identification tags may modify or update the stored personal medical information as needed.

title_en: Method and apparatus for processing signal associated with warning notification in wireless communication system
abstract_en: Based on a proposed method, the UE can initiate a certain timer in order not to allow non-emergency calls when warning notification is given in a certain area. In particular, the UE can receive a paging message including warning indication from a network, and starting a delay timer upon receiving the paging message if the UE belongs to a delay-tolerant category. The UE performs a random access procedure after the delay timer is expired. Namely, the UE that receives the paging message for warning, such as the ETWS and CMAS, immediately check whether it belongs to a certain category proposed by this document to trigger a delay timer to wait for a certain period of time until it attempt the call initiation procedure.

title_en: Systems for tracking medications
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to integrated systems, methods and apparatuses for assisting individuals in managing acute life-threatening conditions. A system in accordance with the current disclosure may comprise an electronic circuit configured to be attached to a container of a medication and one or more devices in communication with the electronic circuit in a private network. In an aspect, the one or more devices may work in concert to determine the safety level of an individual based on predetermined usage settings. In some aspects, the system may be configured to determine whether a medication would expire before its manufactured expiry date. In another aspect, the system may assist an individual in locating a medication. In a further aspect, the system may determine whether an individual is having an anaphylactic reaction. In some aspects, the system may detect a known allergen and alert the individual.

title_en: Method of transmitting or receiving an updated warning message in mobile communication system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of receiving or transmitting an updated warning message in wireless communication system. More particularly, a terminal (UE), which attempts to receive the warning message, receives a broadcast control channel (BCCH) within a corresponding cell, obtains update information for the warning message through the received BCCH, determine whether the warning message has been updated according to the obtained update information, and receives the updated warning message only when the warning message is determined to be updated.
assignees: LG ELECTRONICS INC;LEE YOUNG-DAE;YI SEUNG-JUNE;CHUN SUNG-DUCK;PARK SUNG-JUN

title_en: Earthquake precaution evacuation manoeuvre method by using earthquake early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake early warning manoeuvre method based on an earthquake early warning system for carrying out of an emergency evacuation manoeuvre. During the manoeuvre, earthquake magnitude and position of an earthquake focus of a simulated earthquake are set through a manoeuvre controlling device. When the manoeuvre starts, earthquake early warning receiving terminals located everywhere receive earthquake early warning signals. An earthquake early warning controlling output device automatically starts voice output equipment, wherein the voice output equipment gives earthquake early warning alarms. Proper risk avoiding measures (if the early warning time received is shorter than risk avoiding time, people hide in near places, if the early warning time received is longer than the risk avoiding time, people withdraw to a safe area quickly) are adopted in different places according to different earthquake early warning alarms received. Various forms of manoeuvres about the distance of the earthquake focus, the earthquake magnitude and the like are carried out by using the method, people receiving the manoeuvres form conditioned reflex and are capable of adopting proper risk avoiding measures according to different earthquake early warning time and intensity of the earthquake.

title_en: Medical supplies supply chain intelligent early warning system and early warning machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and an early warning machine for a medical material supply chain, comprising an information input module, an output module, a temperature and humidity monitoring module, a display module, an early warning and alarming module, an input module and a control module; the information input module is used for inputting information of medical supplies; the output module is used for recording the output use information of the medical materials; the temperature and humidity monitoring module is used for monitoring temperature and humidity information of the environment in real time; the display module is used for displaying the medicine information to be invalidated; the early warning and alarming module is used for presenting alarming information sent by the decision executing unit in an acousto-optic mode; the input module is used for setting the expiration date and the quantity threshold of the medical materials when the alarm information is sent out and the temperature and humidity information threshold of the medical material storage environment. The invention can effectively avoid the problems of various resource waste, medical material supply shortage and insufficient supply chain caused by human factors, imperfect management system and the like, so as to ensure the normal and effective operation of the medical supply chain.
assignees: The Second Medical Center Of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor and Method thereof
title_ko: 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor warning broadcasting system which receives a warning signal by using a media dualized into wired communications and a DMB broadcasting, and transfers a warning situation to people in a building, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a warning signal reception unit for receiving an external warning signal; and a main control unit for analyzing a warning signal received through the warning signal reception unit, verifying validity determination and redundancy determination, and notifying the received warning signal to the inside of the building according to a predetermined performance scenario if the warning signal is determined as a valid warning signal. Also, an indoor warning broadcasting receiver for notifying the warning situation to residents in the building which exists as a shadow area in a warning wave of a conventional method is installed, and the warning situation is notified to the residents by using indoor emergency broadcasting equipment or a premises broadcasting facility which are equipped in the building, thereby reducing or preventing death and injury, and property damage to actively cope with the warning situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유선통신과 DMB 방송으로 이중화된 매체를 이용하여 경보신호를 수신한 후, 이에 따른 경보 상황을 건물 내 사람들에게 전달하는 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 외부의 경보신호를 수신받는 경보신호수신부 및 상기 경보신호수신부를 통해 수신된 경보신호를 분석하여 유효성 판단과 중복성 판단의 검증과정을 거친 후, 유효한 경보신호라고 판단되면 상기 수신된 경보신호를 미리 설정된 수행 시나리오에 따라 건물 내부로 알리도록 하는 메인제어부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명의 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 따르면, 기존방식의 경보 전파에 음영지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전파하기 위한 옥내 경보 방송수신기를 설치하고, 건물 내에 구비하고 있는 옥내 비상 방송설비나 구내 방송시설을 이용하여 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전달함으로써, 경보상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of emergency communication processing system based on cloud perception
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of emergency communication processing systems based on cloud perception, the system mainly consists of three parts: realizing empty world information collection storage in cloud center, assimilate forecasting centre and realize information assimilation and forecast, warning information distribution platform realizes that warning information updates and publication.Firstly, cloud center is completed the acquisition of information by satellite main website, the meteorological equipment such as airship and weather radar and is stored based on cloud framework；Secondly, assimilation forecasting centre carries out assimilation processing to acquired various information using 4D-WRF-EnSRF algorithm as core, and warning information distribution platform is sent into a manner of cloud resource；Finally, warning information distribution platform establishes warning information delivery network, warning information is being sent at the first time in a manner of DAB, internet and network etc. to disaster field, guarantee rescue action performs effectively and masses' rapid evacuation.

title_en: A method of forest fire footprint is extracted based on remotely-sensed data
abstract_en: A method of forest fire footprint is extracted based on remotely-sensed data, belongs to remote sensing technology field.The present invention passes through selected target list scape brulee image, it counts the number of tested fire detecting point and extracts ranks number of all tested fire detecting points in the target list scape brulee image and be used as a data set, then the data set is clustered using DBSCAN algorithm, to divide event of fire, extraction obtains the brulee information of event of fire each time.The present invention provides a kind of new tools that fire footprint is extracted based on remote sensing technology, and are suitble to all remote sensing brulee data products.Since DBSCAN algorithm realizes the applicability of space clustering, so that the accuracy for obtaining result is high, it can be used as an important supplement of fire risk assessment, the accuracy and validity for improving fire risk assessment, also can be used as important parameter and participate in the early prediction of forest fire management, plan for fire protection and fire, early warning.

title_en: YOLOv 7-based intelligent identification and early warning method for landslide of dam slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a YOLOv 7-based intelligent identification and early warning method for a side slope landslide of a dam, which comprises the following steps: collecting image data of landslide hazard of the dam slope, and labeling the screened image data; preprocessing image data, dividing a data set, and sending a training set into a network model for training; the verification set verifies the training result and updates the weight file of the network model to obtain the optimal weight file of the dam slope landslide detection model; and performing high-resolution processing on the test set, and then testing the network model to evaluate the performance. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the accuracy of identifying the landslide of the dam side slope is improved, the automation level of identifying and early warning the landslide of the dam side slope is improved, the dangerous situation of collapse and landslide of the dam side slope can be automatically identified and positioned, real-time monitoring and early warning of the landslide of the dam side slope are realized, and the safety and stability of the landslide of the reservoir side slope are improved.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO;NANCHANG INST TECH

title_en: Natural disaster aerial photographing monitoring and big data early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster aerial photography monitoring and big data early warning system in the natural disaster early warning field, which comprises a data processing base station and an unmanned aerial vehicle; acquiring and storing a historical environment model around a river channel through a data processing base station; collecting real-time image information and real-time weather information around the river channel in real time through the unmanned aerial vehicle; the data processing base station marks the historical environment model again based on brightness change or brightness change of plant coordinate points in the real-time image, so that disaster-affected water areas and lands can be distinguished according to the image data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the early warning is conveniently carried out by predicting the follow-up trend of water flow based on boundary establishment of the disaster-affected water areas in the updated historical environment model.

title_en: Warning Broadcasting System Using Two-Way Radio Transceiver
title_ko: 무전기를 이용한 경고방송 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a warning broadcast system comprising a situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device, an emergency situation monitoring device, and a radio. According to the warning broadcast system of the present invention, the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device transmits a video of a surrounding situation in real time in a radio communications scheme using a first channel. Also, the emergency situation monitoring device receives the video of the surrounding situation in real time through the first channel, and outputs the received video of the surrounding situation on a display unit. When a security guard determines that an emergency situation occurs in the surrounding of the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device by the video of the surrounding situation output by the display unit, the radio transmits a warning voice of the security guard in a radio communications scheme using a second channel. Furthermore, the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device receives a signal of the warning voice in real time through the second channel, and outputs the received signal of the warning voice to a speaker unit as a warning broadcast. Therefore, according to the warning broadcast system of the present invention, a conventional system can be used by slightly changing the configuration of a conventional system installed in an apartment complex, thereby constructing and efficiently operating the same with the low costs.
abstract_ko: 상황 감시 및 경고방송 출력 장치, 위급상황 모니터링 장치; 및 무전기를 포함하는 경고방송 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 경고방송 시스템에서, 상기 상황 감시 및 경고방송 출력 장치는 주변 상황에 관한 동영상을 실시간으로 그리고 제1 채널을 사용하는 무전기 통신방식으로 전송하고, 상기 위급상황 모니터링 장치는 상기 제1 채널을 통하여 실시간으로 상기 주변 상황 동영상을 수신하고, 그렇게 수신한 상기 주변 상황 동영상을 디스플레이부에 출력한다. 경비가 상기 디스플레이부에 의하여 출력된 상기 주변 상황 동영상에 의하여 상기 상황 감시 및 경고방송 출력 장치의 주변에 위급상황이 발생한 것으로 판단한 경우, 상기 무전기는 상기 경비의 경고 음성을 제2 채널을 사용하는 무전기 통신방식으로 전송하고, 상기 상황 감시 및 경고방송 출력 장치는 상기 제2 채널을 통하여 실시간으로 상기 경고 음성 신호를 수신하고, 그렇게 수신한 상기 경고 음성 신호를 스피커부에 경고방송으로 출력한다. 따라서, 본 발명의 경고방송 시스템은 기존에 아파트 단지에 설치된 시스템의 구성을 약간만 변경함으로써 기존 시스템을 거의 그대로 사용할 수 있어 적은 비용으로 구축할 수 있고, 또한 적은 비용으로 그리고 효율적으로 운영할 수 있다.

title_en: Indication and transmission method for system message update of earthquake and tsunami warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indication and transmission method for the system message update of an earthquake and tsunami warning system (ETWS). The indication method comprises the following step: whena minor announcement message of the ETWS is updated, a base station indicates the update of the minor announcement message of the ETWS in a paging message by a paging identifier beyond a field of a main announcement message of the ETWS. Through the technical scheme of the invention, a terminal can distinguish the updates of the main announcement message and the minor announcement message of the ETWS.

title_en: A kind of method of the CAE Mechanics Simulations based on BIM information models
abstract_en: It is reconstructed the invention discloses a kind of method of the CAE Mechanics Simulations based on BIM information models, including by BIM building 3-D geometric models by lattice simplified system, the BIM threedimensional models after simplification is imported into CAE Mechanics Simulation systems；The data message in BIM information model systems is extracted, by judging the attribute for changing information, the data for influenceing Mechanics Simulation are sent to CAE Mechanics Simulation systems, and drive CAE Mechanics Simulation system updates；The mechanical information that CAE Mechanics Simulation models after renewal are obtained feeds back to BIM information models, and the mechanical information that calculating is obtained is shown from BIM information models.When carrying out architectural design on BIM by the application architectural design personnel of the present invention, may be referred to mechanical information, improve the efficiency of design, and during construction in later period can in construction due to caused by stress destruction disaster carry out effective early warning, avoid repeating to model simultaneously, it is cost-effective.

title_en: Dynamic elastic power supply recovery method and system for urban power system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic elastic power supply recovery method of an urban power system under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps that a V2G system performs an operation period and collects road network EV traffic data during disaster early warning; providing electric energy support for the urban power grid by adopting EV resources at a temporary V2G interaction station in the disaster, and dispatching maintenance teams according to traffic data to carry out rush repair operation on a fault line; the maintenance team updates the rush-repair scheme in real time by adopting an optimized scheduling method considering the V2G data and repairs the next fault equipment; repeating the steps until all the fault devices are salvaged. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the dynamic elastic power supply recovery method of the urban power system under typhoon disasters. The invention is beneficial to realizing the quick recovery of the post-disaster system and improving the elasticity of the system; the invention has high reliability, good accuracy and higher efficiency.

title_en: Geological disaster pregnancy environment health monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disasters, in particular to a method for monitoring and early warning the health of a geological disaster pregnancy environment, which acquires the influence factors updated in real time such as the topography factors, the geological structure factors, the hydrologic factors, the engineering factors, the historical disaster conditions and the like of an evaluation area by utilizing the Internet of things, and by constructing a health assessment index system of the disaster recovery environment, the regional health risk fine assessment of the disaster recovery environment is completed by utilizing the powerful geographic analysis function of the GIS, and the geological disasters are prevented and treated.

title_en: Oil field production is with drawing and enclose warning line device
abstract_en: The invention provides a pull-enclosing warning line device for oilfield production, and relates to the technical field of pull-enclosing warning. The pull-surrounding warning line device for oil field production comprises a plurality of stand columns, a controller and a storage battery, wherein warning components are fixedly arranged at the tops of the stand columns, inserting grooves and containing grooves are respectively fixedly formed in two sides of the outer surfaces of the stand columns, a mechanical coded lock is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer surfaces of the inserting grooves, locking strips of the mechanical coded lock completely penetrate through the inserting grooves and are in sliding connection with the inserting grooves, rotating rods are embedded in the inner tops and the inner bottoms of the stand columns in a common rotating mode, and elastic reset components are jointly arranged between the rotating rods and the inner walls of the stand columns. Through the combination of the foldable support rod component and the driving hand wheel, the stable support of rapid unfolding is realized, and the folding type support rod can be compact and folded through the storage hole. The warning belt which is matched with the scroll spring to automatically retract and release is used for solving the technical problems that the traditional device is difficult to carry and the portable device is easy to topple while ensuring the wind resistance.

title_en: Building vibration control system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a building vibration control system applicable to a plurality of buildings which share an earthquake detector and a vibration data analysis device.SOLUTION: Earthquake data creation means 8 of a vibration data analysis device 4 creates predicted earthquake data for respective regions on the basis of either vibration data transmitted from an earthquake detector 1 through the Internet 3 or earthquake data included in the emergency earthquake warning transmitted from the Meteorological Agency 2 through the Internet 3, and geological data 6 stored in a storage device 5. Control data creation means 9 creates control data corresponding to a plurality of active vibration control devices 12, 13, 15, 18, 20 and 21 on the basis of the predicted earthquake data created by the earthquake data creation means 8, and building data 7 stored in the storage device 5, and outputs the control data to the corresponding active vibration control devices 12, 13, 15, 18, 20 and 21 through the Internet 3. Then, the active vibration control devices 12, 13, 15, 18, 20 and 21 operate in a manner that cancels out vibration of the buildings 11, 14, 17 and 19 due to an earthquake.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Apparatus for remotely releasing false alarm of alarm receiver
title_ko: 경보 수신기의 오경보를 원격에서 해제하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for remotely cancelling a false alert of an alert receiver. More specifically, a false alert remote cancelation device that can cancel a false alert is connected to an alert receiver that is not equipped with a networking function. Accordingly, if an alert sounds in a situation where no actual fire has occurred due to a false alert from the alert receiver, the alert is canceled by physically pressing an alert cancelation button through the false alert remote cancelation device under the remote control of a manager, or a communication port for system maintenance is used to electronically cancel the alert. As a result, conveniences of residents caused by frequent false alerts of the alert receiver can be relieved, and unnecessary firefighting dispatch can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경보 수신기의 오경보를 원격에서 해제하는 장치에 관한 것으로, 네트워킹 기능이 구비되어 있지 않은 경보 수신기에, 오경보를 해제할 수 있는 오경보 원격 해제 장치를 연결하고, 상기 경보 수신기의 오경보로 인해 실제 화재가 발생하지 않은 상황에서 경보가 울리면, 관리자의 원격제어에 따라 상기 오경보 원격 해제 장치를 통해 경보해제 버튼을 물리적으로 눌러주어 경보를 해제하거나, 혹은 시스템 유지보수를 위한 통신포트를 이용하여 전자적으로 경보를 해제함으로써, 상기 경보 수신기의 잦은 오경보에 의한 거주민들의 불편함을 해소하고, 불필요한 소방 출동을 억제할 수 있도록 하는 경보 수신기의 오경보를 원격에서 해제하는 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Arm type terminal comprehensive sensing and intelligent interaction emergency disposal method based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The position of each arm type interactive terminal is interacted with real-time information of a central server side, global monitoring and data acquisition based on a disaster situation site are carried out, the acquired data are sent to a rear server, an early warning grade is given based on meteorological information and environmental information of the site, a nearest withdrawing point and a withdrawing path are given based on longitude, latitude, altitude and direction of the site, and emergency disposal of emergency events is facilitated. The wireless communication module is provided with communication modes such as 4G, 5G, WIFI, DMR and LORA, and the design has the advantage that in places without networks and base stations, field personnel can contact other equipment through the communication module under any emergency.

title_en: Cable damage prevention early warning device and cable damage prevention early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable damage prevention early warning device and a cable damage prevention early warning method, wherein the cable damage prevention early warning device comprises a marker pile and an early warning module which are arranged in a cable laying area, and a mounting cavity is arranged in the marker pile; the early warning module comprises an alarm, an air cylinder and an air pipe, wherein the alarm is arranged on the outer side of the sign pile, the alarm is connected with a power supply, a first switch is connected between the alarm and the power supply, the air cylinder is inflated to extend out of a piston rod of the air cylinder and keep pressing the first switch, and the first switch is closed to enable the alarm to be powered off; the trachea buries in the area of laying and is located the top of underground cable, and tracheal one end shutoff setting, the other end communicates with the cylinder is inside, when the trachea is destroyed, the cylinder is inside to be released in order to retract the piston rod, in order to open first switch messenger alarm circular telegram and send the early warning. The cable anti-damage early warning device disclosed by the invention can be fully covered above the underground cable through the air pipe so as to early warn and protect the underground cable, and is low in cost and small in occupied ground space.

title_en: Dynamic disaster monitoring system and method for coal and rock mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic disaster monitoring system and a method for coal and rock mining areas, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a model construction module, a monitoring module, a data processing module and an early warning module; the model building module generates a virtual mining area model based on internal construction data of the coal and rock mining area; the monitoring module collects coal and rock condition data of the non-mining area and the mining area working face all over, and comprises the non-mining area coal and rock condition data, mining area working face stress information, mining area working face microseismic signals and corresponding coordinates; the data processing module updates the virtual mining area model in real time based on the coal and rock condition data, and analyzes the coal and rock disaster condition based on the coal and rock condition data; the early warning module sends out early warning based on the disaster condition of the coal rock and displays the disaster place in the virtual mining area model. The invention is based on the digital twin technology, and can more accurately predict the occurrence and development trend of dynamic disasters in coal and rock mining areas through the fusion of the actual monitoring data and the digital twin model.

title_en: Ocean early warning intelligent question-answering method based on large language model and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a large language model-based ocean early warning intelligent question-answering method and a related device, which relate to the technical field of ocean early warning intelligent question-answering, match a question input by a user with each type of task chain and each vectorized corpus in a vector database, fill the question and target vectorized corpus into a prompt word template of a target task chain, output answers to the question by utilizing an ocean early warning large language model, be applied to ocean early warning business work, realize the ocean early warning intelligent question-answering, vectorize the ocean early warning corpus, construct the vector database, search and reorder the question input by the user in the vector database to obtain the target vectorized corpus, restrict and trace the answer of the ocean early warning large language model, update the vector database when the ocean early warning corpus is updated, and meet the accuracy and timeliness requirements of the ocean early warning business.

title_en: System, apparatus and method for providing automatic emergency alert service based on common service and computer-readable medium having thereon program performing function embodying the same
title_ko: 공통 서비스 기반 재난 경보 서비스 제공 시스템, 재난경보 서비스 제공 장치 및 재난 경보 서비스 제공 방법과이를 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 판독가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system, an apparatus and a method for providing a disaster alerting service based on a common service and a computer-readable medium with a program performing a function realizing the same are provided to prevent inefficient use of a frequency due to duplicate transmission of a disaster alerting service and prevent a cost increase of transmission network installation and maintenance. CONSTITUTION: A system for providing a disaster alerting service based on a common service includes a disaster alerting assignee server(300), a service provider server(350), a multiplex business person server(400), and a receiver(500). The disaster alerting assignee server generates disaster alert. The service provider server provides a DMB service. The multiplex business person server combines the disaster alerting service generated based on disaster alert with DMB data and transmits it.

title_en: Emergency management system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency management system and a method, which comprises an information acquisition module, an information reporting module and an information screening module, wherein the personal data information of a managed person is mapped onto a digital map through a digital map meshing technology, and the personal data information is subjected to data screening; screening out data abnormal information according to a preset mechanism; the information early warning module sends early warning to a system manager according to the data abnormal information, so that the system manager can make corresponding decisions conveniently; the information notification module notifies the related party to complete further processing in cooperation with the system manager after the system manager makes a decision; the information tracking module is used for continuously updating information after the managed person arrives at the association party and providing the updated information for the system manager to follow up, so that the problem that the efficiency of the existing top-down troubleshooting mode is too low is solved, the manager of the emergency management system can timely acquire the real-time information of the managed person, and the important emergency can be timely and effectively managed.
assignees: GEOVIS SHENZHEN DIGITAL TECH INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Geological engineering integrated gas storage risk early warning method and system based on microseism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk early warning method and a risk early warning system for a geological engineering integrated gas storage based on microseism, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a geological engineering integrated environment, and constructing a basic geological engineering integrated environment model according to basic data fusion; analyzing small faults and cracks which cannot be identified in a three-dimensional earthquake scale according to actual measurement microseism event data, using the small faults and cracks to update a geological model, loading and updating the small faults and cracks into a geological engineering integrated environment model, re-planning a risk identification area in the updated geological engineering integrated environment model according to guidance of historical risk data, and performing early warning and identification on the microseism risk of the gas storage, wherein the early warning and identification are based on the geological engineering integrated environment model, combining microseism dynamic data and injection and production dynamic data, performing fusion analysis on the running condition of the gas storage, and performing risk identification and early warning. The method solves the problem of single risk identification of the prior gas storage, and carries out risk identification early warning from the point of multi-source data fusion.

title_en: AI-based coal mine underground and roadway three-dimensional earthquake dynamic monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic monitoring, in particular to an AI-based coal mine underground and roadway three-dimensional earthquake dynamic monitoring system which comprises an underground edge computing node cluster module, a multi-source heterogeneous data fusion processing module, a three-dimensional geological dynamic modeling module, an abnormal feature evolution analysis module, a visual early warning decision module and a three-dimensional visual interface, wherein the underground edge computing node cluster module is used for laying edge computing nodes on a mining working face and a transportation roadway, the multi-source heterogeneous data fusion processing module is used for receiving an original signal data set, performing space-time alignment and feature decoupling processing to generate a standardized seismoelectric feature matrix, the three-dimensional geological dynamic modeling module is used for generating a three-dimensional geological dynamic model updated in real time through a dynamic voxel compensation algorithm based on the standardized seismoelectric feature matrix, and the abnormal feature evolution analysis module is used for receiving time sequence data of the three-dimensional geological dynamic model to construct a space-time two-dimensional abnormal degree evolution map. According to the invention, through creatively designing a six-level progressive processing architecture, the performance of the coal mine underground and roadway three-dimensional earthquake dynamic monitoring system is obviously improved.
assignees: RES INSTITUTE OF COAL GEOPHYSICAL EXPLORATION OF CHINA NATIONAL ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Mountain landslide grading early warning method based on multi-mode data change characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide grading early warning method based on multi-modal data change characteristics, which comprises the steps of establishing a mountain digital twin body, deploying a multi-node sensor network in a target area, configuring an edge calculation unit, collecting geological data in real time, screening the geological data based on the mountain digital twin body to form effective local data, constructing a lightweight multi-modal neural network model at each node, dynamically searching super parameters by utilizing an ant colony optimization algorithm to generate an encryption model weight update quantity package, dynamically calculating node weights by a central server according to disaster feature vectors output by the digital twin body, weighting and polymerizing to generate a global model and directionally distributing and updating, fusing real-time monitoring data and model prediction results, executing millimeter-level disaster evolution simulation through a variable-step physical engine, triggering advanced early warning signals when a deduction prediction risk exceeds a threshold value, and remarkably improving edge model adaptability, federal aggregation precision and early warning advance.

title_en: Adaptive relay node selection method for alert message propagation in inter-vehicle communication
title_ko: 차량간 통신에서 긴급메시지전파를 위한 적응적 릴레이노드선정방법
abstract_en: An adaptive relay node selection method for transmitting an alert message in communication between vehicles is provided to realize a short message transmission waiting time even though a node is not located in an edge of a communication range, thereby minimizing a message transmission delay time. An original source node and location information of a source node are extracted. Location information of a node is obtained through a GPS(Global Positioning System). It is determined whether a received message is re-transmitted by comparing a broadcast range included in the received message with a distance from the original source node. If the node belongs to the broadcast range, a message transmission waiting time is calculated and selected. If the message transmission waiting time is expired, location information of a source node included in a broadcast message is changed into location information of a node. The received message is re-transmitted.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량간 통신에서 긴급메시지전파를 위한 적응적 릴레이노드 선정방법에 관한 것으로, 수신한 메시지에 포함되어 있는 원시 소스노드와 소스노드의 위치정보를 추출하고 GPS를 통해 노드 자신의 위치정보를 획득하는 제1 단계; 상기 수신한 메시지 내에 포함되어있는 브로드캐스트 범위와 원시 소스노드로부터의 거리를 비교하여 수신한 메시지의 재전송 여부를 결정하는 제2 단계; 만약 노드가 브로드캐스트 범위 내에 있다면, 소스노드로부터의 거리를 이용하여 메시지 전송 대기시간을 계산하여 선택하는 제3 단계; 및 상기 메시지 전송 대기시간이 만료되면 브로드캐스트 메시지 내에 포함되어 있는 소스노드의 위치정보를 자신의 위치정보로 바꾼 다음 수신한 메시지를 재전송하는 제4 단계;를 포함하여 이루어지고, 상기 제3 단계의 브로드캐스트 범위는 원시 소스노드로부터 메시지가 전파될 거리를 나타내는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     브로드캐스트, 시간창 예약, 릴레이노드, 전송대기시간

title_en: Method and apparatus for notifying si update, eab update and pws message in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 si 업데이트, eab 업데이트 및 pws 메시지를 통지하기 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 시스템 정보(SI; system information)를 수신하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 향상된 커버리지 내에 있거나 셀 대역폭보다 좁은 대역폭에서 동작하는 단말(UE; userequipment)은, SI 업데이트, 지진 및 쓰나미 경보 시스템(ETWS; earthquake and tsunami warning system) 통지, 상용 모바일 경보 시스템(CMAS; commercial mobile alert system) 통지 또는 확장된 접속 차단(EAB; extended access barring) 수정 중 적어도 하나에 대한 지시를 PDCCH(physical downlink control channel)를 통해 네트워크로부터 수신하며, 네트워크로부터 수신된 지시에 따라 시스템 정보를 수신한다.

title_en: V2x communication method and apparatus for sending warning message in v2x communication system supporting sidelink
title_ko: 사이드링크를 지원하는 v2x 통신 시스템에서 경고 메시지를 전송하는 v2x 통신 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present embodiments provide a V2X communication device and a method thereof which change a communication manner with a roadside device based on an adjacent roadside device and another vehicle condition included in a V2X message and receive a V2X message from the roadside device through a direct (PC5) interface between terminals according to the communication manner.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예들은 V2X 메시지에 포함된 다른 차량 상황 및 인접한 노변 장치를 기준으로 노변 장치와의 통신 방식을 변경하고, 통신 방식에 따라 단말 간 직접(PC5) 인터페이스를 통해서 노변 장치로부터 V2X 메시지를 수신하는 V2X 통신 장치 및 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: UIF UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV

title_en: Method and device for updating public warning system (PWS) secret key
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for updating a public warning system (PWS) secret key. The method comprises the following steps of receiving an updated PWS secret key by user equipment (UE) when preset conditions are met, wherein the updated PWS secret key is issued from network side equipment through a non-access stratum down message; updating a current PWS secret key by the UE by adopting the received PWS secret key. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, an effect that the safety protection of a PWS is enhanced through real-time updating of the PWS secret key is achieved.

title_en: Smart home Disasters Prevention and Rescue System
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of smart home Disasters Prevention and Rescue Systems, comprising: cabinet comprising outer container and interior case；The level-one discharge pipe line being connected, water tank, the first connecting tube, the second connecting tube, the first water pump and the second water pump is respectively set with inside in outer container top, realizes circulating for water；When pressing control button, then processor controls the first delivery device respectively and interior case is released outer container, and water receiving tank is released groove by the second delivery device；The signal enabling line memory module that processor receives control button transmission obtains conduct route information, passes through the conduct route of driving mechanisms control cabinet；And fire protection warning platform is sent to processor by the location transmission of locating module positioning cabinet.For the present invention in the case where that can not withdraw, trapped person can be to self-insurance be carried out in cabinet, and starting water circulation waits for rescue, while being positioned by intelligent control, and signal transmission reduction rescue period has greatly ensured the life security of trapped person.

title_en: Multi-linkage personnel evacuation system and method in tunnel and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-linkage personnel evacuation system, a method and a storage medium in a tunnel, wherein the system comprises: the accident identification module is used for monitoring and identifying accident information in the tunnel and sending the accident information to the central management module and the evacuation control module; the central management module is used for receiving an evacuation instruction of a manager and sending the evacuation instruction to the evacuation control module; and the evacuation control module is used for generating and updating an evacuation scheme in real time according to the evacuation instruction and the accident information. According to the evacuation system for people in the tunnel provided by the embodiment of the disclosure, the evacuation channel guide route is automatically started according to the identified emergency accident and event situation, and the evacuation route and the control instruction can be updated in real time according to the latest situation of the accident and the real-time position of the evacuated people, so that the concomitant transmission is realized, and the effectiveness and timeliness of the evacuation method for people in the tunnel are greatly improved.

title_en: Early warning satellite system
abstract_en: The invention provides an early warning satellite system, comprising: a high orbit reconnaissance satellite and a plurality of low orbit early warning satellites; the high-orbit reconnaissance satellite reconnaissance the video field range, and sends first target tracking information to the low-orbit early warning satellite; under the condition that the tracked target is positioned in the field of view of the low-orbit early warning satellite, acquiring second target tracking information of the tracked target, and transmitting the second target tracking information to the high-orbit reconnaissance satellite; and the high orbit reconnaissance satellite iteratively updates the first target tracking information according to the second target tracking information, and sends the updated first target tracking information to the low orbit early warning satellite. According to the early warning satellite system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem of high dynamic performance of the tracked target in the early warning task can be well solved by adopting a high-orbit general survey and low-orbit detailed survey mode, and the early warning task can be timely adjusted, so that the tracked target is always in the field of view of a certain low-orbit early warning satellite.
assignees: PLA STRATEGIC SUPPORT FORCE AEROSPACE ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Urban multi-class security risk early warning method and system based on federal super network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city multi-category security risk early warning method and system based on a federal super network, comprising the steps of receiving first information, updating model parameters corresponding to all risk early warning clients through the super network to obtain updated parameters, sending the updated parameters to the corresponding risk early warning clients, and obtaining second information, wherein the model parameters are obtained by training a preset SC Nor-transducer model through historical data collected by a sensor group corresponding to risks, the SC Nor-transducer model is used for sequentially processing input through a sequence normalization layer, a sequence conversion layer, an encoder, a feature mapping layer and a sequence solution normalization layer to obtain output, and the model parameters corresponding to all risk early warning clients are updated through the super network to obtain updated parameters. The invention can effectively influence the increase of the city scale, the increase of the data volume and the data isomerism, and determine the occurrence type or cause of the disaster.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA;CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD SICHUAN BRANCH;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Ocean disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of marine disaster monitoring and early warning. A marine disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data comprises a multi-source data fusion module, an intelligent modeling module and a real-time early warning module, wherein the method comprises the steps of cleaning and storing multi-source data after wavelet transformation downsampling through edge computing nodes, extracting space-time characteristics through a space-time transducer network, calibrating predicted values through a Coriolis force correction equation to generate future 24-hour disaster risk probability and tide level and wind speed key parameters, triggering hierarchical early warning based on a dynamic risk map, and pushing through a mobile network, emergency broadcasting and other multi-channel seconds. The method reduces the tide level prediction error to less than or equal to 0.2 meter, and effectively solves the problems of high false alarm rate and update hysteresis of the traditional system due to early warning response delay of <10 seconds.

title_en: Scuba safety solution
title_ko: 스쿠버안전 시스템
abstract_en: A scuba safety system is provided to attach a wireless transceiver for a client and to exchange location information and state information of a scuba with a wireless communication apparatus mounted on a fishing boat, thereby preventing accidents of a scuba diver. A wireless communication apparatus(100) for a server is mounted on a lower part of a ship body, and performs communication for exchanging information with a wireless communication apparatus(103) for a client mounted on a scuba diver. A monitoring system(102) mounted on a fishing boat filters and processes data obtained from the wireless communication apparatus(100) for the server, and configures the data so that a user is able to easily see the data. A sea safety control center(104) receives information of the monitoring system(102) through a WCDMA(Wideband Code Division Multiple Access) network or a CDMA2000 network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스쿠버의 부력조절기의 앞면이나 손목, 어깨, 발목 등 특정 부위에 탈부착할 수 있는 클라이언트용 무선 송수신기를 부착하여 스쿠버의 위치 및 상태 정보를 어선에 장착된 서버용 무선통신기와 정보를 교환하여 스쿠버다이버에 일어날 수 있는 사고를 미연에 방지하는데 목적을 둔다.   
      본 시스템은 어선에 모니터링 시스템을 장착하고 송수신기는 배아래 중앙에 장착하여 수신부를 통하여 수신된 스쿠버의 정보를 분석하고 스쿠버 다이버의 안전을 위해 주위 환경에 대한 정보를 송신부를 통해 송신하도록 하는 시스템이다. 
      스쿠버에 장착된 송수신기는 스쿠버의 위치를 주기적으로 갱신을 하며 갱신정보를 저장할 수 있는 저장부와 정보를 제어할 수 있는 제어부, 저장된 정보를 송신할 수 있는 송신부로 나누어진다.  
      저장부는 스쿠버의 인적사항과 다이버가 입수하는 지역, 해수의 온도, 해수의 깊이, 산소통에 남아 있는 산소량을 체크 하여 저장할 수 있다   
      제어부는 일정한 시간마다 스쿠버와 선박의 신호의 세기에 따른 선박과 스쿠버의 거리정보, 온도센서를 통한 해수 온도, 산소의 용량을 체크 하여 저장부에 저장할 수 있도록 하며 동시에 그 정보를 송신할 수 있도록 송신부에 제어권을 넘긴다.   
      송신부는 제어부에서 요청된 명령어를 판독하여 저장부의 데이터를 체크 하여 갱신된 값이 있을 경우 무선 통신을 이용하여 일정한 주기로 서버용 수신기에 데이터 를 송신한다.  
      스쿠버다이버에게 장착된 송수신기는 용도에 따라 LED의 색깔을 다르게 나타낸다. 
      클라이언트 송수신기의 LED는 일반적인 경우에는 파란색을 표시하게 되고 위험 수위가 높지않은 위험 감지시 노란색을 점등하게 되며 선박에서의 위험 신호를 수신하거나 위험한 사항에 빠져 SOS 버튼을 동작할 경우 빨간색으로 점등을 하게 된다.   스쿠버다이버의 송수신기는 위급사항을 알릴 수 있는 SOS 버튼과 LED가 장착이 되어있어 위급사항 발생시 SOS 버튼을 누르게 되면 순간적으로 SOS 정보가 담긴 신호의 출력을 높여 송신 영역을 넓히게 되고 동시에 스쿠버 다이버에게 장착된 송수신기의 LED가 빨간색으로 점등하게 된다. 
      또한, 배터리의 잔량이 없을 경우와 산소통의 산소량이 1차 한계치에 도달할 경우 송수신기의 LED에 노란색을 점등하고 제어부에서 산소량과 배터리 정보를 송신부로 전송하여 송신부는 이 정보를 송신하게 된다. 
       
      선박의 모니터링 시스템은 일정한 주기로 수신되는 정보로 스쿠버 다이버의 위치와 스쿠버 다이버의 신상정보, 스쿠버다이버의 남아 있는 산소량, 해수의 온도 정보를 모니터링 할 수 있으며 수신된 정보를 분석하여 해수의 온도가 갑자기 올라가거나 스쿠버의 위치가 너무 멀어지거나 스쿠버의 남아있는 산소량의 기준 한계 값을 넘었을 경우 경보를 알려주게 된다. 
      또, 무선 통신을 통하여 외부 환경(파도의 세기 및 바람, 날씨 등)에 따라 위험 신호를 스쿠버 다이버에게 보낼 수 있도록 한다.  
      스쿠버 다이버는 해류에 휩쓸리거나 발목이 해초에 끼이는 위급한 상황이 발생했을 시 장착된 무선 송수신기의 SOS 버튼을 통하여 발생한 신호 영역에 있는 서버용 무선통신기가 장착된 선박 및 해양경찰어선에 알릴 수 있다  
      모니터링 시스템에 장착된 대기중인 선박이 스쿠버 다이버를 구하기 힘든 상황이 발생시 선박에서는 모니터링 시스템을 동작하여 무선통신망(WCDMA,CDMA200)을 통해 해양 안전관리소에 선박의 위치와 선박의 위치에 따른 스쿠버 다이버의 위치를 함께 보내어 인명 구조를 신속히 할 수 있도록 한다 
       
     스쿠버다이버,저장부,송신부,제어부.모니터링 시스템,LED,SOS버튼, 클라이언트용 무선통신, 서버용 무선통신

title_en: Wired and wireless voice guiding terminal with multiple sensor and method for emergency message transmitting
title_ko: 유무선 음성안내 복합센서 단말기 및 이를 이용한 비상대피 음성안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wired and wireless voice guide terminal with a composite sensor and a voice guide method for emergency evacuation using the same, which can automatically select and play a voice file in adaptation to current locations and situations or can select and play the voice file from the outside based on detection information including a body detection sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, a gas sensor, a smoke sensor, etc. The wired and wireless voice guide terminal of the present invention comprises: a sensor detection unit selectively including the body detection sensor, the smoke sensor, the gas sensor, and the temperature and humidity sensor, etc.; a voice file storage unit having a USB or an SD memory which can store a plurality of voice files and music files such as an MP3 or the like; a voice output unit including a speaker, an amplifier, and an MP3 play circuit; a wired and wireless communication unit connecting to an external server to transmit and receive data; and a microprocessor connected to the sensor detection unit to convert a sensor detection value into a digital value and transmit the same to an external server through the wired and wireless communication unit, receiving an external server command through the wired and wireless communication unit to select the voice files of the voice file storage unit, transmitting a command to play the voice files through the voice output unit, and renewing the MP3 files of the voice file storage unit with MP3 files provided from the external server through the wired and wireless communication unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체감지센서, 연기센서, 가스센서, 온습도센서 등으로 선택 구성되는 센서 감지부와 MP3 등의 복수의 음성 파일, 음악 파일을 저장할 수 있는 USB 또는 SD 메모리로 구성되는 음성 파일 저장부, 스피커와 앰프, MP3 플레이 회로로 구성되는 음성 출력부, 외부 서버에 연결하여 데이터를 송수신할 수 있는 유무선 통신부, 상기 센서 감지부와 연결되어 센서 감지값을 디지털 값으로 변환하여 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버로 전송하고, 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버 명령을 수신하여 음성 파일 저장부의 음성 파일을 선택하고, 음성출력부를 통하여 재생할 수 있도록 명령을 송신하고, 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버에서 제공하는 MP3파일로 음성 파일 저장부의 MP3 파일을 갱신할 수 있는 마이크로프로세서로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 유무선 음성안내 복합센서 단말기와 이를 이용한 비상대피 음성안내 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Compact type apparatus for storage of cable
title_ko: 원통부를 구비한 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치
abstract_en: A compact-type cable storage device equipped with a cylindrical part of the present invention is equipped with: an inner disk having a spiral-type track formed on a front surface and a rear surface; an outer box body coupled to the front surface and the rear surface with the inner disk interposed therebetween; and a handle and a cable guider block capable of smoothly winding a cable withdrawn to the outside by rotating the inner disk, thereby having an advantage of granting a convenience of use to smoothly withdraw or introduce without the cable being entangled, preventing stress of a worker due to the entanglement of the cable and simultaneously improving workability and shortening working time, enabling to be easily carried when working in a power tunnel, a manhole, and a high-altitude work place since being enabled to be manufactured as a thin inner disk with a thickness slightly larger than that of the diameter of two strands of the cable to be used, and preventing an accident caused by a neglected cable (1) since being able to be immediately wound on the site after using the cable.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 원통부를 구비한 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치는 정면과 후면에 나선형 트랙이 형성된 내부 원판과, 내부 원판을 사이에 두고 정면과 후면에서 결합되는 외부 함체와, 내부 원판을 회전시켜 외부로 인출된 케이블을 원활하게 감을 수 있는 핸들과 케이블 가이더블록을 구비하고 있기 때문에 케이블의 엉킴없이 인출 또는 인입이 원활하도록 하는 사용의 편리성을 부여하고, 케이블의 엉킴으로 인한 작업자의 스트레스를 예방함과 동시에 작업성 향상 및 작업시간 단축하고, 사용하는 케이블 2가닥 직경보다 조금 큰 정도의 두께로 얇은 내부 원판으로 제작이 가능하므로 전력구, 맨홀 및 고소 작업개소 작업시 휴대가 용이하며, 케이블 사용 후 현장에서 즉시 감을 수 있으므로 방치되는 케이블(1)로 인한 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Mobile lamp trolley with windproof early warning and safety control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile lamp trolley with a windproof early warning and safety control system. The mobile lamp trolley comprises a lamp trolley pedestal, a hydraulic control system, an engine, an oil tank, a power generator, rotatable upright columns, hydraulic lifting connecting rods, illuminating lamp trays, a mobile lamp trolley touch control module and a wind power sensor, wherein the lamp trolley pedestal is provided with telescopic hydraulic support legs, a tyre is arranged at the lower part of each telescopic hydraulic support leg, and a travelling guide wheel is arranged at the front end of the lamp trolley pedestal; the hydraulic control system, the engine, the oil tank and the power generator are arranged inside the lamp trolley pedestal; the rotary upright columns are connected with the hydraulic control system; the hydraulic lifting connecting rods are connected with the rotatable upright columns; the illuminating lamp trays are connected with the hydraulic lifting connecting rods; the wind power sensor is connected with the hydraulic control system. The mobile lamp trolley disclosed by the invention integrates power generation and illumination; the wind power sensor is configured to inform the hydraulic control system to get the hydraulic lifting connecting rods down and retract the illumination lamp trays when the wind power reaches a preset value, and thus the safety accidents are avoided; the mobile lamp trolley is flexible to control and wide in applicability.
assignees: JIANGSU LONGEN POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Computer-implemented method and system for improving blockchain network communications
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented communication method. The method includes a mechanism for distributing blockchain-related communications and/or cryptocurrency-related communications such as alerts, notifications and updates to one or more recipients over an electronic network as efficiently and quickly as possible. Embodiments may use IPv6 multicasting to perform such improved communications. The communication may include code, flags, or filters that enable the communication to be targeted to a particular recipient and enable multicast group members that are not interested in or have no access to the communication to ignore the communication. Thus, there is an improvement in both processing resources and time. In some examples, the present disclosure may facilitate implementing a blockchain-related alarm key or system that may help a network to handle emergency situations or threats, thereby improving the security of the blockchain network.

title_en: In-vehicle Sound Wave Device for Providing Traffic Accident Emergency Rescue Service
title_ko: 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sound wave device for a vehicle to provide a traffic accident emergency rescue service, which comprises: a short-range module including at least one short-range wireless communication unit; a location module including a positioning module; a sensor module including one or more sensor units; and a control module. According to the present invention, an emergency mobilization service is automatically requested even if a user falls unconscious by a traffic accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치에 따르면, 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 음파장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보와 상기 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상을 통해 센싱된 방향정보를 하나 이상 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 실제 교통사고 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 교통사고 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보를 발화한 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하고 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: In-vehicle Sound Wave Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Battery Charging
title_ko: 배터리 충전 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an in-vehicle sound wave device to provide an emergency rescue service for battery charging, capable of automatically requesting the emergency rescue service for battery charging. According to the present invention, the in-vehicle sound wave device comprises a short-range communication module, a positioning module, a power module, and a control module.
