title_en: A kind of surface displacement gridding Dynamic Monitoring and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of surface displacement gridding Dynamic Monitoring and methods, including gridding layout stracture is arranged according to slumped mass geological condition, and data acquire on the spot, and data analyze and determine on the spot, and early warning is issued in operating mode selection and data processing；Comprehensive wireless sensor-based network technology, Computer Control Technology, inertial navigation technique, Data fusion technique, the full chain ground displacement data of Overall Acquisition slumped mass disaster body, realize slumped mass disaster entire area all standing monitoring, fully meet slumped mass ground displacement, monitoring cost is substantially reduced using this technology, and monitoring device volume is dexterous, it is convenient to lay, it is easily operated, the data processing unit of design not only may be implemented to issue sound-light alarm at the scene, scene can also be monitored in real time on backstage, it can realize that multi-angle is multi-faceted using data anastomosing algorithm to monitor slumped mass in real time, utmostly guarantee the validity of data, stability and accuracy, new technical support is provided for slumped mass monitoring.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: A kind of elevator rescue channel based on fault pre-alarming mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of elevator rescue channels based on fault pre-alarming mechanism, including security control center, cloud server, lift car, elevator monitoring terminal, ladder carries monitoring, ladder carries screen, elevator data collector, photoelectricity leveling inductor, weight sensor, linear velocity trans, elevator monitoring terminal, ladder carries monitoring, ladder carries screen, elevator data collector, photoelectricity leveling inductor, weight sensor, linear velocity trans are respectively mounted on the elevator car, and it is interconnected by conducting wire, elevator monitoring terminal is connected with the power supply system that elevator is run, elevator monitoring terminal also passes through network connection cloud server, the cloud server is connected by network with security control center.This system realizes that elevator faults early warning and lift facility operating status monitor in real time, when elevator malfunction accident occurs, trapped person and quick response processing are remotely pacified, upgrading updates cloud algorithm model in time, elevator significant trouble probability of happening is reduced, ensures boarding safety.
assignees: GUANGDONG COUNTRY GARDEN PROPERTY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Protective helmet for blind person based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent helmets for blind persons, and discloses a protective helmet for blind persons based on big data, which comprises an AI model, wherein the protective helmet module comprises: sensor integration module: a microprocessor integrating a high-speed GPU and an environment sensor, and collecting environment and position data; and a language interaction module: a microphone array integrating noise suppression and echo cancellation technology captures user voice, and an AI model is used for voice recognition; and an intelligent planning module: combining GPS positioning data, a map AP I and an AI model, and dynamically planning a safe and convenient route; anti-tracking security module: the camera captures a rear image, the AI face recognition algorithm recognizes and analyzes the facial expression and the behavior mode of the follower, and judges whether tracking behaviors exist or not by combining the position and time data; an emergency alert and communication module.

title_en: Trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster warning analysis, and particularly relates to a trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data. According to the invention, the accuracy and timeliness of disaster prediction are obviously improved through optimizing the matching rules and the threshold values in real time, the deep fusion and the efficient utilization of multi-source data are realized, scientific basis and technical support are provided for disaster early warning and emergency response, meanwhile, the system has self-adaptive learning capability, a model can be continuously optimized in continuously updated data, the dynamic accuracy of a prediction result is ensured, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING LIAOWANG SHENZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Locking apparatus for cabinet, locking/unlocking method for cabinet using the same
title_ko: 수납장 잠금 장치 및 이를 이용한 수납장 잠금 및 해제 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cabinet locking device and, more specifically, to a cabinet locking device and a cabinet locking and unlocking method using the same. The cabinet locking device is operated to automatically lock a cabinet if a door is closed and is operated to ring a warning sound and notify users (parents) of an access when an infant accesses to prevent an accident of the infant.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수납장 잠금 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 도어가 닫히면 자동으로 수납장이 잠금 처리되도록 구동되며, 영유아의 접근 시 경고음이 울리고 접근 사실을 사용자(부모)에게 알리도록 구동됨으로써, 영유아의 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 수납장 잠금 장치 및 이를 이용한 수납장 잠금 및 해제 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: dangerous situation warning system at work site based on artificial intelligence deep learning
title_ko: 인공지능 딥러닝 기반의 작업현장 위험상황 경보 시스템
abstract_en: A system for warning a workplace danger situation based on artificial intelligence deep learning comprises: a camera for acquiring a workplace image including a worker and a workplace vehicle; and a control device for analyzing the workplace image to set a static danger area around a place having a high risk of a safety accident and a dynamic danger area around the workplace vehicle, and wirelessly warning a worker terminal based on a distance between the worker having the worker terminal and the static danger area and the dynamic danger area. In this case, the control device changes a shape and a width of the dynamic risk area in consideration of a moving direction and a moving speed of the working vehicle. According to the present invention, the system for warning a workplace danger situation based on artificial intelligence deep learning may more actively and proactively perform safety accident prevention and warning functions.
abstract_ko: 인공지능 딥러닝 기반의 작업현장 위험상황 경보 시스템은 작업자 및 작업차량을 포함하는 작업현장 영상을 획득하는 카메라; 및 상기 작업현장 영상을 분석하여 안전사고 발생위험이 높은 장소 주변의 정적 위험영역 및 상기 작업차량 주변의 동적 위험영역을 설정하며, 상기 작업자 단말기를 소지한 작업자와 상기 정적 위험영역 및 상기 동적 위험영역 사이의 거리에 기초하여 작업자 단말기로 무선으로 경보하는 제어장치를 포함한다. 이때, 상기 제어장치는 상기 작업차량의 이동방향 및 이동속도를 고려하여 상기 동적 위험영역의 형태 및 넓이를 변경하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Headset with safety accident prevention and noise cancelling function and headset system using the same
title_ko: 안전사고 예방 및 노이즈 제거 기능을 갖는 헤드셋 및 이를 이용하는 헤드셋 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a headset having safety accident prevention and noise removal functions, and a headset system using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the headset having safety accident prevention and noise removal functions comprises: a microphone module including a first digital signal processor (DSP) for collecting and outputting an external sound and analyzing a warning sound output at a preset frequency from an external device and input; and a speaker module including a second DPS for reducing the sound input from the microphone to a first decibel or less through active noise canceling (ANC), and outputting the sound input from the microphone to a second decibel when the first DSP recognizes the warning sound. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the headset having safety accident prevention and noise removal functions and a headset system using the same suppress surrounding noise through an active noise removal method, and when a warning sound is generated, the noise removal is adjusted to output the warning sound and surrounding sound, thereby preventing a safety accident.
abstract_ko: 안전사고 예방 및 노이즈 제거 기능을 갖는 헤드셋 및 이를 이용하는 헤드셋 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 안전사고 예방 및 노이즈 제거 기능을 갖는 헤드셋은, 마이크를 구비하는 헤드셋에 있어서, 외부 소리를 집음하여 출력하며, 외부기기로부터 기 설정된 주파수로 출력되어 입력되는 경고음을 분석하는 제1DSP(digital signal processor)를 포함하는 마이크 모듈; 상기 마이크로부터 입력되는 소리를 능동형 소음 제거(ANC : Active Noise cancelling)를 통해 제1데시벨 이하로 저감하되, 상기 제1DSP가 상기 경고음을 인식하면 상기 마이크로부터 입력되는 소리를 제2데시벨로 출력하는 제2DPS를 포함하는 스피커 모듈;을 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 안전사고 예방 및 노이즈 제거 기능을 갖는 헤드셋 및 이를 이용하는 헤드셋 시스템은, 능동형 소음 제거 방식을 통해 주변의 소음을 억제시키되, 경고음이 발생되는 경우 소음 제거가 조절되어 경고음과 주변 소리가 출력되도록 함으로써 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는, 안전사고 예방 및 노이즈 제거 기능을 갖는 헤드셋 및 이를 이용하는 헤드셋 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Mining acousto-optic voice alarm device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of acousto-optic voice alarm devices, in particular to a mining acousto-optic voice alarm device, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer shell, a plurality of waist holes for mounting are uniformly distributed on the mounting frame, an inner shell is vertically arranged in the outer shell, a first opening communicated with the inner part is formed in the upper end surface of the outer shell, an elastic sealing component is arranged in the first opening, a warning lamp is fixedly arranged on the upper end surface of the mounting shell, a mounting seat is fixedly connected to the upper end of the warning lamp, three horns are obliquely and fixedly arranged on the mounting seat, the mounting shell is in sliding sealing contact with the inner shell, two sliding blocks are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the side. The invention can play the role of acousto-optic voice alarm, the alarm device is extended out when the alarm is carried out, and the alarm device is retracted for protection when the alarm device is not used, so that the integral protection function is higher, and the service life is longer.
assignees: ZIBO RUIANTE AUTOMATIC CONTROL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster identification early warning method and system based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing, and particularly discloses a geological disaster identification and early warning method and system based on a remote sensing technology. According to the invention, a medium-resolution satellite is adopted to periodically scan, and a plurality of suspected abnormal target areas are updated and determined; adopting SAR (synthetic aperture radar) to carry out verification monitoring, and screening and marking a plurality of geological abnormal target areas; adopting a high-resolution satellite to perform key monitoring, and screening and marking a plurality of vegetation coverage areas; fine detection is carried out by adopting an airborne LiDAR, and abnormal states are acquired; and judging the abnormal risk, and performing geological disaster early warning when the abnormal risk exists. The method can effectively and reasonably comprehensively utilize the medium-resolution satellites, SAR, high-resolution satellites and airborne LiDAR, realize overall layout, layered arrangement and complementary advantages, can effectively identify different geological conditions, effectively avoid interference faced by a single remote sensing technology, and realize efficient, rapid and accurate geological disaster early warning.
assignees: SHANXI COAL GEOLOGY GEOPHYSICAL PROSPECTING SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST CO LTD

title_en: Panel device with visual screen
abstract_en: The application discloses a panel device with a visual screen, when network access equipment is connected with a network, an equipment network access management system divides a current network scene into a plurality of departments, and the equipment network access management system sends corresponding equipment information to a monitoring unit, and the application has the beneficial effects that: the analysis unit can update the network topology graph and the organization structure graph according to the marking sequence of the IP of the appointed access terminal, and store the updated network topology graph and organization structure graph in the graph library of the storage unit after updating time; through sending early warning information to the strange access terminal according to the specific type and access target of the access terminal, potential safety hazards are eliminated in time, and meanwhile, authority setting can be carried out on a new access terminal, so that the requirements of adding and deleting access equipment or adjusting the authority of the accessed terminal of a current enterprise are met.
assignees: HUBEI YIXING SMART EQUIPMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY

title_en: Method for transmitting and updating public warning system (PWS) key update information and corresponding equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for transmitting and updating public warning system (PWS) update information and corresponding equipment. The method comprises the following steps that: a network-side network element triggers a PWS key update indication process, and informs an access network to broadcast the PWS key update indication information to a terminal; after receiving a message of PWS key update request, the network-side network element transmits a message of PWS key update response to the terminal and carries the PWS key update information; after receiving the broadcasted PWS key update indication information and determining the PWS key update, the terminal triggers a PWS key update process, transmits the message of PWS key update request to the network-side network element and carries the PWS key update request information; and the terminal receives the message of PWS key update response transmitted by the network-side network element, and stores the PWS key update information in the message of PWS key update response. In the invention, the PWS key update request can also be initiated by the terminal. The method can achieve the update of the PWS key information in UE (User Equipment) and increase the security of the PWS service.

title_en: Novel intelligent early warning road cone and remote control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel intelligent early warning road cone and a remote control method, comprising a road cone body and a remote controller; a top touch switch is arranged at the top of the road cone body; a display is arranged below the top touch switch; the lower part of the road cone body is provided with a power switch and a charging interface; the display, the touch switch, the power switch and the charging interface are respectively electrically connected with the power supply; the road cone body is wirelessly connected with a remote controller; the remote controller comprises a disarming module key, a arming module key, a mode module key and a control element; the defense withdrawing module key, the defense deploying module key and the mode module key are respectively electrically connected with the control element. The intelligent road cone warning device can effectively solve the problems of few functions, insufficient warning effect and the like of the existing road cone, improves the warning effect of the road cone, and enables workers to know the condition of the road cone at any time by adopting an intelligent design; the control method for the remote control road cone is provided, has relatively comprehensive coverage on the possible warning effect required by the road cone, and has very high practicability.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CTRLPA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Equipment network access management method in network scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device network access management method under a network scene, when a network access device is connected with a network, a device network access management system divides the current network scene into a plurality of departments and sends corresponding device information to a monitoring unit, and the invention has the advantages that: the network topology map and the organization architecture map can be updated according to the marking sequence of the designated access terminal IP by the setting analysis unit, and the updated network topology map and the updated organization architecture map are stored in the map library of the storage unit after being marked with the updating time; early warning information is sent out according to the specific type and the access target of the access terminal to the strange access terminal, so that potential safety hazards are eliminated in time, and meanwhile, the permission setting can be carried out on a new access terminal, so that the requirements of adding and deleting access equipment or adjusting the permission of the accessed terminal by current enterprises are met.

title_en: Slope displacement monitoring and early warning method and inclinometer
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope displacement monitoring and early warning method and an inclinometer, and belongs to the field of slope displacement monitoring and disaster early warning. Before the inclinometer is installed, the GPS positioning device is embedded into a top monitoring point of the inclinometer connecting rod, namely a monitoring zero point. When the inclinometer is installed, the monitoring zero point is located on the ground surface, and the GPS positioning device automatically acquires real-time dynamic three-dimensional coordinate information of the monitoring zero point. And obtaining measurement data of the deep part of the landslide based on the inclinometer, carrying out conversion processing on the measurement data according to the monitoring zero point, automatically obtaining the displacement quantity in the direction of the effective deep part X, Y, Z and the accumulated total displacement, and obtaining the actual displacement and movement trend of each monitoring point of the deep part of the landslide. And comparing the detected information with the proposed early warning threshold value, and if the detected information exceeds the early warning threshold value, automatically sending early warning information by the system so that on-site constructors can timely judge and withdraw. The invention provides powerful technical support for safe operation, production informatization and automation of mine engineering.

title_en: A Automatic Buoyancy Providing Unit of Vessel and Control Method
title_ko: 선박의 자동 부력 제공 및 비상상태 알림장치와 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic buoyancy providing device of a ship and a control method thereof, wherein the automatic buoyancy providing device of a ship comprises: a sensor capable of sensing seawater flowing into a hull; a solenoid valve for controlling air supply to an air tube; and an air tube for providing buoyancy to a ship to prevent the ship from sinking suddenly, such that the present invention maintains the level of the ship to maintain a time required for the ship to be sunk at the most, thereby guiding emergency escape for ship crews and, at the same time, quickly notifying the emergency state of the ship with a smoke or a flare to enable a quick rescue.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선체로 유입되는 해수를 감지할 수 있는 센서를 통해서 선체 내부에 해수가 유입됨을 확인하고, 솔레노이드 밸브의 열림을 통해서 에어 튜브로 압축 공기가 주입시켜 에어 튜브를 팽창시키도록하며, 여러 개의 에어 튜브가 동시에 선체에 부력을 작용하여 선박을 수평으로 유지하여 선박이 침몰되는 시간을 최대한으로 유지시킴으로써 선박에 승선하고 있는 승조원 등의 긴급탈출을 유도할 수 있도록 하고 동시에 선박에 비상상황이 발생하였음을 연기 또는 조명탄으로 표시하여 인근 선박에서 비상상황을 인지하여 재빨리 구조활동을 진행할 수 있도록 구성한 것을 특징으로 하는 선박의 자동 부력 제공장치와 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 
레벨 센서로부터 신호를 전달받아 선박의 침수를 판단하는 단계와;  선박이 침수하고 있는 것으로 판단되면 솔레노이드 밸브를 작동시켜 에어튜브에 에어를 공급하는 단계와;  에어 공급후 일정시간이 지나면 마그네틱 커플러에 전기적 신호를 출력하여 에어 출력파이프 및 에어 입력파이프의 결합을 해제시키는 단계와;  에어 실린더 장치를 구동하여 선박으로 부터 에어 튜브를 분리시키는 단계와;  에어 튜브가 작동된 것을 도어 열림감지 센서로 파악하고, 조도 센서에 의해서 현재 낮인 경우에 연막탄을 터트려 외부에 연기를 출력하여 비상상황임을 외부 선박들이 인지할 수 있도록 유도하는 단계와;  에어 튜브가 작동된 것을 도어 열림감지 센서로 파악하고, 조도 센서에 의해서 현재 밤인 경우에 조명탄을 터트려 외부에 조명 빛을 출력하여 비상상황임을 외부 선박들이 인지할 수 있도록 유도하는 단계를 포함하여 구성함이 특징이다.

title_en: Infotainment system for notifying emergency rescue request and method thereof
title_ko: 긴급 구조 요청 알림 인포테인먼트 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for notifying an emergency rescue request using an infotainment system. An emergency rescue request notification method in a vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: detecting an accident of the vehicle; collecting information corresponding to the detected accident; generating an emergency rescue request message based on the collected information; searching for an FM radio channel with the highest reception sensitivity; changing the program type of the searched FM radio channel to a specific value using an FM radio data system message and transmitting the same; and transmitting the emergency rescue request message through the discovered FM radio channel. Accordingly, the present invention has the advantage of being able to provide a vehicle emergency rescue service more safely and inexpensively.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인포테인먼트 시스템을 이용한 긴급 구조 요청 알림 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 실시 예에 따른 차량에서의 긴급 구조 요청 알림 방법은 상기 차량의 사고를 감지하는 단계와 상기 감지된 사고에 상응하는 정보를 수집하는 단계와 상기 수집된 정보에 기초하여 긴급 구조 요청 메시지를 생성하는 단계와 수신 감도가 최상위인 FM 라디오 채널을 탐색하는 단계와 상기 탐색된 FM 라디오 채널의 프로그램 타입을 FM 무선 데이터 시스템 메시지를 이용하여 특정 값으로 변경하여 전송하는 단계와 상기 탐색된 FM 라디오 채널을 통해 상기 긴급 구조 요청 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 보다 안전하고 저렴하게 차량 긴급 구조 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Emergency maintenance and update integrated system and method based on target tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency maintenance and update integrated system and method based on target tracking. The system comprises an emergency, tour-inspection and maintenance mobile terminal and a corresponding emergency, dispatch, statistic analysis, early warning and data update integrated service system. The method includes the steps: 1) dynamically tracking moving objects (including vehicles and staff) and dynamically reporting emergency, tour-inspection and maintenance tasks; 2) generating, distributing and transmitting dispatch lists; 3) automatically classifying completion states of work orders; 4) dynamically updating databases of pipeline facilities according to operation and maintenance business data generated by tour-inspection, maintenance and emergency; 5) integrally managing businesses such as data update and statistical statement generation. Potential safety hazards of the facilities can be timely eliminated, safety and reliability of the facilities are enhanced, up-to-date states of basic data and the emergency treatment capacity of emergency rescue and disaster relief of pipe network facilities are improved, so that the labor efficiency of corresponding enterprises is increased, and the management level of the enterprises is improved.
assignees: ZHOU XIAOGUANG;LI GUANGQIANG;LI JIANXIN;LU YUYOU;LU ZHIMING;KONG DEYUN;YANG CHENGFEI;XIAO QIUYONG

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of Internet of things, and discloses an intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things system which comprises an intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things cloud platform, a data comprehensive collector and a fire-fighting equipment sensor, wherein the data comprehensive collector is installed on a fire-fighting site and is connected with the fire-fighting equipment sensor in a 485 wired transmission mode, a 433 wireless transmission mode or an LORA wireless transmission mode, the intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things cloud platform comprises an MQTT message queue server and a service server, the data comprehensive collector is connected with the MQTT message queue server through a 3G network, a 4G network or a 5G network, and the MQTT message queue server is connected with the service server. According to the intelligent fire-fighting equipment access control method, different transmission modes and transmission strategies are adopted, and access of part types of traditional fire-fighting equipment is supported, so that the entrance threshold of intelligent fire fighting is reduced, deployment of the Internet of things is promoted, construction of a smart city is accelerated, and defense deployment and defense withdrawal can be carried out on the fire-fighting equipment remotely.

title_en: Anti-theft alarm device of bridge safety monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bridge safety monitoring equipment, in particular to an anti-theft alarm device of bridge safety monitoring equipment, when the monitoring equipment normally works, the monitoring equipment is positioned in a mounting groove and compresses a pressing strip, a spring retracts into a hidden groove to ensure that a power transmission plate is not contacted with a first conductive block and a second conductive block, at the moment, a buzzer, a memory, a warning lamp and an electronic camera are powered off and are in a non-working state, the monitoring equipment is in a normal state at the moment, when the monitoring equipment is separated from the mounting groove, the pressing strip moves upwards under the action of the spring to drive the power transmission plate to ascend and be contacted with the first conductive block and the second conductive block, so that the buzzer, the memory, the buzzer and the electronic camera are connected with the power supply to work, the buzzer and the warning lamp give sound and light warning, and the electronic camera records videos and stores the videos in the memory, the information of illegal molecules can be recorded, and the subsequent pursuit is convenient.

title_en: Intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system, which comprises a cloud server, a data processing end, a controller, a plurality of indoor sensor assemblies, lighting indicating lamps and a warning device, wherein the cloud server is connected with the data processing end; the indoor sensor assembly comprises a temperature sensor and a smoke sensor; the data processing end is used for receiving data of the indoor sensor assembly and the lighting indicator lamp, analyzing the data to obtain a corresponding control instruction, and then transmitting the data and the control instruction to the cloud server; the system can be applied to fire alarm prompts in different places, can meet the requirements of different use scenes, has strong adjustability, is easy to install, regulate and control, can be updated in real time according to the change of the external environment, and solves the problem that the conventional system is easy to generate false alarm; the whole system architecture is convenient for users to adjust, so that the users can adjust hardware configuration according to use requirements, divide monitoring areas and the like, the flexibility is high, and the number of applicable scenes is large.

title_en: Transmission line operation digital control and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line operation and dimension digital control and early warning system, which comprises a transmission line body, channel hidden danger data, a three-dimensional model, a database and a microclimate sensor, wherein the three-dimensional model of the transmission line is established, the three-dimensional model is associated and matched with the transmission line body and the channel hidden danger data, the channel hidden danger data comprises the influence of line hidden danger and surrounding environment weather changes thereof to form a transmission line body and surrounding environment associated and matched database, the database is updated in real time according to an operation and dimension period, the digital control of the line channel hidden danger is realized, the microclimate sensor of a power grid is combined, the weather change condition of the surrounding environment of the transmission line is detected in real time, the hidden danger which possibly appears is early warned in advance according to the association degree, and early warning information is timely pushed to background operation and dimension personnel through various communication means; the invention has the advantages of convenient control, effective control and timely early warning.
assignees: SHANGQIU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Comprehensive energy operation simulation method and system based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy operation simulation method and system based on multi-objective optimization, belongs to the technical field of energy, and aims to solve the problem of equipment overload and discontinuous power supply caused by unbalance of supply and demand in extreme climates. The model is simulated by adopting an improved NSGA-III algorithm, and a scheduling scheme is generated, wherein the scheduling scheme comprises a start-stop time sequence of hydrogen production equipment. When typhoon warning signals are received, the seawater electrolysis hydrogen production equipment is locked forcibly, and the output power of the diesel generator is fixed in a preset interval. During the operation of the hydrogen production equipment, output fluctuation data of the wave energy generator are collected in real time, and the operation power of the reverse osmosis sea water desalination unit is adjusted through a dynamic correction algorithm. When the hydrogen storage amount of the hydrogen production equipment reaches a threshold value, the power locking of the diesel generator is released, the diesel generator is switched to a multi-energy coupling control mode, and the charging and discharging strategies of the energy storage equipment are synchronously updated.

title_en: Evacuation optimizing paths model building method based on two patterns paste
abstract_en: The present invention relates to evacuation optimizing paths modelings, more particularly to a kind of evacuation optimizing paths model building method based on two patterns paste, the present invention respectively obtains the optimizing paths model of panic crowd and calm crowd for the psychological characteristics of different crowd, and it is modeled based on the optimizing paths of two type fuzzy reasonings, after model construction success, utilize evacuee's optimizing paths situation under the conditions of emulation platform analog emergency evacuation appropriate, or it formulates the evacuation instruction for different target and evacuates management method, and validity and scientific evaluation are carried out with management method to prepared instruction, solves the traffic jam issue during emergency evacuation, improve evacuation efficiency, with very strong creativeness.

title_en: Urban flood risk point prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting urban flood risk points, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood risk point identification and prediction, and comprises the steps of obtaining and establishing a rainfall event library according to historical daily rainfall data of a rainfall station and accumulated water data of an urban water collecting area; according to the rainfall event library, calculating the occurrence condition probability of the ponding; obtaining rainfall probability prediction data, predicting future flood risk occurrence probability according to the ponding occurrence condition probability and the rainfall probability prediction data, completing urban flood risk point prediction, and sending out early warning according to the flood risk occurrence probability; and carrying out error analysis on the occurrence probability of the flood risk to obtain an error analysis result, updating a rainfall event base according to the error analysis result, and carrying out urban flood risk point prediction based on the updated rainfall event base. The method solves the problem that the existing urban flood risk point prediction method is low in efficiency.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power grid early warning and scheduling method and system based on extreme disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid early warning and scheduling method and system based on extreme disaster weather, relates to the field of power grid scheduling, and aims to solve the problem that scheduling is unilateral due to the fact that the conventional power grid scheduling method cannot comprehensively consider the influence factors of the extreme disaster weather, and the method comprises the following steps: determining the fault condition of the power grid equipment in extreme disaster weather according to the weather information of the power distribution area and the state information of the power grid equipment; judging whether to send out power grid early warning according to the fault condition of the power grid equipment and the using time of the power grid equipment, and predicting load reduction; acquiring position distribution information and energy information of power grid energy storage equipment, and determining an executed power grid energy storage equipment scheme according to a first execution strategy; and constructing an energy storage execution model according to the power grid energy storage equipment scheme executed historically, and judging whether the energy storage execution model is updated or not. The invention carries out targeted adjustment and scheduling on the fault power grid equipment, and ensures the objectivity and comprehensiveness of the scheduling result.

title_en: Fire control facility remote monitoring and intelligent management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote monitoring and intelligent management and control system for a fire-fighting facility, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting early warning, and concretely comprises the steps of deploying a multi-parameter sensor array, enabling sensor nodes to form a redundant monitoring network in a honeycomb topology structure, conducting real-time fusion analysis on sensor network data through an edge computing gateway, triggering an abnormal region positioning module when any monitoring parameter is detected to exceed a preset dynamic threshold value, constructing a three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram model based on parameter gradient changes of adjacent sensor nodes by the abnormal region positioning module, dynamically computing the diffusion direction and potential risk level of an abnormal region, enabling a mobile inspection robot cluster to receive coordinates and risk parameters of the abnormal region, automatically generating a multi-stage response path based on a real-time updated building digital twin model, enabling a primary path to be quickly abutted to a preset main road, enabling a secondary path to be dynamically adjusted according to the distribution of field obstacles, and enabling a terminal path to be rechecked by adopting a contact type detection module.
assignees: LINYI NEW SMART CITY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguishing apparatus of automatic and manual type for kitchen fire suppression
title_ko: 주방 화재진압용 자동 및 수동식 소화장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 주방 화재진압용 자동 및 수동식 소화장치에 관한 것으로서, 주방에 마련된 다수의 조리대(1) 상부를 향해 벽면으로부터 분사노즐(11)이 각각 분기되어 배치되는 소화분사관(10)과; 상기 소화분사관(10)과 연결 설치되며, 상부에 약제 및 질소가스 주입을 위한 주입플러그(22)가 마련된 약제 저장용기(20)와; 상기 약제 저장용기(20)의 주입플러그(22)에 연결 설치되며, 주입플러그의 내측과 차단되는 격막(31)이 구비된 커플러(30)와; 상기 커플러(30)로부터 연결되면서 일측에는 상기 소화분사관(10)을 연결하는 연결관체(40)와; 상기 연결관체(40)로부터 연결 설치되며, 내측에 제1설치공간부(51)가 형성되고, 제1설치공간부(51)의 하부에는 안내공(52a)이 외측으로부터 형성된 제2설치공간부(52)가 격벽(53)을 두어 구획 형성된 하우징(50)과; 상기 하우징(50)의 제2설치공간부(52) 선단에 나사체결되며, 내경에는 연결관체(40)를 상호 연결하는 이음관(62)이 구비된 연결 지지구(60)와; 상기 하우징(50)의 제1설치공간부(51) 내에 설치되어 주방화재시 발생하는 경보신호로서 반응하여 작동축(71)을 슬라이딩 구동하는 솔레노이드(70)와; 상기 하우징(50)의 제2설치공간부(52) 내에 설치되어 솔레노이드(70)의 작동에 따라 상기 커플러(30)의 격막(31)을 파열하여 약제 저장용기(20)로부터 압축 저장된 약제를 소화분사관(10)측으로 공급하기 위한 약제 공급부재(80)와; 상기 하우징(50)의 제1설치공간부(51)로부터 설치되어 격벽(53)을 통해 제2설치공간부(52) 내의 약제 공급부재(80)를 긴장된 상태로 유지시키거나 해제시키는 고정부재(90)와; 상기 하우징(50)의 외측으로부터 설치되어 솔레노이드(70)의 작동축(71)을 수동으로 작동시키기 위한 수동식 조정부재(110)와; 상기 소화분사관(10)의 일부를 제외한 나머지 구성요소를 수용하는 설치박스(120);를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는바, 무인상태에서는 화재 경보시스템에 의해 자동으로 소화장치를 작동하여 조리대에서 초기에 진압할 수 없는 정도로 발생하는 화재를 진압하고, 또는 작업자가 원거리에서 소화장치를 수동으로 작동시켜 화재발생한 곳에 다가가지 않고서도 화재를 초기에 진압함으로써, 대형화재로 이어질 수 있는 사고를 방지함과 동시에 수동으로 소화장치를 조작하는 작업자는 화상을 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Surge protective apparatus and the communication method using it
title_ko: 서지 보호 장치 및 서지 보호를 위한 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a surge protecting device and a method thereof. The surge protecting device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a molded case circuit breaker which includes a trip driving unit; a surge protector which cuts off surge flowing in an electrical system; a sensing circuit unit for surge protector cutoff; a signal converting unit which receives a signal of the sensing circuit unit for surge protector cutoff and converts the signal into a digital surge signal; and a microprocessor which controls to trip the trip driving unit for cutting off the surge protector. The surge protecting device according to an embodiment of the present invention can previously prevent a risk of a fire and a frequent breaker trip. The present invention can reduce costs by not installing a short circuit fuse or a thermal fuse in the surge protecting device additionally.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서지 보호 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 서지 보호기의 열폭주를 예방하기 위한 단락 과전류 퓨즈나 열 폭주 방지회로를 추가로 설치할 필요가 없고, 사용 환경적 요인에 의한 서지의 강도에 따라 절연 파괴나 성능 저하로 교체 비용의 상승과 화재의 위험을 미리 예방할 수 있으며, 전력선 통신 등을 통해 기본 통신 정보에 포함되는 일반 통신 정보과 조건 통신 정보를 특정인에게 전송하고, 일정 시간 간격을 두고 일정치 이상의 통신 정보를 특정인에게 전송한 경우 상기 통신 정보를 중지하는 등의 다양한 기능을 포함하고, 맵 응용 API를 활용한 GUI를 통하여 각 정보에 대한 용이한 접근이 가능한 서지 보호 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 과를 개폐함과 함께 과부하, 단락 등의 이상 상태에 대해 를 차단하는 트립구동부를 포함하는 배선 차단기; 배선 차단기와 병렬로 연결되어 전기 계통에 흐르는 서지를 차단하는 서지 보호기; 서지 보호기의 접지선을 주회하여 형성되는 서지 보호기 차단용 감지 회로부; 서지 보호기 차단용 감지 회로부의 신호를 전달받아 디지털 서지 신호로 변환하는 신호변환부; 상기 디지털 서지 신호를 전달받아 기준치 이상의 디지털 서지 신호인 경우에만 상기 배선 차단기와 연동되어 서지 보호기를 차단하기 위해 상기 트립구동부를 트립시키도록 제어하는 마이크로 프로세서로 구성되되, 상기 마이크로 프로세서는, 전원선에 공급되는 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수를 각 측정회로에서 감지하여 합한 값을 비휘발성 메모리에 저장한 후 표시장치에 디스플레이하는 측정값디스플레이모듈; 서지전류 측정회로에서 측정한 서지전류와, 영상변류기를 통한 누설전류 및 변류기를 통한 사용전류와, RTC에서 전송 받은 날짜와 시간 정보를 실시간 확인할 수 있도록 비휘발성 메모리에 저장한 후 표시장치에 디스플레이하는 실시간디스플레이모듈; 조건 통신 정보, 일반 통신 정보를 전송하고 일정 횟수 이상 통신 정보를 전송한 경우 통신 정보 전송을 중지하도록 제어 스위치를 작동시키는 통신 정지 모듈; 전송 조건을 변경하면 조건에 따른 통신 정보를 전송하는 조건 변경 통신 모듈; 현재 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수 통신 정보 설정이 미리 되고, 전송 조건이 변경 안되는 경우 미리 정하여진 일반 통신 정보를 전송하는 일반 통신 모듈; 기존 전원선에 공급되는 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수를 전달한 각 통신 정보를 현재 상태와 동일 상황인지 확인하여, 동일하면 미리 저장된 통신 정보 설정 조건에 따른 통신 정보를 전송하는 동일 상황 비교 모듈; 이기종간에도 일반 또는 조건 통신 정보 전송이 가능하도록 하는 이기종통신모듈; 일반 통신 정보 또는 조건 변경이 되어 새로운 조건에 따른 통신 정보의 인터럽트 알림(interruptive notification)을 사용하기 위해, 인터럽트 메시징(interruptive messaging) 모듈;을 포함한다.

title_en: Digital door lock password alert device in emergency situations
title_ko: 응급 상황 발생 시 디지털도어락 비밀번호 알림장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital door lock password notification device in case of an emergency. After an emergency dispatch request notifying the occurrence of an emergency situation of a requester living in an apartment house such as a detached house or an apartment is received by a rescue server, when the location of a rescuer smartphone receiving an emergency dispatch command is confirmed as the location of a house where the requester resides, the rescuer smartphone displays the digital door lock password of the requester house received from the rescue server and notifies the rescuer. According to the present invention, even when an emergency situation occurs in the house, the digital door lock is unlocked inside the house, and the door cannot be opened, the digital door lock password is displayed and notified on a rescuer smartphone carried by a rescuer who has been urgently dispatched to the location of the house where the rescuer resides, so that the digital door lock can be unlocked and the door is opened to quickly enter the house to rescue the rescuer. In particular, by displaying the digital door lock password on the authorized rescuer smartphone, it is possible to prevent or minimize the risk of exposure of the digital door lock password of the rescuer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급 상황 발생 시 디지털도어락 비밀번호 알림장치에 관한 것으로, 단독주택이나 아파트 등과 같은 공동주택에 거주하는 요구조자의 응급 상황 발생을 알리는 긴급 출동 요청이 구조서버로 접수된 후 긴급 출동 명령을 받은 구조자 스마트폰의 위치가 요구조자가 거주하는 주택 위치로 확인되면 구조자 스마트폰이 구조서버로부터 수신한 요구조자 주택의 디지털도어락 비밀번호를 표시하여 구조자에게 알려준다. 
본 발명에 따르면 집 안에서 응급 상황이 발생하고 집 안쪽에서 디지털도어락을 잠금 해제하고 도어를 열어 줄 수 없는 상황에서도 요구조자가 거주하는 주택 위치로 긴급 출동한 구조자가 휴대하는 구조자 스마트폰에 디지털도어락 비밀번호를 표시하여 알려줌으로써 디지털도어락을 잠금 해제하고 도어를 열어 집 안으로 신속하게 진입하여 요구조자를 구조하게 할 수 있으며, 특히 인가된 구조자 스마트폰에 디지털도어락 비밀번호를 표시함으로써 요구조자의 디지털도어락 비밀번호의 노출 우려를 방지 혹은 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management system, a geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management method and a geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management storage medium, wherein the geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management system comprises a hidden danger point adding unit, a hidden danger point adding unit and a hidden danger point storing unit, wherein the hidden danger point adding unit is used for; the hidden trouble point processing unit is used for determining a hidden trouble point processing scheme; the hidden danger point processing result determining unit is used for determining a hidden danger point processing result; the hidden danger point management unit is used for verifying and canceling or recording hidden danger point information according to a processing result of the hidden danger point; the hidden danger point monitoring and early warning unit is used for acquiring hidden danger point monitoring information and generating early warning; and the maintenance management and maintenance unit is used for acquiring and storing the maintenance data of the processed hidden danger points. The problem of can't carry out orderly improvement to the easy point of sending out of geological disasters is solved, this application has the effect of comparatively orderly improvement geological disasters easy point of sending out.

title_en: Basin water ecological safety monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological safety monitoring, and discloses a watershed water ecological safety monitoring and early warning system.A control mechanism, a communication mechanism, a sensor and a power box are arranged in a box body; the shell main body comprises a lower shell and an upper shell, the lower shell is connected with the upper shell in a sealing mode, an electrical installation groove is formed between the upper shell and the lower shell, and the control mechanism, the communication mechanism, the sensor and the power box are all installed inside the electrical installation groove. The power supply ends of the control mechanism, the sensor and the communication mechanism are electrically connected with the output end of the power supply box; the control end of the communication mechanism and the control end of the sensor are both electrically connected with the control end of the control mechanism. The control mechanism receives signals sent by the sensor and sends the signals of the sensor to the background computer through the communication mechanism. The whole system is simple in structure, convenient to operate, flexible to use and convenient to popularize and use, so that monitoring signals are effectively transmitted, supervision efficiency is improved, detection results are accurate, and data are updated in real time.

title_en: Digital broadcast receiver and digital broadcast reception method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide detailed operation of a transmitter and a receiver capable of minimizing delay in reproduction of an emergency earthquake alert transmitted by digital broadcasting.SOLUTION: A digital broadcast receiver comprises: a receiving part for receiving a transmitted signal; broadcast demodulation part which demodulates a digital broadcast signal from the transmitted signal received by the receiving part; an earthquake motion alert information signal demodulation part which demodulates an earthquake motion alert information signal from the transmitted signal received by the receiving part; and a discrimination part which when an update flag of the earthquake motion alert information signal indicates that the content of earthquake motion information is updated, acquires local area information and earthquake center information of an earthquake motion alert and generates and outputs a video signal relating to the earthquake motion.

title_en: Transmission apparatus, digital broadcast transmission method, digital broadcast transmission/reception system, and digital broadcast transmission/reception method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide detailed operation of a transmission device and a reception device that can reproduce an emergency earthquake alert transmitted by digital broadcasting with minimized delay.SOLUTION: Earthquake center information of a page type of "1" and target local area information of a page type of "0" are alternately transmitted one by one. When information of earthquake motion alarm information is updated, this cycle is disturbed to change an update flag even in a middle way of the cycle, and the updated information is transmitted.EFFECT: As the update flag is changed only by the earthquake motion alarm information where content is updated, change of the update flag is observed and only the earthquake motion alarm information where change of the update flag occurs is obtained, so that a quick updating process can be performed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 34

title_en: Site data management system of disaster prevention monitoring facility
abstract_en: To reduce labor and time required for updating site data stored in a receiver by updating online from an exterior terminal device connectable via a network.SOLUTION: In a site data management system of a disaster prevention monitoring facility, when predetermined site data is stored in advance in a receiver 10 and a fire detection signal is received from an analogue sensor 14 connected to a transmission line 12 led out to a warning zone from the receiver 10, fire response control is performed that includes outputting a fire alarm while displaying a fire breakout place and controlling predetermined equipment based on the site data. A terminal device 50 is connectable for communication via the Internet 46, and a site data terminal management part 62 of the terminal device 50 transmits new site data in which part of the site data has been changed to the receiver 10 to instruct update. A site data receiver management part 48 of the receiver 10 rewrites and updates currently stored site data based on the new site data transmitted from the site data terminal management part 62 of the terminal device 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power breaking apparatus and method with fire protection
title_ko: 화재예방기능을 가지는 전원차단기 및 전원차단방법
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for breaking the power are provided to break a load power or give an alarm by predicting fire possibility when the contact of an electric wire or outlet is trouble. A switch(20) is installed in a power circuit breaker(10) to switch the load power supply. A detection circuit(C1) detects and amplifies a spark waveform and a leakage waveform. A converting circuit(C2) converts the signal received from the detection circuit into a digital signal. A central processing unit(C3) outputs the signal from the converting circuit to a determining circuit. A comparator(C4) compares the signal inputted to the central processing unit with the prediction program. The determining circuit(C5) generates the alarm according to the comparison result of the comparator. An alarm circuit(C6) generates the alarm through a speaker and turns on an LED(Light Emitting Diode) lamp. A circuit breaker(C7) cuts off the load power according to a risk signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력전원으로부터 필요전원을 공급받고 부하전원 라인으로부터 스파크파형 및 누전파형을 검출하고, 이를 이용하여 초기에 누전 또는 전기스파크를 감지 분석하여 전기스파크로 인한 발화 또는 위험이 극도에 달하기 전에 경고 또는 전원을 완전히 차단함으로써, 화재 및 감전사고로부터 재산과 인명피해를 줄일 수 있도록 한 화재예방기능을 가지는 전원차단기 및 전원차단방법으로, 전원차단기 본체(10)에 설치되어 부하전원공급을 개폐하는 스위치(20); 및 상기 입력전원(도시하지 않음)으로부터 전원을 공급받아 스파크파형과 누전파형을 검출하고, 이 검출된 파형을 증폭 출력하는  검출회로(C1)와, 상기 검출회로 로부터 입력된 신호를 변별하여 안정된 디지털신호로 변환하여 출력하기 위한 변환회로(C2)와, 상기 변환회로에 입력된 신호를 선별하여 판별회로(C5)로 출력 및 모니터링 할 수 있는 마이콤(MC)을 구성한 중앙처리부(C3)와, 상기 중앙처리부에 입력된 신호를 사전에 입력된 예측프로그램과 비교 분석하는 비교회로(C4)와, 그 결과에 따라 단계별 경보발생 및 해제할 수 있으며 각각의 경보원인제거 시 초기화기능을 할 수 있도록 한 판별회로(C5)와, 상기 판별회로에서 경보원인 미제거시 스피커(11)를 통해 경고음 발생하고, 동시에 LED램프(12)를 점멸하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Tunnel integrated disaster prevention system capable of accident monitoring, fire disaster prevention, and refugee relief into a tunnel
title_ko: 터널 내 사고 감시, 화재 방재, 및 피난자 구제가 가능한 터널 통합 방재 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an integrated tunnel disaster prevention system comprises: a cable tray having a pair of upright side rails and a bottom plate formed in an H shape, and a power supply cable in an inner part which forms a track rail supporting the bottom plate with a wire bolt to be suspended and supported at a predetermined height on the ceiling of a tunnel, to attach a lighting device of the tunnel, wherein a rack gear is formed on the bottom plate; and a disaster prevention device traveling on the track rail to move to an accident site so as to monitor an accident site in real-time, spraying fire extinguishing liquid upon fire to extinguish the fire, and dropping emergency supplies to victims to save the victims when the victims occur due to thick smoke generated by the fire. The disaster prevention device comprises a moving pulley to be traveled along the track rail and a portable disaster prevention means. The portable disaster prevention means comprises: an image photographing means to photograph traffic flow and accident images in a tunnel; a detection means to detect a traffic accident, fire, and thick smoke in the tunnel; a fire extinguishing device to extinguish the fire when the fire occurs in the tunnel; a wireless communication device to wirelessly communicate with a control room; and a microphone/speaker device to output traffic control and evacuation guide broadcasting. Accordingly, the traffic flow and accident images are monitored in real-time through ordinary turning traveling, such that lane change and speeding of a vehicle traveling in the tunnel are prevented, thereby preventing a traffic accident in the tunnel in advance, and quickly coping with the traffic accident when the accident occurs in the tunnel.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 터널 통합 방재 시스템은 한 쌍의 직립한 사이드 레일 및 바닥판이 H 자 형상으로 일체로 형성되고, 바닥판에 랙 기어가 형성되어 있으며, 전선 볼트를 이용하여 바닥판을 지지하여 터널 천정의 일정 높이에 현수되어 지지되는 궤도 레일을 구성하는 내부에 전원 공급 케이블을 포함하여 터널의 조명 장치를 부착하기 위한 케이블 트레이; 및 상기 궤도 레일을 주행 가능하여 사고 위치로 이동하여 사고 현장을 실시간 감시하고, 화재 발생시, 소화액을 분사하여 화재를 진압하며, 화재 발생시 발생되는 농연으로 인한 피난자가 발생하는 경우, 비상용품을 투하하여 제공함으로써, 피난자를 구제할 수 있는 방재 장치를 포함하고, 상기 방재 장치가, 상기 궤도 레일을 주행 가능한 이동 활차; 및 이동 방재 수단을 포함하고, 상기 이동 방재 수단이, 터널 내 교통 흐름 및 사고 영상을 촬영할 수 있는 영상 촬영 수단; 터널 내 교통 사고, 화재 발생, 및 농연 발생을 감지할 수 있는 감지 수단; 화재 발생시, 화재를 진압할 수 있는 소화 장치; 및 관제실과 무선 통신가능한 무선 통신 장치; 교통 통제 및 대피 안내 방송을 수행할 수 있는 마이크/스피커 장치를 포함하여 평상시 선회 주행을 통해 터널 내 교통의 흐름 및 사고 영상을 실시간 감시함으로써, 터널을 주행하는 차량의 차선 변경 및 과속을 방지하여 터널 내 교통 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있고, 터널 내의 사고 발생시 신속 대응이 가능하다.

title_en: Fire detection device and control method thereof
title_ko: 화재 감지장치 및 이의 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection device and a method for controlling the fire detection device, in which a temperature sensing cycle setting unit lengthens or shortens the cycle of temperature sensing based on the temperature sensed by a temperature sensing unit so that fire detection can be performed in a more efficient, more economical, and safer manner. The present invention includes: the temperature sensing unit sensing the intra-building temperature at regular intervals; a control unit determining whether a fire has occurred based on the temperature sensed by the temperature sensing unit; and an alarm unit outputting an alarm by receiving an alarm output signal from the control unit. The control unit includes: a reference temperature setting unit setting a fire occurrence reference temperature; the temperature sensing cycle setting unit setting the sensing cycle of the temperature sensing unit; and a fire occurrence determination unit determining whether a fire has occurred by comparison with the fire occurrence reference temperature based on the temperature sensed by the temperature sensing unit. The temperature sensing cycle setting unit sets the initial sensing cycle of the temperature sensing unit as a first cycle. When the temperature sensed by the temperature sensing unit using the first cycle and for a certain period of time is measured to be equal to or lower than the fire occurrence reference temperature, the temperature sensing cycle setting unit of the fire detection device changes and sets the sensing cycle of the temperature sensing unit to a second cycle, which is greater in time interval than the first cycle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 온도센싱 주기 설정부가 온도 센싱부에서 센싱한 온도를 기준으로 온도를 센싱하는 주기를 짧거나 길게 조절함으로써 보다 효율적이고 경제적이며, 안전한 화재 감지를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 화재 감지장치 및 이의 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여, 본 발명은 본 발명은 일정 주기로 건물 내부의 온도를 센싱하는 온도 센싱부와, 상기 온도 센싱부에서 센싱한 온도를 기준으로 화재발생 여부를 판단하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부로부터 경보출력신호를 전달받아 경보를 출력하는 경보부를 포함하되, 상기 제어부는 화재발생 기준온도를 설정하는 기준온도 설정부와, 상기 온도 센싱부의 센싱 주기를 설정하는 온도센싱 주기 설정부와, 상기 온도 센싱부에서 센싱된 온도를 기준으로 상기 화재발생 기준온도와 비교하여 화재발생 여부를 판단하는 화재발생 판단부를 포함하고, 상기 온도센싱 주기 설정부는 초기의 상기 온도 센싱부의 센싱 주기를 제1 주기로 설정하고, 상기 온도 센싱부에서 일정시간 동안 상기 제1 주기로 센싱한 온도가 상기 화재발생 기준온도 이하로 측정되는 경우, 상기 온도센싱 주기 설정부는 상기 온도 센싱부의 센싱 주기를 상기 제1 주기보다 시간 간격이 큰 제2 주기로 변경하여 설정하는 것을 특징으로 하는 화재 감지장치를 제공한다.

title_en: FM radio multi-channel automatic disaster warning receiver
title_ko: Fm 라디오 다채널 자동 재난경보 수신기
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 일반 방송채널을 듣고 있더라도 재난경보방송채널 또는 지역방송채널에서 재난경보방송의 수신되면 재난경보방송채널 또는 지역방송채널로 변경하여 재난방송을 출력할 수 있는 FM 라디오 다채널 자동 재난경보 수신기를 제공하고자 하는 것이다.  
본 발명의 제1 실시예는 일반 방송채널이 수신되는 제1FM튜너(110)와, 재난경보방송채널이 수신되는 제2FM튜너(210)와, 제1FM튜너(110)의 FM방송이나 제2FM튜너(210)의 재난경보방송을 출력하는 오디오앰프(310)와, 제1FM튜너(110)나 제2FM튜너(210)를 오디오앰프(310)에 선택적으로 연결하는 오디오스위치(410)와, 제2FM튜너(210)에서 일정 레벨 이상의 신호전력이 수신됨을 감지하면 오디오앰프(310)를 통해 출력되는 제1FM튜너(110)의 FM방송을 차단하면서 제2FM튜너(210)를 통해 수신되는 재난경보방송이 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부(510)를 포함하고, 제어부(510)는 제2FM튜너(210)에서 재난경보방송이 수신되는 신호전력에 대한 기준레벨을 설정하는 기준레벨설정부(511)와, 제2FM튜너(210)에서 수신되는 신호전력을 확인하고 기준레벨 이상인지 판단하는 전력레벨판단부(512)와, 전력레벨판단부(512)에서 신호전력이 기준레벨 이상인 것으로 판단하면 제2FM튜너(210)에서 수신되는 재난경보방송이 출력되도록 오디오스위치(410)를 조작하는 스위치조작부(513)를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of triggering system and method for automatic driving vehicle emergency response
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of triggering system and method for automatic driving vehicle emergency response, is related to driving technical field of vehicle control；Acquisition is to vehicle-state, driver status information, and parameter extraction is carried out to information, it is assessed again, judge whether to need to carry out alarm and carries out the triggering of emergency response, anti-error trigger process is also set up simultaneously, for confirming the validity of warning information and trigger request, to avoid the erroneous trigger as caused by hardware fault；Passed through using the present invention to vehicle and the monitoring of driver's self-condition, the safety guarantee range of automatic driving vehicle can be expanded, the safety coefficient of automatic driving vehicle can be significantly improved, be greatly reduced accident hair at a possibility that, it is greatly reduced or is avoided the life and property loss under automatic driving vehicle fortuitous event, effectively increases the reliance security in automatic driving vehicle driving process.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR HI TECH INVEST & DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on a digital twin technology, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and concretely comprise the steps of collecting geographical information data of landslide in real time, constructing a dynamically updated multi-source space database, constructing a landslide simulation model, conducting grid subdivision on the landslide simulation model, carrying out solving based on the landslide hydraulic coupling model by introducing a stress field and seepage field numerical coupling algorithm, accurately analyzing landslide to represent a state, acquiring a safety coefficient of the landslide in real time by adopting an intensity folding method, establishing a disaster analysis model, deducing a landslide disaster forming range if the safety coefficient reaches a preset alarm threshold, calculating a disaster risk index, evaluating a risk level according to the disaster risk index, and carrying out early warning on the landslide disaster if the risk level is higher than the preset level. The intelligent landslide monitoring system and the intelligent landslide monitoring method realize accurate monitoring and intelligent safety early warning of landslide.
assignees: SUZHOU TURUISI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous Robot system imposed life­saving in invisible area
title_ko: 비가시 영역 내 인명 유무를 고려한 자율형 로봇 시스템 및 인명 유무 판단방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous robot system considering whether a person exists in an invisible area and a method for determining whether a person exists. More specifically, the autonomous robot system considering whether a person exists in an invisible area includes: an autonomous robot platform including an image photographing means photographing image information; and a person existence determination system including an image information obtaining part obtaining the image information, a possible person existence area extraction part extracting a possible person existence area from the image information obtained from the image information obtaining part; a person existence determination part determining whether a person exists in the possible person existence area; and a work plan change notification part transmitting work change and notification information to the autonomous robot platform if the person existence determination part determines that a person exists.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비가시 영역 내 인명 유무를 고려한 자율형 로봇 시스템 및 인명 유무 판단방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 영상정보를 촬상하는 영상촬상수단이 구비되는 자율형 로봇 플랫폼; 및 상기 영상정보를 획득하는 영상정보획득부와, 상기 영상정보획득부에서 획득된 영상정보에서 인명존재 가능 영역을 추출하는 인명존재가능영역추출부와, 상기 가능 영역에서 인명존재유무를 판단하는 인명존재여부판단부와, 상기 인명존재여부판단부에 의해 인명이 존재한다고 판단되면 작업변경, 알림정보를 상기 자율형 로봇 플랫펌으로 전송하는 작업계획 변경 알림부를 갖는 인명존재여부판단시스템;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 비가시 영역 내 인명 유무를 고려한 자율형 로봇 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method for monitoring, reporting and early warning of COVID-19 streaming based on wireless communication and ranging
abstract_en: The invention has the following names: a method for monitoring, reporting and early warning of the covd-19 streaming based on wireless communication and ranging. Technical field: wireless ranging and wireless communication applications. The technical scheme is as follows: the distance information and the time information between devices are detected by taking the standards of 802.11AX and 802.11ac, namely the standards of VHT and HE as a test method in a 2G-5G environment through portable communication devices such as mobile phones, tablet personal computers or other portable devices, and the detection distance reaches the distance precision of 20cm and more. The system and the implementation of the application device comprise the following subsystems: the system comprises a radio frequency front end, a baseband signal processor and a central processing unit of the system. The device is used for testing the approaching distance and time of people, epidemic prevention and epidemiological investigation can be accurately carried out, the contact distance of potential new crown positive personnel can be recorded, monitored and early-warned in real time, and the database is updated at the central control position. Can also be used in other fields.

title_en: Administrative safety monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an administrative security monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: a plurality of data acquisition modules; the safety early warning modules are responsible for receiving signals sent by the corresponding data acquisition modules; the safety early warning module is internally provided with a singlechip, and the singlechip is based on a machine learning algorithm model; the monitoring end is connected with the safety early warning modules and the data acquisition modules and comprises a central processing module, a central learning module and a judging module. And the singlechip in the safety early warning module updates and corrects parameters of the machine learning algorithm model according to the online trained machine learning algorithm model. By adopting a distributed computing and central online training mode, a data acquisition module and a corresponding safety early warning module are arranged around the administrative environment, and online training of real-time change data at a monitoring end is utilized to realize dynamic model updating and correction so as to adapt to the change of the administrative environment and new safety threat and improve safety and emergency response capability.

title_en: Chemical industry enterprise safety monitoring platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety monitoring platform for chemical enterprises, which is characterized in that: the system comprises a major hazard source monitoring and early warning module, a safety risk partition management module, a personnel on-duty management module, a safety production whole-flow management module and a combustible gas monitoring and alarming module; the data acquisition equipment such as a sensor is adopted to monitor important dangerous source elements and combustible gas in real time, so that the production state of a factory can be mastered in real time; the on-duty management module can acquire real-time positioning information of on-duty personnel, and is beneficial to rescue the personnel who can not withdraw in time when a safety accident occurs; a large number of supervisory personnel do not need to be arranged, actual conditions can be sensed by monitoring data, and the safety production management effect of chemical enterprises is improved while the labor cost is saved.
assignees: NANTONG SYNASIA NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network outage probability analysis and resource scheduling optimization method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart power grids, and provides a power outage probability analysis and resource scheduling optimization method for a power distribution network based on a knowledge graph. The topology/environment dual-attention architecture is adopted to fuse multi-source features, so that the fusion efficiency of the equipment node features and the environment node features is improved, a fault deduction model with dynamic weight constraint is introduced, and the secondary fault early warning capability is enhanced. And in the resource scheduling link, integrating a mixed integer programming model of carbon-shift factors and island power balance constraint, and realizing pareto optimization of rush repair efficiency and environmental protection targets. And realizing the trans-regional adaptation of the knowledge graph through transfer learning, and controlling the reduction of the access error of the novel station area in the reconstruction scene of the distribution network. The method supports minute-level topology reconstruction and second-level weight update, has low delay and high expansion capacity, and is suitable for provincial power grid real-time deployment.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flood surveillance and forecasting system
title_ko: 홍수위 감시 및 예측 경보 시스템
abstract_en: A system for monitoring and forecasting a flood is provided to secure effectiveness and convenience of a bridge monitoring service through a real-time remote monitoring and forecasting information. A field measurement system(1) includes a CCTV camera(11), a water surface meter(12), a field controller(13), and a signal conversion transmitter(14). The CCTV camera is controlled by the field controller. The water surface meter calculates a distance from a sender to a water surface by receiving a reflective sound wave reflected in the water surface after transmitting a sound wave toward the water surface. The signal conversion transmitter transmits a water surface data and an image signal measured in a bridge to a position in which a field monitoring system(2) is installed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 태풍, 폭우 및 강우 시 다수의 교량에 시설보수요원이 현장에 상주하여, 홍수위 경보에 대한 교량의 여유고를 장시간 관측하는 어려움과 인력 낭비를 해결하기 위한 계측시스템 설치 및 운영에 관한 것이다. 즉, 인적, 물적 자원의 낭비를 절약하기 위하여 홍수위 수위를 실시간 자동계측 하고 위험 분석 및 경보를 발령, 해제하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 복수의 교량 여유고를 수위의 위험 정도에 따라 주의, 경계, 위험, 범람의 단계로 구분하고 경보 발령 및 해제의 기준을 정립하고, 교량의 수위 변화의 추세를 통계학적 방법론으로 분석하여 예측 수위정보를 제공한다. 예측수위정보를 철도영업 km정과 열차의 운행 속도와 연동하여 홍수위의 위험 및 범람 등에 직면한 복수의 교량에 대한, 관심역을 출발한 열차의 통과 가능성 여부 정보를 제공한다. 이를 위하여 각 교량에 수위계와 CCTV 카메라를 설치하여 관할역에서 현장 감시를 하고, 수위데이터와 동영상을 통합제어시스템으로 실시간 전송한다. 
      통합제어시스템에서는 복수의 원격측정장비로부터 실시간 수위데이터 및 동영상 정보를 현시 함에 있어 복수의 교량이 위험 및 범람 등의 가능성이 높은 교량을 그 순서를 위험, 범람 등 위험도 순서로 배열한다. 또한 교량의 수위 상승 예측을 통하여 경보 발령. 해제 및 상. 하행선 열차 통과 가능역 분석 등의 열차 운행제어를 위한 정보를 제공하여 열차의 안전과 철도시설물의 방호 및 승객의 불편을 최소화하고자 하는 시스템에 관한 것이다 
     또한. 데이터베이스를 구축하여 경보 기준 및 수위 예측 정보의 개선에 반영한다. 
       
     철도, 열차, 교량, 홍수위, 여유고, 수위계, 동영상, 경보, 예측 경보

title_en: Method for eliminating false alarm of distress call device by assisting in detecting motion of distress call device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for assisting in measuring motion and eliminating false alarm of a call-for-help device, which relates to the technical field of safety protection equipment and comprises a call-for-help device main body and a bracelet; the bracelet acquires motion signals of the wrist of a firefighter in real time through the first acceleration sensor, and sends control signals to the main body of the distress call device through the first wireless processor chip under the condition that the motion signals are acquired; the calling-for-help device main part passes through the motion signal of second acceleration sensor real-time acquisition firefighter health position, under the motion signal's of not gathering firefighter health position the condition, carry out the counter count, reach under the condition of predetermineeing the numerical value at count data, the control alarm sends alarm instruction, and under the condition of receiving control signal through the second wireless processor chip, reset count data, combine bracelet detection firefighter motion state, the alert operation of accessible motion signal cancellation wrong report, and then play the effect of accurate warning, provide the guarantee to firefighter's security.
assignees: TIANJIN TIANAN BORUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based geological disaster monitoring, predicting and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic data fault detection, and discloses an artificial intelligence-based geological disaster monitoring, predicting and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring geological disaster related data by using a sensor network, satellite remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle technology; s2: integrating multiple data sources to perform multidimensional data fusion analysis; s3: analyzing historical data through a machine learning algorithm, and constructing a prediction model of the geological disaster; s4: automatically learning complex correlations and features in geological disaster data through a neural network model; s5: combining the real-time data with a prediction model to establish a geological disaster real-time monitoring and early warning system; s6: combining with artificial intelligence technology to establish a decision support system; s7: automating and accelerating an emergency response flow; s8: by introducing online learning and incremental learning, the method has higher self-adaptive capacity, and can continuously adjust and update the prediction model according to new monitoring data, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of prediction.

title_en: Transformer substation safety early warning method and device based on position location
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system automation, and discloses a transformer substation safety early warning method and device based on position location. By accurately acquiring the second point cloud data and the second image data, the real-time position and the gesture orientation of the target personnel in the three-dimensional scene of the transformer substation can be accurately acquired, and high-precision positioning is realized. The high-precision positioning technology avoids the situation that the position judgment of the target personnel is deviated due to the fact that the precision of the traditional positioning mode is limited, so that the target personnel accidentally intrudes into a dangerous area, and finally serious potential safety hazards are brought to the transformer substation. Meanwhile, the moving of the objects in the transformer substation is dynamically updated through the first point cloud data acquired in real time, so that the accuracy and timeliness of the whole three-dimensional scene information are ensured, and the safe and stable operation of the transformer substation is comprehensively ensured.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: System and method for rapidly preparing geological disaster weather risk early warning multi-level early warning map
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid preparation system and a rapid preparation method of a geological disaster weather risk early warning multi-level early warning map, which comprise a space vector data acquisition module, an early warning map generation module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the space vector data acquisition module is used for acquiring space vector data of an early warning unit and space vector data of the management unit, the early warning unit comprises a slope unit and a micro-basin unit, the management unit comprises a small basin unit, a village unit and a village street unit, the early warning data acquisition module is used for acquiring early warning data of the early warning unit, the table mapping module is used for constructing a mapping relation table between each management unit and each early warning unit and a mapping relation table between the management units according to the space vector data of the early warning unit and the space vector data of the management unit, the early warning map generation module is used for generating an early warning map of each management unit according to the mapping relation table between each management unit and each early warning unit and the early warning data of the early warning unit, the man-machine interaction module is used for acquiring modification information of early warning of an external user, and the early warning map modification module is used for responding to the modification information of the early warning of the user, and the early warning map of the management unit is updated. The method can realize the modification of different-level early warning diagrams, comprehensively support the early warning treatment work of the geological disaster weather risk, and promote the standardized and procedural management of geological disaster prevention and control.
assignees: CHONGQING GEOMATICS AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER CHONGQING SURVEYING AND MAPPING PRODUCT QUALITY INSPEC;CHONGQING GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for pushing weather forecast of short-coming disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for pushing weather forecast of an impending disaster. The method comprises the steps of collecting weather radar echo intensity data and ground observation station weather data, grouping the radar echo intensity data through a Maring Square algorithm to generate longitude and latitude contour lines, carrying out validity filtering on all the groups, calculating a weather signal of the earth, constructing a weather signal time sequence, judging the starting and stopping time of strong weather to generate a strong weather mark signal, carrying out AI prediction, optical flow extrapolation prediction and Kalman filtering fusion processing on the basis of the strong weather mark signal, the radar echo intensity data and an effective group set to obtain a fusion prediction result diagram, calculating a precipitation rate and a maximum accumulated precipitation value through converting precipitation intensity processing on the basis of the diagram and the longitude and latitude contour lines, and generating an early warning instruction by combining a preset grading threshold. The method improves the accuracy and timeliness of the weather forecast of the short-coming disasters by means of AI prediction, optical flow extrapolation processing and the like.

title_en: Mariculture area risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a risk assessment method and a risk assessment device for a mariculture area, which are used for realizing the joint simulation of various power elements such as deep water topography, an atmospheric forced field, a typhoon moving path, a tide boundary, sea water temperature and salt flow and the like by constructing a multi-dimensional power element coupling simulation model, so that more real and fine marine environment characteristic information can be obtained. By carrying out bidirectional data exchange between the wind wave model and the hydrodynamic model, key parameters such as wave radiation stress, tide speed, tide level and the like can be synchronously updated, so that the simulation precision under extreme sea conditions is remarkably improved. On the basis, the method combines the differential characteristics of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities to respectively determine the risk levels of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities, and further generates the comprehensive risk assessment result facing the target area, so that the actual risk condition can be reflected more accurately, and the scientificity and reliability of disaster early warning and management decision of the mariculture area are improved.

title_en: The method of major accident drive recorder automatic alarm
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of method of major accident drive recorder automatic alarm, it is adaptable to which one installs the automobile of drive recorder, and this method includes：The first setting value of the gravity value of gravity sensor triggering when occurring one-level accident is preset in the drive recorder；The drive recorder judges whether the real-time gravity value of gravity sensor triggering is more than first setting value；If the real-time gravity value is more than first setting value, the drive recorder feeds back an accident information to the mobile phone of driver, if the drive recorder does not receive the confirmation of mobile phone transmission in a setting time, the drive recorder sends warning message；If the drive recorder receives the cancellation information of mobile phone transmission in the setting time, the drive recorder need not send warning message.
assignees: KUNSHAN YANDA COMPUTER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide collaborative monitoring and early warning method and system for high-risk zone of ground disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for collaborative monitoring and early warning of landslide in a disaster high-risk area, which are applied to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring landslide surface data and landslide geological structure data of a target landslide; setting a plurality of monitoring devices, acquiring landslide movement type data and landslide deformation type data, acquiring prediction displacement data, calculating first correction weights, correcting the first correction weights to form second correction weights, updating a second neural network model, and judging whether a target landslide is safe or not according to the prediction displacement data output by the updated second neural network model. According to the invention, different landslide movement types and landslide deformation types are analyzed, and the analyzed results are applied to the updating process of the neural network model, so that the model prediction precision is effectively improved, the iteration efficiency is improved, the prediction model can be timely updated to the latest state after various emergency conditions, and the safety and applicability are effectively improved.
assignees: SICHUAN NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY AND DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed optical fiber temperature-sensing fire detection algorithm based on CNN-LSTM and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed optical fiber temperature-sensing fire detection algorithm based on a CNN-LSTM and an attention mechanism, and aims to solve the problems of high false alarm rate, response lag and poor scene adaptability in the traditional detection technology. The system collects temperature data at a space resolution of 0.5 m at intervals of 2 seconds through a distributed optical fiber sensing unit, inputs CNN-LSTM hybrid model to extract space-time characteristics after Z-Score standardization, db4 wavelet noise reduction and 12-dimensional characteristic enhancement pretreatment, and outputs fire risk indexes of 0-100 in combination with focusing key areas and moments of an attention mechanism. The model training adopts transfer learning and Focal Loss function to realize cross-scene rapid adaptation and sample imbalance treatment, and parameters are updated through incremental learning every 30 days.
