Practice shows that the false alarm rate of the method is reduced by more than 80 percent compared with that of the traditional threshold method, and the smoldering fire disaster early warning is advanced by 25 seconds, so that the method can be widely applied to fire safety monitoring of complex scenes such as tunnels, substations, comprehensive pipe galleries and the like.

title_en: Vehicle Emergency Notification Device
title_ko: 차량의 긴급상황 알림장치
abstract_en: An emergency situation notification device for a vehicle is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an emergency situation notification device installed on an inner surface of a trunk lid of a vehicle comprises: a main body having one side hinged to the inner surface of the trunk lid to be rotatable and having a light emitting part composed of a plurality of LEDs; and a fixing member configured to fix the other side of the main body to the inner surface of the trunk lid, and to release the fixing force of the main body when the trunk lid is opened so that the main body is rotated to be in a vertical state.
abstract_ko: 차량의 긴급상황 알림장치가 개시된다. 실시예에 따르면, 자동차의 트렁크 리드의 내부면에 형성되는 것이며, 트렁크 리드의 내부면에 일측이 힌지 결합되어 회전 가능하도록 하고, 다수의 엘이디로 구성된 발광부가 형성된 본체; 본체의 타측이 트렁크 리드의 내부면에 고정되도록 하고, 트렁크 리드가 개방되면 본체의 고정력을 해제시켜 본체가 회전되어 수직된 상태가 되도록 하는 고정부재;를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation method and system in nuclear power plant field
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for emergency evacuation in a nuclear power plant, comprising the following steps: judging whether an emergency evacuation instruction is received or not; if yes, judging whether an emergency gathering point exists; if yes, outputting an emergency evacuation signal and emergency evacuation information for evacuating to the emergency gathering point; judging whether evacuation from the emergency gathering point is needed or not according to the predicted dose rate and the number of people in real time; outputting an instruction for evacuating from the emergency gathering point if the emergency gathering point is required to evacuate from the emergency gathering point; receiving an instruction of evacuation from an emergency gathering point, and planning a path based on a preset method to obtain an optimal path of emergency evacuation; outputting the optimal path, and withdrawing from the emergency gathering point according to the optimal path. By implementing the invention, under the condition that the dosage rate level is in a safe range, the evacuation and arrangement of personnel can be realized at the highest speed; the dosage rate level in the process of personnel evacuation under the nuclear emergency condition can be maximally reduced; and the emergency accurate decision of the nuclear power plant is improved, and the safety level of the nuclear power plant is improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER DESIGN CO LTD SHENZHEN

title_en: Dynamic forecasting and early warning method and device for mountain torrent disasters in small river basin and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic forecasting and early warning method and device for mountain torrents in a small river basin, and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: collecting topography and topography of a small drainage basin and early rainfall information, and determining factors which have obvious influence on the flow of a control section of the small drainage basin at the next moment by using a gray correlation analysis method; establishing a multiple linear regression model according to the factors to simulate and forecast the flow of the control section at the next moment; calculating early rainfall information at the next moment according to forecast information of a weather forecast department so as to update the early rainfall information; repeating the steps to obtain the control section flow in a future period of time; calculating the over-designed flow proportion, occurrence probability and early warning duration of the control section flow according to the control section flow and the weather forecast information; and determining whether to start early warning according to the over-designed flow ratio, the occurrence probability and the early warning duration. The application provides reliable technical support for flood disaster prevention and has important significance for flood disaster risk treatment and decision.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Single-hole coal rock stress state acquisition method for drill-in sensing-drill-out correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-hole coal rock stress state acquisition method for drill-in sensing-drill-out correction, and belongs to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining wave speed and acoustic emission dynamic characteristics of coal and rock, determining a perception index threshold value, secondly selecting drilling engineering, installing a wave field acquisition tool, thirdly setting acquisition parameters, acquiring and transmitting wave field signals in real time, fourthly performing data noise reduction processing to obtain characteristic parameter values, fifthly selecting the index threshold value, dynamically perceiving an initial stress state of the coal and rock, sixthly, performing drilling-returning peeping scanning, correcting the stress state of the coal and rock in real time, and seventhly, performing inversion imaging to obtain a hole circumferential stress field. According to the invention, dynamic perception of the Kong Zhoumei rock initial stress state in the drilling process is realized, the hole circumference stress correction degree is provided, and the Kong Zhoumei rock initial stress state is objectively corrected in the drilling withdrawal process, so that a real basis is provided for comprehensively acquiring the underground coal rock stratum stress state.

title_en: Data processing method based on three-dimensional geological modeling
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method based on three-dimensional geologic modeling, which comprises the steps of forming a multi-scale geologic data pool by constructing a macro-medium-micro three-level geologic data acquisition system and adopting coordinate unification and format standardization, generating a multi-resolution three-dimensional geologic model based on a layered dynamic fusion architecture and combining a weighting algorithm and a cross-scale calibration technology, realizing incremental dynamic update of the model by means of an Internet of things sensor network and edge computing nodes, and finally generating multi-level geologic hazard early warning by means of mechanical parameter threshold analysis and AR visualization technology. The method realizes the whole-flow closed-loop management from data acquisition to early warning generation, effectively solves the problem of fusion of multi-source heterogeneous geological data, remarkably improves the timeliness, accuracy and visualization level of geological disaster early warning, and provides reliable technical support for geological disaster prevention.
assignees: China railway 11th bureau group co ltd;CHINA RAILWAY 11TH BUREAU GROUP XIAN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Medical consumable management system and method based on intelligent expiration manager
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical consumable management system and a method based on an intelligent expiration date manager, which belong to the technical field of medical consumable management and comprise the intelligent expiration date manager and a mobile terminal, wherein the intelligent expiration date manager is added between a traditional locker and an electronic form to realize real-time bidirectional association of physical consumables and electronic information, each batch of consumables has independent identifiable marks and active early warning capability, a system can automatically remind near expiration dates of consumables, the current stock quantity of consumables and quickly position target consumables by means of a Bluetooth communication and audible and visual prompting mechanism, manual inspection and searching burden is greatly reduced, and an intelligent consumable management system with low cost, expandability, adaptation to the current situation of a department can be constructed on the premise that a complex WMS system is not required to be deployed, so that the problems of mixed placement of multiple batches, delay of expiration date management, low searching efficiency, asynchronous data and the like are fundamentally solved, and the safety, timeliness and working efficiency of consumable management are remarkably improved.

title_en: Apparatus and method for preventing disaster caused by short-circuit in electric power systems
title_ko: 전력계통에서의 단락 발생시 재해 방지장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method to prevent a disaster when a short circuit occurs in a power system, using fail power short-circuited when a short circuit occurs on a load side of a power distribution line installed in a power system to decrease a short circuit current of a supply power side and decrease an output voltage of the load side, so as to prevent an electric accident due to the short circuit current. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a warning generator to interlink with the power system (power distribution line) for supplying power to a single or three-phase, and to warn occurrence of a short circuit; a warning release signal input unit to release a warning; and a short circuit correction device. The short circuit correction device comprises: a short circuit power converter to generate a short circuit signal simultaneously with the occurrence of the short circuit when the short circuit occurs, to prevent a casualty accident due to an electric shock, reduce the output value of the load side while changing an electric connection position of a coil connected to a power input terminal, distribute the voltage inputted to the power input terminal to the coil of which the position is changed to reduce the short circuit current when earth fault occurs due to a short circuit as a ground potential difference of the short-circuited power is reduced more than a potential difference of the power, and to allow a harmonic wave to flow once in normal and inverse phases which are converted by 180 angular degrees when the harmonic wave is generated on the load side; a switch to transfer the short circuit signal; and a switch to output power cut-off and warning signals in accordance with an electric signal outputted from the switch.
abstract_ko: 전력계통에 구비된 배전선로의 부하측에서 단락시에 단락된 고장전력을 이용하여 공급전원측 단락전류를 감소시키고, 부하측 출력전압을 감소시켜, 단락전류로 인한 전기사고를 방지할 수 있도록 한 전력계통에서의 단락(합선)시 재해 방지장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 전력계통에서의 단락(합선)시 재해 방지장치는, 단상 또는 3상을 통해 전력을 공급해주는 전력계통(배전선로)과 연계하고, 단락(합선) 발생을 경보하는 경보 발생기와; 경보해제를 위한 경보해제 신호 입력부와; 단락보정장치를 포함하며 상기 단락보정장치는, 상기 단락이 발생하면 단락 발생과 동시에 단락전기신호를 발생하고, 단락 된 전력의 대지 전위차를 전원의 전위차보다 감소하여 단락으로 인한 지락(누전)이 발생하면 감전에 의한 인명사고를 예방하며, 전원입력단자에 연결된 코일의 전기적인 연결 위치를 변경하고 전원입력단자에 입력되는 전압을 상기 위치를 변경한 코일로 분산시켜 단락전류를 감소시키면서, 부하측의 출력전압을 감소시키며 부하측에서 고조파가 발생하면 상기 고조파를 180도 변환되는 정상위상과 역상위상에 한 차례 흐르게 하여 발생한 고조파를 상쇄하는 단락전력변환기와; 상기 단락 전기신호를 전달하기 위한 스위치와; 상기 스위치에 의해 출력되는 전기신호에 따라 전력차단 및 경보신호를 위한 스위치를 포함한다.

title_en: Electrical fault detection and recovery power distribution system and its construction method
title_ko: 전기고장 만능탐지 및 복구 배전시스템 및 그 공사방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power distribution system for detecting and restoring all electrical faults, which prevents electric shock, fire, and a blackout, and to a construction method thereof. The power distribution system for detecting and restoring all electrical faults comprises: a power source side detection/recovery device; a load side detection/recovery device; a fault detector; a controller; an alarm generator; an alarm-clear input unit; and a breaker.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 삼상 또는 단상 전기설비(부스덕트 등) 또는 본 배전시스템 자체에서 저항증가, 아크, 단선, 결상, 접속불량, 반단선, 오결선, 이상전압유입, 누전, 합선, 전력불평형이 발생하면 고장이 발생한 구간, 장소, 고장위치에 따라 즉시 경보, 차단, 복구, 통보, 감시, 제어하는 전기고장 만능탐지 및 복구 배전시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 전기고장 만능탐지 및 복구 배전시스템은, 제1 중성점을 구비하고, 이 중성점을 상기 전기설비에 구비된 중성선에 연결하거나, 부하측 탐지/복구기의 제2 중성점에 연결하는 전원측 탐지/복구기와; 상기 제2 중성점을 구비하고, 이 중성점을 상기 전원측 탐지/복구기의 제1 중성점 또는 상기 전기설비에 구비된 중성선에 연결하여, 전원측 전기고장을 차단 또는 탐지 또는 복구하도록 하는 상기 부하측 탐지/복구기와; 상기 부하측 탐지/복구기는 상기 전기설비의 설치위치에 따라 연계하여 구비되거나, 각 층별 또는 각 전기설비마다 하나 이상이 구비되어 고장 발생 시에 구간, 장소, 회로위치를 구분하도록 하고, 구간, 장소. 위치를 구분한 전력선 또는 중성점의 입출력 전류를 분리하여 검출하거나, 상기 중성점과 중성선 또는 중성점과 중성점의 전압 또는 전류를 분리 탐지하여 경보 또는 차단하거나, 검출한 고장검출값을, 자기위치를 포함하여 제어기에 전달하는 고장검출기와; 상기 고장검출기가 제공한 검출 값을 설정치와 비교하여 고장으로 판단되면, 고장위치에 대응하는 경보, 차단, 복구, 통보, 감시, 제어하거나, RTU통신모듈과 연계하여 제어하는 제어기와; 상기 고장검출기 또는 제어기에서 제공받은 경보신호에 따라 경보를 발생하는 경보발생기와; 상기 경보발생기의 경보발령을 해제하기 위한 경보해제 입력부와; 상기 고장검출기 또는 제어기의 차단신호에 따라 고장전원을 차단하기 위한 차단기가 구비된다.

title_en: An experimental method for measurement of seasonal human heat adaptation and assessment method of the acclimation model using the same
title_ko: 계절 별 인체 열 적응 측정을 위한 실험 방법 및 이를 이용한 한국형 기후적응모델의 평가 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experimental method for measuring seasonal human heat adaptation and a Korean climatization model evaluation method using the same. According to the present invention, the Korean climatization model is a modified German climatization model in consideration of the climate environment of Korea and warm and cool sensations for Koreans. The method comprises: a step a of setting health warning standards due to heat waves based on the Korean climatization model; a step b of setting experimental conditions of a seasonal human body heat adaptation experiment; a step c of when the experiment is performed according to the experimental conditions, receiving a result of warm/cool vote by examining the warm/cool vote from subjects of the experiment; a step d of predicting a result of the warming/cooling vote on the basis of the experimental conditions and health warning criteria; and a step e of evaluating the Korea climatization model by comparing the result of the warming/cooling vote with predicted values.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 계절 별 인체 열 적응 측정을 위한 실험 방법 및 이를 이용한 한국형 기후적응모델의 평가 방법에 관한 것으로, 계절 별 열 적응 측정을 위한 실험을 기반으로 한국형 기후적응모델을 평가하는 방법에 있어서, 상기 한국형 기후적응모델은 독일형 기후적응모델을 한국의 기후환경 및 한국인의 온냉감 특성을 고려하여 변경한 것이며, 상기 한국형 기후적응모델을 기반으로 폭염으로 인한 건강 경고 기준을 설정하는 a 단계, 계절 별 인체 열 적응 실험의 실험 조건을 설정하는 b 단계, 상기 실험 조건에 따라 실험을 수행하면, 상기 실험의 피험자로부터 온냉감투표를 조사하여 온냉감투표 결과 값을 수신하는 c 단계, 상기 실험 조건 및 건강 경고 기준을 기반으로 온냉감투표 결과를 예측하는 d 단계 및 상기 온냉감투표의 결과 값 및 예측 값을 비교하여 상기 한국형 기후적응모델을 평가하는 e 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Traveler's alert system
abstract_en: A method and a system for producing an updated status of users, associated with an MSISDN number in a mobile network, who are staying in a specific geographical area abroad, where it is desirable to be able to send information and warn of an undesirable event by sending a message to persons concerned.

title_en: Method for monitoring on-line quality and updating prediction model of rubber hardness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the on-line quality and updating a prediction model of rubber hardness, which comprises the following steps of: building a hardness online predicting model according to a training data set, and computing an alarm limit, a warning limit and a selecting limit; inputting a reheological parameter new sample into the hardness online predicting model, and automatically outputting a rubber hardness value; and according to relationship between the Q statistics value of the reheological parameter new sample Xnew and the alarm limit, the warning limit and the selecting limit, confirming whether the hardness online predicting model to be updated or not or whether a quality monitoring system alarms or not, checking the working condition of a production line by operation workers, and carrying out corresponding technical adjustment, so that the current working condition can be recovered to be the normal status. The model is constantly updated by the method, so that the exact rubber hardness value can be obtained, the quality of the rubber can be improved, the practical test verifies that the higher precision can be obtained by the method, and the potential safety hazards can be reduced; and along with the reduction of the number of the samples, the memory space of a computer can be reduced, and the computing speed can be observably improved.

title_en: Managing evacuation of a building in real time
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 100, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building triggered (S202) by an alarm notification, based on determining (S214) the precise real-time location of a personal ultra-wideband UWB device, as determined by a UWB real-time location system, RT L S, a controller determines (S210) a real-time evacuation plan specific to the personal UWB device, based on the individual evacuation plan and input from the building facility, defines (S208) and sends to each personal UWB device real-time guidance information providing to the person carrying the personal UWB device which direction to move to reach a guided safe area (S212). then, based on the location signal, UWB RT L SA calculates the updated location of the personal device and sends it to the evacuation management system.

title_en: Electric bicycle charging safety monitoring system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring the charging safety of an electric bicycle and an early warning method, and relates to the technical field of the charging safety of the electric bicycle, wherein the system comprises the steps that after a user inserts a power line, a two-dimensional code on an intelligent charging socket of the electric bicycle is scanned, and the intelligent charging socket of the electric bicycle is associated with an intelligent charger; sequentially performing battery information analysis processing, charging information analysis processing and shed-level information analysis processing; the platform side information is pushed to a user charged by the electric bicycle, and friendly interaction is carried out with the user; if the safe charging of the electric bicycle is completed, the platform cancels the intelligent charging socket of the electric bicycle focused by the user; if the electric bicycle has faults in the charging process, the three-stage sectional protection is directly started. The invention creates a public charging safety environment, creates a solution for interaction between the electric bicycle and the network, and aims at strengthening protection in the charging process, and mainly installing a professional intelligent charging socket to solve the potential safety hazard of charging of the electric bicycle.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Lighter data allocation method and system based on intelligent cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud computing data analysis, in particular to a lighter data allocation method and system based on an intelligent cloud platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of efficiently storing data of the intelligent lighter by arranging a data cache layer in the cloud platform; the cache data is periodically updated, a data cache mechanism is established, and the cache efficiency and availability are ensured; the battery state data of the intelligent lighter are extracted from the buffer layer at regular intervals or according to the set triggering conditions, and the change of the battery state is accurately captured; the battery health index of the intelligent lighter is obtained through calculation, and the battery state of the intelligent lighter is judged so as to facilitate subsequent fault early warning; and acquiring a primary early warning prompt, a secondary early warning prompt and a tertiary early warning prompt through processing analysis, and performing targeted management and control. The invention is used for solving the technical problems of data transmission delay and potential safety hazards of the intelligent lighter in the existing scheme.

title_en: Slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm and system based on deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a standardized state characterization vector and establishing a state quality evaluation index; the method comprises the steps of receiving a state characterization vector as input, constructing a dual-mode strategy architecture, generating a preliminary decision and confidence level assessment thereof to form a quantitative index of decision reliability, forming a final early warning instruction and strategy updating suggestion, generating a strategy performance assessment report, continuously tracking the change trend of state feature distribution, constructing a strategy degradation early warning system, triggering a model reconstruction mechanism, feeding back updated strategy network parameters to the dual-mode strategy architecture, and feeding back optimized feature extraction suggestion to an established state quality assessment index. The system comprises an index establishment module, a report generation module and a reconstruction mechanism module. The slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm realizes a monitoring-decision-optimizing end-to-end closed-loop control system through a deep reinforcement learning framework.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;ANHUI CONSTRUCTION ENG ROAD & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for warning rear side vehicle based on information of driver
title_ko: 운전자 인식에 기반한 후측방 경보 방법 및 후측방 경보시스템
abstract_en: A rear side alarming method and a rear side alarming system based on driver's recognition are provided to prevent safety accidents by supplying an emergency signal based on driver's recognition. A rear side alarming method and a rear side alarming system based on driver's recognition comprises the followings: a diver database(210) in which driver recognition information is stored; a driver recognition part(220) generating driver recognition information; an alarming area set part(230) setting up an emergency signal domain corresponding to the driver recognition information; a rear side vehicle sensing part(240) sensing a rear side vehicle by suing a vehicle sensor; and an alarming operating part(250).
abstract_ko:
운전자 인식에 기반한 후측방 경보 방법 및 후측방 경보 시스템이 소개된다. 그 시스템은, 운전자 인식 관련 정보가 저장된 운전자 데이터베이스; 운전자 인식 정보를 생성하는 운전자 인식부; 상기 운전자 인식 정보에 해당하는 경보영역을 설정하는 경보영역 설정부; 차량 감지 센서를 이용하여 후측방 차량을 감지하는 후측방 차량 감지부; 및 상기 감지된 후측방 차량이 상기 설정된 경보영역에 존재하면 경보하는 경보 관리부를 포함한다. 이러한 시스템은, 운전능력 또는 판단능력이 낮거나, 운전시 필요한 운동 신경이 둔화된 운전자의 안전한 주행 및 차선 변경을 보조한다. 
       
     후측방 차량, 운전자 인식, 경보영역
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: A kind of indoor disaster alarm based on Internet of Things and manned salvage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of indoor disaster alarm based on Internet of Things and manned salvage system, including controlling terminal, the sensing controler being connected with control terminal, manned aid, alarm device, control terminal comprises central processing unit, central processing unit is connected with sensing controler, manned aid, alarm device by the first signal transmitting and receiving module；Sensing controler is connected with shaking sensor, Smoke Sensor, gas detector, temperature sensor one；Manned aid includes controller, manned mobile device, and manned mobile device includes seat, is located at the mobile roller of under-seat；Human body infrared induction apparatus, temperature sensor two it is additionally provided with in manned mobile device.The present invention can the timely early warning provide can actively move to need to withdraw near people and the manned device withdrawn to handicapped people when disaster occurs, when disaster the occur casualties that cause is greatly reduced.

title_en: Intelligent terminal for realizing risk detection based on hong Mongolian system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of risk detection and discloses an intelligent terminal for realizing risk detection based on a hong Mongolian system. According to the application, the physiological monitoring module is utilized to generate corresponding physiological data through data preprocessing and multi-period segmentation and recombination, then the physiological data is compared with a dynamically updated physiological threshold value to generate physiological early warning, the high-inverse evaluation module is utilized to combine altitude data and historical high-inverse records to carry out high-inverse evaluation through similarity analysis and generate warning, the safety perimeter module is utilized to integrate individual position and overall distribution evaluation position risk to generate early warning or warning, and the warning module is utilized to integrate various information and push warning according to priority, so that the defects of the traditional technology in aspects of data integration analysis, high-inverse evaluation scientificity, position evaluation comprehensiveness, warning information processing and the like are overcome, and the safety monitoring level of personnel in complex operation environments is improved.
assignees: GUO NENG LONG YUAN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: In-vehicle Sound Wave Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Puncture of Tire
title_ko: 타이어 펑크 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an in-vehicle sound wave device to provide an emergency rescue service for a flat tire, capable of automatically requesting the emergency rescue service for a flat tire. According to the present invention, the in-vehicle sound wave device comprises: a short-range communication module; a positioning module; a sensor module; and a control module including a speech recognition unit, a position checking unit, a sensor checking unit, a situation checking unit, a sound wave checking unit, and a service processing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 타이어 펑크 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치에 따르면, 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 음파장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보를 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 타이어 펑크 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 타이어 펑크 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보에 대응하는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하면서 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Collaborative optimization and safety early warning system for building construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building construction safety monitoring and management, and discloses a collaborative optimization and safety early warning system for building construction. The dynamic risk modeling module constructs a multisource risk factor matrix based on the standardized data and calculates a composite risk score. The dynamic threshold generation module generates a security load dynamic threshold in combination with the material process and the environmental data. The behavior risk identification module analyzes the relevance of the personnel behaviors and the risk areas. The response scheduling optimization module generates an optimal response path scheme based on the risk score and the early warning signal. The system linkage control module coordinates the multi-level control and dynamically updates the system parameters. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion, dynamic threshold adjustment and self-adaptive weight algorithm, accurate risk assessment and intelligent emergency dispatch are realized, a closed-loop safety management system is constructed, construction monitoring instantaneity is improved, and accident rate is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCIAL ERJIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP LTD

title_en: Cabinet-type fire extinguisher with advance withdrawal guiding functionality and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 사전 퇴거 유도 기능의 캐비닛형 소화기 및 사전 퇴거 유도 방법
abstract_en: According to the embodiments of the present invention, a cabinet type fire extinguisher comprises: a fire receiver sensing a fire to generate a fire warning linking signal, an odorant emission signal, and a fire extinguishing gas emission signal and outputting a delay fire extinguishing gas emission signal; a fire extinguishing gas emission unit emitting a fire extinguishing gas in accordance with a delay fire extinguishing gas emission signal; and an odorant emission unit provided inside to at least one housing, opening a discharge valve of an odorant storage container storing a high-pressure inert gas, a high-pressure gas, and a liquid odorant or a powder odorant in accordance with the odorant emission signal to enable the odorant to be operated to be emitted from a nozzle connected to the discharge valve by expansion of the high-pressure inert gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들에 따른 캐비닛형 소화기는 화재를 감지하여 화재 경보 연동 신호, 부취제 방출 신호 및 소화 가스 방출 신호를 생성하고, 지연 소화 가스 방출 신호를 출력하는 화재 수신반, 지연 소화 가스 방출 신호에 따라 소화 가스를 방출하는 소화 가스 방출부 및 고압의 가스, 액상 또는 분말 형태의 부취제와 고압의 비활성 가스를 저장하는 부취제 저장 용기의 배출 밸브를 부취제 방출 신호에 따라 개방하여, 부취제가 고압의 비활성 가스의 팽창에 의해 배출 밸브에 연결된 노즐로부터 방출되도록 동작하는 부취제 방출부를 적어도 하나의 하우징 내에 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Safety system of Cross walk
title_ko: 횡단보도 안전시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crosswalk safety system which can: calculate a passage forecast time (T) by a calculated movement speed (WV) after calculating the movement speed (WV) of a pedestrian; solve problems in which a movement speed is excessively delayed while securing the safe passage of the pedestrian by determining a display period of a pedestrian signal according to the calculated passage forecast time (T); accurately detect a display period by corresponding to the movement speed (WV) of the pedestrian by calculating the movement speed (WV) and the passage forecast time (T) with components of an X-axis direction which is a longitudinal direction of a crosswalk after detecting a movement vector of the pedestrian; secure a safe passage of a new pedestrian while minimizing delay of a vehicle by resetting the display period by calculating a change forecast time (T) by multiplying the calculated passage forecast time (T) with a multiple which becomes lower according to the set number of the display period while resetting the display period when a new pedestrian is detected after setting the display period of the pedestrian signal; and completely prevent an accident in advance by being formed to display warning data when the movement of a vehicle stopping on a stop line is sensed when a pedestrian signal is turned on or a vehicle violating a speed limit is sensed by being formed to sense a vehicle in real time. The crosswalk safety system includes: a crosswalk traffic light; a pedestrian detecting radar which senses a waiting area (S1) formed in a crosswalk or in both sides of the crosswalk; a vehicle detecting radar which senses a vehicle; and a traffic signal controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보행자의 이동속도(WV)를 산출한 후 산출된 이동속도(WV)에 따라 통행예측시간(T)을 산출하며, 산출된 통행예측시간(T)에 따라 보행자신호의 현시주기를 결정함으로써 보행자의 안전한 통행을 보장함과 동시에 이동속도가 과도하게 지체되는 문제점을 해결할 수 있으며, 보행자의 움직임벡터를 검출한 후 횡단보도의 길이 방향인 X축 방향의 성분을 가지고 이동속도(WV) 및 통행예측시간(T)을 산출함으로써 보행자의 이동속도(WV)에 대응하여 현시주기를 더욱 정확하게 검출할 수 있고, 보행자신호의 현시주기를 설정한 이후, 신규보행자가 감지되는 경우 현시주기를 재설정하되, 현시주기의 설정 회수에 따라 낮아지는 배수를 산출된 통행예측시간(T)에 곱하여 변경예측시간(T`)을 산출하여 현시주기를 재설정함으로써 차량의 지체를 최소화하면서 신규보행자의 안전한 통행을 보장할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 차량을 감지하도록 구성되어 제한속도를 위반한 차량이 감지되거나 또는 보행자신호 점등 시 정지선에 정차 중인 차량의 움직임이 감지되는 경우 경고데이터를 표출하도록 구성됨으로써 안전사고를 사전에 철저하게 방지할 수 있는 횡단보도 안전시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_ko: 화재안전장치 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 상업적 주방 응용분야에 특히 적합한 화재안전시스템은 에너지 효율을 위한 배기 수준들의 제어를 제공하고 화재들 또는 화재 위험들에 지능적으로 대응한다. 실시예들에서, 시스템들은 화재 위험들 또는 임박한 화재들의 조기 경고를 제공할 수 있다. 실시예들은 취소가능한 경보들에 대해 확률적 추정치를 사용한다. 실시예들은 지도 학습을 위한 메커니즘으로서 경보 취소들을 활용할 수 있는 분류기들을 사용한다.

title_en: Mine side slope deformation monitoring and early warning system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a mine side slope deformation monitoring and early warning system and an early warning method thereof. The early warning system is composed of a ground control subsystem, a space wireless communication network and a communication auxiliary subsystem of monitoring workers, wherein the ground control subsystem, the space wireless communication network and the communication auxiliary subsystem are used for carrying out communication connection. The ground control subsystem is composed of a GPS mine side slope monitoring subsystem and a GPS monitoring data processing subsystem. The GPS monitoring mine side slope subsystem comprises a set of displacement measuring robots, a receiving antenna, a data transmission module, a GPS receiver and a power supply system, wherein the GPS receiver is used for receiving mine side slope deformation data collected by the displacement measuring robots. Various data are collected in real time, the monitoring data are processed, and the uploaded data are fast and automatically stored, transmitted, updated, counted and managed. The mine side slope deformation monitoring and early warning system has the advantages that the mine side slope displacement is dynamically monitored in real time, and safety production of a mine is guaranteed.

title_en: Mobile terminal early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile terminal early warning method and device. The method comprises the following steps: position information of a mobile terminal and a potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information are acquired in real time; if the potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information is equal to or greater than a preset value corresponding to the position information, the mobile terminal is triggered to give an alarm; the position information and the potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information are stored; the preset value corresponding to the position information is updated according to the stored potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information. According to the mobile terminal early warning method and device, the position information of the mobile terminal and the potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information are acquired in real time, the preset value corresponding to the position information is updated according to the stored potential safety hazard parameter, as a result, the preset value can change along with positions of a user or change along with practical situations of the position where the user is located, and the accuracy of the early warning function is improved to a certain extent.

title_en: A kind of staple crops Low temperature disaster remote sensing monitoring forecast system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to crops disaster monitoring technical fields, disclose a kind of staple crops Low temperature disaster remote sensing monitoring forecast system and method, it is provided with central operation device and controller, central operation device and controller connect with infrared remote sensing information monitor and control its working condition, then can send Low temperature disaster early warning to Low temperature disaster precursor.Crops Low temperature disaster index collector, modifier is improved with infrared remote sensing information monitor, disaster index and information-storing device is connected, the information that acceptable infrared remote sensing information monitor is sent, and modifier is improved with disaster index and is communicated, the index being collected into can also be sent in information-storing device and store by timely synchronized update.The present invention is stored and is compared to data target, and the Low temperature disaster that can may be arrived to future is forecast, the peasant of region crops is made to carry out precautionary measures in advance, is influenced from Low temperature disaster suffered by the crops of region is reduced, is ensured the interests of peasant.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted head-up display system oriented to safety auxiliary function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle-mounted head-up display system oriented to a safety auxiliary function, which comprises: the mainboard is used for providing a serial port and calculating; a projection screen connected with the main board for providing a reverse image; the display screen is a semi-transparent semi-reflective screen and displays safety auxiliary information, wherein the safety auxiliary information comprises lane change warning, pedestrian collision warning, construction area early warning and the like; the camera is connected with the main board, is arranged in the vehicle, shoots the face image of the driver and transmits the face image of the driver to the main board; during operation, the mainboard receives road side information and the driver face image transmitted by the camera, the mainboard updates the safety auxiliary information on the display screen according to the road side information, and simultaneously the mainboard identifies the driving state of the driver and adjusts the safety auxiliary information on the display screen according to the driving state of the driver so as to adapt to the state of the driver. Compared with the prior art, the occurrence of road safety accidents can be obviously reduced.

title_en: Water conservancy and hydropower engineering construction safety supervision system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring construction safety of water conservancy and hydropower engineering. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a hub monitoring subsystem comprising a plurality of first sensors in a dam hub area; constructing a landslide body monitoring subsystem comprising a plurality of second sensors in a landslide body area; constructing an early warning rule for single construction risk based on the subset of the first sensor and the second sensor; the pre-warning rules are updated based on periodic and/or incident manual checks. According to the invention, when the deformation of the hub and the landslide body, the groundwater level of the landslide body and other data reflecting engineering risks are monitored through the monitoring subsystem, personnel inspection information which is difficult to obtain through the monitoring data is obtained through manual inspection, an early warning rule is constructed and updated, and the accuracy, timeliness and instantaneity of early warning are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN WATER CONSERVANCY ENG CONSTRUCTION QUALITY AND SAFETY CENTER STATION

title_en: Network-based informatization supervision terminal for electric power construction site and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network-based informatization supervision terminal for an electric power construction site and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of terminal position positioning, and comprising a real-time positioning unit: the position information of the personnel is obtained in real time by using a satellite positioning technology and is uploaded to the central processing module by using a wireless communication technology, and the current position of the personnel can be displayed on a map and updated along with the change of the position; track recording unit: the method is used for recording the moving track of the supervision personnel; alarm notification unit: the position change of the supervision personnel is monitored, and an alarm notification is sent when an abnormal situation occurs; management and scheduling unit: the management end can check the real-time position of personnel, and perform task allocation and resource scheduling according to the needs, so that the efficiency and accuracy of construction management are improved. The invention tracks and records the personnel position in real time, and is convenient for the superior management department to manage and schedule.

title_en: Fire risk dynamic assessment and early warning method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety monitoring and early warning, in particular to a fire risk dynamic assessment and early warning method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multisource perception data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamically updated fire risk assessment state space based on multisource perception data, processing real-time states in the state space and generating a risk assessment decision through a deep reinforcement learning agent optimized based on a cumulative reward function with accuracy rewards, false alarm penalties and false alarm penalties, mapping continuous output of the risk assessment decision into discrete dynamic fire risk levels by the deep reinforcement learning agent, and triggering an early warning signal matched with the dynamic fire risk levels according to the dynamic fire risk levels. According to the invention, through multi-source data standardization, dynamic state space, reinforcement learning optimization and hierarchical early warning binding, accurate dynamic assessment, reliable early warning and high-effect emergency response are realized.

title_en: Port infrastructure marine environment disaster early warning platform construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early warning platform construction, and discloses a method and a system for constructing a harbour infrastructure marine environment disaster early warning platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the current time point, the current position and the current speed of typhoons, and the air density and the gravity acceleration of the height of the typhoons; the method comprises the steps of constructing a motion equation, calculating the speed of typhoon at the next time point, calculating the adjacent value between the current time point and the next time point of typhoon, updating the position and the speed between the current time point and the next time point of typhoon occurrence to obtain an updated position and an updated speed to obtain a typhoon path, calculating the typhoon wave height according to the typhoon path and typhoon intensity, and more accurately reflecting the actual movement condition of typhoon by updating the typhoon path in real time, so that the fine change of the typhoon path can be captured, real-time monitoring is realized, and strong data support is provided for construction of an early warning platform.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Attribute revocation encryption access control method and system based on time tag
abstract_en: The invention relates to a time-stamp-based attribute revocation encryption access control method and a time-stamp-based attribute revocation encryption access control system, wherein the system comprises a time stamp definition module, an alarm trigger judgment module, a dynamic optimization module, a disaster tolerance path configuration module and an encryption revocation execution module, wherein the time stamp definition module is used for realizing accurate pre-judgment of authority invalidation time by constructing a three-level constraint structure of an early warning window, an intervention window and an execution window, the alarm trigger judgment module is used for dynamically generating a hierarchical alarm signal based on a time window inclusion relation to solve the problem of manual response hysteresis, the dynamic optimization module is used for adaptively adjusting a scanning strategy by combining a system load state to eliminate resource waste of a fixed scanning mechanism, the disaster tolerance path configuration module is used for guaranteeing reliable execution of revocation instructions under a high concurrency scene through a main-backup dual-path design, the encryption revocation execution module is used for thoroughly eliminating historical key decryption capability through a key update factor injection technology, and triple promotion of authority revocation is realized under the cooperation of a data communication module.

title_en: Anti-theft system for cultural properties
title_ko: 문화재 도난방지용 시스템
abstract_en: An anti-theft system for cultural properties is provided to raise a security level by instantly notifying a manager of a theft or a blackout. Plural shelves are arranged in a drawer(14). Plural antennas(20) are attached to an upper surface of the drawer and enclose a rim of the drawer. A frequency adjuster(30) determines a frequency of an output signal. An RFID(Radio Frequency IDentification) reader(40) is connected to the antenna through the frequency adjuster. A PDA(50) is connected to the RFID reader and notifies a manager of a theft through a mobile communication network or a wired telephone network. An RFID tag is inserted into a book or an old document. An alarm device(70) is installed on an outer wall of the drawer and connected to the PDA(Personal Digital Assistant). A release switch is connected to the PDA and turns off the alarm device. A power supply device(60) supplies power and notifies a blackout to the PDA.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 문화재 도난방지용 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 서적이나 고문서와 같은 유형문화재의 도난방지를 위하여 알에프아이디 시스템을 적용한 것이다. 본 발명은 복수 개의 선반을 구비한 수납장과; 상기 각 선반의 상면에 부착되어 선반의 테두리를 감싸는 복수 개의 안테나와; 상기 안테나에 연결되어 출력전파의 주파수를 결정하며, 상기 각 선반에 부착되는 주파수 조절기와; 상기 주파수 조절기를 통해 안테나와 연결되는 RFID 리더기와; 상기 RFID 리더기를 제어할 수 있도록 RFID 리더기와 연결되며, 이동통신 전화망 또는 유선전화망에 연결되어 관리자에게 도난사실을 통지할 수 있는 PDA와; 상기 각 선반에 거치되는 서적 또는 고문서에 끼워서 사용되는 시트상의 RFID 태그와; 상기 PDA와 연결되어 도난시 경보를 발생시키도록  상기 수납장 외벽에 설치된 경보발생장치와;경보해제스위치와; 상기 RFID 리더기와 PDA와 경광등에 전원을 공급하기 위한 무정전 전원공급장치로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     RFID, PDA, 문화재, 서적, 전화, 도난방지

title_en: Assistant motorized walker
title_ko: 전동식 보조 보행기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric auxiliary walker, which comprises: an upper frame in which a dashboard, a first brake, a second brake, a driving button, and an LED light are installed; a support frame connected to the upper frame to support the walking of a user; a lower frame connected to the support frame and having one or more wheels installed therein; and a footrest unit having a foldable hinge unit. According to the present invention, a footrest unit is provided to enable a user to step thereon to move or carry heavy objects, and both automatic driving and manual driving can be performed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 노인이나 환자에게 적용될 수 있는 보행기로 사용자의 상황에 따라 수동 보행이나 자동 주행으로 변경 가능한 전동식 보조 보행기에 관한 것으로 상부 프레임(20)으로 사용자의 상체를 지지하며, 주행 시 사용되는 계기판(21)과 전자식 브레이크를 제공하는 제 1 브레이크(22)와 수동으로 정지하기 위한 한 개소 이상의 제 2 브레이크(23)가 설치되며 주행을 실시하여 속도를 조절하는 주행버튼(24) 및 전방 주시 및 보행을 알리기 위한 LED 라이트(25)가 설치된다. 이때, 상부 프레임(20)과 연결되어 사용자의 보행을 위해 지지하기 위한 축이 되는 지지 프레임(30)을 포함하고, 지지 프레임(30)과 연결되어, 지면 위를 이동하도록 한 개소 이상의 휠이 설치되는 하부 프레임(40)을 포함한다. 또한, 하부 프레임(40)에 결합하도록 접이식 힌지부(51)를 두어 절첩 가능하고 사용자의 하체를 거치하도록 발판부(50)를 포함하고 발판부(50)를 미사용 시 수동보행하고 사용 시에 자동주행을 제공한다. 따라서, 발판부(50)를 두어 사용자가 올라서서 이동하거나 무거운 물건을 싣고 이동이 가능하며 자동주행과 수동주행이 모두 가능하고 비상시 알림버튼을 구비하여 사용자에게 비상사태가 발생시 GPS를 통해 가족, 가까운 지인의 스마트 폰이나 경찰서, 소방서와 같은 관공서에서 자동 알림을 통해 사용자의 위치를 전송할 수 있도록 하는 것을 목적으로 한다.  
본 특허 출원은 2016년 상반기 실시(2016.03.01.~2016.08.31.[6개월]) 영산대학교 교원역량강화 연구년제에 대한 결과물로 영산대학교 산학협력단과 (주)국제산업전자에 의해 공동 출원함.
assignees: YOUNGSAN UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION;INT INDUSTARY ELECTRONICS

title_en: Internet-of-things control system of mobile lighting vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an internet-of-things control system of a mobile lighting vehicle. The mobile lighting vehicle comprises a lighting vehicle base, rotatable stand columns, hydraulic lifting connecting rods, lighting modules and a mobile lighting vehicle control module. The lighting vehicle base is provided with retractable hydraulic supporting legs, the lower portion of the lighting vehicle base is provided with proceeding tires, and proceeding guiding wheels are arranged at the front end of the lighting vehicle base. A hydraulic control system, an engine, an oil tank and a generator are arranged on the lighting vehicle base. The hydraulic lifting connecting rods are connected with the rotatable stand columns, and the lighting modules and the mobile lighting vehicle control module are connected with the hydraulic lifting connecting rods. The internet-of-things control system of the mobile lighting vehicle comprises a monitoring center, the mobile lighting vehicle control module is connected with the monitoring center through a network, and the mobile lighting vehicle control module is connected with multiple sensors and electric energy gauges of the mobile lighting vehicle. The internet-of-things control system of the mobile lighting vehicle can monitor the working state and environmental condition of the mobile lighting vehicle in a remote mode, when faults occur on the lighting vehicle, or environmental degradation occurs, a warning is sounded in time, or the working state of the lighting vehicle is automatically changed, severe safety accidents are prevented from occurring, and management efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU LONGEN POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Aging management method and aging management terminal for storage materials
abstract_en: An aging management method and an aging management terminal for storage materials are used for carrying out aging management on disposable medical and food materials; the method comprises the following steps of managing the effective period of the original packaging material: the user registers and logs in to clarify a manager and the responsibility thereof, associates or inputs material valid information including material name, specification, manufacturer, production date, validity period and the like, automatically generates a two-dimensional code, collects and counts the valid period and the expiration period of each material in real time, and automatically discriminates and sends out a warning; the method for managing the valid period of the opened materials comprises the following implementation steps: the user registers and logs in to clarify a manager and the responsibility thereof, the code two-dimensional code is scanned, whether the system collects the materials which gradually fail in an effective period or not is identified, and the materials are automatically distinguished and sent out a warning; the invention aims at effectively using and managing materials and supplies which need to be effectively used for packaging and unsealing, and avoids the loss of personnel, assets and even public safety caused by using invalid materials.
assignees: CHILDRENS HOSPITAL OF CHONGQING MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Equipment and method for safe tunneling and disaster early warning of river-crossing high-water-head tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment and a method for safe tunneling and disaster early warning of a river-crossing high-water-head tunnel. The hydraulic stem stretches out and draws back, it rotates along the fixed plate to drive the regulation seat, change and adjust the seat angle of pitch, thereby make the drilling rod drive the drill bit along predetermined angle and creep into, and protection machanism protects the circumstances such as unexpected outage, avoid equipment damage and personnel to damage, when drilling takes place to gush water when drilling, the drilling rod drives the drill bit and withdraws from, change shutoff head, carry out the slip casting that pressurizes through the shutoff head to drilling fast, make mud infiltration drilling inner wall gap, thereby consolidate the shutoff, prevention and elimination gush water calamity.
assignees: NUCLEAR IND JINGXIANG CONSTR GROUP CO LTD

title_en: SSL certificate automatic discovery and monitoring method and computer based on Zabbix
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Zabbix-based SSL certificate automatic discovery and monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: generating a format object according to the web monitoring object; the monitoring object can be automatically found by the Zabbix monitoring system; modifying a configuration file of the Zabbix-agent and customizing a monitoring item of the SSL certificate; based on the configuration file, performing low-level discovery configuration on the monitoring item on the Zabbix-server; automatically acquiring time information of the SSL certificate through the Zabbix-agent after the configuration file is validated and returning the time information to the Zabbix-server; monitoring time information of the SSL certificate through low-level discovery configuration, and judging whether the time information reaches a condition for triggering an alarm or not; if yes, an alarm is sent out. The SSL certificate is monitored in real time by an automatic means, and early warning is carried out on the expiration time of the certificate, so that operation and maintenance personnel can replace or renew the certificate in time after receiving alarm information, the hidden danger of expiration of the SSL certificate is effectively solved, and the occurrence of abnormal conditions of an application system caused by certificate invalidation is reduced.
assignees: CGN INTELLIGENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Important hidden danger prediction method and system based on transmission line visualization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission line fault monitoring, in particular to a key hidden danger prediction method and a key hidden danger prediction system based on power transmission line visualization, wherein an operation and maintenance layer hidden danger early warning information feedback module in the system combines weather forecast information received in historical data, dynamically analyzing the risk thermodynamic evolution process of the power transmission line in the period corresponding to the weather forecast, dynamically marking the hidden danger prediction area of the power transmission line, constructing hidden danger early warning information, and transmitting the hidden danger early warning information to a display end for visual presentation. According to the method, the continuous updating of the power transmission line model is realized in a mode of static data and dynamic data, the static data in the updated model is kept unchanged all the time, the data acquisition quantity is effectively reduced, the response speed of the updating of the power transmission line model is improved, meanwhile, fusion analysis is carried out according to multi-source data, the simulation of the power transmission line risk thermal evolution process is realized, the hidden danger prediction area of the power transmission line is dynamically locked, and the accurate prediction of the key hidden danger of the power transmission line is realized.
assignees: ANHUI BAISHENG ELECTRONIC SYSTEM INTEGRATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for processing signal associated with warning notification in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 경고 통지에 관련된 신호를 처리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, user equipment (UE) can initiate a certain timer in order not to allow non-emergency calls when a warning notification is from a certain area. To be specific, UE receives a paging message including a warning indication from a network, and a delay timer can be initiated according to the paging message when if the UE is included in a delay-tolerant category. The UE can a random access procedure after the delay timer is expired. That is, UE, which received a paging message for a path such as ETWS and CMAS, can initiate a delay timer to wait for a certain time to perform a call initiation procedure when the terminal is in a certain category presented by this application. [Reference numerals] (AA) Not expired;(BB) Expired;(S310) Receiving paging message including warning notification;(S320) Starting delay timer when UE is included in delay-tolerant category;(S330) Obtaining scheduling information by interpreting SIB 1;(S340) Receiving other SIBs such as SIBs 10-12;(S350) Determining whether delay time is expired;(S360) Processing random access when session start request is triggered
abstract_ko: 제안된 방법에 따르면, 사용자 단말(UE)는 경고 통보(warning notification)가 특정 지역에 주어진 경우, 비-비상통화(non-emergency calls)를 허락하지 않도록 특정한 타이머를 개시할 수 있다. 구체적으로, UE는 네트워크로부터 경고지시가 포함된 페이징 메시지를 수신하고, 만약 상기 UE가 지연내성(delay-tolerant) 카테고리에 속하는 경우, 상기 페이징 메시지 수신에 따라 지연 타이머(delay timer)를 개시할 수 있다. 상기 UE는 랜덤 액세스 절차를 상기 지연 타이머가 만료된 다음 수행할 수 있다. 즉 ETWS 및 CMAS와 같은 경로를 위한 페이징 메시지를 수신한 UE는, 해당 단말이 본 문서에서 제시하는 특정한 카테고리에 속하는 경우, 통화 개시 절차를 수행하기 위해 특정 시간을 대기하도록 지연 타이머를 개시할 수 있다.

title_en: House based on GIS Life cycle safety management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of house based on GIS Life cycle safety management system, check that system, dilapidated house inspection management system, calamity emergency are speedily carried out rescue work system, building safety feedback system and public query system including expire early warning system, old building safety of house service life.The present invention carries out comprehensive internet information management to data such as safe, the repairerment in house, flood control, disasters, grasp dilapedated building to administer and situation of lossing, obtain dilapedated building register information and log-off message, access the house safety information in Life cycle for public user.

title_en: A kind of smart travel traffic system and management method
abstract_en: A kind of smart travel traffic system and management method, including information acquisition system, information processing system, communication system and warning system, information acquisition system includes the GPS location acquisition module of collection car positional information, visitor uploads the destination to be reached and the electronic monitoring acquisition module of the trip data uploading module for passing by website, the road conditions on collection road and other emergency situations；Information processing system includes receiving the trip data receiving module of the traffic path of visitor, calculates the information on services update module that Real-time Feedback is carried out apart from the vehicle number of the website and the data processing module for number of going on a journey and the result of calculation for drawing data processing module in real time；Communication system realizes the communication between information acquisition system, information processing system and warning system；The present invention solves visitor's number and configures unmatched situation with visit vehicle, and only visitor does not provide facility, while also safeguards scenic spot order, reduces the empty of vehicle and runs phenomenon, resource is obtained an equitable breakdown.

title_en: Fire disaster intelligent evacuation guiding system based on multi-information source fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire intelligent evacuation guiding system based on multi-information source fusion, which comprises: the monitoring and positioning unit is used for collecting fire conditions, safety exit data and personnel position information; the evacuation guiding unit gives out fire early warning according to the data output by the monitoring and positioning unit, gives warning signals to indoor and outdoor personnel, plans evacuation escape tracks according to the occurrence condition of fire, updates the optimal escape route in real time, and feeds back the updated optimal escape route data to the server end for guiding trapped personnel to evacuate rapidly and safely; the self-rescue help seeking unit is used for receiving data of the server side, transmitting the positions, environments and physical conditions of personnel to fire rescue personnel when all escape routes are damaged, and guiding trapped personnel to save the self or escape to a relatively safe position by the evacuation guiding unit or the server side to wait for rescue.

title_en: Multi-mode public opinion risk early warning system and method based on dynamic knowledge graph and federal reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-mode public opinion risk early warning system and method based on dynamic knowledge graph and federal reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of public opinion analysis. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a mode fusion module, a knowledge graph construction module, a comparison learning module, a federal reinforcement learning modeling module and a response output module. The system realizes multi-mode semantic alignment of texts, images, videos and the like based on multi-source heterogeneous data, digs entity relations and propagation paths through dynamically updated knowledge maps, and fuses federal reinforcement learning to realize collaborative modeling under privacy protection among terminals, so that real-time perception of public opinion risks, grade early warning and multi-level response strategy recommendation are realized. Based on the system, the method has the advantages of high fusion precision, high response speed and strong visual propagation path, and is widely applicable to the fields of enterprise crisis management, government affair public opinion monitoring and public safety.

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and early warning system for easily-made drugs based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based dynamic monitoring and early warning system for easily-made drugs, relates to the technical field of public safety supervision, and solves the technical problems that a corresponding knowledge graph is difficult to construct and is updated dynamically, and a multidimensional abnormal evaluation value is lack to be constructed for early warning analysis; the method comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, a data preprocessing and knowledge graph construction module and an abnormality evaluation and early warning module, wherein the knowledge graph is constructed by integrating ERP, logistics TMS, pharmacy HIS and pharmacy supervision office data of a production enterprise by utilizing a BERT model, a regular expression and a deep learning technology, the relation and the confidence coefficient existing between entity recognition probability and entity pairs are calculated, corresponding entity characteristics, relation characteristics and attribute characteristics are extracted from the constructed knowledge graph, corresponding abnormality evaluation values are constructed, and the comprehensive abnormality evaluation values are obtained after weighting addition, so that whether early warning is triggered or not is judged.

title_en: Ship approach warning system and warning method for bridge protect
title_ko: 교량 보호를 위한 선박 접근 경보 시스템 및 경보 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A ship approach warning system for bridge protection and a warning method thereof are provided to prevent a ship from colliding with a bridge by sensing a ship which approaches the bridge and enters the sensing area and warning it. CONSTITUTION: An approach detection unit is constituted with a laser radiation unit (100), a control unit, a laser light receiving unit, a detection unit (300) and a micro processor unit (MPU) (600). The laser radiation unit and the laser light receiving unit are installed at the bridge center of the right lower part of the superstructure of a bridge. The detection unit provides an output of the laser light receiving unit and an output of a photo detector sensed in the laser radiation unit. A condenser lens (202) is installed in the front of an avalanche photo diode (APD) of the laser light receiving unit. A warning driver (700) is controlled by being connected to an output port of the MPU.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 바다의 연도교(連島橋)나 연륙교(連陸橋) 또는 강에 설치된 장대 교량의 보호를 위하여 접근 중인 선박을 감지하여 경보를 발할 수 있도록 하는 교량 보호를 위한 선박 접근 경보 시스템 및 그 경보 방법을 개시한다. 
본 발명은 교량에 접근하는 선박을 감지함에 있어서 감지 영역에 음영이 발생됨을 최소화함과 아울러, 최대 감지 거리를 비행하여 복귀하는 신호에서 각종 노이즈를 포함한 입사 신호에서 유효 신호를 산출하기 위한 연산처리과정에서 소요되는 시간을 단축시킬 수 있도록 하여 넓은 영역에 걸쳐서 실시간으로 교량 상부 구조 보호를 위한 선박 접근 경보가 가능하게 된다. 
또한, 본 발명은 조류가 선박의 상방에서 비행하여 선박의 높이로 오인되지 않도록 조류와 선박에 의한 입사 신호 파형을 식별할 수 있도록 함으로써 작동의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있게 되는 효과가 있다. 
아울러, 본 발명은 선박이 교량의 교각에 똑바로 접근하는 경우에만 경보를 발하도록 하여 선박과 교량의 교각이 충돌됨을 방지할 수 있도록 하여 교량과 선박의 충돌을 방지함으로써 막대한 사회적 손실 및 인명, 재산상의 손실을 방지할 수 있게 되는 유용한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Cleaning apparatus and polishing apparatus
title_ko: 세정 장치, 연마 장치
abstract_en: A cleaning apparatus includes: a cleaning tank that defines a cleaning space for cleaning a wafer; a wafer rotation mechanism that is arranged inside the cleaning tank and holds and rotates the wafer; a cleaning member that contacts and cleans a surface of the wafer, is rotatable around a central axis extending in a lateral direction, and has a length in an axial direction longer than a radius of the wafer; a swing mechanism that swings the cleaning member around a swing axis located inside the cleaning tank to move the cleaning member from a retracted position outside of the wafer to a cleaning position directly above the wafer; a second cleaning means that cleans the surface of the wafer; and a second swing mechanism that swings the second cleaning means around a second swing axis located inside the cleaning tank to pass directly above a center of the wafer. The present invention can provide a cleaning apparatus and a polishing apparatus capable of moving a cleaning member from a retracted position to a cleaning position, which reduces the footprint of a cleaning tank without forming an opening for running on the side wall of the cleaning tank.
abstract_ko: 세정 장치는, 웨이퍼의 세정을 행하는 세정 공간을 획정하는 세정조와, 세정조의 내측에 배치되어, 웨이퍼를 보유 지지하여 회전시키는 웨이퍼 회전 기구와, 웨이퍼의 표면에 접촉하여 세정하는 세정 부재이며, 횡방향으로 연장되는 중심 축선 주위로 회전 가능하고, 축선 방향의 길이가 웨이퍼의 반경보다도 긴 세정 부재와, 세정 부재를, 세정조의 내측에 위치하는 요동 축선 주위로 요동시켜, 웨이퍼의 외측의 대피 위치로부터 웨이퍼의 바로 위의 세정 위치까지 이동시키는 요동 기구와, 웨이퍼의 표면을 세정하는 제2 세정 수단과, 제2 세정 수단을, 세정조의 내측에 위치하는 제2 요동 축선 주위로 요동시켜 웨이퍼의 중심의 바로 위를 통과시키는 제2 요동 기구를 구비한다.

title_en: Method and system for identifying, sensing and early warning mine water inrush source
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine water disaster intelligent prevention and control safety, in particular to a method and a system for recognizing, sensing and early warning a water source with water inrush in a mine. Mine information is obtained in real time; and the acquired mine information is transmitted, stored and analyzed in real time, so that the identification and prediction of the mine water inrush water source and the early warning of the mine water inrush water damage are realized, and early warning information is issued. The system integrates key hydrogeology and water chemistry characteristic information acquisition of a mine, innovatively combines a Python deep learning technology with an Internet of things cloud platform, realizes a real-time monitoring, detecting, forecasting and early warning technology for quickly judging and identifying water inrush hazards of the mine, gives consideration to safe, quick and real-time storage of data, feeds back mine information and analysis results in real time, and realizes real-time monitoring and dynamic continuous perception early warning. The problem of can't carry out all-weather monitoring and early warning to mine water burst water source information among the prior art, the information update that leads to is untimely, can't satisfy the theoretical requirement of current exploitation is solved.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning device for underground water level
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and early warning device for underground water level, which is arranged in a monitoring well along the periphery of a foundation pit, an underground pipeline and a historical sedimentation zone, wherein the monitoring and early warning device comprises a bracket component, a water level monitoring component and an early warning component, the bracket component is used for suspending the water level monitoring component at the design depth of the monitoring well, the bracket component comprises an expansion ring, a fixed bracket, a sleeve and a retractor, and the expansion ring and the inner wall of the monitoring well are anchored through hydraulic expansion; the water level monitoring assembly is used for monitoring the dynamic change of the underground water level and providing data support for the early warning assembly, the water level monitoring assembly comprises a vertical rod, a lower disc body, an upper disc body, a balancing weight, a sensor module and a damping buffer piece, and the early warning assembly comprises an early warning host and an antenna. According to the invention, through the cooperative arrangement of the water level monitoring component and the early warning component, an omnibearing dynamic monitoring and early warning device integrating monitoring, intelligent early warning and adaptation to various complex scenes is constructed.

title_en: A lighting fixture with a built-in fire alarm
title_ko: 화재감지기가 내장된 등기구
abstract_en: A lighting device with a built-in fire detector is provided to release a fire alarm by pushing an on/off switch after putting out a fire. A lighting device includes a mounting plate(1), a side plate(2), and a cover(3). The mounting plate is fixed to a ceiling. The side plate is combined in the mounting plate by a coupling piece. The hole for the inflow of the smoke is formed between the mounting plate and the side plate. The cover is combined in the lower part of the side plate. A fire detector, a plurality of LED(Light Emitting Diode)s and a control circuit unit are mounted on the mounting plate. The fire detector outputs the fire detection signal by detecting the smoke. The control circuit outputs the alarm through a speaker and turns on the LED according to the fire detection signal.
