title_en: Morphinan derivatives, method for the preparation thereof and pharmaceutical composition containing same
title_ko: 모르피난 유도체, 이의 제조방법 및 이를 유효성분으로 함유하는 약학 조성물
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing morphinan derivatives is provided to use the morphinan derivatives as a nerve-protecting medicine for prevention or treatment of degenerative brain diseases and to offer a morphinan derivative having excellent neuroprotective activity. A method for manufacturing a chemical formula 1 comprises the following steps of: obtaining a compound of a chemical formula 3 by reacting CbzCl or (BOC)2O in a sodium hydroxide aqueous solution; gaining the compound of a chemical formula4 by reacting trifluoro methanesulfonyl chloride or trifluoro methane sulfonic acid anhydride; and manufacturing a compound of a 1a in an organic solvent under presence of catalysts.

title_en: Mobile with function of nfc communication and safety aboarding service system
title_ko: 엔에프시 통신 기능을 가진 모바일 및 안전승차 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a mobile device with an NFC communication function and a safe taxi service system enabling a user to safely use a taxi anytime anywhere. A mobile device transmits user identification information and current location information to a taxi system when get-on and get-off tagging is made. The mobile device displays taxi information received from the taxi system when get-on tagging is made and transmits a get-on notice message to a mobile device of a specific person. The taxi system sets valid multi-route to a destination by using the destination input after get-on tagging, and informs the mobile device of the specific person and/or a taxi server of an emergency situation when the taxi is out of the valid multi-route over a set time. The mobile device displays fare information received from the taxi system when a get-off tagging is made. The taxi system exchanges information with the mobile device through NFC communication, generates get-on notice information including the user identification information, a get-on time and the current location information, transmits the same to the taxi server when a get-on tagging is made, and transmits, to the taxi server, get-off information including the user identification information, the current location information, a get-off time and taxi fare information when a get-off tagging is made.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일에서는 NFC 통신을 이용한 승차 태깅 및 하차 태깅시에 탑승자 식별정보와 현재위치정보를  택시 시스템에 전송하며,  승차 태깅시에  택시 시스템으로부터 수신된 차량정보를 표시하고 승차 알림 메시지를 특정인 모바일로 전송하며,  승차 태깅 후에 입력된 목적지를 이용하여  목적지까지의 유효 다중 경로를 설정하고  택시가 설정시간 이상  유효 다중 경로를 벗어난 경우에 비상상황을  특정인 모바일 및 택시 서버 중 적어도 하나에 알리며,  하차 태깅시에  택시 시스템으로부터 수신된 요금정보를 표시하고, 택시 시스템에서는  모바일과 NFC 통신으로 정보를 교환하며,  승차 태깅시에  탑승자 식별정보, 탑승시간 및  현재위치정보를 포함하는 탑승 알림 정보를 생성하여 택시 서버로 전송하고,  하차 태깅시에  탑승자 식별정보,  현재위치정보, 하차시간 및 택시요금을 포함하는 하차 알림 정보를 택시 서버로 전송한다.

title_en: Monitoring data processing method and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide
abstract_en: This application discloses the monitoring data processing methods and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide, are related to disaster alarm field, by laying monitoring point in premonitoring region, obtain the multi -components monitoring data of monitoring point.Multi -components monitoring data include the variation of physics-mechanics character at monitoring point, the Characters of Geographical Environment of monitoring point and weather condition.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the landslide risk index of the monitoring point.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of landslide and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the dangerous of landslide in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: Method for automatically acquiring and processing disaster prevention early warning information by high-speed railway CTC system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for automatically acquiring and processing disaster prevention early warning information by  high-speed railway CTC systems, which is used for getting through data barriers between the CTC systems and disaster monitoring system equipment and transmitting the warning information of the disaster monitoring system to the CTC systems by utilizing the existing system functions and expansion interfaces, and comprises the steps of 1) obtaining disaster prevention warning information from the disaster monitoring systems by the CTC systems, 2) displaying the disaster prevention warning, utilizing a visualization means to ensure that the disaster prevention data are visually and accurately displayed to a dispatching terminal and inquiring historical warning data, and simultaneously having the function of automatically generating a speed limit command on a disaster prevention monitoring interface, 3) automatically matching a high-speed train in an affected area according to the disaster prevention warning detailed information, 4) automatically generating a speed limit command according to the disaster prevention warning detailed information, and automatically generating a speed limit cancellation command after receiving the warning cancellation information.

title_en: Forest fire prevention early warning management method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of computers, and provides a forest fire prevention early warning management method and system based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ground satellite remote sensing data at fixed time; extracting thermal infrared band information in ground satellite remote sensing data; identifying and analyzing thermal infrared band information; generating first early warning information; timely collecting real-time images of a monitoring area; identifying and analyzing the real-time image of the monitoring area; generating second early warning information; uploading the first early warning information and the second early warning information, and generating and sending alarm information; updating alarm information at regular time; the method and the system can acquire thermal infrared band information and real-time images of the monitoring area, acquire data in a diversified manner, identify and analyze the possibility of forest fire occurrence, timely generate and update fire early warning, further improve the reliability of forest fire early warning, and effectively reduce the harm and influence of forest fire.
assignees: NANJING BAINUO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual battlefield scene simulation system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual battlefield scene simulation system and a method thereof, in particular to the technical field of scene simulation, which are characterized in that various information in the scene tree updating process, including data loading information, event triggering information and hardware platform performance information, are acquired, abnormal conditions in the updating process are perceived in time, an updating hidden danger analysis model is established according to the acquired various information, and the updating hidden danger of the scene tree is evaluated by comprehensively analyzing factors such as data loading speed, event triggering response and hardware performance, so that whether the updating hidden danger exists in the scene tree is judged more accurately, abnormal virtual battlefield scene images caused by the abnormal conditions in the updating process are avoided, and the real-time monitoring and judgment of the scene tree updating process is realized. And classifying and early warning the update states of the scene tree according to different update state signals, and timely adjusting the update strategy to ensure the stability and fluency of the virtual battlefield scene.
assignees: BEIJING JINGPINTEZHUANG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: User psychological state assessment method and system for meta universe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user psychological state assessment method and system for meta-universe, in particular to the technical field of user psychological state assessment, which comprises the steps of quantifying whether abnormal fluctuation exists in a user psychological state by acquiring virtual scene update data in meta-universe, judging whether the user is an unstable user, acquiring unstable information of data acquisition, fluctuation information of data transmission and calculation resource allocation uneven information of a user psychological state assessment model to construct an assessment result timeliness monitoring model, the method comprises the steps of identifying and responding to potential problems, guaranteeing timeliness of a continuous monitoring evaluation result, providing basic data for subsequent risk early warning, further obtaining timeliness monitoring data information, establishing a timeliness monitoring data set, carrying out risk early warning on the influence depth of timeliness hidden danger through analysis and moving average calculation of the timeliness monitoring data set, and guaranteeing intervention before or at the early stage of the occurrence of the problems, so that overall performance and user experience are improved.

title_en: The Case for Smart-Phone that have the function for the emergency rescue request and the perverting device from a menace
title_ko: 긴급구조요청 및 치한퇴치기능을 가진 스마트폰 케이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smartphone case having functions of emergency rescue request and pervert eradication. The smartphone case can help from the surroundings or call a police after hearing the warning siren and the voice of emergency rescue request, and can intuitively know the position of a victim exposed to the risk. An alarming smartphone case main body (1) comprises an emergency rescue request operation circuit unit (100), an emergency rescue request button (101), a warning speaker (102), a blue light lamp (103a), a red light lamp (103b), an electric shocking rod (104), an auxiliary button (105), a charging terminal (106), a warning release button (107), a smartphone installation groove (200), and a smartphone case cover (300).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 후미진 골목이나 으슥한 장소에서 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등이 접근할 경우 위협을 느낌과 동시에 긴급구조요청버튼을 3초간 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광램프 및 긴급구조요청음성 및 전기충격봉이 작동되는 긴급구조요청 및 치한퇴치 기능을 가진 스마트폰 케이스에 관한 것으로 서, 상술하면 긴급구조요청버튼을 3~5초간 누르게 되면 경보싸이렌이 발령되고 긴급구조요청음성[예 ; 살려주세요]과 경보싸이렌이 반복적으로 일정시간동안 자동으로 지속 송출되며, 동시에 적색과 청색으로 구성된 경광램프가 반복적으로 일정시간동안 점멸이 자동으로 지속된다. 동시에 안테나 방식으로 내장된 전기충격봉이 자동으로 길게 펼쳐지며 치한의 공격으로부터 피해갈 수 있는 긴급구조요청 및 치한퇴치기능을 가진 스마트폰 케이스에 관한 것이다. 
이와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은, 긴급구조요청버튼을 누르게 되면 경보싸이렌이 발령되고 긴급구조요청음성[예 ; 살려주세요]과 경보싸이렌이 반복적으로 일정시간동안 자동으로 지속 송출되며, 동시에 적색과 청색으로 구성된 경광램프가 반복적으로 일정시간동안 점멸이 자동으로 지속 반복되며, 동시에 안테나 방식으로 내장된 전기충격봉이 자동으로 길게 펼쳐지게 하는데 있어서,  
상기의 경보스마트폰케이스본체(1)는 긴급구조요청작동회로부(100)와 긴급구조요청버튼(101) 및 경보스피커(102) 및 청색경광램프(103a) 및 적색경광램프(103b) 및 전기충격봉(104) 및 보조버튼(105) 및 충전터미널(106) 및 경보해제버튼(107) 및 스마트폰장착홈(200) 및 스마트폰케이스커버(300)를 가지는 것을 특징으로 하는 단계,  
; 상기의 긴급구조요청작동회로부(100)에 경보사이렌발령회로(100a) 및 경광램프작동회로(100b) 및 구조요청음발생회로(100c) 및 전기충격봉작동회로(100d) 및 밧데리(100e) 및 충전기회로(100f)를 구성한 것이 특징인 단계와, 
; 상기의 스마트폰케이스커버(300)상에 경보발생홀(102a)을 형성한 것이 특징인 단계와,  
; 상기의 전기충격봉(104)의 상단 말단부에 점멸전기충격침(104a)을 구성한 것에 특징이 있다. 
본 발명의 경우, 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등과 대면할 경우 긴급구조요청버튼을 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광램프 및 긴급구조요청음성 및 전기충격봉이 작동되므로 서 누군가 위험에 처한 상황이라는 것을 알려 주므로서 주변에서 도움을 얻을 수 있고, 또한 주위의 도움이 지연되거나 불가항력의 상황에서 전기충격봉으로 치한을 퇴치하거나 겁먹은 치한의 도주를 유도할 수도 있게 하여 위기로부터 안전하게 탈출할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: vehicle and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 차량 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, when a firmware-over-the-air (FOTA) update notification message is received in a standby mode for performing a remote service mode, only an update file for updating is downloaded while the remote service mode is normally performed, thereby saving power in the standby mode. In addition, the present invention can update corresponding software using the downloaded file when the mode is switched from the standby mode to a normal mode. Accordingly, the present invention can minimize cases in which the update is not performed as the update notification message is not received. In addition, the present invention checks whether software to be updated is present by automatically accessing a server at a preset time (e.g., diagnostic time, periodic inspection time, etc.) in the normal mode, and updates the checked software, thereby performing the update without missing even for the software which has not received the update notification message from the server due to an off mode.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 서비스 모드를 수행하는 대기 모드 시에 FOTA(Firmware Over The Air) 업데이트 알림 메시지를 수신 받을 경우, 원격 서비스 모드를 정상적으로 수행하면서 업데이트를 위한 업데이트 파일만을 다운로드함으로써 대기 모드 시 전력을 절감할 수 있다. 
또한 본 발명은 대기모드에서 일반 모드로 전환되면 다운로드된 파일을 이용하여 해당 소프트웨어를 업데이트할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 업데이트 알림 메시지의 미수신으로 인해 업데이트가 미수행되는 것을 최소화할 수 있다. 
또한 본 발명은 일반 모드 시 미리 설정된 시점(예, 진단 시점, 정기 점검 시점 등)에 자동으로 서버에 접속하여 업데이트할 소프트웨어가 존재하는지 확인하고 확인된 소프트웨어를 업데이트함으로써 오프 모드로 인해 서버로부터 업데이트 알림 메시지를 수신받지 못한 소프트웨어에 대해서도 빠뜨림 없이 업데이트를 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: The system which provides a disaster notification contents
title_ko: 재난 알림 콘텐츠 제공시스템
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to support a user to easily resolve the problem of quality deterioration of various electronic devices due to excessive battery consumption of a DNC service app. A DNC providing system comprises: a DNC distribution agency server which communicates with a disaster notification contents (DNC) production agency server via a wired/wireless communication network, collects the DNC, and distributes the collected DNC to a user information device; a firebase cloud messaging (FCM) server which processes inter-platform messages and data transmission between the DNC distribution agency server and the user information device; and a location-based DNC service application which is installed in the user information device, generates a DNC subscription request message, transmits the DNC subscription request message to the FCM server, receives the DNC from the FCM server, and outputs the DNC through the user information device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 알림 콘텐츠(DNC: Disaster Notification Contents) 제공시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 DNC 배포 기관 서버, 사용자 정보기기 등의 통신 체제 하에, <DNC 배포 기관 서버와 통신하여, 이에 의해 배포되는 DNC를 수집할 수 있음과 아울러, DNC 배포 기관 서버 및 사용자 정보기기 사이의 플랫폼 간 메시지 및 데이터 전송(즉, 플랫폼 간 메시지 및 데이터 푸쉬(Push))을 처리할 수 있는 FCM 서버(Firebase Cloud Messaging 서버)>, <사용자 정보기기에 설치되면서, 상기 사용자 정보기기의 위치정보가 포함된 DNC 구독요청 메시지를 생성한 후, 생성된 DNC 구독요청 메시지를 상기 FCM 서버로 전송함과 아울러, 상기 FCM 서버 측으로부터 상기 DNC 구독요청 메시지에 상응하는 DNC가 전송되면, 해당 DNC를 접수한 후, 접수된 DNC를 상기 사용자 정보기기를 통해 출력시킬 수 있는 위치기반 DNC 서비스 앱> 등을 추가 설치하고, 이를 통해, DNC의 제공 패턴이 '사용자 정보기기 측 DNC 서비스 앱과 DNC 배포 기관 서버 측의 직접적인 교신에 의한 위치정보 보고/수집 기반 패턴'(즉, DNC 서비스 앱이 DNC 배포 기관 서버 측에 주기적으로 사용자 정보기기의 위치정보를 전송/보고하면, DNC 배포 기관 서버 측에서 그에 상응하여, 사용자 정보기기가 위치한 지역의 DNC를 제공하는 패턴)이 아니라, 'FCM 서버를 우회 기반으로 하는 푸쉬 데이터(Push data) 형식의 DNC 토픽 구독 패턴'(즉, DNC 서비스 앱 측에서, DNC 배포 기관 서버에 대한 별도의 주기적인 위치정보 전송/보고 절차 없이, 단순히 FCM 서버 측에 DNC 토픽의 구독을 요청하기만 하면, FCM 서버 측에서 DNC 배포 기관 서버 측과 통신하여, DNC를 우회 접수한 후, 접수된 DNC 중 사용자 정보기기가 처한 위치에 상응하는 특정 지역의 DNC를 DNC 서비스 앱 측으로 푸쉬해주는 패턴)으로 대폭 변경될 수 있도록 유도함으로써, 결국, 사용자 측에서, DNC 서비스 앱의 배터리 과잉 소모에 기인한 각종 전자기기 품질저하 문제점을 손쉽게 탈피할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Processing method for grading early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method of grading early warning, which comprises the following specific steps: installing a monitoring device; performing a normal distribution test on all the measured data-time information, and dividing all the data into a plurality of normal distribution sets; temporarily fixing the result of the normal distribution test, selecting a nearest normal distribution data set for operation processing, and performing grading early warning according to the operation result; and by plotting a data-time plot; drawing a numerical value-date curve graph and a landslide speed-date curve; and fitting the numerical value-date curve graph into a function curve, and performing regression analysis by using the curve to predict subsequent landslide displacement and time points. The method adopts a statistical method and a mode of introducing data set segmentation, and carries out early warning sending, early warning cancellation judgment and regression analysis respectively through two parameters with different statistical meanings, thereby realizing the prediction of the slope landslide trend.
assignees: HUNAN LIANZHI MONITORING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning equipment for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disaster early warning field provides an early warning equipment for geological disasters, including the brace table, the roof of brace table is provided with protection machanism, protection machanism is used for protecting early warning equipment, the upper portion fixedly connected with of brace table is retracted the mechanism, retracted the mechanism and is used for protecting power supply unit, the outer wall bottom fixedly connected with fixed establishment of brace table, fixed establishment is used for fixed early warning equipment, protection machanism includes the supporting shoe, supporting shoe fixed connection is at the roof of brace table, two the roof fixedly connected with same control box of supporting shoe. Through the mutually supporting of protection machanism inner structure, start the double-end motor when early warning equipment sends the alarm, make two guard plates inwards rotate, accomplish the block, realized the protection to the inside controlgear of early warning equipment, control equipment can not suffer the damage when the calamity takes place to this sends further early warning to the calamity condition.

title_en: Device and system for identifying and early warning risks in expressway operation area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a system for identifying and early warning risks in an expressway operation area. The system comprises a portable pressure-sensitive deceleration strip, an integrated intelligent traffic cone and an engineering pre-warning vehicle, wherein the two portable pressure-sensitive deceleration strips are respectively arranged at a first-stage early warning boundary and a second-stage early warning boundary in front of the integrated intelligent traffic cone at the upstream of an operation area and used for sending warning signals to other associated devices when detecting that a vehicle enters an early warning area on a high-speed early warning lane, the integrated intelligent traffic cone is used for automatically placing the integrated intelligent traffic cone at a preset position, configuring an integrated module such as a monitoring camera, an audible-visual alarm and a text prompt board according to the early warning effect so as to identify risks inside and outside the operation area and early warn, and the engineering pre-warning vehicle is used for assisting in identifying the risks inside and outside the operation area, processing early warning information and relieving collision. By constructing the device and the system for identifying and early warning the risks of people, vehicles and equipment in the expressway operation area, the risk of running in the vehicles outside the operation area and the risk of equipment in the internal personnel can be actively found, an alarm prompt is made before the risk comes, the workers in the operation area are guided to withdraw rapidly, and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: E-vehicle battery black box system
title_ko: 이차전지 모니터용 블랙박스장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A black box for a secondary battery monitor is provided to control charging and discharging current by measuring the voltage, current, and temperature of a secondary battery in real time, thereby preventing over charging and over discharging. CONSTITUTION: A black box for a secondary battery monitor(1) comprises a black box module(200) which supplies power to an electric vehicle or a device, storing measured voltage, current, and temperature data, and image data of a secondary battery, and informs a user of abnormal signals of a secondary battery through a smart phone. The black box module consists of an input and output connection terminal, a fuse part, and a BMS(Battery Management System)(210), a cooling fan(220), and a black box(230). [Reference numerals] (AA) Input connection terminal; (BB) Output connection terminal
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 종래의 리튬이온전지 및 리튬폴리머전지에 사용되는 PCM(Protection Circuit Moudule), 혹은 BMS(Battery Management System)이 전기차 및 전기구동장치화재시 이차전지와 함께 전소되어 사고분석 자체를 파악할 수 없고, 이차전지의 사고발생시, 전기차 사용자의 스마트폰으로의 알림기능이 없어, 전기차 및 전기구동장치화재시 대형사고의 문제점을 개선하고자, 입·출력접속단자, 퓨즈부(Fuse), 블랙박스연계형 BMS(Battery Management System), 냉각팬, 이차전지모니터용 블랙박스로 이루어진 이차전지 모니터용 블랙박스 모듈(200) 
로 구성됨으로서, 탈부착식 구조로 형성되어 BMS기능과 함께 혹은 단독으로 사용하여, 이상상황에 해당하는 데이터를 실시간으로 저장 및 분석할 수 있고, 전기차 뿐만 아니라 전기구동장치의 이차전지에도 호환시켜 적용시킬 수 있으며, 이차전지모니터용 블랙박스모듈에 저장된 측량데이터와 영상데이터를 통해 리튬이온전지 및 리튬폴리머 전지 등의 개별 구성 전지의 밸런싱(BALANCING)에 의한 용량 감소, 과충전 등에 의한 사고유발, 잔량 경고 이후의 사용시간 예측, 및 소비자의 연료 경고 이후의 행동 예측, 전기차의 전기차 및 전기구동장치 사고 및 전기차용 이차전지 성능 향상에 막대한 영향을 주는 고속 충전, 고율방전에 의한 잔량예측, 사용환경의 급속한 변경 등에 대한 이차전지의 반응 등을 예측할 수 있는 데이터를 획득할 수 있고, 무엇보다 이차전지의 이상신호발생시, WiFi 통신모듈을 통해 전기차 및 전기구동장치 사용자의 스마트폰으로 사전에 알려줄 수 있어, 대형사고를 미리 예방시킬 수 있는 이차전지 모니터용 블랙박스장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Car Rear Safety Stationery Device
title_ko: 자동차 후방 안전문구 생성 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for generating words of safety on the rear of a vehicle. The device comprises: a display panel and a sunshade installed on the back glass of a vehicle; a rear horn unit installed on the rear end of the vehicle; and a control unit provided in the interior space of the vehicle, and communicatively connected to the display panel, the sunshade, and the rear horn unit to control the operation of each device. The device can request, from vehicles behind or pedestrians a danger signal including an accident situation in front of the driving vehicle or a vehicle breakdown condition, a rescue request signal in case of kidnapping or illness occurrence, lane change, and restraints on retaliatory driving, can store, in a memory, text and voice messages corresponding to a notification signal to report to the public office as needed, and can select and print the stored message.
abstract_ko:
자동차 후방 만전문구 생성 장치에 관한 것으로, 자동차의 후측 윈드글라스에 설치되는 디스플레이 패널과 햇빛 가리개, 자동차의 후단부에 설치되는 후방 경적 유닛 및 자동차의 실내 공간에 마련되고, 상기 디스플레이 패널과 햇빛 가리개 및 후방 경적 유닛과 통신 가능하게 연결되어 각 장치의 구동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 구성을 
마련하여, 후방의 차량이나 행인들에게 주행 차량의 전방 사고 상황이나 차량 고장 상태를 포함하는 위험신호, 납치나 환자 발생에 따른 구조 요청신호, 차선 변경, 보복운전의 자제를 요청하고 필요 시 관공서에 신고를 알리는 알림 신호에 대응되는 문자 및 음성 메시지를 메모리에 저장하며, 저장된 메시지를 선택해서 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Urban flood control early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an urban flood control early warning system and method, which relate to the technical field of urban meteorological data processing and comprise the following steps: obtaining terrain data of a target city, and constructing a waterlogging dangerous point set of the target city; constructing association relations of waterlogging dangerous points in the waterlogging dangerous point set based on the topographic data of the target city; establishing a plurality of prediction models based on the historical flood data of the target city and the corresponding weather data; collecting future weather related prediction information of the target city according to a preset rule; and matching a corresponding prediction model from each prediction model according to the future weather related expected information, and predicting and updating the waterlogging risk of the waterlogging risk point set by combining the association relation of the waterlogging risk points. According to the method, the terrain influence relationship is considered, the weather related conditions are introduced to predict and update the waterlogging risk, and the accuracy of flood control prediction is improved.
assignees: LIAOCHENG KEHUI MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Weather information-providing system for preventing disaster and therefor
title_ko: 방재 기상정보 제공시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A disaster preventing weather information providing system and a method thereof are provided to generate an alarm sound quickly and supply weather data in real time before a disaster alarm is released, thereby enabling general persons to easily confirm related disaster data. A bad weather analysis system analyzes weather data received from a synthesis weather information system, and outputs alarm/release signals. A display device receives the alarm/release signals and disaster data in real time through a communications network and generates the alarm/release signals or displays the disaster data. The bad weather analysis system(110) comprise the followings. A weather data receiver(120) receives weather data. A disaster reference value storage part(130) previously sets up a disaster reference value by disaster and stores the set reference value. A weather data comparison unit(140) compares the weather data with the disaster reference value stored in the disaster reference value storage part, and outputs the comparison value. An alarm signal generating/releasing part(150) receives the comparison value, and generates a control signal and alarm/release signals corresponding to the comparison value. A disaster data transmitting unit(160) receives the weather data in response to the control signal, and outputs disaster data. The display device(190) comprises the followings. The alarm signal generating/releasing part generates the alarm/release signals received from the alarm signal generating/releasing part through the communications network. A disaster data display unit receives the disaster data from the disaster data transmitting unit, and displays the received disaster data in real time together with graph or identity code etc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 종합 기상 정보시스템으로부터 수신된 기상데이터를 분석하여 경보/해제 신호 및 재해데이터를 출력하는 악기상 분석시스템 및 상기 경보/해제신호 및 재해데이터를 실시간으로 통신망을 통해 수신하여 상기 경보/해제 신호를 발동하거나 상기 재해데이터를 디스플레이하는 디스플레이장치를 포함하며, 상기 악기상 분석시스템은 상기 기상데이터를 수신하는 기상데이터 수신부, 재해별 재해 기준값을 사전에 설정하여 저장되는 재해기준값 저장부, 상기 기상데이터와 상기 재해기준값 저장부에 저장된 재해 기준값을 비교하여 비교값을 출력하는 기상데이터 비교부, 상기 비교값을 수신하여 이에 대응하는 경보/해제 신호 및 제어신호를 발생하는 경보신호 발생/해제부 및 상기 제어신호에 응답하여 상기 기상데이터를 수신하여 재해데이터로 출력하는 재해데이터 송신부를 포함하고, 상기 디스플레이장치는 상기 경보신호 발생/해제부로 부터 상기 통신망을 통해 수신된 상기 경보/해제 신호를 발동하는 경보신호 발동/해제부, 상기 재해데이터 송신부로 부터 상기 재해데이터를 수신하여 실시간으로 그라프 또는 식별 부호등과 함께 디스플레이하는 재해데이터 디스플레이부를 포함하는 방재 기상정보 제공시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for notifying si update, eab update and pws message in wierelss communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 si 업데이트, eab 업데이트 및 pws 메시지를 통지하기 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 시스템 정보(SI; system information)를 수신하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 향상된 커버리지 내에 있거나 셀 대역폭보다 좁은 대역폭에서 동작하는 단말(UE; userequipment)은, SI 업데이트, 지진 및 쓰나미 경보 시스템(ETWS; earthquake and tsunami warning system) 통지, 상용 모바일 경보 시스템(CMAS; commercial mobile alert system) 통지 또는 확장된 접속 차단(EAB; extended access barring) 수정 중 적어도 하나에 대한 지시를 PDCCH(physical downlink control channel)를 통해 네트워크로부터 수신하며, 네트워크로부터 수신된 지시에 따라 시스템 정보를 수신한다.

title_en: Carrier beacon mode
abstract_en: A method of using a vehicle to warn of potential risks comprising: determining that a user of the vehicle is to be absent; determining an estimated absence time; and if the user does not return within the estimated absence time, sending a warning to the authority via the control system. The method may include receiving an estimated absence time from a user, or a control system of the vehicle determining the absence and the estimated absence time. The user may define the absence and input the estimated absence time by a centralized location such that a warning is sent from the centralized location. After expiration of the estimated absence time, a pedestrian in the vicinity of the vehicle is detected and a pre-recorded emergency message is then played through a speaker so that the pedestrian is aware of the pre-recorded emergency message. The carrier lamp/horn may be operable to guide the user, possibly in a decaying manner.

title_en: Tobacco plant topping height judging method based on tobacco planting soil conductivity and chlorophyll
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tobacco plant topping height judging method based on tobacco planting soil conductivity and chlorophyll, when network access equipment is connected with a network, an equipment network access management system divides a current network scene into a plurality of departments, and the equipment network access management system sends corresponding equipment information to a monitoring unit, and the invention has the beneficial effects that: the analysis unit can update the network topology map and the organization structure map according to the marking sequence of the appointed access terminal I P, and store the updated network topology map and organization structure map in the map library of the storage unit after updating time; through sending early warning information to the strange access terminal according to the specific type and access target of the access terminal, potential safety hazards are eliminated in time, and meanwhile, authority setting can be carried out on a new access terminal, so that the requirements of adding and deleting access equipment or adjusting the authority of the accessed terminal of a current enterprise are met.
assignees: QIANNAN BRANCH OF GUIZHOU TOBACCO COMPANY

title_en: Microseismic waveform multi-task integrated analysis method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic waveform multi-task integrated analysis method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a multichannel microseismic waveform data set, wherein the multichannel microseismic waveform data set comprises sample data and tag data; training the neural network by using the multichannel microseismic waveform data set to obtain a multi-task processing model; and inputting the target multichannel microseismic waveform data into a multi-task processing model, and respectively outputting the target focus positioning, the target event energy value and the target moment magnitude through the multi-task processing model. The invention can integrate and output the target parameters more quickly and accurately, so as to update the stability development state of the surrounding rock more quickly, and remarkably improve the reliability and accuracy of disaster early warning.

title_en: Integral nipple air breathing device and whistle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integral nipple air breathing device and whistle which is designed to use together with a miniature nostril plug cover and an oxygen supply apparatus. When a disaster suddenly occurs, dense smoke and dust are generated and the device of the invention is used together with the miniature nostril plug cover and the oxygen supply apparatus, the miniature nostril plug cover is used to take in oxygen for human body through the oxygen supply apparatus and an oxygen catheter; the user holds an expiration nipple (1) in the mouth, a lip cover (3) covers lips naturally, the turbid qi is discharged in a bellows (4) through an expiration hole (2) to drive a jump ball (5) to move violently and push a bellows door (7) to open; the turbid qi is expired from a whistle opening (9) to generate loud whistle sounds for warning and locating, thus an accurate direction can be provided for rescuers so as to help the rescuers to rescue successfully; and the bellows door (7) uses a bellows door shaft (8) to be connected with the bellows (4) through a bearing (6); the bellows door (7) is opened during expiration and returns and is closed after expiration under the action of gravity, thus the toxic smoke can be effectively prevented from inhaling and a respiratory circulation can be completed through one inspiration process and one expiration process.

title_en: Thunder and lightning information collection and early warning method and system for high speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a thunder and lightning information collection and early warning system for a high speed railway. The system comprises a thunder and lightning information collection device, a current signal/value signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold of thunder and lightning disaster risks, a determining device startd by an early warning program, a locating device, a train controlling device for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device. A control module serves as a core of the whole system, controls operation of the devices on one hand, and is used for being connected with external devices including an external computer device and the like to achieve communication and control. In the system, the dynamic generating mode is adopted in the reference threshold for evaluating the thunder and lightning disaster risks, the historical disaster situations are combined, and the historical situations are continuously updated after new early warning is given, so that the risk pre-evaluation of a certain region is considered more completely and scientifically with contrast to historical data. The invention further provides a thunder and lightning information collection and early warning method for the high speed railway.

title_en: Moving ring fault prediction and linkage control method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, and particularly discloses a dynamic ring fault prediction and linkage control method and system based on machine vision. The method comprises the steps of extracting feature information from early warning information to obtain early warning feature information, extracting feature information from alarm information to obtain alarm feature information, generating fault prediction strategy information according to the early warning feature information and the alarm feature information, judging whether the fault prediction strategy information is in preset strategy library information, and updating the fault prediction strategy information into the preset strategy library information if the fault prediction strategy information is not in the preset strategy library information, so that the existing database can be continuously updated in real time, the machine room fault can be comprehensively predicted according to the database updated in real time, and meanwhile, the real-time updated database can also comprehensively link emergency equipment which needs to be timely linked after the occurrence of a problem, so that the risk of the machine room after the occurrence of safety fire fighting safety can be reduced through timely linkage.

title_en: User order return risk early warning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and discloses a user order withdrawal risk early warning method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving a return risk prediction request, wherein the return risk prediction request comprises target object information; acquiring external platform data and internal platform data matched with target object information; preprocessing external platform data and internal platform data to obtain data to be analyzed; carrying out feature extraction processing on the data to be analyzed through a preset feature extraction model to obtain feature data; carrying out risk prediction processing on the characteristic data through a preset risk prediction model to obtain a return list risk prediction result; and generating the form withdrawal risk early warning information according to the form withdrawal risk prediction result, and generating a risk control strategy according to the form withdrawal risk early warning information. The invention can realize more comprehensive risk prediction, improves the intelligent degree and the accuracy of the form withdrawal risk early warning, and is beneficial to improving the recognition capability of novel form withdrawal blackout products in the financial field.
assignees: PING AN LIFE INSURANCE CO CHINA LTD

title_en: Strong wind disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou GNSS-R
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong wind disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou GNSS-R, which comprises the steps of 1, carrying out wind speed detection operation of the inner water surface of an unmanned aerial vehicle on the periphery of a strong water fall area by carrying out GNSS-R receiving equipment, carrying out data calculation on acquired satellite observables, 2, constructing an LSTM wind speed inversion model integrating double-factor decoupling, carrying out inversion prediction on the water surface wind speed of a reflection point area by inputting the received satellite observables and calculation results and carrying out error correction, obtaining future time step wind speed prediction based on the past time step wind speed inversion results, 3, establishing a boundary self-adaptive grid and a dynamically updated Kriging interpolation model, obtaining wind speed data of a specific signal reflection point missing area, assisting wind speed data supplement of the reflection point missing area, and 4, constructing a double-effect strong wind early warning strategy of the coordination of wind speed time sequence extrapolation and inversion stability, judging whether strong wind is about to appear or not, and carrying out early warning.

title_en: One-person household smart home protector
title_ko: 1인 가구 스마트 홈 지킴이
abstract_en: The present invention provides a single-person household smart home guardian that identifies whether a resident is active through a motion detection sensor, and automatically transmits a rescue request signal to 119 when there is no follow-up action after transmitting a notification signal to an application of a user when determined that an emergency situation has occurred. The single-person household smart home guardian comprises: a motion detection sensor; a control part for controlling a corresponding signal when a movement of a person is detected by the motion detection sensor; a user terminal for receiving a signal; and a communication means for transmitting a control signal of the control part to the user terminal, wherein the control part increases a motion detection counter to 0 when the movement of the person is not detected and increases the motion detection counter to 1 when the movement of the person is detected by the motion detection sensor, increases a motion detection timer by 1 when the motion detection counter is 0 to initialize the motion detection timer to 0 when the motion detection counter becomes 1, and transmits a notification signal to the user terminal when the motion detection timer reaches a set time in a state wherein the motion detection counter is 0 and increases the motion detection counter to 2 when the notification is not turned-off for a predetermined time through an application installed in the user terminal to transmit emergency situation occurrence information to 119.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 1인 가구 스마트 홈 지킴이에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 다양한 센서가 설치되어 사용자의 긴급상황 여부를 판단 후 긴급상황으로 판단되는 경우 자동으로 119에 구조요청 신호를 발송하는 1인 가구 스마트 홈 지킴이에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따르면, 집 안에 설치되어 사용자에게 긴급상황이 발생한 것으로 판단되면 자동으로 신고를 진행하는 1인 가구 스마트 홈 지킴이에 있어서, 상기 집 안의 적어도 하나 이상의 문에 설치되어 사람의 움직임을 감지하는 모션감지센서; 상기 모션감지센서에서 사람의 움직임이 감지되면 해당 신호를 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부를 통해 신호를 전달받는 사용자단말기; 및 상기 제어부의 제어신호를 상기 사용자단말기로 송신하는 통신수단;을 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 상기 모션감지센서에서 사람의 움직임이 감지되지 않는 경우 모션감지카운터를 0, 사람의 움직임이 감지되는 경우 모션감지카운터를 1로 증가시키고, 상기 모션감지카운터가 0인 상태에서는 모션감지타이머를 1씩 증가시키되 모션감지카운터가 1이 되면 모션감지타이머를 0으로 초기화하고, 상기 모션감지카운터가 0인 상태에서 상기 모션감지타이머가 설정된 시간에 도달하면 상기 사용자단말기로 알림신호를 송신하며, 상기 사용자단말기에 설치된 어플리케이션을 통해 소정의 시간동안 알림이 해제되지 않으면 모션감지카운터를 2로 증가시키며 119에 긴급상황 발생 정보를 송신하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 1인 가구 스마트 홈 지킴이를 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Power transmission line tree obstacle risk level evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating tree obstacle risk level of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting the amplitude I of tree barrier discharge pulse Measuring And frequency f Measuring (ii) a Step 2, waveform validity judgment: when the amplitude value I Measuring Exceeding the threshold value I of the discharge amplitude of the hidden danger m1 And the discharge waveform has periodic repeatability compared with power frequency, namely the discharge waveform is judged to be an effective waveform, and the discharge waveform is judged to be I of the effective waveform Measuring And f Measuring Entering a history library for storage; step 3, taking the weight coefficient k of the middle amplitude N ＝I m2 /I m Intermediate frequency weight coefficient l N ＝f 2 /f m According to formula A Measuring ＝k N I m side +α/(l N f Measuring ) For the amplitude I of the effective pulse Measuring And frequency f Measuring Calculating to obtain a calculation result A Measuring Step 4, according to the calculation result A Measuring Judging the risk level;the technical problems that the evaluation process of the power transmission line tree obstacle early warning is multiple in operation steps, large in implementation difficulty, complex and multiple in information processing, inconvenient to actual operation and the like are solved.

title_en: Automatic parking tracker
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to managing and performing vehicle parking. The system may receive at least one parking message from the sensor. The parking message may indicate whether the vehicle is in the parking space and then track a duration of the vehicle in the parking space based on the at least one parking message. Some embodiments relate to starting a timer in response to receiving a parking request, wherein the timer is set to expire according to a requested parking duration. Further, a first alert signal may be generated in response to the duration exceeding a predetermined threshold and in response to no parking request being received; and the second alert signal may be generated in response to an indication that the vehicle is in the parking space and in response to expiration of the timer.

title_en: Alarm device for monitoring collapse of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm device for monitoring mountain collapse, which relates to the technical field of early warning equipment and comprises the following components: the solar panel of installation branch and fixed connection in installation branch upper end one side, the bilateral symmetry fixedly connected with loudspeaker of installation branch upper end, the top fixed mounting of installation branch has audible and visual alarm, the upper end of installation branch is provided with smog cooperating structure, smog cooperating structure is including the backup pad of fixed connection in installation branch upper end, open produced smog from holding vessel exhaust pipe department discharge and rise to sky through the smog jar, and form red in this alarm area sky, thereby when having compensatied daytime, the warning light that audible and visual alarm sent is difficult for being seen by personnel, and the mountain obstructs the defect of loudspeaker sound propagation, the visibility of alarm has not only been increased, can also transmit warning information fast, in order to remind nearby personnel to withdraw urgently or dodge.
assignees: QINGHAI CHINACOAL GEOLOGY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm and emergency escaping system for the deaf and the senior
title_ko: 노약자 및 청각장애인들을 위한 화재 경보 및 대피 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention informs the senior or the deaf with a weak sensing ability who sleeps of a fire and escapes the senior or the deaf when the fire breaks out in a building. The losses of properties and casualties are prevented by the reduction of the escape time of rescuers and the quick fire response of firefighters, by vibrating a pillow, opening an entrance door by automatically unlocking a door lock, and reporting the occurrence of the fire to surrounding fire stations and police stations through a transmitter by comprising the vibration type pillow, the automatic open and close door lock, and the transmitter to wirelessly transmit and receive a signal to and from a fire reception board if the fire breaks out.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 내 화재 발생 시 수면중인 감지 능력이 부족한 노약자나 청각장애인들에게 화재가 발생하였음을 알리고 대피시키기 위한 것으로서, 화재 수신반과 무선으로 신호를 주고받는 “진동형 베개”, “자동개방 도어락”, “발신기”를 구성하여 화재가 발생하면 베개를 진동시키고, 도어락을 자동으로 해제하여 출입문을 개방하고, 발신기를 통하여 주변의 소방서 및 경찰서에 화재 발생 사실을 통보함으로써 요구조자들의 대피시간 단축 및 소방관들의 신속한 화재대응으로 인명피해 예방과 재산상의 손실을 방지하는 것이다.

title_en: Compact type apparatus for storage of cable
title_ko: 부채꼴 형태의 개구부가 형성된 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compact type cable storage apparatus with a sector-shaped opening. The apparatus includes an internal disc with spiral tracks formed on the front and rear, an external enclosure that is coupled to the front and rear with the internal disc in between, a handle for rotating the internal disc so as to smoothly wind the withdrawn cable, and a cable guider block. This configuration allows for smooth extraction and retraction of cables without tangling, providing ease of use, preventing stress for operators due to cable tangling, improving work efficiency, and reducing work time. The internal disc can be made thin, slightly thicker than the diameter of two cables being used, making it easy to carry during power duct, manhole, and high-altitude work. Additionally, cables (1) can be immediately wound on-site after use, preventing accidents caused by unattended cables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 부채꼴 형태의 개구부가 형성된 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치는 정면과 후면에 나선형 트랙이 형성된 내부 원판과, 내부 원판을 사이에 두고 정면과 후면에서 결합되는 외부 함체와, 내부 원판을 회전시켜 외부로 인출된 케이블을 원활하게 감을 수 있는 핸들과 케이블 가이더블록을 구비하고 있기 때문에 케이블의 엉킴없이 인출 또는 인입이 원활하도록 하는 사용의 편리성을 부여하고, 케이블의 엉킴으로 인한 작업자의 스트레스를 예방함과 동시에 작업성 향상 및 작업시간 단축하고, 사용하는 케이블 2가닥 직경보다 조금 큰 정도의 두께로 얇은 내부 원판으로 제작이 가능하므로 전력구, 맨홀 및 고소 작업개소 작업시 휴대가 용이하며, 케이블 사용 후 현장에서 즉시 감을 수 있으므로 방치되는 케이블(1)로 인한 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning system. The geological disaster early warning system comprises a comprehensive database, a data analysis module and an early warning module; the comprehensive database is used for storing real-time monitored related data; the data analysis module is used for performing analysis processing on the monitored data by using a corresponding analysis algorithm, wherein the corresponding analysis algorithm can be opened and edited in a use process according to requirements of a user so as to be modified and updated; and the early warning module is used for performing corresponding early warning on the monitored data analyzed by the data analysis module by using a set corresponding threshold value. According to the geological disaster early warning system, since the analysis algorithm inside the data analysis module can be directly opened and correspondingly edited, and therefore, when the user needs to edit the analysis algorithm, the user can directly edit the algorithm in the use process so as to realize corresponding modification and update without the re-development of a corresponding data analysis module required; and therefore, the geological disaster early warning system is advantageous in convenient operation and high application efficiency. The invention also provides a geological disaster early warning method.
assignees: WUHAN DIDA INFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Cigarette sense warning device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of cigarette sense warning device, including smoke alarm, camera is installed on the smoke alarm.Cigarette sense warning device provided by the invention, integrated smoke alarm and monitoring camera camera function, smoke alarm is connected to the host computer of fire-fighting Central Control Room when use with camera, the screen video that Central Control Room operator on duty passes through monitoring host computer, intuitive quickly reaction, it is confirmed whether to report by mistake, self-extinguishing equipment and fire-fighting link device are closed if wrong report, and cancel alarm, due to can directly be observed by screen video, therefore it substantially reduces and is confirmed whether to report by mistake the required time, it is not easy to serious property loss and manpower be caused to be lost.
assignees: BEIJING ZIGUANG XINRUI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: System is monitored based on wireless sensing and the geo-hazard early-warning of the communication technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses the geo-hazard early-warnings based on wireless sensing and the communication technology to monitor system, and a point emergency platform is in communication in main emergency platform；Point emergency platform is provided with the acquisition module for collection site data；Acquisition module collection site data, point emergency platform will be sent to main emergency platform after on-site data processing；By treated, field data generates disaster alarm data to main emergency platform in conjunction with geography information；When disaster alarm data be more than warning value when, main emergency platform to divide emergency platform sending early warning；Warning information is sent to the corresponding area of disaster alarm data more than warning value according to geography information by point emergency platform.The present invention is based on wireless sensings and the geo-hazard early-warning of the communication technology to monitor system, by the way that above-mentioned platform is arranged, it realizes comprehensive early warning to geological disaster and its secondary disaster when geological disaster occurs, and for subsequent rescue work and withdraws work good reference is provided.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling data early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed disaster recovery drilling data early warning method and a distributed disaster recovery drilling data early warning system based on artificial intelligence.A central early warning model is uploaded to the local for training if a local edge node has no trained model; after receiving the central early warning model, the local edge node server performs associated data analysis and classification aggregation; calculating local prior probability, local conditional probability, local adjustment factors and local posterior probability, and inputting the local prior probability, the local adjustment factors and the local posterior probability into a central early warning model for training to obtain optimal disaster recovery drilling occurrence warning probability; and submitting the alarm probability data of the optimal disaster recovery drilling in each region to a central server to update a central early warning model, updating a headquarter drilling result database, storing the updated indexes after each training, and re-executing a new round of model training by a central server program so as to complete the whole process. According to the method, disaster recovery drilling is used as a main line, historical drilling data is used as an analysis basis, artificial intelligence is introduced to replace artificial experience to replace an early warning model, and labor cost is greatly reduced.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall threshold dynamic updating method for early warning landslide
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of landslide early warning and risk management and control research, and particularly discloses a rainfall threshold dynamic updating method for serving landslide early warning, which comprises the steps of counting occurrence probability of landslide on an area according to area landslide record and rainfall data; extracting useful information in a real-time early warning record, wherein the useful information comprises a plurality of rainfall parameters and landslide triggering or not, then carrying out sample marking on the early warning record according to the landslide triggering or not, if the landslide occurs, marking the occurrence probability as 100%, otherwise marking as 0%, taking the occurrence probability of the landslide on the area as pre-training data, fitting the relation between the rainfall parameters and the occurrence probability of the landslide according to the occurrence probability of the landslide under a certain rainfall event in the slope through a machine learning model, dynamically updating the rainfall threshold of a risk slope, and issuing landslide early warning to the risk slope according to the updated rainfall threshold, so as to generate a new early warning record. The application has high early warning accuracy and can meet the disaster prevention and reduction requirements under the current weather change and earthquake frequency estrus.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;ZHEJIANG GEOLOGICAL INST

title_en: Temporary protection withdrawing method for intelligent security and protection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temporary protection withdrawing method for an intelligent security and protection system. The method comprises the steps that main control computer software sets a global variable for recording the current mode, and the current temporary protection withdrawing state is recorded; after the system receives an effective temporary protection withdrawing request, the configuration state information of the current system can be firstly stored, in addition, a piece of access record information is inserted, the temporary protection withdrawing state is changed into an effective state, a state update notice is sent to an authorized user side, then, a corresponding warning linkage output code is sent to a linkage card according to the current time, next, the set temporary protection withdrawing time starts to count down, after the time is out, the original warning linage code is taken out to be sent to the linkage card, then, the temporary protection withdrawing state variable is set as the non-temporary protection withdrawing, in addition, a state update notice is sent out, and the system recovers to a previous protection setting mode. Convenience is provided for clients to go into or go out of self corresponding protection regions, and meanwhile, the potential safety hazard and the disturbing on families and neighbors are also avoided.
assignees: RUN TEXTILE CO LTD OF SHENZHEN CITY HIGH

title_en: Novel intelligent safety helmet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel intelligent safety helmet, belonging to the technical field of safety helmets and solving the problem of insufficient protection performance and intelligent degree in the prior art, the invention increases the air suction range and shortens the detection time by arranging a detector sampling air inlet channel at the top of a helmet shell, arranging an acceleration sensor between the helmet shell and a lining to detect an impact signal, integrating a set of control detection early warning system connected with a remote terminal through a processor to improve the intelligent degree, simultaneously controlling an air supply mechanism to supply air to a plurality of communicated spherical air cushions and a cylindrical air cushion arranged at the bottom of the lining, filling gaps between the top of a head and the lining by the plurality of communicated spherical air cushions, and expanding the cylindrical air cushion to retract into the periphery of the head to realize automatic filling, extruding and wearing without the helmet and stable wearing, realizing intelligent comfort and stable wearing of the safety helmet through the structure, meanwhile, the functions of rapid detection and impact detection early warning of the safety helmet are added, and the intelligent degree and the efficiency of emergency rescue reaction are greatly improved.

title_en: Crane and safe cantilever thereof
abstract_en: A crane and its safe cantilever relate to the crane technology field, including a base, a column fixed on the base, a rotating shaft connected on the column, a connecting frame fixed on the rotating shaft, a cantilever fixed on the side of the connecting frame, a sliding rail in the cantilever, an electric hoist connected on the sliding rail, a retractable hanging rope in the electric hoist, a hook fixed on the lower end of the hanging rope, a dynamometer in the connecting frame, a fixed pulley fixed on the upper part of the connecting frame, a pulling rope fixed on the dynamometer, the pulling rope turned by the fixed pulley and fixed on the cantilever far from the column, the invention provides a crane and its safe cantilever, recording the stress variation of the pulling rope through the dynamometer, inputting the data into the control system for analysis, when the cantilever is deformed to a certain degree, the dynamometer will change greatly, thus providing early warning to the user, and then carry out the safety inspection to the cantilever to avoided current cantilever to warp easily and have the problem of potential safety hazard.

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management method for paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out, which comprises the following steps: step S1, inspecting and archiving the paint raw materials, wherein the paint raw materials are required to be subjected to qualification product quality inspection, detection and authentication and purchased according to the standard; s2, processing the paint raw materials after passing inspection, detection and authentication, inputting and storing various information of the paint, and generating a unique label serving as quality tracing; step S3, monitoring the service time and the residual storage time of the paint in real time according to various recorded information of the paint, and triggering early warning when the preset threshold value is reached; and S4, reminding a manager to timely process the coating which is about to be or has expired through an acousto-optic or electronic notification mode. Also disclosed are a paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out intelligent management system and an electronic device. The quality of the paint is controlled and traced, so that the physical health and the environmental quality of consumers are further ensured.

title_en: The tube incubate ropes.
title_ko: 밧줄을 품은 튜브
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tube having a rope embedded therein to enable an ordinary person to quickly rescue a drowning person within the golden time. According to the present invention, a rope is overlapped with the outer surface of the tube and is covered with waterproof cloth. A whistle is tied to an end portion of the cloth and is used to enable the drowning person to alert the surroundings first in case of an emergency. In the event of an emergency, the cloth attached by Velcro tape is detached, the rope is withdrawn, and an end portion of the rope and the cloth are crumpled into one body to be thrown at the drowning person. The other end portion of the rope is connected to the tube.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 밧줄이 들어가 있는 튜브에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 물놀이를 할 때 안전사고가 났을 때 튜브에 있는 밧줄을 빼어 밧줄을 둘러싼 원단을 함께 뭉쳐서 익수자를 구조할 수 있게 함으로써 익수자를 미리 구할 수 있게 하는 튜브에 관한 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명은 상기한 바와 같은 문제점을 해결하기 위해 제안된 것으로, 본 발명의 목적은 튜브 본연의 기능을 유지하면서도 익수자 발생 시 일반인이 골든타임동안 빠른 시간 내에 구할 수 있게끔 하기 위해 튜브 겉 표면에 줄을 덧대고 줄을 방수 천으로 감쌌다. 그 천의 끝부분엔 호루라기를 달아 긴급 상황 시 호루라기로 주변에 위험을 먼저 알릴 수 있게 하였다. 
긴급 상황 시 벨크로로 붙어있는 천을 떼어내고 줄을 빼내어서 줄 끝부분과 천을 함께 뭉쳐서 익수자에게 던져준다. 줄의 또 다른 끝부분은 튜브와 연결 되어있다. 익수자는 그 부분을 잡고 해경이 구조하러 올 때까지 기다린다. 
만약 구조 자가 물 밖에서 목격을 했을 경우, 줄 부분을 기둥에 묶고 튜브를 던져주고 끌어서 구조한다. 
본 발명은 앞서 본 목적을 달성하기 위하여 다음과 같은 구성을 가진다. 
본 발명에 따른 밧줄을 품은 튜브는 튜브 외부에 줄을 소방호스 형태로 감아 놓았고, 줄을 방수 천으로 벨크로를 이용하여 고정시켜 놓았다. 
또한 천의 사이에 부력 재를 넣었고, 천 안부분에 줄의 끝부분이 붙어있다.  
또한 천의 끝부분(줄의 끝부분)쪽에 호루라기가 달려있다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 물놀이에서 즐겁게 놀기 위해 반드시 챙겨가는 튜브에 물놀이 안전에 필요한 인명 구조용 밧줄을 하나로 결합하여, 반드시 챙겨가는 튜브에 꼭 필요한 물건을 함께 갖고 다닐 수 있도록 하였다. 평소처럼 튜브를 챙기지만 안전한 수중 레저 활동을 할 수 있다. 
또한, 평소에는 기존의 물놀이 튜브로 사용하다가 위급 상황에서 튜브를 벗기면 안전용품인 인명 구조용 밧줄이 바로 나와 사용 할 수 있고, 
구명환은 부피가 크고 딱딱해서 물놀이에서 사용하기에는 적합하지 않지만, 밧줄을 품은 튜브는 기존 튜브처럼 부드럽고 가볍기 때문에 물놀이 활동에서 사용하기 좋다는 실용적인 효과가 있다. 
 기존 튜브에 약간의 변형만으로도 인명 구조를 할 수 있다는 점은 어떠한 경제적인 효과보다 크다고 할 수 있다.

title_en: Portable safety equipment test device and test method for diagnosing abnormality of live wire detection device
title_ko: 활선 감지 장치의 이상 여부를 진단하는 휴대용 안전장구 시험 장치 및 이의 시험 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable safety equipment testing device for diagnosing abnormality of a live wire detection device, and a testing method thereof, wherein a reference voltage input unit alters the size of the power supplied from the power supply source and outputs a reference voltage to be supplied to an internal circuit; a neutral pole setting unit sets a reference phase voltage of an AC voltage to be generated by the reference voltage with the output reference voltage as an input; a signal generating unit outputs a square wave signal with the output reference voltage and the reference phase voltage as inputs and converts the output square wave signal into a sine wave signal; and an AC voltage output unit boosts the converted sine wave and outputs an AC voltage, wherein a coil is provided at the output terminal to generate electromagnetic induction by the output AC voltage to supply power to an external power line. When a worker conducts a performance test of a safety detector or a live wire approach alarm device for detecting whether a live wire is present, it is possible to prevent accidents caused by malfunction of a live wire detection device used by the worker, thereby improving the reliability of the live wire detection device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 활선 감지 장치의 이상 여부를 진단하는 휴대용 안전장구 시험 장치 및 이의 시험 방법에 관한 것으로, 기준전압 입력부가 상기 전력 공급원으로부터 공급된 전력의 크기를 변경하여 내부 회로에 공급할 기준전압을 출력하고, 중성극 설정부가 상기 출력된 기준전압을 입력으로 기준전압에 의해 생성될 교류 전압의 기준 위상 전압을 설정하며, 신호 생성부가 상기 출력된 기준전압 및 기준 위상 전압을 입력으로 구형파 신호를 출력하고 출력된 구형파 신호를 정현파 신호로 변환하고, 교류 전압 출력부가 상기 변환된 정현파를 승압하여 교류 전압을 출력하되, 상기 출력단에 코일을 구비하여 출력된 교류 전압에 의해 전자기 유도를 발생하여 외부 전력선에 전력을 공급하는 구성으로 작업자가 활선 여부를 감지하는 안전용 검전기 또는 활선 접근 경보기의 성능시험을 진행함에 따라 작업자가 사용하는 활선 감지 장치의 오작동으로 인한 안전사고를 미연에 방지하여 활선 감지 장치의 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Housing Management System for each stage of pig growth through temperature detection in the body
title_ko: 체내 온도 감지 통한 돼지 성장단계별 축사 관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개별 축사 내의 돼지 개체에 대한 체온 측정을 성장단계별로 구분하여 실시하며, 이를 통한 축사의 설  
비 제어도 사육환경 제어데이터를 근거로 하여 성장단계별로 구분 관리하며, 개체의 질병상황을 나타내는 개체이  
상 보고메시지를 생성 및 전송하는 지역통제부(100);와, 상기 지역통제부(100)에서 전송된 상기 개체이상 보고메  
시지에 따른 이상개체비율값을 통해 연산코드를 산출하며, 상기 연산코드에 따라 질병 상황별 경보코드를 생성하  
여, 개체이상 경보메시지를 전송하되, 질병 상황에 따라 지역내 교통 통제와 비상연락을 실시하며, 축사 설비기  
기의 제어를 위한 사육환경 제어데이터를 상기 지역통제부(100)에 통보하는 광역통제부(200);와, 전체 축사의 개  
체 질병 현황을 파악하여 상기 다수의 광역통제부(200)에 개체이상 경보메시지를 전달하며, 전체 개체의 건강상  
태 및 질병 상황이 기록된 데이터베이스를 구비하며, 질병 발생 및 기상변화에 따라 변경된 사육환경 제어데이터  
를 상기 다수의 광역통제부(200)에 전달하며, 지역간 교통 통제가 종합적으로 가능한 시스템이 구비되어 종합적  
인 개체의 질병 상황 감지 및 관리가 가능하도록 구성되는 중앙관제부(300);로 구성되며, 상기 광역통제부(200)  
가 개체이상 경보메시지를 전송하는 대상 범위는 광역통제부(200)가 직접 관리하는 다수의 타  
지역통제부(100)와, 다수의 축사관리자나 다수의 방역당국 관련자가 소지한 이동단말기(400);와, 중앙관제부 
(300);로 선정되어 돼지의 질병 발생 및 확산을 방지하는 것을 특징으로 하는 체내온도감지를 통한 돼지의 성장  
단계별 축사관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Portable firefighting warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable firefighting warning device and belongs to the technical field of warning devices. The portable firefighting warning device comprises a cuboid warning screen, wherein a handle is arranged on the top surface of the warning screen, two sides of the warning screen are clamped in two fixing plates at the upper part of a support frame body, two rectangular casings are arranged on the outer side of each fixing plate in the vertical direction, a rectangular groove is formed between the two rectangular casings, and a folding rod with the movably connected lower end and outwards folding upper end is arranged in the rectangular groove; two U-shaped racks are arranged at the lower part of the support frame body, two side rods of each U-shaped rack slide in from bottom ports of the rectangular casings on two side surfaces of the warning screen respectively, accordingly, a connecting part of the U-shaped rack is arranged at the lower part of the warning screen, and a pedal is connected onto the connecting part. According to the portable firefighting warning device, the retractable U-shaped racks and folding rods are arranged on the side surfaces of the warning screen, the warning screen is supported from the front side, the back side, the left side and the right side respectively, a front panel of the warning screen is provided with three LED display areas, and accordingly, the portable firefighting warning device has an obvious pre-warning prompt function and overcomes the defect that the warning effect of a common warning board and warning line is not obvious.

title_en: Gust front automatic recognition method based on Doppler weather radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gust front automatic recognition method based on Doppler weather radar data, and the method comprises the following steps: 1), extracting a weak narrow band echo suspected area according to the radar performance characteristics of gust front through employing a local binaryzation algorithm; 2), carrying out the segmentation, connection and screening of the weak narrow band echo suspected area, and obtaining a skeleton image corresponding to a weak ridge-shaped belt; 3), obtaining an optical flow field through two low-pitching-angle radar images at a current moment and a former moment, supposing the matched skeletons at the former and latter moments in the skeleton images corresponding to the weak ridge-shaped belt obtained at step 2) as the suspected gust front, and recognizing the gust front according to the relation between the position and speed of the suspected gust front and the position and speed of a windstorm cell and the relation between the direction and speed of the suspected gust front. The method achieves the automatic detection of the gust front, achieves the timely early warning of disasters, and reduces the economic loss and casualty. Moreover, the validity of the method is verified.

title_en: Movable safety fence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a movable safety fence which comprises a fence main body, a driving assembly and a movable base, wherein the fence main body comprises a soft fence and a control cabinet, the soft fence is arranged in the control cabinet, a retractable opening for extending the soft fence is formed in the control cabinet, the driving assembly comprises a rotating rod and a motor, the rotating rod is in transmission connection with an output shaft of the motor, the movable base comprises a bottom plate and a driving wheel, the driving wheel is arranged below the bottom plate, the control cabinet is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, the soft fence is wound on the rotating rod, and the rotating rod is vertically arranged in the control cabinet. This security fence has functions such as automatic receive and release net, warning suggestion, removal use, alone alright accomplish laying of security fence and withdraw work, can improve artifical transport, lay, withdraw security fence's efficiency, alarming function then can send the early warning to the personnel of mistake income charged area, and the suggestion personnel keep away from to guarantee safety.

title_en: Laboratory safety precaution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laboratory safety, in particular to a laboratory safety early warning system, which comprises a naming registering module, a portrait tracking module, a digital twin module, a common monitoring module, a monitoring analysis module for determining a monitoring mode of a laboratory and a monitoring control module, wherein the monitoring control module determines a safety warning library according to experimental contents of each laboratory so as to identify abnormal behaviors of the laboratory, determines operation experimental equipment according to the experimental contents and experimental videos so as to monitor and update partial digital twin models corresponding to the operation experimental equipment in real time, and controls the common monitoring module to perform common monitoring on an experimental area so as to determine an influence characterization trend of a non-experimental area on the experimental area so as to determine whether safety early warning is performed. The invention solves the problems of incomplete monitoring, untimely early warning, difficult accident cause tracing and unreasonable resource utilization in the aspect of laboratory safety management in the prior art.

title_en: Communication equipment for disaster prevention
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide communication equipment for disaster prevention equipped with a press button which can be easily identified even by a handicapped person without damaging the original function of a push button operation while preventing any malfunction as much as possible.  <P>SOLUTION: This communication equipment installed in a residence for receiving a warning related with emergency circumstances from a central station is provided with a display means for visually displaying a warning; an acoustic means for audibly transmitting a warning; a press button for accepting the input of information such as the validity/invalidity of support or contact by a resident; a communication means for performing data communication; and a casing, wherein the operation surface of the casing is provided with a hollow section, and the press button is arranged so as to be projected from the button face of the hollow section, and to be exposed to the outside of the casing, and the height of the press button does not exceed the depth of the hollow section. abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mobile communication terminal having an alarm unit which notifies the approach of an electronic anklet wearer is provided to secure the personal safety of a user by issuing a warning alarm in case an electronic anklet wearer having the record of sex offense approaches within the safety behavior radius range of the user. CONSTITUTION: The wearer approach alarm unit of a mobile communication terminal comprises a receiver(1), a filter(2), a switch(3), an amplifier(4), and an AD converter(5). The filter identifies an electronic anklet transmission signal received in the receiver. The switch is automatically turned on by the filter. The amplifier amplifies the electronic anklet transmission signal delivered from the switch and delivers the amplified signal to the AD converter. The AD converter converts the electronic anklet transmission signal into a digital signal and delivers the signal to the processing unit of the mobile communication terminal.
