abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전자발찌를 착용한 성범죄 전력자가 사용자의 안전행동반경 범위 내에 들어올 경우 경보를 발하여 자신의 신변 안전을 도모할 수 있는 전자발찌 착용자 접근 경보수단을 가진 이동통신단말기를 제공하려는 것으로서, 전자발찌의 발신신호 감지 및 인식수단을 내장하여 통상의 이동통신단말기에 내장된 진동모터, 스피커를 통해 경보를 발하며, 또는 이와 함께 동시적으로 디스플레이에 경보문구로 표시되거나 LED가 점멸되어 사용자에게 알림으로써 신속하게 신변 안전을 위한 행동을 취할 수 있게 하며, 전자발찌 발신신호가 감지되는 즉시 ON되어 증폭기에 의해 증폭된 후 디지털신호로 변환하여 이동통신단말기의 처리부로 전달해 경보케 하는 증폭기와 아날로그/디지털 컨버터를 포함한다.  상기 경보수단은 사용자의 안전행동반경 내에 전자발찌 착용자가 존재하는 사실이 처음 확인된 후로 정해진 시간 동안 동안 반복적으로 경고를 발하고, 경고유효시간 경과 후에는 경고대기상태로 전환되며, 계속해서 전자발찌의 발신신호가 포착되면 상기한 바와 같은 내용의 경보가 반복되고 전자발찌의 발신신호가 소멸되면 경보가 해제되는 타임 딜레이도 포함한다.

title_en: method and apparatus for improving security on the drawer and cabinet with Low Power
title_ko: 서랍 및 캐비닛의 보안성을 향상시키기 위한 배터리 구동용 저전력 보안장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for improving security of a drawer or the like, which allow a user to detect an opening state of a monitored device such as a drawer, a cabinet, a safe, etc. so that an audiovisual warning can be given if a certain time is elapsed in a detected state. The device of the present invention comprises: a keypad to input time setting data of a user; a keybox switch and first to N^th drawer switches which are electrically connected to a power unit to supply power and to maintain an ON-state of a contact point when a locking device is unlocked and a cabinet body is opened to detect a locking state of the locking device and whether a drawer is opened; a control unit to receive power through an operation selecting switch (138) which is connected to the keybox in parallel and the first to N^th drawer switches, to receive the time setting data of the user from the keypad to regularly check whether the drawer is maintained to be opened until the set time is finished, and to generate a warning signal; and a warning device which is formed at an output end of the control unit to give an audiovisual warning by a control signal of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 사용자가 서랍, 캐비닛 및 금고 등 피감시장치의 개방 상태를 검출하여, 검출된 상태로 소정시간이 경과하면 시청각적인 경보를 수행하여 서랍 등의 보안성을 향상시키기 위한 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 서랍 및 캐비닛의 보안성을 향상시키기 위한 장치는, 사용자의 시간 설정 데이터를 입력받는 키패드; 전원을 공급하기 위한 전원부와 전기적으로 연결되어 시건장치의 잠금상태와 서랍의 개방 여부를 감지하기 위하여 각각 시건장치의 잠금해제와 서랍 및 캐비닛 본체의 개방시에 접점이 ON 상태를 유지하는 키박스 스위치 및 제 1~제 N서랍 스위치;  키박스 스위치와 병렬로 연결된 동작선택 스위치(138) 및 제 1~제 N서랍 스위치들을 통하여 전원을 공급받고, 키패드로부터 사용자의 시간 설정 데이터를 입력받아 설정된 시간이 종료될 때까지 서랍의 개방상태가 지속되는지의 여부를 주기적으로 확인하고 경보신호를 발생시키는 제어부; 및 제어부의 출력단에 형성되고 제어부의 제어신호에 의하여 시청각적인 경보를 수행하는 경보장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart fire response integrated management system
title_ko: 스마트 화재대응 통합관리시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an integrated smart fire response management system for preventing damage to human life and facilities by promptly responding to a fire by automatically linking a fire alarm control panel for receiving whether a fire occurs, a locking device such as fire extinguishing equipment, relief equipment, and the like for responding to a fire, and a location notification device. The smart fire response integrated management system comprises: a cloud-based control server (10); an integrated field relay device (20) for a fire detection and rescue equipment storage box (30); an unlocking device (40) for fire detection and rescue equipment; a fire detection and rescue equipment location notification device (50); and an administrator terminal (60). According to the present invention, fire detection and rescue equipment can be constantly inspected via mobile devices, allowing for dual safety inspections along with fire safety inspections, thereby facilitating equipment maintenance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 화재대응 통합관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 클라우드 기반 관제서버(10), 화재수신반 일체형 현장중계장치(20), 소화 및 구호 장비 보관함(30)의 잠금해제장치(40), 소화 및 구호 장비 위치알림장치(50), 관리자 단말기(60)를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 관제서버(10)는 관리자 단말기(60)로부터 전송되는 사용자 정보를 데이터베이스에 등록하고, 전송되는 로그인정보를 이용하여 데이터베이스에 등록된 사용자에 대하여 로그인을 수행하고 해당 관리자 단말기(60)로 제어권한을 부여하며, 상기 관리자 단말기(60)로부터 원격제어 명령을 전달받아 상기 잠금해제장치(40) 및 위치알림장치(50) 및 현장중계장치(20)의 동작을 제어함과 아울러 작동 상태에 대한 모니터링을 수행하며, 화재 발생 시 현장중계장치(20)로부터 전송된 화재신호를 무선으로 전달받아 데이터베이스에 기록하면서 잠금해제장치(40) 및 위치알림장치(50)로 동작제어신호를 출력하여 소화 및 구호 장비에 대한 잠금해제장치(40)를 구동함과 아울러 및 위치알림장치(50)를 작동하여, 화재발생 여부를 수신하는 화재수신반과 화재대응을 위한 소화장비, 구호장비 등의 잠금장치 및 위치알림장치를 연동시켜 신속한 화재대응으로 인명 및 시설의 손상을 방지하는 스마트 화재대응 통합관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Server, vehicle terminal and method for providing emergency notification
title_ko: 서버, 차량용 단말 및 이를 이용한 긴급 상황 알림 방법
abstract_en: A method for notifying an emergency situation of a server is disclosed. The method comprises the steps of: receiving emergency situation information from a vehicle terminal for a vehicle when an emergency situation event of the vehicle occurs; starting a standby count for canceling the emergency situation for the vehicle terminal; determining whether the vehicle is in an emergency situation according to whether the emergency situation is canceled until the standby count for canceling the emergency situation is terminated; and reporting the emergency situation of the vehicle to an emergency reporting agency using the received emergency situation information when the vehicle is determined to be in the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 서버의 긴급 상황 알림 방법이 개시된다. 본 방법은 차량의 긴급 상황 이벤트 발생시, 차량에 대한 차량용 단말로부터 긴급 상황 정보를 수신하는 단계, 차량용 단말에 대하여 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트를 시작하는 단계, 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트가 종료될 때까지 긴급 상황에 대한 취소가 이루어지는지 여부에 따라 긴급 상황 여부를 판단하는 단계, 긴급 상황으로 판단되면, 수신된 긴급 상황 정보를 이용하여 긴급 신고 기관으로 차량의 긴급 상황에 대한 신고를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of landslide monitoring early-warning system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of landslide monitoring early-warning systems, including server, mobile communication terminal and the multigroup signal pickup assembly being arranged along mountain, every group of signal pickup assembly to include：The baffle that is configured at an angle with massif surface, the pressure sensor of upper surface for being arranged in baffle, the control unit being connect with pressure sensor, the wireless transmission unit that is connect respectively with control unit and positioning unit；Server communicates to connect each wireless transmission unit and the mobile communication terminal respectively.Implement the landslide monitoring early-warning system of the present invention, can effective monitoring landslide, early warning is carried out to landslide in time, and sends warning information to the position come down, personnel is notified to withdraw.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;DONGYING JUXIAN ZHENGNENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of intelligence automatic fire extinguishing system and self-extinguishing method
abstract_en: A kind of intelligence automatic fire extinguishing system, including self-extinguishing module, fire monitoring module, middle control module, mobile terminal, alarm module, comprehensive analysis module, NB-iot modules；Self-extinguishing module, fire monitoring module, middle control module, mobile terminal, alarm module are bi-directionally connected with middle control module；NB-iot modules are connected to central controller and wireless launcher；Fire monitoring module includes sensor or detector；NB-iot modules are used to receive the signal of fire monitoring module and are sent to middle control module, then are transferred to comprehensive analysis module, are additionally operable to control module and mobile terminal in receiving and transmit the signal of coming；Middle control module includes central controller and data storage.The present invention can greatly reduce personnel's injury, reduce the disaster-stricken rate of extinguishing device itself, improve fire extinguisher and quickly spray efficiency.It by big data analysis, can give warning in advance with expired fire extinguisher to that will fail, check replace in time, greatly save manual review workload.
assignees: SHANGHAI LIQI ELECTRONIC TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent traffic cone and retraction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent traffic cone and a retraction method thereof, comprising the steps of collecting construction operation area information, dividing functional sections of a construction operation area, and manufacturing a road grid map by combining the occupied area of the intelligent traffic cone; screening the intelligent traffic road cone placement grids according to traffic road cone placement standards and construction operation plans; initializing an intelligent traffic cone, and generating an intelligent traffic cone moving path by taking the shortest occupied road moving distance as a strategy. According to the invention, by controlling the directional movement of the intelligent traffic cone, the construction efficiency is improved, and the risk of collision of the manual retraction traffic cone is reduced; the constructor can control the intelligent traffic road cone to enter or leave the lane and temporarily stop through software at the outer side of the emergency lane, so that potential safety hazards caused by manual road cone placement of construction operators are reduced; through the perception and early warning module of intelligent traffic cone, the vehicle distance and the speed of vehicle upstream the perception construction lane in time send audible and visual warning, remind construction operation personnel, reduce the possibility of taking place the incident.

title_en: Artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and an application method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ship safety management and artificial intelligence technology intersection. According to the artificial intelligent auxiliary ship safety management system and the application method thereof, when an AIS device signal is interrupted, a shipborne offline regulation library and a navigation database are called for localized analysis, management blind areas are eliminated, an AIS data packet and a device operation parameter packet are synchronized, and the regulation library is combined for cross analysis, so that single data misjudgment is avoided, risk identification precision is improved, classified instructions are generated and pushed through automatic verification of data compliance, manual dependence is reduced, compliance records are truly and timely ensured, an AI analysis layer updates the database according to instruction feedback, an AI model is optimized regularly to reduce misinformation rate, active early warning is realized, shore bases view data in real time and issue instructions, a crew terminal feedback result is broadcasted in a grading manner, sudden accident handling time is shortened, and emergency response speed is effectively improved.
assignees: WUHU ANHANG E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: System for alarm of fire with selectively assign of information of specific event
title_ko: 시점 정보의 선택적 어사인 기능을 구비한 선별적 알림 화재 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a selective notification fire monitoring system having a selective assign function of time information, which includes: a monitoring unit including a predetermined sensor and monitoring a preset space; a fire analysis unit recognizing a predetermined fire event and selectively selecting a valid event from the predetermined fire event; an information sharing unit providing information on a predetermined fire event for a preset space to an external terminal; and a suppression control unit checking the valid event from the fire analyzing unit and controlling the operation of a fire alarm or fire extinguishing device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시점 정보의 선택적 어사인 기능을 구비한 선별적 알림 화재 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 소정의 센서를 포함하고, 미리 설정된 공간을 모니터링하는 모니터링 유닛; 소정의 화재 이벤트를 인식하며, 소정의 화재 이벤트로부터 유효 이벤트를 선택적으로 선별하는 화재 애널라이징 유닛; 미리 설정된 공간에 대한 소정의 화재 이벤트에 대한 정보를 외부의 단말기에 제공하는 인포메이션 쉐어링 유닛; 및 화재 애널라이징 유닛으로부터 유효 이벤트를 확인하여, 화재경보 또는 소화장치의 동작을 관장하는 진압 콘트롤 유닛을 포함하는 기술적 사상을 개시한다.

title_en: A kind of fire disaster intelligently early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire disaster intelligently early warning system；First detection unit, the second detection unit, the 3rd detection unit are respectively used to detect the concentration value C of the band value P of ultraviolet light in target area, the band value R of infrared light, fuel gas and smog；Alarm unit is according to the instruction alert of control unit；Fire extinguishing unit carries out fire-extinguishing operations according to the instruction of control unit to target area inside；Control unit obtains the concentration value C of the band value P of ultraviolet light in target area, the band value R of infrared light, fuel gas and smog, and it is compared with preset value, is acted further according to comparative result instruction control alarm unit and fire extinguishing unit.Actual parameter in present invention collection target area, reliability is high, and monitoring timeliness is good, takes countermeasure according to actual parameter in target area in time, and the probability caused danger in target area is near minimum, fully ensures that the reliability and validity of the system.
assignees: HEFEI SHIER CULTURE & CREATIVITY CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological prediction method, electronic device, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a weather prediction method, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. According to the embodiment of the application, the good fitting capacity of the weather prediction model can be combined, and the target weather data at the target moment can be accurately calculated according to the initial weather data, so that the accuracy of weather prediction is improved. In addition, because the embodiment of the application can calculate the target weather data at the target moment, and the target moment can be any moment, the embodiment of the application can update the target weather cloud image with higher frequency, so that the electronic equipment can control and display the latest weather cloud image, thereby improving the response speed of weather disaster early warning and alarming.
assignees: NANJING YINGAN INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Attaching type Glass breaker
title_ko: 부착형 유리파괴장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an attachable glass breaker attached to a glass window of a passenger vehicle or commercial vehicle to enable a user to quickly and easily break the window to secure an escapeway when the user cannot normally escape through a vehicle door due to a sudden accident. More specifically, the attachable glass breaker includes: a breaking part (1) having predetermined hardness to break a glass window; an operation part (2) in which the breaking part is provided in a fixed state, unfixing the breaking part due to operation by a user; and a control part (3) coupled with an upper part of the operation part, and projecting the breaking part to the outside by turning the operation part. The attachable glass breaker strikes the control part, thereby breaking glass by using the breaking part projected to the outside of the operation part. Here, the operation part (2) can include: a fixing device (21) fixing the breaking part; and a spring device (22) projecting the breaking part to the outside when the fixing device is unfixed. Also, the control part (3) can include a handle (31) coupled with the fixing device (21) and capable of being manually rotated. Moreover, the control part (3) can include a light emitting device (31) emitting light in case of a fire, a sensor (32) sensing smoke, and an alarm device (33) generating a sound when smoke is sensed by the sensor. The control part can be manufactured of a semitransparent or transparent material. The control part (3) can include a battery (34) supplying power to the light emitting device, the sensor and the alarm device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 승용차 및 상용차에 구비되는 유리창에 부착되어 갑작스러운 사고로 인하여 문을 통해 정상적으로 탈출하기가 어려울 경우 탈출구 확보를 위하여 신속하고 용이하게 유리창을 파쇄시키는 부착형 유리파괴장치에 관한 것이다. 
더욱 자세하게는, 유리창을 파괴할 수 있도록 소정의 경도를 가지는 파괴부(1); 내부에 상기 파괴부가 고정된 상태로 구비되며, 사용자의 작동에 의해 파괴부에 대한 고정을 해제하는 작동부(2); 및 상기 작동부 상단에 결합되며, 작동부를 회전시켜 파괴부를 외부로 돌출시키는 조작부(3);를 포함하고, 상기 조작부를 가격함으로써, 작동부 외부로 돌출된 파괴부를 이용하여 유리를 파괴하는 부착형 유리파괴장치를 제공한다. 
이때, 상기 작동부(2)는, 상기 파괴부를 고정시키는 고정장치(21), 상기 고정장치가 해제될 시 상기 파괴부를 외부로 돌출시키는 스프링장치(22)를 포함할 수 있다. 
또한, 상기 조작부(3)는, 상기 고정장치(21)와 결합되며 수동으로 회전가능한 손잡이(31)를 포함할 수 있다. 
아울러, 상기 조작부(3)는, 내부에 화재 시 빛을 내는 발광장치(31), 연기를 감지하는 센서(32) 및 상기 센서에 의해 연기가 감지될 경우 소리를 발생하는 알림장치(33)를 포함하고, 상기 조작부는 반투명 또는 투명 재질로 제작될 수 있다. 
그리고 상기 조작부(3)는, 상기 발광장치, 센서 및 알림장치에 전원을 공급하는 배터리(34)를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Method and apparatus for broadcasting alert service message in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선통신시스템에서 경보 서비스 메시지 방송 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a method for broadcasting a commercial mobile alert service (CMAS) message by a base station in a wireless communication system. The CMAS message broadcasting method comprises the steps of: configuring, when a CMAS emergency occurs, a System Information Block 8 (SIB8) containing CMAS messages; determining a System Frame Number (SFN) corresponding to a default paging cycle value closest to the current SFN in the current system information change cycle as a broadcasting time of the CMAS messages; generating a short message announcing the broadcasting of SIB8; broadcasting system information including the SIB8 at the broadcasting time of the CMAS messages; and transmitting a short message at the broadcasting time of the CMAS messages. According to the present invention, in a wireless communication system, CMAS messages can be transmitted to all terminals within a CMAS broadcasting region as quickly and accurately as possible.
abstract_ko: 무선통신시스템의 기지국에서 상용 모바일 경보 서비스(Commercial Mobile Alert Service, CMAS) 메시지를 방송하는 방법이 제공된다. CMAS 메시지 방송 방법은 CMAS 비상 상황 발생 시, CMAS 메시지를 포함한 SIB8(System Information Block 8)을 구성하는 단계, 현재 시스템 정보 변경 주기에서 현재 SFN(System Frame Number)과 가장 가까운 디폴트 페이징 사이클 값에 해당하는 SFN을 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점으로 결정하는 단계, 상기 SIB8의 방송을 알리는 단문메시지를 생성하는 단계, 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점에서 상기 SIB8을 포함하는 시스템 정보를 방송하는 단계, 그리고 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점에서 상기 단문메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Stretchable warning belt device for escalator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stretchable warning belt device for an escalator. The stretchable warning belt device is installed on an outer cover plate of a rotary cock of the escalator. The stretchable warning belt device comprises a shell and a stretchable device. The lower portion of the shell is fixedly connected with a steel plate. The steel plate is fixed to the outer cover plate. The stretchable device is arranged in the shell. A warning belt which can elastically stretch and retract in the stretchable device is arranged on the stretchable device. According to the stretchable warning belt device for the escalator, when the escalator breaks down, security personnel can rapidly spread the warning belt to remind people that the escalator cannot be used before escalator maintainers arrive, and thus potential safety hazards are effectively prevented; in addition, the stretchable warning belt device is made of stainless steel materials, thereby being not prone to deformation or rusting, simple in structure, not prone to damage, convenient to use and easy to operate.

title_en: A kind of intelligence SVG dynamic passive compensation systems
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligence SVG dynamic passive compensation systems, including SVG dynamic passive compensations module, multiple power supplies module, main control module, electrical parameter are according to acquisition module, comprehensive management and control module, memory module, environmental parameter acquisition module, emergency alert module, communication module, switch motion module and remote control terminal；The present invention is used to carry out reactive-load compensation to power grid, the ability of accurate compensation and transient response can be reached, speed, the present invention can also improve the scope and validity for power system monitor at the same time, the intelligence, automation and generalization of whole system are substantially increased, there is higher practical value and be widely applied prospect.
assignees: MAANSHAN JIAFUNI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent pedestrian protection method and system based on data processing and road traffic
abstract_en: An intelligent pedestrian protection method and system based on data processing and road traffic comprises the following steps: the monitoring camera is controlled to start to capture monitoring images in real time, the warning lamp set is bound with the traffic signal lamp corresponding to the pedestrian crossing, the light change of the warning lamp set is controlled to correspond to the bound traffic signal lamp, the light information of the traffic signal lamp is analyzed in real time, if the warning lamp set is a traffic light, the pedestrian lifting and descending barrier is controlled to lift a first distance, the motor vehicle lifting and descending barrier is controlled to completely retract, if the warning lamp set is a traffic light, the motor vehicle lifting and descending barrier is controlled to completely lift, the pedestrian lifting and descending barrier is controlled to completely retract, when the traffic signal lamp is a traffic light, pedestrian crossing area information is recognized in real time, whether pedestrians are located in the pedestrian crossing area is analyzed in real time, if yes, the warning light set is controlled to enter a warning state, the speed reduction lifting mechanism is controlled to drive the non-Newtonian fluid to slowly rise and fill the ground protection band, and after the pedestrians are recognized to leave, the speed reduction lifting mechanism is controlled to drive the non-Newtonian fluid to slowly shrink.
assignees: SUZHOU CHUANGCUN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on big data and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on big data and image recognition, which belongs to the technical field of computers, and is characterized in that big data analysis is carried out through historical disaster images filed by the existing professionals, so that an image change key dimension trend of disaster occurrence and an image database of critical disaster occurrence are obtained; the method and the system have the advantages that various preconditions of disaster occurrence under various scenes are obtained based on big data analysis, the data are more accurate, a disaster critical big database is created, the site conditions and the threshold value of the disaster can be calculated in a closed loop mode, the data comparison is automatic, the efficiency is higher, the accuracy is higher, the threshold value can be automatically updated in a closed loop mode, and various disasters can be tracked and simulated. Under certain condition judgment, the disaster occurrence can be early-warned and forecasted in real time.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIXIANG BEIDOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pedestrian portrait method and system oriented to traffic management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian portrait method, a system, computer equipment and a medium oriented to traffic management, which relate to the technical field of pedestrian traffic behavior portraits, wherein the method comprises the following steps: automatically reading data of each platform of a traffic management department through a developed server-side program, or manually updating and reading pedestrian attribute basic data, traffic traveling behavior basic data and traffic bad behavior basic data of external data periodically; storing the data to a portrait system server database; mining the data through a data fusion and statistics method to form a pedestrian portrait; and according to the pedestrian portrait, the traffic management department carries out pedestrian management work and updates the pedestrian portrait according to the management result. According to the scheme, the evaluation and early warning of the traffic behaviors and the bad behaviors of the pedestrians can be realized aiming at the pedestrian portrait, the behaviors of each pedestrian can be mastered in a refined mode, the source is used for active prevention and control, hidden danger is eliminated, and traffic accidents are reduced.
assignees: YANCHENG INST TECH;YANCHENG UNIV SCIENCE PARK CO LTD

title_en: Entry blocking system to hazardous area
title_ko: 위험 지역으로의 진입 차단 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for blocking entry to a hazardous area and, more particularly, to a system for blocking entry to a hazardous area, which increases an entry blocking effect by blocking an entry path as well as a visually warning, for vehicles entering a hazardous area such as a tunnel or an underpass in which an accident or a fire have occurred. The system comprises: a front blocking device installed on the side of a road connected to a hazardous area, and performing an entry blocking operation and an entry blocking release (entry permitting) operation for the road by using a blocking unit crossing the road; an information acquisition device detecting a moving body approaching the front blocking device, and capturing an image thereof; and a management device wirelessly communicating with at least one of the front blocking device and the information acquisition device, and managing and monitoring the hazardous area.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 진입 차단 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 특히 사고나 화재가 발생된 터널이나 지하차도 등의 위험 지역으로 진입하는 차량들에 대해서, 시청적인 경고뿐만 아니라, 진입 경로를 차단함으로써 진입 차단 효과를 증대시키는 위험 지역으로의 진입 차단 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 위험 지역으로의 진입 차단 시스템은 위험 지역으로 연결된 도로 측면에 설치되며 도로를 가로지르는 차단부를 이용하여 도로에 대한 진입 차단 동작 및 진입 차단 해제(진입 허용) 동작을 수행하는 전방 차단 장치와, 전방 차단 장치로 접근하는 이동체의 접근 감지 및 영상 촬영을 수행하는 정보 획득 장치와, 전방 차단 장치 및 정보 획득 장치 중의 적어도 하나 이상과 무선 통신을 수행하며 위험 지역에 대한 관리 및 모니터링을 수행하는 관리 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted type greenbelt three-side trimmer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted type greenbelt three-side trimmer, comprising an automobile and a trimmer fixedly arranged on the automobile, wherein the trimmer comprises an adjusting bracket, shears and a transmission device; the shears and the transmission device are installed on the adjusting bracket; the adjusting bracket is driven through the transmission device to spread, withdraw and adjust the trimming height and the trimming width of the shears; and the shears are a rotational structure which consists of at least three cutters combined in the transverse direction and in the vertical direction. The vehicle-mounted type greenbelt three-side trimmer has the advantages that the mechanical three-side simultaneous trimming is realized for a green belt in the center of a road; the trimming for plant at different heights and distances can be satisfied as well; in such a way, the trimming quality is improved, the labor force is saved and the working efficiency is improved; in addition, the vehicle-mounted type trimmer drives in the same direction with other driving vehicles, and further is provided with a striking warning board; and therefore, the potential safety hazard is eliminated for green workers and the operation safety is guaranteed.
assignees: JIANGSU ANDERSON SUPERCONDUCTING ACCELERATOR TECHNOLOGY INC;NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHANGAN;JIANGSU DEZUO ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligently send management system and method in a kind of miniature fire station
abstract_en: Management system is intelligently sent the invention discloses a kind of miniature fire station, including receive a crime report information distribution platform, group's early warning processing platform, neighbourhood committee of detachment sends platform and miniature fire station website；Its method is：Alert information is accessed, and alert information is distributed to group's early warning processing platform；According to the alert information of reception, the neighbourhood committee in the pre-set radius of search alert position sends platform and miniature fire station website, and distributes alert information；Send local miniature fire station security personnel and rush for alert center；Information is sent to set out fire fighter and equipment and feed back.The present invention can visualize completion to operations such as the precise positioning of alert, Response project, command scheduling and equipment information records, and real-time communication, command deployment, scene feedback and water source feedback can be carried out with front fireman, ensure promptness, the validity of information, greatly improve the efficiency of control alert dangerous situation.
assignees: SICHUAN FANGSHENG RUIJIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Corpse vehicle analysis and early warning method and device based on big data
abstract_en: The corpse vehicle analysis and early warning method and device based on big data that the present invention provides a kind of, the following steps are included: obtaining the structural data that each bayonet captures vehicle in real time, establish vehicle archives, the time is captured comprising each vehicle identification feature for capturing vehicle, last time in the vehicle archives and captures bayonet, when vehicle is captured again, its archives of real-time update；Timed periodic traverses vehicle archives, judges that the last time of each vehicle captures the time whether before N days, if so, being determined as corpse vehicle, generates warning information according to its archives, and corpse vehicle information is deleted from vehicle archives；Warning information and persistent storage are received, shows corresponding warning information for user query and to user.The present invention can make the regulation of corpse vehicle change from passive to active, and automatic early-warning, relevant departments law enfrocement official can exclude related hidden danger in time.
assignees: WUHAN FIBERHOME DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Warning device and warning method for converter station electronic fence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning device and a warning method of a converter station electronic fence, and the warning device comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with two support rods, one opposite side of the two support rods is fixedly connected with a warning plate, the tops of the two support rods are fixedly connected with a top plate, the top of the top plate is provided with a warning mechanism, the top of the top plate is provided with a power supply assembly, the warning mechanism comprises a first fixed bin fixedly connected with the top of the top plate, and a first sliding rod is fixedly connected inside the first fixed bin. This warning device of converter station fence and warning method thereof is through setting up warning mechanism to can warn daytime passerby through the warning board, can warn night passerby through the warning light, through first motor, can withdraw the warning light when daytime, thereby protected the warning light, through setting up the wheel, thereby removal warning device that can be better. Suitable for use in a converter station.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DC COMPANY

title_en: Fire-fighting linkage alarm bell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and particularly discloses a fire-fighting linkage alarm bell, which comprises a shell, wherein a control main board, an alarm horn, a flash warning lamp, a fire button, an emergency button and a power battery are arranged in the shell, the alarm horn, the flash warning lamp, the fire button, the emergency button and the power battery are all connected with the control main board, the control main board comprises a power management module, a CPU (central processing unit) module, a wireless transceiver module, a storage module and a 4G (fourth generation) module, the wireless transceiver module is used for sending stored information data to the periphery and receiving information sent by similar products around, the CPU module is connected with a cloud server through the 4G module, the cloud server is used for being connected with a mobile phone end, and the mobile phone end is used for setting fire alarm position information. The invention has reasonable design, solves the problem that people around the fire disaster can not be notified to withdraw to the safety zone immediately at present when the fire disaster occurs, and effectively ensures the life safety of people.
assignees: DONGGUAN LE PU ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic guide system and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 무인 경비 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A manless security system and a control method thereof are provided to improve the efficiency of management for the request of a guard and release support service. CONSTITUTION: When the input of a set specific button combination is detected by a reader(10), a main controller(20) generates a password. The main controller transmits the password to a control device(60) through a communication network(30). The control device stores the received password in a memory area. The control device displays the password on a screen of the reader through a control screen and the main controller. If the password is normally inputted through the reader, the main controller executes the control of guard or release. [Reference numerals] (1) Sensor; (10) Reader; (20) Main controller; (32) Personal line network; (33) Internet network; (50) Multiplexer; (AA) PSTN decoder; (BB) Personal line decoder
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경계 혹은 해제가 임의로(Random)로 생성되는 1회용 비밀번호의 입력으로 실행될 수 있도록 하는 무인 경비 시스템 및 그 제어방법이 개시된다. 
본 발명은 가입자장치로부터 수신되는 정보를 모니터링하여 침입자 발생에 따른 경보 출력, 경계 및 해제의 모니터링을 실행하여 감시영역내의 인명과 재산을 보호하는 서비스를 제공하는 관제장치, 지정된 영역을 감시하는 감지기, 고객 카드의 정보를 판독하는 리더기, 관제장치와 연동하여 리더기의 정보에 따라 경계 혹은 해제를 실행하는 주제어기를 포함하는 무인 경비 시스템에 있어서, 리더기로부터 설정된 특정 버튼 조합의 입력이 검출되면 비밀번호를 생성하여 관제장치에 전송하고, 관제장치는 생성된 비밀번호를 메모리에 저장한 다음 자체 관제화면과 주제어기를 통해 리더기의 화면에 생성된 비밀번호를 표시하며, 주제어기는 리더기를 통해 비밀번호가 정상 입력되면 경계 혹은 해제 제어를 실행하는 것을 특징으로 하는 무인 경비 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Vehicle control method, device, vehicle, electronic device and storage medium
title_ko: 차량 제어 방법, 장치, 차량, 전자기기 및 저장매체
abstract_en: In an embodiment of the present application, disclosed are a vehicle control method, a device, a vehicle, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The embodiment of the present invention relates to autonomous driving technology. The method includes: a step of outputting a notification message, wherein the notification message is for notifying a surrounding vehicle of the intention to change a lane of a host vehicle, and the surrounding vehicle is a vehicle having a potential influence on the lane change of the host vehicle; a step of determining first driving state prediction information of the surrounding vehicle, wherein the first driving state prediction information is related to feedback on the notification message; a step of generating and performing a first driving strategy based on the first driving state prediction information, wherein the first driving strategy includes lane-change driving or driving within the current lane; and a step of determining the first driving state prediction information based on feedback on the notification message, determining whether the surrounding vehicle supports the lane change of the host vehicle, and generating and performing the first driving strategy accordingly. The method can prevent lane change failure and/or accident defects caused by a change in driving strategy of the surrounding vehicle in the related art and implements the technical effect of improving lane-change safety and reliability.
abstract_ko: 본 출원의 실시예는 차량 제어 방법, 장치, 차량, 전자기기 및 저장매체를 개시하며, 자율 주행 기술에 관한 것이다. 해당 방법은, 알림 메시지를 출력하되, 알림 메시지는 주변 차량으로 본 차량의 차선 변경 의도를 알리기 위한 것이고, 주변 차량은 본 차량의 차선 변경에 대해 잠재적 영향이 존재하는 차량인 단계, 주변 차량의 제1 운전 상태 예측 정보를 결정하되, 제1 운전 상태 예측 정보는 알림 메시지의 피드백과 관련되는 단계, 제1 운전 상태 예측 정보를 기초로 제1 운전 전략을 생성 및 수행하되, 제1 운전 전략은 차선 변경 운전 또는 현재 차선 내에서 운전을 포함하는 단계, 알림 메시지의 피드백을 기초로 제1 운전 상태 예측 정보를 결정하여, 주변 차량이 본 차량의 차선 변경을 지원하는지 여부를 파악하고, 이에 따라 제1 운전 전략을 생성 및 수행하는 단계를 포함하여, 관련기술에서 주변 차량의 운전 전략 변경에 의해 초래되는 차선 변경 실패 및/또는 안전사고 결함을 방지할 수 있으며, 차선 변경 안전성과 신뢰성을 향상시키는 기술효과를 구현한다.
assignees: BEIJING BAIDU NETCOM SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of scraper automatic fire protection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of scraper automatic fire protection system, scrapers（11）It is interior to be equipped with controller（1）, manual start switch（10）, alarm（5）, stand-by power supply（2）, foaming agent automatic fire extinguisher（3）, the first dry powder extinguishing installation（4）, temperature-sensitive cable（7）, fuel gas smokescope detector（8）, the second dry powder extinguishing installation（9）, fuel gas smokescope detector（8）By combustible gas probe（8‑1）And smoke detector（8‑2）Composition, controller（1）It is separately connected the vehicle power supply of scraper（11‑5）, stand-by power supply（2）, the first dry powder extinguishing installation（4）, the second dry powder extinguishing installation（9）, alarm（5）, temperature-sensitive cable（7）, combustible gas probe（8‑1）, smokescope and hygrosensor（8‑2）, manual start switch（10）, omnibearing stereo of the present invention protection ensures the validity of fire extinguishing, gives warning in advance, can put out equipment fire on a large scale, burning things which may cause a fire disaster is put out from source.
