title_en: Wellness and human care robot
title_ko: 웰니스 겸용 휴먼 케어 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wellness-human care robot is provided to supply convenience to patients, elders living along, and children by using a moving object sensing function and a voice recognizing function. CONSTITUTION: A robot control operating unit(70) withdraws information inputted by various input units(51-54) from a memory(55) by using a program stored in a CPU(Central Processing Unit)(50) in order to move a robot body according to a command. A content storage unit(80) stores content for patients and children. An interface unit interfaces a voice recognition conversation for an emergency call and a health check unit(71) for health check with each other. [Reference numerals] (40) Power supply unit; (50) Central processing unit; (51) Camera input unit; (52) Voice recognition input unit; (53) Touch screen input unit; (54) Remote control input unit; (55) Memory storage unit ROM, RAM, FLASH; (60) Display; (71) Health check unit(urine, blood sugar, blood pressure, temperature, weight, moving object detection); (72) DATA transmission unit(Blue tooth, WLAN, WIFI); (73) Communication protocol(TCP/IP, HL7); (74) Program(Firmware, Middle ware, App, Web); (75) Interface SD, smart phone, remote control; (80) Content storage; (AA) Wellness-human care robot block diagram; (BB) Robot control operating unit; (CC) Voice recognition conversation, emergency call;
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 웰니스 겸용 휴먼케어 로봇에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 음성인식과 동체감지기능이 겸비된 로봇으로 이동이 자유롭고 소변검사, 혈당측정, 혈압측정, 체온측정, 체중측정의 건강상태를 측정하여 건강관리기능이 내장된 독거노인을 위한 실버 관리가 가능하고, 또 한편으로는 어린이나 유아들의 지능개발과 일반인들을 대상으로 하는 보안감시 기능을 겸비한 웰니스 겸용 휴먼케어 로봇에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 웰니스 겸용 휴먼케어 로봇은 마이크입력을 통한 음성인식부; 카메라입력부; 터치스크린입력부; 리모콘입력부; 로봇제어구동부; 로봇에 전원을 공급해주는 전원부; 설정과 결과, 전자액자, 동영상, 화상 대화를 표시하는 디스플레이부; 데이터를 저장하는 외부메모리와 내장메모리를 관리하는 메모리저장부; 동요나 영상자료, e-Book자료, MP3 음악자료를 저장하고 보관하는 콘텐츠 저장부; 음성인식 대화, 건강체크, DATA전송, 통신프로토콜, 펌웨어, 미들웨어, 스마트폰어플리케이션, 웹어플리케이션 프로그램과 스마트폰, SD카드, USB포트, Bluetooth, 리모콘의 인터페이스를 담당하는 인터페이스부; 웰니스 겸용 휴먼케어 로봇의 모든 제어를 담당하는 중앙처리장치로 구성되어 사용자의 명령에 따라서 제어를 한다. 
본 발명의 로봇의 기능은 고령자를 위한 기상시간알림, 식사시간알림, 복약시간알림, 운동시간알림, 로봇과대화, 음악청취, 전자액자, 동영상실행, 취침, 거동이 불편한 환자관리, 독거노인 관리의 편의제공의 효과가 있으며, 아울러 독거노인이나 요양원, 실버타운에 거주하는 고령자나 환자의 경우에는 자동주행하는 웰니스 겸용 휴먼케어 로봇이 설정된 프로그램에 따라서 로봇이 명령어를 지시하고 감시하며 예를 들면 4시간 동안 활동이 없거나 움직임이 없으면 로봇에 등록된 간호사, 요양보호사, 방문간호사, 등록된 자녀에게 알람을 발생하여 문자전송(SMS)를 하고 1시간을 기다려도 응답에 대한 회신이 없을 경우에는 119 관제 센터나 주민자치센터로 경고 알람을 보내어 환자관리나 독거노인을 관리하는데 효과가 있다. 
또한, 맞벌이 부부의 집에 혼자 남은 아이들에 대한 걱정을 들어주는 친구와 아이들의 행동을 감지하여 안전을 지켜주며, 엄마와 아빠가 스마트폰으로 보내주는 동영상과 콘텐츠를 자동으로 다운로드 하여 저장하고 실행되게 하는 기능을 가지고 로봇이 아이들의 친구가 되고 아이들을 관리하는 효과가 있다. 
추가 적으로 로봇의 몸통 후면의 문을 열면 내부에 장착된 혈압측정, 체온측정, 체중 측정을 할 수 있는 기능과 로봇의 정면으로 봤을 때 우측면의 중간 부분에 장착된 소변분석기와 혈당측정기는 건강기능검사를 하여 향후 원격의료서비스와 웰니스 서비스, 유실버를 위한 유용한 도구로 제공된다.

title_en: Emergency alert system to secure golden hours and method for emergency alert system thereof
title_ko: 골든아워 확보를 위한 긴급출동 알림시스템 및 이를 이용한 긴급출동 알림시스템 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for automatically changing an outgoing call number for securing a golden hour in emergency dispatch. More specifically, provided is the system for automatically changing an outgoing call number, which automatically changes a mobile phone number of a caller such as a fire officer or the like to an emergency disaster number (such as 119, etc.) to notify an emergency situation to a receiver in order to prevent an accidental golden hour from missing due to illegal parking and stopping in case of emergency dispatch for fire or rescue. In order to achieve the goal of the present invention, the system for automatically changing an outgoing call number for an emergency situation comprises: a mobile phone for public service (200), which is installed through authentication of a public servant and is converted into a security mode; and a mobile communication system (300) identifying the public servant connected in the security mode to provide a two-number service.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 긴급출동 시 골든아워 확보를 위한 발신번호 자동 변경시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 화재나 인명 구조를 위한 긴급출동 시 불법 주정차에 의해 사고 골든아워를 놓치는 경우를 예방하기 위해 소방공무원 등 발신자의 휴대전화 번호를 긴급재난번호(‘119’등)로 자동 변경하여 수신자에게 긴급 상황임을 알릴 수 있는 발신번호 자동 변경시스템에 관한 내용이다.   
상기 과제를 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 긴급 상황을 위한 발신번호 변경시스템은, 공무수행자 인증을 통해 설치되어 보안모드로 전환되는 공무수행용휴대폰(200); 및 상기 보안모드에서 접속된 공무수행자를 식별하여 번호변경(Two-number) 서비스를 제공하는 이동통신시스템(300);을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Portable door alarms
title_ko: 휴대용 도어 방범장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable door crime prevention device in which a latch bolt (1b) of a locking module (1a) installed on a hinged door (1) is engaged with a latch hole (2b) of a striker (2a) mounted on a door frame (2) to be locked/unlocked. The portable door crime prevention device is simply installed in a gap space between the door and the door frame to improve a structure to output a notification signal when a door opening force is detected from an intruder, thereby quickly detecting external intrusion and outputting a warning message to prevent an accident. Tthe portable door crime prevention device comprises a lock plate (10), a lock hole (20), a locking piece (30), a holder (40), a lock stopper (50), and an intrusion detection module (60).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 여닫이 도어(1)에 설치되는 잠금모듈(1a)의 레치볼트(1b)가 문틀(2)에 장착된 스트라이커(2a)의 레치홀(2b)에 맞물려 잠금/해제 작동되도록 구성되는 휴대용 도어 방범장치에 관련되며, 이때 휴대용 도어 방범장치는 도어와 문틀 사이 틈새공간에 간단하게 설치되어 침입자로부터 도어 개방력이 감지되면 알림 신호가 출력되도록 구조 개선되어, 외부 침입을 신속하게 감지하고, 경고메시지를 출력하여 안전사고를 예방할 수 있도록 락플레이트(10), 락홀(20), 걸림편(30), 홀더(40), 락스토퍼(50), 침입감지모듈(60)을 포함하여 주요 구성으로 한다.

title_en: Hoisting equipment danger early warning system, hoisting equipment and danger area early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hoisting equipment danger early warning system, hoisting equipment and a danger area early warning method. Wherein early warning system includes wearing equipment, davit length measurement module and first signal transceiver module, davit length measurement system set up on hoisting equipment's davit and with first signal transceiver module electric connection, first signal transceiver module sets up in hoisting equipment's bottom, first signal transceiver module and wearing equipment communication and detect the horizontal distance of wearing equipment apart from hoisting equipment to according to horizontal distance and davit length ratio control wearing equipment on the projection length on ground and send different warning information. According to above-mentioned technical scheme's early warning system, when the constructor who dresses wearing equipment gets into hoisting equipment's danger area, can send the warning to constructor, improve constructor attention and warn constructor withdraw danger area, reduce because the risk that the thing caused the constructor casualties.

title_en: Intelligent anti-cancellation composite device for electrical cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and discloses an intelligent electrical cabinet anti-extinction composite device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a magnet, and the upper end of the bottom plate is provided with a positioning hole. This intelligent regulator cubicle prevents eliminating composite set, when ambient temperature is higher than 170 ℃, heat-sensitive induction line release fire extinguishing substance, when fire extinguishing substance contacted open flame or fire-retardant face, release fire extinguishing gas and fire extinguishing agent after the decomposition, take place many times chain reaction and air formation gaseous mixture, consume the exothermic reaction between active group and the inhibitory group, thereby play the inhibitory effect to the combustion reaction, can put out the condition of a fire in the enclosure space fast, temperature sensor gathers ambient temperature and inputs into the treater, but the user uses cell-phone wireless connection wireless module real time monitoring ambient temperature, the treater has preset warning temperature, when ambient temperature is greater than warning temperature, the treater starts the siren and sends out alarm sound, the warning effect is good.
assignees: SHAANXI WENDING TECH TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Analysis processing method and system for water level signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level signal analysis processing method and system, and relates to the technical field of water level signal analysis processing. The method comprises the steps of placing a plurality of water level meters, collecting water level signals of the water level meters, carrying out primary processing on the collected water level signals, verifying the validity of sampling points and the validity of measured values of the water level signals, carrying out secondary processing on the water level signals, and carrying out automatic early warning according to the secondary processing results. The invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of water level prediction, is beneficial to flood control and reservoir management, can discover and process abnormal water level conditions in time, and reduces disaster risks.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG FUJIANG HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological-assisted mountain fire high-efficiency early warning and scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain fire early warning, in particular to a weather-assisted mountain fire high-efficiency early warning and scheduling system. According to the invention, through the application of real-time monitoring and data analysis, the reaction speed and accuracy of mountain fire early warning are greatly improved, the real-time measurement and analysis of meteorological variables enable the fire early warning to be independent of a traditional probability model, the early warning threshold value can be dynamically adjusted based on real-time data, the early warning is more timely and has strong pertinence, the problem of data update delay is solved, accurate risk assessment is provided, the fire alarm is issued immediately, the real-time optimization of a rescue path is ensured, the quick response of rescue resources through the shortest path is ensured, the success rate and efficiency of rescue actions are directly influenced, and the fire prediction model utilizes continuous data training, so that the adaptability and prediction capability to fire change are further enhanced.

title_en: A kind of transmission line forest fire monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of transmission line forest fire monitoring method and system, comprise the following steps：1) basic database, storage and real-time update fire point latitude and longitude coordinates (data according to Meteorologic Satellite Receiving and measurement are obtained), transmission line of electricity latitude and longitude coordinates and distance threshold are set up on the server；2) the distance between they are calculated according to fire point latitude and longitude coordinates and transmission line of electricity latitude and longitude coordinates, if the distance is less than distance threshold, produces warning message；3) by alarm information pushing to mobile terminal；4) after mobile terminal receives warning message, staff is reminded to check.The present invention can make transmission line of electricity operation maintenance personnel quickly obtain transmission line of electricity to cover mountain fire condition and respond.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO DISASTER PREVENTION & REDUCTION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-dimensional monitoring and early warning method and device for geological disaster risk of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides a multidimensional monitoring and early warning method and device for geological disaster risk of an oil and gas pipeline, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a target disaster risk based on a knowledge graph of the geological disaster risk of the oil and gas pipeline; acquiring a first multi-dimensional feature of a preset reference image, acquiring a second multi-dimensional feature of each frame of monitoring image, and inputting the first multi-dimensional feature and the second multi-dimensional feature into a preset association relation identification model to acquire a corresponding relation matrix between the monitoring image and the reference image; based on the corresponding relation matrix, acquiring the pose of a target object in each frame of monitoring image, and fusing the pose with the coding data corresponding to the monitoring image in the initial coding video stream to obtain a target coding video stream; and playing the target coded video stream through a preset video playing device so as to display the target disaster risk existing in each frame of monitoring image. This scheme is through the validity that can guarantee disaster risk monitoring, accuracy, timeliness.

title_en: Earthquake early warning analysis system based on intelligent monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake early warning analysis system based on intelligent monitoring equipment, relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring and early warning, and is used for solving the problems of low earthquake focus positioning precision and poor early warning timeliness of a traditional early warning system; the method realizes rapid identification and accurate early warning of the seismic event by constructing a multisource data fusion and intelligent analysis mechanism, the system collects triaxial acceleration data of intelligent monitoring equipment nodes distributed at different geographic positions, generates a standardized acceleration time sequence, calculates a wave field coherence coefficient, constructs a seismic event validity map, positions the primary position of the seismic source and a key propagation path, combines signal-to-noise ratio dynamic weight, geologic structure characteristics and propagation direction angles to generate an early warning decision matrix in a minimum error range, avoids early warning delay caused by global rearrangement, and the system links wave field real-time deduction and risk dynamic evaluation to form a closed-loop early warning release process, so that the stability, self-adaption capability and response efficiency of early warning are improved under a complex geological environment.

title_en: Indoor air quality managing system using of private security service
title_ko: 기계 경비서비스를 이용한 실내 공기질 관리시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for managing the quality of indoor air using a mechanical security service are provided to improve satisfaction about a security service. CONSTITUTION: A subscriber main device(2a-2n) generates an alarm when the indoor air exceeds a preset value by comparing the indoor air with a reference value. A control center server(40) receives the indoor air quality information of a subscriber and a security situation signal from a subscriber main device, calls the corresponding subscriber, transmits an SMS, or generates a dispatch signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기계 경비서비스를 이용한 실내 공기질 관리시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 경계 모드시에 추가적으로 가스 누출이나 온도를 감지하여 이상상황 감지시 경보를 발생시켜 가입자가 스스로 확인할 수 있게 하며, 외출시에는 가입자의 핸드폰으로 정보를 전송하여 이를 확인할 수 있게 하고, 경계 해제모드시에는 실내의 공기질을 관리하고 각종 오염기체를 감지하여 실내 공기의 오염발생시 그 기체의 종류와 오염발생 정보를 출력시키고 이를 경보하여 가입자가 대처할 수 있게 함으로써 서비스 만족도를 향상시키는 기계 경비서비스를 이용한 실내 공기질 관리시스템 및 그 방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.  
     본 발명을 적용하면, 경비모드시 경계 감지는 물론이고, 경비 해제모드시에도 가스와 온도, 실내 공기질을 감시하여 실내 공기의 오염을 경보하여 가입자의 환기 및 가스 누출에 대한 처리, 화재에 대한 처리를 수행할 수 있게 함으로써 사설 경비서비스의 질을 향상시키고 경비 서비스에 대한 만족도를 높일 수 있다는 장점이 있다. 
       
     기계 경비, 사설 경비업체, 실내 공기질, 가스 누출, 유기화합물.

title_en: Notification information outputting device using message input means located in a remote place
title_ko: 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용한 알림정보 출력장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for outputting notification information using a message input means located in a remote place and, more particularly, to an apparatus for outputting notification information, which is capable of changing messages outputted from the apparatus collectively or separately using a message input means located in a remote place. An apparatus for outputting notification information using a message input means located in a remote place according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a wireless communication unit which wirelessly receives a message including device identification information from the message input means, but receives the message when the device identification information is identical to a predetermined identification information; a memory unit which stores the received message; an output unit which outputs, to the outside, the message stored in the memory unit as notification information including video and audio; and a control unit which controls the wireless communication unit, the memory unit, and the output unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용한 알림정보 출력장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용하여 알림정보 출력장치에서 출력되는 메시지를 일괄적으로 또는 개별적으로 변경할 수 있는 알림정보 출력장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 알림정보 출력장치는, 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용한 알림정보 출력장치로서, 상기 메시지 입력수단으로부터 장치 식별정보가 포함된 메시지를 무선으로 수신하되, 상기 장치 식별정보가 기설정된 식별정보와 동일할 경우 메시지를 수신하는 무선통신부; 수신된 상기 메시지를 저장하는 메모리부; 상기 메모리부에 저장된 메시지를 영상 및 음성을 포함하는 알림정보로서 외부에 출력하는 출력부; 및 상기 무선통신부, 상기 메모리부 및 상기 출력부를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Sewage early warning and treatment analysis system based on Internet of things and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sewage early warning and treatment analysis systems, and particularly relates to a sewage early warning and treatment analysis system based on the Internet of things and deep learning; the invention is that the sewage data collector collects the sewage data parameter of the sewage treatment process, the sewage monitoring module monitors the sewage treatment node in real time, the sewage data parameter is automatically uploaded to the sewage data processing and analyzing platform, and whether the sewage treatment meets the sewage treatment standard is analyzed; the sewage alarm module reminds managers of abnormal data parameters after sewage treatment at multiple positions of a sewage treatment point in multiple modes, and triggers the sewage treatment module to treat sewage; the data of the collection points in the sewage treatment process are stored in a sewage distributed database in a storage and updating mode; the sewage treatment method has various sewage treatment using methods, can arrange treatment according to sewage, can provide detailed data feedback for the sewage internal treatment technology, and can save and update at each detection point by using a distributed database.

title_en: Urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on expected fault set
abstract_en: The application provides an urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on an expected fault set, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining meteorological data with real-time monitoring data and operation data of a power grid to judge the type of disaster where the power grid is currently located; the method comprises the steps of receiving a target prediction model corresponding to a current disaster type, calling the target prediction model corresponding to the current disaster type to predict whether the power grid can fail, predicting the failure type after judging that the power grid can fail, optimizing super parameters of the target prediction model through a parameter adjusting tool, carrying out global risk assessment and disaster early warning on the power grid through an expected failure set, dynamically updating the model through an online learning algorithm and a model parameter self-adaptive adjustment algorithm based on real-time data flow, and carrying out failure prediction and risk assessment again based on the dynamically updated model. According to the method, prediction uncertainty is reduced through staged model prediction, and accurate fault prediction can be realized under various disaster scenes by combining dynamic updating of a prediction model and an expected fault set.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Typhoon-prevention flat-top greenhouse
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a typhoon-preventing flat-top greenhouse which comprises a main framework, a flat-top structure and insect-preventing nets arranged on the top and the periphery, and is characterized in that the greenhouse is provided with an insect-preventing net retraction mechanism, the insect-preventing net retraction mechanism is used for retracting the insect-preventing net when typhoon warning signals are received so as to enable the greenhouse framework to be completely exposed, thereby reducing wind load, and a liftable windproof baffle is arranged in the greenhouse and is lifted after the insect-preventing net is retracted, so that a protective enclosure is formed around crops. Meanwhile, the internal windproof baffle is lifted to form a local enclosure, so that wind power entering the greenhouse is effectively attenuated, crops are directly protected from strong wind impact, double cooperative protection from the structure to the content is realized, and the integral typhoon resistance of the greenhouse system is remarkably improved.
assignees: SANYA NANFAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HAINAN UNIV

title_en: Parking managemnet system for enhancing safety of immersion
title_ko: 침수 안전성을 높인 주차장 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a parking lot management system. According to the present invention, each parking lot is operated in a normal, forecast, or emergency mode as an operating mode in accordance with inundation prediction information. At the same time, the operating process of a parking facility is optimally set and operated in accordance with the operating mode. In the forecast or emergency mode, an emergency alert text is transmitted to a parked vehicle driver's portable terminal. As a result, inundation-attributable vehicle damage can be effectively forestalled and parking lot management can be improved in terms of efficiency and convenience. When the forecast or emergency mode is determined by an integrated management server, phone number information in parking status information on the parking lot is searched for and text transmission is performed. In the presence of a parked vehicle with no written phone number, a missing vehicle detection unit and a missing vehicle phone number search unit are executed to separately detect the number of the phone number-less parked vehicle. Accordingly, the rate of parked vehicle text transmission can be considerably raised and service accuracy and reliability can be further improved. The integrated management server generates, updates, and stores a separate use history DB by parking lot. In the event of missing vehicle detection, the server primarily searches the use history DB regarding the corresponding parking lot to detect a missing vehicle phone number. In the event of primary detection failure, the server searches the use history DB regarding every parking lot to detect a missing vehicle phone number. Accordingly, unnecessary computational processing consumption attributable to DB search can be reduced and missing vehicle number detection can be performed with speed and accuracy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 침수예측정보에 따라 각 주차장의 운영모드를 평시모드, 예보모드 및 비상모드로 운영함과 동시에 운영모드에 따라 주차설비의 동작 프로세스를 최적으로 설정하여 운영하되, 예보모드 또는 비상모드 시 주차차량 운전자의 휴대단말기로 비상경보 문자를 전송하도록 구성됨으로써 침수로 인한 차량의 피해를 미연에 효과적으로 방지함과 동시에 주차장 관리의 효율성 및 편의성을 높일 수 있으며, 통합관리서버가 예보모드 또는 비상모드 판단 시, 해당 주차장의 주차현황정보의 전화번호 정보를 탐색하여 문자를 전송하되, 전화번호가 기입되지 않은 주차차량이 존재할 때, 누락차량 검출부 및 누락차량 전화번호 탐색부를 실행시켜 이들에 의해 전화번호가 기입되지 않은 주차차량의 차량번호을 별도로 검출하도록 구성됨으로써 주차차량의 문자전송률을 획기적으로 높일 수 있어 서비스 정확성 및 신뢰도를 더욱 개선시킬 수 있고, 통합관리서버가 별도의 각 주차장별 이용내역DB를 생성 및 갱신하여 저장하되, 누락차량이 검출될 때, 1차적으로 해당 주차장의 이용내역DB를 탐색하여 누락차량의 전화번호를 검출하되, 1차 검출 실패 시, 전체 주차장의 이용내역DB를 탐색하여 누락차량의 전화번호를 검출하도록 구성됨으로써 DB 검색으로 인한 불필요한 연산처리 소모를 줄여 신속하고 정확하게 누락차량의 번호를 검출할 수 있는 주차장 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and device for online simulation of cascading failures of grid system based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and device for online simulation of cascading failures of a grid system based on a genetic algorithm. The method includes the steps that a grid topology is generated according to read system state information, and tidal data of a current system state are acquired; according to the tidal data of the current system state, the adaptive value of each system state in a generated system state set is calculated; according to the system state set, an initial population is generated; according to the size of the adaptive value of each individual in the initial population, a new population is generated optionally; the new population serves as a parent population and generates new child populations according to hybridization and mutation of the genetic algorithm; the generated child populations are continuously updated to meet preset cut-off conditions, and then a cascading failure result of a grid is output. By simulating the biological evolution process based on natural selection, online cascading failure evaluation is conducted on the grid, probable cascading failure paths in the current state of the system are quickly found, a failure early warning is given out, and aid decision making is provided for scheduling personnel.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;POWER GRID PLANNING RES CT OF GUIZHOU POWER GRID CORP

title_en: A kind of self-control Housthold earthquake siren
abstract_en: A kind of self-control Housthold earthquake siren, it is made of longitudinal wave detection circuit, shear wave detection circuit, illuminating circuit and sound warning circuit, by the judgement for carrying out early earthquake to the detection of horizontal plane, when an earthquake occurs, longitudinal wave reaches ground first, and ground is made to generate wavy lifting, longitudinal wave detection circuit of the invention detects ground rise or fall signal, light bulb LD issues the light of kermesinus, and Integrated circuit IC 4 issues police whistle sound, and people is reminded to flee from rapidly；After shear wave arrives at ground, ground swings, and shear wave detection circuit detects the signal that swings, light bulb LD becomes normal light from kermesinus, people are facilitated to withdraw, while the alarm song that loudspeaker SW is issued is bigger, to remind more people to withdraw rapidly；It is simple that the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows structures, and warning effect is significant, is particularly suitable for night use.

title_en: Coupled meteorological hydrologic hydrodynamic force-based super-standard flood forecasting and early-warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for forecasting and early warning based on coupling meteorological hydrologic power superstandard flood, which are used for collecting historical hydrologic data of monitoring stations in a research area, screening superstandard flood climate early warning indexes, constructing a superstandard flood climate early warning index chart, constructing a topological relation of a research area, constructing a flood evolution model and a hydrologic forecasting model, constructing a river basin superstandard flood forecasting scheme system, constructing a meteorological hydrologic coupling river basin superstandard flood forecasting model, solving the river basin superstandard flood forecasting model based on the superstandard flood forecasting scheme system and combining expert experience to correct in real time to obtain a river basin superstandard flood forecasting scheme updated in real time. Compared with the traditional super-standard flood forecasting and early-warning method, the method can meet the requirements of a modern disaster prevention, reduction and relief system in aspects of flood forecasting precision, forecasting period and the like.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Barrier lake dam break analysis system and method based on barrier erosion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrier lake dam break analysis system and a barrier lake dam break analysis method based on corrosion inhibition, which relate to the technical field of water conservancy and geological engineering disaster prediction and comprise a user interface module, wherein the user interface module allows a user to input parameters, starts each functional module and visualizes results; the dam breaking system comprises a data processing module, a data management module and a data processing module, wherein the data processing module is responsible for simulating a dam breaking process considering the erosion blocking effect, the data management module is responsible for checking, storing and exporting data, and in the data processing module, related parameters are called, the lake water level change is updated according to a time step, corresponding breaking parameters are calculated through an established model, meanwhile, the stability of a broken slope is verified, and a critical elevation and a critical slope foot are judged. Therefore, by adopting the dam break analysis system and method based on barrier lake erosion, the accuracy of water level, break flow, dam body and break geometric change data can be improved, and meanwhile, smooth parameter interaction and data visualization are realized through modular design, so that the dam break analysis system and method based on barrier lake dam break has good disaster early warning application prospect.

title_en: Emergency calling system of an elevator
title_ko: 엘리베이터의 응급 호출 시스템
abstract_en: An emergency call system for elevators is provided to enable a passenger to inform a current situation via an elevator car interphone to various notifying route when the elevator is in an emergency. Elevator car interphones(2a to 2n) are installed in elevator cars, and has an emergency call button and a handset. A guard-room or control-room interphone(8) receives a call signal from the elevator car interphones. An emergency telephone central office trunk(10) talks over the telephone with a passenger according to automatic switching of a telephone number which is set by an operator. An emergency call control unit(4) sequentially sets an emergency call path to switch the call number from the elevator car interphone, and implements automatic call admission with the interphone or central office trunk if call admission of a prior interphone or central office trunk is failed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 엘리베이터의 응급 호출 시스템에 관한 것으로, 다수의 엘리베이터 카에 구비된 인터폰에 각각 접속되고, 경비실, 방제실, 기타 응급 전화번호가 일정 시간 대기후 순차적으로 자동 스위칭 전환되게 구성됨으로써 비상정지되거나 고장난 엘리베이터 카에 갇힌 사용자가 카 내의 인터폰을 통해 다양한 알림 경로로 현 상황을 알릴 수 있도록 한 엘리베이터의 응급 호출 시스템을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다. 
     본 발명을 적용하면, 다수의 내선 인터폰 및 다양한 국선라인을 자동으로 순차 스위칭할 수 있게 설정할 수 있으므로, 엘리베이터 정지나 고장발생시 엘리베이터 카로부터 원격 음성 통화가 가능하게 되므로 편의성이 매우 높고, 안전사고 발생시 신속한 대처가 가능해지게 된다는 장점이 있고, 기존의 엘리베이터 응급 콜 시스템을 최소한의 변경으로 구성할 수 있으므로 경제적으로 유리하다. 
       
     엘리베이터, 인터폰, 응급 호출.

title_en: Gas type fire-fighting apparatus for a ship with double detective function
title_ko: 이중감지식 선박용 가스소화설비
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 내부의 방호구역에서 발생한 화재를 연기감지수단으로 감지하여 이산화탄소 등의 소화가스를 방호구역으로 공급시키는 가스소화설비에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 배풍기유닛의 작동에 따라 방호구역의 내부공기를 연기감지유닛으로 공급하는 샘플링파이프와 함께, 방호구역의 환기와 방폭(妨爆) 목적으로 제공된 또 다른 공기배출통로상에 화재감지용 센서로서의 스모크디텍터를 설치하여, 상기 스모크디텍터가 연기감지유닛과 추가적으로 접속되도록 함으로서, 방호구역에서의 화재발생여부를 이중으로 신속.정확하게 감지할 수 있도록 하며, 이로 인하여 선박 내부의 방호구역에서 발생한 화재를 보다 안전하게 진압할 수 있도록 함은 물론, 기존에 설치된 가스소화설비의 구조적인 변경이나 추가적인 배관설비를 수행하지 않더라도, 최근에 들어 안전규정이 보다 엄격하게 제시되고 있는 선박용 가스소화설비의 요구사항을 충분히 만족시킬 수 있도록 한 이중감지식 선박용 가스소화설비에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 배풍기유닛(5)의 작동에 따라 방호구역(1)의 내부공기를 연기감지유닛(4)측으로 공급시키는 샘플링파이프(2)와, 화재진압용 소화가스가 압축 저장되는 소화가스용기(6)와, 상기 소화가스용기(6)로부터 연장되어 샘플링파이프(2)와 연결 설치되는 가스공급관(6a)과, 상기 샘플링파이프(2) 및 가스공급관(6a)의 연결부위에 설치되어 공기통로와 소화가스통로를 선택적으로 개방시키는 삼방밸브장치(8)를 포함하여서 이루어지는 선박용 가스소화설비(10)에 있어서, 상기 각각의 방호구역(1)에는 배풍팬(12)이 설치된 배풍팬덕트(11)가 구비되고, 상기 배풍팬(12)의 상부 또는 하부측에 해당하는 배풍팬덕트(11)의 내부에는 화재감지용 센서로서의 스모크디텍터(Smoke detector)(13)가 설치되며, 상기 각각의 스모크디텍터(13)는 케이블(13a)에 의하여 연기감지유닛(4)과 접속 설치되고, 상기 연기감지유닛(4)은 케이블(4a)에 의하여 화재경보패널(7a)과 접속 설치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method of controlling a quick coupler of an excavator and apparatus for performing the same
title_ko: 굴삭기의 퀵 커플러 제어 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 장치
abstract_en: According to a method to control a quick coupler of an excavator, a warning sound rings in an unlock mode of a quick clamp switch wherein an attachment is separated from a quick coupler. A warning sound rings from a release mode of the quick clamp switch to a neutral mode. When the neutral mode of the quick clamp switch is shifted to a lock mode, the warning noise is stopped. As such, the warning sound rings during the neutral mode, and a worker can accurately recognize that the quick coupler stably locks the attachment; thus preventing accidents where lives are lost.
abstract_ko: 굴삭기의 퀵 커플러 제어 방법에 따르면, 퀵 커플러(quick coupler)로부터 어태치먼트(attachment)가 분리되는 퀵 클램프 스위치(quick clamp switch)의 해제 모드(unlock mode) 중에 경보음을 발한다. 상기 퀵 클램프 스위치의 해제 모드로부터 중립 모드(neutral mode)까지 상기 경보음을 계속 발한다. 상기 퀵 클램프 스위치의 중립 모드로부터 잠금 모드(lock mode)로 전환되면, 상기 경보음을 정지시킨다. 따라서, 중립 모드 동안에도 경보음이 계속 발하게 되어, 작업자는 퀵 커플러가 어태치먼트를 견고하게 로킹한 상태를 정확하게 인지할 수가 있게 되어, 인명 사고와 같은 안전 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring agricultural meteorological disasters, wherein the method for monitoring agricultural meteorological disasters comprises the following steps: constructing a knowledge graph of agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring based on the obtained multi-source heterogeneous data related to the agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring; updating the weather data in the weather grids in the knowledge graph based on the updated weather forecast data to obtain an updated knowledge graph; determining whether an abnormal weather grid exists in the updated knowledge graph based on weather data in the updated knowledge graph and preset disaster conditions; determining a geographical area corresponding to the abnormal weather grid and an agricultural weather disaster grade of the area corresponding to the abnormal weather grid in the geographical area; and screening out farmland patches for planting specific crops from the areas corresponding to the abnormal meteorological grids in the geographic area, and sending early warning information of agricultural meteorological disasters to an administrator of the farmland patches.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Dynamic early warning system and early warning method for landslide disasters along pipeline
abstract_en: The system comprises a database, a pipeline landslide susceptibility evaluation module, a slope unit influence condition evaluation module, a regional surface displacement data processing module, a pipeline landslide dynamic early warning module and an early warning information release module. According to the invention, by comprehensively utilizing the earth surface displacement data and the related geological environment factors, the slope body which threatens the pipeline safety can be more accurately judged, and the early warning level is reasonably issued; the invention not only provides early warning at the initial stage, but also updates early warning information in time according to the real-time change of the earth surface displacement, thereby ensuring the timeliness and accuracy of early warning; the method is particularly aimed at specific geology and environmental conditions along the pipeline, so that the early warning is more targeted and applicable, and the effectiveness of the early warning is improved in practical application.

title_en: Flood inundation range prediction method, flood inundation range prediction system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation range prediction method, a flood inundation range prediction system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of determining a new basic flooding range according to a real-time SAR image and water surface fluctuation data when the new real-time SAR image is acquired, determining a current real-time water volume according to the new basic flooding range and a terrain digital elevation model, determining an actual water volume increment according to the current real-time water volume and a previous real-time water volume, updating a dynamic coefficient according to the actual water volume increment and the precipitation in a revisit period, determining a predicted water volume increment according to the acquired predicted precipitation volume and the updated dynamic coefficient, and determining a flood flooding prediction range according to the predicted water volume increment and the terrain digital elevation model by taking the new basic flooding range as an initial flooding range. The evolution of the flood inundation range can be predicted in time in the revisit period, the timeliness and the accuracy of prediction are considered, and early warning is carried out on a disaster-stricken area in advance.
assignees: ANHUI SURVEY & DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Method of preventing traffic accidents in crossroad for signal violation and overspeed, and system of the same
title_ko: 과속 및 신호위반에 의한 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preventing traffic accidents in an intersection and a system thereof. When signals change abruptly near an intersection, a vehicle approaching the intersection after a straight or left turn signal at the intersection frequently crashes into another vehicle entering the intersection after receiving a signal in another road while approaching the intersection without being able to stop at a stop line of the intersection due to the acceleration of the vehicle. To solve the problem, the intersection traffic accident prevention method and the system thereof according to the present invention are configured to sense an approaching vehicle, which travels at a speed equal to or greater than a predetermined speed while ignoring signals, or a vehicle, which enters the intersection in a straight path or after taking a left turn, through an image camera and sense the warning light and siren of an emergency vehicle through the image camera and a sound sensor in order to operate the warning lights or secondary traffic lights arranged on the traffic lights in each road and output warning text through electrical signs. The present invention can prevent a collision accident between a vehicle, which approaches the intersection while ignoring signals in the intersection and a vehicle entering the intersection in advance.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교차로에서 직진 또는 좌회전 신호를 받고 교차로를 향하여 달려가고 있는 차량이 교차로 부근에서 갑자기 신호가 변경된 경우 차량의 가속도 때문에 교차로의 정지선에 정지하지 못하고 그대로 교차로를 통과하다가 다른 차도에서 신호를 받고 교차로로 진입하는 차량과의 추돌 사고가 빈번히 일어나는 문제점이 있었다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명의 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템은, 교차로에서 신호를 위반하고 소정의 속도 이상으로 달려오는 차량이나 교차로로 진입하는 직진 및 좌회전 차량을 영상카메라를 통해 감지하고, 영상카메라와 소리감지센서를 통해 긴급자동차의 경광등과 싸이렌을 감지하여, 각 차도의 신호등에 배치된 경광등 또는 보조신호등을 작동시키고 전광판을 통해 주의 문자를 출력하도록 구성하였다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 교차로에서 신호를 무시하고 교차로로 달려오는 차량과 교차로로 진입하는 차량 간의 충돌사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of warning device for electronic information laboratory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of warning device for electronic information laboratory, including shell and Convenient switch panel, the upper end outer surface of the shell is installed with Smoke Sensor, and the side of Smoke Sensor is provided with alarm lamp, the lower end outer surface of the shell is installed with firewire binding post, and the side of firewire binding post is provided with zero line binding post, the opposite side of the firewire binding post is provided with earth terminal, and zero line binding post is fixedly mounted on the lower end of shell with earth terminal.A kind of warning device for electronic information laboratory of the present invention, provided with Convenient switch panel, voice announcer and signal projector, the warning device to perch can conveniently be controlled, and personnel are instructed to withdraw laboratory in the case of being caused danger in laboratory, and laboratory room managing personnel not at the scene can be notified, the accident at timely processing scene, brings more preferable prospect of the application.
assignees: WEIHAI YUNRUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction
abstract_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction, it is related to disaster alarm field, by laying earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region, a variety of physical quantitys and chemical quantity for monitoring earthquake monitoring point are monitored, and obtain multi -components monitoring data.Multi -components monitoring data at the earthquake monitoring point because the variation characteristic of physical field and chemical fields caused by underground activities is related.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the earthquake monitoring point or the Earthquake risk index in the premonitoring region.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of earthquake and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the danger that earthquake occurs in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: Method for tracking laser breakpoint by using particle filtering algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for tracking laser breakpoints by using a particle filter algorithm, which comprises 6 steps of establishing a state space model, initializing targets and particles, measuring similarity, updating weights, determining breakpoint states and judging resampling; describing breakpoint monitoring by adopting a dynamic state space model, wherein the dynamic state space model of the time-varying problem comprises a state transition model and an observation model, and determining the dynamic state space model; initializing a breakpoint target and sample particles; updating the weight of the particles through similarity measurement, wherein each particle has different weights; based on a particle filtering algorithm, acquiring a particle update weight according to an observation likelihood function of the target region characteristics; and correcting the particles with different weights, performing recursive prediction and updating on the breakpoint state, and determining the breakpoint state. The invention can detect the laser breakpoint in the video screen in real time, thereby giving real-time early warning to the landslide, and the tracking process is accurate, stable and real-time.

title_en: Mountain torrent mud-rock flow early warning system based on multisource data comprehensive analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent mud-rock flow early warning method and system based on multi-source data comprehensive analysis. The monitoring system carries out multi-source monitoring on rainfall, material source and mud level change characteristics of the ditch. Based on the double-threshold rainfall intensity parameters, a quantitative analysis model of channel mud position and flow is superimposed on a blockage mechanism of deformation of an object source. And determining the threshold value of each element according to the disaster history, establishing a probability formula of disaster outbreak, and screening the key factor weight through a random forest algorithm. Preprocessing of the data is performed through cross-validation and dynamic adjustment. And substituting the monitoring data into an analysis model, and comprehensively judging the early warning level of the mountain torrent mud-rock flow. And issuing an early warning signal of a corresponding grade to the object in the power-assisted region through the early warning system. After operation, the model is updated by online learning by adopting an incremental random forest method, data duplication is carried out, and model threshold correction and parameter inversion analysis are carried out. The early warning system establishes a comprehensive monitoring early warning evaluation system for quantitative analysis of the combined action of multiple indexes.

title_en: Method and system for realizing unmanned tunneling working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for realizing an unmanned tunneling working face, which comprise the steps of dividing equipment groups working on the tunneling working face into N rigid body groups which independently operate, installing an inertial navigation and a laser target on main rigid body equipment of each rigid body group, designing and installing a measuring and positioning robot, wherein the measuring and positioning robot comprises an inertial navigation and N automatic target-seeking total stations, establishing a digital twin platform of the unmanned tunneling working face, realizing pose calculation, fault diagnosis, disaster early warning, cooperative control, scene update, equipment start-stop and maintenance decision-making, and providing remote intervention and man-machine interaction interfaces to realize unmanned operation of the tunneling working face. The invention can realize the accurate measurement, positioning and attitude control of all equipment such as digging, drilling, anchoring, supporting, transporting, passing and the like in the tunneling working face, realize the unmanned operation of zero accident and zero fault of the tunneling working face, and provide technical support for avoiding personal injury and death and greatly improving the tunneling efficiency.

title_en: Digital broadcast signal and apparatus and method of processing the signal
title_ko: 디지털 방송 신호와 상기 신호를 처리하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A digital broadcasting signal, and an apparatus and a method for processing the digital broadcasting signal are provided to increase the efficiency of a receiver without processing all emergency warning messages. A digital broadcasting signal includes a synchronization channel, a fast information channel(FIC), and a main service channel(MSC). The FIC includes an emergency warning message for emergency warning broadcasting. The digital broadcasting signal is received. The emergency warning message in the FIC is parsed. It is determined whether an emergency warning message having message identification information identical to that of the parsed emergency warning message is previously received. If the previously received emergency warning message is previously received, it is determined whether a version number of the parsed emergency warning message is greater than the version number of the previously emergency warning message. If the version number of the parsed emergency warning message is greater than the version number of the previously emergency warning message, the parsed emergency warning message is received.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 방송 신호와 상기 신호를 처리하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 디지털 방송 신호는 SYNC(synchronization channel), FIC(fast information channel)와 MSC(main service channel)로 구성하고, 상기 FIC는 재난 방송을 위한 재난 메시지를 포함하되, 상기 재난 메시지는 버전 관련 정보 또는 상기 버전 관련 정보와 재난 종료 시각 관련 정보를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이때, 상기 버전 관련 정보는 해당 재난 메시지의 메시지 아이디(message identification)를 나타내는 정보와(또는) 버전(version)을 나타내는 정보를 포함하고, 상기 재난 종료 시각 관련 정보는 재난 종료 시각을 나타내는 정보와 상기 재난 종료 시각을 나타내는 정보의 존재 유무를 나타내는 정보를 포함하는 것이 바람직하다. 따라서, 본 발명에 따르면, 수신되는 모든 재난 메시지를 처리할 필요가 없어 수신기 시스템의 효율을 높일 수 있고, 사용자에게도 모든 재난 메시지를 디스플레이하는 것이 아니라 항상 최신의 정보만을 디스플레이할 수 있어 동일한 메시지나 이미 지난 재난 메시지를 다시 디스플레이함으로써 오는 혼동이나 디지털 방송을 시청하지 못하게 되는 경우 등을 피할 수 있다. 
       
     디지털 멀티미디어 방송, FIC, FIDC, 재난 메시지

title_en: System for emergency signal and control process thereof
title_ko: 건물 내부의 비상 경보 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: An emergency alarm system and a control method thereof are provided to evacuate the people inside the building by unlocking a fire door when a sensing signal corresponding to an emergency situation is inputted. A sensor(100) is installed in a room or a living room. The smoke and the heating temperature due to the gas and fire are sensed. A controller box(200) outputs a control signal by a sensing signal outputted from the sensor. An alarm(300) is driven by the control signal outputted in the control box to make a manager and a user recognize an emergency situation. If the smoke and the heating temperature are sensed in one of a plurality of rooms or living rooms with the sensor, the alarm in other room or living room where the smoke and the heating temperature are not sensed, are driven by the control box.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물 내부의 방이나 거실에서 가스 및 화재로 인한 연기 및 가열 온도가 감지되면 사용자 및 관리자가 인식할 수 있도록 경보하게 하는 건물 내부의 비상 경보 시스템 및 그 제어방법을 제공하는데 그 특징이 있다. 
     또한, 본 발명은 다수의 방이나 거실 중에 어느 한 곳이라도 가스 및 화재로 인한 연기 및 가열온도가 감지되면 감지되지 않은 다른 방 또는 거실의 경보기가 작동하게 하는 건물 내부의 비상 경보 시스템 및 그 제어방법을 제공하는데 있다. 
     또한, 본 발명은 비상 상황에 해당하는 감지신호가 입력되면 방화문이 열릴 수 있도록 잠금을 해제시키는 방화문의 개폐장치와 연동하게 하고, 화재 및 가스누출과 같은 비상 상황이 발생할 경우 미리 설정된 사용자 및 관리자가 갖고 있는 통신단말기의 전화번호로 문자 또는 호출음과 같은 형태로 알려주게 하는 건물 내부의 비상 경보 시스템 및 그 제어방법을 제공하는데 있다.

abstract_en: PURPOSE: A construction drawing of a bundle road is provided to efficiently use a limited space by constructing a second story and to enable a driver to rapidly arrive at a destination by selectively operating lanes. CONSTITUTION: A construction drawing of a bundle road is composed as follows. Northbound columns, center columns, southbound columns are connected in a zigzag shape. A self-powered electrical generator is built. Emergency warning lights are arranged. Hot wire frames are buried in the ground in order to prevent a road from being cracked.
abstract_ko:
본 발명품은 1층 도로와 2층도로 한뭉치 도로 건립도로서대한민국의 땅은 한정되어 있는 실정에서 지역적으로 도로를 확장하고 새로운 도로를 건설 공사를 해야하는 오늘날에 1차산업 2차산업 3차산업의 균형된 발전을 이룩함과 동시에 도로를 확장하고 새로운 도로를 건설해야하는 우리의 과제가 주어집니다. 
     본 발명품은 교통안전 확보와 도로운행 혼잡을 미연에 방지하여 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻을두었습니다. 
     본 설계도는 아름다운 자연을 살리면서 1차산업의 터전인 논·밭의 형질변경을 줄이고 교통의 발전을 도모할수 있는 2층도로 건립도가 절실히 요구되는 현실이 되고 있습니다. 확장해야 하는 도로에 많은 논·밭을 도로에 편입시키지 말고 2층도로 공사로 교통 문제점을 해결해야 할것이며 1층도로 신설공사 지역에는 100년앞을 내다보는 도로교통 발전의 일환으로 2층도로 건설공사를 후대에 할 수 있도록 터전을 마련하면서 1층도로공사를 시행 하도록 합시다. 
     ① 2층도로 바닥 기초기둥 도형이란? 
     도로 양쪽 가장자리에 사방 3m 폭 가로×세로로 터파기하여 철근을 깔고 사방 가로×세로 폭 1.5m로기둥을 세움과 도로중앙 가로 3m 세로양쪽3M 터파기와 철근을 깔고 기초 콘크리트 타설 중앙가로 1.5m 가로막대 기둥과 세로양쪽 1.5m×1.5m가로막대 기둥자리를 세울 양쪽 각각 3m폭 터파기를 해야합니다. 양쪽 3m중 중앙 1.5m×1.5m 세로 고정 막대 기둥을 세우게 됩니다.(상행선) 
     반대편 하행선 차도에는 상행선 기둥 자리와 기둥자리 중간 지점에 기둥자리 터파기를 함과 도로 중앙 기둥자리로 상행선 중간 기둥자리와 기둥자리 중간 지점에 기둥자리 터파기를 해야 합니다. 기둥자리에는 강관 또는 파일항타후 철근을 깔고 콘크리트 타설과 기둥을 세움과 가로세로 막대 고정후 상판을 깔고 도로 바닥 포장을 합니다. 
     터널을 통과하는 2층도로 에서는 터널 옆으로 새로운 터널을 뚫고서 2층 도로를 건설함과 1층도로위 2층 지점에 교차도로가 있을때 1km후방에서 서서히 다리 길이를 높게하여 2층 교차지점에서는 3층 높이로 도로가 통과할 수 있도록 한 후 차츰차츰 낮게 한후 1km지점에서는 2층 높이로 정상적으로 2층도로 건설 공사를 할 수 있도록 할 것. 강 육교 2층도로 공사로서 육교위 2층도로 공사를 할때는 육교도로 양쪽 끝부분에 기초다리 공사를 튼튼히 함과 육교중앙 도로를 기둥 폭 만큼 구멍을 브레이카로 뚫어서 기둥세움 2층 높이로 공사하는 공법과 기존도로 옆으로 새로운 육교도로 건설 공사 후 육교 끝부분 500m부근에서 2층도로 진입 정상적인 2층도로 공사를 시행공법이 있습니다. 2층도로 가장자리에서 손님이 탑승장소는 전부 엘리베이터로 오르내리게 함과 2층도로 건립은 조립식으로 공사하는 건설 공법입니다. 
     1.2층 전반에 공급되는 전기는 모두 자가발전소에서 발전 생산되는 전기를 공급하게 됩니다. 
     도로 상행선 가장자리에 3층.3색.거리표시 경고등을 250m에서∼500m까지 뒤의 차량에게 사고를사전에 알려주는 역할을 하게 됩니다. 하행선 가장자리도 똑같 이 상행선과 동일하게 설치하며 버튼 설치는 100m 거리 단위로 0m지점에 설치되어 있으며 안전장치인 휴즈박스 고장 경고등을 필히 설치함 연쇄충돌 사고를 예방하여 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻이 있습니다. 3층 경고등 밑 부분은 파이프형 표면에 나사산 가공 2층 지붕에 구멍식 너트가공과 2층 경고등 밑부분에 파이프 식으로 표면에 나사산 가공 1층 천장에 구멍형속 너트 가공함. 도로 지하철이나 지하상가를 먼저 공사후 추운지방을 우선으로 눈이 많이오는 지방을 우선으로 도로굴곡. 경사가 많은 지방 도로를 우선으로 하여도로폭 3.5m중 열선틀 철근으로 제작 크기는 가로×세로 3m크기로 철근으로 제작후지정된 곳에 동파이프를 조립 파이프속에 넣고 캡에 고정함. 발열이 강한 니크롬선과같은 열선을 조립하여 도로3m폭으로 1차.2차.3차.4차선 도로까지 열선틀을 매설하게됩니다. 4차선까지 같은 배선으로 연결함과 배선으로 퓨즈박스도 설치해야 합니다. 고장시 3m폭으로 4차선까지 모두 터파기하여 철거후 다시 새것으로 교체매설함. 이렇게 계속 연결해 나가면서 매설하면 됩니다. 열선틀 공사를 함으로서 겨울철 동절기 결빙으로 인하여 미끄럼 연쇄충돌 눈폭설 교통대란 차량전복등의 사고를 예방 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻을 두었습니다. 니크롬선 최고의 열기온도가 높고 낮음에 주석합금 동파이프 굵기와 두께와 주석합금을 결정함. 
     인도지하 양쪽벽 부품 조립도란? 
     도로인도 또는 가장자리에 3m∼3.5m폭과 깊이 3m∼5m깊이로 터파기하여 철근 콘크리트 타설옹벽 제작과 뚜껑 철근콘크리트 두께 30cm이상되게 제작하여 뚜껑은 6m∼10m길이 크기로 제작 크레인이나 기중기로 들어서 뚜껑을 덮게 됩니다. 지하벽  양쪽에 받침대 고정고리 각종 부품을 조립함. 지하바닥은 소형차량 레일을 깔것과 천장.조명등 CCTV를 설치하여 고장 유무를 관리소 모니터로 확인 하세요. 
     도로 차도에는 두번다시 터파기를 하지 못하며 공사시설 관리비는 공동으로 분담하고 공동으로 관리를 합니다. 공사후 내부조립 시에는 뚜껑을 개봉후 조립함. 지하차도 부품조립 공사는 도로차도 지하에 무질서하게 겹쳐지게 위험물등을 매설한 곳이라 부품 교체할 때 인건비도 많이들고 위험성도 크고 도로차도에 많은시설안전품도 매설하지 못하므로 새로신설되는 도로는 필히 도로안전 부품을 모두설치 매설후에 준공검사를 받게 합니다. 2층 도로 준공을 필한 고속도로에서는 1층도로 1차선은 고속버스 전용도로 2차선은 대형화물 전용도로 3차선은 중형화물차 전용도로 4차선은 긴급차량과 지역으로 출구도로 2층 고속도로에서는 1차선은 120km빠르기 승용차량선 2차선은 100km빠르기 승용차선 3차선은 80km빠르기 승용차선 경·소형 화물차량 4차선은60km빠르기 승용차겸 소형 화물차선 앞지르기 차량이나 차선 위반으로 진행방해 행위차량 지정된 차선외 차선진입 차량은 범칙금을 부과받게 됩니다. 
     종전에 1층도로 건설공사를 시행했던 원청이 2층도로 건설 공사를 함으로 1층과 2층 차량운행 숫자가 차이가 많이나게 됨으로 1층고속도로 건설공사를 시행한 원청업체가 2층고속도로 구간을 건설하게 되며 부득이한 사정으로 공사를 원청이 못할 때 공개입찰할것과 새로 신설고속도로 1층과 2층 공사는 공개입찰제입니다. 
     많은업체가 공사에 참여 짧은 구간공사로써 빠른 시일에 준공으로 안전사고를 예방합니다.

title_en: Intergration environment monitoring system that the center control is possible
title_ko: 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An integrated environment monitoring system is provided to offer desirable building surroundings by comprehensively controlling environment within a building and to prevent the input of unnecessary manpower. CONSTITUTION: A MCU(Main Control unit)(20) generally control a system. A plurality of sensor units senses temperature and humidity within building, existence and nonexistence of an access, smoke, power state, and environment of a CCTV. A signal input unit(4), an image signal input unit(8), an ADC(Analog to Digital Converter), and GPIO(General Purpose Input/ Output) receives environmental information sensed in the sensor unit. A signal processing unit(30) processes the environmental information. An interface(13) transmits the processed environmental information to a client(14). The client outputs a transmitted environmental information result.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기업, 정부기관, 건물 내의 자료를 저장 보관하는 서버 실과 같은 주요시설의 환경정보를 실시간 감시하여 획득한 정보를 통해 화재와 도난뿐만 아니라, 자료 소실 및 손실을 가질 수 있는 상황을 사전 감지하여 대응할 수 있도록 도와주는 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템이다. 
본 발명의 목적은  건물 내의 환경을 종합적으로 감시 및 제어하여 바람직한 건물 환경을 제공할 수 있도록 한 환경감시(온도, 습도),보안감시(출입자 유무 확인),화재감시(연기센서), 영상감시(CCTV),전원감시(Main 전원,보조전원(UPS)) 및 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템을 제공하는 데 그 목적이 있다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명에 따른 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템은, 
전체적인 제어를 위한 제어부(MCU)와, 건물 내의 환경감시, 보안감시, 화재감시, 영상감시, 전원감시 등의 환경을 감시하는 복수의 감지센서부(3)(5)(7)(9)(11)와, 상기 센 서부로부터 감지된 환경 정보가 입력되는 신호 입력부(4), Ext. Interrupt(6), 영상신호 입력부(8),ADC(10),GPIO(12)와, 
상기 부에 연결되어 환경 정보를 처리하는 신호처리부와, 처리된 환경 데이터를 클라이언트에 전송하는 인터페이스와, 전송된 환경정보 결과를 출력하는 클라이언트로 구성한다. 
상기 전송된 결과를 클라이언트의 환경 감시 프로그램으로 설정된 기준 정보 데이터를 초과 또는 이상 시 경보음을 울리게 한다. 
또한, 이러한 정보를 종합해서 상황을 유추할 수 있으며, 기준 정보 데이터의 설정 값과 경보음을 변경할 수 있도록 인터페이스 되어 있다. 추가로 상기 수집된 환경 정보와 통신연결 유무를 LAN 통신으로 중앙통제 감시 시스템에 전송하고 기 전송된 정보의 상황을 분석하여 해당 예하 클라이언트에 상황대처 지시를 하달할 수 있도록 설계한다. 
본 발명에 의한 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템은, 
상기와 같은 구성에 의하여 건물 내의 환경을 종합적으로 감시 및 제어하여 바람직한 건물 환경을 제공할 수 있다. 
구체적으로는, 환경 감시 및 제어 시스템에 의해 화재와 도난뿐만 아니라,그에 따른 상황을 사전 감지하여 대응할 수 있도록 도와주는 시스템이며, 건물 내의 환경감시, 보안감시, 화재감시, 영상감시, 전원감시 및 제어 시스템을 통합된 단일장치로 작동함으로써 추가적인 장치가 필요로 하지 않다. 
따라서 건물 내의 환경의 신뢰도를 높이고, 종합적이고 정확한 데이터의 입수를 가능하게 하여 불필요한 인력의 투입 및 사고를 방지함과 동시에 가장 적합한 제어 명령을 수행할 수 있다. 
또한, 중앙 통제 감시 시스템과 원격으로 통신하여 중앙기관 및 부서에서 본 발명의 클라이언트를 통제 또는 감시할 수도 있다.

title_en: Device and method for detecting defects of circuit breaker with vacuum or gas interrupter using electromagnetic waves in real time
title_ko: 차단기 밸브의 결함 검출을 위한 실시간 전자기파 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 진단방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time electromagnetic wave measuring device for detecting a fault of a circuit breaker valve, and a diagnosis method using the same, which secure facility reliability. The real-time electromagnetic wave measuring device of the present invention comprises: an electromagnetic wave measuring sensor (100); a display unit (101) for displaying an electromagnetic wave measurement value and a set value; an operation unit (102) for various settings; and an input/output unit (104) connected to a computer to analyze a spectrum of electromagnetic waves.
abstract_ko:
발전소 및 화학플랜트 등 산업설비에는 수많은 차단기가 사용되고 있다. 차단기의 주 접촉자(Main Contactor)가 위치한 밸브(Interrupter)(1)는 절연매체(13)로서 진공 또는 육불화유황가스(SF6)가 사용된다. 밸브(1)의 진공도가 저하되거나 가스 압력이 저하된 상태에서 차단기가 개폐 동작하는 경우 과도전압(Transient Voltage)으로 인해 절연(Insulation)이 파괴되고 고장전류(Fault Current)로 인해 화재로 이어지는 중대한 고장이 발생할 수 있다. 따라서 차단기의 신속하고 정확한 동작은 매우 중요한다. 

차단기의 주 접촉자(Main Contactor)는 고정접촉자(11)와 가동접촉자(12)로 밀폐된 구조의 밸브(1)에 내장된 구조이다. 차단기 밸브(1)에 대한 건전성 시험을 수행하기 위해서는 차단기(5)를 수배전반(4) 설비에서 인출해야만 하고, 밸브(1) 외부에서 가동접촉자(12)의 간극을 측정하거나 밸브(1)에 고전압을 인가하여 절연상태를 점검하는 방식으로 수행된다. 따라서 차단기가 운전되고 있는 활선 상태에서는 차단기 밸브(1)에 대해 건전성은 확인 할 수 없는 문제가 있다. 

본 발명은 차단기 밸브(1)가 개폐 동작할 때 발생하는 전자기파를 실시간으로 측정하여 차단기 밸브(1)의 건전성을 확인할 수 있으므로 기존에 수행하고 있는 차단기 밸브(1)에 대한 시험 방법을 보완할 수 있다. 측정장치(2)는 전자기파 센서(100)와 연결되고, 측정치를 정량화하여 나타내는 표시부(101), 경보의 취명, 설정치 변경을 위한 조작부(102), 경보의 취명, 제어신호 출력 및 원격종합제어장치(3)와 통신으로 연결하기 위한 입·출력부(103)로 구성된다. 여기서 표시부(1)와 조작부(1)는 사용자 인터페이스로서 터치스크린을 사용하는 경우 일체형으로 구성된다.  

정상 운전상태에서 발생하는 전자기파를 기준값으로 설정하고 주기적으로 측정된 자료와 비교하여 상태를 판정할 수 있다. 또한 유사한 부하 종류별로 분류하여 상호 대비하여 판정치를 수립함으로서 비정상적으로 높게 검출되는 전자기파에 대해 비교 평가할 수 있다. 이러한 새로운 진단기법을 통해 차단기가 운전되고 있는 활선 상태에서 실시간으로 전자기파를 측정함으로서 차단기 밸브(1)의 결함을 조기에 검출하여 선제적으로 예측정비를 통해 설비신뢰도를 확보하는 이점이 있다.

title_en: One kind is emergent to self solve access controller
abstract_en: Met an urgent need the invention discloses one kind and self solve access controller, including shell, base and operation panel shell, the upper surface middle position of shell is provided with display screen, digital button is provided with below display screen, cancel button is provided with the right side of digital button, confirming button is provided with below cancel button, warning light is provided with the right side of display screen, card reader is provided with the right side of warning light；Temperature sensing alarm is provided with access controller, when the condition of a fire occurring outside gate inhibition's device, can be in time by temperature sensing alarm, automatic alarm and unblock, so as to reach rapid evacuation crowd, reduce casualties, card reader of entering, camera and scrambler are provided with access controller, improves the security of gate inhibition's device, and is also provided with display screen, unlocking staff more preferably is prompted, so as to reach the purpose using more safe ready.
assignees: ANHUI TRULY INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public early warning broadcasting method, system and base station equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a public early warning broadcasting method, a public early warning broadcasting system and base station equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: enabling the AMF to send a write replacement early warning request message to the gNB-CU-CP through the NG interface; enabling the gNB-CU-CP to generate an F1 interface message according to the replacement indication written in the replacement early warning request message and the new public early warning information, and sending an F1 interface message to the gNB-DU, wherein the F1 interface message comprises a replacement indication bit and the new public early warning information; and enabling the gNB-DU to replace the current public warning broadcast information by the new public warning information in the F1 interface message according to the replacement indication bit in the F1 interface message. By the scheme, F1 interface signaling can be reduced, repeated cancellation and restarting of resource scheduling are avoided, and the problems of early warning information transmission delay and the like can be reduced.
assignees: INNOVATIVE DIMENSION SCIENCE AND TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for broadcasting and disseminating disaster safety information
title_ko: 재난안전정보의 방송 및 전파를 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난안전정보의 방송 및 전파를 위한 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난안전정보의 방송 및 전파를 위한 방법은 각 단계가 정보표출장치에서 이루어지는 것으로서, 재난안전정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 재난안전정보가 CAP(Common Alert Protocol)를 준수하는지 여부를 판단하여 상기 재난안전정보의 유효성을 판정하는 단계; 상기 재난안전정보가 유효한 것으로 판정된 경우 통신반경 내에 위치하는 하나 이상의 정보표출장치로 페어링 없이 상기 재난안전정보를 전파하는 단계; 및 상기 재난안전정보가 유효한 것으로 판정된 경우 상기 재난안전정보에 따른 비상경보를 방송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency message dissemination method and system based on trust cascade in Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency message dissemination method and system based on trust cascade in Internet of vehicles, wherein the system comprises an authority mechanism, a road side unit and a vehicle: the authority mechanism is responsible for providing registration and revocation services for the vehicle, and storing and updating trust information of the vehicle; the road side unit provides a communication interface for the vehicle and the authority; the vehicle-mounted unit is mounted on the vehicle and can communicate with the adjacent road side unit and other vehicles; when an emergency occurs, the emergency message can be disseminated among nearby vehicles in a trust cascade, wherein entity-oriented trust values (which can be evaluated and updated by and included in the trust certificate) are taken as important weights; the method and the system efficiently apply the entity-oriented trust value to the data-oriented trust evaluation, compared with the existing message dissemination mode, the method and the system have more accurate evaluation result, and have good excitation mechanism, error tolerance, compatibility and robustness.

title_en: Early warning and monitoring method for preventing collapse of deep foundation pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to foundation pit monitoring, in particular to a method for early warning and monitoring collapse prevention of a deep foundation pit. The method comprises the following steps: step A, constructing a stay wire foundation at the position of a slope toe of the pit bottom of a foundation pit, and constructing a connecting rod foundation at the position, close to a slope wall, of a slope top; b, arranging a spring on the inner side of the slope wall of the foundation pit, wherein two ends of the spring are respectively connected with the cantilever connecting rod and the stay wire foundation through stay wires; step C, installing a contact device by a spring, wherein the contact device comprises a T-shaped inner contact rod and a hook-shaped outer contact rod; and D, connecting the inner feeler lever with an alarm in series through a wire, electrically connecting the alarm with one electrode of a power supply through the wire, and electrically connecting the other electrode of the power supply with the outer feeler lever through the wire. The invention has simple structure and high sensitivity, provides automatic broadcast alarm before the collapse danger of the foundation pit, withdraws people in time, prevents the collapse accident of the foundation pit, and avoids casualties and property loss.

title_en: Smart phone using risk notification system
title_ko: 스마트폰을 활용한 위험 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a danger alarm system utilizing a smartphone and, more specifically, to a danger alarm system utilizing a smartphone secretly requesting for rescue by detecting a dangerous situation through a released state to transmit position information with danger information to a designated guardian, a friend, a police station, a first station and the like in a wireless or contacted state. The danger alarm system comprises a danger sensing bracelet (10) and a terminal (20).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰을 활용한 위험 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 무선 또는 접촉된 상태에서 해제상태를 통해 위험상황을 감지하여 지정된 보호자, 친구, 경찰, 소방서 등에 위험정보와 함께 위치정보를 전송하여 비밀리에 구조요청을 할 수 있는 스마트폰을 활용한 위험 알림 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV NAT HANBAT IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Environmental information monitoring system using partially replaceable sensor module
title_ko: 부분교체 가능한 센서모듈을 이용한 환경정보 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A module can be replaced according to a type of a sensor for each application business site. In case of a business site in which a process is frequently changed, the module can be replaced according to the change of the sensor, thereby being economical. A measurement value measured in the sensor is transmitted to a smart phone of a worker by mounting a communication function so as to instantly check the value through an application, thereby sensing an accident risk and instantly coping with a negligent accident. When a risk situation for each measurement material concentration is analyzed and the accident is predicted in the business site, an alarm can be notified and data can be collected and managed. A communication device includes an antenna part, a device part including the sensor which is replaceable, a battery part including a detachment part and an additional battery, and a case which is waterproof and dustproof.
abstract_ko:
적용 사업장 별 센서의 종류에 따른 모듈의 교체가 가능함 
공정 변경이 잦은 사업장의 경우 센서 변경에 따른 모듈의 교체가 가능하여 경제적임 
통신기능 탑재로 센서에서 측정된 값이 작업자의 스마트폰으로 전송되어 Application을 통해 즉시 확인이 가능하여 사고 위험 감지 및 즉각적인 안전사고 대응이 가능함 
사업장 내 측정물질 농도별 위험상황 분석 및 사고 예측 시 경보알림이 가능하며, 데이터 수집 및 관리 가능

title_en: A kind of Internet of Things Landslide Hazards intelligent early-warning platform of Fibre Optical Sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Internet of Things Landslide Hazards intelligent early-warning platform of Fibre Optical Sensor, including Fibre Optical Sensor, the forecast system for landslide multidate information to be outwardly presented, and the main control terminal being electrically connected with Fibre Optical Sensor, forecast system respectively；Fibre Optical Sensor includes fiber optic modulator, fibre circuit, fiber demodulator for sensing landslide change, fibre circuit will carry the optical signal transmission of landslide change information in fiber demodulator, and fiber demodulator receives the optical signal from fibre circuit and is simultaneously demodulated；Main control terminal includes the data acquisition unit being electrically connected with fiber demodulator, and the data processing unit being electrically connected with data acquisition unit forecast system respectively, landslide change information is obtained in the optical signal that data processing unit is conveyed and come from data acquisition unit and is analyzed, control instruction is transported to forecast system and is operated with Guiding Weather Forecast System by data processing unit according to analyze data, the design detection speed is fast, Information Communication process is smooth, notifies that people withdraw in time.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN SOFT SCIENCE RES ASS;ZHONGSHAN TOPWARE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: The emergency system of alarm is provided in the case of indoor emergency
abstract_en: The invention discloses the emergency system that alarm is provided in the case of indoor emergency, including processor and the apparatus of air conditioning, fire detection equipment, seismic survey equipment, toilet detection processing equipment, display screen and the warning device that are connected respectively with the processor.The present invention solves the problems, such as that indoor disaster existing in the prior art takes place without alert process equipment, the emergency system of alarm is provided in the case of offer indoor emergency, when it is applied when bathroom floor water level exceedes the threshold value of setting, it is issued by audible and visible alarm and reminds householder, occur so as to avoid because of the situation that householder stays out or toilet is flooded during sleeping at night, cause irremediable property loss, even casualties, when fire or earthquake occur, alarm is sent at the first time to indoor occupant, avoid life security risk caused by withdrawing not in time, and property loss.

title_en: Method and apparatus for supporting wireless emergency alert messages
abstract_en: methods may include utilizing binary value 0000 as an update number in a wireless emergency alert message having short text, utilizing binary value 0001 as an update number in a wireless emergency alert message having long text, broadcasting a short text wireless alert message to a mobile device  on a second or third generation (2G/3G) network, and broadcasting a long text wireless emergency alert message to a mobile device  on a Long Term Evolution (LTE) network.

title_en: Slope landslide early warning method based on NPR cable slip force monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope landslide early warning method based on NPR cable slip force monitoring. Firstly, constructing an evidence reasoning model for predicting the sliding force of the side slope, wherein input variables of the evidence reasoning model are a sliding force monitoring value acquired by an NPR anchor cable sensor at the current moment and a difference value between the sliding force monitoring value at the current moment and a sliding force monitoring value at the historical moment, and output variables of the evidence reasoning model are predicted values of the future sliding force of the side slope; then constructing a Reference Evidence Matrix (REM) to model a mapping relation between input and output variables; when the input variable samples are acquired online, the evidence of activation of the input variable samples is obtained through REM, all the evidences of activation of the input variable samples are fused through an evidence reasoning algorithm to obtain a fusion result, the predicted value of the slope sliding force at the future moment is calculated through the fusion result, and an alarm threshold value is set to implement out-of-limit alarm; by utilizing a sequential linear programming method, REM is updated in real time for predicting the sliding force at the next moment, and the predicted value of the method has higher prediction precision.

title_en: Integrated flood disaster accurate monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated flood disaster accurate monitoring and early warning method, which belongs to the field of disaster monitoring and comprises the following specific steps: (1) collecting information of each area; (2) flood disaster information prediction; (3) performing statistical planning on each region; (4) analyzing and optimizing the information prediction; according to the invention, the water level information is monitored in real time by arranging the laser radar, so that the estimation accuracy of the water level can be greatly improved, the collection can be kept stable under different illumination conditions, the prediction neural model can be automatically updated, the manual update of workers is not needed, the workload of the workers is reduced, and the working efficiency of the workers is improved.

title_en: Forest fire alarm system based on remote sensing
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of incomplete coverage, early warning lag, high false alarm rate, lack of an optimization mechanism and the like in the traditional forest fire monitoring, the invention provides a forest fire alarm system based on remote sensing. The system comprises a perception layer, a decision layer and a verification and feedback layer, wherein the perception layer acquires multi-mode data through the cooperation of a geostationary orbit satellite group, a low orbit satellite constellation and an unmanned aerial vehicle/high altitude pseudolite, the decision layer quantifies original data into abnormal indexes, hierarchical early warning is realized through a fluid mechanics-chemical reaction coupling model and a deep neural network, the verification and feedback layer confirms in situ through the unmanned aerial vehicle to form true value data, model parameters are adjusted for false alarm/missing report backtracking, and a case is used as a sample to update the neural network to form closed loop learning. The system realizes early-stage precursor recognition and accurate early warning of fire, and improves the timeliness and accuracy of prevention and control.

title_en: Offshore wind power autonomous lifting platform prevention device and lifting control method thereof
abstract_en: An offshore wind power autonomous lifting platform prevention device and a lifting control method thereof belong to the technical field of offshore wind power generation and aim to solve the problems that the height cannot be adjusted by a traditional fixed wind power foundation, a mooring cable is broken or a platform is overturned easily when the traditional floating platform is passively anti-platform, and a high-level wind turbine bears a large load in a typhoon stage, so that the damage rate is high; the device comprises a cross-shaped bottom foundation, a middle sleeve-sleeve rod lifting mechanism, at least three hydraulic rods, a cylindrical buoyancy cabin capable of filling and draining and a ballast water system, wherein the fan tower is fixedly connected with the sleeve, the hydraulic rods drive the sleeve to lift along the sleeve, the buoyancy cabin is coaxial with the sleeve and the buoyancy is regulated by the ballast water to assist in action, the control method comprises the steps of retracting the hydraulic rods and draining the buoyancy cabin when typhoon is early-warning, enabling a fan to sink to the sea surface to avoid a strong wind layer, injecting water into the buoyancy cabin after typhoon, extending the hydraulic rods, and resetting the fan to generate power.
assignees: THREE GORGES ZHUJIANG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;THREE GORGES NEW ENERGY SHANTOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Safety cabinet
title_ko: 안전물품의 사용이 편리한 소방용 안전보관함
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting safety storage box, which is installed in public places such as a subway and enables people to draw out necessary safety goods immediately and use the safety goods in accordance with disaster situations by storing the safety goods such as a fire extinguisher, an emergency lantern, and a smoke proof mask while issuing warnings when an emergency occurs. The firefighting safety storage box enables safety goods to be used conveniently by rapidly using the safety goods stored in the box by automatically opening a locking door of closing a storage space for safety goods by a control unit when a disaster occurs. The firefighting safety storage box according to the present invention: enables the rapid use of safety goods since a person does not need to forcefully damage a transparent window of the storage space of safety goods and separately release the locking state of a locking door when an emergency occurs; and enables a rapid and safe evacuation by inducing to an evacuation path and guiding the position of the storage box even in a situation in which a view is not secured by radiating a laser beam with various warnings.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하철 등의 공공장소에 설치되어 긴급 상황 발생 시 경보를 발령함과 동시에, 소화기, 비상용 랜턴, 방연마스크 등과 같은 안점물품이 비치되어 재난 상황에 따라 대피자가 필요한 안전물품을 바로 꺼내어 사용할 수 있도록 하는 소방용 안전보관함에 관한 것으로, 재난 발생 시 제어부에 의해 안전물품 수납공간을 폐쇄하는 잠금도어가 자동으로 개방되어 함체에 비치된 안점물품을 바로 신속하게 사용할 수 있도록 하는 안전물품의 사용이 편리한 소방용 안전보관함에 관한 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명에 따른 소방용 안전보관함은 긴급 상황 발생 시 대피자가 안전물품 수납공간의 투명창을 강제로 파손하거나, 잠금도어의 잠금을 별도로 해제할 필요가 없기 때문에 안전물품의 신속한 사용이 가능하며, 각종 경보와 함께 레이저 광선이 조사되어, 시야 확보가 안 된 상황에서도 대피로 유도 및 함체의 위치를 안내하여 신속하고 안전한 대피가 이루어지도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for Synchronizing Warning Processing And Mobility Management Device Therefor
title_ko: 경보처리를 동기화하는 방법 및 이동성 관리장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method for synchronizing warning processing and a mobility management device therefor. According to an aspect of the present disclosure, provided are the method for synchronizing warning processing for synchronizing a warning processing method between a terminal and a core network based on the version of a warning processing mapping table, and the mobility management device.
abstract_ko:
본 개시는 경보처리(warning processing)를 동기화하는 방법 및 이를 위한 이동성 관리장치(mobility management device)를 제공한다. 
본 개시의 일 측면에 의하면, 경보처리 매핑테이블(warning processing mapping table)의 버전(version)을 기초로 단말과 핵심망(core network) 간 경보를 처리하는 방식을 동기화하는 경보처리 동기화 방법 및 이동성 관리장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Escape indicating means, device, control system and storage medium
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of escape indicating means, device, control system and storage mediums.Method includes when receiving security alarm signal, obtain warning area information, according to warning area information, obtain default best-effort path, obtain the device identification of the corresponding each escape prompt equipment of default best-effort path, when detecting default best-effort path, there are when personnel, it generates and pushes multiple and different more new signals respectively to the corresponding escape prompt equipment of each device identification, each more new signal is used to make the instruction information update of each escape prompt equipment, and preset rule variation is presented in the instruction information updated in counterpart personnel's escape direction of default best-effort path.So that the prompt information of each escape prompt equipment is distinct, escape personnel can intuitively determine best-effort path according to the instruction information of rule variation, increase the escape probability of escape personnel, to improve the escape reliability of escape personnel.
assignees: HUNAN HUIBO ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: SAM-based remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device based on SAM, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a proper SAM model version, configuring an operation environment, then carrying out pit target detection on a remote sensing image pit based on a YOLOv model after training, generating a target detection frame, and inputting the generated target detection frame as a boundary frame prompt (box prompt) and a remote sensing image into the SAM model together to obtain a remote sensing image pit segmentation result.
