The method can not only improve the precision and efficiency of pit extraction, but also adapt to the pit extraction requirements of different scales and complexity, provides powerful support for the fields of water resource management, environment monitoring, disaster early warning and the like, has higher accuracy in pit detection, has good robustness and high running speed, is light in weight and easy to deploy, and provides an innovative application for the field of pit water surface extraction.
assignees: ZHONGKE XINGTU ZHIYUAN TECH ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Control device and power storage system
abstract_en: To provide, for example, a control device and a power storage system that can control the charge and discharge of the power storage device in an optimum mode even when a power failure occurs after a weather warning is canceled.SOLUTION: A control device includes an acquisition unit that acquires weather information, and a mode switching unit that switches the charge/discharge control mode of a power storage device. When weather information acquired by the acquisition unit is issuance of weather warning, the mode switching unit switches the charge/discharge control mode from the normal mode to the disaster mode. When the weather warning continues before a first switching time elapses since switching of the charge/discharge control mode to the disaster mode, the mode switching unit switches the charge/discharge control mode from the disaster mode to the normal mode after the first switching time elapses from a time when the weather warning is determined to continue.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of city VANET multi-hop broadcasting methods based on competition and finite state machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on the city VANET multi-hop broadcasting methods competed with finite state machine, and the state of each node includes：N is not receive message；P is that possible receive message；R is to confirm to receive message.It learns the emergency message of the subsidiary sending node list of source node construction of emergency episode and broadcast, oneself state is set to R；Its neighbor node state was changed to P if being N originally；The node for receiving the emergency message first finds node in this message sending node and the included sending node list of message in local neighbor table, if their states are set to R in the presence of if.Then recipients calculate the stand-by period of itself according to relative distance, the communication quality etc. between upper hop node.The node that stand-by period terminates at first can just update emergency message and broadcast, and new information can be considered implicit ACK.If existence is not the neighbours of R, sender understands Retransmission timeout.The present invention is suitable for multiple network topology, real-time transmitting of the guarantee emergency message in the whole network.

title_en: Intelligent tripod
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent tripod, which comprises a moving frame and two frame plates, wherein the two frame plates are rotatably arranged at the top of the moving frame, the top of each frame plate is provided with a connecting rod which penetrates through two sides of the frame plate and is in sliding connection with the frame plate, and the frame plates are provided with reflective belts; a central controller is arranged in the movable frame, a plurality of flashing lamps are arranged on the frame plates, a laser lamp is fixed on one frame plate, an ultrasonic ranging sensor is arranged on the other frame plate, and the flashing lamps, the laser lamp and the ultrasonic ranging sensor are all electrically connected with the central controller; the central controller comprises a controller; the device carries out the high-speed vehicle in intelligent response rear through well accuse ware and ultrasonic ranging sensor to carry out the warning of multimode to accident vehicle and high-speed vehicle in rear through alarm module and dangerous feedback module, effectively avoid accident vehicle to take place the possibility of secondary accident, and effectively remind accident vehicle driver and crew to withdraw, reduce the production of casualties.
assignees: JUNIOR HIGH SCHOOL AFFILIATED TO CHONGQING NORMAL UNIV

title_en: Disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning method applied to a cloud edge cooperative system, and belongs to the field of disaster early warning. The cloud edge cooperative system comprises a cloud server, edge nodes and a plurality of edge terminals, wherein the cloud server is connected with the plurality of edge terminals through the edge nodes, and a plurality of disaster early warning models are stored in the cloud server. The method comprises the following steps: the cloud server selects a target early-warning model from a plurality of disaster early-warning models according to task properties, and transmits the target early-warning model to a plurality of edge terminals through edge nodes; the initial confidence coefficient threshold value of the target early warning model is regulated down, result data with the occurrence probability of the predicted target being greater than the initial confidence coefficient threshold value is summarized to an edge node, and the result data is uploaded to a cloud server after being re-marked; the re-labeled data is used as a training set, the target early-warning model of the edge node is trained again, and the target early-warning model is updated; replacing the current target early warning model; and carrying out disaster early warning through the target early warning model.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE JIAXING

title_en: Intelligent mine water disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and method for mine water damage, and relates to the technical field of mine water damage monitoring. The early warning method comprises water inrush risk early warning, well flooding risk early warning and water environment risk early warning, wherein the water inrush risk early warning is used for processing water inrush time sequence data through a sliding window, three-level water inrush risk early warning is excited continuously for three times in an abnormal mode, the water inrush quantity can be updated and predicted, the well flooding risk early warning is used for setting three-level thresholds based on the double ratio of water inrush quantity to water drainage capacity and water sump volume, the water environment risk early warning is used for monitoring water quality according to national standards, and early warning is carried out according to pollution risk indexes in three levels. The early warning system comprises a monitoring unit, a data management unit, a water damage early warning unit and a visualization unit. According to the invention, through multi-parameter collaborative monitoring, intelligent analysis and expert judgment, the accuracy, timeliness and intelligent level of water damage early warning can be obviously improved.

title_en: Multifunctional projection exit light
title_ko: 다기능 프로젝션 유도등
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multifunctional projection exit light is provided to display various pictograms with one exit light by displaying the pictograms implemented by a projection, and to transmit spot images to a central control chamber in case of urgent emergency through bidirectional communications, and to guide an escape in a right direction according to the spot condition by changing the pictogram of the exit light in a remote place. CONSTITUTION: A projection exit light includes a light source(212), a pictogram board(213), an optical mechanism(216), and a screen(220). The pictogram board is separated from the light source, and generates a pictogram by selectively transmitting light. The optical mechanism processes the pictogram to be formed on the screen. The screen displays the pictogram which passes through the optical mechanism. [Reference numerals] (202) Intensity of illumination; (211) Power unit; (212) Light source; (213) Pictogram 1; (214) Pictogram selection unit; (215) Control unit; (216) Optical unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유도등의 그림문자를 프로젝션을 이용하여 구현하고 피난자의 신속한 피난을 도와줄 수 있는 경보기능 및 피난자와 중앙 통제실과의 영상통신기능 등을 포함하는 다기능 프로젝션 유도등에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 유도등은 광원과, 다수의 그림문자 표지를 구비하고 있고 광원에 의하여 발생한 빛을 선택적으로 투과시켜 그림문자 이미지를 생성하기 위한 그림 문자판과, 그림문자판의 다수의 그림문자 중 하나를 선택하여 표시하도록 하는 그림문자 선택부와, 그림문자 이미지를 광학적으로 처리하여 스크린에 맞게 그림문자가 맺히게 하는 광학 메커니즘과, 광학 메커니즘을 통과한 그림문자를 표시하는 스크린으로 구성된다. 따라서 본 발명에 따르면 다수의 그림문자 표지를 준비한 후 설정이나 원격 선택신호에 따라 선택된 그림문자를 표시하여 동일한 유도등으로 다양한 종류의 그림문자를 표시할 수 있고, 이에 따라 피난경로가 변경되어도 유도등을 교체할 필요가 없어 사용이 편리하며 화재발생위치에 따라 올바른 방향으로 피난하도록 유도할 수 있다. 그리고 일련의 에니메이션용 그림문자들을 준비해 놓은 후 순차적으로 그림문자를 선택하여 반복 표시할 경우에는 에니메이션과 같은 동적인 그림문자를 피난표지로서 표시할 수도 있다.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and method for outputting a alarm, and system including a locking device connected to the electronic device
title_ko: 경보를 출력하는 전자 장치 및 방법, 및 상기 전자 장치와 연결되는 잠금 장치를 포함하는 시스템
abstract_en: Various embodiments of the present invention relate to an electronic device for outputting an alarm, to a method thereof, and to a system including a locking apparatus connected with the electronic device. To this end, various embodiments of the present invention include a connection terminal and a processor in the electronic device. The processor may be set to detect connection with the locking apparatus through the connection terminal, receive an identifier of the locking apparatus from the locking apparatus, check the received identifier to set the electronic device to an alarm mode, detect disconnection between the electronic device and the locking apparatus, and output an alarm in response to the detected disconnection. Other embodiments may be possible.
abstract_ko:
다양한 실시 예들은 경보를 출력하는 전자 장치 및 방법, 및 상기 전자 장치와 연결되는 잠금 장치를 포함하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 다양한 실시 예들은 전자 장치에 있어서, 연결 단자, 및 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 연결 단자를 통해 잠금 장치와의 연결을 감지하고, 상기 잠금 장치로부터 상기 잠금 장치의 식별자를 수신하고, 상기 수신된 식별자를 확인하여 상기 전자 장치를 경보 모드로 설정하고, 상기 전자 장치와 상기 잠금 장치간의 연결 해제를 감지하고, 상기 감지된 연결 해제에 응답하여 경보를 출력하도록 설정될 수 있다. 다른 실시 예들도 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: An system and method for preventing child safety accident using an intelligent boarding and alerting apparatus
title_ko: 지능형 승하차 알림 장치를 이용한 어린이 안전사고 방지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system which applies an intelligent getting on and off system to provide a system which can prevent the number of remaining children and car accidents through event occurrences such as shock detection, movement detection, pressure detection, and voice detection, when children fall asleep or hide in the car and a person in charge is not aware off whether the children got off the car. As a result, parents monitors school bus route to and from school buses for young children in daycare centers and kindergartens with software in real time, and a location to and from the school can be changed and modified through two-way communication means when an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지능형 승하차 시스템을 적용하여 잠 들었을 때, 숨거나 하는 경우 하차유무를 책임자가 인지를 못하는 경우에 대하여 잔류인원의 충격 감지, 움직임 감지, 압력감지, 음성감지를 이벤트 발생을 통해 어린이 잔류인원과 차량 사고를 방지할 수 있는 시스템을 제안하고, 그에 따른 소프트웨어로 어린이집이나 유치원 등을 다니는 어린 자녀들이 타고 있는 통학버스의 등하교 경로를 부모가 실시간으로 모니터링하고 긴급 상황 발생 시 양방향 통신수단을 통하여, 등하교 위치를 변경신청 및 수정할 수 있는 지능형 승하차 알림 장치를 이용한 어린이 안전사고 방지 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Application that enables car alarm to send signals to cell phone
title_ko: 자동차 도난 경보음 발생 시 휴대전화로 알림을 보내는 애플리케이션
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system connected via Bluetooth. More specifically, it is possible to cancel the alarm sound through a video and a notification sent to a mobile phone of a false vehicle theft alarm. Through the present invention, it is possible to prevent an attempt to steal a vehicle, and to quickly respond to annoying people around by the false alarm sound. The present invention connects the smart key of the vehicle, the sensor, and the mobile phone of the user through the application, so that the image and notification recorded in a black box are transmitted to the mobile phone of the user, when the theft attempt or a big shock is received through the sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 블루투스를 통해 연결된 시스템에 대한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 잘못된 자동차 도난 경보를 영상과 휴대전화로 전송되는 알림을 통해 경보음을 해제시킬 수 있는 것이다. 이 발명을 통해 자동차 도난 시도를 막고, 잘못된 경보음에 의해 주변인들에게 민폐를 끼치는 것에 빠르게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 본 발명은 애플리케이션을 통하여 자동차의 스마트키, 센서, 사용자의 휴대전화를 연결함으로써 도난 시도나 큰 충격이 센서를 통하여 접수될 경우 블랙박스에서 녹화한 영상과 알림이 사용자의 휴대전화로 전송된다.

title_en: Compact type apparatus for storage of cable
title_ko: 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compact cable storage apparatus which comprises: an inner disc with spiral tracks formed on the front and back surfaces; an external enclosure joined at the front and rear surfaces with the inner disc interposed therebetween; and a handle and cable guider block rotating the internal disc to efficiently wind a cable pulled out to the outside. According to the present invention, the compact cable storage apparatus provides advantages of providing convenience of use to allow efficient withdrawal or retraction of cables without entanglement, preventing a worker's stress caused by tangled cables, increasing workability, and shortening work time. In addition, a thin internal disc with a thickness slightly larger than the diameter of two cable strands to be used can be manufactured, thereby providing an advantage of facilitating carry during working in power outlets, manholes, and high-altitude work areas. In addition, the cable can be wound immediately on a site after use, thereby providing an advantage of preventing accidents caused by unattended cables (1).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치는 정면과 후면에 나선형 트랙이 형성된 내부 원판과, 내부 원판을 사이에 두고 정면과 후면에서 결합되는 외부 함체와, 내부 원판을 회전시켜 외부로 인출된 케이블을 원활하게 감을 수 있는 핸들과 케이블 가이더블록을 구비하고 있기 때문에 케이블의 엉킴없이 인출 또는 인입이 원활하도록 하는 사용의 편리성을 부여하고, 케이블의 엉킴으로 인한 작업자의 스트레스를 예방함과 동시에 작업성 향상 및 작업시간 단축하고, 사용하는 케이블 2가닥 직경보다 조금 큰 정도의 두께로 얇은 내부 원판으로 제작이 가능하므로 전력구, 맨홀 및 고소 작업개소 작업시 휴대가 용이하며, 케이블 사용 후 현장에서 즉시 감을 수 있으므로 방치되는 케이블(1)로 인한 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Automatic management system for fire safety equipment
abstract_en: An automatic management system for fire-fighting safety equipment includes at least one fire-extinguishing device, at least one maintenance server and a management server, in which the fire-extinguishing device includes a pressure gauge head and a wireless transmitting module which is linked by the pressure gauge head and can send out a warning signal when the pressure in a steel cylinder exceeds a preset pressure range, the maintenance server includes a network module and a maintenance control module which is electrically connected with the network module and stores a form to be maintained, the management server includes a wireless receiving module for receiving the warning signal, a management control module for storing an equipment database and a network module electrically connected with the management control module, the equipment database has at least one equipment data set corresponding to the fire-extinguishing device and the maintenance server, the management server updates the information in the equipment data set in the maintenance server through the network after receiving the warning signal The form to be repaired is in the service device.

title_en: The three-dimensional dynamic safety management method of building enterprise's overall process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of three-dimensional dynamic safety management method of building enterprise's overall process.This method uses Bidirectional closed-loop function mode, handled by carrying out classification identification to the engineering project for entering security risk assessment storehouse in general headquarters of building enterprise aspect, produce engineering project security evaluation report, the three-dimensional dynamic security hidden danger monitoring model of engineering project is set up in secondary corporate's aspect and issues hidden danger warning information, carry out sensor in project management department, the real-time monitoring of video monitoring and artificial timing are patrolled and rectified and improved, the very first time carries out reply processing to security incident, immediate updating solid dynamic security hidden danger monitoring model, after engineering project terminates, study is updated to security risk assessment storehouse.The present invention carries out study recycling to building enterprise's safety management historical data, accomplish ex ante forecasting, early warning and prevention to potential safety hazard, accomplish that the very first time rationally tackles afterwards to security incident, be capable of the safety of effective guarantee building enterprise engineering project human, financial, and material resources, reduce loss.

title_en: A kind of arithmetic for real-time traffic flow detection early warning system based on Computerized three-dimensional scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of, and the arithmetic for real-time traffic flow based on Computerized three-dimensional scene detects early warning system, including vehicle detection unit, congested link detection unit, pavement detection unit, central processing unit, prewarning unit and wireless communication module；Occupation rate and the magnitude of traffic flow of the vehicle detection unit for detecting vehicle in real time；Congested link detection unit for detecting track width section vehicle flowrate, inlet and outlet ring road vehicle flowrate and viaduct uphill way vehicle flowrate in real time；Water film thickness, visibility and temperature road on and humidity of the pavement detection unit for detecting road surface in real time；The system improves the specific aim, real-time and validity that highway traffic control department actively prevents traffic accident measure, technical support is provided to reduce regional highway network traffic hazard degree, preventing particularly serious road traffic accident, technical support and aid decision are provided for the traffic safety monitoring and emergency command of national A-road net.

title_en: A kind of community's nine small place dangerous situations management system and application method based on LoRaWAN networks
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of community's nine small place dangerous situations management system and its application method based on LoRaWAN networks, including fire-fighting cloud platform, LoRaWAN cordless communication networks and detecting alarm, wherein, fire-fighting cloud platform is responsible for including the maintenance management of LoRaWAN wireless networks, data collection and distribution, role and access control, notice service as operation platform；The LoRaWAN wireless communication networks pass to the data that detecting alarm device detects in cloud platform using LoRaWAN gateways；The detecting alarm is responsible for real-time detecting fire alarm and starts buzzer, while passing through LoRaWAN Radio Transmission Technologys, transmission alarm notification to cloud platform.The present invention has the deployment of the wisdom fire-fighting in nine small place of community simple, implementation need not connect up, without building pre-buried mounting box, construction is simple, Internet of Things cloud platform has map display function, can show alarm place, data real-time update, other big data platforms can be docked to realize that system interconnects, reach the advantageous effect of the Display on the same screen of all information.
assignees: SHANDONG GUYUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for pre-detecting signs of abnormality in nuclear power plant equipment including process for determining equipment importance and alarm validity
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device, including determination of importance of the device and validity of the alarm. The method for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device includes: the first step is as follows: determining, by the early warning processing means, whether the plant monitoring signal value is outside of a normal operating range using a weighting value based on importance data for each monitoring variable that has been previously analyzed by an operator; the second step is as follows: generating an alarm by the early alarm processing means when the plant monitoring signal value is outside the normal operating range; and a third step of: determining, by an alarm determination device, whether the generated alarm is a valid alarm to be analyzed and tracked.
assignees: KOREA HYDRO NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Safety precaution system for highway construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety early warning system for highway construction, which is applied to the technical field of safety early warning, and comprises a construction fence wall, an early warning column module, an acousto-optic early warning board, a ranging camera module, a vehicle deflection module, a deflection roller, a broken wall cylinder, a winding wheel net and a reverse hook nail, wherein the ranging camera module is used for carrying out camera shooting monitoring on abnormal vehicles which drive to the construction fence wall, and the acousto-optic early warning board is used for warning the vehicles and constructors according to the monitoring condition, the staff of being convenient for makes the correct safe action of withdrawing, before unusual vehicle is about to collide to construction fence wall simultaneously, utilize the rolling ability of deflection roller, change the direction of travel of unusual vehicle, thereby effectively avoid the direct striking construction fence wall of vehicle, and in the wheel is pinned into through the barb, thereby realize breaking of broken wall section of thick bamboo, the wheel is locked in the parcel of the winding wheel net that is pulled out, realize the braking effect to unusual vehicle, effectively reduce the destructive power of vehicle striking, realize providing the protection for the driver of vehicle.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION FIFTH ENG BUREAU SICHUAN CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-camera collaborative analysis dynamic locking vehicle safety early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine inclined shaft vehicle safety early warning system and a mine inclined shaft vehicle safety early warning method based on multi-camera collaborative analysis and dynamic locking mechanism. The system adopts a deep learning technology to detect the targets of the vehicle and personnel, extracts the appearance characteristics of the vehicle through ReID networks, and combines a Kalman filter to realize the tracking of the vehicle across cameras and the judgment of the movement direction. When the vehicle is detected to enter a specific road section, the system automatically updates the locking state of the area, starts the personnel detection module, immediately triggers an audible and visual alarm and reports to the monitoring platform once the personnel is found to enter the locking area. According to the technical scheme, curve monitoring blind areas are effectively eliminated, the accuracy and response instantaneity of collision early warning of people and vehicles are remarkably improved, reliable technical guarantee is provided for mine transportation safety, and good practicability and popularization value are achieved.

title_en: Coal mine rock burst danger space-time early warning method and system based on multi-source image data fusion, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rock burst danger space-time early warning method and system based on multi-source image data fusion, storage media and equipment, wherein 1, multi-source heterogeneous data are acquired, 2, data preprocessing, 3, gridding cloud pictures of various data are constructed, 4, a rock burst early warning model based on an MSA-Unet encoder-decoder network structure is constructed, 5, model training and optimization are carried out, 6, early warning areas and data are dynamically updated, 7, end-to-end reasoning is carried out to generate a rock burst danger early warning cloud picture, and 8, a cyclic early warning mechanism taking time or a footage distance as a trigger condition is established. The multi-source heterogeneous data are converted into uniform image representation, so that the problem of multi-source data fusion and utilization of rock burst disaster geological data, microseismic monitoring data and the like is solved, meanwhile, the rock burst danger early warning and evaluation of the advanced area of the mining working face are realized based on the space-time division of the data, and the rock burst danger space-time dynamic early warning of the coal mining working face is realized.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Molester-Repelling Device of the Smart-Phone that have the function for the emergency rescue request and the perverting device from a menace
title_ko: 경보싸이렌 및 경광램프 및 긴급구조요청음성 및 전기충격봉이 작동되는 긴급구조요청 및 치한퇴치 기능을 가진 스마트폰 착탈형 치한퇴치기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a molester repelling device detachable from a smartphone having emergency request for rescue operating a warning siren, a warning lamp, an emergency voice request for rescue, an electric shock bar and molester repelling functions which are automatically operated when a user pulls out a button for an emergency request for rescue for 3-10 seconds when the user is threatened by an approaching robber, a kidnapper, a sex offender, or the like in a dark alley or a lonely place.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 후미진 골목이나 으슥한 장소에서 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등이 접근할 경우 위협을 느낌과 동시에 긴급구조요청버튼을 3~10초간 당기게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광램프 및 긴급구조요청음성 및 전기충격봉이 작동되는 긴급구조요청 및 치한퇴치 기능을 가진 스마트폰 착탈형 치한퇴치기에 관한 것으로 서, 
상술하면 긴급구조요청버튼을 3초정도 당김과 동시에 경보싸이렌이 발령되고 긴급구조요청음성[예 ; 살려주세요]과 경보싸이렌이 반복적으로 일정시간동안 자동으로 지속 송출되며, 동시에 적색과 청색으로 구성된 경광램프가 반복적으로 일정시간동안 점멸이 자동으로 지속된다. 그리고 긴급구조요청버튼을 3~10초정도 당기게 됨과 동시에 전기충격기가 작동하게 되는 스마트폰 착탈형 치한퇴치기에 관한 것이다. 
이와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은, 긴급구조요청버튼을 3초정도 당김과 동시에 경보싸이렌이 발령되고 긴급구조요청음성[예 ; 살려주세요]과 경보싸이렌이 반복적으로 일정시간동안 자동으로 지속 송출되며, 동시에 적색과 청색으로 구성된 경광램프가 반복적으로 일정시간동안 점멸이 자동으로 지속되고, 더불어  전기충격기가 작동하게 되게 하는데 있어서,  
상기의 치한퇴치기본체(1)는 작동회로부(100)와 비상조작버튼(101) 및 경보스피커(102) 및 청색경광램프(103a) 및 적색경광램프(103b) 및 전기충격침A(104a) 및 전기충격침B(104b) 및 전원공급단자(106) 및 경보해제버튼(107) 및  청적LED램프(108) 및 스마트폰착탈홀더(200) 및 카메라용홀(300)를 가지는 것을 특징으로 하는 단계,  
; 상기의 작동회로부(100)에 경보사이렌발령회로(100a) 및 경광램프작동회로(100b) 및 구조요청음발생회로(100c) 및 전기충격기작동회로(100d)를 구성한 것이 특징인 단계와, 
; 상기의 치한퇴치기본체(1)상에 경보발생홀(102a)을 형성한 것이 특징인 단계와,  
; 상기의 치한퇴치기본체(1)의 상단 말단부에 전기충격침A(104a) 및 전기충격침B(104b)을 구성한 것에 특징이 있다. 
본 발명의 경우, 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등과 대면할 경우 긴급구조요청버튼을 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광램프 및 긴급구조요청음성 및 전기충격기이 작동되므로 서 누군가 위험에 처한 상황이라는 것을 알려 주므로서 주변에서 도움을 얻을 수 있고, 또한 주위의 도움이 지연되거나 불가항력의 상황에서 전기충격기으로 치한을 퇴치하거나 겁먹은 치한의 도주를 유도할 수도 있게 하여 위기로부터 안전하게 탈출할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Fire alarm siren detection real-time fire situation transmission robot
title_ko: 화재경보기 사이렌 감지 실시간 화재 상황 전송 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention can recognize a loud sound, such as the sound of a fire alarm siren and the sound of an explosion, or an alarm sound from a fire detector, move to the place where the loud sound is generated by using a noise direction sensor when an accident occurs, photograph an accident situation and transmit a photographed image to enable rapid identification of an accident situation, report the accident, and distinguish it as a non-fire report. The present invention comprises: a noise direction sensor for recognizing the arrival time of sound through three microphones; a calculation part for calculating the direction of the sound by calculating the time difference obtained through the sensor; a robot driving part which enables a robot to navigate in the direction of the sound recognized by a motor and a wheel and changes the angle of a camera through a servo-motor; the camera capable of photographing a site; and a transmitting/receiving part capable of controlling the robot by using a signal received through an external WIFI server according to a user′s need and transmitting the image photographed by the camera.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재경보기 사이렌 및 폭발 등 큰소리 또는 화재감지기의 경보를 인식하여 안전사고 발생 시 소음 방향 감지 센서를 통해 큰소리가 나는 곳으로 이동 후 사고 상황을 촬영, 영상을 전송하여 빠른 안전사고 현장 파악과 신고, 비화재보 구분이 가능하도록 한다. 본 발명은 세 개의 마이크를 통해 도착하는 소리의 시간을 인식하는 소음 방향 감지 센서; 센서를 통해 들어온 시간 차이를 계산해 소리의 방향을 계산하는 연산부; 모터와 바퀴로 인식한 소리의 방향으로 찾아가도록 해주고, 서보모터를 통해 카메라의 구도를 변경하는 로봇 구동부; 현장을 촬영할 수 있는 카메라; 사용자가 필요할 때 외부 WIFI 서버를 통해 받은 신호로 로봇을 제어하고, 카메라로 촬영한 영상을 송신할 수 있는 송수신부를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of balance mechanism that CTP is pressed from both sides with version tail
abstract_en: The invention discloses the balance mechanisms that a kind of CTP is pressed from both sides with version tail, including bottom plate, column is welded at the top of the bottom plate, the side of column offers mounting groove, mounting blocks are rotatably equipped in mounting groove, one end of mounting blocks extends to the outside of mounting groove and is welded with an edition tail folder, version tail presss from both sides the side far from mounting blocks and is welded with first bevel gear, rotation hole is offered at the top of the bottom plate, rotating bar is rotatably equipped in rotation hole, the top of rotating bar is welded with second bevel gear, second bevel gear is engaged with first bevel gear, the bottom of bottom plate is equipped with runner, fixing groove is offered at the top of runner, rotating bar is slidably mounted in fixing groove, the top of the version tail folder is equipped with balance base.The configuration of the present invention is simple, easy to operate, quickly and easily, degree of regulation is high for the balance mechanism adjustment speed, and version tail folder can be intuitively observed by emergency warning lamp whether in equilibrium state, substantially increases the efficiency of CTP plate-making.
assignees: WEIFANG HUAGUANG DIGITAL EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-parameter Internet of things monitoring system and method for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter Internet of things monitoring system and a multi-parameter Internet of things monitoring method for a power transmission line, wherein the system comprises a three-dimensional model building module, an error factor generating module and an early warning and routing inspection module; the three-dimensional model building module is used for obtaining parameters to build a three-dimensional model and judging whether the distance between the tower and the reference platform generates deviation or not so as to enable the tower to be in a settlement state; the error factor generation module is used for acquiring local terrain and weather factors, establishing a distance vector according to the distance between the tower and the reference station, and analyzing whether the local terrain and the weather factors are the reasons for causing the offset distance, so that the distance vector is updated; the early warning routing inspection module is used for acquiring a distance vector influenced by weather in the historical record, comparing the distance vector stored in the historical record with the updated distance vector, and analyzing whether the tower can generate large-amplitude settlement and early warning; therefore, the problem that the tower cannot be overhauled due to sudden large-amplitude settlement of the tower is solved.
assignees: JIANGSU JOTRY ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for monitoring and evaluating running state of power grid in real time
abstract_en: A method and a device for monitoring and evaluating the running state of a power grid in real time are provided, wherein the method comprises the following steps: each complex event processing engine acquires actual power grid change events of each type from the D5000 data bus; if the actual power grid change event is normal, the complex event processing engine evaluates the actual power grid change event by utilizing an electronization rule in the rule engine; if the actual power grid change event is abnormal, the complex event processing engine triggers the power grid virtual model to update based on the actual power grid change event to obtain a simulated power grid change event, the simulated power grid change event is obtained, and the simulated power grid change event is evaluated by utilizing an electronic rule in the rule engine. By the method and the device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the running state of the power grid can be monitored and evaluated in real time, and early warning can be sent out to key and major hidden danger of the power grid, so that the risk and influence of major accidents are reduced.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Operation vulnerability early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation vulnerability early warning method, an operation vulnerability early warning system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vulnerability early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an asset account library and a vulnerability library, wherein the vulnerability library comprises a security vulnerability early warning library and a security information vulnerability library; comparing the vulnerability information in the security vulnerability early warning library with the asset information in the asset account library, and storing the corresponding vulnerability information into the security information vulnerability library if the version information of the asset information is within the security vulnerability early warning range of the vulnerability information; and performing risk assessment on the vulnerability information stored in the security information vulnerability database, and determining a security vulnerability early warning report strategy according to an assessment result. According to the method, the device and the system, the affected assets are acquired, identified and evaluated, related responsible persons are associated and notified, the security vulnerability is identified, early-warned and repaired in real time and efficiently, potential safety hazards and security risks of enterprise unit information are reduced, and the security of enterprise operation units is improved.
assignees: ANHUI IND HULIAN DATA INTELLIGENT INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring-based natural disaster early warning and responding method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring-based power system natural disaster early warning and responding method, which relates to the technical field of power early warning response and comprises the following steps of data analysis and processing, wherein the data analysis and processing utilizes a long-short-period memory network to combine with a Bayesian network to analyze and process real-time monitoring data in a power system, a scheduling scheme is generated, the state of the power system is updated in real time and an optimal scheduling scheme is generated based on a multi-source data fusion and optimization method combining a Kalman filter and a genetic algorithm, an emergency response strategy is generated, the influence of a natural disaster on the power system is simulated in real time in a virtual model through a digital twin technology and a self-adaptive dynamic programming method, and an emergency response strategy is provided, and anomaly detection and self-healing are performed by combining big data analysis with edge calculation to perform anomaly detection and self-healing on the running state of the power system.
assignees: TIELING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Tamper-proof early warning method and device for container application apparatus, storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a tamper-proof early warning method, a tamper-proof early warning device, tamper-proof early warning equipment, tamper-proof early warning storage medium and tamper-proof early warning computer program product for container application, and relates to the technical field of container security, wherein the tamper-proof early warning method comprises the steps of constructing a container mirror image corresponding to a basic mirror image, and embedding a monitoring dependent program in the container mirror image; the method comprises the steps of creating and starting a target container based on a container mirror image, running a container application in the target container through a monitoring dependent program, monitoring the container application, carrying out validity authentication on a change event when the change event occurs in the container application, and sending an early warning notice if the container application is tampered according to a validity authentication result. According to the application, the change event in the container application is monitored while the container application in the target container is operated by the monitoring dependent program, so that whether the container application is tampered or not can be accurately judged according to the validity authentication result corresponding to the change event, and an early warning notification is sent when the container application is tampered is determined, so that the occurrence of safety accidents is prevented.

title_en: Urban disaster risk studying and judging method and device
abstract_en: A city disaster risk studying and judging method and device comprises the steps of obtaining a weather early warning area according to weather early warning information, obtaining a flood early warning area according to water condition early warning, carrying out space superposition on the weather early warning area and the flood early warning area to determine a city area to be studied and judged, constructing a city disaster risk keyword library, distinguishing flood caused by heavy rain, geological disasters and secondary disaster risks thereof, constructing a large language model risk studying and judging prompt word, obtaining information about the heavy rain in social media, extracting disaster risk information from the information, obtaining potential extension risk semantic indexes according to the disaster risk information, obtaining and quantifying abnormal information in city mobile phone signaling before and after the heavy rain and traffic speed data of a floating car GPS, obtaining potential extension risk human activity indexes according to the abnormal degree, constructing a city disaster chain semantic association network according to a causal association method, fusing multi-source data to update disaster evolution situation in real time, and outputting disaster information and possibly derived secondary disaster prediction.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: The method of noise elimination and update on accident alarm signal of accident notifying device
title_ko: 차량용 사고 알림 장치의 사고 발생 신호에 대한 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a noise removal and update method for an accident occurrence signal of an accident notification device for a vehicle. the noise removal and update method for an accident occurrence signal of an accident notification device for a vehicle according to the present invention is implemented by an external server and performs a noise removal and update function of the accident occurrence signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량용 사고 알림 장치의 사고 발생 신호에 대한 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 방법에 대한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 차량용 사고 알림 장치의 사고 발생 신호에 대한 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 방법은 외부 서버에 의해 구현되고 사고 발생 신호의 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 기능을 수행한다.

title_en: Attachable Approach Warning Apparatus and Operation Method Thereof
title_ko: 부착형 접근 경고 장치 및 그 동작방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 부착형 접근 경고 장치 및 그 동작방법에 관한 것으로, 부착수단을 통해 작업복 또는 자동차에 부착할 수 있게 형성되어, 외부의 충격으로부터 보호하는 하우징, 경고음 또는 경고음성을 출력하는 스피커, 경고등을 출력하는 램프, 일정 거리 내의 객체를 감지하는 센서, RFID를 포함하여 다른 장치와 통신하는 통신부 및 상기 하우징의 내부에 설치되어, 상기 센서 및 상기 RFID 중 적어도 하나를 통해 일정 거리 내에 상기 객체가 감지되면, 상기 스피커 및 상기 램프를 제어하여 경고를 출력하고, 상기 객체와의 거리 변화에 따라 단계적으로 상기 경고를 변경하여 출력하도록 제어하는 프로세서를 포함하여, 안전사고의 발생을 예방할 수 있고, 작업자를 위험으로부터 보호할 수 있어 작업자의 업무 효율을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Data backup and disaster recovery method and system based on data lake platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data backup and disaster recovery system based on a data lake platform, which comprises the following steps: the data backup module is used for backing up the data in the data lake; the snapshot module is used for generating corresponding snapshots when the data in the data lake is changed; the disaster recovery module is used for recovering the backup data and the snapshot; the control module is used for judging whether to send out information early warning according to whether the data backup process and the disaster recovery process are abnormal, and also used for adjusting the data backup mode according to the average time length of backup data recovery or executing the judgment function of marking validity of the metadata information by combining the data difference byte quantity ratio of the metadata information, and determining marking problem response according to the judgment result of the marking validity. The invention realizes the improvement of the effectiveness of data backup.

title_en: Subway construction period emergency resource management and allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency resource management in an iron construction period, in particular to a method and a system for managing and allocating emergency resources in the subway construction period, which comprises the steps of establishing a route map of an existing subway route, counting the types, the quantity and the coordinates of resources of an emergency resource warehouse, constructing a resource map, setting accident grades according to the accident types, determining required resources under each grade, determining the required resources according to the accident types and the grades when the emergency occurs, formulating a deployment scheme by combining a resource map, and informing a manager of the emergency and the deployment scheme to realize rapid deployment of the resources. According to the invention, accurate matching is realized by presetting an emergency resource list and combining with real-time engineering progress, emergency information is updated regularly to ensure accurate aging, the map realizes visual management, and the response sensitivity is improved by linkage of automatic monitoring and early warning, so that the emergency command and dispatch is more convenient, and the emergency response efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: DALIAN PUBLIC TRANSP CONSTRUCTION INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD;DALIAN PUBLIC TRANSP CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;BEIJING AGILETECH ENG CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: The disaster emergency alert system of using dps broadcast of t-dmb
title_ko: 지상파 디엠비 기반 디피에스 방송을 이용한 재난재해 긴급 경보 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster emergency alarm system using a eps broadcasting based on DMB is provided to innvotively reduce loss of a human life and property due to natural disaster or man-made disaster. CONSTITUTION: A disaster transmission system(20) uses a DPS standard of a T-DMB. A DPS accepting station(30) uses a DPS standard of T-DMB. A disaster emergency alarm system analyzes and expresses disaster information through the DPS standared of the T-DMB. The disaster transmission system converts information of text, image, video type ,which is disaster information, into XML which is suitable for DPS.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난재해 상황 시 재해지역의 피해 당사자들 또는 관계자들에게 신속하고 정확한 정보를 제공하기 위한 방송시스템에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는 재난 안전 대책본부, 도로 교통 센터, 기상청, 소방본부, 경찰청에서 제공하는 정보를  통합본부에서 데이터를 수집하여 정보의 유효성과 신뢰성을 검사한 후 T-DMB기반의 DPS방송을 통해 송출하여 각 재해지역의 수신 단말을 통해 관계자들에게 다양한 표출 매체를 통해 신속한 정보를 제공하는 기능을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명은 현재까지의 경보 시스템이 긴급 재난이나 , 재해 등이 발생하거나 , 예측이 되는 지역에 대한 경보 발령에 많은 시간이 소요되어, 실제적인 사전 예방 시스템으로서의 역할을 못하고 있고, 또한 정전으로 인해 재난경보 시스템이 제 기능을 못하는 문제를 보완하고, 경보 발령에 있어 즉시성과 신속성, 정확성을 향상하여 재난 경보 시스템으로서 갖추어야 할 수단과 , 경보 발령 시스템을 구비하게 함으로써 자연 재해나 인재 등으로 인한 막대한 인명 및 재산 손실을 획기적으로 줄이는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
       
     재난재해 경보시스템, 재난재해경보메시지 저작시스템, DPS 방송시스템, DPS 방송 수신 단말기, 포출 장비

title_en: Fault prediction method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium
title_ko: 고장 예측 방법, 장치, 전자 기기, 저장 매체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present application discloses a fault prediction method, apparatus, a storage medium, and a computer program and relates to fields of cloud computing and fault processing. An exemplary embodiment includes: acquiring a fault alarm request, wherein the fault alarm request is obtained by at least two fault triggering parameters of a fault generated by cloud operation, a hidden danger generated by cloud operation, and a change generated by terminal operation at a user level; analyzing the fault alarm request, to obtain at least two fault triggering parameters of the fault, the hidden danger, and the change; establishing an association between the at least two fault triggering parameters of the fault, the hidden danger, and the change, to obtain an association result; and predicting a fault causing the fault alarm request according to the association result, to obtain a fault prediction result. According to the present invention, the accuracy of fault prediction is improved.
abstract_ko: 본 출원은 고장 예측 방법, 장치, 전자 기기, 저장 매체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램을 개시하며, 클라우드 컴퓨팅, 고장 처리 분야에 관한 것이다. 구체적인 구현 방안은, 고장 경보 요청을 획득하고, 상기 고장 경보 요청은 클라우드의 실행으로 인해 발생하는 고장, 잠복해 있는 위험 및 단말 사용자 차원의 조작에서 발생하는 변경 중의 적어도 두가지 고장 트리거 파라미터에서 취득하며; 상기 고장 경보 요청을 해석하여, 상기 고장, 상기 잠복해 있는 위험 및 상기 변경 중의 적어도 두가지 고장 트리거 파라미터를 취득하고; 상기 고장, 상기 잠복해 있는 위험 및 상기 변경 중의 적어도 두가지 고장 트리거 파라미터 사이에 관련을 구축하여, 관련 결과를 취득하고; 상기 관련 결과에 따라 상기 고장 경보 요청을 일으키는 고장을 예측하고, 고장 예측 결과를 취득한다. 본 출원을 사용하면, 고장 예측의 정확성을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Phone Number-Based Digital Platform Integrated Management System and Method
title_ko: 전화번호 기반 사용자 인증 및 디지털 플랫폼 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The digital platform integrated management system automatically detects changes in a user's phone number by linking in real-time with a telecommunications carrier's HLR (Home Location Register) or HSS (Home Subscriber Server) system, automatically synchronizes change information with multiple affiliate platforms through API and SDK-based interfaces, and includes a dual identifier structure that updates only the internal identifier (Num-ID) while maintaining the external user ID. According to the present invention, this is a technology that automatically links with various affiliate platforms upon detection of a phone number change or abnormal status to realize user information protection, ensure authentication reliability, and prevent misdelivery.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자 전화번호를 기반으로 다양한 디지털 플랫폼을 통합적으로 관리하고, 사용자 상태에 따른 인증 처리 및 이상 상황 대응이 가능한 시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히, 전화번호 변경 시 이를 자동으로 감지하고, 제휴 플랫폼에 정보 변경을 실시간 동기화함으로써 사용자 정보의 최신성을 유지하고 오도착이나 인증 오류를 방지할 수 있도록 설계되었다. 
또한, 사용자의 앱 이용 로그, 메시지 응답률, 로그인 빈도 등의 데이터를 기반으로 인공지능(AI)이 행동을 예측하고, 번호 변경 또는 서비스 해지 가능성을 점수화하여 선제적으로 사용자에게 안내함으로써 불필요한 서비스 유지 비용을 줄인다. 
비정상 상태가 감지될 경우, 보호자 또는 최근 이용 제휴 플랫폼에 사전 알림을 전송하고, 다회 응답 실패 시에는 공공기관(경찰, 소방 등)에 사용자 정보, 최종 위치, 로그인 기록 등을 자동 전송하는 기능도 포함한다. 이 때 사용자의 사전 설정 및 개인정보 보호법을 기반으로 전송 정보는 필터링 처리된다. 
또한, 사용자가 사망하거나 인지 능력 저하 등으로 직접 시스템을 제어할 수 없는 경우, 사전 등록된 대리인에게 열람, 수정, 해지 등의 권한이 자동으로 이관된다. 모든 정보 변경 이력 및 인증 활동은 위변조 방지 기능이 적용된 인증서 형태로 발급된다. 
본 시스템은 제휴 플랫폼에 SDK 또는 API 형태로 제공되며, 인증 마크를 UI에 표시하거나 메시지 전송 시 오도착 방지 필터를 적용할 수 있도록 구성된다. 전체 구조는 다양한 응용 시나리오에 대응 가능하도록 설계되어 있으며, 고령화 사회의 긴급 대응, 계정 정리, 정보 갱신 등 다양한 사회적 니즈를 충족시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent fire early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent fire early warning monitoring system. The system comprises temperature and smoke sensors, wherein the temperature and smoke sensors are arranged at building positions needed to be monitored, and are in wireless communication with a wireless network; the wireless network is in wireless communication with a building fire management server and an intelligent broadband access gateway; the intelligent broadband access gateway is communicated with internet protocol version 6 (IPV6) or IPV4 Internet; and the IPV6 or IPV4 Internet is communicated with the building fire management server and a municipal fire protection center management server. Temperature and smoke information which is acquired by the system can be locally viewed and stored and can be remotely viewed easily through the IPV6 or IPV4 Internet, which is extremely useful for disaster relief command and remote monitoring and command of important events; and on-line information storage greatly facilitates remote analysis and processing after the events happen and greatly improves processing efficiency.

title_en: Early warning information processing method and device for multiple disasters and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an early warning information processing method and device for multiple disasters and terminal equipment, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early warning information report, and acquiring the early warning stage type of the previous disaster early warning information report of the same disaster type of the monitoring area corresponding to the current disaster early warning information report; when the early warning stage type is the end reporting condition, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the early warning stage type is not finished reporting, acquiring an information generation category of the current disaster early warning information report, and determining that the current disaster early warning information report is an updated report or finished report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the previous disaster early warning information report according to the information generation category of the current disaster early warning information report and an early warning finishing condition. The invention can perform the integration of disaster early warning events on the received disaster early warning information report, and is beneficial to the user to process the current disaster early warning information report.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Landslide safety monitoring system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide safety monitoring system and an early warning method thereof, and relates to the technical field of safety monitoring. The system comprises a control end connected with a cloud server and a landslide sensor embedded in a soil slope for monitoring; the landslide sensors are uniformly distributed on the soil slope to be monitored, and soil layer tightness data and soil layer deviation data of different depths of installation points of the landslide sensors are obtained; the control end acquires soil layer tightness data and soil layer deviation data sent by a landslide sensor, and constructs a soil layer three-dimensional monitoring model of the soil slope to be monitored by combining a pre-acquired three-dimensional image of the region of the soil slope to be monitored; the control end acquires the landslide sensor sending data in real time and updates the soil layer three-dimensional monitoring model, and if the change amount of the soil layer three-dimensional monitoring model exceeds a preset threshold value, the control end sends out landslide early warning alarm; the change of the soil layer three-dimensional monitoring model is a comparison value of the real-time soil layer three-dimensional monitoring model and the initial soil layer three-dimensional monitoring model, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining the soil layer tightness change and the soil layer offset.

title_en: Coal face gas concentration dynamic distribution model determination method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal face gas concentration dynamic distribution model determining method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring. The technical problem that the dynamic distribution of gas on a working face cannot be reflected in traditional single-point static monitoring and the prediction accuracy is low is solved. The technical scheme includes that an air inlet corner, a middle part of a working surface and an air return corner sensor network are deployed to collect data in real time, a gas distribution function model y=ae  b(l‑x)  is constructed, wherein a is an air return corner concentration value, b is a dynamic attenuation coefficient, measured data solving parameters are fitted through a least square method, and an update period t dynamic correction model is set. The technical effect is that the full-space dynamic mapping of the gas concentration of the working face is realized, the ventilation condition change is responded in real time, the disaster early warning capability is improved by combining the visual interface, the gas explosion risk is obviously reduced, and the coal mine safety production is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Method, user equipment and system for acquiring ETWS message
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method for acquiring an ETWS message, which comprises the following steps that: a UE acquires change indication information of an earthquake and tsunami warning system (ETWS); and when the change indication information of the ETWS indicates an added or updated ETWS message, the UE acquires the ETWS message. The embodiment of the invention also disclosesa method for sending the ETWS message. In the embodiment, due to the transfer of the change indication information of the ETWS, the UE can acquire the state change of the ETWS message timely by only reading the added or updated ETWS message instead of an invalid ETWS message or other system messages so as to effectively reduce the power consumption of the UE. The embodiment of the invention also discloses the user equipment and a system.

title_en: Programmable logic controller and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a programmable logic controller and an early warning method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring whether the switching times of a relay output unit of the programmable logic controller reach an early warning value or not; and sending an alarm signal when the switching times of the relay output unit reach an early warning value. By implementing the programmable logic controller and the early warning method thereof provided by the invention, because the counting unit is added on the basis of the existing PLC or the frequency monitoring unit is further added, the switching times of the relay output unit of the PLC, even the switching use frequency can be monitored, and the switching times and even the switching use frequency are taken as the basis of early warning. By implementing the invention, according to the monitoring results of the switching times and the frequency, a corresponding alarm signal can be sent to prompt a user to judge the service life of the PLC, thereby providing safety guarantee for the operation of the PLC and eliminating potential safety hazards caused by using the PLC which is about to expire.
assignees: SHENZHEN CO TRUST TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Situation awareness system based on intelligent video analysis technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a situation awareness system based on an intelligent video analysis technology. The situation awareness system disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the system collects, transmits, processes and displays situation information for an abnormal disaster site, realizes target detection, abnormality identification, threat analysis, risk early warning and other functions, has an open system structure, and can access other situation awareness means and realize information interaction and sharing. The application of the system in the field of disaster prevention and mitigation can not only promote the upgrade and update of the current widely used video monitoring systems, but also can realize the information fusion processing of various means mainly depending on videos to form an overall situation of an event site, and can compensate the shortcomings of the traditional video monitoring and effectively improve the handling ability of a commander on the scene situation.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGKE INST OF INTELLIGENT IDENTIFICATION IND TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of intelligent concrete, which pours, sets template method for managing security
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent concrete, which pours, sets template method for managing security, belongs to technical field of concrete construction.Method is applied to cloud system, cloud system receives the signal for carrying out self-template installation end sensing mould group, it include: to pour the safe sex determination for setting formwork for template installation end sensing module signal progress concrete after concrete pours and sets template installation: obtaining structure change numerical value after algorithm calculates through template installation end sensing module signal；Compared with by structure change numerical value safety value corresponding with cloud data bank, if structure change numerical value is greater than the safety value, determine that concrete pours that set formwork dangerous, and send caution signal；Otherwise determine that concrete pours and set formwork safety, then the safety value of cloud data bank is updated to current structure variation numerical value.The present invention can obtain the sensing signal of template installation end in real time, and progress concrete in side pours the safe sex determination for setting formwork beyond the clouds, can alert in time, make emergency response processing convenient for construction personnel.

title_en: Construction site monitoring method and system based on Internet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet, and discloses a construction site monitoring method and a construction site monitoring system based on the Internet, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring equipment parameters, environment parameters and life body state parameters from scene parameters of a construction site scene; respectively updating corresponding model components in a preset construction site model according to the equipment parameters, the environment parameters and the life body state parameters to obtain updated model components; and when the scene parameters meet preset abnormal conditions, executing a corresponding warning strategy on the construction site scene based on the updated model component. The construction site monitoring system has the advantages that the completeness and the display effect when the scene parameters of the construction site are displayed are improved by setting the preset construction site model, corresponding model assemblies in the preset construction site model are respectively updated according to the acquired equipment parameters, environmental parameters and life state parameters, the construction site is intelligently and centrally monitored based on the updated model assemblies, the safety of the construction site is improved, and potential safety hazards are avoided.

title_en: Gas detection alarm
abstract_en: The application discloses gaseous detection alarm relates to alarm device's technical field. The alarm comprises a mounting box and an alarm body arranged in the mounting box, wherein a pressure sensor is arranged on the alarm body, a supporting rod and a driving rod are arranged in the mounting box, one end of the supporting rod is abutted with a pressing mechanism abutted against the pressure sensor, the limiting mechanism is used for limiting the displacement distance of the supporting rod, and the resetting mechanism is used for resetting the supporting rod. Pressing means drive branch and pressure sensor butt to make the gas detection alarm report to the police, the displacement distance of spacing subassembly restriction branch, pressure when control branch and pressure sensor butt reduces pressure sensor and transships and receive the possibility of damage, and canceling release mechanical system can realize button mechanism automatic re-setting and stop the warning, need not that the staff is manual to reset, operates when being convenient for next report to the police, has guaranteed the normal use of gas detection alarm.
assignees: SHENZHEN LANGXIN INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunneling, in particular to a digital twinning-based tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises an inversion learning operation module, a tunnel construction entity module, a twin digital model and a twin database. The invention establishes a digital twin model based on the real development environment of the tunnel and the underground space, simulates the whole development process of the tunnel and the underground space, visualizes the whole construction state, gives early warning to the disasters about to happen, and can update and optimize the model according to the on-site construction, thereby developing the driving protection for the traffic country construction and the underground space in China.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY INVEST CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Interactive emergency prompt report processing method and device based on intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive emergency prompt report processing method and device based on an intelligent terminal, comprising the following steps: when an emergency public event occurs, the intelligent terminal reports the emergency event and triggers an active reporting mechanism of the emergency event; acquiring emergency details filled in according to the active reporting mechanism of the triggering emergency, and reporting the emergency details to a server; based on the reported emergency details, automatically constructing an intelligent terminal registered by a base station where the emergency occurs as a current base station tight flash report temporary group, and controlling the mass-sending of corresponding emergency notification information to the intelligent terminal registered by the base station where the emergency occurs; and the intelligent terminal registered by the base station where the emergency occurs updates the current emergency progress in real time through mass information. The invention can effectively utilize the intelligent terminal at the place where the emergency occurs to trigger and update the latest progress of the current emergency, and can perform quick interaction to complete the early warning and update notification of the current emergency.
assignees: SICHUAN KUBI COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Code multiplexing processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a code multiplexing processing method and device, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining code files and script files of a service to be online, submitting the code files and script files to a version management tool for analysis processing to obtain a list, determining a host object, accessing a full-quantity code of the host object in a server, inquiring information related to transaction codes, determining an association analysis table in a database, determining transaction information related to the association analysis table by using a pre-configured code multiplexing check strategy, inquiring information related to the transaction codes in the association analysis table and the transaction information, and after the inquiry operation is completed, generating a suspected code multiplexing message based on the information related to each transaction code, sending the suspected code multiplexing message to an audit node for risk identification and warning of risk. The implementation mode realizes comprehensive inspection and risk management of code multiplexing, reduces potential safety hazards and compatibility problems, and improves development efficiency and code quality.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable Terminal and An Accident Notification Method Using Portable Terminal
title_ko: 휴대 단말 및 휴대 단말을 이용한 사고 알림 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile terminal and an accident notification method using thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an accident notification method of a mobile terminal comprises the steps of: confirming whether a vehicle is initially connected to the vehicle though a short-range wireless communication; detecting an occurrence of an impact by using an impact detection sensor when the initial connection is confirmed; confirming whether the initial connection is released when an impact is detected; confirming whether the vehicle is reconnected through the short-range wireless communication within a predetermined period of time when the initial connection is released; detecting whether a motion is generated using the impact sensor or a GPS sensor when reconnection with the vehicle is not confirmed; and transmitting accident information to an accident notification server when the motion is not confirmed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대 단말 및 휴대 단말을 이용한 사고 알림 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 휴대 단말의 사고 알림 방법은, 근거리 무선 통신을 통해 차량과 초기 연결 여부를 확인하는 단계; 상기 초기 연결을 확인하면, 충격감지센서를 이용하여 충격 발생 여부를 감지하는 단계; 충격 발생이 감지된 경우, 상기 초기 연결의 해제 여부를 확인하는 단계; 상기 초기 연결이 해제된 경우, 기 설정 시간 내에 근거리 무선 통신을 통해 상기 차량과 재 연결 여부를 확인하는 단계; 상기 차량과 재 연결이 확인되지 않는 경우, 상기 충격감지센서 또는 GPS 센서를 이용하여 움직임 발생 여부를 감지하는 단계; 움직임이 감지되지 않은 경우, 사고 알림 서버로 사고 정보를 전송하는 단계; 를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: Building a smart university safety campus using safety booths
title_ko: 안심부스를 이용한 스마트한 대학 안전 캠퍼스 구축
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the construction of a safe campus of a smart university using a safety booth, which can recognize a situation of a criminal or evacuee inside and outside a safety booth. The safety booth for criminal prevention and emergency rescue, comprises: a safety booth installed to be spaced apart from each other at a dangerous area; a roof of the safety booth; a glass and a door of the safety booth; an emergency door lock installed on the door; a control center; a rim and a receiving means; a CCTV or camera, Wi-Fi, and warning light; and a fixed chair.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면은 범죄예방 및 긴급구조 안전부스를 이용하여 여성 및 노약자, 어린이 등이 안전부스를 통해 신속하게 격리시켜 범죄자로부터 부터 긴급구조 요청함과 동시에 안전을 제공하여 범죄예방을 방지하기 위한 안전부스; 상기 안전부스의 지붕; 상기 안전부스의 유리 및 도어문; 상기 도어문에 설치된 비상도어락; 상기 복수개 안전부스와 유무선 및 영상통신이 가능하고, 대피자와 동시에 유무선 및 영상통화가 가능한 관제센터; 상기 관제센터에 의해 상기 복수개 안전부스 위치와 비상상황을 구조자에게 실시간으로 알려주고 출동하는 알림 및 수신수단; 상기 안전부스에 장착된 CCTV 또는 카메라, 와이파이, 경광등; 및 상기 안전부스 내부에 구비된 CCTV 또는 카메라, 공중전화기, 비상벨, 스마트 미디어기, 긴급통화 장치, 비대면 ATM, AED. 함체형 탈착식 들것, 냉난방기, 고정식 의자;을 포함하고, 대피자가 상기 안전부스 내부에 장착된 상기 비상벨을 누를 경우, 상기 도어문의 비상도어락, 경과등 및 사이렌이 작동되고, 상기 비상벨의 신호는 관제센터에 송신되어서 관제요원 긴급출동중에도 구조자가 대피자에게 응급상황과 대처지시를 하면서 대피자를 구조;하고, 상기 비상벨의 해제 누를 경우 상황이 종료;되게 구성되고, 또한 상기 유리 및 도어문은, 강화유리로 이루어지면서 대피자가 비상벨을 작동할 경우 상기 도어문이 작동되어 잠겨지게 구성될 수 있고, 상기 CCTV 또는 카메라는, 상기 안전부스의 안밖의 범죄사 또는 대피자의 상황을 파악하거나, 상기 안전부스 내부의 대피자의 응급상황을 대처할 수 있도록 포함되게 구성되어 있다.
assignees: GANGNEUNG YEONGDONG COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Method of updating new pattern on stretchable display bag, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방에 신상 패턴을 업데이트하는 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A method of updating a new pattern on a stretchable display bag comprises the steps of: wirelessly communicating with a design provider of the stretchable display bag periodically; notifying a user that a design update is available when a new pattern for the stretchable display bag is released; activating an interface to enable the design of the stretchable display bag to be updated through a user's touch; providing the user with a list of updatable designs for the stretchable display bag; and downloading a design selected by the user to change at least one of the color, pattern, and texture of the stretchable display bag. Accordingly, the method allows users to change the color and pattern of the bag to their desired design by providing trend colors and pattern designs announced every season.
abstract_ko: 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방에 신상 패턴을 업데이트하는 방법은, 스트레처블 디스플레이(stretchable display) 가방의 디자인 제공사와 일정 주기마다 무선 통신하는 단계; 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 신상 패턴이 출시된 경우 사용자에게 디자인의 업데이트가 가능함을 알림하는 단계; 사용자의 터치에 의해 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 디자인 업데이트를 가능하도록 인터페이스를 활성화하는 단계; 업데이트가 가능한 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 디자인 리스트를 사용자에게 제공하는 단계; 및 사용자가 선택한 디자인을 다운로드하여 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 색, 패턴 및 질감 중 적어도 하나를 변경하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 시즌마다 발표되는 트렌드 컬러와 패턴 디자인을 제공하여 사용자가 원하는 디자인으로 가방의 컬러와 패턴을 변경할 수 있다.

title_en: Server, vehicle terminal and method for providing emergency notification
title_ko: 서버, 차량용 단말 및 이를 이용한 긴급 상황 알림 방법
abstract_en: An emergency notification method of a server is disclosed. The method includes the steps of: receiving emergency situation information from a vehicle terminal for a vehicle, when an emergency event in the vehicle occurs; starting a standby count for cancellation of emergency situation for the vehicle terminal; determining whether an emergency situation exists depending on whether cancellation of the emergency situation is made until the standby count for the cancellation of emergency situation ends; and reporting an emergency situation in a vehicle to an emergency reporting agency using the received emergency situation information, if it is determined to be an emergency situation. Therefore, it is possible to comprehensively manage vehicle operation conditions, including parking shocks or emergency situations.
abstract_ko: 서버의 긴급 상황 알림 방법이 개시된다. 본 방법은 차량의 긴급 상황 이벤트 발생시, 차량에 대한 차량용 단말로부터 긴급 상황 정보를 수신하는 단계, 차량용 단말에 대하여 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트를 시작하는 단계, 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트가 종료될 때까지 긴급 상황에 대한 취소가 이루어지는지 여부에 따라 긴급 상황 여부를 판단하는 단계, 긴급 상황으로 판단되면, 수신된 긴급 상황 정보를 이용하여 긴급 신고 기관으로 차량의 긴급 상황에 대한 신고를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: PWS (Public Warning System) secret key updating method, network side equipment and terminal in wireless communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PWS (Public Warning System) secret key updating method, network side equipment and a terminal in a wireless communication system. The updating method comprises the steps executed by the network side equipment as follows: issuing two PWS secret keys and identification information of the two PWS secret keys to the terminal in the initial accessing process, wherein one key is a currently used PWS secret key, and the other one is a PWS secret key used next; issuing secret key indicating information at least including the identification information on the PWS secret key currently used by the network side equipment; and after receiving a message carrying the secret key updating indicating information and sent by the terminal, issuing the PWS secret key requested by the terminal to the terminal. According to the invention, the PWS secret key can be updated only in the existing procedure without additionally adding new signaling procedure and without triggering the signaling procedure independently.

title_en: Geological environment and monitoring information management method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological environment and monitoring information management method, which comprises the following steps of obtaining investigation and detection information of new hidden danger points; executing hidden danger point judgment operation, and screening and inputting newly added hidden danger points according to investigation detection information of the new hidden danger points; inputting newly-added hidden danger points and integrating the hidden danger points with survey detection information of original hidden danger points to generate hidden danger point information and form a hidden danger point distribution map; determining hidden danger points needing to be processed, determining a processing scheme of the hidden danger points according to the hidden danger point information, and performing monitoring operation on the hidden danger points which are not processed temporarily; acquiring reporting information when acquiring early warning information corresponding to newly increased hidden danger points which are not processed temporarily, importing the reporting information to a hidden danger point distribution map, and determining an emergency processing scheme according to the hidden danger point distribution map after importing the reporting information; and collecting and determining the processing result of the hidden danger point, and verifying and canceling or re-inputting the information of the hidden danger point. The method has the effects of dynamically monitoring the geological environment and orderly managing the geological hidden danger points.
assignees: REAL ESTATE ASSESSMENT CENTER SHENZHEN SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Prediction evaluation method and related equipment for fault tunnel damage
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a fault tunnel damage prediction and assessment method and related equipment. Specifically, the predictive evaluation method includes: constructing a fault tunnel model; wherein the fault tunnel model comprises at least one solid particle and at least one fluid particle; the parameters of the solid particles and the fluid particles are respectively given corresponding initial values; wherein the parameters include target parameters; according to a preset time step and a preset target parameter control equation, circularly updating the target parameter until the preset times; and determining the impact pressure of the water body according to the updated target parameters of the fluid particles. The scheme provides effective basis for disaster prevention and disaster early warning in tunnel construction.

title_en: Facility reservation apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reserve facilities quickly just after an earthquake such that at a major earthquake affecting a wide area, facilities in the affected areas and peripheries can be used to the full to support damage restoration activities.  <P>SOLUTION: An earthquake information reception part 60 receives an earthquake warning, based on earthquake detection by seismometers installed in various regions. In response to the earthquake warning, a facility reservation part 72 exchanges or updates data online by a preset algorithm to reserve facilities.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Automatic calling device and method using telephone network
title_ko: 전화회선을 이용한 자동 비상 호출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An automatic emergency calling apparatus using a telephone line and a method thereof are provided to transmit a warning signal generated from a fire alarm to the center management server of a fire station quickly by using a telephone network. A wireless transmission module(2) receives sensing signals outputted from fire detecting sensors(1) which are installed in each story within a building, and then outputs an alarm signal. A wireless relay device(4) wirelessly receives the alarm signal outputted from the wireless transmission module, converts the received signal into a signal suitable for a telephone network, and then transmits the converted signal to a command server(3) installed in a fire station. The wireless transmission module outputs a position signal corresponding to the identification code of the fire detecting sensor and the time when a fire is detected according to the inputted sensing signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전화회선을 이용한 자동 비상 호출 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 건물에서 화재 발생 시 경보기에서 발생된 경보신호를 전화회선망을 이용하여 신속하게 소방서등의 중앙관리서버에 전송함과 아울러 중앙관리서버에서 화재 발생지역을 즉시 알 수 있도록 한 전화회선을 이용한 자동 비상 호출 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 목적은, 건물에 화재 발생 시 화재경보기에서 전화망을 통해 직접 소방서등에 신속하게 화재신고를 할 수 있도록 함으로써 화재진압에 소요되는 시간을 단축하고 효율적인 화재 진압을 할 수 있도록 구성된 전화회선을 이용한 자동 비상 호출 장치 및 방법을 제공함에 있다. 
     상기한 목적을 실현하기 위하여 본 발명에 따른 장치는, 건물내의 각층별로 설치되어 있는 화재 감지 센서등과 같은 센서(1)에서 출력되는 감지 신호를 입력받아 무선으로 경보신호를 출력하는 무선 송신모듈(2)과, 상기한 무선송신모듈(2)에서 출력된 경보신호를 무선으로 입력받아 전화망(N)에 적합한 신호로 변경하고 이를 소방서의 지령서버(3)에 다이얼링을 통해 전화를 하여 화재경보를 발하도록 구성된 무선 중계장치(4)로 구성함을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명에 따른 방법은, 건물에서 화재가 발생되면 감지센서(1)가 이를 감지하여 무선송신모듈(2)의 마이컴(8)으로 송신하는 단계와, 
     상기한 마이컴(8)에서 감지신호를 입력받으면 이를 무선송신부(9)에서 무선 신호로 변환하여 송출하는 단계와, 
     상기한 무선신호를 무선수신부(10)에서 수신받아 무선중계장치(4)의 마이컴(12)으로 전송하는 단계와, 
     상기한 마이컴(12)에 감지신호가 입력되면 음성메시지가 미리 저장되어 있는 음성메시지저장부(11)에서 호출하여 출력하는 단계와, 
     상기한 마이컴(12)에서 음성메시지 및 화재신호를 출력하여 모뎀(13)에서 전화선(N)을 통해 다이얼링하면서 소방서의 지령서버에 전화를 걸고 메시지를 전송하여 화재경보를 하는 단계로 구성함을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     원격경보 장치, 비상호출 시스템, 재난사고 경보

title_en: Positioning System for Workers Combining Sensor Devices and Beacon Technology
title_ko: 센서 디바이스와 비콘 기술을 결합한 작업자의 위치확인시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a worker positioning system combined with a sensor device and a beacon technology. According to the present invention, a field manager terminal can perform check and control management by interworking with a smartphone to recognize whether a sensor device is worn and a location for each floor of a field worker by fusing a beacon technology and a sensor technology, such that an accident can be prevented, and the last location of the field worker can be recognized to provide an assistance in a rescue of human lives in case of an accident. Also, a location for each ID is set by using the sensor technology and the beacon technology to be transmitted to a cloud server through the smartphone, such that a location value can be obtained even without constructing a separate communication device or network, and also, a status and the location value of a worker can be transmitted to the field manager terminal through the cloud server in real time by matching sensing information by various sensors and worker information.
