In addition, head impact, fall and overturn are detected through a shock sensor mounted on a sensor device and an emergency button is operated to transmit an emergency message to the field manager terminal or a central control server via the smartphone and the cloud server, such that follow-up measures can be processed quickly depending on a field accident location. Also, a power on/off message is transmitted to the field manager terminal or central control server when a chin strap of the sensor device is worn or removed, such that the safety of a field worker can be managed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서디바이스와 비콘 기술을 결합한 작업자의 위치확인 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 비콘 기술과 센서 기술을 융합하여 현장 작업자의 센서디바이스 착용 여부와 층별 위치 파악을 스마트폰과 연동하여 현장관리자단말기에서 확인하고 관리 지휘할 수 있게 함으로써, 사고를 미연에 방지함은 물론 사고시 현장 작업자의 마지막 위치를 파악하여 인명구조에 도움을 줄 수 있고, 센서 기술과 비콘 기술을 사용하여 미리 ID 별 위치를 설정하여 스마트폰을 통해 클라우드 서버로 전송하여 줌으로써, 별도의 통신장비나 네트워크를 구축하지 않아도 위치 값을 취득이 가능할 뿐만 아니라 각종 센서들에 의한 센싱 정보와 작업자의 정보를 매칭 처리하여 실시간으로 작업자의 현황과 위치 값을 클라우드 서버를 통해 현장관리자단말기에서 전송받을 수 있으며, 센서디바이스에 장착된 충격감지센서를 통해 머리 충격과 낙상 및 넘어짐을 감지하고 응급상황버튼을 작동시켜 응급상황 메시지를 스마트폰과 클라우드 서버를 거쳐 현장관리자단말기 또는 중앙관제서버로 전송하여 줌으로써, 현장 사고 위치에 따른 후속조치를 신속하게 처리할 수 있고, 센서디바이스의 턱끈 착용 및 해제시 파워의 온/오프 메시지를 현장관리자단말기 또는 중앙관제서버로 전송하여 줌으로써, 현장 작업자의 안전을 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine region
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine regions, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The embodiment of the application aims to effectively improve the timeliness and accuracy of meteorological data by updating a meteorological monitoring data set, applying an advanced data restoration algorithm and carrying out multi-round wind load state vector mining based on a characteristic focusing strategy. By applying the embodiment of the application, the problem of delayed update of the meteorological data can be solved, the whole quality of the meteorological monitoring data can be obviously improved through deep data mining and intelligent restoration, thereby providing a more reliable data base for meteorological prediction, disaster early warning and the like, and having obvious technical progress and application value.
assignees: METEOROLOGICAL DATA CENTER OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE HEILONGJIANG METEOROLOGICAL DETECTION CENTER HEI

title_en: Mountain crack geological disaster information monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The application provides a mountain crack geological disaster information monitoring and early warning method which comprises the steps of obtaining crack form data of a mountain crack area, wherein the crack form data comprise crack length, width, depth and trend, acquiring geological feature parameters of the crack area in real time through a preset sensor network, wherein the geological feature parameters comprise lithology, structure and stress state, acquiring data through a pre-arranged geological sensor network, transmitting the crack form data and the geological feature parameters acquired in the wild to a monitoring platform in real time, designing a visual display module according to a dynamically updated crack dividing result, generating a crack space distribution map and an attribute feature map, and performing correlation analysis on the visually displayed crack dividing result and monitoring information such as rainfall, earth surface displacement and the like in the monitoring platform to generate a disaster early warning report.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA

title_en: Steel logistics whole-flow real-time dynamic management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for dynamically managing a steel logistics whole process in real time, belonging to the technical field of steel logistics control methods and devices. The technical scheme includes data acquisition and monitoring, tracking of states of transportation vehicles and goods, demand prediction and stock dynamic adjustment, high-frequency goods allocation according to shipment frequency to respond to emergency orders, visual management of a supply chain, establishment of shared data of all links of the supply chain, construction of a 3D logistics map, real-time display of stock, transportation states and bottleneck nodes, risk control management and rapid starting of alternative schemes when early warning is triggered. The method has the beneficial effects of optimizing efficiency, reducing the limitation of the traditional single transportation mode, realizing the rolling update and emergency response of demand prediction, improving the data transparency and the trust degree, realizing the risk quick response, and having the advantage of realizing the whole life cycle management of logistics.
assignees: HANDAN IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD;HANGANG NENGJIA IRON AND STEEL CO LTD

title_en: The left and the right side direction dangerous sense and warning device of automobile
title_ko: 자동차의 좌·우측 방향 위험 감지 및 경보장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for alarming and detecting risks of left and right direction of a vehicle is provided to help a use to stably drive at night or in the rain by confirming information of the vehicle located in a blind spot as well as left and right information of the vehicle using sight and hearing. CONSTITUTION: An apparatus for alarming and detecting risks of left and right direction of a vehicle comprises: a movement sensor; an infrared ray distance meter(20); a monitoring camera(30); a controller(50) which generates warning sound and operates a monitoring camera when an adjacent driving vehicle is within an error range of an initial standard distance(5m) and operate direction indicator light to be changed to red color from yellow color; a monitor(40); and an on/off switch(60) which sanctions the power to the movement sensor, the infrared ray distance meter, the monitoring camera, the monitor, and the controller. It includes.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 좌측 또는 우측 방향으로 자동차의 주행 차로를 변경하고자 할 때 차로 변경을 위한 방향지시등 작동시 사각지대를 포함한 좌측 또는 우측 방향의 선택된 어느 한 방향에 대해 근접해 있는 자동차를 신속하게 감지하여 운전자는 물론, 차로 변경 방향에 있는 주행 자동차에 대해서도 시각(방향지시등) 및 청각(경보음)으로 알릴 수 있도록 함으로써 자기 차량은 물론 타 차량의 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 하는 자동차의 좌·우측 방향 위험 감지 및 경보장치에 관한 것으로,   
좌측 또는 우측으로 차선을 변경하고자 방향지시등(80) 작동용 레버(81)를 작동할 경우 레버(81)의 작동에 따른 차선 변경신호를 감지하고 감지한 차선변경신호를 제어부(50)에 전달하는 동작센서(10)와, 상기 동작센서(10)에서 감지된 차선 변경 신호에 따라 주행차량의 좌측 또는 우측 방향과, 각 사각지대에 위치한 인접 주행차량의 거리를 측정하여 제어부(50)에 전달하는 적외선 거리측정기(20)와, 상기 적외선 거리측정기에서 측정된 오차범위 이내의 인접 주행차량 정보를 촬영하여 차량의 실내에 구비된 모니터(40)에 표시되도록 하는 감시카메라(30)와, 상기 동작센서(10)에서 전달받은 신호를 적외선거리측정기(20)에 전달하여 거리를 측정하도록 하고, 적외선거리측정기에서 측정한 인접 차량의 거리정보 중 최초 입력된 기준거리(5m)의 오차 범위 이내에 인접 주행차량이 있을 경우 감시 카메라가(30)가 작동되도록 함과 동시에 경보기(70)로부터 경보음이 발생 되도록 하고, 방향지시등은 황색에서 적색으로 변경되도록 조작하는 제어부(50)와, 상기 감시카메라(30)에서 촬영된 인접 차량(2,3)의 정보를 주행차량(1)의 운전자에게 알 수 있도록 하는 모니터(40)와, 상기 동작센서(10), 적외선거리측정기(20), 감시카메라(30), 모니터(40), 제어부(50)에 전원을 인가 및 차단시키는 온/오프 스위치(60)를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: The APP for Smart-Phone that have the function for the emergency rescue request and the emergency warning
title_ko: 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능을 가진 스마트폰 앱의 구성
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of an application for a smartphone having a function for emergency rescue requesting and emergency alerting, which automatically activate an alerting siren, a warning lamp screen, and an emergency rescue requesting voice function when a user feels a risk and simultaneously touches an emergency rescue request application for three seconds when a robber, kidnapper, sex offender or the like approaches the user in a secluded alley or a dark place. According to the present invention, when an SOS icon installed on a locked screen is immediately touched for 3 to 5 seconds when the user faces a robber, kidnapper, sex offender or the like, the alarm siren, warning light screen, and urgent emergency rescue voice are automatically activated to notify that the user is in a dangerous situation, thereby obtaining help from other persons near the user. In addition, the alarm siren, warning light screen, and urgent emergency rescue voice are automatically activated such that a perpetrator shrinks psychologically and stops committing the crime or escapes the area, thereby providing the user with a measure of safety.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 후미진 골목이나 으슥한 장소에서 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등이 접근할 경우 위협을 느낌과 동시에 긴급구조요청앱인 3초간 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광등화면 및 긴급긴급구조요청음성 기능이 작동되는 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능을 가진 스마트폰 앱의 구성에 관한 것이다 
이와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은, 상기 스마트폰(1)의 잠금화면(100)상에 SOS아이콘(101)이 설치 및 구현되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 단계와,  
; 상기 잠금화면(100)상에 SOS아이콘(101)을 3~5초간 누름과 동시에 자동으로 경보싸이렌(101a)의 발령 및 경광등화면(101b)의 작동 및 긴급구조요청음(101d)의 송출 및 카메라 동영상촬영(101e)이 이뤄지고 동시에 경찰서와 사전등록된 등록지인1(101g) 및 등록지인2(101h)...에게 현위치정보(101c)와 카메라에서 실시간으로 촬영되고 있는 동영상촬영(101e)정보 및 구조를 요청하는 긴급구조요청메세지(101f)가 전송되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 단계와, 
; 상기의 스마트폰(1)의 잠금화면(100)상에 SOS아이콘(101)을 3~5초간 누름과 동시에 잠금화면(100)이 경광등화면(101b)으로 전환되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 단계와 ; 상기 경광등화면(101b)상에서는 적색램프(201) 와 청색램프(202)가 반복적으로 점멸을 반복하는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 것과,  
상기 경광등화면(101b) 및 경보싸이렌(101a) 및 긴급구조요청음(101d)송출 기능을 구성한 것은 상기의 경보싸이렌(101a) 또는 긴급구조요청음(101d)과 경광등화면(101b)이 작동되면 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등에게 일단 심리적으로 위축되는 효과를 주며 자신의 위치가 범행대상이 아닌 주위의 누군가 제3자들에게 알려졌다는 불안감으로 범행의지를 철회하게 하는 효과를 유발하기 위한 것이 특징인 것과, 
; 상기 스마트폰(1)의 통상앱설치화면(300)에도 SOS설정아이콘(301)이 설치 및 구현되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 것과 ; 상기 SOS설정아이콘(301)은 스마트폰(1)의 잠금화면(100)상에 설치되어 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능이 작동중인 SOS아이콘(101)의 기능을 중지시키고자 할 경우 SOS설정아이콘(301)을 누르면 즉시 경계상태가 해제되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 것 및 더불어 SOS설정아이콘(301)을 3~5초간 누르면 긴급위기상황 발생시 가까운 지인이나 가족에게 현위치정보(101c)와 동영상촬영(101e) 및 긴급구조요청메세지(101f)를 송출할 수 있도록 사전에 설정하는 등록지인1(101g) 및 등록지인2(101h)... 기능 및 기타 설정기능을 가지는 것에 특징인 것과, ; 상기 스마트폰(1)의 통상앱설치화면(300)에도 SOS설정아이콘(301)이 설치되는 구성을 가지는 것은 사용자가 스마트폰(1)의 잠금화면(100)상에 설치되어 있는 SOS아이콘(101)을 실수로 조작하거나 장난으로 조작했을 경우 통상앱설치화면(300)상에 설치된 SOS설정아이콘(301)을 누르면 경보발령상태가 즉시 해제되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 것과, 
; 그리고 위기상황에 노출된 피해자의 휴대폰을 범인이 강탈하여 임으로 경보를 해제하는 것을 방지하기 위해 잠금화면(100)상에 경보발령해제 기능을 겸비한 SOS설정아이콘(301)을 설치하지 않고 잠금화면(100)상에서 비밀번호를 조작하여야만 열리는 통상앱설치화면(300)상에 SOS설정아이콘(301)을 구성한 것이 특징인 것과, 
; 더불어 위기상황에 노출된 피해자의 휴대폰을 범인이 강탈하여 스마트폰 밧데리를 제거하더라도 비상용보조 밧데리가 즉시 구동되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징이다. 
본 발명의 경우, 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등과 대면할 경우 즉시 잠금화면상에 설치된 SOS아이콘을 3~5초 동안 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광등화면 및 긴급긴급구조요청음성이 작동되므로 서 누군가 위험에 처한 상황이라는 것을 알려 주므로서 주변에서 도움을 얻을 수 있으며, 더불어 경보싸이렌 및 경광등화면 및 긴급긴급구조요청음성이 작동되므로 서 범인을 심리적으로 위축시키므로 서 범의를 철회하게 하거나 치한이 범행을 의도한 장소로부터 도주하고자하는 충동을 유발시키므로 인해서 위기로부터 안전하게 탈출할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Security crisis management system and method for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a security crisis management system and a security crisis management method for a coal mine. The system comprises a security crisis monitoring module, a security crisis management module, a security crisis evaluation module, a security crisis early-warning module and a security crisis response module, wherein the security crisis monitoring module monitors the actual operating state of the coal mine, converts the actual operating state into corresponding data information and sends the corresponding data information to a crisis information database; the security crisis management module stores the crisis information of the current operating state in the crisis information database and updates the crisis information of the operating state of the coal mine in real time; the security crisis evaluation module analyzes and evaluates the current security operating situation of the coal mine; the security crisis early-warning module judges whether an accident possibly occurs in the coal mine according to an evaluation result, and gives an alarm if a risk exists and the accident possibly occurs; and the security crisis response module performs corresponding crisis elimination handling according to crisis alarm information, so a dangerous source is eliminated, and the accident is prevented. By the invention, a production accident can be effectively prevented, and the degree of damage caused by a sudden accident can be controlled to the greatest extent.
assignees: SHANXI LU AN ENVIRONMENTAL ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Methods and systems for presenting alert when leaving direct-mode coverage area
abstract_en: At least one embodiment takes the form of a process carried out by a given mobile radio in a group of mobile radios. The process includes broadcasting heartbeat messages in accordance with a group-wide symmetric-timing protocol and maintaining an in-range list of mobile radios. The in-range list is maintained at least in part by (i) adding mobile radios that are not already on the in-range list to the in-range list upon detecting transmissions from such mobile radios; (ii) maintaining, for each mobile radio on the in-range list, a respective keepalive timer in accordance with the group-wide symmetric-timing protocol; and (iii) removing mobile radios from the in-range list upon expiration of the respective keepalive timers. The process further includes presenting an alert via a user interface when a count of mobile radios on the in-range list falls below a notification threshold.

title_en: Slope rainfall infiltration stability dynamic evaluation and landslide prediction method
abstract_en: A dynamic evaluation and landslide prediction method for slope rainfall infiltration stability comprises the steps of constructing a numerical model coupling rainfall infiltration and slope stress field response, integrating multi-source data, updating model boundary conditions in real time, carrying out dynamic stability evaluation based on a local safety coefficient method, training a landslide prediction model and realizing intelligent early warning judgment. The invention provides a seepage-stress-intensity three-field coupling numerical model, which dynamically simulates the physical response process of an unsaturated soil body, can truly restore the precursor mechanism of rainfall induced landslide, improves prediction scientificity and accuracy, integrates remote sensing topographic data, soil property investigation parameters and real-time meteorological monitoring information, dynamically updates the boundary condition and initial state of the model through a system interface, realizes real-time response environment change, improves simulation reliability, introduces a local safety coefficient assessment mechanism, combines a continuous weak area discrimination algorithm, realizes space identification and time sequence tracking of a potential slippage area and a damaged area, and improves the analysis refinement level of slope stability.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 2 GROUP;NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTER FOR HIGH SPEED RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION;CHINA RAILWAY ERJU 6TH ENG CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Cable channel fire parameter monitoring and temperature-oxygen-smoke collaborative early warning method
abstract_en: The application relates to a cable channel fire parameter monitoring and temperature-oxygen-smoke collaborative early warning method, a device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, which can be used in the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-parameter monitoring data in a cable channel, carrying out feature recognition processing on the multi-parameter monitoring data to obtain multi-parameter feature information, wherein the multi-parameter feature information comprises temperature field space-time evolution feature information, oxygen consumption feature information, combustion intensity feature information and smoke feature information, inputting the multi-parameter feature information into a fire state recognition model to carry out fire state recognition processing to obtain a fire state recognition result, generating early warning and emergency information of the cable channel according to the fire state recognition result and the multi-parameter feature information, and the early warning and emergency information comprises multi-stage early warning information, fire development trend prediction information and an evacuation path update scheme. By adopting the method, the early warning accuracy of the cable channel fire disaster can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Multi-mode agent cluster control system for dynamic evaluation of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-modal intelligent agent cluster control system for dynamic evaluation of geological disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of three-dimensional geological modeling and digital twin, and is used for solving the problem that model expression disaster body states are inaccurate due to inconsistency of multi-modal monitoring data when digital twin models are fused; the multi-dimensional multi-modal monitoring data is collected by the data collection module by utilizing heterogeneous intelligent agent clusters, the cause judgment module judges whether the real disaster evolution is generated or not, the risk identification module identifies a high-risk critical area, the task generation module generates intelligent agent cluster collaborative observation task planning aiming at the high-risk critical area, the planning optimization module re-optimizes the collaborative observation task planning, and the execution updating module controls the heterogeneous intelligent agent cluster to execute the re-optimized task planning and feed back and update the digital twin three-dimensional model in real time, so that the dynamic accurate evaluation and early warning of the geological disaster are realized.
assignees: CHENGXIN ZHILIAN WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environmental sanitation platform task scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of environmental sanitation platform task scheduling system, it is related to intelligent dispatching system field, the environmental sanitation platform task scheduling system is managed scheduling by way of cluster, greatly reduces development and maintenance cost；Distributed deployment, the high availability of system is ensure that, retractility, load balancing, is improved fault-tolerant；Timed task can be disposed and managed by console, it is convenient, flexible efficient；Task can be persisted to database, avoid the machine of delaying and hidden danger that loss of data is brought, while have perfect mission failure to reform mechanism and the tracking of detailed task and warning strategies.
assignees: SUZHOU VORTEX INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue individual combat command methods and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fightings and emergency management and rescue individual combat command methods, comprising the following steps: the location information and physiologic information of acquisition individual soldier and/or teams and groups；Obtain the real-time body posture and historical track of individual soldier；Obtain the working condition of individual soldier and/or the taken equipment of teams and groups；Obtain the real time data of fire-fighting and emergency rescue scene；It is generated according to all information of acquisition and suggests sending scheme and the corresponding prediction scheme that executes to be executed by commanding's selection；The corresponding execution prediction scheme of scheme is sent to assign a task instruction to corresponding individual soldier and/or teams and groups according to selection；It is disposed for fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue, the physiological status for providing the decomposition of prediction scheme, the distribution of task, the assigning of instruction, fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue personnel is obtained to be obtained and the indoor and outdoor location information of the corresponding early warning of scene, fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue is obtained and collected and update with region danger early warning and field data with early warning, fire-fighting and the behavior of emergency management and rescue personnel and posture.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting gas alarm method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire protection early warning, and provides a fire protection gas alarm method, which comprises the steps of acquiring response time signal stability and detection precision data through a sensor to obtain a real-time monitoring sequence; the method comprises the steps of calculating a response time and a correlation coefficient of signal stability according to a real-time monitoring sequence, determining a change trend index, inputting a preset regression model by the change trend index to obtain a performance degradation predicted value, judging potential faults and generating an alarm signal if the performance degradation predicted value exceeds a preset threshold value, adjusting detection precision parameter to optimize sensor configuration through a threshold mechanism after the alarm signal is obtained, re-collecting gas concentration and concentration fluctuation data according to the optimized sensor configuration to determine an updated monitoring sequence, judging a gas leakage risk level by adopting the updated monitoring sequence to match with abnormal smoke characteristics, inputting a classification model through the risk level to obtain a fault predicted result and activating a maintenance system response, providing high-efficiency early warning for catering kitchen gas monitoring, and guaranteeing safety.

title_en: Downward evacuation ladder for emergency escape when detecting the fire and leaking the gas
title_ko: 화재 또는 가스 누출시 긴급 대피용 하향식 피난 사다리 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A downward evacuation ladder for an emergency used when a fire or gas leak is detected is provided to automatically release a locking device of the evacuation ladder when gas or heat is sensed. CONSTITUTION: A downward evacuation ladder for an emergency used when a fire or gas leak is detected comprises a housing, a controller(30), an input unit(40), and an output unit. The housing receives a foldable ladder and a decompression device therein and has an opening and closing cover. The controller is installed to be adjacent to one side of the housing. The input unit is connected to the controller and senses a gas leak, a fire, and the opening and closing of the cover. The output unit is connected to the controller and powers an alarm(54).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 또는 가스누출시 접이사다리를 이용한 긴급 대피용 하향식 피난 사다리 장치에 있어서: 상기 접이사다리(20)를 작동레버(22) 및 감압장치(23)와 함께 수용하고, 상면에 개폐용 커버(12)를 지닌 하우징(10); 상기 하우징(10)의 일측에 인접하여 설치되고, 상기 작동레버(22)에 대한 구동 출력을 판단하는 제어기(30); 상기 제어기(30)에 연결되어 가스누출, 화재, 커버(12)의 개폐에 대응한 신호를 감지하는 입력수단(40); 및 상기 제어기(30)에 연결되어 상황 안내용 표시기(33)와 음향안내용 부저 또는 음성안내용 스피커를 지닌 경보기(54)를 구동하는 출력수단(50)을 포함한다. 
이에 따라, 화재 또는 가스 누출시 긴급 대피용 하향식 피난 사다리 장치는 가스/연기 감지 센서, 열감지 센서와 연동된 제어기에 연결된 피난 사다리의 하부 도어의 잠금 장치가 해제되고, 가스 또는 열이 감지되면 경보음을 발생하고 조명이 켜지며, 사용자가 피난 사다리의 상부 도어를 열고 래칫 방식의 감압장치의 걸림 장치를 해제하면 하향식으로 다단으로 구성된 피난사다리를 펼치고, 아래층으로 안전하게 대피 경로를 제공하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Stage setting apparatus of motor control method
title_ko: 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting, which apply an algorithm, adapted to constantly monitor, compare and analyze the amount of load applied to a motor, to a motor drive-type stage setting, and thus the apparatus and method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing change in load of motor drive-type stage setting can induce a user to check and maintain the stage setting in advance, thereby preventing inconvenience and cancelation of performance from being caused by a sudden mechanical failure, protecting people from a safety accident and the like, and contributing to success of performance. For this purpose, the method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting according to the present invention comprises the steps of: determining whether an instruction for moving a batten is present; when the instruction for moving the batten is present, checking a moving direction, and performing a location moving instruction and residual distance calculation; determining whether a location of the moved batten corresponds to a limit location; stopping when the location of the moved batten corresponds to the limit location; and determining again whether the instruction for moving the batten is present. The method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting monitors a load factor from a start of lifting or lowering of a batten, calculates and backs up an average value or maximum value of the load factor, provides a warning to a stage director or stage setting administrator in advance when a load factor higher than a preset load factor is detected, induces the stage director or stage setting administrator to perform regular check when the warning is a minor warning, induces the stage director or stage setting administrator to perform emergency checking when the warning is a strong warning, and executes a forced stop when the warning is an urgent warning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모터구동방식 무대장치에 있어서 항상 모터의 부하량을 모니터링 및 비교 분석하는 알고리즘을 적용하여 사전에 무대장치를 점검 및 정비를 유도함으로써 갑작스런 기계 고장으로 인한 불편과 공연의 취소, 안전사고 등으로부터 인명을 보호하고 성공적인 공연에도 기여할 수 있도록 한 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은  배튼의 이동지령 여부를 판단하여 배튼의 이동 지령이 있는 경우 이동방향 확인, 위치이동 지령 및 잔여 거리 연산을 실행한 후 이동한 배튼 위치가 규정위치인가 여부를 판단하여 규정위치이면 일단 정지한 후 배튼의 이동지령 여부를 재차 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 모터구동방식 무대장치의 관리방법에 있어서, 배튼이 상승 또는 하강을 시작할 때부터 부하율을 모니터링하고 평균값 또는 최대값을 연산 및 백업하여 미리 설정된 부하율 보다 높은 값이 측정될 경우 무대 감독이나 무대장치 관리자에게 이 사실을 사전에 경고하여 경경고일 경우 정기점검의 유도를, 중경고일 경우는 긴급 점검의 유도를, 중대경고일 경우에는 강제정지를 실행하도록 이루어진 것이다.

title_en: Space-time intensity online early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a space-time intensity online early warning method and a system, comprising the following steps: calculating a landslide hazard index based on gridding, and determining a landslide-prone area according to the landslide hazard index; constructing a dynamically updated accumulated effective rainfall model, and calculating a landslide probability for predicting the landslide activity time; obtaining the power transmission tower fault probability caused by landslide, which reflects the damage degree of the power transmission tower in the area easy to landslide from the functional angle; and calculating the probability of tower and line faults when the landslide disaster caused by rainfall and the landslide effect power transmission tower occur. The method tracks weather forecast information in real time, dynamically evaluates the influence of the activity time of the slope and the downslide of the slope on the fault rate of the power transmission tower on the basis of determining the position of the slope in a gridding manner, and achieves online early warning of the fault of the power transmission tower.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Early warning method and device for multi-ocean physical field fusion representation based on graph convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method and device for multi-ocean physical field fusion representation based on graph convolution, wherein the method comprises the following steps: updating the characteristics on a plurality of physical fields by utilizing a three-layer graph convolution neural network, and mining the interrelation among different physical fields to update the overall characteristic representation with the comprehensive characteristics of different physical fields; inputting integral feature representations with different physical field comprehensive characteristics and position coding information corresponding to the integral feature representations into double-layer time sequence attention by utilizing double-layer time sequence attention operation to obtain time-interval multi-physical field data feature coupling representation; and (3) performing characteristic coupling representation of the multi-physical-field data in the time period as global characteristics, mining time sequence information to predict a Nino3.4 index, fusing the Nino3.4 index and input typhoon observation data, and predicting typhoon intensity. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. The method and the device solve the problem that the prediction of the typhoon intensity of the sea area near the communication base station in the coastal region is not accurate enough in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;DEVELOPMENT CENTER OF NATIONAL LABORATORY FOR MARINE SCIENCE AND TECH QINGDAO

title_en: Passage shelter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passage shelter which is used for being connected with a functional shelter. The passageway shelter includes: the emergency evacuation warning system comprises a cabin body, a power supply system, three movable pedal doors, a cabin door, four telescopic tarpaulins, an audible and visual alarm, a sound box, a lighting lamp and an emergency evacuation sign. The front end of the cabin body is provided with an inlet and an outlet, and the left side, the right side and the rear end of the cabin body are respectively provided with an opening. The power supply system is arranged in the cabin body and is electrically connected with the external power supply equipment. The three movable pedal doors are respectively arranged at the left side, the right side and the rear end of the cabin body in an opening and closing manner. The hatch is arranged at the entrance and the exit. Four retractable tarpaulins are respectively arranged at the outer sides of the three movable pedal doors and the outer sides of the cabin doors, and one ends of the four retractable tarpaulins are respectively fixedly connected with the cabin body. Therefore, the passage shelter has a simple and reasonable structure, can be rapidly deployed in the field and is rapidly connected with the functional shelter, so that the on-site sick and wounded can be timely and rapidly treated in real time, and the shelter is convenient to unfold and fold.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD;CSSC JIANGXI MARINE INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Safety alarm system of distributing board
title_ko: 비접촉식 전기장 감지센서를 이용한 안전경보장치가 장착된 배전반
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A distribution board having a safety alarm system using a contactless electric field detection sensor is provided to measure and transmit all power values of an electric power system by sensing a conducting state of a power supply circuit. CONSTITUTION: A power supply unit(170) stabilizes power provided inside a distribution board. A battery(180) supplies the power to a power supply unit in power outage. A door locking unit(190) locks and unlocks a door of the distribution board. A central control unit(200) controls the operation of an electric component while receiving a sensing value of each sensor. An administrator terminal(300) is connected to the central control unit to have communication.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 배전반의 안전 경보장치는 배전반 내부에 전원을 공급하는 공급선로의 전원 공급 유무를 검출하여 점등되는 LED 램프(101) 및 레이저 발생부(102)가 구비된 자기장 검출센서(100)와, 상기 자기장 검출센서(100)에서 발생되는 레이저 빛을 변환하는 변환장치(110)와, 배전반 내부의 통전상태를 표시하는 표시패널(120)과, 배전반 내부의 과열 및 발열을 감지하는 열/냄새 감지센서(130)와, 배전반에 접근하는 물체를 감지하는 근접센서(140)와, 배전반 내부의 출입자를 감지하는 생체인식센서(150)와, 배전반 도어의 열림/닫힘을 감지하는 도어센서(160)와, 배전반 내부에 공급되는 전원을 안정화시키기 위한 전원 공급부(170)와, 정전시 전원 공급부(170)에 전원을 공급하기 위한 배터리(180)와, 상기 배전반 도어를 잠금/해제하는 도어 잠금부(190)와, 상기 각 센서의 센싱값을 전송받아 전장품의 동작을 제어하는 중앙제어부(200)와, 상기 중앙제어부(200)와 통신 가능하도록 연결된 관리자 단말기(300)로 구성된 것이다.

title_en: System for warning floor noise using sensor
title_ko: 센서를 이용한 층간소음 알림시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an inter-floor noise notification system using sensors, and more specifically, to an inter-floor noise notification system using sensors, which is provided with a vibration sensor and a sound sensor, so that when an inter-floor noise generated in the household exceeds a certain level, a sensor detects the inter-floor noise and emits a lamp or outputs a guidance sound, thereby making persons causing the inter-floor noise aware of the inter-floor noise and changing activities style within the household to reduce the inter-floor noise.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서를 이용한 층간소음 알림시스템에 관한 것으로, 더 상세하게는 진동센서 및 소리센서를 장착하여 세대에서 발생되는 층간소음이 일정크기 이상일 경우 센서가 이를 감지하여 램프발광 또는 안내음출력이 이루어지게 하여 층간소음 유발자에게 층간소음을 자각시켜 세대내 활동 스타일을 변경시켜 층간소음을 감소시킬 수 있는 센서를 이용한 층간소음 알림시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on deepness belief network
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on deepness belief network, initially sets up Landslide Monitoring early warning system, acquires a large amount of disaster incitants, screens with MIV algorithm, filters out major casualty incitant；The disaster incitant filtered out is standardized process, is divided into test sample and training sample in specific proportions；Then, the landslide disaster forecasting model based on deepness belief network is constructed, setting structure is two layers of RBM and three layer of BP network composition；Using CD algorithm to RBM pre-training, network parameter is updated；Learnt using genetic algorithm supervised training, guarantees DBN network total optimization；Finally, the landslide disaster forecasting model that reconstruct has optimized, carries out landslide grade classification to output result, forecasts landslide possibility occurrence.Method disclosed by the invention accelerates convergence rate, prevents from falling into local optimum, promote landslide disaster forecast precision by extracting feature disaster incitant.

title_en: Intelligent identification and early warning method and system for air-space-ground universe monitoring during emergency electric power emergency disposal
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-space-ground universe monitoring intelligent recognition early warning method and system for electric emergency handling of emergency events, which are used for carrying out universe detection and data acquisition based on disaster sites, sending the acquired data to a server of a rear command center, giving out early warning levels based on meteorological information and environmental information of the sites, and giving out nearest withdrawing points and withdrawing paths based on longitude, latitude and altitude of the sites, so that field emergency handling personnel can master the surrounding environment conditions of the sites, risk pre-control of the emergency handling personnel is facilitated, and emergency handling of the emergency events is facilitated.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Fire rescue marker light
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire rescue marker light, which comprises a base, a shell, a warning device and a switch, wherein the shell is arranged on the base, the lower part of the base is provided with an adhesion device, the upper part of the base is provided with an electric power storage device, the shell is provided with the warning device, the electric power storage device is electrically connected with the warning device, and the switch is in control connection with the electric power storage device. The fire rescue identification lamp has an identification guiding function, can facilitate rescue exploration and fire rescue personnel withdrawal when fire fighters cannot see the surrounding clearly due to a large amount of smoke when the fire fighters enter a strange environment for rescue, and has the advantages of simple structure, easiness in manufacturing and operation and the like.
assignees: HENAN YONG GRANVILLE EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Multipurpose TV Converter System.
title_ko: 다목적 tv 컨버터 시스템
abstract_en: A multipurpose TV converter system is provided to enable a receiver to set up an address in his/her converter by adding a unit for enabling the receiver to set up the address in an IC card or a separate IC module to a DA(Digital to Analog) converter. A TV signal output unit is comprised of an analog TV signal output terminal and a digital TV signal output terminal. A separating unit(103) classifies an address signal, an instruction signal and an information signal. The separated signals are signals which a host computer of a TV broadcasting station inserts into a digital TV and transmits. A detachable memory unit(106) stores the separated information signal.
abstract_ko:
TV방송 시스템이 아날로그에서 디지털 TV방송으로 변환되는 추세이며 방송시스템이 변경되더라도 세계 각국의 아날로그 TV소지자가 디지털 TV방송을 시청할 수 있도록 하는 DA(Digital to Analog)컨버터가 필요하다. 
     본 발명은 사용자가 소지하고 있는 카드로 DA 컨버터에 어드레스를 부여하여 지역별 또는 그룹별로 구분하여 국가비상재난기구의 컴퓨터가 TV방송신호에 삽입된 데이터 신호로 DA 컨버터를 원격 제어하여 경보신호를 지향적으로 전송하는 기능을 구현하며 신문 등의 간행물을 파일형태로 온라인으로 배달하거나 또는 DA 컨버터를 통한 방송국의 호스트컴퓨터와 DA 컨버터간의 쌍방향 통신 서비스망의 구성으로 동영상 VOD 및 인터넷 서비스를 겸용으로 제공하는 다목적 컨버터 시스템을 제공한다. 
     이로서 TV 방송 시스템이 디지털로 전환될 시 발생하는 수억개의 컨버터 폐기물 발생을 억제하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Loss prevention and loss finding device
title_ko: 양방향 통신 기능을 갖는 휴대품 분실 방지 및 찾기장치와 그 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Personal belongings loss preventing and finding apparatus and a control method thereof are provided to easily find a product which does not seen like a car key, a cellular phone, and a remote controller. CONSTITUTION: A main terminal(MD) is formed in order to be accepted in the purse of a user or worn in waist and transmits a radio frequency signal in which a main native code is included at every fixed cycle by wireless to a short distance. The main terminal determines whether a terminal is registered or not by deciphering a sub native code from the radio frequency signal which is transmitted from sub terminals(SD1-SDn). The main terminal outputs warning tone when the radio frequency signal in which the sub native code is included is not received from the sub terminal for designated time. A plurality of sub terminals is installed to personal belonging in which user carries. A plurality of sub terminals deciphers a main native code from the received radio frequency signal and determines whether the terminal is registered or not. The radio frequency signal in which a sub native code is included is wirelessly transmitted to the main terminal as an answer signal when the radio frequency signal in which the main native code was included receives.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 양방향 통신 기능을 갖는 휴대품 분실 방지 및 찾기장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는  
소정주기마다 고유코드가 포함된 RF신호로 등록된 서브단말기와 근거리 무선교신을 하여 소정시간 동안 서브단말기와의 응답이나 교신 신호가 수신되지 않으면 서브단말기가 장착되어 있는 휴대품이 사용자로부터 이격된 것으로 판단하거나(서브주도의 분실방지(S2), 메인주도의 분실방지(S1,S1a), 무선링크 채널을 형성하고 서브 단말기로 부터 형성된 링크채널을 주기적으로 확인하게하여 이격의 상태를 판단케하거나(무선링크의 분실방지(S3)), 현재 동작모드의 상황을 판단 필요에 따라 서브단말기에 다음 동작모드로 운영되도록 서브단말기에 지령을 하여 효율적이고 확실한 분실방지(혼합모드의 분실방지(S4))를 할 수 있는 기능과 서브단말기가 부착된 물건을 쉽게 찾게 하기위한 기능을 가진 사용자의 지갑에 수납되거나 또는 허리에 착용할 수 있도록 형성된 메인단말기와 ;   
메인단말기와 근거리 고유코드가 포함된 신호로 무선교신을 하고 수신된 메인단말기의 신호에 응답하여 메인단말기에 서브단말기가 존재함을 알려주어 이격되지않음을 알게 하거나(서브주도의 분실방지(S2)), 자신의 타이머를 소정의 주기로 셋팅하여 실행하고 메인으로 부터 신호가 수신되면 타이머를 클리어시켜 메인과 이격되지않음을 알고 반대로 메인과 이격되어 신호가 소정의 주기동안 수신되지않으면 타이머가 폭주하여 이격된 사실을 알게 하거나(메인주도의 분실방지(S1,S1a), 메인단말기가 형성해 놓은 무선링크를 주기적으로 체크하여 링크가 끊겼을 경우 이격된 것(무선링크에 의한 분실방지(S3))으로 판단 하거나 메인에서 지령된 동작모드가오면 현재의 동작모드를 지령된 동작모드로 변환하여 해당 동작모드로 동작하여 휴대용기기의 문제인 밧데리의 전력 소모 방지및 다른기기와의 전파간섭에 따른 오동작을 방지하게 하여 효율적인 분실방지(혼합모드의 분실방지(S4))를 하게 하고, 메인단말기 또는 서브단말기가 부착된 물건을 쉽게 찾게 하기위한 기능을 가진 사용자가 휴대품을 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록 하는 사용자가 휴대하는 휴대품에 장착 또는 부착 설치되는 복수개의 서브단말기; 로 구성한 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 사용자가 필수적으로 휴대하는 지갑에 수납하거나 허리에 차고 다닐 수 있도록 된 메인단말기와  휴대폰 또는 열쇠고리와 같이 사용자가 휴대하고 있는 휴대품에 부착 또는 장착 사용되는 복수개의 서브단말기로 구성하되, 메인단말기와 서브단말기는 소정 주기로 서로 1~2MD 근거리 RF신호 교신하면서 소정시간 이상 상대측으로 부터 RF신호가 수신되지 않거나 또는 RF의 링크 를 구성하고 주기적으로 이를 체크하여 링크가 끊어졌을 경우 이를 체크 하여 이격된 사실을 알게 하여 분실 될 위험이 있다는 사실을 알게 경보를 울려 알려주게함은 물론 휴대용 기기의 문제인 전력 소모의 방지나 다른 사람소지의 단말기와 혼재에 따른 오동작을 방지하기 위하여 메인 단말기가 현재의 동작상황을 판단하여 다음 동작 명령을 서브단말기에 보내고 서브단말기는 지령된 명령에 따라 현재의 동작모드를 메인단말기주도의 동작 또는 서브단말기주도의 동작 또는 무선링크에 의한 동작모드로 바꾸어 동작하게 하여 전력소모를 최대한 줄여 사용시간을 최대한 늘이는 한편 다른 사람 소지의 물건과의 간섭에 의한 오동작을 줄이고 효율적으로 휴대품 분실위험을 사용자에게 알리며, 근거리에 존재하는 보이지 않는 단말기가 부착된 휴대품을 찾기 위해 찾기기능이 실행되면 찾기 RF신호를 좀더 먼거리 전송할 수 있도록 대 증폭율로 증폭하여 전송하여 먼거리에 존재하는 휴대품 또는 근거리에 존재하는 잘 보이지 않는 휴대품을 신속히 찾을 수 있도록 한다, 또한 다수의 서브단말기들이 메인단말기의 신호를 다른 서브단말기로 전송해주는 중계기의 기능을 갖도록 하여 먼거리에 떨어져 있는 서브단말기들에게도 찾기 RF신호가 송신되어 쉽게 휴대품을 찾을 수 있고, 집안에 설치되는 홈단말기를 더 구성하면서 홈단말기에서 송출되는 RF신호가 메인단말기 및 서브단말기에 수신될경우 메인 단말기는 자동으로 집안모드로 설정되고 하부의 서브단말기들에게 명령 홈단말기에 연결되도록 하고 분실방지기능을 해제하면서 찾기모드로 작동하게 하여 집안에서 공동으로 사용되는 자동차키, 핸드폰, 리모콘과 같이 잘 보이지 않는 물품을 쉽게 찾을 하여 편리하게 사용할 수 있으며, 다시 홈단말기의 실행반경에서 멀어지면 메인단말기는 자신고유의 동작모드를 설정하고 자신에 등록된 서브단말기에 이를 알려 분실방지동작을 수행하여 편한다. 사용자가 잠시 화장실을 가거나 교회에 참석하여 안전모드로 설정하면 메인단말기와 서브단말기가 이격되더라도 경보음이 출력되지 않도록 하여 사용상 불편함을 줄이는 효과를 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Emergency Situation Monitoring using Wearable Device
title_ko: 웨어러블 장치를 이용한 비상 상황 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring an emergency by using a wearable device. The system for monitoring an emergency by using a wearable device according to the present invention comprises: a wearable device which detects a state of a user; and a user terminal which outputs an emergency notification signal based on the detected state of the user, and waits for an emergency release instruction input by the user in response to the emergency notification signal. According to the present invention, a state of a user can be monitored in real time by using the wearable device worn or carried by the user, and a rescue request can be more rapidly transmitted to a reception target registered in advance when an emergency is determined to have occurred based on the state of the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 장치를 이용한 비상 상황 모니터링 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 시스템은 사용자의 상태를 감지하는 웨어러블 장치, 그리고 감지된 사용자의 상태에 기초하여 비상 알림 신호를 출력하고, 비상 알림 신호에 대응하여 사용자로부터 비상 해제 명령의 입력을 대기하는 사용자 단말을 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 사용자가 착용하거나 휴대한 웨어러블 장치를 이용하여 사용자의 상태를 실시간으로 감지하고, 사용자의 상태를 기초로 비상 상황이 발생된 것으로 판단되면, 미리 등록된 수신 대상으로 보다 신속하게 구조 요청할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: independent smoke detection alarm device having escape position indicator
title_ko: 탈출구 지시기를 갖는 독립형 연기 감지 경보기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a standalone smoke detection alarm having an escape exit indicator, and comprises: a smoke detection sensor installed in a housing installed on the ceiling of a building to detect smoke; an escape exit indicator installed in the housing to dynamically display an escape exit direction guidance indication line indicating the direction of the escape exit through a transparent window at the bottom of the housing; and an alarm control unit that controls the display of an escape exit direction guidance indication line from the escape exit indicator when the smoke detection level detected by the smoke detection sensor exceeds a set reference value. According to the standalone smoke detection alarm having such an escape exit indicator, the standalone smoke detection alarm can be installed in an existing building without changing the facility, has a simple structure, and can dynamically display and provide an escape exit direction when smoke is detected, thereby improving the efficiency of escape exit guidance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탈출구 지시기를 갖는 독립형 연기 감지 경보기에 관한 것으로서,  건물의 천정에 설치되는 하우징 내에 설치되어 연기를 감지하는 연기감지센서와,  하우징 내에 설치되며 하우징 하부의 투과창을 통해 탈출구 방향을 지시하는 탈출구 방향안내 표시라인을 동적으로 표시하는 탈출구 지시기와, 연기감지센서로부터 감지된 연기감지 레벨이 설정된 기준치 이상이면 탈출구 지시기로부터 탈출구 방향안내 표시라인이 표시되게 제어하는 경보 제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 탈출구 지시기를 갖는 독립형 연기 감지 경보기에 의하면, 기존의 건물에 시설변경없이 설치할 수 있으면서도 구조가 간단하면서도 연기 감지시 동적으로 탈출구 방향을 표시하여 제공할 수 있어 탈출구 안내 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있다.
assignees: CHOSUN COLLEGE OF SCIENCE&TECHNOLOGY IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Workflow-based quick response system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a workflow-based quick response system and application of the system in a mobile production line of airplane general assemblies. The system comprises an abnormal information obtaining module, an information classification and confirmation module, an early warning information releasing module and a response information synchronizing module, wherein the abnormal information obtaining module captures and submits abnormal information based on a mixed information capturing mechanism; the information classification and confirmation module comprehensively analyzes, determines and processes the abnormal information based on a quick response workflow; according to information generated in the quick response workflow, the early warning information releasing module displays early warning information via different early warning display devices; and the response information synchronizing module is connected with the early warning information releasing module via serial ports to query and update information in the quick response workflow. The system can be used to display, manage and monitor different production emergency information in the airplane assembling process, can help relevant departments take measures rapidly to decrease direct man-hour consumption in assembling, eliminates delay in production process, improves product quality, and finally realizes the requirement of zero-latency production.

title_en: RFID labeling-based highway emergency warning message (EWM) data packet identification and reception method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a RFID labeling-based highway emergency warning message (EWM) data packet identification and reception method. The method comprises that 1, a RFID responder is installed at each inlet of a highway, wherein the responder comprises ID information of the highway and information related to mileage from the starting inlet of the highway to the responder and ID information data of parts of the same highway along different driving directions are different, 2, when a vehicle goes through an inlet of the road provided with the RFID responder, a reader installed in the vehicle reads highway ID information and mileage information in the responder, 3, a vehicle-mounted CPU effectively processes and records the acquired ID information and mileage information, accumulates the recorded mileage to the mileage computed at the intersection, and continuously updates the memory cell, and 4, through EWM information received by an OBU, according to preferential identification and comparison between the ID information and mileage information in the EWM data packet, the vehicle determines a relative position relationship with a vehicle in an accident and then determines if the EWM information needs to be read or transmitted.

title_en: A kind of side slope real-time stability monitoring and warning system based on rainfall
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of side slope real-time stability monitoring and warning systems based on rainfall, module, rainfall infiltration model building module and controller are established including data acquisition module, static flow model in porous media, data acquisition module is used for soil strength parameter and soil body penetration parameter；Data acquisition module is additionally operable to obtain the displacement variable of ground at each coordinate after different rainfalls；Static flow model in porous media establishes module for establishing the static flow model in porous media of side slope according to the soil strength parameter and soil body penetration parameter of ground at each coordinate；Rainfall infiltration model building module is used for the parameter in the static flow model in porous media of displacement variable update according to ground at each coordinate after different rainfalls, to obtain rainfall infiltration model；Controller is used to calculate the stationary value of the ground after rainfall, and the alert when stationary value is more than pre-determined stability value.The all sequencing of all modeling process, easy to operation and programming greatly reduced artificial calculation amount, and prediction result is more reliable by the present invention.

title_en: Early warning information processing method and device for multiple disasters based on time-space correlation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for processing early warning information of multiple disasters based on space-time correlation, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early warning information report, and acquiring early warning stage types of a first historical disaster early warning information report and at least one second historical disaster early warning information report; under the condition that the obtained early warning stage types are all judged to be finished reporting, when the current disaster early warning risk level is higher than a threshold value, determining that the current disaster early warning information is reported as the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the acquired early warning stage type is determined to be non-end report, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is an updated report or an end report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the first historical disaster early warning information report or the second historical disaster early warning information report according to the information generation category and the early warning end condition of the current disaster early warning information report. The disaster early warning system can realize the time-space correlation of disaster early warning information reports of different monitoring areas and perform the fusion of disaster early warning events.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Wireless type parking guidance system with ststem of early warning earthquake and sensing quake
title_ko: 지진 및 진동 감지 시스템을 구비한 무선 주차 유도 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a parking guidance system. The parking guidance system is installed on a parking lot, includes both a vehicle sensor and an earthquake sensor, senses the presence of a vehicle in a normal situation, communicates with a sensor control module and a central control module, operates an earthquake alarm system by transmitting earthquake sensing information to the sensor control module when the earthquake sensor senses an earthquake, and keeps operating the earthquake alarm system as long as the earthquake sensor keeps sensing the earthquake, transmits a vehicle sensing signal to the sensor control module when a change in the vehicle is sensed by the vehicle sensor during the operation of the earthquake alarm system, and transmits a release signal to the earthquake alarm system from the sensor control module to execute only the vehicle sensing function since the earthquake sensor does not send the earthquake sensing information to the sensor control module when stopping sensing the earthquake. In addition, the parking guidance system can be installed outdoors by including batteries and solar cells to enable the sensor module to wirelessly communicate with the sensor control module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 주차장에 설치되는 주차 유도 시스템에 차량감지 센서와 지진감지 센서를 모두 구비시켜 평소에는 차량 유무를 감지하여 센서제어모듈 및 중앙제어모듈과 통신하되, 지진감지 센서에서 지진이 감지되면 센서제어모듈에 지진감지정보를 송신하여 지진경보시스템이 동작하게 하며, 지진센서에서의 지진감지가 지속 되는 한 지속하여 지진경보시스템을 동작시키며, 지진경보시스템 동작 중, 차량감지센서에서 차량의 변동사항이 감지되면 차량감지신호를 센서제어모듈에 전송하며, 지진감지센서에서 지진감지가 중단되면 센서제어모듈에 더이상 지진감지정보가 전송되지 않으므로 센서제어모듈은 지진경보시스템에 해제신호를 전송하여 차량감지기능만을 수행하게 하는 주차유도시스템을 제공한다. 
또한, 상기 주차유도시스템은 옥외설치가 가능하도록 배터리와 태양전지를 구비하여 배선없이 무선으로 센서모듈이 센서제어모듈과 통신하게 하였다.

title_en: Digital door lock password alert device in emergency situations
title_ko: 응급 상황 발생 시 디지털도어락 비밀번호 알림장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital door lock password notification device in case of an emergency. After an emergency dispatch request notifying the occurrence of an emergency situation of a requester living in an apartment house such as a detached house or an apartment is received by a rescue server, a rescuer smartphone receiving an emergency dispatch command acquires and displays the digital door lock password of the requester's house from a beacon installed in the house where the requester resides, and notifies the rescuer. According to the present invention, even when an emergency situation occurs in the house, the digital door lock is unlocked inside the house, and the door cannot be opened, the digital door lock password is displayed and notified on a rescuer smartphone carried by a rescuer who has been urgently dispatched to the location of the house where the rescuer resides, so that the digital door lock can be unlocked and the door is opened to quickly enter the house to rescue the rescuer. In particular, by displaying the digital door lock password on the authorized rescuer smartphone, it is possible to prevent or minimize the risk of exposure of the digital door lock password of the rescuer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급 상황 발생 시 디지털도어락 비밀번호 알림장치에 관한 것으로, 단독주택이나 아파트 등과 같은 공동주택에 거주하는 요구조자의 응급 상황 발생을 알리는 긴급 출동 요청이 구조서버로 접수된 후 긴급 출동 명령을 받은 구조자 스마트폰이 요구조자가 거주하는 주택에 설치된 비컨으로부터 요구조자 주택의 디지털도어락 비밀번호를 획득 후 표시하여 구조자에게 알려준다. 
본 발명에 따르면 집 안에서 응급 상황이 발생하고 집 안쪽에서 디지털도어락을 잠금 해제하고 도어를 열어 줄 수 없는 상황에서도 요구조자가 거주하는 주택 위치로 긴급 출동한 구조자가 휴대하는 구조자 스마트폰에 디지털도어락 비밀번호를 표시하여 알려줌으로써 디지털도어락을 잠금 해제하고 도어를 열어 집 안으로 신속하게 진입하여 요구조자를 구조하게 할 수 있으며, 특히 인가된 구조자 스마트폰에 디지털도어락 비밀번호를 표시함으로써 요구조자의 디지털도어락 비밀번호의 노출 우려를 방지 혹은 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of indoor intelligent emergency personnel evacuating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of indoor intelligent emergency personnel evacuating system; including installing plate; the preceding surface of installing plate is provided with loading plate; the loading plate upper surface is provided with evacuation mechanism; rectangular aperture is machined with the No.1 mounting box both side surface; catch net is equipped with each rectangular aperture, Surface Machining has opening before the signal box, and electronics gear door is provided with the edge of opening.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows; the present apparatus can timely carry out smokescope and withdraw the report of points for attention, allow people timely to understand smokescope when there is the condition of a fire; correctly reply is when smokescope is big; the problem of LED warning lamps can rotate, and the personnel of improving see clearly, when the intensity of a fire becomes big; device device can be returned in warning box and protected; it is unlikely to be burned, reduces loss, it is easy to use.
assignees: NINGBO LINGYUN TECH INFORMATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis anti-collision structure
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting proposed by the present invention, rescue robot chassis anti-collision structure, by install panel be installed on fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis on, Orbital Symmetry is arranged, connect rear anti-crash plate, middle Crashworthy plate and preceding Crashworthy plate are sequentially connected on rear anti-crash plate, middle Crashworthy plate and preceding Crashworthy plate are under the action of spring buffer bar and resetting spring, in direction bending；When colliding, Crashworthy plate before touching first gives warning in advance, meanwhile, preceding Crashworthy plate is pressurized retraction, at this point, as fire-fighting, rescue robot are braked, substantially bottomless adjustment debit wound, the damage of anti-collision structure is also smaller；Such as fail to brake in time, preceding Crashworthy plate is pressurized retraction until horizontality, simultaneously, anticollision strip is started to work, and one of effect can stop sundries that be involved in chassis, higher-height, the two of its effect, scratch, the sound and vibration prompt driver can be generated with sundries, fire-fighting, rescue robot are braked in time.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Non-standard unsafe behavior detection system in campus
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irregular unsafe behavior detection system in a campus, which comprises a detection processing system and a warning system, wherein the detection processing system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a network updating module; the invention is arranged in any place needing to be supervised by the portable characteristic of the external mobile adjusting camera, increases the monitoring detection range, realizes real-time monitoring without dead angles, simultaneously detects and judges the acquired video image data through the behavior detection model, acquires the irregular behavior and the unsafe behavior of students, carries out early warning and reporting criticism, helps the students to improve the self-supervision habit and parallelism, updates the behavior detection model based on the neural network model, effectively improves the credibility of the detection result, has high intelligent degree, avoids safety accidents, and simultaneously reduces the labor intensity of the teacher for patrol.

title_en: Risk management and control method, system and equipment based on hydraulic engineering project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk management and control method, a system and equipment based on hydraulic engineering projects, which relate to the technical field of risk management and control and calculate sensor data drift abnormality indexes by acquiring multisource monitoring data of a target hydraulic engineering project after an earthquake, and calculating an engineering structure change abnormality index based on a preset structure health model and a seismometer parameter, calculating an earthquake propagation influence index by combining a seismic source distance, further calculating an earthquake influence coefficient by combining the three, and judging whether the original risk early warning evaluation system needs to be updated according to the earthquake influence coefficient. The method can judge whether the risk early warning evaluation system needs to be updated according to the actual disaster degree after encountering a natural disaster event (such as a slight earthquake), ensure that early warning is not delayed or invalid, reduce the possibility of causing larger potential safety hazards, and judge whether the risk early warning evaluation system is updated or not reasonably according to the influence of the actual earthquake on the construction of hydraulic engineering projects, thereby reducing unnecessary waste of computing resources.
assignees: DONGHUA SOFTWARE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-resolution low-air-image risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution low-meteorological risk early warning method, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following components of S1, a data acquisition and preprocessing step, S2, a multi-disaster correlation model building and training step, S3, a high-resolution grid risk calculation step, S4, a risk assessment and grading step, and S5, a linkage early warning release and dynamic updating step; according to the invention, by combining historical disaster data and real-time data, a correlation model of low weather risk and geological disasters and flood disasters and multiple disasters is constructed, linkage early warning of multiple disasters is realized, meanwhile, the correlation model of multiple disasters is dynamically updated and optimized by continuously collecting data in real time, the risk value and the early warning level of a grid unit are timely adjusted according to a new calculation result, and latest early warning information is issued.
assignees: CHONGQING YUNJI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning index correction method under non-stationary condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning index correction method under a non-steady condition, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting rainfall, river water level and branch inflow port water flow movement data in real time and preprocessing; step three, further calculating a hydrologic state model, predicting whether tributaries impact a bank, updating the threshold and early warning if impact, otherwise, returning to the step two. The invention adopts the ultrasonic sensor and the electromagnetic flow velocity meter to collect multiple data, models the prediction jacking effect, dynamically updates the critical rainfall, avoids the adaptation failure of the traditional fixed threshold value, prevents the aggravation of disasters caused by early warning lag, disassembles water flow data and partition differentiation weighting, improves hydrologic evaluation accuracy, combines data preprocessing, and provides reliable support for mountain torrent early warning and flood control decision under non-steady conditions.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: A Closed wet sprinkler heads that can prevent damage due to shocks
title_ko: 충격파손 방지구를 구비한 폐쇄형 습식 스프링클러헤드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a closed wet sprinkler head with an impact-breakage prevention device, preventing breakage due to an impact when a sprinkler head installed in an indoor golf training room is hit by a strong hitting ball of users, thereby preventing an undesired damage due to unexpectable spray of fire water. According to the present invention, the sprinkler head (A) comprises a frame assembly (1), a heat detection unit (2), and a spray unit (3). The frame assembly (1) includes: a frame (100); a circular frame fixation plate (200) formed with a circular steel plate of a ring shape wherein a central part is perforated, having a plurality of piece coupling holes (210) perforated along the ring shape, and coupling the frame (100) to a ceiling finishing material (C) through a shock absorption material (B) by a piece (230); an impact receiving member (300) formed based on a circular rubber plate with a predetermined thickness; a support bush (400); and a head protection device (500).

title_en: A kind of light rail train beam wind information collection and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of light rail beam wind information collection and early warning system, including the acquisition device for beam wind information, current signal/numerical signal conversion device, device, the device for controlling train speed for generating dynamic beam wind calamity source reference threshold, storage device and control device, core of the control module as whole system, on the one hand the operation of aforementioned each device is controlled, on the other hand for being attached realization communication and control with external equipments such as external computer installations.In the present invention, reference threshold for the assessment of beam wind calamity source is using dynamic generation by the way of, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after newest early warning occurs, to compare with historical data, the risk Pre-Evaluation in a certain area is more improved and scientifically considered.The present invention also provides a kind of light railway beam wind information collection and method for early warning.

title_en: Be used for geological disasters monitoring and early warning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning device which structurally comprises an induction machine, a display screen, a placing seat, a supporting clamp, a connecting rod and a sleeve, wherein the induction machine is matched with the display screen in an electrical connection mode, and is in transition fit with the placing seat through the supporting clip, the placing seat is connected on a connecting rod, the connecting rod is in sliding fit in the sleeve, the abutting device and the retraction structure are arranged in the power assisting body, and are matched in the cotton hooking body, when the sector angle is subjected to alternating bending stress applied up and down, the sliding handle is pushed to slide downwards, the outer bow is extruded to be in a full bow state, the abutting device is adjusted to adopt a 'head heavy foot light' mode under the assistance of the retraction structure, the height drop and the stereoscopic impression of the hooked cotton in the bearing platform are guaranteed, the triangular support of the sector angle can be maintained, and the complete transmission of energy flow is facilitated.
assignees: SICHUAN BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES CHENGDU CENTER OF HYDROGEOLOGY AND ENG GEOLOGY

title_en: Nuclear power base emergency method, system, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of nuclear emergency, and provides a nuclear power base emergency method, a system, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining emergency notices corresponding to all users of the nuclear power base, wherein the emergency notices comprise emergency configuration information, and the emergency configuration information is used for indicating the users to withdraw and check in during emergency evacuation; sending the emergency notification to each user; and acquiring the evacuation sign-in information of the user, and determining an evacuation result according to the evacuation sign-in information. The application can improve the accuracy and efficiency of emergency evacuation.
assignees: GUANGDONG NUCLEAR POWER JOINT VENTURE CO LTD;LINGAO NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;Lingdong nuclear power co ltd;DAYA BAY NUCLEAR POWER OPS

title_en: Factory personnel gathers alarm system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of factory safety production, in particular to a factory personnel gathering alarm system which comprises a personnel positioning module, a dynamic area dividing module, a gathering judging module and an alarm processing module. The system divides the virtual grid area by collecting positioning data in real time, judges personnel gathering events by combining preset parameterization indexes, and generates an emergency response path or a daily monitoring path. The data center records environment information and updates a database, and the risk assessment model is utilized to predict the potential safety hazard development condition so as to generate a scheduling strategy. According to the application, the fine warning is realized by quantifying the aggregation index, the accuracy and timeliness of potential safety hazard warning in a complex production environment are improved, and the safety production requirement of a factory is met.
assignees: HANGZHOU XINKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue management method and system, and relates to the field of fire safety. Firstly, after receiving warning information, a background server of a team sends out a warning; after receiving the warning information, the middle team determines the number of fire stations for implementing rescue, auxiliary small stations, police-giving personnel, fire trucks and the like by combining a fire-fighting force distribution map in the area, generates an alarm-giving instruction and sends the alarm-giving instruction. Then, according to the feedback information reported by the small-sized station after the small-sized station arrives at the site, the alarm condition is updated to generate an operation action time line, and the operation process is recorded, so that unified command is facilitated. And finally, the rescue fire brigade arrives at the site and carries out rescue actions according to the instructions until the task is finished. According to the method, the field situation is known in real time through communication between the background server and the client, the disaster information is integrally controlled, and the operation information and the communication command can be accurately and timely transmitted, so that the fire fighting strength in the district can be efficiently and conveniently scheduled and commanded.
assignees: LANZHOU BOYANG SOFTWARE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Control method and system of warning lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a warning light technical field discloses a control method and system of warning light, this application has add ultrasonic transducer on the warning light, ultrasonic transducer sends a plurality of ultrasonic signals in real time, ultrasonic monitoring equipment real-time supervision is received at least one ultrasonic signal, if receive ultrasonic signal, then predict the azimuth information of first warning light according to this ultrasonic signal, and send the azimuth information to the second warning light, search and rescue personnel are equipped with the second warning light, can remove to the direction of first warning light based on azimuth information, in order to avoid the direction to take place the mistake, can be in the removal in-process, whether continuously monitor the ultrasonic signal that the first warning light sent is received, so be convenient for search and rescue personnel continue to search along current direction, and in search the in-process, continuously receive ultrasonic signal, with real-time update azimuth information, thereby be convenient for search and rescue personnel confirm the positional information of waiting rescue personnel as early as possible, improve search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: System and method for the commander's cluster communication application of the aviation integral admittance emergency communication of big-dipper satellite is led to based on day
abstract_en: Lead to the real-time monitoring system for the power equipment under varying environment established with big-dipper satellite based on day, possess data acquisition module, data aggregation module, data analysis module, alarm module, audio call module, exchange, rating database and exchange.Each data acquisition module is provided with itself can identified identity, for the data message in real-time pickup area, and the electric power facility that will be disperseed using Big Dipper high-precision foundation location, the data analysis module is sent data to after tower line data inputting database, after analysis module analyzes real time data, according to analysis result notify exchange or instruction alert rating database is updated or eictic word sound calling module carry out audio call, staff can safeguard system according to different analysis results, and the ambient stable implementations of system each area can be grasped in real time.
assignees: JINAN CHUANGZHI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: risk identification rescue method and system based on coordination of smart watch and smart phone
abstract_en: the risk identification rescue method and system based on the coordination of the smart watch and the smart phone are characterized in that a data acquisition component acquires positioning information data and heart rate information data of a field operation user; the data processing component judges whether the field operation user has poisoning, fainting and falling conditions; the data encryption component encrypts and isolates the acquired data; the data transmission component transmits the encrypted data to the mobile phone end; the management user invites the field operation user and the supervision user to form a community space through the invitation component; the data decryption component decrypts the received data; the risk early warning component is used for triggering a risk alarm by a field operation user, a management user or a supervision user, and the field operation user withdraws according to the risk alarm; and the equipment control component is used for shutting down the field operation equipment according to a preset instruction after the risk early warning component triggers a risk alarm. The intelligent identification and interactive rescue of the working staff in the industrial toxic environment are realized, and the limit of privacy disclosure risk examination is avoided.

title_en: Fatigue driving early warning method, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a fatigue driving early warning method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein a first target fatigue grade is determined from preset fatigue information according to vehicle state data and driver state data, when the accumulated occurrence number of the first target fatigue grade is greater than or equal to a target upgrading threshold value, the first target fatigue grade is upgraded according to an upgrading strategy to obtain a second target fatigue grade, when the second target fatigue grade reaches the highest preset fatigue grade, the accumulated occurrence number of the first target fatigue grade is reset, when the accumulated occurrence number of the first target fatigue grade is smaller than the target upgrading threshold value, the first target fatigue grade is used as the second target fatigue grade, the accumulated occurrence number of the first target fatigue grade is updated, and a corresponding target early warning scheme is executed according to the second target fatigue grade, so that the effect of fatigue driving early warning is improved, and the potential safety hazards of fatigue driving are reduced.
assignees: SINO TRUK JINAN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mine safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine monitoring, and provides an intelligent mine safety monitoring system and method, comprising a path network modeling device, a multi-source risk monitoring device, a personnel positioning and tracking device, a dynamic path updating device and an intelligent evacuation guiding device; when the risk level of any path exceeds a preset safety threshold, an emergency evacuation instruction is triggered, wherein the emergency evacuation instruction is calculated and generated for each person based on a current updated three-dimensional topological model and person position information, evacuation information is output, the evacuation information comprises an emergency evacuation alarm of a whole mine broadcasting level, and a real-time dynamic pointing instruction facing each node is generated according to the personalized optimal evacuation path and is presented through a physical indicating device deployed at the node or terminal equipment carried by the person. The technical scheme disclosed by the application can timely guide staff in the mine to evacuate.
assignees: YANGCHENG BRANCH OF SHANDONG JIKUANG LUNENG COAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall landslide early warning method based on multi-source environment threshold and nonlinear fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall type landslide early warning method based on multi-source environment threshold and nonlinear fusion, which comprises the following steps of constructing a landslide disaster-causing factor set, introducing soil humidity, vegetation index and evapotranspiration, calculating threshold parameters corresponding to rainfall type landslide events to obtain an environment threshold point set, constructing and training a landslide susceptibility model based on progressive learning according to the landslide disaster-causing factor set, adopting a double-layer nonlinear fusion model based on multi-source data fusion and quality perception gating, combining the landslide susceptibility model to obtain comprehensive risk probability distribution, and carrying out grading early warning based on the comprehensive risk probability distribution to finish rainfall type landslide early warning. The method is based on traditional rainfall parameters, introduces early-stage disaster-pregnant environmental factors to form a multi-source environmental threshold, adopts fuzzy logic reasoning to realize nonlinear fusion of threshold information and landslide susceptibility base map, combines with a annual iteration updated susceptibility map layer to dynamically reflect the regional environmental condition evolution process, and realizes more refined and adaptive space grading early warning.
assignees: HUNAN SHUANGPAI PUMPED STORAGE CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Surveillance Robot System for abnormal behavior detection
title_ko: 이상행위 감시를 위한 감시로봇 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot surveillance system for detecting abnormal behaviors capable of improving the reliability of surveillance by recognizing the current location of a robot and if any abnormal signal occurs due to a dynamic obstacle or moved static obstacle at the location delivering the location information and the abnormal signal to a situation room. The system includes: an abnormal behavior surveillance module which detects any abnormal behavior of a dynamic obstacle or due to a moved static obstacle, transmits images in real time, and sends a warning if any problem; an AGV location movement control module which controls the movement of the location of an AGV; an AGV location measurement module which measures the location following the movement of the location of the AGV by the AGV location movement control module; a command execution control unit which checks a movement command from a situation management and control server and executes the movement command; and the situation management and control server which designates and inputs a route in advance, controls autonomous driving and driving route change in case of an obstacle, detects a dynamic obstacle by the abnormal behavior surveillance module, identifies a case where a static obstacle is moved on a map environment, and controls surveillance of abnormal behaviors.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 현재 로봇의 위치를 인식하고 해당 위치에서 동적 장애물/변경된 정적 장애물로 인한 이상 신호가 발생 시 상황실로 위치 정보와 이상 신호를 전달하여 감시 경계의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있도록 한 이상행위 감시를 위한 감시로봇 시스템에 관한 것으로, 동적 장애물 및 변경된 정적 장애물로 인한 이상 행위 감시를 수행하여 실시간 영상 전송 및 문제 발생시의 경고 발송을 하는 이상 행위 감시 모듈;AGV 위치 이동을 제어하는 AGV 위치 이동 제어 모듈;상기 AGV 위치 이동 제어 모듈을 통한 AGV 위치 이동에 따른 위치 측정을 수행하는 AGV 위치 측정 모듈;상황 관리 및 제어 서버의 이동 명령을 확인하여 이동 명령을 수행하는 명령 실행 제어부;미리 경로를 지정해서 입력하고 자율적 주행 및 장애물 인식 시 주행 경로 변경을 제어하고 이상 행위 감시 모듈을 통하여 동적 장애물을 판별하고 또한 맵 환경에서 정적 장애물이 변경된 경우를 파악하여 이상 행위의 감시 제어를 하는 상황 관리 및 제어 서버;를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: PUSAN NAT UNIV IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Integrated rescue management system based on personal position for ship
title_ko: 선박용 개인위치기반 안전구조 통합관제시스템
