abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety rescue integrated control system for a ship based on a personal location, which comprises: a tag device for inputting a unique tag to a mobile device of a ship passenger when boarding on a ship; a ship warning system installed in a ship to monitor a disaster situation of the whole ship; an evacuation support device for storing various disaster states in the ship, and storing each evacuation scenario therefor; an integrated control server for inputting and outputting location-based mobile device information, and receiving ship disaster information from the ship warning system; a communication connection network connected to the integrated control server to transmit a ship disaster state, and receiving external evacuation instruction information; and a dashboard installed in an evacuation control center in the ship to output each evacuation information on the passenger and the ship disaster state. According to the present invention, when an internal warning of the ship is input by the ship warning system to the integrated control server, the ship disaster state is determined using the location-based mobile device information and an internal warning state of the ship, and an optimal evacuation scenario is selected to output individual evacuation information to each passenger mobile device. Also, the dash board is operated to display evacuation information and a disaster progress state of the ship, an evacuation state in the ship is transmitted via the communication connection network, and the external evacuation instruction information is received to update entire evacuation information. According to the present invention, the spread of the dangerous situation during evacuation of a passenger is prevented in case of emergency of the ship, an overall instruction action for emergency can be performed, and an external rescue can be effectively performed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박용 개인위치기반 안전구조 통합관제시스템에 관한 것으로서, 선박 승선자의 모바일 디바이스에 승선시 고유 태그를 입력시키는 태그 장치와; 선박 내 설치되어 선박 전체의 재난상황을 감시하는 선박 경보시스템과; 선박 내 각종 재난상태와 이에 대한 각 대피 시나리오가 저장되는 대피지원장치와; 상기 위치기반 모바일 디바이스 정보가 입출력되고, 상기 선박 경보시스템으로부터 선박 재난정보를 입력받는 통합관제서버와; 상기 통합관제서버에 연결되어 선박 재난상태를 전송하고 외부대피 지휘정보를 입력받는 통신 연결망과; 선박 내 대피관제소에 설치되어 승선자의 각 대피정보와 선박의 재난상태를 출력시키는 대시보드로; 구성되어, 상기 통합관제서버에 상기 선박 경보시스템에서 선박 내부 경보가 입력되면, 상기 위치기반 모바일 디바이스 정보와 선박 내부 경보 상태로 선박 재난 상태를 판단하고 최적 대피 시나리오를 선택하여, 각 승선자 모바일 디바이스로 개별 대피정보를 출력시키고, 상기 대시보드를 가동하여 승선자의 각 대피정보와 선박의 재난 진행상태를 디스플레이시키며, 상기 통신 연결망으로 선박 내 대피 상태를 전송하고, 외부대피 지휘정보를 입력받아 전체 대피정보를 갱신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 의하여, 선박 재난 상황시에 승선자 대피 도중 위험 상황 확산을 방지하고, 재난 상황에 대한 총괄적 지휘 대응이 가능할 수 있게 하고, 외부 구조가 효과적으로 이루어지도록 하는 선박용 개인위치기반 안전구조 통합관제시스템이 제공되는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Missing child tracking system using beacon
title_ko: 비콘을 이용한 미아방지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a missing child prevention system using a beacon which comprises: a guardian terminal running an application operating to measure a separated distance from a wearing device of a target to be protected using a beacon signal received from the wearing device of a target to be protected and generating a notification signal when the measured distance is greater than or equal to a preset distance; and a wearing device of a target to be protected providing an LED display unit generating a beacon signal, interlocked with the guardian terminal to perform bidirectional communication using the guardian terminal and Bluetooth, and displaying display information of preset contents in the LED when the interlocking with the guardian terminal is released.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비콘을 이용한 미아방지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보호 대상자 착용장치로부터 수신되는 비콘(beacon) 신호를 이용하여 보호 대상자 착용장치와의 이격 거리를 측정하고, 상기 측정된 거리가 미리 설정된 거리 이상이면 알림신호를 생성하도록 동작하는 어플리케이션이 구동되는 보호자 단말기; 및 비콘 신호를 발생하며 상기 보호자 단말기와 연동되어 보호자 단말기와 블루투스를 이용하여 양방향 통신하고, 상기 보호자 단말기와 연동이 해제된 경우 미리 설정된 내용의 디스플레이 정보가 LED로 표시되는 LED 표시부가 구비된 보호 대상자 착용장치를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA POLYTECHNIC UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Emergency integrated information service platform system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency integrated information service platform systems, are related to public place security protection and evacuation technical field.The present invention includes emergency integrated information service platform, emergency information acquiring unit, emergency situation from analytical unit, information issue unit, network decision acquiring unit, emergency scheduling unit, information service data library and emergency information Cloud Server.The present invention is sent to emergency integrated information service platform after receiving emergency information by emergency information acquiring unit, situation of meeting an urgent need carries out early warning analysis according to emergency information from analytical unit, emergency scheduling unit obtains emergency preplan from information service data library according to early warning analysis result and emergency information, and emergency preplan is sent to information issue unit, it is effectively guaranteed the treatment effeciency to emergency event, improve the accessibility and validity of emergency evacuation information service, market application value with higher.
assignees: ANHUI ZHIRONG JINGHE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent firefighting visual platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of visual monitoring, and discloses an intelligent firefighting visual platform which comprises a facility monitoring module, a firefighting resource adjusting module, an emergency response module, a combustion rate identifying module, a dynamic early warning module and a firefighting guiding module; according to the intelligent firefighting visual platform, the distribution and the running state of firefighting facilities are monitored in real time, the signal intensity and the transmission delay are analyzed, the response speed and the efficiency of the intelligent firefighting visual platform are effectively improved, the state data of the firefighting facilities can be updated in time, accurate basis can be provided for optimizing a resource network, a water supply distribution route is adjusted, the maximized resource utilization rate is achieved, the understanding of the development of the fire is enhanced, scientific basis is provided for early warning of the fire, and in the aspect of personnel evacuation, an evacuation route is adjusted according to a real-time building structure and people flow data, so that a more efficient and safe solution strategy is provided for firefighting safety.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV WEIFANG

title_en: Intelligent construction management platform for city update
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent construction management platform oriented to city updating, which relates to the technical field of mineral screening and comprises the following steps of establishing a unified data standard and a data interface protocol, and ensuring that data of different systems, departments and enterprises in the platform can be subjected to seamless butt joint. The invention realizes the data sharing of different systems by unifying the data standard and the interface protocol, and improves the project management efficiency and the decision accuracy. The real-time data acquisition and intelligent analysis technology enhances the safety monitoring and intelligent early warning functions, and ensures that potential safety hazards in the construction process are recognized and processed in time. Meanwhile, the flexibility and emergency response capability of the project are improved by the dynamic adjustment and intelligent early warning mechanism, resources and construction plans can be automatically adjusted in project progress, sudden problems are guaranteed to be solved, progress delay and resource waste are reduced, and smooth project progress is guaranteed.

title_en: Bridge navigational watch alarm system using artificial intelligence
title_ko: Ai를 이용한 선교 항해 당직 경보 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bridge navigation watch alarm system using artificial intelligence. The system comprises: a wired call terminal provided in a cabin, an engine controlling room, or a mechanical room; a monitor terminal provided in a remote site in a ship to output a CCTV video of a bridge; a bridge navigational watch monitoring device monitoring watch-keeping of a person responsible for bridges in real time; a mobile communication terminal remote control server performing remote control according to requests from the bridge navigational watch monitoring device; and a mobile communication terminal of a person on bridge duty performing locking or unlocking according to remote control of the mobile communication terminal remote control server. According to the bridge navigation watch alarm system using artificial intelligence described above, the system senses the face, motions, and pupils of a person on bridge duty to allow an artificial intelligence engine to determine whether a person on bridge duty enters a bridge, whether the person sleeps or is drowsy on his/her duty, and whether the person uses a mobile communication terminal, thereby identifying various kinds of negligence of the person on bridge duty in real time and tacking with the same.
abstract_ko: AI를 이용한 선교 항해 당직 경보 시스템이 개시된다.  선실, 엔진 조종실 또는 기계실에 구비되는 유선 통화 단말; 선박 내 원격지에 구비되어 선교의 CCTV 영상을 출력하는 모니터 단말; 선교 당직자의 당직 근무를 실시간 모니터링하는 선교 항해 당직 모니터링 장치; 상기 선교 항해 당직 모니터링 장치의 요청에 따라 원격 제어를 수행하는 이동통신단말 원격 제어 서버; 상기 이동통신단말 원격 제어 서버의 원격 제어에 따라 잠금 또는 잠금 해제를 수행하는 선교 당직자 이동통신단말을 구성한다.  상술한 AI를 이용한 선교 항해 당직 경보 시스템에 의하면, 선교 당직자의 안면, 모션, 눈동자를 감지하여 AI 엔진에 의해 선교 당직자의 선교 출입, 당직 중 수면이나 졸음, 이동통신단말의 이용 등을 판단하도록 구성됨으로써, 선교 당직자의 다양한 근무 태만을 실시간으로 확인하고 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Landslide real-time monitoring early warning system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of landslide real-time monitoring early warning systems.Using wireless internet of things technology GPS positioning technology, electronic gyroscope posture analysis technology and wireless internet of things technology, multiple sensor nodes, multiple host observation point and cloud backstage observation point are formed into a network by wireless internet of things technology, sensor node uses GPS positioning technology and electronic gyroscope posture analysis technology in network, converts collected GPS and electronic gyroscope data value to by algorithm the variation of practical moving distance, the direction of motion and posture.And reporting massif breath letter extremely to host automatically by wireless internet of things, host receives voice broadcast early warning immediately after breath letter, informs that nearby personnel take care and withdraws.And reporting dangerous situation to give cloud backstage Observation personnel by network simultaneously, tissue rescue personnel enters disaster area rescue, realizes monitoring and warning system.

title_en: Location information updating method of wireless emergency alarm, mobile terminal and network equipment
abstract_en: Provided are a location information updating method of a wireless emergency alert, a mobile terminal, a network device, and a computer-readable medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first geographical position where a mobile terminal is currently located; sending a request message to a network side through an IMS network via a Wi-Fi hotspot, wherein the request message is used for initiating a subscription service of a wireless emergency alarm and carries a first geographical position; receiving a response message sent by a network side; checking whether the response message carries a location updating parameter of the wireless emergency alarm, if so, storing the location updating parameter and acquiring a second geographic location where the mobile terminal is currently located according to the location updating parameter; and sending an update message to the network side, the update message including the second geographic location. The method realizes that the geographical position information is simply, timely and accurately updated to the network by carrying the geographical position information in the request message and the updating message for initiating the wireless emergency alarm subscription service.

title_en: Tunnel construction safety early warning system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel construction safety pre-warning system based on BIM, comprising: the construction site monitoring module is used for collecting the tunnel construction site data in real time based on the sensor and monitoring the construction progress according to the site data; the BIM model building module is used for building a three-dimensional BIM building model based on a tunnel construction drawing and updating the three-dimensional BIM building model in real time according to field data; the safety threshold construction module is used for presetting the safety threshold of each field data based on the three-dimensional BIM building model uploading information; the abnormal condition monitoring module is used for identifying abnormal data according to the three-dimensional BIM building model updated in real time and the safety threshold value of each field data; the abnormal condition early warning module is used for analyzing the abnormal data, carrying out tunnel construction safety early warning judgment and making early warning or warning prompt. The invention can prevent the occurrence of safety accidents through dynamic risk assessment and visual early warning, and strengthen the active control of risks.
assignees: UNIV HUBEI EDUCATION;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Karst development area geological disaster identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst development area geological disaster identification method and system based on artificial intelligence, relates to the field of geological disaster early warning and risk assessment, and solves the technical problems that geology and related data are difficult to integrate, model prediction disaster types are difficult to construct based on historical disaster cases and real-time monitoring data, and a prediction result is lack of correlation with a geographic space so as to generate a risk distribution map and dynamically update a high risk area; the method comprises the following steps: introducing multi-source heterogeneous data and combining historical geological disaster cases; preprocessing data; extracting the characteristics of the change rate of the underground water level, the soil humidity and the vibration frequency; combining a plurality of features into a feature matrix, and projecting the feature matrix into a principal component space; after training a model by using a random forest algorithm, optimizing and constructing the model by combining cross verification and a Bayesian algorithm; converting the model prediction result into a risk grade value through a mapping rule; and generating a risk level distribution map based on the GIS data.
assignees: GUIZHOU BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT 114 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE

title_en: Security apparatus providing home security service using SNS and method thereof
title_ko: Sns를 이용하여 홈 보안 서비스를 제공하는 보안 장치 및 보안 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a security apparatus for providing a home security service, capable of determining whether a user is in an emergent situation and alerting SNS friends of the user to the situation, and to a method thereof. The security apparatus according to the present invention comprises: an SNS friend storage unit for storing SNS account information on at least one SNS friend of each user; an emergent situation determination unit for analyzing information being received from a user terminal, and determining whether an emergent situation occurred or not; a security operation unit for transmitting, if an emergent situation is determined to have occurred, a message alerting to the emergency situation, to SNS friends of the user by using the SNS account information of the user; and an emergent situation reporting unit for estimating the emergency level of the situation, after the message is transmitted, and automatically reporting the situation if the estimated emergency level is not released for a predetermined time. According to the present invention, the security apparatus enables notification of an emergent situation of a user to SNS friends or neighboring users of the user, thereby allowing the situation to be reported promptly, and preventing false or erroneous reports.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자의 위험 상항을 판단하여 SNS 지인들에게 알리는 홈 보안 서비스를 제공하는 보안 장치 및 보안 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따르는 보안 장치는, 사용자별로 적어도 하나 이상의 지인에 대한 SNS 계정 정보를 저장하는 SNS 지인 저장부; 사용자 단말로부터 수신되는 정보를 분석하여 위험 상황의 발생 여부를 판단하는 위험 상황 판단부; 위험 상황이 발생한 것으로 판단한 경우, 사용자의 SNS 계정 정보를 이용하여 위험 상황의 메시지를 알리는 보안 동작부; 및 메시지가 전송되면 사용자의 위험 상황을 설정하고, 소정 시간 내에 설정된 위험 상황이 해제되지 않는 경우, 자동 신고하는 위험 상황 신고부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 위험 상황을 SNS 지인들 또는 이웃 사용자들에게 알려서 조속한 신고가 가능하고 신고의 허위나 오류의 가능성이 배제된다.

title_en: Shared bicycle platform system equipped with a shared bicycle installation display based on global positioning system location information and its operating method
title_ko: Gps 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템 및 그 운용 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a shared bicycle platform system having a shared bicycle installation type display based on GPS location information. The shared bicycle platform system comprises: a user device (110) in which a dedicated application (111) for performing a procedure and a series of processes for sharing, using, and returning a shared bicycle (101) is mounted and executed; a display device (120) for displaying a preset advertisement based on GPS location information while a user rides on the shared bicycle (101) and moves; and a management server (130) for registering and managing the shared bicycles (101) in which the display device (120) is installed. According to the present invention, it is possible to promote a positive role and sustainable mobility in carbon reduction activities by encouraging the use of a shared bicycle, and to enable an immediate disaster situation alarm and rapid disaster situation response in an emergency situation such as a national disaster situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 GPS 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템 및 그 운용 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 GPS 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템으로서, 공유 자전거를 공유하여 사용하고 반납하기 위한 절차와 일련의 과정을 수행하기 위한 전용 앱이 탑재되어 실행되며, 예약된 공유 자전거의 잠금을 해제하는 사용자 디바이스; 상기 사용자 디바이스를 통해 잠금이 해제된 공유 자전거에 탑재되어 설치되며, 사용자가 공유 자전거에 탑승하여 이동하는 동안 GPS 위치정보 기반으로 미리 설정된 광고를 표시하는 디스플레이 장치; 및 상기 디스플레이 장치가 설치된 공유 자전거들을 등록 관리하며, 광고주가 설정한 광고가 공유 자전거가 이동하는 동안 디스플레이 장치를 통해 표시되도록 관리하되, 공유 자전거 주행 거리에 대한 보상을 수행하는 관리 서버를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명의 특징에 따른 GPS 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템의 운용 방법은, GPS 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템의 운용 방법으로서, (1) 사용자 디바이스가 공유 자전거를 공유하여 사용하고 반납하기 위한 절차와 일련의 과정을 수행하기 위한 전용 앱이 실행되는 상태에서, 예약된 공유 자전거의 잠금을 해제하는 단계; (2) 사용자 디바이스를 통해 잠금이 해제된 공유 자전거에 탑재되어 설치된 디스플레이 장치가 사용자가 공유 자전거에 탑승하여 이동하는 동안 GPS 위치정보 기반으로 미리 설정된 광고를 표시하는 단계; 및 (3) 관리 서버가 디스플레이 장치가 설치된 공유 자전거들을 등록 관리하며, 광고주가 설정한 광고가 공유 자전거가 이동하는 동안 디스플레이 장치를 통해 표시되도록 관리하되, 공유 자전거 주행 거리에 대한 보상을 수행하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 GPS 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템 및 그 운용 방법에 따르면, 공유 자전거를 공유하여 사용하고 반납하기 위한 절차와 일련의 과정을 수행하기 위한 전용 앱이 탑재되어 실행되며, 예약된 공유 자전거의 잠금을 해제하는 사용자 디바이스와, 사용자 디바이스를 통해 잠금이 해제된 공유 자전거에 탑재되어 설치되며, 사용자가 공유 자전거에 탑승하여 이동하는 동안 GPS 위치정보 기반으로 미리 설정된 광고를 표시하는 디스플레이 장치와, 디스플레이 장치가 설치된 공유 자전거들을 등록 관리하며, 광고주가 설정한 광고가 공유 자전거가 이동하는 동안 디스플레이 장치를 통해 표시되도록 관리하되, 공유 자전거 주행 거리에 대한 보상을 수행하는 관리 서버를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 공유 자전거에 설치된 디스플레이 장치를 통해 지역 특성별 고객 맞춤형 광고와 국가 재난 상황 경보가 가능하고, 광고 표시에 따른 공유 자전거 주행 거리에 대한 라이더 보상이 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 GPS 위치정보 기반 공유 자전거 설치형 디스플레이를 구비한 공유 자전거 플랫폼 시스템 및 그 운용 방법에 따르면, 공유 자전거에 설치된 디스플레이 장치를 통해 지역 특성별 고객 맞춤형 광고와 국가 재난 상황 경보가 가능하고, 광고 표시에 따른 공유 자전거 주행 거리에 대한 라이더 보상이 가능하도록 함으로써, 공유 자전거의 사용을 장려하여 탄소 저감 활동에 긍정적 역할 및 지속 가능한 이동성을 촉진하고, 국가 재난 상황과 같은 비상 상황 시 즉각적인 재난 상황 경보와 신속한 재난 상황 응대가 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Tunnel disaster risk intelligent early warning method and system with self-learning capability
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent tunnel disaster risk early warning method and system with self-learning capability, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the risk degree index of various ground disasters is defined as the four arithmetic results of the corresponding advanced detection/monitoring index value and the correction term, so that the coupling of an experience method and a detection/monitoring method is realized. The detection/monitoring index value is derived from advanced detection or monitoring methods adopted by specific engineering, the correction term depends on geological conditions affecting specific disaster types, and the correction term is derived from advanced detection/monitoring geological interpretation. The initial value of the correction term is obtained by experience judgment and is calculated and obtained according to the matching degree of the actual situation revealed afterwards and the predicted result in advance in the tunnel construction process, so that the correction coefficient value can be continuously learned and updated according to the actual situation in the tunnel circulation tunneling process, and the reliability of the early warning result is improved.

title_en: Transmission device, transmission method, reception device, reception method, and computer program
abstract_en: This invention makes use of a broadcasting service to suitably convey emergency-warning information. A transmission device (200) (broadcasting station) inserts emergency-warning-information signaling in the form of an activation signal and uses a physical-layer packet structure to convey an emergency-warning-information message that indicates the scale (category) of a disaster, the type of the disaster, the time of the disaster, the location of the disaster, version information, and the like. Even a simple, inexpensive reception device (300) provided with just a broadcast reception antenna and a demodulator can receive said emergency-warning-information message. Digital signage or street lights can be used to display directions in which to evacuate or maps or routes to evacuation areas, and street lights can be used to indicate evacuation routes.

title_en: A kind of emergency command platform quickly to relieve traffic congestion
abstract_en: The emergency command platform that one kind disclosed by the invention quickly relieves traffic congestion, including ground, lifting chamber is equipped in the ground, the intracavitary sliding of lifting is equipped with liftable emergency command platform, described emergency command platform or so end is installed with elevator, lifting device is equipped on the outside of the lifting chamber, the lifting device is threadedly coupled with the elevator, then the lifting device can control the emergency command platform to go up and down, the symmetrical retraction slot in front and back is equipped in the emergency command platform, emergency command platform liftable of the invention is shunk, when original state, this device is concordant with ground, ensure the planarization on road surface, when use, emergency command platform is extend out on ground, the cover board of command set periphery has warning function, secondly, be provided in command set can sun-shading rain-proof folding shed device, and foldable shed height is adjustable, it is applied widely, it operates conveniently.
assignees: YIWU ZIYING MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic analysis device for power grid alarm
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic power grid alarm analysis device which comprises a host, an indicator light, a display screen, a key and a power socket, wherein the internal components of the host comprise a cable pipe, a main block, a core bar, a gate valve, a gate row block and an internal groove, the cable pipe is arranged at the top end of the outer wall of the host, the main block is arranged below the cable pipe, the core bar is arranged in the main block, the gate valve is arranged below the main block, and wiring ports and communication cable fastening mechanisms are arranged at two ends of the cable pipe. The substantial effects of the invention are as follows: 1) the whole power system flow structure updated in real time is stored in the cloud, the influence degree of the fault on the power system can be automatically analyzed when the fault occurs, and the technical problem that the existing power system warning device cannot analyze the severity degree of the influence of the abnormal condition causing the warning on the power grid according to the power grid condition is solved; 2) a cable fastening mechanism is introduced to solve the technical problem of interruption or misinformation of power grid detection caused by poor contact at a wiring position.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD KAIHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Electric control system of rescue excavator capable of realizing self-adaptive spraying in high-temperature environment and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric control system of a rescue excavator with self-adaptive spraying in a high-temperature environment, which comprises the following components: the system comprises an environment temperature sensor, a water level sensor, a controller, an electronic monitor, a spray pump proportional valve, a relay, a spray pump and a vehicle-mounted spray water tank, wherein the water level sensor is arranged in the vehicle-mounted spray water tank and used for detecting the water level in the vehicle-mounted spray water tank, a water outlet of the vehicle-mounted spray water tank is connected with the spray pump through a pipeline, the spray pump is connected with a vehicle-mounted spray nozzle through a pipeline, the environment temperature sensor and the water level sensor are connected with an input end of the controller, the spray pump proportional valve and the relay are connected with an output end of the controller, the electronic monitor is interconnected with the controller through a CAN bus, the spray pump is communicated with a power supply through a switch contact of the relay, the working method of the system is used for planning water spraying flow, improving working time and giving early warning, and prompting a rescue excavator to withdraw from a fire scene in time.

title_en: Landslide instability time prediction method and product based on dynamic selection of landslide early warning model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a landslide instability time prediction method and a landslide instability time prediction product based on dynamic selection of a landslide early warning model, and relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and early warning. In the embodiment of the invention, the uncertainty of the candidate model is quantified by adopting a Bayesian method, and the most suitable model with the largest occurrence probability is objectively selected, so that reliable destabilization time probability prediction is provided. For continuous monitoring scenarios, further incorporating sequential Bayesian updates and parallel computation into the above-described approach allows for efficient dynamic updating of destabilizing time predictions when new monitoring data is available. The prediction method for the integrated model selection provided by the invention can achieve reasonable balance between prediction uncertainty and prediction precision, and the average absolute prediction error of the most probable destabilization time of the prediction is obviously lower than that of the prediction method based on a single model. In summary, the present invention proposes a practical, probabilistic framework to predict landslide destabilization time aimed at supporting proactive landslide risk management.

title_en: Intelligent management method for self-rescuer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety equipment management, and discloses an intelligent management method of a self-rescuer, which comprises the following steps of firstly, configuring an identification unit; the method comprises the following steps of deploying an intelligent terminal, processing and storing data, managing platform operation and early warning mechanism. The system realizes intelligent management of the self-rescuer, reduces manual operation, improves management efficiency and accuracy, avoids misrecording, can monitor state information such as quantity, distribution, validity and the like of the self-rescuer in real time, has an early warning function, can timely early warn abnormal conditions such as about to expire, realizes full life cycle tracking management, is convenient to trace, and can enable a manager to quickly inquire the position and quantity of the available self-rescuer through a platform under emergency conditions, thereby improving emergency response capability.
assignees: XIAN ZHONGZHUANG WEIKEN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for determining whether or not an arc abnormality to prevent fire of photovoltaic system
title_ko: 태양광 발전 시스템의 화재예방을 위한 아크 이상 유무 판별 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining the presence of anomaly in an arc to prevent a fire in a photovoltaic system, wherein when an arc detection analog circuit unit (56) matches and amplifies an electrical current and an arc detected by an electrical current/arc sensor (52) with an analog signal, an AD conversion unit (57a) converts the analog signal into a digital signal and an FFT (57b) interprets the digital signal of the AD conversion unit (57a) in a frequency area to identify signal power distribution, further allow an unnecessary band removal unit (57c) to remove a noise band from the signal power distribution of the FFT (57b), allow an effective band power calculation unit (57d) to calculate power of an effective band in the signal power distribution, direct an arc band power calculation unit (57e) to calculate power of an arc band when the electrical current/arc sensor (52) detects an arc, and then allow a power comparison/warning issuing unit (57f) to compare the power of the effective band of the effective band power calculation unit (57d) with the power of the arc band of the arc band power calculation unit (57e) and issue a warning signal when a different therebetween is greater than or equal to a critical point, thereby enabling presence of anomaly in an arc on a transmission line to be accurately determined.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아크검출아날로그회로부(56)에서 전류/아크센서(52)로부터 감지된 전류 및 아크를 아날로그신호로 정합 및 증폭시키면 AD 변환부(57a)에서 아날로그신호를 디지털신호로 변환시키고, 이어서 FFT(57b)는 AD 변환부(57a)의 디지털신호를 주파수영역에서 해석하여 신호전력분포를 파악하고, 나아가 불요대역제거부(57c)를 통해 FFT(57b)의 신호전력분포로부터 잡음대역을 제거, 유효대역전력계산부(57d)를 통해 신호전력분포에서 유효대역의 전력을 계산 그리고 아크대역전력계산부(57e)를 통해 전류/아크센서(52)에서 아크 감지시 아크대역의 전력을 계산토록 한 후, 전력비교/경고발생부(57f)로 하여금 유효대역전력계산부(57d)의 유효대역의 전력 및 아크대역전력계산부(57e)의 아크대역의 전력을 비교하여 상호간의 차이가 임계치 이상일 경우 경고신호를 발생토록 함으로써 송전선로상의 아크 이상 유무에 대한 판별을 정확하게 실현케 한 태양광 발전 시스템의 화재예방을 위한 아크 이상 유무 판별 장치에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: System for having access to flood-prevention early warning service based on Android tablet terminal and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for having access to a flood-prevention early warning cloud service based on an Android tablet terminal and a construction method. The construction method includes the steps of real-time data acquiring of the flood-prevention early warning cloud service, early warning rule management and setting, early warning analysis, early warning information pushing and message noticing and data acquiring, storage and display of a flood-prevention early warning client side system of the Android tablet terminal. Rain condition, water condition, weather, dangerous circumference situation and disaster situation system service interfaces and other system service interfaces are packaged by the flood-prevention early warning cloud services to acquire real-time data, early warning service modules are partitioned according to flood-prevention work needs, corresponding early warning rules are made, data format content is formed, real-time information is analyzed accordingly, and early warning information is pushed to the tablet terminal; message notice pushed by the flood-prevention early warning cloud services is monitored based on the flood-prevention early warning client side system of the Android tablet terminal, latest early warning information data are downloaded from the cloud services or early warning information is acquired in an active request mode and is classified, updated and displayed according to different early warning modules.

title_en: Task scheduling management system, method, device and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a task scheduling management system, method, device and storage medium thereof, compared with the prior art: configuring task parameters and task scheduling on a visual interface; standardizing a standard task interface, providing a platform-level task scheduling center, and improving the development efficiency of engineers; the task execution log is recorded, so that the log can be conveniently tracked by related responsible persons, an early warning threshold value is provided, different early warning mechanisms are dynamically configured, and the method is flexible and universal; the cluster deploys a task executor to ensure high availability of tasks; the disaster recovery mechanism is independently researched and developed, the state of a task executor is monitored through a heartbeat packet, a platform automatically processes a disaster recovery server, faults are transferred, and the usability of a program is improved; the method has the advantages that a gray scale upgrading mechanism is realized, the concept of version numbers is provided, developers can smoothly upgrade the task version, dynamic routing strategies are configured on the bottom layer through Socket communication, the purpose of smooth upgrading is achieved, and the situations of task execution loss and the like caused by upgrading are avoided.

title_en: Fire fighter fire extinguishing protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective clothing identification, in particular to a fire-fighting protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence firefighters. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting body type data of a firefighter and protective clothing data of fire extinguishment equipment of the firefighter, S2, accessing a video monitoring module of a rescue place, then establishing a three-dimensional space model of the rescue place by combining the video monitoring module, collecting video recording data of the firefighter at the rescue place, and sending the video recording data to the three-dimensional space model for supplementing, accurately obtaining key vital sign data such as temperature, humidity and heart rate of the firefighter in the protective clothing through a built-in sensor by monitoring the performance parameters of the protective clothing in real time, and immediately giving an early warning once the data exceeds a safety threshold value, so that the firefighter can know own situation danger in the first time, withdraw replacement equipment in time or take corresponding protective measures, and life safety of the firefighter in fire extinguishment rescue actions is practically ensured.
assignees: U PROTEC SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood prevention rainfall early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rainfall early warning systems, in particular to a flood prevention rainfall early warning monitoring system which comprises a meteorological information module, a rainfall display module, a rainfall report module, a rainfall comparison module, a rainfall early warning module, a data screening module and a short message management module. The invention has the advantages that the weather information is updated timely, and the early warning can be automatically realized when the rainfall threshold is reached; rainfall data of the weather monitoring station is acquired through an external link and is pushed and displayed in the system in real time, so that a user can conveniently know the rainfall data, the rainfall information is updated more timely, the user does not need to screen a large amount of weather information, and the information acquisition efficiency is improved; the rainfall threshold is set or modified in the system according to the permanent brightness requirement, and when the current rainfall data is monitored to exceed the rainfall threshold, the rainfall data is pushed to related personnel in a short message mode, so that users in the rainfall sensitive industry are reminded and warned.
assignees: SHANDONG CTRL CLOUD COMPUTING CO LTD

title_en: Network version digital ocean ball public application and development integration method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a network version digital ocean ball public application and development integration method and system. The intelligent buoy provided with the laser communication device, the scanning device and the processor is used as a dynamic node to construct an self-organizing communication network to share underwater position and ocean current data. When multiple nodes detect abnormal targets at the same time, a cooperative authentication mechanism is triggered. The system drives the nodes to adjust the layout by using a dynamic sphere model, and controls at least three nodes to move towards the center of the target along a spiral path, so that a multi-layer spherical monitoring structure is formed. And finally, uploading the three-dimensional coordinate data code to a shore-based platform to generate an updated digital ocean ball map. The technical scheme provided by the application realizes the accurate positioning and three-dimensional visual monitoring of the abnormal targets of the marine environment, obviously improves the sex and space coverage precision of marine ecological monitoring, and provides three-dimensional data support for marine environment protection and disaster early warning.

title_en: Digital twinning-based falling stone slope geological early warning device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based falling stone slope geological early warning device and method, and relates to the technical field of slope geological early warning. The digital twin module builds a mechanical twin model, combines standard data to dynamically update to form a digital twin body, accurately re-inscribes the slope state, and the early warning decision module realizes hierarchical early warning through a risk assessment system. The whole closed loop of the full link of perception, transmission, modeling and early warning is formed, the problems of fragmentation, strong artificial dependence and actual pain point of static modeling dislocation of traditional early warning data are solved, the transition from passive response to active prejudgment is realized, the on-site quick response and global accurate analysis are balanced, and the accuracy, instantaneity and actual combat of early warning of a falling rock slope are improved.
assignees: THE 5TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 22ND BUREAU GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY 22ND BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;THE FIFTH CIVIL ENG CO LTD OF CREC SHANGHAI GROUP

title_en: Infrastructure disaster warning system and infrastructure disaster warning method
abstract_en: To provide an infrastructure disaster warning system that accurately grasps the risk of contact between an infrastructure facility and a monitored object even at construction sites where the location of the infrastructure facility may change.SOLUTION: An infrastructure disaster warning device includes: a position information acquisition part for acquiring a position of a monitored object that can move at a construction site based on a GPS signal obtained from a GPS terminal attached to the monitored object; an infrastructure position information storage part for storing infrastructure position information representing the location in a three-dimensional space where an infrastructure facility in the construction site is located; an update part for updating the infrastructure position information according to the construction status of the infrastructure facility; a determination part for determining whether the monitored object is within a predetermined range of the infrastructure facility based on the infrastructure position information stored in the infrastructure position information storage part and the position information of the monitored object; and a warning transmitting part for transmitting a warning to a terminal device that is notification destination based on the determination result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Stand-alone wireless fire-alarm and system including the same
title_ko: 독립형 무선 화재 경보기 및 이를 포함하는 시스템
abstract_en: A stand-alone wireless fire alarm device includes the following: a sensor which senses a fire and outputs a sensing signal; a control circuit which outputs a fire signal in response to the sensing signal; an RF transmission/reception module which converts the fire signal into an RF fire signal and outputs the RF fire signal to a remote controller; an alarm unit which sets off a fire alarm in response to the fire signal; and a battery which supplies operation voltage to the sensor, control circuit, RF transmission/reception module, and alarm unit. The RF transmission/reception module converts an RF fire alarm release signal outputted from the remote controller which is RF-paired with the stand-alone wireless fire alarm into a fire alarm release signal and outputs the fire alarm release signal to the control circuit. The control circuit can turn off the fire alarm from the alarm unit in response to the fire alarm release signal.
abstract_ko: 독립형 무선 화재 경보기는 화재를 감지하고 감지 신호를 출력하는 센서, 상기 감지 신호에 응답하여 화재 신호를 출력하는 제어 회로, 상기 화재 신호를 RF 화재 신호로 변환하고, 상기 RF 화재 신호를 리모트 컨트롤러로 출력하는 RF 송수신 모듈, 상기 화재 신호에 응답하여 화재 경보를 발생하는 알람 장치와 상기 센서, 상기 제어 회로, 상기 RF 송수신 모듈, 및 상기 알람 장치로 동작 전압을 공급하는 배터리를 포함하며, 상기 RF 송수신 모듈은 상기 독립형 무선 화재 경보기와 RF 페어링된 상기 리모트 컨트롤러로부터 출력된 RF 화재 경보 해제 신호를 화재 경보 해제 신호로 변환하고, 상기 화재 경보 해제 신호를 상기 제어 회로로 출력하고, 상기 제어 회로는 상기 화재 경보 해제 신호에 응답하여 상기 알람 장치로부터 발생하는 상기 화재 경보의 해제를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of mountain flood monitoring and early warning platform
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of mountain flood monitoring and early warning platform, including manual creation early warning system；Dangerous situation reporting system；Monitoring station judges system；Early warning system, the monitoring station judges that system includes automatic monitor station one, automatic monitor station two, signal tower and early warning service center, the automatic monitor station one and the automatic monitor station two connect together and are directed toward the signal tower, and the signal tower connects and is directed toward the early warning service center；The early warning system includes new generation early warning, cancels early warning, internal early warning and external early warning, the new generation early warning connects and is directed toward the internal early warning, the internal early warning connects and is directed toward the external early warning, and the new generation early warning and the internal early warning connect together and be directed toward the cancellation early warning；Respond starting module；Respond feedback module；Ending module.Mountain flood monitoring and early warning platform provided by the invention has the advantages that early warning speed is fast, warning information is accurate, autonomous early warning.

title_en: Meteorological early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a weather early warning system, which is used for executing a weather early warning method, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, an early warning release module, a receipt module and an updating module, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a data acquisition module acquires weather early warning data and geographical position data of a ship in a navigation warning area; s2, analyzing the acquired weather early warning data in the navigation warning area and the geographical position data of the ship by the data analysis module and obtaining an analysis result; s3, generating an early warning report by the early warning module according to the analysis result; s4, the early warning issuing module issues weather early warning to the ship according to the early warning generation report and generates a receipt; s5, the receipt module sends the receipt to the ship; and S6, when the receipt is sent to the ship, the updating module updates the geographical position data of the ship receiving the receipt. The invention can inform the ship of the weather early warning in time, thereby guaranteeing the safety of the ship.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting and storing a daily behavior pattern of a user; means for receiving disaster information in real time; means for specifying a user in a target area based on the received disaster information; means for collecting latest data (position information, last update time, surrounding user information, and radio wave reception status) of the user when a disaster occurs; and means for issuing a safety confirmation alert to a notification destination registered in advance when the degree of risk exceeds a predetermined threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: The monitoring method and system of application system for telecommunication CRM business service
abstract_en: Embodiment of the present invention provides the monitoring method and system of a kind of application system for telecommunication CRM business service, belongs to the monitoring technical field of application system update.The monitoring method comprises determining that whether the application system has issued new version；Determining that the application system there are in the case where new version, the service of the application system of new version is compared with the service of the application system currently, determines the service change inventory of the application system of new version；The module for the application system that may be influenced during version updating is determined according to the service change inventory；Export the module.The monitoring method and system can judge automatically hidden danger that may be present when whether application system upgrades and upgrade, and notify staff in time, to issue early warning when application system updates, avoid the occurrence of serious failure.
assignees: HEFEI FINEDO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Graded early warning method for stability of toppling deformation body under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a grading early warning method for stability of a toppling deformation body under multiple working conditions, which comprises the steps of collecting real-time monitoring time sequence data and preprocessing, determining an analysis period according to the preprocessing data, extracting target monitoring data to calculate a stability grading label, generating a reinforced support strategy aiming at a high-risk label, generating a maintenance monitoring strategy aiming at the stability label, detecting abnormal deformation based on a current or updated strategy and combining an instability prediction model, and triggering personnel evacuation or disaster early warning through an emergency response decision tree if control abnormality exists. The invention can improve the accuracy and timeliness of the stability control of the dumping deformation body, reduce the risk of geotechnical engineering instability and optimize the distribution of supporting resources.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of monitoring in real time of uneven blast of transmission line of electricity and typhoon early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of monitoring in real time of the uneven blast of transmission line of electricity and typhoon early warning system, monitoring being capable of science with typhoon early warning system in real time for the uneven blast of the transmission line of electricity, objectively assess different grades of typhoon apart from early warning different distance when produce the grade and the disaster loss grade that is caused to power circuit of typhoon of strong wind, improve the validity of wind speed early warning and disaster caused by a windstorm early warning, the degree of accuracy and timeliness, for optimization repairing strength allotment, strengthen early warning before calamity, the ability of anticipation is rushed to repair after prevention and calamity, reduce electric network fault, reduce breakdown loss etc. and technical guarantee is provided.
assignees: JIANGMEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dam safety multi-source data sensing and early warning terminal with multi-monitoring element acquisition function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dam safety early warning, and particularly relates to a dam safety multi-source data sensing and early warning terminal with a multi-monitoring element acquisition function. The interior of the monitoring terminal is provided with a containing cavity and a driving mechanism, so that the position of the radar water level sensor can be dynamically adjusted to update real-time water level data. When the dam is abnormal, the system automatically sends out an early warning signal and transmits an alarm to a remote monitoring center through a communication module. In addition, the structural design of the monitoring terminal adopts an elastic connecting piece and a special-shaped connecting rod, so that the stability and the anti-interference capability of the equipment are enhanced. Through first touch switch and second touch switch and alarm lamp linkage, the system can in time send out the warning at sensor adjustment in-process, improves emergency response ability. The method effectively solves the problems of low data precision, slow response, inflexible monitoring equipment and the like in the traditional dam monitoring system.

title_en: Method and apparatus for auto recording of digital television receiver
title_ko: 디지털 티브이 수신기의 자동 녹화 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An automatic recording method and an automatic recording apparatus of a digital television receiver are provided to output a disaster broadcast when an emergency alarm or an interrupt occurs and to perform an automatic record function. A broadcasting signal receiving member(100) receives digital broadcasting. A storing member(180) stores present received broadcasting. A control member(170) stores the present received broadcasting in the storing member when an emergency alarm or an interrupt occurs, commands the conversion and return of the disaster broadcasting and reproduces the broadcasting stored in the storing member. A broadcasting output member(140) selectively reproduces the stored broadcasting according to the control of the control member. The present received broadcasting is stored in a time shift function. The interrupt information generates by interruption of the video or audio signal received by the present watching broadcasting.
abstract_ko:
개시된 본 발명은 긴급경보(EAS) 또는 인터럽트 발생시 자동 녹화 기능을 수행하는 디지털 TV 수신기의 자동 녹화 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 디지털 방송을 수신하고; 긴급경보 또는 인터럽트 발생시 현재 수신되는 방송을 저장시킴과 동시에 해당 재난방송으로 전환하고; 상기 긴급경보 해제시 해당 재난방송을 종료하고 상기 단계에서 정지된 시점으로부터 저장된 방송을 재생한다. 상기 현재 수신되는 방송을 저장시키는 기능은, 타임 시프트(Time Shift) 기능에 의하여 저장되고, 상기 긴급경보는, 현재 시청중인 방송으로 수신되는 비디오 또는 오디오 신호의 인터럽트에 의하여 발생하거나, 현재 시청중인 방송으로 수신되는 PSIP(Program and System Information Protocol) 데이터에 의하여 발생한다. 따라서, 긴급경보 또는 인터럽트 발생시 해당 재난방송을 출력함과 아울러, 자동으로 현재 시청중인 방송의 녹화 기능을 수행하고, 재난방송 종료후 녹화된 방송으로부터 현재 시청하던 방송을 이어서 재생하여 본 방송을 끊김 없이 시청할 수 있다. 
       
     긴급경보, 인터럽트, EAS, 녹화, 타임 시프트, TS, TV, PVR, 재난방송

title_en: Information provision system and method using telephone calls
title_ko: 전화 통화를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing information using a telephone call. The system automatically displays a telephone number of a call center of a traffic information center corresponding to a stopped road on a dial screen of an information providing mobile device or on a screen of a running navigation when an abnormal stop occurs due to a failure, an accident, unconsciousness during driving, and a warning of a terminal for a vehicle or a vehicle. When the telephone call is made to the displayed call center of the traffic information center, a report data set including traffic risk information is automatically transmitted to a server of the traffic information center. The traffic information center server automatically analyzes the report data set, automatically generates a shared data set including traffic risk information based on valid information among them, and provides the shared data set to an information receiving mobile device. The information receiving mobile device automatically guides valid traffic risk information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전화 통화를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 
고장이나 사고, 운전 중 의식불명 및 자동차 또는 차량용 단말기의 경고 등으로 인한 비정상 정차 시, 정차한 도로에 해당하는 교통정보센터의 콜센터 전화번호를 정보 제공 모바일기기의 다이얼 화면 또는 실행 중인 내비게이션의 화면에 자동으로 표출하고, 표출된 교통정보센터의 콜센터로 전화 통화 시 교통위험 정보가 포함된 신고 데이터 set를 교통정보센터의 서버로 자동으로 전송하며, 교통정보센터 서버는 신고 데이터 set를 자동으로 분석하고, 이 중 유효한 정보를 기반으로 교통위험 정보가 포함된 공유 데이터 set를 자동으로 생성하여, 정보 수신 모바일기기에 제공되도록 하면, 정보 수신 모바일기기는 유효한 교통위험 정보를 자동으로 안내하는 전화 통화를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Intelligent gas monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gas monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: the gas acquisition module is used for acquiring gas to be detected in a target monitoring area based on a preset monitoring probe; the gas component analysis module is used for analyzing the collected gas to be detected and determining the gas type and the corresponding gas concentration in the gas to be detected; and the early warning module is used for judging whether dangerous gas leakage exists or not based on the gas type and the corresponding gas concentration and carrying out early warning operation when the dangerous gas leakage occurs. The realization is monitored the regional gas of monitoring in succession, and when taking place dangerous gaseous leakage, transmits alarm signal in real time to command center and carries out the early warning operation to the scene, has improved the accuracy and the validity of gas monitoring, avoids major incident hidden danger, stops dangerous emergence.

title_en: Mining area catastrophe early warning method, device and equipment based on rock mass multidimensional quantitative characterization model
abstract_en: The application provides a mining area catastrophe early warning method, device and equipment based on a rock mass multidimensional quantitative characterization model, which inputs collected multi-field data of a stress field, a rock mass damage field and a permeation field into a multi-field co-evolution model to obtain corresponding multi-field evolution coefficients, and updates the output of the catastrophe early warning model by the evolution coefficients, so that a stress-rock mass damage-permeation co-evolution mechanism is constructed, the prediction precision of disasters such as rock burst, water burst mud burst and the like is ensured, and the advanced early warning and active control of catastrophe are realized.

title_en: Early warning and optimizing method for extreme value fault of driving voltage of cloud data of lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery cloud data driving voltage extreme value fault early warning optimization method, which belongs to the technical fields of fault early warning and software algorithms: according to the method, the relationship between the consistency of the battery and the abnormality of the battery is analyzed, the judgment of the battery fault is converted into the problem of voltage consistency evaluation, firstly, the method utilizes feature extraction and feature selection to extract the health features of the battery, secondly, density noise spatial clustering particles are generated based on the minimum field radius calculation principle, the voltage consistency is measured by optimizing the spatial clustering particles and tracking individual extremum and population extremum to update individual positions, then the parameter with the extremum dimension as one is defined, the generalization capability of the algorithm to actual working conditions is improved, and finally, the super-parameter in the proposed early warning algorithm is determined by utilizing orthogonal experiments, so that the fault early warning of the battery system is realized. The invention can realize the fault early warning of the lithium battery system, avoid the safety accidents caused by improper maintenance in the use process of the battery, and reduce the occurrence rate of the fault safety accidents of the lithium battery system.
assignees: LINENG XINGKONG TIANJIN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for forwarding emergency messages from a terminal in a communication network
title_ko: 통신 네트워크에서 단말로부터 긴급 메시지들을 포워딩하기위한 방법
abstract_en: The invention describes a method by means of which a user can transmit emergency messages to a selected communication network, in particular a WiMax network, even without valid registration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 유효한 등록이 없더라도, 사용자가 긴급 메시지들을 선택된 통신 네트워크, 특히 WiMAX 네트워크로 전송할 수 있도록 하는 방법을 기술한다.

title_en: Real-time monitering and diagnostic system for turn-out branching-off point and crossing
title_ko: 분기기 및 선로전환기 실시간 감시 및 진단 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring and diagnosing a branching-off point and a track turning point and comprises a track turning point safety information reception unit for receiving the safety information of a track turning point sensing unit for sensing the safety operation of the track turning point which provides power to convert the branching-off point ,which converts the direction of the track to convert the progress direction of a train, into a normal position and an opponent position; an adhered locking apparatus safety information reception unit for receiving the safety information of an adhered locking apparatus sensing unit for sensing the safety operation of the adhered locking apparatus for locking by adhering a tongue rail to a basic rail according to the conversion of the branching-off; an adhered detecting point safety information reception unit for receiving the safety information of an adhered detecting point sensing unit for sensing the safety operation of the adhered detecting point for detecting the adhered state of the basic rail and the tongue rail; and a comparison processing unit for analyzing the position and cause of faults by analyzing the safety information inputted from the track turning point safety information reception unit, the adhered locking apparatus safety information reception unit, and the adhered detecting point safety information reception unit. According to the present invention, the system accurately and rapidly responds to faults of operation and maintenance by transmitting an error message or emergency warning when abnormal information is generated after analyzing the safety information of the track turning point, the adhered locking apparatus, and the adhered detecting point by receiving the safety information using the cable in real time. [Reference numerals] (100) Monitoring and diagnose system; (110) Track turning point; (120) Track turning power; (130) Adhered detecting point; (160) Adhered locking device; (30) Signal machine room
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 분기기 및 선로전환기 실시간 감시 및 진단 시스템에 관한 것으로; 열차의 진행 경로를 변경하기 위해 열차가 운행되는 선로의 방향을 변환하는 분기기를 정위 또는 반위 방향으로 전환할 수 있도록 동력을 제공하는 선로 전환기가 안전하게 작동하는지 감지하는 선로 전환기 센싱부의 안전정보를 수신하는 선로전환기 안전정보 수신부와; 상기 분기기 전환에 따라 기본레일에 텅레일이 밀착되면 쇄정하는 밀착쇄정장치가 안전하게 작동하는지 감지하기 위한 밀착쇄정장치 센싱부의 안전정보를 수신하는 밀착쇄정장치 안전정보 수신부와; 기본레일과 텅레일의 밀착 상태를 감지하는 밀착검지기가 안전하게 작동하는지 감지하는 밀착검지기 센싱부의 안전정보를 수신하는 밀착검지기 안전정보 수신부와; 상기 선로전환기 안전정보 수신부와 밀착쇄정장치 안전정보 수신부 및 밀착검지기 안전정보 수신부로부터 입력되는 안전정보를 분석하여 고장 유무 및 고장 위치와 원인을 분석하는 비교처리부;로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 선로전환기와 밀착쇄정장치 및 밀착검지기의 안전정보를 실시간으로 케이블을 통하여 병렬로 수신하여 정상 또는 비정상 여부를 분석한 후 만약 비정상 정보가 발생된 경우에는 비상경보 또는 에러 메시지를 송출함으로써 운영 및 유지보수 요원 등이 이상 또는 고장이 발생한 위치를 정확히 알 수 있어 신속하고도 정확한 대처를 할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and system for opening and closing emergency door
title_ko: 비상문 개폐 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: A system for opening and closing an emergency door includes: a fire alarm detecting occurrences of fires and generating a control signal to wirelessly transmit the same to the emergency door; and an EM lock device for unlocking the emergency door by allowing the power to be blocked when the control signal is received.
abstract_ko: 비상문 개폐 시스템은, 화재가 발생하였음을 감지하고, 제어 신호를 생성하여 비상문으로 무선 전송하기 위한 화재경보기, 및 제어 신호를 수신함에 따라, 전원이 차단됨으로써 비상문의 잠금을 해제시키기 위한 EM락 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of four camera multifunctional running recorder mounting structures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of four cameras multifunctional running recorder mounting structure, including the first rack, supporting plate is provided with first rack, multiple second racks are rotatably connected in the supporting plate, the both sides of second rack are equipped with the first chute, the first sliding bar is equipped with first chute, the side wall relative with the first chute is fixedly connected respectively at the two ends of first sliding bar, sliding shoe is socketed with two first sliding bars, retractor device is equipped between two sliding shoes and supporting plate, the upper and lower ends of first rack are all provided with fluted, illuminating lamp and alarm are respectively equipped with two grooves.A kind of four cameras multifunctional running recorder mounting structure can comprehensively record motor vehicle environment image, potential safety hazard is reduced, and warning function and illumination functions can be provided, prevents automobile to be stolen, use and provided conveniently, while conveniently removing and installing for user's night.

title_en: Real-time interaction method for MQTT interconnection of earthquake early warning terminal platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning, in particular to a real-time interaction method for MQTT interconnection of an earthquake early warning terminal platform, which comprises the steps of constructing an MQTT middleware, defining a Topic according to administrative regions and terminal types, reporting the types after terminal initialization and subscribing to corresponding Topic, setting an update timer, detecting the change of the Topic and dynamically subscribing, monitoring the connection state, triggering reconnection when disconnected, guaranteeing reliable transmission of the information by adopting a QoS strategy, analyzing and processing the received early warning information, and converting the information processing flow by adopting an innovative three-layer Topic architecture, wherein the message processing flow is reduced, the delay is reduced, and the route based on geographic topology ensures that the key region receives the early warning information preferentially.

title_en: Automatic Fire Extinguishing System For Automobile Engine Room
title_ko: 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 자동 소화시스템
abstract_en: An automatic fire extinguishing system in an engine compartment of a small tactical vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a continuous temperature-type sensing linear detector (100) installed in the engine compartment of the small tactical vehicle and detecting a fire warning position reaching a predetermined temperature; a thermal image detector (200) interlocking with the continuous temperature-type sensing linear detector (100) to photograph the fire warning position; a control unit (300) which determines whether or not a fire has occurred in the engine compartment of the small tactical vehicle based on data of the thermal image detector (200); a fire extinguishing unit (400) which receives a command from the control unit (300) and is in charge of extinguishing a fire in the engine compartment of the small tactical vehicle; and a monitoring unit (500) which is connected to the continuous temperature-type sensing linear detector (100), the thermal image detector (200), the control unit 300, and the fire extinguishing unit (400) to exchange data and monitor the state of the engine compartment of the small tactical vehicle. The thermal image detector (200) is normally maintained in a standby mode, and when the fire warning position is specified by the continuous temperature-type sensing linear detector (100), the standby mode is released to photograph the fire warning position.
abstract_ko:
본 개시의 실시예에 따른 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 자동 소화시스템은, 
소형전술차량 엔진룸에 설치되어 소정의 온도에 도달하는 화재경고위치를 감지하는 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100); 상기 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100)와 연동되어 상기 화재경고위치를 촬영하는 열화상 감지기(200); 상기 열화상 감지기(200)의 데이터를 바탕으로 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 화재발생여부를 판단하는 제어부(300); 상기 제어부(300)의 명령을 받아 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 화재발생 시 소화를 담당하는 소화부(400); 및 상기 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100). 상기 열화상 감지기(200). 상기 제어부(300) 및 상기 소화부(400)와 연결되어 데이터를 주고받으며 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 상태를 모니터링할 수 있는 모니터링부(500); 를 포함하되, 
상기 열화상 감지기(200)는 평상시 대기모드로 유지되고, 상기 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100)에 의해 화재경고위치가 특정되는 경우에는 대기모드를 해제하여 상기 화재경고위치를 촬영하는 것을 특징으로 하여 구성될 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV TONGMYONG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Lamp for swichboard case
title_ko: 배전반 함체용 램프
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a lamp for a switchboard case, wherein a light, a warning light, and a speaker are operatively installed in a switchboard case, so that the light, the warning light, and the speaker can automatically operate depending on mode settings of a controller when a door is opened, thereby ensuring a visual field of a worker and calling the attention of surrounding workers to establish a safe work environment. In case of an accident such as a fire and current leakage during work, countermeasures can be rapidly induced through changing the mode of the controller. The lamp for a switchboard case according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a lamp body installed to be able to flicker inside the switchboard case and having a light located on one side and a warning light located on the other side; a controller installed to be electrically connectable to the lamp body inside the switchboard case, having a built-in speaker that outputs an alarm sound, and allowing the light, the warning light, and the speaker to operate in various modes depending on settings; and a sensor installed to be electrically connectable to the controller inside the switchboard case to enable the controller to control the power supply to the lamp body depending on whether the switchboard case's door is opened or closed, wherein the operation of the light, the warning light, and the alarm speaker is started depending on the mode settings of the controller when the switchboard case's door is opened and the operation of the operating light, warning light, and speaker is stopped when the switchboard case's door is closed.
abstract_ko:
개시된 내용은 배전반 함체 내부에 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커가 작동 가능하게 설치되어 도어 개방시 컨트롤러의 모드 설정에 따라 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커가 자동으로 작동됨으로써 작업자의 시야확보는 물론 주변 작업자의 주위환기를 통해 안전한 작업환경이 조성될 수 있고, 작업중 화재 및 누전과 같은 안전사고가 발생될 경우 컨트롤러 모드 변경을 통해 신속한 후속대응이 유도될 수 있도록 한 배전반 함체용 램프에 관한 것이다. 
개시된 내용의 일 실시 예에 따른 배전반 함체용 램프는 배전반 함체 내부에 점멸 가능하게 설치되되, 일측에는 조명등이 위치되고 타측에는 경광등이 위치되는 램프본체와, 상기 배전반 함체 내부에 상기 램프본체와 전기적으로 접속 가능하게 설치되고 내부에는 알람음이 출력되는 스피커가 내장되며 설정에 따라 상기 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커가 다양한 모드로 작동되게 하는 컨트롤러와, 상기 배전반 함체 내부에 상기 컨트롤러와 전기적으로 접속 가능하게 설치되고 상기 배전반 함체 도어의 개폐 여부에 따라 상기 컨트롤러에서 상기 램프본체로의 전원공급이 제어되게 하여, 상기 배전반 함체 도어의 개방시 상기 컨트롤러의 모드 설정에 따라 상기 조명등, 경광등 및 알람음 스피커의 작동이 개시되게 하고 상기 배전반 함체 도어의 폐쇄시 작동중인 상기 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커의 작동이 중지되게 하는 센서가 포함되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Umbrella-type surfing security alerting system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of umbrella-type surfing security alerting system, including surfboard location equipment, sandy beach area update equipment, blue water more new equipment, region decision equipment and warning commanding apparatus, current blue water for the location data based on satellite navigation, the current sandy beach region of real-time update and real-time update determines whether to send deep-sea early warning signal or deep-sea early warning signal, and realizes corresponding with sandy beach early warning signal or deep-sea early warning signal warning operation.By means of the invention it is possible to while umbrella-type surfing equipment rushes at danger zone, Zone Alerts information be sent in time, so as to be prevented effectively from casualties.
assignees: WUXI BEIDOUXINGTONG INF TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Stress wave P-wave component pickup sensor based on hollow piezoelectric ball and application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stress wave P-wave component pickup sensor based on a hollow piezoelectric ball and an application method thereof. According to the invention, by constructing the hollow piezoelectric ball with radial polarization and symmetry, P waves with right-symmetrical properties generate the same potential on two hemispheres of the piezoelectric ball, so that excitation charges are mutually overlapped to form P wave signals, S waves with anti-symmetrical properties form opposite potentials on adjacent quarter spheres and finally cancel each other, the purpose of filtering the S waves is realized, the operation is simple, the separation precision is high, and the method is well applicable to earthquake early warning systems needing P wave real-time monitoring.

title_en: Cultural relic safety evaluation analysis system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an artificial intelligence based cultural relic security assessment and analysis system, comprising a data collection module, a data analysis module, a scheme generation module, a user interaction interface, an execution and monitoring module, and a maintenance and update module. Through the use of this system, real-time monitoring and adjustment of environmental information in museums can be achieved, ensuring that cultural relics are stored in a good environment and improving their safety. At the same time, it can also provide early warning of external disasters to enhance the protection effect of cultural relics.

title_en: Alarm method and perimeter security system based on multi-technology fusion
abstract_en: The application provides an alarming method and a perimeter security system based on multi-technology fusion, which can reduce missing report and false report caused by animal activities and environmental interference, improve alarming accuracy and enhance system accuracy and reliability. The method comprises the steps of generating an event attribute set containing state information of the rechecking device and the type of the first detection result when the first detection result of the core detection device is received for the first time, and setting the initial type of an event corresponding to the event attribute set as early warning. If the event attribute set is not updated, triggering a corresponding alarm flow according to the initial type of the event. When the event attribute set is updated, if the event attribute set exists the type of the second detection result of the rechecking device, updating the type of the event according to the type of the first detection result and the type of the second detection result. If the second detection result type reported by the rechecking device does not exist in the event attribute set, the event type is updated based on the operation state of the rechecking device and the first detection result type.
assignees: HEFEI XINQIAO INT AIRPORT CO LTD;NEW SINGULARITY INT TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ecological environment detection method and device based on multi-source data and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an ecological environment detection method, device and storage medium based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting space distribution parameters and environment stress parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing an intrusion space index based on a target plaque area and a target plaque boundary perimeter, constructing a habitat stress index according to a daily inundation time length and root system soil salinity, constructing a diffusion risk factor according to a plaque area of an associated area of a target plaque, constructing a risk index based on the diffusion risk factor, the intrusion space index and the habitat stress index, constructing a plaque treatment priority, constructing an adjustment coefficient according to a crown temperature daily difference, constructing an update coefficient according to a seed removal rate and the adjustment coefficient, and updating the plaque treatment priority based on the update coefficient and the target plaque area. The invention realizes the accurate diagnosis, risk early warning and scientific sequencing of the treatment priorities of the spartina alterniflora invasion situation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZEYI TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of emergency lighting controller able circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency lighting controller able circuit.Including main control CPU and the fire-fighting link telecommunication circuit of main control CPU control, display screen telecommunication circuit, terminal communication circuit, power-switching circuit, information storage circuit, active node testing circuit, external drive circuit；Power-switching circuit is divided into first order Power convert, second level Power convert, third level Power convert；Active node testing circuit is used for detecting external active signal；Externally drive circuit is used for driving external equipment.The present invention is by " guiding " principle to be converted into " safety guides " principle nearby original emergency evacuation display lamp worked alone.When a fire, emergency lighting controller able circuit and fire alarm warning system carry out coordinated signals, according to on-the-spot fire information intelligentized control emergency evacuation light fixture, adjust its channeling direction, dynamically guide personal security, withdraw deathtrap accurately and rapidly.
assignees: HEFEI LIANXIN POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: The wireless electric tuning of virtualization for integrated avionic system and audio management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless electric tuning of virtualization for integrated avionic system and audio management systems, can reduce the volume of system, mitigate airborne load, save space, and can be under the premise of keeping reliability convenient for upgrading and update.The system includes：Two VHF radios, Audio control unit, data processor, navigation equipment and two sets of audio frequency control boxes being separately positioned in front deck and rear deck and two sets of synthetical display control units；Wherein, synthetical display control unit has wireless electric tuning and audio frequency controller graphical interfaces, and the instruction for receiving pilot's input simultaneously sends control signal to Audio control unit, and sends audio frequency control source selection signal to Audio control unit by discrete magnitude interface；Audio control unit is used to carry out flight interphone, PERCOM peripheral communication, emergency communication, the wireless electric tuning that navigation sound is listened to and alerting tone is monitored and audio frequency controller according to control signal.

title_en: Rock burst early warning method for microseismic data long-term and short-term feature comparison
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster prediction of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst early warning method for comparing long-term and short-term characteristics of microseismic data, which is used for predicting whether a primary microseismic event to be happened in the future is a rock burst event or not, and comprises the following steps of S1: constructing a training set; s2: extracting long-term and short-term microseismic data characteristics of a training set sample; s3: training a rock burst prediction model; s4: an application of rock burst early warning method based on microseismic data long-short period characteristic comparison. According to the invention, priori knowledge is introduced into algorithm design to automatically extract the rock burst early warning implicit early warning index; parameters of the designed feature extraction module can be continuously updated and replaced in training, so that the generalization performance of the early warning method on different mines is improved, and the early warning accuracy is higher than that of other deep learning algorithms.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Cloud inspection system and method with matched size models
abstract_en: The application discloses a cloud inspection system and a method matched with a size model, wherein the cloud inspection system comprises the following components: the cloud policy center, the business data service center, the model optimization center, the log analysis and optimization center and the backup disaster recovery center; the cloud policy center is responsible for issuing a cloud policy to an edge and issuing a cloud instruction to the edge; the business data service center is used for receiving event data and/or log data returned by the side end; the model optimization center is used for optimizing a large model to obtain an optimized large model version, the optimized large model version is updated into a cloud OTA version library, and the cloud OTA version library is stored in the cloud policy center; the log analysis and optimization center is used for analyzing and early warning log data of the business data service center to obtain a log analysis result, and the log analysis result is transmitted back to the side in the form of abnormal table data and log table data; the backup disaster recovery center is used for data backup.
assignees: BEIJING DAOYI SHUHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic ground resistance monitoring method and system based on regional cooperative measurement
