abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground resistance dynamic monitoring method and system based on regional cooperative measurement, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a regional power outage plan, selecting a substation set participating in cooperative measurement, planning measurement execution sequences of all substations according to the regional power outage plan provided by power grid dispatching, forming a measurement task sequence and issuing the measurement task sequence to corresponding measurement terminals deployed in all substations, sequentially or parallelly measuring electric parameters and environment parameter data of the corresponding substations by each measurement terminal through a bipolar method in a power outage window period, uploading the measurement data in real time, carrying out iterative calculation and updating on mirror coefficients and ground resistances of related substations according to the data uploaded in real time, carrying out dynamic monitoring on the updated ground resistance values, triggering early warning when the ground resistance values exceed a preset threshold value, and generating overhaul suggestions. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of calculation of the grounding resistance, discover hidden danger of power equipment in time and ensure safety.
assignees: CHANGDE POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Entrance blocking apparatus for vehicls
title_ko: 차량통제용 차단기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a barrier installed on a road to control entry and exit of a vehicle. The barrier comprises: a vertical pole vertically fixed; a blocking bar connected to a predetermined height of the vertical pole through a rotation shaft to be installed to be rotatable in a vertical direction with respect to the ground; a rotation driving motor installed on the blocking bar or one side of the vertical pole; a power transmission line having one end connected to the blocking bar to transmit power of the rotation driving motor to the blocking bar; a notification member installed on the blocking bar and having a warning phrase indicating the prohibition of entry of a vehicle with respect to an underground road; and a control unit controlling the operation of the rotation driving motor. The control unit rotates the rotation driving motor in one direction to unwind the power transmission line to rotate the blocking bar downward to a first position horizontally crossing the road when the entry is prohibited, and rotates the rotation driving motor in the opposite direction to wind the power transmission line to rotate the blocking bar upward to a second position when the entry is not prohibited.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로에 설치되어 차량의 출입을 통제하는 차단기에 있어서, 수직으로 고정된 수직폴대; 상기 수직폴대의 정해진 높이에 회동축을 통해 연결되어 지면에 대해 상하방향으로 회동 가능하게 설치된 차단바; 상기 차단바 또는 상기 수직폴대의 일측에 설치된 회동 구동모터; 일단이 상기 차단바에 연결되어 상기 회동 구동모터의 동력을 상기 차단바에 전달하는 동력전달 줄; 상기 차단바에 설치되어 상기 지하차도에 대한 차량의 진입금지를 알리는 경고문구가 표기된 알림부재; 및 상기 회동 구동모터의 작동을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는, 진입금지 시에는 상기 회동 구동모터를 일방향으로 회전시켜서 상기 동력전달 줄을 풀어서 상기 차단바를 차로를 수평하게 가로지르는 제1 위치까지 하향 회동하고, 진입금지 해제 시에는 상기 회동 구동모터를 반대방향으로 회전시켜서 상기 동력전달 줄을 감아서 상기 차단바를 제2 위치까지 상향 회동시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 차량통제용 차단기를 개시한다.

title_en: A kind of geological disaster alarming device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to geological disaster field, more particularly to a kind of geological disaster alarming device.The geological disaster alarming device, including contain monitoring host computer, disaster monitoring probe group, control executive device, solar cell, it is characterized in that：The disaster monitoring probe group, control executive device, solar cell are electrically connected with monitoring host computer respectively, disaster monitoring probe group includes deformation monitoring device, displacement monitors, inclination and vibration monitoring device, water level monitor, rainfall monitor, and control executive device includes that warning is broadcasted, warning light is aobvious, barrier curtain, stops fence.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows：It reminds people to pay attention to preventing, avoid or withdrawing, starts warning light display warning information, start barrier curtain when disasters danger reaches higher or has occurred and that or fence prevents pedestrian and vehicle from entering danger zone；Detection case is transferred to monitoring distal end simultaneously, also receives the relevant control of monitoring distal end, i.e. remote measuring and controlling.

title_en: A kind of electricity power engineering weather monitoring method for early warning based on GIS
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of electricity power engineering weather monitoring method for early warning based on GIS, the described method includes: constructing vector quantization grid for province GIS map, meteorological data in current and n hours of each weather monitoring point is associated with each electrical network facilities to vector quantization grid, meteorological data vector quantization grid is formed using interpolation algorithm, electrical network facilities scene meteorological data is predicted, when prediction result exceeds predetermined threshold, is alarmed and shown, and start live camera.Meanwhile this method is by the power parameter of the sensing data real-time update interpolation algorithm at electrical network facilities scene, so that prediction result is more accurate.The present invention realizes the meteorological prediction in electrical network facilities scene using interpolation algorithm, improves the predictive ability to electrical network facilities the condition of a disaster, reduces estimation range radius, reduce computational complexity, improves the efficiency of rescue.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Privacy preserving component hazard detection and handling
abstract_en: Tools and techniques are described to protect private configuration and operational information while obtaining relevant data regarding known concerns of various kinds of packaging, runtime, and software components. Dependencies between software items may be traversed to obtain more complete hidden danger information. Version numbers and other telemetry regarding installed components and operational events from installed components may be derived from the system while still protecting privacy of system-specific details. Privacy protection may include withholding privacy information from a repository or other hidden danger list source, using truncated hashes or fingerprints to select an ambiguous subset of available hidden danger lists, anonymized telemetry, aggregated telemetry, and other mechanisms. A potential hazard warning may be given when a component is loaded or an application is launched, a project is built, a component is selected for deployment, a component is added to a project or workspace, and other events. Updates to the components may be performed to remove known hazards.

title_en: Ground surface deformation monitoring method and related equipment based on interference radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring and discloses an earth surface deformation monitoring method based on an interference radar and related equipment. The method is applied to an interference radar-based earth surface deformation monitoring system, and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of: the edge equipment adjusts model parameters of the monitoring model based on the regulation and control instruction so as to update the monitoring model; the edge equipment controls the interference radar to acquire multi-frame ground surface radar images based on the monitoring instruction, and sends the multi-frame ground surface radar images to the monitoring management platform so that the monitoring management platform can generate a regulation and control instruction, and according to the multi-frame ground surface radar images, ground surface deformation identification and landslide risk assessment are carried out by utilizing the latest monitoring model, so that a monitoring result of the ground surface deformation is obtained. The invention realizes the automatic early warning of landslide possibly occurring in the process of large-scale surface deformation, and improves the efficiency of the early warning of the landslide of the surface.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CORP EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO KUNMING BUREAU

title_en: Portable Diving Control Console
title_ko: 휴대 이동용 잠수 조종 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable diving control console (PDCC) as a device for deep-sea diving, which comprises: a main diving control console (MDCC) supply unit which supplies gas that a diver breathes underwater in a surface-supplied diving method (SSDS); and an upper diving control display console (UDCDC) supply unit, where divers communicate with field supervisors. According to the present invention, provided is technology related to the portable diving control console, and it is possible to prevent negligent accidents caused by nitrogen anesthesia and accumulated inert gas syndrome.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 잠수사가 수중에서 호흡하는 기체를 표면 공급 잠수 방식(SSDS)으로 공급하는 잠수 조종 통제 콘솔 공급부(MDCC, Main Diving Control Console)와, 잠수사와 현장 감독관이 소통하는 잠수 지휘 통제 콘솔 전시부(UDCDC, Upper Diving Control Display Console)로 구성된 휴대 이동용 잠수조종장치(PDCC : Portable Diving Control Console)로서 심해 잠수용 장치이다.  
휴대 이동용 잠수 조종 장치에 관한 기술로, 호흡기체 공급계통을 압축공기, 헬리옥스, 나이트록스, 트라이믹스 중 한 개로 선택하도록 배관 회로를 단순화-소형화로 발명하고, 호흡기체 공급의 경로 변경 밸브를 종래의 6개 Yokes형 또는 볼밸브 다수를 하나의 경로변경 밸브(3 way gate valve)로 개발하여 밸브 단순화로 발명하고, 기체 압력 센서로 공급기체 압력 미달이나 다이버가 표면감압 잠수기술(Sur D)로 수중 감압을 하지 않고 상승 시에 호흡기체를 교체하는 수심을 경고하는 호흡기체 경보기(Safety Warning) 발명하여 질소 마취와 누적된 불활성 기체 증후군에 따른 안전사고를 예방할 수 있다. 또한 별개 장비인 CCTV, 수중통신, Diving Data의 신호정보를 1개의 콘솔에 동시에 전시하게 하고,  수중 영상 신호, 수중 음성 신호 및 잠수 정보를 통합하는 신호 융합 터미널 보드(JCT Board)를 포함하는 신호 정보를 하나의 저장장치로 통합하는 신호융합 터미널 보드(JCT Board)를 설비하고, 마지막으로 구조선박에 설비된 표면공급잠수시스템(SSDS) 장치들을 기능별로 단순화-최소화하여 Scuba장비처럼 사람이 휴대 이동 할 수 있도록 경제적인 가방형식( 콘테이너 탑재 방식의 소형 Box Package)으로 한다.

title_en: Compact type apparatus for storage of cable
title_ko: 케이블 가이더블록이 구비된 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치
abstract_en: A compact cable storage device having a cable guider block according to the present invention includes: an inner disk having a spiral track formed on a front surface and a rear surface; an outer enclosure coupled to the front and rear surfaces with the inner disk interposed therebetween; and a handle and a cable guider block capable of smoothly winding a cable drawn to the outside by rotating the inner disk. The compact cable storage device enables smooth drawing and retraction of the cable without entanglement, thereby providing convenience of use. The device prevents worker stress caused by cable entanglement, improves workability, and shortens working time. Manufacturing the device with a thin inner disk having a thickness slightly larger than the diameter of two cable strands makes carrying easy during work in power tunnels, manholes, and high-altitude work sites. Immediate winding of the cable on-site after use prevents accidents caused by neglected cable (1).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 케이블 가이더블록이 구비된 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치는 정면과 후면에 나선형 트랙이 형성된 내부 원판과, 내부 원판을 사이에 두고 정면과 후면에서 결합되는 외부 함체와, 내부 원판을 회전시켜 외부로 인출된 케이블을 원활하게 감을 수 있는 핸들과 케이블 가이더블록을 구비하고 있기 때문에 케이블의 엉킴없이 인출 또는 인입이 원활하도록 하는 사용의 편리성을 부여하고, 케이블의 엉킴으로 인한 작업자의 스트레스를 예방함과 동시에 작업성 향상 및 작업시간 단축하고, 사용하는 케이블 2가닥 직경보다 조금 큰 정도의 두께로 얇은 내부 원판으로 제작이 가능하므로 전력구, 맨홀 및 고소 작업개소 작업시 휴대가 용이하며, 케이블 사용 후 현장에서 즉시 감을 수 있으므로 방치되는 케이블(1)로 인한 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: A kind of escape route generating method based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of escape route generating methods based on BIM, including establish BIM model according to architecture information；The collection point ID of default sensor and with one-to-one first location information of the collection point ID, and by the collection point ID and first positioning information update to the BIM model；The warning message that sensor is sent is obtained, the warning message includes the corresponding collection point ID of sensor；The second location information of escape personnel is obtained, and escape route is generated according to the warning message, second location information and the BIM model.Escape route can be generated according to the environmental data of place where the accident occurred and the location information of escape personnel.Avoid escape personnel because of the loss of life and property caused by can not obtaining escape route or escape route inaccuracy.
assignees: XIAMEN HUAFANG SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake broadcasting method, system, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an earthquake broadcasting method, an earthquake broadcasting system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, wherein the embodiment of the invention updates the current earthquake early warning information into the Nth earthquake early warning information according to the received Nth earthquake early warning information, wherein N is a positive integer greater than or equal to 1; and then generating an Nth report voice broadcast content aiming at the updated Nth report earthquake early warning information, and broadcasting the Nth report voice broadcast content, so that more accurate earthquake early warning content can be broadcast to users in real time within earthquake early warning time, and more reasonable risk avoidance measures can be taken for people within a short time.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Transportation management system for counting orders according to effective transportation times
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportation management system for counting orders according to effective transportation times, which comprises a driver mobile terminal, a supervision mobile terminal, a server, a starting point control management end and an end point control management end, wherein the driver mobile terminal is used for scanning orders at the starting point control management end and acquiring pressure data information, scanning the orders at the end point control management end, checking and canceling the orders and acquiring end point pressure data information for comparison, and the supervision mobile terminal is used for supervising the driver mobile terminal; by the aid of unmanned supervision of starting points and end points, labor investment is saved greatly, potential safety hazards of single workers in a construction site are eliminated, and working efficiency of the single core projectile is improved; the weight of starting point and terminal point is responded to through the gravity-feed tank and whether knowing the vehicle and having had the condition of empting, stealing the grit on the way in the transportation to show warning suggestion and in time stop empting, steal the emergence once more of this phenomenon of grit, directly improved conveying efficiency, reduce cost of transportation.
assignees: CHENGDU FUJI UNION ENVIRONMENTAL PROT BIG DATA CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire alarm device for buildings
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting alarm device for buildings, which comprises a fixed shell and a transparent rotating cover, the transparent rotating cover is movably inserted at the bottom of the fixed shell, the outer side of the transparent rotating cover is fixedly embedded with a dynamic alarm device, the dynamic alarm device comprises a dynamic reflector and a fixed seat, wherein the fixed seat is provided with a medium-sized telescopic hole, the intelligent fire-fighting alarm device for the building has reasonable design, when the transparent rotating cover rotates, the transparent alarm cover of the dynamic alarm device can be thrown out and emits light, and the cleaning pad is arranged in the middle-sized telescopic hole of the fixed seat, on one hand, the dynamic alarm effect can be achieved, and then improve the effect of reporting to the police, on the other hand, when transparent warning cover withdrawed, the clearance pad can be cleared up transparent warning cover to can prevent effectively that smog from covering and leading to the warning effect to reduce.

title_en: Remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method. According to the invention, the accuracy of geological risk prediction is improved by analyzing various geological features, the understanding of soil erosion mechanism and landslide risk is improved by simulating water-soil interaction, the effectiveness of disaster early warning is optimized, the identification capacity of landslide areas is enhanced by comparing with historical data patterns, the disaster spatial association information is analyzed, the disaster diffusion trend prediction and risk level adjustment are optimized, the dynamic update of real-time disaster risk assessment and disaster risk monitoring is combined, the timeliness and accuracy of early warning information are improved, and comprehensive technical support is provided for geological disaster early warning.
assignees: TAIAN JINTUDI SURVEYING AND MAPPING CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining and updating high formwork monitoring and early warning values by fusing data and models
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining and updating high formwork monitoring and early warning values by fusing data and models, which adopts the construction of a visual displacement monitoring system to monitor displacement response data of monitoring nodes in real time, replaces the prior contact sensor which requires staff to climb and install, greatly reduces the occurrence of safety accidents, simultaneously, the invention carries out buckling failure analysis on the high formwork by establishing a finite element model, the method and the device have the advantages that the early warning value when buckling damage occurs is obtained, the effect of automatically monitoring the high formwork displacement can be achieved by comparing the early warning value with displacement response data, and the monitoring efficiency and accuracy are improved by carrying out sensitivity analysis on the high formwork design parameter set to update the finite element model and continuously and iteratively updating the early warning value along with continuous advancement of construction stages and massive accumulation of measured data.

title_en: Visual safety risk early warning system for archaize building mixed structure construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a visual safety risk early warning system for archaize building mixed structure construction, in particular to the field of safety risk early warning for archaize building construction, which remarkably improves construction safety risk management and control capability through cooperation of multi-source data fusion and an intelligent algorithm, acquires mechanics and environment data of key nodes of a high-branch formwork body in real time, dynamically updates load distribution by combining a building information model to generate high-precision space-time tag data stream, predicts short-term instability risk based on a dual-channel neural network, constructs a complex network model quantification node failure linkage effect to generate visual risk propagation thermodynamic diagram, finally realizes augmented reality visual warning and equipment linkage control through a dynamic threshold triggering hierarchical warning strategy, breaks through the traditional manual monitoring limitation, realizes full-flow closed-loop management of risk perception, archaize prediction, positioning and response, effectively reduces the safety accident rate, and ensures the safety and reliability of construction of the complex structure of the building.
assignees: SHANDONG CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Early warning system and method for side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning system and a warning method for a side slope, which belong to the technical field of road side slope monitoring and solve the technical problems of lag warning on a running vehicle, insufficient multi-sensor data fusion and poor system stability of the existing side slope monitoring and warning. The system comprises a controller, a remote acquisition control terminal and a multi-stage warning device which are arranged in a partitioning mode, wherein a side slope is divided into a plurality of monitoring areas, each area is provided with the controller, a flexible strain sensor, a stay wire displacement sensor, an anchor cable meter and other multi-source monitoring equipment, the acquisition control terminal and the side slope keep a safe distance of 30-50 meters, the influence of side slope abnormality on data processing is avoided, an early warning indication frame is arranged at the front end of a driving road section at 500 meters, and multi-dimensional warning is realized by integrating a display screen, an audible-visual alarm, a voice player and a retractable warning screen cloth. According to the invention, the monitoring precision is improved through a multisource data fusion algorithm, the system redundancy design is additionally arranged to ensure stable operation, the early warning response time is prolonged, and the vehicle running safety along the side slope is remarkably improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: A kind of interlink warning device of novel intelligent detection fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of interlink warning device of novel intelligent detection fire, including shell, smoke inductor, signal connector and alarm, outer casing bottom is provided with smoke inductor, temperature detector is provided with above smoke inductor, temperature detector side is provided with battery compartment, manual pull station is provided with above battery compartment, signal connector is provided with above manual pull station, signal connector side is provided with alarm, signal connector opposite side is provided with display screen, emergency light is provided with above display screen, vacuum cup is provided with behind shell, vacuum cup side is provided with peg button, runing rest is provided with above peg button.Beneficial effect is：Can automatic detection smokescope and environment temperature, and according to setting value automatic alarm, and interlink warning can be realized, be easy to withdrawing in time for floor gap personnel, while when night fire occurring, emergency light can help the timely safe escape of people, reduce casualties.
assignees: CHONGQING CHENGJI FIRE FIGHTING SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: The high speed rail earthquake pre-warning monitoring Railway Bureau centring system information processing platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high speed rail earthquake pre-warning monitoring Railway Bureau centring system information processing platform, the earthquake information of acquisition is carried out comprehensive analysis by platform, it is uniformly processed, automatically generate the emergency action information of appropriate level when there is earthquake, and the control of quick nematic, lead the external systems such as change and earthquake car-mounted device sends；Meanwhile, efficiency of transmission, reliability, validity also to the information processing platform, maintainable it is described with security etc., it is ensured that information system is reliable and stable in itself, so as to improve the protection level of Railway Disaster and the security of high ferro train operation；Additionally, platform also provides all clear after earthquake terminates and post earthquake recovery function, it is ensured that system is recovered normally to run working condition after the earthquake；Additionally, the wrong report for producing can also be released immediately, train recovers rapidly normal operation after ensureing earthquake wrong report, greatly improves railway transportation production efficiency.
assignees: SIGNAL & COMMUNICATION RES INST OF CHINA ACAD OF RAILWAY SCIENCES;CHINA ACAD RAILWAY SCIENCES;BEIJING HUATIE INFORMATION TECH DEV GENERAL CO LTD;BEIJING RUICHI NAT RAILWAY INTELLIGENT TRANSP SYSTEM ENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coach turn signal lamp early warning prompt strategy based on ESC
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ESC-based early warning and prompting strategy for a steering lamp of a passenger car, which comprises an instrument panel, an instrument arranged on one side of the back of the instrument panel, an angle sensor connected with the instrument and a controller connected with the angle sensor, wherein a state display screen is arranged above the instrument panel, an alarm indicator lamp is arranged on the upper surface of the state display screen, a wired high-frequency interface and a wired low-frequency interface are arranged on the instrument, a lead is connected between the instrument and the alarm indicator lamp, and the controller is provided with two ports which are respectively butted with the wired high-frequency interface, the wired low-frequency interface and the angle sensor of the instrument. The invention adds the prompting device of the steering lamp on the basis of ESC of the passenger car, effectively avoids misjudgment of the vehicle direction caused by the conditions that surrounding pedestrians and vehicles turn on the steering lamp by mistake, turn to temporarily cancel forgetting to turn off the steering lamp or the steering lamp fails to return, and the like, avoids such potential safety hazards and reduces safety accidents.
assignees: NANJING GOLDEN DRAGON BUS CO LTD

title_en: Landslide early warning device and early warning method for mine rock-soil slope landslide disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of alarms responding to disaster events, and discloses a landslide early warning device and a mine rock-soil slope landslide disaster investigation early warning method. The device has the advantages that when landslide occurs, the detection leaves detect the earth on the earth surface to generate sliding, the signal transmitter is influenced by the detection results of the detection leaves to generate signals, the signal transmitter operates through the signal control auxiliary mechanism to move the early warning mechanism into the protection cylinder, the protection door seals the protection cylinder, and accordingly the early warning mechanism is fully retracted into the protection cylinder to protect the protection cylinder when the landslide occurs, the early warning device in the protection cylinder can be recycled when accumulated soil generated by the landslide is cleaned after the landslide occurs, the early warning device is recycled and protected after the landslide is early warned, the early warning device can be recycled after the landslide disaster, the applicability of the early warning device is improved, and the use cost of the early warning device is reduced.

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN EXPRESSWAY CONSTRUCTION AND DEV GROUP CO LTD;SHUDAO INVEST GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING TONGNAN DISTR TRAFFIC AFFAIRS CENTER

title_en: In-vehicle Air Cleaning Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Puncture of Tire
title_ko: 타이어 펑크 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an air purification device for providing an emergency rescue service for a puncture of a tire comprises: a photocatalytic panel; an air purification module; a sound wave module having a sound wave input unit receiving a sound wave signal and a sound wave output unit outputting the sound wave signal; and an operation module including a communication module having at least one communication unit. The air purification device includes a short distance module, a location module, and a sensor module. The air purification device further includes an OBD interlocking unit, an ignition recognizing unit, a location checking unit, a sensor checking unit, a situation grasping unit, a sound wave checking unit, and a control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 타이어 펑크 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치에 따르면, 광촉매 물질을 코팅한 복수의 규소 성분 구슬들을 패널 형태로 집적 성형한 지정 개수의 광촉매 패널과 UV(UltraViolet)-A 파장 대역의 UV를 방출하는 지정 개수의 UV램프부를 지정된 기하학적 관계로 배치한 공기정화모듈을 구비하고, 상기 공기정화모듈을 통해 차량 내부의 공기 정화를 운영하면서 차량내의 상황을 인식하여 서비스를 제공하기 위해 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 운영모듈이 구비된 공기정화장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보를 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 타이어 펑크 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 타이어 펑크 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보에 대응하는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하면서 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Fire protection device capable of early warning high temperature and early warning system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire protection device for high-temperature early warning, which comprises a fire protection monitoring box, an intelligent data processing device and an external manual repositor, wherein the intelligent data processing device comprises a PCB integrated board, an alarm timing pusher, an integrated processing chip, an alternating current/direct current converter, a charging device, a data transmitter, a remote networking monitoring element and a fire alarm processor are arranged on the PCB integrated board, the alarm timing pusher is electrically connected with the external manual repositor, when the fire protection device is used in combination with a corresponding early warning system, a local server in a monitoring system platform is synchronously butted with a cloud server and is remotely connected with a network generated by the intelligent data processing device, the early warning effect of fire is improved, meanwhile, under the help of the set timing function, under the condition that the safety can be rapidly processed and confirmed in the early stage of fire outbreak, alarm information can be timely withdrawn, and the alarm ring can be better avoided, thereby avoiding the occurrence of trample events caused by panic of the public and reducing the alarm cost of fire departments.

title_en: Scenic spot crowd gathering risk assessment and early warning method and system based on multiple features
abstract_en: The invention provides a scenic spot crowd gathering risk assessment and early warning method and system based on multiple characteristics, and relates to the field of model prediction of a deep learning algorithm. The prediction model based on the multi-feature scenic spot crowd risk assessment is a model which is superior to a model constructed by single source data, the multi-feature set comprises a plurality of influencing factors such as passenger flow, weather, other sudden disaster information and the like as feature variable input, the prediction accuracy is effectively improved, and the LSTM long-term memory network algorithm model is used, so that more intelligent passenger flow prediction is effectively realized. In addition, the method combines the historical data with the real-time data, and adds crowd information obtained by real-time monitoring data on the basis of the prediction of the historical data model, so that the prediction model is continuously optimized and updated, the prediction of the evaluation result of the aggregation risk of different time-frequency crowd is realized, and the accuracy and the comprehensive performance of the prediction model in different time periods are greatly improved.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM HONGXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geotechnical engineering stability early warning system method combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering stability early warning system method combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation, which relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering safety monitoring and disaster early warning, and comprises the steps of combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation, wherein multisource real-time monitoring data of slope deformation and numerical simulation are fused, and a dynamically updated slope deformation evolution analysis system is constructed; and setting an automatic triggering grading early warning signal of a geotechnical engineering early warning index to finish slope risk dynamic assessment and early warning output of the geotechnical. The invention realizes automatic triggering of the grading early warning signals, obviously improves the response speed, judgment accuracy and risk assessment scientificity of the geotechnical engineering early warning system, and provides intelligent, dynamic and systematic technical support for slope safety prevention and control.

title_en: System for monitoring flooding of road and its method
title_ko: 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring flooding on a road. Provided is the system for monitoring flooding on a road, the system comprising: a water level meter which is disposed in a predetermined position inside a manhole and which measures a water level of rainfall or sewage flowing through a sewer; a rainfall meter which is installed at a predetermined location around the manhole and which measures the amount of rainfall at the location; a flooding prediction and warning server which calculates a speed of a rise in the water level in the sewer by using water level data transmitted by the water level meter, which predicts a rise in a water level inside the manhole by using an SWMM model when rainfall occurring at the location is determined to continue by using rainfall data transmitted by the rainfall meter, and which generates flooding prediction data when a back flow to the manhole is predicted; an image acquisition means which is installed at a predetermined location on a road, which performs photographing for a traffic safety or crime prevention purpose under the control of a CCTV management server in an ordinary situation, and which photographs a water depth indicator installed on a facility of the road when a predetermined control right has been changed; and a monitoring server which receives image data acquired by the image acquisition means and which performs image detection and analysis regarding the water depth indicator. Furthermore, also provided is the method for monitoring flooding on a road. According to the present invention, provided is an advantage of provision of the system and method for monitoring flooding on a road, which can minimize installation of unnecessary CCTVs for the sole purpose of monitoring of the flooding on a road and which can improve accuracy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 개시된 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법은, 맨홀 내 소정 위치에 설치되고, 관거 내를 흐르는 우수 또는 하수의 수위를 측정하는 수위계, 상기 맨홀 근처의 소정 지점에 설치되고, 상기 지점의 강우량을 측정하는 강우량계, 상기 수위계로부터 전송되는 수위데이터를 이용하여 상기 관거의 수위 상승 속도를 계산하고, 상기 강우량계로부터 전송되는 강우 데이터를 이용하여 상기 지점에 강우가 지속되는 것으로 판단되면, SWMM 모형을 이용하여 상기 맨홀 내 수위 상승을 예측하고 상기 맨홀로 역류가 예측되면 침수예보 데이터를 생성하는 침수예경보서버, 도로의 소정 위치에 설치되고, 평상시에는 CCTV관리서버의 관리에 따라 평상시에는 도로교통안전용 내지 방범용으로 촬영을 수행하다가, 소정의 제어권 변경시 도로의 시설물에 설치된 수심 표지물을 촬영하는 영상획득수단 및 상기 영상획득수단으로부터 촬영된 영상데이터를 전달받아 수심표지물에 대한 영상 감지 및 분석을 수행하는 모니터링서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 도로 침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 도로 침수 모니터링을 위한 불필요한 CCTV의 설치를 최소화하고 정확도를 향상할 수 있는 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공할 수 있다는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Touch-type air fryer with ignition detection sensor
title_ko: 발화감지센서가 달린 터치형 에어프라이어
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a touch-type air fryer with an ignition sensor to solve a problem of fire in the air fryer. According to the present invention, the touch-type air fryer comprises: a main body of the air fryer; an outer pot formed in a circular shape; an inner pot formed in the shape coupled to a handle; a heat detection sensor consisting of a system for automatically sending real-time fire notifications to an air fryer user and a fire station through a fire sensor installed between a heating wire and the inner pot; and a touch dial.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 발화감지센서가 달린 터치형 에어프라이어 에 관한 것으로서 발열감지 센서에 의하여 에어프라이어 내에서의 화재발생을 사전에 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자의 스마트폰으로 화재 발생 감지 알림이 빠르게 전달되고, 화재 발생시에 소방서에게 알림 문자가 자동으로 보내질 수 있게  함으로써 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 에어프라이어에 있어서 제품의 겉면을 구성하며, 제품의 디자인이 소비자에게 시각적으로 보여지는 부분으로서 제품구매시에 매우 중요하고  달걀형으로 형성한 에어프라이어 몸통(본체), 식품으로부터 유출됨 기름이 담겨질 수 있게 구멍이 없고 높은 온도로 가열된 식품이 닿아도 제품의 성상이 유지되는 원형으로 구성한 외솥, 가열된 식품으로부터 유출되는 드립, 기름 등을 잘 걸러져서 담백한 맛의 식품을 만들 수 있게 구멍이 여러개 있는 원형이며, 외솥과 분리가 가능한 결합형태오 제품을 여닿을 수 있는 손잡이가 결합된 모양으로 구성한 내솥, 에어프라이어 내에서의 화재발생을 사전에 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자의 스마트폰으로 화재 발생 감지 알림이 빠르게 전달되고, 화재 발생시에 소방서에게 알림 문자가 자동으로 보내질 수 있게  에어프라이기의 열선과 내솥 사이에 화재 발생 감지 센서를 부착하고, 이를 통해 화재가 발생하거나 발생할 것 같을 때를 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자와 소방서에 자동으로 실시간 알림이 가는 시스템을 구성한 발열감지 센서, 제품의 가열 온도와 시간을 조절할 수 있으며 시간과 온도가 써져있는 부분을 눌러 이를 변경할 수 있게 터치형으로 구성한 터치 다이얼으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 발열감지 센서에 의하여 에어프라이어 내에서의 화재발생을 사전에 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자의 스마트폰으로 화재 발생 감지 알림이 빠르게 전달되고, 화재 발생시에 소방서에게 알림 문자가 자동으로 보내질 수 있게  함으로써 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Landslide, avalanche precaution device installation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster alarm field, especially a kind of landslide, avalanche precaution device installation method.Step is as follows：A, massif is observed, selects easy slide strip that monitoring unit is installed；B, level land, build template by laying bricks or stones, pour out concrete casing, pre-buried installation foot, concrete casing is installed inner chamber carry out it is smooth；C, after after concrete casing completely solidification, level meter and signal projector are installed；D, according to the position of monitoring unit install signal in capstan head, capstan head in signal is covered all monitoring unit, after after all monitoring unit installations, communication connection set up between monitoring unit and warning center by capstan head in signal；E, the foundation communication connection between warning center and local household.By setting monitoring unit to send pre-warning signal by signal projector in massif danger zone, after warning center receives pre-warning signal, danger zone resident is directly notified by modes such as broadcast, bulk SMSs, helps resident to withdraw in time.

title_en: Perception monitoring system and method based on intelligent helmet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent perception monitoring of safety helmets, and discloses a perception monitoring system based on an intelligent helmet; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a user behavior baseline modeling module, a perception monitoring module and an early warning response module, wherein user and environment data are acquired in real time through the data acquisition module and standardized pretreatment is carried out, the user behavior baseline modeling module establishes an individual initial behavior template through guided calibration, a baseline is dynamically updated through combination of active state identification and an index weighted moving average algorithm in use, the perception monitoring module carries out multidimensional risk assessment by calculating instantaneous deviation of real-time data and the baseline and fusing persistence and trend indexes to generate a grading early warning signal, the early warning response module carries out grading early warning response according to the grading early warning signal, the transition from passive protection to active self-adaptive monitoring is realized, and monitoring accuracy and emergency rescue efficiency are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU NIUWANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle terminal for anti-damage/anti-theft, method for anti-damage/anti-theft using the same
title_ko: 파손/도난방지를 위한 차량단말, 그리고 이를 이용한 파손/도난감지방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A terminal of a vehicle for preventing breakage and theft, and a method using the same are provided to check the state of a vehicle. CONSTITUTION: A method for preventing breakage and theft using a terminal of a vehicle is as follows. When the driving mode is changed into a parking mode by a shift lever, impact monitoring data and location data are collected. When the impact monitoring data corresponds to an emergency situation, emergency warning message is output on a mobile terminal(30). When the location of a vehicle is changed, the location of the vehicle is transferred to the mobile terminal. [Reference numerals] (20) Communication network
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 파손/도난방지를 위한 차량단말, 그리고 이를 이용한 파손/도난감지방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 상기 차량의 변속레버가 주차모드(PARKING) 모드로 변경되면, 충격감시데이터 및 위치데이터를 수신하는 제 1 단계; 및 상기 충격감시데이터에 대한 판단결과 긴급상황인 경우, 긴급상황메시지를 모바일단말로 전송하며, 상기 위치데이터에 대한 판단결과 위치변경인 경우, 위치조회메시지를 생성하여 상기 모바일단말로 전송하는 제 2 단계; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의해, GPS를 이용한 차량과 모바일단말의 양방향 통신을 함으로써 차량 위치를 조회도 할 수 있으며, 주차된 위치에서 차량이 벗어난 경우 알려주도록 하는 효과를 제공한다. 또한, 본 발명은, 주차 뒤, 접촉사고, 파손, 도난 등으로 충격이 발생한 경우 있을 때 모바일단말에 메시지 형식으로 통지함으로써, 차량상태를 바로 알 수 있도록 하는 효과를 제공한다. 뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 차량의 파손 또는 도난의 경우 매립된 비상용카메라로 차량의 상태 및 도로 상황을 파악하여 파손 또는 도난에 최선책인 방안을 강구하도록 하는 효과를 제공한다.

title_ko: 비상경보 사용자 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 경고 시스템 및 방법은 타켓된 경고 메시지를 전송하는 운전자를 검증할 수 있다. 통보 서버는 고객 장치로부터 비상 메시지를 수신할 수 있다. 비상 메시지는 1차 비상 경고 및 지리적 관심 영역의 사양을 포함할 수 있다. 통보 서버는 비상 메시지가 유효한지 여부를 판별하도록 구성될 수 있다. 전송 시스템은, 비상 메시지의 검증시, 비상 메시지를 경고 가능 장치로 전송하도록 구성될 수 있다. 경고 가능 장치는 비상 메시지를 수신하고, 경고 가능 장치가 지리적 관심 영역 내에 있는지 여부를 결정하고, 경고 가능 장치가 지리적 관심 영역 내에 위치할 경우에만 사용자에게 비상 메시지를 제시하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of generation method, device and the storage medium of building evacuation route
abstract_en: The present invention relates to generation method, device and the storage mediums of a kind of building evacuation route, this method comprises the following steps: obtaining the characteristic parameter of multiple structure nodes of building and the change rate of characteristic parameter, structure node is the structure support point or binding site in building；The security level of each structure node is determined according to characteristic parameter and change rate；When security level is greater than or equal to default warning level, warning message is exported, and best evacuation route is determined in pre-stored evacuation route according to the security level of each structure node；Best evacuation route is exported, best evacuation route is for guiding evacuating personnel.In dangerous situation preceding user's early warning into building can occur for technical solution of the present invention, guidance people withdraw as early as possible, it can better ensure that the personal safety of people, simultaneously, best evacuation route is determined according to the security level of structure node, people can be made to avoid a dangerous zone during evacuation, safely and fast withdrawn from building.
assignees: MICRO CLOUD WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning management system and method for three gorges reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning management system and method in a three gorges reservoir area, which comprises a detection device, a power supply box, an alarm device and a control box, wherein a rainfall detection unit, a soil humidity detection unit, a displacement detection unit and a first wireless communication unit are arranged in a mounting seat of the detection device, the power supply box is electrically connected with a plurality of detection devices, the control box is electrically connected with the alarm device, a loudspeaker and an alarm lamp of the alarm device are distributed in a village and a town, and a plurality of indicator lamps form an escape path. Can detect the geological conditions of each position of massif and upload central control platform through detection device, when the dangerous situation appears, central control platform sends radio signal, is received by second wireless communication unit, then starts speaker and the alarm lamp that distributes in the village and small town and warn, and light the pilot lamp, make people can follow the instruction of pilot lamp and withdraw fast, thereby avoid needing to guide by the family by the manpower, the propaganda promotes the efficiency of fleing.

title_en: Disaster early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on multiple sensors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning method, a disaster early warning system, disaster early warning equipment and a storage medium based on multiple sensors, wherein firstly, time sequence data acquired by each sensor is subjected to noise elimination processing, so that the interference of the noise measured by the sensor is reduced, the standard deviation of the noise is calculated, and the precision and the effectiveness of subsequent deviation judgment are improved; the gross error, the slow speed change and the offset are used as parameters to be estimated to construct an estimation model, so that the influence of the gross error and the slow speed change on offset judgment is avoided, and the accuracy of the offset judgment of the time sequence data can be greatly improved; the estimation model effectively estimates an offset parameter, a slow speed parameter and a gross error parameter according to a stage iteration estimation mode, and the estimated parameters are subjected to validity check, so that the reliability of parameter estimation is improved; obtaining estimated time sequence data by using the qualified parameters; and finally, judging whether obvious deviation exists or not according to the residual error between the de-noised time sequence data and the estimated time sequence data and the noise standard deviation.
assignees: HUNAN BEIDOU MICRO CHIP INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent security audit method driven by dependent items and third party library
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent security audit method driven by a dependent item and a third party library, which particularly relates to the technical field of security audit, and specifically comprises the following steps of scanning the dependent item of an item by using a dependent item management tool applicable to the item, and acquiring version information of each dependent item; the method comprises the steps of analyzing the relation among the dependency items, constructing a dependency graph, determining the hierarchical relation and the dependency chain among the libraries, matching the collected dependency item version information with a public vulnerability database, identifying the known security vulnerability information existing in each dependency library, marking the severity level and the influence range of the vulnerability, and generating the security vulnerability propagation risk coefficient according to the security vulnerability information and the dependency relation existing in each dependency library. The invention can judge the potential hidden danger of the security hole propagation of the bottom layer dependency library in time, generate corresponding early warning prompt, help development team to take preventive measures and coping strategies, and promote the overall security and stability of the system.

title_en: Method and system for observing earthquake response of existing building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an existing building earthquake response observation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting building vibration response data under micro vibration and strong vibration and high-definition video data under the strong vibration of a building in real time, carrying out second-level early warning and minute-level early warning based on the building vibration response data, calculating displacement of an observation floor relative to the ground based on the high-definition video data, constructing an adjacent matrix based on the building vibration response data, updating the adjacent matrix by utilizing real-time data and a graph convolution neural network when the minute-level early warning occurs, carrying out hour-level early warning based on edge characteristics of the updated adjacent matrix, and simultaneously updating a digital twin model of the existing building based on a finite element model based on the calculated displacement, and evaluating the earthquake resistance and the security of the structure after the earthquake. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the state identification precision of the building strong earthquake response stage, the earthquake resistance evaluation efficiency after earthquake and the like.

title_en: Road-related construction safety control application system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of highway management and control systems, in particular to a road-related construction safety management and control application system. The invention relates to a road construction safety control application system, which comprises: carrying out event detection on a road traffic attention area; acquiring traffic event information; the traffic incident information is locally stored and sent to a construction safety control application platform; the construction safety control application platform collects and summarizes event information data; acquiring real-time positioning information of a traffic incident; and the construction safety control application platform externally releases the traffic event information and the traffic event positioning information and updates the traffic event information and the traffic event positioning information at any time. The road-related construction safety control application system can find traffic events in time, quickly respond to the road traffic events, release traffic information in time, remove road hidden dangers and reduce traffic operation influence. And then can early warning guide, avoid taking place secondary accident, reduce the influence to the traffic, improve the traffic safety level.
assignees: GUANGDONG NANYUE TRANSP RENBO EXPRESSWAY MANAGEMENT CENTER

title_en: Intelligent traffic evacuation method based on dynamic path optimization and multi-objective cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic evacuation method based on dynamic path optimization and multi-objective coordination, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and emergency management, and comprises the steps of establishing an improved HD-PSO model based on a traffic violation risk space-time distribution map, calculating a risk index of a path node through a dynamic congestion influence factor matrix, constructing a four-layer dynamic early warning mechanism, and outputting a real-time risk index and a grading response instruction; based on the optimized evacuation path weight parameters and the resource allocation factors, and by combining the real-time environment state, the invention predicts the people flow density through a DRL-LSTM hybrid model and dynamically updates the path weight parameters to generate an optimized evacuation strategy.

title_en: Detaching apparatus for an alarm device
title_ko: 경보장치용 고정장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fixing apparatus for an alarm device is provided to generates an alarm due to an operation of a sensor while arbitrary force for escape is generated. CONSTITUTION: A fixing unit fixes an alarm unit on an installation position. The alarm unit generates an alarm when a pushed state of a sensor is released. An installation target contact cover is closely disposed at the installation position. A device combination unit is installed at the installation target contact cover in order to be coupled with the alarm device. The device combination unit includes a push part and a magnetic generation member. A floating combination unit is installed on the installation target contact cover. The floating combination unit forms a pushing state of the push part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 센서의 눌림상태 해제시 경보를 발생시키는 경보장치를 설치위치에 고정설치되게 하는 고정장치에 있어서,  설치위치에 밀착 배치되는 설치대상접촉덮개,  설치대상접촉덮개에 장착된 상태로 상기 경보장치에 결합되며, 일 측부에는 센서에 대향되게 결합된 누름부와, 자력에 의해 설치위치에 탈부착 가능하게 고정되도록 자기발생부재가 마련된 장치결합부,  장치결합부가 경보장치 방향으로 유동이 가능하도록 설치대상접촉덮개 상에 장착되게 하며, 경보장치에 외부로 향하는 당김힘이 가해지지 않을 경우에는 탄성팽창력에 의해 장치결합부를 설치대상접촉덮개 방향으로 밀어 누름부가 센서에 접촉된 상태로 누름상태가 되게 하며,  경보장치가 설치위치에 고정 설치된 상태에서 경보장치를 이탈시키려는 힘이 가해질 경우, 장치결합부가 경보장치 방향으로 이동할 수 있도록 하여, 장치결합부와 설치대상접촉덮개 사이의 간격을 증대시키며 누름부에 의한 센서의 누름상태가 해제되면서 경보가 발생되게 하는 유동결합수단을 포함하는 경보장치용 고정장치를 제공한다.
assignees: ULSAN METROPOLITAN CITY;HYUN DAI HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: Safty device for Control panel
title_ko: 수배전반의 안전관리장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A safety management device of a distribution board is provided to control opening and closing of a door and a safety state of a distribution board using various kinds of sensors and alarm devices, thereby providing safe work environments. CONSTITUTION: A human body detection sensor detects access by an operator. A temperature sensor detects internal temperature of a panel. A fire detection sensor detects fire inside and outside a distribution board(200). A display unit displays the internal temperature of the panel, a power transmission state of the distribution board, and an opening state of a panel door. An alarm unit operates an alarm lamp and an alarm buzzer. A manipulation part comprises an alarm manipulation part for controlling operation of the alarm unit. The door opening part opens or closes the panel door(210) according to user manipulation. A controller controls opening and closing of the door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 안전관리기와 도어개폐기로 구성되는 장치를 현장에서 판넬 도어 전면부에 부착하여 시공할 수 있으며, 수배전반의 안전 상태를 감지하여 실시간으로 알려주어 인가된 작업자가 안전하게 작업할 수 있도록 유도하는 수배전반의 안전관리장치에 관한 것으로, 작업자의 접근을 감지하는 인체감지센서, 판넬 도어의 개폐를 감지하는 도어감지센서, 판넬 내부로의 송전 여부를 감지하는 송전감지센서, 판넬 내부의 온도를 감지하는 온도감지센서, 수배전반 내외부의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서로 구성되는 센서부; 판넬 도어의 개폐 상태, 수배전반의 송전 상태 및 판넬의 내부 온도를 표시하는 표시부; 상기 센서부에 의하여 판넬 내부에 불안 요소가 발생하는 경우 경보 램프와 경보 부저를 통하여 위험을 외부로 알리기 위한 경고부; 도어의 개폐를 위하여 비밀번호 입력하고 변경하는 비밀번호 조작부, 상기 경고부를 동작을 제어하는 경고 조작부로 구성되는 조작부; 작업자의 조작에 따라 판넬 도어를 개폐하는 도어개폐부; 및 상기 센서부의 감지 신호 및 상기 조작부의 입력 신호에 따라 상기 표시부 및 경고부를 제어하며, 상기 도어의 개폐를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of Intelligent fence special for high-voltage test
abstract_en: In order to solve the problems, such as that existing High-Voltage Experimentation fence safety is inadequate, the present invention provides a kind of Intelligent fence special for high-voltage test, including fence chassis body, warning light, power supply, fence chassis body lateral surface is equipped with external fence, limiting and guiding device is provided between external fence and fence chassis body, external fence is connected on the outside of fence chassis body by retractable structure, when retractable structure inwardly stretch to it is a certain amount of when, retractable structure touches alarm lamp switch and carries out warning note, be conducive to timely alarm to the unconscious personnel for touching fence, it avoids that safety accident occurs, improve the security performance of fence.
assignees: DONGYING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for monitoring communication link optimization of early warning and emergency command scheduling system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication, and particularly discloses a method, a device and a system for monitoring communication link optimization of an early warning and emergency command scheduling system. According to the method for monitoring the communication link optimization of the early warning and emergency commanding and dispatching system, the communication link library is established by initializing each communication link, the state of each communication link is monitored, the scoring coefficient of each communication link is updated, the reliability value of each communication link is calculated, the communication link is selected according to the reliability value or the communication surrogate value of each communication link, data transmission is completed through the selected communication link, after a disaster occurs, the emergency rescue and dispatching commanding communication system can automatically calculate the communication link with the highest reliability or the communication link with the high reliability and the low transmission cost according to the communication links supported by the system for communication, manual intervention is not needed, and the communication link is guaranteed to be normal under the extreme condition.
assignees: SICHUAN AEROSPACE SUNKUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data analysis and early warning method based on distributed disaster recovery drilling scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data analysis and early warning method based on a distributed disaster recovery drilling scene, which comprises the following steps: step one: training a central early warning model in a distributed manner and carrying out privacy data aggregation; step two: the first step of data is put into a model for training, a local disaster backup exercise early warning model is obtained through training, the disaster backup exercise early warning model data of each place are submitted to a central server for updating the disaster backup exercise early warning model, a headquarter exercise result database is updated, and updated indexes after each training are stored; meanwhile, updating the service identifier and storing the service identifier into a database to serve as an initial service identifier of the next disaster backup scene of the same type, and commanding the central server program to execute new model training again, so that the whole process is completed, and the probability of a real disaster in the training process of disaster backup exercise is obtained. The invention can effectively overcome the problem of model deviation and reduce the calculation complexity.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: BIM-based ultra-wide deep large foundation pit monitoring method and system for deep soft soil area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metering, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring ultra-wide deep large foundation pit in deep soft soil areas based on BIM, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the deformation degree of a construction process at a target depth by utilizing the geological survey data and displacement monitoring data of a construction influence area; the method comprises the steps of determining a deformation abnormal range of a construction influence area by utilizing deformation degree of a corrected construction process, determining a soil deformation mutation risk degree by utilizing the deformation abnormal range, obtaining an adjusted monitoring frequency by utilizing the soil deformation mutation risk degree and an initial monitoring frequency, obtaining updated displacement monitoring data based on the adjusted monitoring frequency, obtaining a target soil deformation mutation risk degree by utilizing the updated displacement monitoring data of the construction influence area and combining with geological survey data, and determining a risk area. By the technical scheme, the early warning capability of safety accidents possibly occurring in the construction process is improved, and the method is beneficial to timely finding out dangerous areas and timely taking treatment measures.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCIAL ERJIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP LTD

title_en: Apparatus and operating method of emergency phone with restrict call
title_ko: 통신제한 비상전화기 및 운용방법
abstract_en: A communication-restrictive emergency phone and a method for operating the same are provided to prevent an unauthorized person from communicating with the third person without permission and to enable a permitted engineer to change an emergency phone number or the arrangement of key buttons in a remote place. A communication-restrictive emergency phone includes a communication circuit part(100), a control part(110), a hook switch part(120), an audio part(130), a key button part(140), a memory part(150), a DTMF receiving part(170), and a DTMF generating part(160). The communication circuit part transmits and receives emergency communication signals. The control part accesses the communication circuit part, controls emergency communication, detects illegal communication, generates a warning signal, and records an inputted emergency phone number. The hook switch part accesses the control part, and provides communication start/stop indication signals. The audio part confirms the input of a command signal according to the control of the control part, and outputs a tone signal to warn of illegally occupied communication. The key button part accesses the control part, and inputs command signals to operate the emergency phone and a command signal to appoint a specific person selected for emergency communication. The memory part records and outputs an emergency phone number according to the control of the control part. The DTMF receiving part receives and detects emergency phone number information which is remotely inputted from the other side who calls the emergency phone. The DTMF generating part outputs the phone number of an appointed person's emergency contact point according to the control of the control part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통신제한 비상전화기 및 운용방법에 관한 것으로 특히, 비상통신신호를 송신과 수신하는 통신회로부; 통신회로부에 접속하고 비상통신을 제어하며, 무단통신을 검출하여 경고신호를 발생하고 입력되는 비상통신 전화번호를 기록하도록 제어하고 감시하는 제어부; 제어부에 접속하고 통신의 시작과 종료 표시 신호를 제공하는 후크스위치부; 제어부의 제어에 의하여 명령신호의 입력 확인과 무단점유 통신을 경고하는 오디오 신호를 출력하는 오디오부; 제어부에 접속하고 비상전화기를 운용하기 위한 명령신호와 비상통신으로 선택된 상대방을 지정하는 명령신호를 입력하는 키버튼부; 및 제어부의 제어에 의하여 비상전화번호를 기록하고 출력하는 메모리부; 가 포함되는 구성을 특징으로 하여, 비상전화기를 허용되지 않은 타인이 무단으로 국선에 접속하여 제 3 자와 통신하지 못하도록 하고, 허용된 기술자가 현장 또는 원격으로 접속하여 기록된 비상전화번호를 변경 및 키버튼 배열을 변경하므로 감시 감독이 용이한 효과가 있다.
