title_en: Smart video projector and system and method for disaster warning using the same
title_ko: 단계별 교육 및 평가를 기반으로 하는 반려동물 보호자 교육 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 기술적 측면에 따른 반려동물 보호자 교육 시스템은, 반려동물 보호자 교육 서비스를 제공받기 위하여, 사용자 및 사용자의 반려동물에 대한 정보를 제공하는 사용자 단말 및 공통 교육 분야 및 사용자 맞춤형 교육 분야를 포함하여 반려동물 보호자 교육 커리큘럼을 구성하고, 반려동물 및 반려동물의 보호자의 상황에 따라 능동적으로 학습 대상을 변경 설정하여 학습 서비스를 제공하는 서비스 서버를 포함한다. 상기 공통 교육 분야 및 사용자 맞춤형 교육 분야는 각각 복수의 세부 과목을 포함한다. 상기 서비스 서버는, 상기 사용자에게 복수의 평가를 수행하여 상기 복수의 세부 과목 각각에 대하여 상기 사용자 별 학습자 레벨을 설정하고, 설정된 학습자 레벨을 기초로 상기 사용자에게 제공될 학습 대상을 설정 할 수 있다.

title_en: Steel production risk dynamic early warning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for dynamically pre-warning the risk of steel production, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data in the steel production process, carrying out fluctuation analysis and stability analysis on the original data, carrying out pairwise comparison on each dimension index based on the analyzed data to generate a weight matrix, calculating a comprehensive weight coefficient, inputting the comprehensive weight coefficient into a preset mixed model, calculating a comprehensive safety risk value of a region to be detected by combining a predefined membership function, triggering a pre-warning signal according to the comparison result of the risk value and a preset threshold value, executing an emergency response strategy, adjusting model parameters based on a verification data set after executing the response strategy, and realizing full life cycle management through time sequence version comparison.
assignees: CISDI INFORMATION TECH CHONGQING CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method and system of wireless passive temperature sensor
abstract_en: A data processing method and system of a wireless passive temperature sensor comprise four stages of preprocessing of a data acquisition layer, dynamic filtering of edge nodes, cloud self-adaptive calibration and intelligent early warning, wherein multi-dimensional temperature characteristic parameters are extracted through orthogonal demodulation, singular values are removed through double windows, a filtering algorithm is dynamically switched based on noise statistics characteristics to achieve anti-interference and low-delay balance, a multi-dimensional drift compensation model is built, calibration parameters are dynamically updated through a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and a four-level early warning mechanism is built based on absolute temperature, change rate and fluctuation degree. The system comprises a sensing layer, an edge layer, a cloud layer and an application layer, and realizes data acquisition-processing-calibration-early warning full-link coordination. The invention solves the problems of signal distortion, poor filter adaptability, insufficient drift compensation and stiff early warning in the prior art, and is suitable for long-term precise monitoring of special scenes such as high-voltage equipment, rotating machinery and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;AVIC BEIJING PRECISION ENGINEERING INST FOR AIRCRAFT INDUSTRY

title_en: Emergency warning broadcast receiver, method thereof, information reproducing device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency warning broadcast receiver capable of receiving emergency warning broadcast with low power consumption and low cost; and to provide a method thereof, an information reproducing device, and electronic equipment.  <P>SOLUTION: The emergency warning broadcast receiver includes a program information update detector for detecting update of program information included in a transport stream, and a decoder for executing decoding processing of packet data separated from the transport stream. The decoder executes decoding processing for the packet data separated from the transport stream as emergency warning broadcast data, on the basis of a result of analysis of program information which has been executed in a condition of detection of the update of the program information by the program information update detector.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Fire alarm notification and fire extinguisher that informs the expiration date
title_ko: 유통기한을 알려주는 화재경보 알림 겸용 소화기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher (1) combined with a fire alarm notifying expiration date. More specifically, the fire alarm notifying expiration date sounds an alarm through a speaker when the expiration date passes, and when a fire occurs, the fire alarm (1) transmits the fire alarm to a speaker (2) to notify that the speaker (2) has a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유통기한을 알려주는 화재경보 알림 겸용 소화기(1)에 관한 것으로,더욱 상세하게주는 화재경는 유통기한이 지나면 스피커를 통해 알람이 울리고 화재가 발생하면 화재경보기(1)가 스피커(2)로 전달하여 스피커(2)가 화재가 발생했습니다라고 알려준다.

title_en: Experimental method and device for dynamic disaster of rock burst in roadway excavation
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for dynamic disaster experiment of tunnel driving rock burst is characterized in that the experiment method includes an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under normal geological conditions and an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under abnormal geological conditions; both of them comprise (1) preparing a sample; (2) applying a static load to the sample, and simulating the actual stress environment of rock mass around the underground tunneling working face of the coal mine; (3) controlling the motion track of a cutter to simulate tunneling through a computer program, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the tunneling process of a sample; (4) withdrawing the cutter from the sample, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the process of stopping digging the sample; (5) respectively in step 2 and step 3, applying dynamic load, and controlling dynamic loading waveform characteristics and application time parameters by a computer; (6) and changing the form and the strength of the dynamic load waveform until the sample is subjected to impact damage, obtaining the condition criterion of the roadway impact damage and the like. The method can provide theoretical reference and scientific countermeasures for early warning and prevention of coal mine roadway excavation rock burst.

title_en: Lithium battery energy storage management system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery energy storage management system and a lithium battery energy storage management method, which relate to the technical field of lithium battery management and comprise a cloud service platform, an EMS energy management module, a BMS battery management module, a current transformer, a fire control management module, a temperature control module, a warning module and an intelligent terminal. The invention carries out charging energy storage at the time of low peak of electricity utilization, discharges at the time of high peak of electricity utilization, can carry out emergency power supply and fire control filling, reserves fire control electricity utilization lithium batteries every day, changes every day, and reserves two groups of fire control lithium batteries every day; the position of the lithium battery for fire fighting is ensured to be randomly updated every day, the lithium battery for fire fighting also participates in normal charging and discharging work, the running state of the lithium battery for fire fighting can be ensured to be mastered in time, and the lithium battery for fire fighting is prevented from being in a full-charge state or a non-power state for a long time; the reserve lithium cell of fire control designs spatial distance, guarantees no matter which direction receives the damage from the lithium cell, guarantees at least that a set of reserve lithium cell of fire control can supply to use.

title_en: Coal mine environment safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine environment safety monitoring system and a method, wherein environment information acquisition terminals are arranged at different monitoring positions, and a user terminal server is used for preprocessing, so that the analysis and recognition accuracy of the safety level corresponding to the environment information is improved, the environment information exceeding the limit of the preset safety level is selectively selected and transmitted to a host server at an upper level, the monitoring workload is reasonably distributed, and the processing problem caused by excessive data is reduced. And simultaneously, the main server is utilized to store and analyze the environment information exceeding the limit of the preset security level, the security level matched with the environment information and the personnel position identity information, and the environment information is processed into the three-dimensional space security information updated according to the monitoring period. By using the system and the method, the underground safety problem of the coal mine can be effectively monitored, accurate and timely automatic informatization prediction and early warning are realized, and effective help is provided for processing safety accidents.
assignees: TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH OF KAILUAN GROUP LTD LIABILITY CORPORATION;ZHONGLUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: A transfer method for service request information
title_ko: 서비스 요청 정보 전달 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a service request information transmission system which comprises: a service reception/management terminal connected to a cloud service server connected via a wireless Internet communication means; a customer terminal; and an employee terminal, and to a service request information transmission method. The service request information transmission method comprises the steps of: determining, by the service reception/management terminal, when a specific event such as a room service request and an emergency situation generated from the customer terminal and the employee terminal occurs, an employee at the shortest distance from the location where the event occurs; transmitting a room service message or an emergency message to an employee terminal of an employee who is determined to be at the shortest distance from the location where the event occurs; checking whether the employee who has received the room service message or the emergency message accepts the message; repeatedly determining, when the employee rejects the message, a recipient who can be added and transmitting the message to an employee terminal of the recipient; and updating, when the message is accepted, state information with respect to the employee terminal and completing the transmission of the message. According to the present invention, it is possible to efficiently provide a service.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선 인터넷 통신수단을 통해서 접속되는 클라우드 서비스 서버와 연결되는 서비스 접수/관리 단말기, 고객용 단말기, 직원용 단말기를 포함하되, 상기 서비스 접수/관리 단말기는, 고객용 단말기 및 직원용 단말기로부터 생성된 룸서비스 요청 및 위급 상황과 같은 특정 이벤트가 발생될 경우, 상기 이벤트가 발생된 위치와 최단거리에 있는 직원을 판별하는 단계; 이벤트가 발생된 위치와 최단거리로 판별된 직원의 직원용 단말기로 룸 서비스 메시지 또는 위급 메시지를 송신하는 단계; 상기 룸 서비스 메시지 또는 위급 메시지를 수신받은 직원의 메시지 수락 여부를 확인하는 단계; 메시지가 거부된 경우, 추가 가능한 수신자를 반복적으로 판별하여 상기 수신자의 직원용 단말기로 메시지를 송신하는 단계; 메시지가 수락된 경우, 직원용 단말기에 대한 상태정보를 갱신하고 메시지 전달을 종료하는 단계;를 포함하는 서비스 요청 정보 전달 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_ko: 회로 차단기를 사용하여 부하가 걸린 회로를 모니터링하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 방법 및 장치는 회로 차단기가 회로에 대해 트립되기 전에 조치가 취해질 수 있도록 열화에 대해 회로를 모니터링하고 열화의 사전 경보를 획득하는 개선된 방법을 제공한다. 이 방법은 회로에 대한 기준선을 설정하고, 회로에 대한 전압 및 전류에 대한 제로 교차점을 모니터링하는 단계를 포함한다. 동작 중에, 회로는 제로 교차점을 사용하여 모니터링되고, 이러한 정보는 변경이 발생했는지를 결정하기 위해 기준선과 비교된다. 기준선 정보는 적절한 신호가 제공되어 적절한 조치가 취해지고, 회로를 중단하며, 교정 조치를 취할 수 있도록 회로가 열화하고 있음을 나타내는 임계값을 설정한다.

title_en: Distribution and Cabinet Panel take in Measurement and Alert Device for Leakage Current With Resistance Element
title_ko: 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a distribution and cabinet panel mounting a resistive leakage current measurement and alert device and, more particularly, to a distribution and cabinet panel mounting a resistive leakage current measurement and alert device, capable of accurately checking a leakage state based on a detection result by accurately detecting an effective resistive leakage current flowing on the ground due to the degradation of an electric wire on the distribution and cabinet panel. The present invention includes a circuit breaker (2) to which utility power (1) is inputted, a DPDT relay (3), a load part (4), a current detecting unit (7), a control unit (8), a calculation and determination unit (11), a voice generating unit (12), and an alert generating unit (13). The distribution and cabinet panel mounting the resistive leakage current measurement and alert device according to an embodiment of the present invention prevents an electric shock accident and an electrical fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반에 관한것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 배전 및 분전반에 전선 열화로 인해 대지에 흐르고 있는 유효한 저항성 누설전류를 정확하게 검출하여, 그 검출결과에 근거하여 누전 측정 및 경보가 이루어지도록 함으로써 관리자로 하여금 정확한 누전상태를 확인 할 수 있게 하는 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 상용전원(1)이 입력되는 차단기(2), 상기 차단기(2)는 DPDT 릴레이(3)에 입력되고, 상기 DPDT 릴레이(3)는 부하부(4)에 입력되고,  
상기 부하부(4)는 제어부(8)에서 동작신호(6)가 상기 DPDT 릴레이(3)에 입력되면 대지접지와 연결되어 저항성 누설전류를 검출한 측정값을 전류 검출부(7)에 의해 제어부(8)에 입력되고,  
상기 제어부(8)는 입력된 상기 측정값을 산출 및 판단부(11)에 입력하고, 상기 산출 및 판단부(11)에서 출력된 측정값을 판단하여 음성 발생부(12)와 경보 발생부(13)에 누전 측정값의 상태를 전송함과 동시에 관리자나 관리실(2)에서 누전상태를 확인 할 수 있게하는 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반으로 구성하여 본 발명의 과제의 해결 수단이다. 
본 발명은 배전 및 분전반에 전선 열화로 인해 대지에 흐르고 있는 유효한 저항성 누설전류를 정확하게 검출하여, 그 검출결과에 근거하여 누전 측정 및 경보가 이루어지도록 함으로써 관리자로 하여금 정확한 누전상태를 확인 할 수 있게 하는 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반을 제공하여 감전사고와 전기화재를 예방하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: fire-prevention system possible earthquake observation
title_ko: 지진 감지가 가능한 소방 방재 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물내 흔들림에 대한 차동분석을 실시간으로 실시하여 지진 발생시 지진 경보 알림을 알려줌과 함께 상시전원 상태를 비상전원 상태로 전환하여 안전한 유효 동작 시간을 증대시키도록 한 지진 감지가 가능한 소방 방재 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건물의 천장이나 벽면에 부착되어 열, 연기, 불꽃 중에서 적어도 어느 하나의 화재 발생 신호를 감지하고 외부의 제어신호를 받아 색상 변화를 통해 시각 경보 기능을 갖는 소방 감지기와, 상기 소방 감지기의 화재 발생 신호를 받아 화재 유무를 판단하여 건물 내의 소방설비를 전체적으로 제어함과 더불어 상기 소방 감지기에 제어신호를 출력하는 화재 수신기와, 상기 소방 감지기로부터 감지된 화재 발생 신호를 상기 화재 수신기가 상기 화재 발생 신호를 수신받아 처리하도록 증폭하여 전송하는 소방 중계기와, 상기 소방 감지기내에 설치되어 상기 건물내 흔들림에 정보를 검출하여 상기 소방 중계기를 통해 상기 화재 수신기로 전송하는 지진 감지부와, 상기 화재 수신기로부터 화재 또는 지진이 발생하여 상기 소방 감지기로 제어신호를 출력할 때 상기 화재 또는 지진 정보를 무선으로 받아 상위 관리자에게 전송하는 단말기를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SMART POWER CO LTD;Z HOME LED CO LTD

title_en: Security alarm and bootstrap technique
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technical field of safety protection, in order to solve in existing safety alarm system, lead to congestion since the personnel of the same area are concentrated in an exit passageway when withdrawing to reduce the problem of withdrawing speed, provide a kind of security alarm and bootstrap technique, including alarming step and green indicating lamp directing step；Alarming step：When alert occurs, alert inductive signal is sent control module by the first induction module of alert sub-system, and the alarm module of control module control alert sub-system is alarmed；Wherein, green indicating lamp directing step is：When a certain second induction module of alert sub-system senses a certain exit passageway congestion, the congestion signal is sent to control module, the luminance adjustment module movement of control module control guidance subsystem, reduces the brightness of the green indicating lamp in the exit passageway by luminance adjustment module；The optical filtering part worn in guidance subsystem for personnel can mask the green indicating lamp other than particular color.
assignees: GUIZHOU RENHUAI XIKE COMPUTER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an upper fixing plate, wherein a signal processor is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the upper fixing plate, a lower fixing plate is arranged at the lower end of the upper fixing plate, a fixing sleeve is arranged on the outer surface of the lower end of the lower fixing plate, and a camera is arranged at the side end of the fixing sleeve. This fire control unmanned aerial vehicle passes through the cooperation of fixed sleeve and spring and telescopic link, descend the in-process at unmanned aerial vehicle, its telescopic link and spring can be effectual to unmanned aerial vehicle its cushioning effect, prevent that unmanned aerial vehicle is whole to take place to turn on one's side the damage, through the cooperation of cylinder and movable rod and No. two motors and rotation axis, user's accessible stretches out the camera with the cooperation of movable rod, real-time rotation monitoring to the camera through the cooperation of No. two motors and rotation axis, through the speaker that is the symmetry and arranges and the cooperation of spacing frame, can in time send the warning to people or animal under the dangerous condition, make it withdraw danger area.

title_en: Chemical enterprise safety production risk management system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety production management, and particularly relates to a safety production risk management system and method for a chemical enterprise. The management system comprises a safety production management platform, wherein the safety production management platform comprises an information processing module, a safety production danger source monitoring module, a communication module, a personnel on-duty monitoring module, a safety early warning module and a plurality of user terminals; according to the invention, data acquisition equipment such as sensors and the like are adopted to monitor heavy dangerous source elements and combustible toxic and harmful gases in real time, so that the production state of a factory area can be conveniently mastered in real time, the on-duty monitoring module of personnel can acquire real-time positioning information of the on-duty personnel, and the personnel who cannot withdraw the gas in time can be easily rescued when a safety accident happens; a large number of supervision personnel do not need to be set up, and the monitoring data can respond to actual conditions, and the human cost is saved and the safety production management effect of chemical enterprises is improved.

title_en: Earthquake data information release system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic data information release system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of seismic data processing. According to the earthquake data information release system and the storage medium, users can be divided into multiple release object grades from near to far by taking a seismic source as a center, so that the earthquake release sequence can release notifications according to the release object grades, the user closest to the seismic source can acquire earthquake early warning notification information in the shortest time, important users who really need to withdraw from danger can be locked to a great extent through the earthquake release notification, meanwhile, the earthquake early warning notification can be carried out on users who have access to the earthquake range or live in the earthquake range and are registered as non-earthquake ranges, the pertinence of the earthquake release is stronger, and the earthquake release is more comprehensive.

title_en: Double-layer cascading dynamic constraint optimization agricultural disaster prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer cascading dynamic constraint optimization agricultural disaster prediction method and a double-layer cascading dynamic constraint optimization agricultural disaster prediction system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and grading satellite remote sensing data and external reference data, and constructing a prediction center and an influence area data set; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a central data set to establish an early warning model to predict agricultural disasters and trigger alarms, combining the two data sets to establish a space-time diffusion model to predict development trend and make strategies, setting a dynamic optimization model and evaluating the dynamic optimization model, and dynamically adjusting sampling strategies. The invention adopts a double-layer cascade prediction model and a dynamic constraint optimization strategy to realize the balance of agricultural disaster prediction precision and efficiency, rapidly positions disaster hotspots and predicts global trend through the cooperative prediction of a hierarchical positioning early warning and a space-time diffusion model, reduces the dependence on full-dimension data, adopts a self-adaptive sampling strategy to reduce redundant calculation, keeps dynamic update in the high-incidence period of the disaster, and provides clear guidance for decision makers through the hierarchical early warning and prevention and control strategy and the interpretable output.

title_en: Apartment basement garage emergency bell device
title_ko: 무인으로 운영되는 아파트 지하주차장에서 자동차의 손상, 분실 등을 억제하는 비상벨 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell device of an apartment basement garage through a network, capable of easily securing stability for a parking space through the emergency bell device in an unmanned vehicle garage and securing the safety of a vehicle user by enabling the user to check notification information in a parking control center. According to the present invention, if an information request for a parking space is received from the user to confirm information on the parking space in order to park the vehicle in the apartment basement garage, the user is requested to input user information. The authentication of the user is requested by receiving the user information from the user terminal and transmitting the user information to a control server. If the authentication pass of the user is received from the control server, the selected vehicle releases the locking of the emergency bell device of the basement garage. The emergency bell device of the apartment basement garage and a management system according to the present invention can quickly cope with an emergency situation through the monitoring of the user who uses the apartment basement garage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 네트워크를 통한 아파트 지하주차장 비상벨 장치에 관한 것으로, 무인으로 운영되는 자동차 주차장에 비상벨 장치를 통하여 쉽게 주차공간에 대한 안정성을 확보하고 주차 관제 센터에서의 알림 정보를 사용자가 확인할 수 있도록 하여 자가용 이용자의 안전을 확보하기 위한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 자동차를 아파트 지하주차장에 주차를 하기 위해서 주차공간에 대한 정보를 확인하기 위해서 사용자로부터 주차공간에 대한 정보 요청을 수신하면 사용자에게 사용자정보 입력을 요청한다. 사용자의 사용자 단말로부터 사용자정보를 수신하여 관제 서버로 전송하여 사용자의 인증을 요청한다. 관제 서버로부터 사용자의 인증 통과를 수신하면 선택된 자동차가 지하주차장 비상벨 장치의 잠금을 해제한다. 본 발명에 따른 아파트 지하주차장 비상벨 장치 및 관리 시스템은 아파트 지하주차장을 이용하는 사용자의 모니터링을 통하여 긴급 상황에 신속하게 대처할 수 있다.

title_en: System for suppressing fire equipped with function of selectively sensing flame of fire
title_ko: 선별적 유효 이벤트 감지 기능을 구비하는 화재 진압 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire suppression system with a function of selectively detecting an effective event. The fire suppression system includes: a monitoring unit including a predetermined sensor and monitoring a preset space; a fire analyzing unit which recognizes a predetermined fire event using a predetermined sensor of the monitoring unit and selectively selects a valid event from the predetermined fire event; and a suppression control unit which checks valid events from the fire analyzing unit and controls an operation of a fire alarm or a fire extinguishing device. Therefore, it is possible to selectively detect a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선별적 유효 이벤트 감지 기능을 구비하는 화재 진압 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 소정의 센서를 포함하고, 미리 설정된 공간을 모니터링하는 모니터링 유닛; 모니터링 유닛의 소정의 센서를 이용하여 소정의 화재 이벤트를 인식하며, 소정의 화재 이벤트로부터 유효 이벤트를 선택적으로 선별하는 화재 애널라이징 유닛; 및 화재 애널라이징 유닛으로부터 유효 이벤트를 확인하여, 화재경보 또는 소화장치의 동작을 관장하는 진압 콘트롤 유닛을 포함하는 기술적 사상을 개시한다.

title_en: Systems and methods to re-trigger a detection-based proximity alarm system
abstract_en: A proximity warning system (100) includes a camera (104) positioned on a machine (10), a processor (1210), and one or more memory devices (1250) including instructions for execution by the processor. The system includes instructions to receive (202) image data from a camera (104) depicting an object (20) within a field of view (FOV) of the camera (104). The system includes instructions to derive (204) a first distance between the object (20) and the machine (10) based on the image data, and trigger (206) an alarm (108) when the first distance is less than a first threshold distance D1. The system may include an instruction to receive (208) a request to temporarily turn off the alert (108) and stop the alert (108). Additional image data may be received (210) from the camera (104) and a second distance between the object (20) and the machine (10) is derived (212) based on the additional image data. The system includes instructions to cancel (214) the temporary shutdown and re-trigger the alarm (108) when the second distance is less than a second threshold distance (D2).

title_en: Three-dimensional collaborative multi-type label plotting system and method based on fire alarm condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional collaborative multi-type label plotting system and method based on fire alarm conditions, and relates to the technical fields of geographic information systems and alarm condition processing. The system comprises a warning receiving platform, a warning condition receiving end, a plotting service end, a plotting cache end, a plurality of three-dimensional plotting client ends and a plurality of user ends, wherein the warning condition receiving end is respectively in communication connection with the warning receiving platform and the plotting service end, the plotting service end is respectively in bidirectional communication connection with the plotting cache end and the three-dimensional plotting client ends, the user ends are in communication connection with the corresponding three-dimensional plotting client ends, the warning condition receiving end receives warning condition information of the warning receiving platform, pushes the warning condition information to the plotting service end, interacts with the three-dimensional plotting client ends and the plotting cache ends, and the plotting cache ends are used for caching data and are displayed to the corresponding user ends after being updated. When the fire-fighting police condition is processed, the three-dimensional situation plotting, commanding and dispatching and information sharing can be carried out on the disaster site, and the processing efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: FUJIAN SIXIN DIGITAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Prevention of Bird-Strike using GNSS and SBAS
title_ko: 항법위성시스템과 위성기반 오차보정시스템을 활용한 버드 스트라이크 예방시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bird strike prevention system using a global navigation satellite system (GNSS) and a satellite-based augmentation system (SBAS). According to the present invention, the bird strike prevention system detects birds (4) through the GNSS (1), increases accuracy through the SBAS (5), and transmits a warning signal to an aircraft (3). According to the present invention, aircraft flight cancellation and casualties caused by bird strikes can be prevented.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공항용(空港用) 버드 스트라이크(Bird Strike) 예방에 관한 것으로서, 조류는 자연상태에서 천적이 접근한다 해도 크기와 속도에 상관없이 일정 거리 이내에 접근해야 피하는 습성이 있다. 대체로 30m 정도에 반응을 보이는데 그보다 멀면 상대속도가 빠르건 느리건 굳이 피하려 들지 않고 가까워진 다음에야 피하려 들어서 항공기 상대로도 똑같은 반응을 보이기 때문에 피하지 못하고 버드 스트라이크가 일어난다.  
기존의 버드 스트라이크 대책은 대부분 BAT반이라고 불리는 조류통제요원들로 해결한다. 하지만 대부분의 활주로들은 개활지인데다 사람의 입장이 통제되어 새들이 살기 좋은 환경이다. 또한 통제요원들은 습지 같은 곳처럼 가지못하는 곳이 많다. 밤에는 조류관측 조차 어려우며, 공항이 넓은 경우에는 인력 부족 및 Manhour의 문제까지 발생한다. 
어느정도 충돌사고는 대부분 대비할 수 있는 방법이 마련되어 있지만, 조류의 경우 하늘에서 고속으로 날고 있다면 육안으로 확인하는 것은 거의 불가능하고 작아서 레이더로도 발견이 어려운 경우가 많아 항공 관계자들 사이에서 문제가 되고 있다.  
이를 해결하기 위해 새들의 전체적인 움직임을 AI나 빅데이터를 활용해 한번 필터링을 하여 관측 해야 하는 범위를 줄이고, 항법위성시스템(GNSS)과 위성기반 오차보정시스(템SBAS)을 활용해서 기존의 GPS의 정밀도를 높이고 활주로 및 임무형상 내에 있는 새들의 위치를 파악하여 사전에 파일럿, 관제탑, 지휘통제실에 알려주는 시스템을 사용하여 버드 스트라이크를 방지한다. 나아가 미사일, 전투기 등의 국방 및 방산부문에서의 사용도 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: Automatic Fire Extinguishing System For Automobile Engine Room
title_ko: 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 자동 소화시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing system in an engine room of a small tactical vehicle, capable of increasing fire extinguishing efficiency, which comprises: a constant temperature detecting linear detector (100); a thermal image detector (200) for photographing a fire warning location; a control unit (300) for determining whether a fire occurs; a fire extinguishing unit (400); and a monitoring unit (500).
abstract_ko:
본 개시의 실시예에 따른 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 자동 소화시스템은, 
소형전술차량 엔진룸에 설치되어 소정의 온도에 도달하는 화재경고위치를 감지하는 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100); 상기 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100)와 연동되어 상기 화재경고위치를 촬영하는 열화상 감지기(200); 상기 열화상 감지기(200)의 데이터를 바탕으로 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 화재발생여부를 판단하는 제어부(300); 상기 제어부(300)의 명령을 받아 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 화재발생 시 소화를 담당하는 소화부(400); 및 상기 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100), 상기 열화상 감지기(200), 상기 제어부(300) 및 상기 소화부(400)와 연결되어 데이터를 주고받으며 소형전술차량 엔진룸의 상태를 모니터링할 수 있는 모니터링부(500); 를 포함하고, 
상기 소화부(400)는 소형전술차량 트렁크에 장착되는 적어도 하나 이상의 소화장치(410)와, 상기 소화장치(410)에 내장된 소화분말을 소형전술차량의 엔진룸에 분사시키기 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 분사모듈(420)과, 상기 소화장치(410)와 상기 분사모듈(420)을 연결하는 배관모듈(430) 및 상기 분사되는 소화분말의 유량을 조절하는 유량조절모듈(440)을 포함하고, 
상기 분사모듈(420)은 내부에 적어도 하나 이상의 원통 형상의 배관으로 형성되는 오리피스관을 구비하는 본체파츠(421)와, 상기 본체파츠(421)에 결합되며 상기 오리피스관의 직경 크기를 조절하는 조절파츠(422)와, 상기 본체파츠(421)에 교체가능하도록 결합되며 복수의 분사 구멍이 형성되어 상기 소화분말을 상기 분사 구멍을 통해 외부로 분출시키는 노즐파츠(424)를 포함하고, 
상기 조절파츠(422)는 상기 본체파츠(421)에 결합되며 중앙에 소정의 공간이 개방된 내부링판(422aa)과 상기 내부링판(422aa)의 외주면에 결합되어 회전되는 외부링판(422ab)이 구비되는 플레이트유닛(422a)과, 상기 플레이트유닛(422a)과 상기 본체파츠(421) 사이에 위치되고 상기 내부링판(422aa)과 상기 외부링판(422ab)에 결합되며 상기 외부링판(422ab)의 회전 시 함께 회전됨으로써 상기 오리피스관의 직경 크기를 조절하는 조절유닛(422b)과, 상기 내부링판(422aa)의 상부면에 결합되는 커버유닛(422c)을 포함하고, 
상기 열화상 감지기(200)는 평상시 대기모드로 유지되고, 상기 정온식 감지선형 감지기(100)에 의해 화재경고위치가 특정되는 경우에는 대기모드를 해제하여 상기 화재경고위치를 촬영하는 것을 특징으로 하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Method for providing low power IoT communication based geofencing services based on context aware information of location tracking devices
abstract_en: A method of providing low power IoT communication based geofence services based on situational identification information of a location tracking device, comprising: allowing a situational analysis engine of the location tracking device to measure situational identifying information obtained from peripheral sensors capable of accepting signals from the periphery, such as the user's heart rate, body temperature, and movement status; determining whether the detected condition is an emergency or a normal condition based on condition identifying information measured by a condition analysis engine of the location tracking device; transmitting an emergency notification message and the detected location tracking data to a server through a low-power IoT communication method when the situation is an emergency; selecting a module capable of stably tracking a location among Global Positioning System (GPS), WIFI sniffing, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and Ultra Wideband (UWB) modules of a location tracking device for location tracking after transmitting an emergency notification message; measuring mobile location information of a location tracking device user using the selected location tracking module; checking whether the measured mobile location information and situation recognition information are obtained from a peripheral sensor capable of receiving signals from the periphery, for example, the heart rate and body temperature of the user can be transmitted by being converted through real-time communication; if the transmission can be performed through real-time communication, the situation identification information can be transmitted to the server through real-time communication at a higher data rate than usual and at frequent transmission cycles; receiving an emergency cancel message from the server manager based on the mobile location information and the situation recognition information; an emergency cancellation message is received and then transmitted to a server, situation identification information is obtained from peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from a location tracking device user periphery, such as heart rate, body temperature, and mobility status, and the situation identification information is converted by low power IoT communication at a reduced transmission period and lower data rate compared to an emergency.

title_en: Indoor multifunctional disaster prevention early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor multifunctional disaster prevention early warning device, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention early warning equipment. Including the equipment shell, wherein the fixed shell support that is provided with of equipment shell upside, be provided with the driver in the equipment shell, the driver both sides are connected with the drive wheel, the drive wheel is located the equipment shell outside, still be provided with the subassembly and the transport subassembly of soaking in the equipment shell, the subassembly that soaks is connected with the driver, be provided with the early warning subassembly on the shell support, be provided with thermal imaging system on the equipment shell to and temperature detector, be provided with smoke detector in the front side of shell support. The invention can carry out inspection, determine the goods with abnormal temperature in the current warehouse through the functions of the thermal imaging system, the temperature detector and the like, withdraw the goods to an open area, send a signal to the monitoring end to alarm, and carry the goods and prevent the equipment from being soaked in water.
assignees: HEBEI JINTAI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Potential safety hazard investigation method and system for power transformation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential safety hazard investigation method and system for power transformation equipment, which particularly relate to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power equipment and are used for solving the hidden operation risk problem caused by equipment aging characteristic and generalized strategy mismatch in the prior art, and early warning and accurate intervention of hidden danger are realized by collecting multisource operation state data of the power transformation equipment and constructing an asynchronous data set, differential weight distribution is carried out on the abnormal parameters based on equipment structural characteristics, risk grades of different areas are quantified, time sequence relevance of contact resistance and electric field response is analyzed, breakdown risk caused by insulation degradation is judged, a maintenance period optimization scheme and an electric field compensation parameter are generated by combining the risk grades, an aging model is dynamically updated based on execution feedback, and the problem of control mismatch caused by material degradation characteristic of the traditional method is effectively solved by carrying out early warning and accurate intervention of hidden danger.
assignees: INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Module and method for distress call
title_ko: 조난 알림 모듈 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a distress call module and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the distress call module is a distress call module mounted on a bag, comprising: an impact sensor which measures the degree of an impact given to the distress call module; an angular acceleration sensor, which measures an angular acceleration that occurs during the rotation of the distress call module; an alert unit which generates an alert in accordance with an alert control signal; and a control unit which, when the measured degree of an impact is a preset value or higher and the measured angular acceleration is a preset value or higher, generates the alert control signal to the alert unit. According to embodiments, the present invention is able to firstly check if there is a distress situation through an impact given to the distress call module, and secondly check if there is a distress situation based on an angular acceleration generated during the rotation of the distress call module to generate an alert by more precisely determining an actual distress situation. In addition, when an alert is not released within a preset time from a point of time of alert generation, the present invention is able to automatically transmit a distress call signal and notify a distress situation and position of a user even when the user cannot make a distress call in person.
abstract_ko: 조난 알림 모듈 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 조난 알림 모듈 및 방법은 가방에 장착되는 조난 알림 모듈로서, 상기 조난 알림 모듈에 가해지는 충격 정도를 측정하는 충격 센서; 상기 조난 알림 모듈의 회전 시 발생하는 각가속도를 측정하는 각가속도 센서; 경보 제어 신호에 따라 경보를 발생시키는 경보부; 및 상기 측정된 충격 정도가 기 설정된 값 이상이고 상기 측정된 각가속도가 기 설정된 값 이상인 경우, 상기 경보 제어 신호를 상기 경보부로 발생시키는 제어부를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예들에 따르면, 조난 알림 모듈에 가해지는 충격을 통해 조난 상황 여부를 1차적으로 확인하고, 조난 알림 모듈의 회전 시 발생되는 각가속도를 기반으로 조난 상황 여부를 2차적으로 확인함으로써, 실제 조난 상황을 보다 정확하게 판단하여 경보를 발생시킬 수 있다. 또한, 경보 발생 시점으로부터 기 설정된 시간 이내에 경보 해제가 되지 않는 경우, 조난 알림 신호를 자동 전송함으로써, 사용자가 직접 구조 요청을 할 수 없는 경우에도 사용자의 조난 상황 및 위치 등을 외부에 알릴 수 있게 된다.
assignees: DONG-A UNIV RES FOUND FOR INDUSTRY-ACADEMY COOP

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The scheme discloses a fire early warning method, a fire early warning system and a fire early warning medium based on multi-source information fusion, which comprise single vehicle model training, model deployment, fire risk assessment, BIM modeling display and abnormal information notification. According to the fire disaster early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source information fusion, through deep fusion and model training of images, positioning and temperature information of the vehicle, the temperature fault mode of the vehicle can be quickly and accurately identified, the accuracy of fire disaster early warning is improved, when the vehicle has an overtemperature phenomenon, workers can quickly position the vehicle and the vicinity, measures can be timely taken for the overtemperature vehicle, the occurrence of fire disaster is prevented, the disaster damage degree of the fire disaster is reduced, and powerful support is provided for fire disaster prevention and control work. Through setting up bridge BIM model, show bridge fire risk map at display device or user terminal, command department, staff and driver can grasp the information such as disaster site, fire cause, disaster degree, vehicle intensive degree of current bridge fire rapidly through bridge fire risk map, the environmental adaptation ability of system is strong, can evaluate the fire risk under different environment, improve command department's decision-making efficiency, the staff can arrive the rescue scene fast and expand fire extinguishing and rescue work, the driver in low risk area can withdraw the bridge or assist the staff to carry out personnel evacuation promptly, casualties and economic loss that the biggest reduction conflagration caused.

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion digital intelligent mining pressure monitoring method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and discloses a multi-mode data fusion intelligent mining pressure monitoring method, a multi-mode data fusion intelligent mining pressure monitoring device and electronic equipment. And then, cleaning and feature extraction are completed through a data processing module, the cleaning and feature extraction are input into an intelligent analysis module with a built-in attention mechanism and a long-short-term memory network, the space-time evolution rule of the mine pressure is deeply excavated, and real-time pressure probability is output. The system judges the risk level according to the probability interval and executes graded linkage, namely, low risk maintains normal state monitoring, medium risk prompts to strengthen patrol, high risk directly contacts with sounding and light alarming and automatically interlocks and cuts off equipment power to force people to withdraw. The method effectively overcomes the limitation of single-source monitoring, and remarkably improves the accuracy of roof disaster early warning and the emergency response timeliness through multi-mode deep fusion and automatic interlocking control.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for telling a disaster in a t-dmb
title_ko: 지상파 ｄｍｂ 수신기의 재난 알림 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for informing a disaster in a T-DMB(Terrestrial-Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) receiver are provided to detect a disaster region code value by analyzing a TII signal within a disaster broadcasting stream in a standby mode state and release the standby mode through comparison between the detected disaster region code values, thereby informing a user of generation of the disaster. A TII(Transmitter Identification Information) timing detecting module(106) detects timing information of a TII signal in a disaster broadcasting stream transmitted from a transmitter during a standby mode of a receiver. A carrier power detecting module(108) detects carrier power by using an FFT(Fast Fourier Transformed) TII signal according to the TII timing information. A TII decoder(110) decodes the FFT TII signal if the detected carrier power is higher than a predetermined reference value. A location calculating module(104) calculates a location code value of the receiver. A disaster notification signal generating module(112) generates a disaster notification signal if a disaster region code value is consistent with the location code value, calculated by the location calculating module, in the decoded TII signal. A control module(114) generates a control signal for notifying generation of a disaster according to the disaster notification signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 지상파 DMB 수신기의 재난 알림 장치는, 수신기의 대기 모드 시 송신기로부터 송출되는 재난 방송 스트림에서 TII 신호의 타이밍 정보를 검출하는 TII 타이밍 검출 모듈과, TII 타이밍 정보에 따라 고속 푸리에 변환된 TII 신호를 이용하여 캐리어 전력을 검출하는 캐리어 전력 검출 모듈과, 검출된 캐리어 전력이 소정 기준 값 이상이면 고속 푸리에 변환된 TII 신호를 디코딩하는 TII 디코더와, 수신기의 위치 코드값을 산출하는 위치 산출 모듈과, 디코딩된 TII 신호에서 재난 지역 코드값과 위치 산출 모듈에서 산출된 위치 코드값이 같으면 재난 알림 신호를 발생시키는 재난 알림 신호 발생 모듈과, 재난 알림 신호에 따라 재난 발생을 알리기 위한 제어 신호를 발생시키는 제어 모듈을 포함한다. 
     이와 같이, 본 발명은 대기 모드 상태에서 재난 방송 스트림 내 TII 신호의 분석을 통해 재난 지역 코드값을 검출한 후 검출된 재난 지역 코드값간의 비교를 통해 대기 모드를 해제시킴으로서, 재난 발생을 사용자에게 알려줄 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
     재난 방송, T-DMB, 위치, GPS

title_en: Apparatus and method to detect cardiac arrhythmia
title_ko: 응급상황 인지를 위한 부정맥 검출방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An arrhythmia detecting method for recognizing emergency and a device thereof are provided to determine only regularity of a heartbeat, thereby diagnosing arrhythmia. CONSTITUTION: An arrhythmia detecting unit detects a heartbeat from an electrocardiogram signal received from a sensing unit(220). The arrhythmia detecting unit detects arrhythmia of the heartbeat by using regularity of pulse time. When the detected arrhythmia is constantly detected as a set arrhythmia reference number within set effective time, a controlling unit determines a current situation as an emergency situation(230,240). A warning generating unit outputs a warning signal to an external(250). [Reference numerals] (210) Selecting an initialize compensating factors(= 0); (220) Detecting arrhythmia from a pulse time between a previous heartbeat and next heartbeat; (230) Detecting the AR of the arrhythmia within Te?; (240) Determining as an emergency situation; (250) Generating alarm signals; (260) Reset; (AA) Start; (BB) End
abstract_ko:
응급상황을 인지할 수 있는 부정맥 검출 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.   
부정맥 검출부는 이전 심박동과 이후 심박동의 시간 간격인 박동시간을 이용하여 심박동의 부정맥을 검출할 수 있다. 
제어부는 부정맥이 기설정된 유효시간 이내에 연속하여 기설정된 부정맥 기준횟수만큼 검출되면, 응급상황으로 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire alarm service method, apparatus and system using local wireless data communication
title_ko: 근거리 무선 데이터 통신을 이용한 화재 경보 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention automatically generates an alarm signal when a fire occurs by checking a fire state through enabling a terminal device to analyze sensing information received from a beacon device for sensing the fire, by receiving a beacon signal including a minor value changed according to the change of sensing information collected in a preset space in which the beacon device is located; simply checks the fire state through the beacon device in a place without a fire alarm by automatically reporting the fire to a registered emergency contact list at the same time; and quickly dealing with the fire when a user does not recognize the fire like a sleeping state.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비콘 장치가 위치한 일정 공간에서 수집된 센싱 정보의 변동에 따라 변경된 마이너 값을 포함하는 비콘 신호를 단말 장치에서 수신함에 따라 단말 장치가 화재 감지를 위해 비콘 장치로부터 수신된 센싱 정보를 분석하여 화재 여부를 확인하여 화재 발생 시 자동으로 경보를 발생할 수 있으며, 동시에 등록된 긴급 연락처로 자동으로 신고를 수행함으로써, 화재 경보기가 없는 장소에서도 비콘 장치를 통해 간편하게 화재 발생 여부를 확인할 수 있으며, 사용자가 수면중인 경우와 같이, 화재를 인지할 수 없는 상황에서도 화재 발생에 빠르게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Functional fire safety management reminder signs
title_ko: 기능성 소방안전관리 알림표지판
abstract_en: The present invention relates to firefighting management notification sign board which comprises: a main body unit formed to be attached and fixed to a building, provided in the form of a plate, and configured to transmit information such specifications, locations, etc. of firefighting equipment in the form of letters, numbers, symbols, etc. displayed on a front surface thereof; an information checking means formed on a front side of the main body and capable of communicating with a fire station server management center (C) while double-checking accurate information such as firefighting-related equipment, located the inside and outside of the building, and operation states thereof through a terminal (B) such as a tablet PC during management performed by a firefighting equipment inspector (A) so as to allow for improvement of operational failure and operational malfunction in real-time; and a coating unit which protects the main body unit while preventing external foreign substances from entering the main body unit and the information checking means. According to the present invention, the firefighting management notification sign board enables a firefighting equipment inspector to recognize all kinds of information such as firefighting-related equipment of a building and a status of firefighting equipment (building drawing, emergency escape information, previously-conducted firefighting inspection items, etc.) at once and to identify whether initially-stored firefighting equipment details match information of a present view point which inspects modification information, thereby increasing convenience of firefighting management. In addition, the firefighting management notification sign board enables the firefighting equipment inspector to exchange various kinds of firefighting equipment information of a modified view point in real-time with the firefighting server management center through a terminal so that the firefighting equipment inspector may take precautions to cause the corresponding firefighting equipment to be properly functioning, and may also set up an emergency call available. Therefore, when an emergency situation occurs at night, it is possible to make an emergency call to a police station of a fire station.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관리 알림표지판을 형성함에 있어서: 건물 등에 부착 고정이 가능하도록 구성되고, 플레이트 판 형태로 형성되어 전면에 글자 · 숫자 · 기호 등의 형태로 소방 설비 제원 · 위치 등의 정보를 전달하는 본체부; 본체 전면부에 형성되어 소방시설점검자(A)의 관리 시 태블렛 PC 등의 단말기(B)를 통해 건물 내·외부의 소방관련 장비와 작동상태 등의 정확한 정보를 재차 확인하면서 소방서버관리처(C)와의 교류가 가능하여 실시간 형태로 기기의 작동불능 및 오류의 개선 등이 가능하게끔 구비하는 정보확인수단; 및 본체부와 정보확인수단에 외부의 이물질 유입 등을 방지하면서 본체부의 보호가 가능하게끔 코팅부를 구비함을 특징으로 한다. 
이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 건물의 소방관련 장비와 소방 기기상황(건물도면 · 비상탈출정보 · 종전의 소방점검사항 등) 등의 모든 정보를 소방시설점검자가 일거에 인지하도록 하는 한편, 최초 저장된 소방설비내역과 변경정보 등을 점검하는 현재시점의 정보가 일치하는지를 단번에 알 수 있도록 함으로써 소방 관리의 편의성이 증진되도록 하면서도 변경된 시점의 각종 소방 설비정보를 소방시설점검자가 단말기를 통해 소방서버관리처와 실시간으로 교류하여 해당 소방 설비가 제대로 작동될 수 있도록 사전 조치하고 비상호출 또한 가능하도록 함으로써 야간에 긴박한 일이 발생할 시 경찰서 또는 소방서로 비상호출이 가능하게 한 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of wireless ad hoc network construction method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to self-organizing network application technologies, it is therefore an objective to a kind of wireless ad hoc network construction method is provided, for constructing disaster field monitoring early-warning system.Technical solution of the present invention is characterized in that: monitoring disaster keypoint part with photographic device, live prompt person is prompted to withdraw with warning device, the photographic device and warning device are carried and installed with cushion cap, photographic device sends data to server by wireless receiving and dispatching terminal, and server sends instructions to the photographic device and warning device by wireless receiving and dispatching terminal.The present invention is for common radio network, it does not need to increase any network infrastructure, without wiring between radio receiving transmitting module, install, migrate it is more convenient, system has better robustness, and it is suitble in disaster field rapid build and implementation, to carry out auxiliary rapidly and assist the work such as earthquake relief work.The present invention plays video monitoring, and secondary disaster early warning commands the effects of providing foundation for Disaster relief countermeasure.
assignees: CHENGDU HENGAN POLICE EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Compact type apparatus for storage of cable
title_ko: 레일이 형성되는 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치
abstract_en: A compact cable storage device which forms a rail, of the present invention, comprises: an inner disc with spiral tracks formed at the front and rear; an outer housing joined at the front and rear with the inner disc between them; and a handle and cable guide block that rotate the inner disc to smoothly wind the cable drawn outward. The device facilitates easy cable withdrawal and retraction without tangling, prevents operator stress due to cable tangling, and simultaneously improves workability and shortens work time. The device can be manufactured with a thin inner disc, slightly larger than the diameter of two cable strands, making it easy to carry when working in power trenches, manholes, and other high-altitude locations. The device can be immediately reeled in after use, preventing safety accidents caused by abandoned cables (1).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 레일이 형성되는 컴팩트형 케이블 수납장치는 정면과 후면에 나선형 트랙이 형성된 내부 원판과, 내부 원판을 사이에 두고 정면과 후면에서 결합되는 외부 함체와, 내부 원판을 회전시켜 외부로 인출된 케이블을 원활하게 감을 수 있는 핸들과 케이블 가이더블록을 구비하고 있기 때문에 케이블의 엉킴없이 인출 또는 인입이 원활하도록 하는 사용의 편리성을 부여하고, 케이블의 엉킴으로 인한 작업자의 스트레스를 예방함과 동시에 작업성 향상 및 작업시간 단축하고, 사용하는 케이블 2가닥 직경보다 조금 큰 정도의 두께로 얇은 내부 원판으로 제작이 가능하므로 전력구, 맨홀 및 고소 작업개소 작업시 휴대가 용이하며, 케이블 사용 후 현장에서 즉시 감을 수 있으므로 방치되는 케이블(1)로 인한 안전사고를 예방할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: A kind of subway station intelligent emergent evacuation indication system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of subway station intelligent emergent evacuation indication system and method, including comprehensive survey module, central control module and multi information intelligence indicating module；The comprehensive survey module carries out real-time monitoring to the subway station region Nei Ge, and the environmental data that will acquire is sent to the central control module immediately；The central control module, the environmental data is analyzed and processed, whether reach danger threshold according to each area monitoring data, judge region on fire, flue gas diffusion zone, and real-time update is carried out to emergency evacuation lines according to judging result, and send evacuation instruction to the multi information intelligence indicating module；The multi information intelligence indicating module is instructed according to the evacuation, carries out guiding in real time to crowd evacuation in subway station.It can quickly find underground fire hazard and real-time intelligent planning evacuation route, effectively avoid evacuation crowd from being strayed into fire smoke sprawling region during evacuation, greatly improve evacuation efficiency and evacuation safety degree.

title_en: Region-based multi-industry object global weather risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional-based multi-industry object global weather risk early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring boundary data of a target area and all meteorological factor data at a certain time point; dividing a target area into a plurality of grid areas according to boundary data and the calibrated spatial resolution, and processing meteorological factor data into meteorological factor grid data; constructing a gridding time data layer of each meteorological factor at a certain time point; acquiring position information of a multi-industry object in a target area and a risk threshold value of a meteorological factor corresponding to the position information; and respectively determining the grid areas according to the position information, calling grid data corresponding to the grid areas in grid time data layers with different weather factors and the same time, comparing the grid data with a corresponding industry object weather factor risk threshold value, and simultaneously carrying out weather risk early warning on multiple industry objects. The method and the system can perform global real-time rolling update weather risk early warning on multi-industry objects in the target area.

title_en: Intelligent management system for experiment dangerous waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste management, in particular to an intelligent management system for experimental dangerous waste, which comprises a waste liquid information identification module, an emission behavior identification module, a capacity state evaluation module, a multi-stage linkage early warning module and a flow compliance tracking module. According to the invention, the binding identification mark is constructed by utilizing the experiment task number and the container information, and the first node data is formed by registering, so that the waste liquid has traceability from collection, the discharge fluctuation state identification is realized by comparing the current flow rate data with the historical quartile interval, the full-level time is predicted by combining the liquid level change rate, the early warning is implemented by associating the discharge frequency, the notification priority is set, the audible and visual alarm is linked, the automatic dialing and the message pushing are linked, and various channels such as the closed loop response is formed, meanwhile, the RFID reading record is collected and constructed to construct a chain time sequence data structure, the path validity verification is executed, the dynamic identification precision of the waste liquid discharge behavior is improved, and the predictive management and control on the container capacity abnormality is enhanced.

title_en: Point landslide debris flow potential degree self-adaptive monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses a point landslide and debris flow potential degree self-adaptive monitoring and early warning method. The method comprises the steps of setting a lattice monitoring equipment array, collecting displacement data of multiple monitoring points and environmental parameters, analyzing a displacement data time stamp through a time axis analysis module, generating a dynamic time axis, marking geological event nodes, combining a geographic information system with space mapping of the displacement data, and fusing the environmental parameters to obtain a preliminary potential degree assessment result. The pattern recognition engine classifies displacement speed and deformation characteristics of the preliminary result to generate a deformation characteristic map with a space-time tag, the multi-factor weighted evaluation model calculates a dynamic potential evaluation map according to the deformation characteristic map, adjusts an early warning threshold according to a user instruction to generate a personalized early warning rule set, and the scanning map outputs a multi-stage early warning response scheme. Based on early warning feedback, the model and the engine are iteratively updated, newly added monitoring data trigger re-analysis in real time, related schemes are updated in a linkage mode, and different scene requirements are adapted.
assignees: ZHEJIANG CHENGAN BIG DATA CO LTD;ZHEJIANG INSTITUTE OF SURVEYING AND MAPPING SCIENCE AND TECH;UNIV ZHEJIANG;ZHEJIANG NATURAL RESOURCES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom community data management platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and particularly discloses a smart community data management platform, which comprises: the system comprises a community basic information importing module, a fire control monitoring information importing module, a fire control patrol correction judging module, a fire control patrol update confirming module and a fire control patrol update feedback terminal. According to the invention, the firefighting inspection correction judgment is carried out according to the firefighting hidden danger tracking log, firefighting monitoring information and regional weather information of the target community, and the corrected firefighting hidden danger inspection clearing information corresponding to the target analysis community is confirmed, so that the problem of insufficient attention to the firefighting hidden danger processing at present is effectively solved, the defect that the firefighting hidden danger monitoring and early warning are only focused at present is avoided, the defect of the firefighting hidden danger processing at present is overcome, the processing capacity and coping capacity after the subsequent firefighting hidden danger occurs are improved, the prejudging and processing capacity of fire risks can be improved, and the optimization of resource allocation is realized.
assignees: SHANDONG JUZHENZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging monitoring platform real-time waterlogging early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and particularly relates to a real-time waterlogging early warning method of an urban waterlogging monitoring platform based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring live video stream data of a camera from a video platform; s2: intercepting pictures from live video stream data of a camera to construct a waterlogging identification data set; s3: creating a MobileNetV-based deep neural network model, and loading model weights; s4: configuring an SGD optimizer and a learning rate scheduling function in the training process so as to update parameters and adjust the learning rate when training a deep neural network model; s5: and training the freezing stage of the deep neural network model. According to the invention, by adopting a deep learning-based method and taking MobileNetV as a basic model, the urban waterlogging is monitored rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Flood disaster risk monitoring system, method and storage medium based on distributed hydrologic model
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster risk monitoring system, method and storage medium based on a distributed hydrological model, relating to the technical field of flood disaster risk monitoring and comprising the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of sub-area modules and collecting meteorological data, soil data and hydrological data of the target area; the acquired real-time data of all subdomains are input into a meteorological evaluation model, a soil evaluation model and a hydrological evaluation model, the outputs of the three models are combined to comprehensively generate a distributed hydrological model, a corresponding flood risk index is obtained, the flood risk index is compared with a preset risk threshold, and early warning is automatically triggered when the flood risk index exceeds an early warning threshold. According to the invention, the target area is divided into a plurality of sub-field modules, and the corresponding evaluation model is constructed by combining the meteorological data, the soil data and the hydrological data, so that the comprehensive analysis of complex topography and variable meteorological conditions is realized. The accuracy of flood risk assessment is improved, and model output can be updated in real time.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying hidden danger of field operation by AI image
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of field operation hidden danger, relates to an AI image recognition technology, and is used for solving the problem that the prior art cannot shield different types of field operation to intelligently recognize the field operation hidden danger, in particular to a method for recognizing the field operation hidden danger by an AI image; in the monitoring time period, the hidden danger in the monitoring area is alarmed by monitoring the total number RY of personnel, the personnel flow value RL, the average identification accuracy P of equipment and the average space density M in real time, and the hidden danger early warning threshold YXmax is periodically updated by combining the number of generated hidden danger alarms.
assignees: HUNAN SUNSHINE POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drought early warning, calculation and updating method for full-type water supply source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drought early warning, measuring, calculating and updating method for a full-type water supply source. The invention provides a unified drought early warning standard parameter and a measuring and calculating method for water supply source areas with different types and large quantity, measures and calculates the number of days of accumulative drought bearable of the water supply source areas by collecting basic or drought actual monitoring data, sets the days as red early warning, and sets orange and yellow early warning standards by reserving lead; when the observation accumulated rainless day reaches the early warning standard, early warning corresponding color; after the rainfall is observed, the direct water supplement amount of the rainfall falling into the open area of the water source area and the indirect water supplement amount of the rainfall falling into the rain collecting area are calculated, and the total soil accumulative drought degree is offset, so that the accumulative drought days are offset, and the drought early warning condition is updated. The invention obtains the per capita drought data of the water source area in each scale range through the weighted calculation of the water supply population of the water source area, is convenient for relevant departments to master the drought condition and provides a reference basis for implementing drought control measures.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Pull-through pin withdrawal alarm circuit of coke quenching car traction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pin penetrating and exiting alarm circuit of a coke quenching car traction mechanism, and belongs to the field of coke oven locomotive equipment. The circuit comprises a limiter, an intermediate relay and an audio-visual signal warning lamp. Wherein, stopper and audible and visual signal warning lamp are connected with intermediate relay respectively, and intermediate relay sets up in electric locomotive control circuit. The limiter SQ is used for detecting the pin penetrating state, the sound-light alarm lamp LS is used for giving out sound-light alarm when the pin penetrates out, and the intermediate relay KA is used for interrupting the power system and starting the sound-light alarm when the pin penetrates out. The invention can effectively early warn the pin penetration and withdrawal, and prompt operators to check and recover the pin penetration in time, thereby avoiding safety accidents caused by the pin penetration and withdrawal.
assignees: CHONGQING IRON & STEEL LTD BY SHARE LTD

title_en: Intersection short-time traffic flow prediction method based on quantile regression and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-time traffic flow prediction method for intersections based on quantile regression and a Bayesian network, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and comprises the following steps of constructing a Bayesian network, analyzing traffic flow data by adopting a quantile regression method, determining probability space distribution of traffic flow under abnormal traffic conditions, and determining parameters in the Bayesian network by utilizing the quantile regression result; the invention accurately grasps the space-time and nonlinear characteristics of traffic flow, provides support for policy formulation and signal optimization of a management department, effectively dredges blockage and improves efficiency, ensures reliable prediction for emergency management and accident early warning based on various abnormal conditions by quantile regression of determined network parameters, reduces the risk of confusion and loss, acquires updated data in real time and optimizes a model, flexibly adjusts according to scene change, enables intelligent fine energization for traffic management, improves system performance and service quality, meets multiple requirements and drives traffic to continuously develop.

title_en: Intelligent early warning terminal system for self-adaptive adjustment of sensitivity of earthquake sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning terminal system for self-adaptive adjustment of sensitivity of an earthquake sensor, which comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a database module, a data processing module, an early warning module and a data output module, wherein the preprocessing module is used for generating a warning report when an earthquake occurs, the database module is used for judging the dangerous degree of the earthquake and adjusting the sensitivity of the earthquake sensor, the intelligent early warning terminal system is used for acquiring the seismic wave data when the earthquake occurs, analyzing the earthquake magnitude, analyzing and quantifying the dangerous degree of the earthquake according to the earthquake magnitude and the occurrence frequency, and reducing the sensitivity of the earthquake sensor when the earthquake dangerous degree is low and insufficient to cause damage, so that the earthquake sensor is insufficient to accurately detect the occurrence of the earthquake, and meanwhile, canceling warning, shielding the earthquake with lower destructiveness on the premise of ensuring the safety, so as to avoid causing social panic and ensure the social order and the safety.

title_en: Landslide disaster monitoring and early warning method for frozen soil area of Qinghai-Tibet plateau
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster monitoring and early warning method for a Qinghai-Tibet plateau frozen soil area, which relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring and early warning methods and comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source data acquisition, acquisition of regional topography and vegetation coverage data by adopting a satellite remote sensing technology, collection of frozen soil temperature, humidity, displacement, underground water level and meteorological data by utilizing a ground sensor network, S2, data preprocessing, S3, feature extraction, S4, risk assessment, S5, early warning release, S6, dynamic update, and realization of accurate monitoring and timely early warning of landslide disasters in the Qinghai-Tibet plateau frozen soil area by adopting multi-source data acquisition, data preprocessing, feature extraction, risk assessment, early warning release and dynamic update, and reduction of loss caused by landslide disasters.
assignees: QINGHAI METEOROLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CENTER

title_en: Landslide hazard early warning method and device based on rainfall typing, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a landslide disaster early warning method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium based on rainfall typing, which are characterized in that characteristics of grid nodes are obtained by collecting multi-source data such as grid connection meshing processing geology, rainfall events are segmented, morphology and statistical characteristics are extracted, machine learning rainfall typing is carried out based on the characteristics to obtain probability vectors of each rainfall type, then a graph structure integrating space and geological relations is constructed, static and dynamic characteristics of the grid nodes are fused, a space-time characteristic graph is input into a graph neural network, attention weight is regulated by taking the probability vectors as condition signals through learning mapping, landslide probability is calculated and early warning is generated based on updated grid node representation, so that the deep coupling of rainfall typing and graph neural network is realized, the spanning from static threshold value to dynamic characteristic modulation is realized, and early warning accuracy, timeliness and space perception capability are improved.

title_en: Notification system when changing to a departure signal while stopped at an intersection signal
title_ko: 교차로 신호대기 정차 중 출발신호로 변경시 알림시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교차로 신호대기 정차 중 출발신호로 변경시 알려주는 시스템에 관한 것으로서,  
교차로에 설치되어 신호를 주관하는 하는 신호제어기(10)를 기반으로,  
상기 신호제어기(10)와 유·무선으로 연결되어 실시간 신호변경 데이터를 전송받는 구획별 신호정보송출기(20)(20-1 내지 20-n)를 구성하되,  
교차로를 중심으로 각 구획별 신호정보송출기(20)는 해당 구획(G)(G-1 내지 G-n)에 신호 대기로 정지된 차량에 대하여 출발신호(직진, 좌회전)로 변경시 해당 구획(G)에 정차된 차량들로 전파을 발생시기키도록 구성하고,  
차량 내에는 단말기(30)를 구비하여 해당 구획(G)에 신호 대기로 정차 중 해당 구획(G)에 설치된 신호정보송출기(20)에서 전송하는 전파를 수신함에 따른 출발신호바뀜을 알려주도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Building fire-fighting hierarchical intelligence management system and operating method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to building fire-fighting hierarchical intelligence management system, including tier building, signal collection device, signal processing apparatus, intelligent processor and output device, signal collection device connection signal processing apparatus, signal processing apparatus are connected with intelligent processor, intelligent processor is connected with output device, and tier building is equipped with the signal collection device and signal processing apparatus being connected per first floor, and signal collection device includes smoke alarm and temperature detector.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows：Hierarchical analysis and Intelligent treatment have been carried out to fire information, make owner in building, it is different according to the application program to fire information, different early warning are given respectively and escape is advised, be conducive to the fire-fighting security of personnel in building, can in time find the condition of a fire at different levels in building, by the classification and prompting of intelligence, effectively making everyone has comprehensive, clear and definite understanding to the fire information in building, eliminates uneasy mood, improves fire attack and personal security is withdrawn.
assignees: DEZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Subway station accident emergency evacuation is saved oneself command system
abstract_en: Saved oneself command system the invention provides a kind of subway station accident emergency evacuation, including：Intelligent accident monitor controller, internet centre control terminal, intelligent alarm system, emergency evacuation instruction system, evacuating personnel are saved oneself mobile terminal；Each passage, the Monitoring Data of platform in intelligent accident monitor controller acquisition subway station, and it is sent to internet centre control terminal；Net center control terminal determines time, place, situation and the safe escape path that accident occurs by Monitoring Data, and is sent to evacuating personnel and saves oneself mobile terminal, and sends to intelligent alarm system and emergency evacuation instruction system and start configured information；Evacuating personnel mobile terminal of saving oneself receives the safe escape path that internet centre control terminal is sent, and reminds personnel to withdraw according to the safe escape Path language.System in the present invention can find the accident of subway station in time, and life automatically generates the scheme of withdrawing, and at utmost reduce the casualty rate that accident triggers.

title_en: Hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain, torrential flood and flood in small watershed of mountainous area
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain and torrential flood in small watershed of mountainous area, which divides actual measurement flood and flood simulated by adopting a hydrological model into an initial rising section, a steep rising section, a disaster forming section and a water withdrawal section, screens the hydrological model by comparing the calculation results of the hydrological model to the steep rising section and the disaster forming section with the actual measurement flood, fully considers the early catching capacity of the hydrological model to some key disaster early warning moments of the steep rising section, can catch the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster causing moment in advance, can avoid leakage of police, improves the accuracy and reliability of the early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster in small watershed of mountainous area, and can provide more scientific guidance and technical support for the forecasting and early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster in small watershed of mountainous area.

title_en: Real-time status notification of response personnel actions to building owners/operators
abstract_en: Described herein are devices, systems, and methods for real-time status notification of central station actions to building owners/operators. A system comprising: building owner/operator communication devices; an alarm system at the building, the alarm system having a control panel component and one or more alarm system equipment components; a central monitoring station configured to execute executable instructions to: receiving an event alert signal from an alert system component; transmitting a response request signal to a response facility; receiving a response request signal reply indicating that a responding facility person will respond to the building; receiving event response update data from the responding facility personnel via the responding personnel communications devices; and sending the event response update message to the building owner/operator communication device.

title_en: Dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and dynamic early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and dynamic early warning system, which particularly relates to the technical field of industrial safety monitoring, and is used for solving the monitoring failure problem caused by signal interference or cancellation in a mixed leakage scene of various dangerous chemicals in the prior art, acquiring multisource monitoring data such as gas concentration and temperature in real time through a data acquisition module, detecting reverse fluctuation characteristics of sensor data by a conflict recognition module, reversely positioning a leakage source and verifying path shielding interference by a leakage verification module based on production pipe network topology and real-time flow data, analyzing signal cancellation characteristics of a dangerous chemical combination and verifying matching performance of a diffusion path and sensor layout by a materialization analysis module after physical shielding is eliminated, dynamically correcting the monitoring data by a dynamic compensation module according to a materialization reaction mechanism, generating a mixed leakage risk level and triggering a grading emergency response instruction by a risk assessment module, and realizing accurate recognition and dynamic early warning of the mixed leakage risk.

title_en: Fracturing construction monitoring and early warning system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and intelligent early warning of fracturing engineering, in particular to a fracturing construction monitoring and early warning system and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initializing equivalent system resistance and flow state correction index; the method comprises the steps of constructing a reference physical model, calculating a theoretical pressure value, calculating a deviation index, triggering inversion of a geological state in response to the deviation index being larger than a preset dynamic judgment threshold, returning to execute the step of collecting the current real-time pressure value and the current real-time discharge value of the high-pressure grouting pump in real time in response to the deviation index being smaller than or equal to the dynamic judgment threshold, reversely solving to obtain updated equivalent system resistance, calculating to obtain a risk index, generating a grading early warning and decision instruction, and updating the initialized equivalent system resistance in the reference physical model to the updated equivalent system resistance in response to confirmation of an early warning event.
assignees: DONGYING HUAXING OIL & GAS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel disaster prevention system
