abstract_en: To make it possible to adequately determine a situation of insulation deterioration by continuing measurement and recording of line current without being disturbed by warning of current value abnormality even when the warning of current value abnormality is obtained via periodical measurement of current of a signal line to which a terminal apparatus is connected.SOLUTION: A tunnel disaster prevention system performs monitoring by connecting a terminal apparatus including a notification device and detector 16, 18 to a signal line drawn out from a disaster prevention reception board 10 into a tunnel. The disaster prevention reception board 10 includes line current monitoring means 72 for measuring and recording, in each predetermined period, a value of current flowing through the signal line to which the terminal apparatus is connected, determining current value abnormality and originating warning before notifying an external remote supervisory control facility 27 of the current value abnormality to make the facility originate warning when the measured value of current is equal to or larger than a predetermined threshold or exceeds the threshold, and canceling the current value abnormality before resuming current value measurement in each predetermined period when recovery operation by the disaster prevention reception board 10 or the remote supervisory control facility 27 is detected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: User treminal for interwoking with gateway installed in a vehicle and and method for guiding a change of traffic signal using smartphone application
title_ko: 차량 내에 설치된 게이트웨이와 연동하는 사용자 단말 및 스마트 폰 애플리케이션을 이용한 교통 신호 변경 안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for notification of a change in a traffic signal by using a smartphone application, which notify a change in a traffic signal to a driver via a user terminal, such as a smartphone, operating in conjunction with a wired or wireless gateway by using the Wi-Fi wired or wireless gateway without installing an additional device in a vehicle in the case of a low-cost vehicle in which an AVN is not installed. The user terminal comprises: a wireless communication module which receives image information, in which a traffic signal is photographed, from a gateway installed in a vehicle via short-distance wireless communication; an image processing unit which receives the image information from the wireless communication module, detects a pattern indicating the traffic signal from the image information by using an image processing algorithm, and recognizes a change in color of the detected pattern; a control unit which determines a change in the traffic signal based on a result of the recognition of the image processing unit; and an output unit which outputs an alarm notifying the change of the traffic signal, based on a result of the determination of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 차량의 게이트웨이와 연동하는 사용자 단말이 개시된다. 이 사용자 단말은, 차량에 설치된 게이트웨이로부터 교통 신호등을 촬영한 영상 정보를 근거리 무선 통신으로 수신하는 무선 통신 모듈과, 상기 무선 통신 모듈로부터 상기 영상 정보를 전달받고, 영상 처리 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 영상 정보로부터 상기 교통 신호등을 나타내는 패턴을 검출하고, 검출된 패턴에 대한 색 변화를 인식하는 영상 처리부와, 상기 영상 처리부의 인식 결과에 따라 교통 신호의 변경을 판단하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부의 판단 결과에 따라 상기 교통 신호의 변경을 알리는 경보를 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Remote fire monitoring system using energy harvesting
title_ko: 에너지 하베스팅을 이용한 원격 화재감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a stable, fast and economical in terms of maintenance costs energy harvesting remote fire monitoring system and a method thereof. The remote fire monitoring system includes a smoke detection sensor, a heat detection sensor, an infrared heat detector, a fire alarm device, a CCTV, a microphone, a speaker, an emergency lighting, a warning lighting; a controller; a central control device; and a mobile device. In addition, the remote fire monitoring method comprises: a step of disposing a remote fire monitoring system (S1); a step of detecting the fire (S2); a step of detecting a fire location (S3); a step of transmitting a video photographed in the CCTV (S4); a step of delegating the determination on whether to extinguish the fire (S5); a step of releasing the fire alarm of a corresponding area, when the fire is extinguished (S6); a step of reporting the fire of the corresponding area, when the fire is not extinguished (S7); and a step of transmitting and notifying a fire report fact (S8).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 센서체계를 중첩적으로 구비할 뿐만 아니라, 센서체계의 전력을 상시전원 뿐만 아니라, 에너지 하베스팅방식으로 전환하고, 시스템을 이루는 구성요소간 통신형태를 근거리무선통신방식으로 구축하여, 안정적이고, 신속하면서, 유지비용면에서도 경제적인 에너지 하베스팅 원격 화재감시 시스템 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 에너지 하베스팅을 이용한 원격 화재감시 시스템은 사전에 미리 설정된 기준치 이상의 연기농도를 감지하면 연기감지신호를 출력하는 연기감지센서; 주간에 작동하고, 사전에 미리 설정된 기준치 이상의 열을 감지하면 열감지신호를 출력하는 열감지센서; 야간에 작동하고, 사전에 미리 설정된 기준치 이상의 온도를 감지하면 적외선열감지신호를 출력하는 적외선열감지기; 상기 연기감지센서와 상기 열감지센서와 적외선열감지기 중 어느 하나로부터 연기감지신호 또는 열감지신호 또는 적외선열감지신호를 수신하면 화재가 발생된 것으로 판단하여 내부에 설치된 벨을 울리며 외부로 화재경보 신호를 출력하는 화재경보기; 제어신호를 수신하면 활성화되고, 소정의 건물 내부 또는 외부에 설치되어 사전에 미리 할당된 구역의 영상을 촬영하여 촬영된 동영상 또는 이미지를 사전에 미리 설정된 목적지로 전달하는 CCTV; 제어신호를 수신하면 활성화되고, 소정의 건물 내부 또는 외부에 설치되어 사전에 미리 할당된 범위의 지역으로 사용자의 실시간 음성을 출력하거나 사전에 미리 녹음된 음성데이터를 출력하는 마이크, 스피커; 제어신호를 수신하면 활성화되고, 소정의 건물 내부 또는 외부에 설치되어 사전에 미리 할당된 범위의 지역으로 경보를 위한 조명을 출력하는 비상조명, 경광등; 일정 범위의 구역을 담당하여, 일정 범위의 구역 내에 하나씩 설치된 상기 화재경보기로부터 화재경보 신호를 수신하면 상기 CCTV, 상기 마이크, 스피커, 상기 비상조명, 경광등으로 제어신호를 송신하여 해당 구성요소를 활성화시키고, 이러한 상황을 외부로 출력하는 컨트롤러; 상기 컨트롤러로부터 화재상황에 대한 데이터를 수신하면, 이를 내부에 저장하고, 모니터를 통해서 이를 디스플레이하며, 해당 지역의 관리자에게 상기 CCTV에 대한 열람권한을 부여하고, 해당 지역의 관리자의 모바일기기로 화재발생을 통지하는 중앙통제장치; 상기 중앙통제장치로부터 열람권한부여 및 화재발생통지에 대한 데이터를 수신하면 사용자가 담당하는 특정 지역의 상기 CCTV에 대한 동영상 또는 이미지를 디스플레이하는 앱이 설치된 모바일기기로 구성되고; 상기 연기감지센서, 상기 열감지센서, 상기 화재경보기는 각각 에너지 하베스팅모듈, 커패시터모듈, 무선통신모듈과 함께 기능단말을 이루는 구성이고, 상기 에너지 하베스팅모듈로부터 공급된 전력으로 구동됨을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 에너지 하베스팅을 이용한 원격 화재감시 방법은 원격 화재감시 시스템이 배치되는 단계(S1); 원격 화재감시 시스템의 센서들에 의해서 화재가 감지되는 단계(S2); 화재경보기에 의해서 화재를 경보하고, 중앙통제장치에 의해서 화재위치를 검출하는 단계(S3); 상기 화재위치를 관리하는 관리자의 모바일기기에게 해당 CCTV에 대한 열람권한을 부여하고, 해당 CCTV에서 촬영된 동영상을 전송하는 단계(S4); 상기 관리자의 모바일기기로부터 화재진압여부를 입력받아서 상기 중앙통제장치가 상기 관리자의 모바일기기로 화재진압여부에 대한 판단을 위임하는 단계(S5); 상기 관리자의 모바일기기로부터 상기 중앙통제장치로 화재진압여부가 "예"라면 해당 구역의 화재경보를 해제하는 단계(S6); 상기 관리자의 모바일기기로부터 상기 중앙통제장치로 화재진압여부가 "아니오"라면 해당 구역의 화재사실을 해당 주소와 해당 관리자연락처를 소방본부서버로 전송하여 화재를 신고하는 단계(S7); 상기 관리자의 모바일기기로 화재신고사실을 전송하여 통지하는 단계(S8)로 이루어짐을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Come down emergency escape device
abstract_en: Come down emergency escape device, it is related to civil engineering geo-hazard early-warning technical field, including power supply, switch, normally indicate green light, early warning instruction red light, early warning loudspeaker, obliquity sensor, it is easy to happen the region of landslide hazard in massif, slopes, it will be moved towards along mountain shape, slopes trend is vertically arranged multiple holes, the pre-buried obliquity sensor in hole, the variation of slopes angle is monitored using obliquity sensor, slopes angle change causes early warning circuit to be closed, start alarm activation, police instruction blinking red lamp, alarming horn report early warning sound.Not only at low cost the present invention is based on the emergency escape device on landslide, high sensitivity, monitoring are accurate, the accuracy of early warning is ensure that, but also very useful, when landslide occurs, it can quickly send out and withdraw information, people is promoted quickly to withdraw, to reduce casualties and property loss.
assignees: HANGZHOU LINPING VOCATIONAL SENIOR MIDDLE SCHOOL

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane management-control method, device, system and readable storage medium storing program for executing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned plane management-control methods, method includes the following steps: by having detected whether that UAV targets enter predeterminable area in time, the UAV targets for entering predeterminable area are identified, and judge whether UAV targets are registered unmanned plane according to recognition result, when being determined as registered unmanned plane, warning information is sent to UAV targets, prompt UAV targets withdraw predeterminable area, when being determined as unregistered unmanned plane, according to the location information of UAV targets, counter instruction is sent to corresponding target sub-command post, it is disposed using target sub-command post by predetermined manner.Using technical solution provided by the embodiment of the present invention, a large amount of investments application of unmanned plane is efficiently solved to work bring new challenges such as secrecy, security protection and anti-terrorisms, effective control to unmanned plane is realized, ensure that public safety.The invention also discloses a kind of unmanned plane control device, equipment and storage mediums, have relevant art effect.
assignees: CETC DEYANG SPECIAL MISSION AIRCRAFT SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering. And after big data fusion is carried out on the heterogeneous data, the heterogeneous data is stored in a landslide geological disaster sample library, so that the data of the sample library is updated, and the aim of improving the landslide geological disaster monitoring and early warning data quality is fulfilled. According to the method, the timeliness of large-data acquisition of landslide disaster points is improved, the problem that the existing geological disaster reporting site is not accurate enough is solved, the accuracy of obtaining the topographic data of the disaster point area is improved, and large-area and low-cost calculation processing of the surface deformation data of the disaster point area is realized.

title_en: Automatic emergency disposal system for civil gas explosion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic emergency disposal system for civil gas explosion, which comprises: the system comprises a control processor, a gas concentration sensor, a full-house power-off device, an exhaust ventilation device, an inert gas injection device, an audible and visual word alarm notification device, an automatic door and window closing device and a data analysis transmission module; the gas concentration sensor is used for detecting the concentration of fuel gas, oxygen and inert gas, and the full house power-off device, the exhaust ventilation device and the inert gas injection device are controlled to be opened and closed by the control processor; the audible and visual word alarm notification device is used for sending an alarm signal when the concentration of the fuel gas is abnormal; the automatic door and window closing device is arranged on the user door body and the window body; the data analysis transmission module is used for uploading accident emergency treatment data, and sending the danger alarm signal and the treatment condition to the mobile phone of the user and keeping the information updated.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data fusion side slope digital twin modeling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope digital twin modeling method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining slope multidimensional monitoring data through laying GNSS sensors, multipoint displacement meters, distributed optical fiber strain sensors, accelerometers, osmometers, monocular cameras and satellite remote sensing image equipment, converting the collected data into a unified format through time alignment, spatial registration and standardization processing to be used as modeling input, constructing an initial digital twin model reflecting the real form and physical characteristics of a slope by utilizing a three-dimensional modeling and finite element simulation technology, dynamically driving model evolution based on a space-time fusion algorithm by combining real-time perception data, automatically correcting boundary conditions and material parameters through actual measurement deviation feedback, realizing continuous twin iteration update of the model, finally extracting landslide risk indexes, and realizing real-time early warning of the slope. The invention realizes the integration of multisource perception and digital twin, and improves the accuracy, the instantaneity and the intelligent level of the monitoring of the side slope.

title_en: Controllable hammer source device suitable for advanced geological prediction by seismic wave method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of advanced geological forecast and early warning of engineering geology, in particular to a controllable hammering vibration source device suitable for advanced geological forecast by a seismic wave method, which comprises a reinforcement cage shield, wherein the upper end of the reinforcement cage shield is connected with a shell, a spring retraction sensor is arranged in the reinforcement cage shield and comprises a hammering metal block and a compression spring, the top of the hammering metal block is provided with a groove, the hammering switch is fixedly embedded in the groove, and the two ends of the compression spring are respectively connected with the shell and the lower end of the hammering metal block; an integrated circuit board and a plurality of stress control buttons which are respectively and electrically connected with the integrated circuit board are arranged in the shell, and the spring retraction sensor is electrically connected with the integrated circuit board. The invention can control the frequency of the earthquake waves released by the earthquake source to be more approximate, improves the precision and reliability of data acquisition, and is safer, more stable and more efficient compared with a wheel hammer and explosive discharge.
assignees: STATE KEY LABORATORY SHIELD MACHINE & BORING TECH;China railway tunnel group co ltd

title_en: Financial risk assessment method based on financial statement data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of financial management, in particular to a financial risk assessment method based on financial statement data, which comprises the steps of obtaining mobile cash flow data and liability data, and calculating to obtain a mobile cash shortage risk warning value; generating a mobile cash shortage risk signal according to the mobile cash shortage risk warning value; the method comprises the steps of obtaining data of the non-collected money, calculating to obtain a bad account risk index, generating a bad account hidden danger signal according to the bad account risk index, obtaining an initial existing residual value and a high-risk withdrawal amount, calculating to obtain a curvature fluctuation value, generating an influence intensity signal according to the curvature fluctuation value, calculating to obtain an initial existing residual minimum value according to the high-risk withdrawal amount, and generating a financial crisis risk signal according to the initial existing residual value.

title_en: Three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system based on autonomous control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring, in particular to an autonomous controllable three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous geological, hydrologic and construction data, fusing and obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological-construction coupling digital twin model after alignment coding, conducting water gushing evolution rolling prediction through multi-scale physical-AI mixed modeling and correcting real-time data, outputting prediction data, constructing a three-dimensional visual platform, starting multi-level linkage early warning based on a risk threshold, and enabling the system to comprise a data fusion module, a water gushing evolution rolling prediction module and a multi-level linkage early warning module, and meet the requirements of rapid early warning and timely decision making of water gushing disasters in the tunnel construction process by combining three-dimensional visual rendering and deep learning fluid simulation technology through fusion of geological data, hydrologic monitoring data and construction parameters.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CHANGJIANG TRANSP DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING HIGH SPEED RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION WANKAIDA EXPRESSWAY CO LTD

title_en: A real-time emergency medical information system using the rfid
title_ko: 무선주파수인식기술을 이용한 실시간 응급 의료 정보시스템
abstract_en: A real time emergent medical information system using RFID technology is provided to provide rapidly information on preparation for emergency, to standardize behavior guide for the first aid medical members, and to provide real time information on the first aid for establishing an emergency countermeasure system. A real time emergent medical information system using RFID technology comprises an RFID tag(10), an RFID reader(20), a system(30) in an ambulance car, systems(50-1-50-n) in a hospital, and a u-health center server(100). The RFID tag(10) has basic information on a patient in a field stage. The RFID reader(20) reads information from the RFID tag(10) adhered to the patient. The system(30) in an ambulance car makes Bluetooth communication with the RFID reader(20) for synchronizing with it. The systems(50-1-50-n) in a hospital notify an emergency control center and u-health center server that the patient arrives at the hospital, provide the basic information on the patient or information inputted or measured by an emergency rescue squad, and display information on the past disease history and the current medication. The u-health center server(100) manages all the information of an emergent medical information system by using the RFID.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선주파수인식기술(RFID : Radio Frequency Identification)을 이용한 실시간 응급 의료정보 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 공공의료부문에서 만성질환자, 고위험 환자들을 대상으로 응급 상황 발생시의 병원으로 이송 중의 RFID를 이용한 실시간 의료 정보를 제공하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     또한, 상기 RFID를 이용한 실시간 응급 의료 정보 제공 시스템에 기한 실시간 응급 의료 서비스를 제공하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 RFID를 이용한 실시간 의료 정보를 제공하는 시스템은, 응급 의료 서비스용으로서 환자 개인의 최소한의 정보와 환자 식별 정보만을 저장한 환자의 RFID 태그와; 상기 환자의 RFID 태그로부터 정보를 RFID를 이용하여 읽는 휴대형 RFID 리더와; 상기 환자의 정보를 읽는 휴대형 RFID 리더와 블루투스 통신을 이용하여 환자 확인 및 환자 정보 관리를 위한 동기화를 하고, 환자의 이송 중에는 목적지 병원의 설정과 상기 설정된 목적지 병원 ID를 U-헬스케어 센터 정보 시스템에 송신하고, 상기 응급구조사가 측정한 환자의 생체 징후와 상기 응급구조사가 파악한 주증상을 입력할 수 있는 인터페이스를 갖추고 있고, 상기 응급구조사가 응급처치하여야 할 방법의 표시와 응급처치한 내용을 저장하고, 상기 입력한 환자의 생체 징후와 주증상과 응급처치한 내용, 환자의 RFID 태그 ID와 구급차 들것 태그 ID, 구급차의 출발시간 등을 무선인터넷망을 이용하여 U-헬스케어 센터 정보 시스템에 제공하고, 상기 입력한 환자의 생체 징후와 주증상과 응급처치한 내용, 환자 의 RFID 태그 ID와 구급차 들것 태그 ID는 로컬 정보 시스템에 제공하는 송수신부를 갖춘 구급차 내의 시스템과; 상기 응급 환자가 병원에 도착하여 응급실 게이트를 통과할 때 구급차 들것의 태그 ID로부터 도착을 확인하는 병원 입구의 RFID 리더와 병원의 응급관제 센터에 상기 응급 환자의 도착을 알리고 U-헬스케어 센터 정보 시스템에도 전송하는 로컬 정보 시스템과 상기 응급실 내에서 응급실 담당 의사의 진료시에 있어서 로컬 정보 시스템에 저장되어 있는 환자의 기본 정보와 응급구조사가 측정하고 파악한 생체 징후, 주증상 및 응급처치 내용 등을 입력한 정보를 참조하도록 보여주고, 기존의 병원 정보 시스템의 데이터 베이스에 있는 환자의 과거 병력과 투약 약물 등의 정보를 보여주는 응급실용 단말기를 갖춘 병원 내의 시스템과; 상기 응급 환자의 기본 정보와 관련된 정보를 구급차 내의 시스템으로부터 수신하여 저장하고, 목적지 병원의 설정에 필요한 병원 정보를 구급차 내의 시스템에 제공하고, 상기 병원 입구의 RFID 리더로부터 환자의 도착의 알림을 제공받고, 상기 응급실에서 진료시에 참조하도록 하기 위하여 필요한 환자에 대한 상세 정보를 응급실용 단말기에 보여주도록 로컬 정보 시스템에 제공하고, 신규회원에 대한 정보 등록과 신규 대상자용 RFID 태그를 발급하고, 퇴원하는 환자에게는 환자의 RFID 태그의 정보를 갱신하여 발급하는 U-헬스케어 센터 정보 시스템의 서버;를 포함하도록 구성한다.  
     이와 같이 구성한 본 발명에 따른 RFID를 이용한 실시간 응급 의료 정보 시스템은 응급대응체계 확립으로 신속한 응급 대응 정보 제공과 응급 처치요원의 행동지침 표준화 및 실시간 응급 처치 정보 제공의 효과가 있다.  
     또한, 상기와 같이 이루어지는 본 발명의 RFID를 이용한 실시간 응급 의료 정보 시스템은 응급상황 판단 정보 제공과 정확한 환자 정보에 의한 응급대응 및 병원 도착 후 응급처치 시간 단축으로 응급 상황 대처 능력의 재고 및 신속, 정확한 의료체계의 확립의 효과가 있다. 
     또한, 응급 처치의 효용성 증대 및 RFID를 이용한 실시간 정보의 제공으로 환자 수송의 효율화를 이룰 수 있다.     
       
     RFID, 태그, 리더, 센서, 응급의료, 실시간, U-헬스케어.
assignees: OH HAE SEOK;GIL MEDICAL CT;UNIV GACHON MEDICINE

title_en: safety home using a location-based service applications
title_ko: 위치기반 서비스를 이용한 안심귀가 어플리케이션
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety home return application using a location-based service, capable of solving problems, caused when there is not any solution to a danger signal delivery button malfunctioning in case of an emergency, by reporting the emergency to a desired contact through a wrong route display function even without pressing an emergency reporting button. According to the present invention, the safety home return application includes: an address book setting button formed as an UI button to set contacts to report an emergency; a service on/off button formed as an UI button to start and terminate the service; a route changing button formed as a UI button to change a route as a user wants; a home button formed as a physical button to send a danger signal by being consecutively pressed; a destination setting function formed by a touch to set a destination; a route mark formed on a map to indicate a red route on the map; a wrong route mark formed on the map and generated to deliver a dangerous situation and a current position to the address book in case of entering a wrong route; a departure setting function formed by a touch to set a desired departure spot; and a GPS display window located on the top of the screen to check whether GPS is on/off. As such, the present invention is capable of solving problems, caused when there is not any solution to a danger signal delivery button malfunctioning in case of an emergency, by reporting the emergency to a desired contact through a wrong route display function even without pressing an emergency reporting button.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위치기반 서비스를 이용한 안심귀가 어플리케이션에 관한 것으로서 경로 이탈 표시기능을 통하여 경로가 이탈 되었을 경우 긴급 알림 버튼을 누르지 않아도 원하는 연락처로 긴급 상황을 전달 할 수 있게 하도록 함으로써 기존의 위험 신호 전달 버튼이 눌러지지 않는다면 위급시 대처 방법이 없는  문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 안심귀가 서비스 어플리케이션에 있어서 위험 상황 발생시 알림을 해줄 대상들의 연락처를 설정할 수 있게 UI 버튼으로 형성한 주소록 설정 버튼, 서비스를 시작 종료 할 수 있게 UI 버튼으로 형성한 서비스 on/off 버튼, 경로를 원하는대로 변경 할 수 있게 UI 버튼으로 형성한 경로변경 버튼, 연속으로 홈버튼을 눌러 위험 신호를 보낼 수 있게 물리 버튼으로 형성한 홈 버튼, 도착지를 설정 할 수 있게 터치를 통해 형성한 도착지 설정 기능, 지도상에 붉은색을 경로를 표시할 수 있게 지도위에 형성한 경로 표시, 경로 이탈시 저장된 주소록으로 현재 위치와 위험 상황을 전달할 수 있게 이탈시 생성, 지도위에 형성한 경로 이탈 표시, 원하는 출발지를 설정할 수 있게 터치를 통해 형성한 출발지 설정 기능, GPS가 on/off인지 확인 할 수 있게 화면 최상단에 위치한 GPS 표시창으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 경로 이탈 표시기능을 통하여 경로가 이탈 되었을 경우 긴급 알림 버튼을 누르지 않아도 원하는 연락처로 긴급 상황을 전달 할 수 있게 하도록 함으로써 기존의 위험 신호 전달 버튼이 눌러지지 않는다면 위급시 대처 방법이 없는  문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Training method of magnitude estimation model, magnitude estimation method and magnitude estimation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake prediction and early warning, in particular to a training method of a magnitude estimation model, a magnitude estimation method and a magnitude estimation model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a sample set, wherein the sample set comprises seismic signals and real results corresponding to the seismic signals; obtaining a prediction result through a magnitude estimation model based on the sample set; calculating an error between the predicted result and the real result, and calculating an error gradient, wherein the error gradient is calculated by using a back propagation algorithm; and (3) building a weight optimizer based on an Adam algorithm to update the weight, wherein the weight is updated, the weight learning rate and the regularization parameter given by the magnitude estimation model are set based on the negative direction of gradient descent, and the weight of the model is updated. The seismic level estimation system has better precision, wider application range and stronger robustness by combining the Transformer with the ResNet and RNN structures and adopting the arrival time and travel time information as a means for data enhancement.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system of petroleum development platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil platform monitoring, in particular to an intelligent monitoring system of an oil development platform, which comprises a well platform external environment monitoring, a well platform internal environment monitoring and platform construction; the monitoring of the external environment of the well platform comprises the real-time monitoring of the natural environment conditions around the offshore oil development platform; the monitoring of the internal environment of the well platform comprises the steps of collecting and analyzing various indexes in the petroleum well platform; the platform construction is based on a three-layer structure design and comprises a sensing layer, a transmission layer and an application layer, wherein the sensing layer collects environmental data of ocean and well stations through the Internet of things technology; the transmission layer utilizes satellite technology to rapidly transmit data, so that real-time update of information is ensured; and the application layer processes the received data, realizes data fusion and visualization, and establishes an intelligent monitoring and early warning unit. The invention effectively reduces the safety accident risk caused by environmental factors and internal faults.

title_en: AIoT anomaly identification method, disaster early warning system and road safety system
abstract_en: The invention discloses AIoT anomaly identification method, disaster early warning system and road safety system, wherein the identification method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a double-network feature extractor, S2, acquiring a data set; s3, training and optimizing a double-network feature extractor to obtain an identification model; s4, acquiring data to be identified; s5, identifying multi-category abnormal events to obtain an identification result; the disaster early warning system comprises a sensor computing unit and a base station edge computing unit; the road safety system comprises a road side calculation unit and a vehicle-mounted calculation unit; the complex abnormal mode and the characteristics in the intelligent Internet of things environment can be accurately recognized through the double-network characteristic extractor; the weight update of the local and global features is realized through parallelization of the parallel knowledge migration framework based on the local and global features, and the recognition precision and generalization capability of the overall model are improved; the method is tightly combined with the field of real disaster emergency and road safety, and practical problems of disaster early warning and road safety early warning are practically solved.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA;CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD SICHUAN BRANCH;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting automatic fire alarm device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm devices, in particular to an intelligent automatic fire alarm device for fire protection and a use method thereof, comprising a mounting seat, wherein smoke sensors are fixedly arranged on two sides of the mounting seat, a communication module is fixedly arranged in the mounting seat, a connecting cavity is formed in the upper end of the mounting seat, the upper end of the connecting cavity is fixedly connected with a plastic sheet, and a T-shaped connecting seat is internally connected in the connecting cavity; the control pulls the mechanism and starts behind detecting smog through smoke transducer, and first baffle removes to cancel the blocking to the air guide chamber, and the gas in the carbon dioxide gas pitcher enters into the connection intracavity to promote the upward movement of T type connecting seat, make LED alarm lamp warning speaker and camera stretch into in the external environment and start, prevent lighting device's light by mud or dust blocking, can ' T illuminate around the alarm device, and the speaker in the alarm device probably can be because of dust or the adhesion of mud, and can ' T carry out the condition emergence of normal work.

title_en: Deep Learning-based Hazardous Situation Object/Event Information Detection Method with Cameras Applied to EV Charger
title_ko: Ev 충전기에 적용되는 카메라를 활용한 딥러닝 기반의 위험 상황 객체/이벤트 정보 검출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting dangerous situation object/event information based on deep learning using cameras applied to an EV charger. The method for detecting dangerous situation object/event information based on deep learning, according to the present invention, comprises the steps of: detecting one or more objects around an EV charger; transmitting the objects to a control server; measuring the size of the objects; extracting an object having a certain size or larger; determining whether the object corresponds to a dangerous situation that has occurred around the EV charger; transmitting a certain warning signal when the object is determined to correspond to the dangerous situation; and outputting text information or sound information corresponding to the warning signal. According to the present invention, valid events occurring around the EV charger can be focused.

title_en: Nuclear power plant's security against fire monitoring and managing method and system
abstract_en: A kind of nuclear power plant's security against fire monitoring and managing method and system, method include that the possibility for needing to carry out in each region is introduced into the field operation of fire risk to carry out real-time update in dynamic fire fighting database；And for each of dynamic fire fighting database region, risk assessment is individually carried out to each single item field operation that may introduce fire risk, superposed risk between assessing while being under the jurisdiction of the multinomial field operation of the same area, individually carried out based on every field operation risk assessment result and the superposed risk, assess the cumulative risk in each region in real time.Fire fighting database and live traffic are associated by the present invention, form dynamic database in real time, plant personnel is facilitated easily to inquire；Assessment risk in real time, it is also contemplated that the superposed risk between while multinomial field operation；Further, visualization Risk-warning and Precaution Tactics are provided for approving person；By the risk assessment criterion of different dimensions, the fire-fighting risk status in each region of power plant is provided.
assignees: SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST;DAYA BAY NUCLEAR POWER OPS;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of library bank falling zone landslip array early warning system
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of library bank falling zone landslip array early warning system, the array of a 3*3 specification including tilt alarm composition, each tilt alarm passes through conducting wire respectively and connect with a total control device；Tilt alarm includes shell, and power supply unit and monitoring device interconnected are from top to bottom successively arranged in shell, and shell lower end is connected with fixed part.The application array early warning system, when reservoir level is minimum, when namely falling zone is in maximum exposing area, it may be arranged at the library bank falling zone region of landslide or avalanche danger, once soil body run-off the straight or displacement, photo resistance will because inclination caused by illuminance change due to change, micro-current electric signal receiver will communicate information to processing module at this time, after processing identification warning information will be issued by transmitting module, it helps resident to withdraw in time and water reservoir management personnel is notified to be disposed, avoids the loss of lives and properties.

title_en: Intelligent door and window assembly with built-in child early warning device
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent door and window assembly with a built-in child early warning device, relates to the technical field of doors and windows, and solves the problems that a child is easy to open the intelligent door and window assembly to cause a safety accident, the child cannot be opened through structural improvement on one hand, and automatic warning and alarming prompt when the child touches the intelligent door and window assembly on the other hand cannot be realized. A smart door and window assembly with a built-in child early warning device comprises a frame body; the window body A and the window body B are connected to the frame body in a sliding mode, a fixing structure is fixedly connected to the window body B through bolts, and an alarm structure is further mounted on the window body B. The installation seat B is provided with a contact switch, and the contact switch is electrically connected with an alarm arranged in the window body B; when the handle rotates 90 degrees, the head end of the handle is in elastic contact with the contact switch, the contact switch is in a retraction state of offsetting backwards by 0.5cm at the moment, and the contact switch is in a switch-on state at the moment, so that extrusion type alarming is realized.

title_en: TDMA time slot allocation method for underground and underwater wireless Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-overhead TDMA time slot allocation method for underground and underwater wireless Internet of things, which mainly solves the problems of overlong time of time slot allocation process and larger allocation overhead in the underground severe environment in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: constructing an underground Internet of things network model, and establishing a self time slot table, a one-hop node table and a two-hop node table on the same layer by the sensor node to finish initialization of each table item; all nodes update own hop count information through interaction of time slot frames, establish a network layered structure and complete updating of related table items; the sensor node selects the time slot group to which the sensor node belongs according to the hop value, the first layer node designates the sending time slot uniformly by the data sink node, the sensor node does not participate in the time slot allocation process, and other layer nodes send time slot frames mutually to negotiate to apply for the sending time slot. The method improves the transmission reliability of the underground wireless internet of things, reduces the additional communication overhead and reduces the network energy consumption, and can be used for underground environment monitoring, pipeline facility monitoring and disaster early warning.

title_en: 30-60-Minute emergency evacuation scheme for influencing fire potential based on weather change
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety early warning, and discloses a 30-60-minute emergency evacuation scheme for influencing fire potential based on weather change, wherein early warning trigger logic is constructed based on weather mutation, a response level is dynamically regulated and controlled, and minute-level evacuation strategy linkage update is realized. According to the emergency evacuation scheme, by constructing the high-sensitivity index library of wind speed jump, humidity dip, lightning strike ignition and the like and combining microscale weather evolution trend and on-site situation data, the emergency evacuation scheme can quickly enter a forced response state 30-60 minutes before the wild fire is rapidly expanded, and the effectiveness and timeliness of evacuation decisions are obviously improved.

title_en: System and Method for Measuring and Monitoring Seismic data Applied to the City Building
title_ko: 도시건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a city building capable of preventing false detection and false alarm, and quickly inspecting effectiveness of an occurred event and rapidity of seismic event detection for construction of an earthquake quickly warning system for earthquake disaster alleviation of a city building. Moreover, the system for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a city building comprises: multiple seismic data measuring systems located at a distance different from an object to be monitored, and for performing pre-detector of an earthquake event by having a GPS receive module and an earthquake acceleration sensor; and an earthquake monitoring system for re-forming a noise-removed and single stacked data by visual-synchronization processing data transmitted from the multiple seismic data, and for finally determining whether of occurrence of an earthquake event by utilizing the pre-detected result and post-process detected result of an earthquake event in each of seismic data measuring systems by post-process detecting in order to check whether of occurrence of an earthquake event.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시건축물의 지진재해경감을 위한 지진신속경보체계 구축을 위하여 지진 이벤트 감지의 신속성 및 발생 이벤트의 유효성을 빠르게 검사하고 오검출 및 오경보를 방지할 수 있도록 한 도시건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시 대상물과 서로 다른 거리에 위치하고, GPS 수신모듈과 지진가속도센서를 포함하고 지진이벤트의 사전 검출을 수행하는 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들;상기 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들로부터 전송된 데이터를 시각 동기화 처리하여 잡음제거 및 단일 중합데이터로 재구성하고, 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하기 위해 후처리 검출을 하여 각각의 지진 데이터 측정시스템에서의 지진이벤트 사전검출 결과와 후처리 검출결과를 활용하여 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 최종 판별하는 지진 감시시스템;을 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Method for alarming according to positioning information of GPS navigation system and mobile terminal
abstract_en: A method and mobile terminal for alarming according to positioning information of a GPS navigation system, the method comprises the following steps: creating an alarm template with text attributes and storing the alarm template in the mobile terminal, wherein the content of the alarm template comprises fixed content and dynamic content; after receiving an emergency call dialing instruction, starting a GPS navigation system built in the mobile terminal to acquire current position information; collecting event information input by a user through voice, and storing the event information as a record; converting the alarm template into alarm voice, replacing the position mark in the dynamic content with current position information in the conversion process, and replacing the event mark with event information recording; and transmitting the updated alarm voice to the called terminal. The invention can quickly send alarm signals, has less information required to be input by a user so as to avoid causing the alert of criminals as much as possible, has the characteristics of concealment, rapidness, safety and accuracy, and avoids delaying rescue due to unclear alarm information provided in emergency.

title_en: Locomotive axle temperature detects warning device circuit
abstract_en: Warning device circuit is detected the invention discloses a kind of Locomotive axle temperature.The present invention gathers Locomotive axle temperature by some new DS18B20 digital sensors, instead of traditional PN sensors, carry AD converter, it is effectively reduced the error of gathered data, improve antijamming capability, stability and high efficiency control based on single-chip microcomputer STC89C58RD+, display lamp D1, D2 and alarm LS1 devices etc. effectively raise the degree of accuracy detected to Locomotive axle temperature, when Locomotive axle temperature be higher than design temperature when can the communication of alarm in time it is long to locomotive, take measures in time, exclude hidden danger, it is ensured that the safety of driving.The present invention improves the accuracy of axle temperature detection, stability, improves the validity of transmission, it is ensured that the security of driving.

title_en: Sensor wireless general data collector
abstract_en: Sensor wireless general data collector is related to automatic monitoring data acquisition technology field.The present invention includes following part：Signal receiving unit is used for receiving sensor signal；The signal Dispatching Unit being connect with signal receiving unit, for classified sensor signal type and sensor signal is distributed to different sensor processing units；And the following sensor processing units being connect with signal Dispatching Unit：Digital sensors signal processing unit, analog sensor signal processing unit, pulsed quantity sensor processing unit, break-make quantity sensor signal processing unit；Digital filter, for receiving the output data from each sensor processing unit and being filtered noise reduction to it：The threshold comparison unit being connect with digital filter.The invention has the advantages that sensor remote data acquisition can be realized, has both disaster and Realtime Alerts, teleprogram update upgrade function occurs, there is very high working efficiency.

title_en: Double-power-rod anti-climbing early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-power-rod anti-climbing-error early warning device, which relates to the technical field of electric power construction safety and comprises an anti-climbing-error device, a detection switch, an early warning host and a password controller, wherein the anti-climbing-error device, the detection switch and the password controller are respectively electrically connected with the early warning host; the anti-mistaken-climbing device comprises an umbrella part and a lifting device, the umbrella part is hinged to the lifting device, the lifting device comprises a rack, a gear and a sliding block, the gear is fixed to the sliding block, a motor is fixedly arranged on the sliding block, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the gear, a chuck is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the sliding block, a plurality of supporting rods are hinged to the chuck, and the other ends of the supporting rods are hinged to the middle section of the rib. The anti-climbing device is controlled by a password controller, and a pole climbing worker needs to obtain a password or fingerprint authorization and then retract the anti-climbing device, so that the construction worker is prevented from climbing the double power supply pole randomly to cause electric shock safety accidents.
assignees: LINYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing sos message service
title_ko: 휴대단말에서 긴급문자 서비스 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An urgency message sending method for a personal digital assistant is provided to rapidly perform a contact with another person by sending an SOS message after auto releasing a call forwarding service. CONSTITUTION: An urgency message sending method for a personal digital assistant comprises the following steps: confirming call forwarding service setting information after detecting an SOS signal using the personal digital assistant(101,103); changing setting information of a call forwarding service when the call forwarding service is activated(105,107); sending a request message for releasing the forwarding service to a corresponding base station by the personal digital assistant(109); and sending the SOS message to a telephone number of another person after releasing the call forwarding service(111).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 착신전환 서비스가 설정된 휴대단말에서 긴급문자 서비스 요청 시 상기 착신전환 서비스를 해제한 후 상기 긴급문자 서비스를 처리하여, 신속하게 긴급 상황에 대처할 수 있도록 하는 긴급문자 서비스 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 휴대단말의 긴급문자 서비스 방법에 있어서, 긴급문자 서비스 요청을 감지할 시 착신전환 서비스 설정 상태를 판별하는 과정과, 상기 착신전환 서비스가 설정된 경우, 상기 착신전환 서비스를 해제하는 과정과, 상기 착신전환 서비스 해제 후 상기 긴급문자 서비스 요청에 따른 긴급상황 알림 메시지(SOS 메시지)를 설정된 가입자번호로 전송하는 과정을 포함한다. 
       
     휴대단말, 긴급문자 서비스, SOS, 착신전환, CFU

title_en: Server, vehicle terminal and method for providing emergency notification
title_ko: 서버, 차량용 단말 및 이를 이용한 긴급 상황 알림 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a server emergency notification method. The method includes the steps of: receiving emergency situation information from a vehicle terminal for a vehicle, when a vehicle emergency event occurs; starting a standby count for emergency cancellation with respect to a vehicle terminal; determining whether there is an emergency situation depending on whether cancellation for the emergency situation is made until the standby count for the emergency cancellation ends; and performing a report on the emergency situation of the vehicle to an emergency reporting organization using the received emergency situation information, in case of emergency. Accordingly, it is possible to take measures corresponding to a driving state of the vehicle more appropriately and quickly.
abstract_ko: 서버의 긴급 상황 알림 방법이 개시된다. 본 방법은 차량의 긴급 상황 이벤트 발생시, 차량에 대한 차량용 단말로부터 긴급 상황 정보를 수신하는 단계, 차량용 단말에 대하여 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트를 시작하는 단계, 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트가 종료될 때까지 긴급 상황에 대한 취소가 이루어지는지 여부에 따라 긴급 상황 여부를 판단하는 단계, 긴급 상황으로 판단되면, 수신된 긴급 상황 정보를 이용하여 긴급 신고 기관으로 차량의 긴급 상황에 대한 신고를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Automatic identification and early warning system for potential safety hazards of roads based on passenger traffic data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of road traffic safety, and particularly relates to a passenger traffic data-based automatic identification and early warning system for potential safety hazards of roads. Meanwhile, real-time video transmission is carried out on the traffic accident to be occurred, the traffic accident is sent to a background to further carry out accident safety processing, real-time video data and GPS positioning of the traffic accident and a vehicle are carried out, and the position of the accident road section is updated by continuously combining historical operation data.

title_en: Rainfall type recognition-based dynamic mountain torrent disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic mountain torrent disaster early warning method based on rainfall rain recognition, which comprises the following steps: based on historical rainfall data containing disaster rainfall in a research area, constructing a research area characteristic rainfall library by using a k-means cluster analysis method; constructing a rainfall similarity association formula of the actually measured rainfall and the rainfall type library based on the shape similarity and quantity similarity principle, calculating the similarity between the actually measured rainfall and the characteristic rainfall, identifying the rainfall type of the actually measured rainfall, and then obtaining a rainfall forecasting process by combining the total rainfall forecasted by the numerical forecasting product; constructing a small-basin hydrologic model to simulate a rainfall-runoff process, and performing model parameter calibration and verification; and as rainfall observation information is increased, a rainfall type recognition result is dynamically updated time-period by time-period, a hydrologic model is used for dynamically forecasting a disaster prevention object to control a section flood process, and flood peak flow rate is used as an early warning index to issue dynamic early warning of the mountain flood disaster or not.

title_en: Electrical fire early warning system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-sensor fusion electric fire, and provides a multi-sensor fusion-based electric fire early warning system, which comprises the steps of deploying a sensor integration module to synchronously sample indexes of a plurality of electric appliance environments in the power utilization environment of an old community, embedding low-power consumption chip period acquisition information and data preprocessing in a sensor, deploying a lightweight early warning core module at an edge gateway to perform data collaborative analysis on a plurality of sensor channels, constructing standard score judgment abnormal event grades, and (3) carrying out notification reminding on the user by adopting an intelligent face brushing entrance guard and intelligent door lock sensing linkage mechanism according to the abnormal event level and pushing information of the property, setting tolerance of light abnormal co-occurrence of the user, carrying out label on feedback of the property and the user, carrying out expert classification and label reliability assignment, finishing preliminary training by using a decision tree, carrying out model training and iteration by using a semi-supervised learning strategy, issuing an updated data packet, and adopting an A/B test to select a stable model.

title_en: Lamp controol apparatus for vehicle
title_ko: 승합차량용 램프 제어시스템
abstract_en: A lamp control apparatus for vehicle is provided to prevent the safety accident by warning an operator of the backward vehicles by using a sprinkling lamp. The reverse-current interrupting diode(14) is connected between the main battery(10) and the sub battery(12). The auxiliary power supply part(16) supplies power source to the micom(18). The bi-directional radio transceiver(22) receives the control signal of the main controller(20). The red and yellow light driving part(26,28) sprinkles successively the first red and yellow light. The second red light driving part(36) sprinkles successively the red light. The display panel driving part(42) operates the display panel lamp(40).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 승합차량용 램프 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 램프를 깜박이거나 점등시켜 후방차량의 운전자에게 알림으로써 안전사고를 예방할 수 있도록 한 승합차량용 램프 제어시스템에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은 메인배터리(10), 보조배터리(12), 역류차단 다이오드(14), 보조전원공급부(16), 마이콤(18), 양방향무선송수신기(22), 안전표시용 경광램프(24), 제1적색등구동부(26)/황색등구동부(28), 차량자체신호입력부(30), 제1 및 제2차선변경용 경광램프(32)(34), 제2적색등구동부(36), 밝기센싱부(38), 전광판램프, 전광판구동부(42), 신호등용 신호램프(녹색등, 황색등, 적색등)(44), 신호등구동부(46), 비상램프(48), 비상전환스위칭부(50), 차량비상등구동부(52), 차량시그널 전원 역류차단 다이오드(54) 등으로 구성되어 운전자에게 위험 신호를 알려 주의운전과 안전한 차로변경을 유도하며, 어린이와 보행자에게도 위험 신호를 제공함으로써 어린이, 보행자, 운전자 모두에게 사고의 위험을 알려 위험으로부터 사전 예방한다. 
     
     승합차, 램프, 마이콤, 전광판, 신호등, 적색등, 황색등

title_en: Pedestrian Protection System
title_ko: 보행자 보호 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for protecting a pedestrian, which comprises: a camera unit to acquire image information of a pedestrian; a pedestrian detection unit to detect whether there is a pedestrian in a predetermined area through the image information transmitted from the camera unit; an alarm notification unit to inform a vehicle driver that there is the pedestrian ahead when the pedestrian is detected by the pedestrian detection unit; and a control unit to control the operation of the camera unit, the pedestrian detection unit, and the alarm notification unit, wherein the pedestrian detection unit includes: an initial model generation unit to generate an initial model of the pedestrian using a difference image of a background image and the current frame image and region segmentation; and a model update unit to update the initial model of the pedestrian using a function for identity determination and a moving object search. The system and the method for protecting a pedestrian according to the present invention can inform a vehicle driver that there is a pedestrian ahead by accurately detecting the pedestrian regardless of the entering direction and number of the pedestrians, thereby preventing a traffic accident by securing the safety of the pedestrian.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 보행자 보호 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보행자의 영상정보를 획득하는 카메라부; 상기 카메라부로부터 전송된 영상정보를 통해 미리 정해진 소정의 영역 안에 보행자의 유무를 검출하는 보행자검출부; 상기 보행자검출부를 통해 보행자가 검출되면, 주행 차량운전자에게 전방에 보행자가 있음을 표시하는 경고알림부; 및 상기 카메라부, 상기 보행자검출부, 상기 경고장치부의 동작을 제어하는 제어부; 를 포함하며, 상기 보행자검출부는, 배경영상과 현재 프레임영상의 차영상과 영역분할을 이용하여 보행자의 초기모델을 생성하는 초기모델생성부; 동일성 판정을 위한 함수와 이동물체 탐색을 이용하여 상기 보행자의 초기모델을 갱신하는 모델갱신부; 를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 보행자 보호 시스템 및 그 방법은 보행자의 진입방향과 수에 관계없이 보행자를 정확히 탐지하여 주행 차량운전자에게 전방에 보행자가 있음을 표시함으로써 보행자의 안전을 보호하여 교통안전사고를 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: Real-time disaster safety evacuation and rescue system using iot repeater and led lighting device and its operation method
title_ko: Iot 중계기 및 led 조명 장치를 이용한 실시간 재난 안전 대피 및 구조 시스템 및 그 운영 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time safety evacuation and rescue system against disasters using IoT repeaters and LED lighting devices to enable people to safely escape from a building. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a plurality of LED lighting devices disposed in the building at predetermined intervals for lighting and including an LED lighting unit operated in one of a general lighting mode and a disaster lighting mode and an IoT motion detection unit disposed in the LED lighting unit and including a motion sensor for detecting motion of a person who exists in a detection range; the IoT repeater receiving a motion detection signal detected by the IoT motion detection unit through Bluetooth communication; a hub disposed in a predetermined position of the building, where the Bluetooth communications with each IoT repeater is available, to receive the motion detection signal from each IoT repeater; and a cloud server connected to the hub through a general wired/wireless communication network to transmit a feedback control signal corresponding to a disaster situation occurrence or cancelation signal, simultaneously transmit earthquake-related information to a manager mobile terminal and a mobile terminal of general users who are residents of the building and guide evacuation through a visual or auditory evacuation guide means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IOT 중계기 및 LED 조명 장치를 이용한 실시간 재난 안전 대피 및 구조 시스템은 건물 내 조명을 위해 소정 이격 간격으로 복수개 배치되어 있으며, 일반 조명 모드와 재난 조명 모드 중 어느 하나의 모드로 동작하는 LED 조명부 및 상기 LED 조명부에 마련되어 있으며 감지 가능 영역 내에 위치하는 사람의 움직임을 감지하는 모션 감지 센서를 구비하고 있는 IOT 모션 감지부를 갖는 LED 조명 장치, 상기 IOT 모션 감지부가 감지한 모션 감지 신호를 블루투스 통신을 통해 수신하는 IOT 중계기, 상기 각 IOT 중계기로부터 블루투스 통신이 가능한 건물 소정 위치에 배치되어 상기 각 IOT 중계기로부터 모션 감지 신호를 전송 받는 허브, 그리고, 상기 허브와 일반 유무선 통신망으로 연결되어 재난 상황 발생 신호 또는 재난 상황 해제 신호에 대응되는 피드백 제어 신호를 전송하고, 동시에 관리자 이동 통신 단말 및 건물 입주자인 일반 사용자 이동 통신 단말에 지진 발생 관련 정보를 전송하며, 시각 또는 청각적 대피 안내 수단을 통해 대피 안내를 수행하는 클라우드 서버를 포함한다.

title_ko: 화재 경보 시스템용 경보 밸브 스테이션
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보 시스템(100)용 경보 밸브 스테이션(1)에 관한 것으로, 이는 소화 유체 입구(5)와 소화 유체 출구(7)를 지닌 경보 밸브(3)를 갖고, 경보 밸브(3)는 소화 유체 입구(5)와 소화 유체 출구(7) 사이에서 소화 유체의 유동을 선택적으로 해제 또는 차단하도록 설정되고; 경보 밸브(3)와 유체 연통되고 압력의 변화를 검출하여 이를 전기 경보 신호(13)로 변환하도록 구성되는 압력 센서(11)를 가지며; 경보 신호를 지연시키는 경보 지연 장치(15)를 갖는다. 본 발명에 따르면, 경보 지연 장치(15)는 전기 경보 지연 장치(15)로서 설계되고 압력 센서(11)와 신호 통신하여 연결된다.

title_en: Entrance blocking apparatus for underground pass
title_ko: 지하통로박스 진입차단장치
abstract_en: An entry blocking apparatus for an underground pass box is installed in front of an underground pass box to control the entry of a vehicle and comprises: a vertical pole installed to be erected on the roadside of one side around the entrance of an underground pass box; a guide member fixed on one side of the vertical pole to guide a wire rope; a blocking bar coupled at a set height of the vertical pole through a rotary shaft to be installed to be vertically rotated relative to the ground; a drive motor installed on one side of the blocking bar based on the rotary shaft and having a wire reel mounted on the rotary shaft; a wire rope wound on the wire reel and passing through the guide member to be connected to the other side of the blocking bar; and a notifying member installed on the other side of the blocking bar to have a warning phrase written thereon and notifying entry prohibition of vehicles into the underground pass box. When entry is prohibited, the wire reel rotates in one direction by the drive motor to unwind the wire rope and rotate the blocking bar downwards to a first position horizontally crossing the road. When entry prohibition is cleared, the wire reel rotates in the opposite direction by the drive motor to wind the wire rope and rotate the blocking bar upwards to a second position.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하통로박스의 전방에 설치되어 차량의 출입을 통제하는 지하통로박스 진입차단장치에 있어서, 지하통로박스의 입구 주변 한쪽 도로변에 세워지게 설치된 수직폴대; 상기 수직폴대의 일측에 고정되어 와이어 로프를 가이드하는 가이드부재; 상기 수직폴대의 정해진 높이에 회동축을 통해 연결되어 지면에 대해 상하방향으로 회동 가능하게 설치된 차단바; 상기 회동축을 기준으로 상기 차단바의 일편에 설치되고 회전축에는 와이어 릴이 장착된 구동모터; 상기 와이어 릴에 감기고 상기 가이드부재를 통과하여 상기 차단바의 타편에 연결된 와이어 로프; 및 상기 차단바의 타편에 설치되어 상기 지하통로박스에 대한 차량의 진입금지알리는 경고문구가 표기된 알림부재;를 포함하고, 진입금지 시에는 상기 구동모터에 의해 상기 와이어 릴이 일방향으로 회전하여 상기 와이어 로프가 풀리면서 상기 차단바가 차로를 수평하게 가로지르는 제1 위치까지 하향 회동하고, 진입금지 해제 시에는 상기 구동모터에 의해 상기 와이어 릴이 반대방향으로 회전하여 상기 와이어 로프가 감기면서 상기 차단바가 제2 위치까지 상향 회동하는 것을 특징으로 하는 지하통로박스 진입차단장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Explosion-proof management system
title_ko: 방폭관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an explosion-proof management system and, more specifically, to an explosion-proof management system which collects data such as information, equipment information, and the like of a specific place exposed to explosion risk such as power generation facilities, gas, petrochemicals, offshore plants, and the like, and notifies a report, thereby preventing accidents in advance through history management, inspection cycle management, information omission prevention according to updates, and the like, and at the same time, facilitating search for explosion-proof equipment required for purchase.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방폭관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 발전시설, 가스, 석유화학, 해양 플랜트 등과 같이 폭발 위험에 노출되어 있는 특정 장소의 정보, 장비 정보 등의 데이터를 수집하고, 보고서화여 알림하여 줌으로써, 이력 관리, 검사 주기 관리, 업데이트에 따른 정보 누락 방지 등을 통해 안전사고 발생을 미연에 방지함과 동시에 구매에 필요한 방폭장비의 검색을 용이하게 해주는 방폭관리시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency information sending method for mobile multimedia broadcast system
abstract_en: The method comprises: 1) mobile multimedia broadcast system acquires an emergency information data, and packages the emergency information data into the multiplexing frames comprising an emergency information indication flag bit, emergency information type flag bit, emergency level flag bit, and one or more bit in the update serial number flag bit of emergency information; 2) when there is an emergency message needing to be transmitted, setting one or more value of said flag bits in the multiplexing frame, and transmitting said multiplexing frame through mobile multimedia broadcast system. By the invention, all kinds of emergency messages can be transmitted to the user through multimedia broadcast system.

title_en: Method for forecasting real-time measurement of spatial geometrical information of coal rock dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for forecasting the real-time measurement of spatial geometrical information of a coal rock dynamic disaster, comprising the following steps of: regarding a tunnel or a working surface as an early warning centre, and dividing a monitoring region into different early warning units; carrying out real-time measurement on the early warning unit through a laser three-dimensional scanner to obtain deformation error of the coal rock spatial geometrical information in the early warning unit; transmitting the measurement values of all the early warning units to a computer center and displaying in the graphic form; judging as a high stress danger unit when the measured deformation error is more than the early warning critical value; judging as a high stress increasing unit when the deformation error increasing ratio in the time is more than the critical increasing ratio; and judging as a high stress gradient unit when two or more adjacent early warning units are increased or reduced sharply. The district that the disaster is possible to take place is analyzed according to the early warnings under different situations, much more time is provided so that an operator can withdraw and take necessary measures, and a convenient way is provided for accurately forecasting the coal rock dynamic disaster.

title_en: Access control system with fire-fighting warning function and fire-fighting warning method
abstract_en: An access control system with fire warning and a fire warning method are provided. The sensing device senses an environment and outputs a plurality of environmental parameters. The entrance guard device comprises a wireless communication unit, an entrance guard storage unit, an entrance guard communication unit and a control unit, wherein the control unit calculates the dangerous state according to the environmental parameters, the weight of a plurality of parameters and the dangerous threshold value. The cloud device comprises a cloud communication unit, a cloud storage unit, an artificial intelligence unit and a processing unit, the processing unit outputs a warning signal according to the dangerous state, and the artificial intelligence unit calculates new parameter weights according to the dangerous state and the corresponding environment parameters and updates the parameter weights to the access control device. Therefore, the early warning accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling data optimization and early warning method based on data warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed disaster recovery drilling data optimization and early warning method based on a data warehouse, which comprises the following steps: deploying a real-time data warehouse based on an iceberg data lake technology in a central server, performing online and offline management on data in a Flink and Spark stream data form, and calculating the occupancy rate of a process pool in real time; the distributed training central early warning model preferentially carries out cross-local privacy disaster recovery drilling data operation when the occupancy rate of the process pool is lower than a set value, so that real-time tracking capture of memory abnormity and early warning based on the central early warning model are realized; and submitting the training results of the models of all the places to a central server to update a headquarter drilling result database, storing the drilling result after each training and storing the privacy data into a real-time data warehouse. The invention can effectively overcome the problem of model deviation and reduce the calculation complexity.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic priority scenario for fire alarm system and management method based on fire location information in the building
title_ko: 건축물에서의 화재 발생 위치에 기반한 동적 우선순위 시나리오 화재 알림 경보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides fire alarm for resident safety by solving an alarm problem based on fire and an alarm and a release function to residents by calculating dynamic priority scenario based on the changed location and context information and by notifying the change of the fire to the residents, and the residents can safely move to safe areas by accurately operating voice alarm and visual alarm functions by realizing a cutting-edge technology in a home device which is supplied currently. The home device comprises an alarm device, a wired/wireless communication network, and a management server. The fire alarm is provided to the residents or public areas by realizing a fire location information treatment process in the management server. The present invention, more specifically, relates to the system and the method calculating the dynamic priority setup scenario based on the fire location information and inducing the residents to move to a safe fire escape along with a guide and information based on a current condition by providing the fire alarm to the residents. [Reference numerals] (100) Dynamic priority scenario fire alarm system;(115) Managing monitor;(120) Receiver interlocking protocol unit;(130) Complex server interlocking protocol unit;(140) Fire alarming operating unit;(150) Fire alarming initiating unit;(160) Fire alarming releasing unit;(170) Database system (DBMS);(180) Graphic user interface (GUI);(190) Dynamic fire alarming initiating unit;(200) Complex server;(210) Fire alarming interlocking unit;(300) Wall pad;(320) Voice alarming device;(340) Time alarming device;(400) Fire receiver;(500) Fire detector
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생에 의한 경보 알림 문제점을 해결하여 입주자 안전을 위한 화재발생 알림 경보를 제공하는 것으로, 발생한 화재의 변화 상황을 입주자에게 신속히 알리며 화재 발생 위치 및 변화된 위치/상황 정보에 기반한 동적 우선순위 시나리오를 산출하여 이에 따라 동적으로 입주자에게 경보 및 해제를 제공하고, 현재 보급 중인 홈 기기에 첨단 IT 기술을 실현하여 음성경보 및 시각 경보 기능을 적절하게 동작하게 함으로써 입주자들이 안전한 대피를 할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 위해 홈기기, 경보장치, 유/무선 통신 네트워크 및 관리 서버를 구성으로 하고, 관리 서버에 화재 위치정보 처리 프로세스를 구현하여 공동 주거지 역 내 또는 세대 내 입주자에게 신속한 화재 경보가 가능하도록 하는 화재알림 경보를 제공한다. 특히 본 발명에 따른 시스템 및 방법은 화재 발생 위치정보에 기반한 동적 우선순위 설정 시나리오를 산출하고 이에 따른 화재 알림 경보를 제공하여 입주자가 화재 위치와 현재 상황에 맞는 정보와 안내에 따라 안전한 대피로로 이동할 수 있도록 함을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV MOKWON CORP IND EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMS

title_en: Smart safety information board with emergency alert function
title_ko: 위급상황 경보기능이 구비된 스마트 안심 정보안내판
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart safety information guide plate with an emergency situation warning function which realizes a warning device for an emergency situation by using a road sign or a building number plate installed on a road or a building or a separate safety information guide plate to provide a safety function even in a secluded area or a dark alley to prevent crimes, and can notify an emergency situation in real time even in a situation in which a user cannot press an emergency button by emergency situation recognition through voice recognition. The smart safety information guide plate recognizes a voice around an area in which the smart safety information guide plate or an emergency button generating an emergency situation signal or an emergency situation cancelation signal in accordance with an operation of a user is installed. An emergency situation is determined if an emergency situation signal is generated by a voice recognition unit generating an emergency situation signal if a recognized voice is an emergency situation voice. If an emergency situation is determined, an LED driving control signal, an emergency warning signal, and emergency situation information for an emergency situation warning are generated and outputted. A warning for an emergency situation is provided audio-visually. The emergency situation information is transmitted to a control center through a gateway to allow a related agency to quickly respond to the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 도로나 건물에 설치된 도로명판이나 건물번호판 또는 별도의 안심 정보 안내판을 이용하여 위급 상황에 대한 경보장치를 구현하여, 인적이 드문 곳이나 어두운 골목길에서도 안심 기능을 제공하여 범죄를 사전에 예방하고, 음성 인식을 통한 위급 상황 인식으로 사용자가 비상버튼을 누르지 못하는 상황에서도 위급 상황을 실시간으로 알릴 수 있도록 한 위급상황 경보기능이 구비된 스마트 안심 정보안내판에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 조작에 따라 위급 상황 신호 또는 위급 상황 해제신호를 발생하는 비상 버튼 또는 스마트 안심 정보안내판이 설치된 주변 음성을 인식하고, 인식한 음성이 위급 상황 음성이면 위급 상황 신호를 발생하는 음성 인식부에서 위급 상황 신호가 발생하면 위급상황으로 판단하고, 위급상황으로 판단되면, 위급상황 경보를 위한 LED 구동 제어신호와 위급 경보 신호 및 위급상황정보를 생성하여 출력하며, 위급상황을 시청각으로 경보해주고, 게이트웨이를 통해 위급상황정보를 관제센터 서버에 전송하여, 관계기관에서 신속하게 대응하도록 한다.

title_en: Airplane slide pre-positioning indicator lamp with ranging and acousto-optic warning functions
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aircraft slide pilot lamp of taking range finding and audible and visual warning function, belongs to civil passenger plane avionics system and hatch door signal system technical field. Including casing and lamp shade, the inside main control circuit board, lamp plate, the reflector of being provided with of casing, main control circuit board fixes in casing inner chamber lower part, and the lamp plate is fixed in the casing inner chamber of main control circuit board portion, and the reflector is fixed on lamp plate upper portion, and the lamp shade cover is in reflector upper portion, and lamp shade border and casing upper portion opening border fixed connection are equipped with distance detection sensor on the lamp shade. The invention can make the crew quickly and accurately prepare and deploy the slide equipment through visual and audible alarm signals in emergency, ensure passengers to quickly and safely withdraw the aircraft, and prevent serious economic loss and aircraft delay caused by careless opening of the slide equipment due to misoperation in normal conditions.
assignees: SHAANXI BAOCHENG AVIATION INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing
abstract_en: A distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing is characterized in that space-time two-dimensional vibration signals are mapped into gray images, a multi-mode fusion technology is utilized, a lightweight convolutional neural network is combined to achieve efficient classification, a dynamic increment learning mechanism and a spatial propagation attenuation correction algorithm are introduced, and the problems of single characteristic representation, model update lag and insufficient positioning accuracy of a traditional method are solved. The method is suitable for the fields of perimeter security protection, pipeline monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like, and can be used for screening and target recognition of mass vibration data under complex environment interference in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of traditional time-frequency domain analysis through signal imaging characterization, obviously improves the distinguishing capability of similar events, simultaneously reduces the false alarm rate and the operation and maintenance cost by depending on a dynamic model optimization technology, effectively suppresses the influence of optical fiber attenuation on the positioning precision by combining a space correction algorithm, and provides reliable technical support for intelligent upgrading of a distributed optical fiber sensing system.

title_en: Intelligent judging method for stability of highway slope rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent judging method for stability of a highway slope rock mass, which comprises the steps of obtaining rock mass displacement and moisture content of the highway slope rock mass, obtaining a rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram through finite element simulation, comparing the rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram with historical geological data, dividing the rock mass into a high uncertainty area and a low uncertainty area, extracting a deformation monitoring sequence from the high uncertainty area, classifying to obtain a deformation trend classification result, fusing the deformation trend classification result with the mechanical property of the low uncertainty area to generate a slope stability index map, updating rock mass fracture density and permeability, combining the updated fracture density, permeability and deformation trend, obtaining a instability probability distribution curve through probability simulation, generating an early warning signal according to whether a curve peak probability point is located in a safety interval, and outputting a slope stability judging report. The method improves accuracy and instantaneity of slope stability evaluation and obviously reduces geological disaster risks.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital broadcasting system and method of processing data in digital broadcasting system
title_ko: 디지털 방송 시스템 및 데이터 처리 방법
abstract_en: A digital broadcasting system and a data processing method are provided to receive and process a notification message by using a notification-dedicated channel, and transmit EAS(Emergency Alert System) corresponding to an emergency through the notification-dedicated channel or ESG(Electronic Service Guide) update information. A baseband processor(100) receives a broadcast signal in which mobile service data and main service data are included. The mobile service data comprises an RS(Reed Solomon) frame. A management processor(200) parses the second signaling information from the RS frame to access a notification message, processes the accessed notification message, and then stores it in a storage unit. A presentation processor(300) outputs the processed notification message to an output device.
abstract_ko:
디지털 방송 시스템 및 데이터 처리 방법이 개시된다. 상기 디지털 방송 시스템 중 수신 시스템은 베이스밴드 프로세서부, 매니지먼트 프로세서부, 및 프리젠테이션 프로세부를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 베이스밴드 프로세서부는 모바일 서비스 데이터와 메인 서비스 데이터가 포함된 방송 신호를 수신한다. 상기 모바일 서비스 데이터는 RS 프레임을 구성할 수 있고, 상기 RS 프레임은 모바일 서비스 데이터와 통지 메시지(Notification Message) 중 적어도 하나를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 RS 프레임은 상기 모바일 서비스 데이터를 전송하는 가상 채널의 시그널링 정보가 서술되는 제1 시그널링 정보와 상기 통지 메시지를 전송하는 통지 채널에 대한 시그널링 정보를 서술하는 제2 시그널링 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 매니지먼트 프로세서부는 상기 RS 프레임으로부터 제2 시그널링 정보를 파싱하여 상기 통지 메시지를 억세스하고, 억세스된 통지 메시지를 처리한 후 저장 장치에 저장한다. 상기 프리젠테이션 프로세서부는 상기 처리된 통지 메시지를 출력 장치로 출력한다. 
       
     mobile, notification, eas, message, schedule

title_en: Building secondary collapse monitoring and early warning system under aftershock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring and early warning system for secondary collapse of a building under aftershock, which comprises a building structure monitoring module and an early warning module; the building structure monitoring module comprises a plurality of sensors, wherein the sensors are arranged at target monitoring points of the local collapse building and are used for monitoring the structural response of the local collapse building under the action of aftershocks; the early warning module is internally provided with a dynamic early warning threshold algorithm, different initial early warning thresholds are set according to characteristic collapse modes of a local collapse building on site, and accurate and timely early warning is provided after data screening processing and sensitivity analysis are carried out by collecting aftershock source signals and structural response signals, and meanwhile, the collapse early warning threshold is dynamically updated and used for next collapse judgment and early warning. Compared with the prior art, the method considers two factors of aftershock and structural response, and enables monitoring and early warning of secondary collapse of the building to be more scientific and accurate through the early warning threshold value of dynamic iteration.

title_en: Typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence, which provides more comprehensive typhoon behavior information by combining various meteorological data sources, preprocesses data and converts the data into a data set suitable for a machine learning model, performs feature learning and pattern recognition on the data by applying a deep learning model comprising a contraction path and an expansion path and jump connection, extracts key features and patterns of typhoons, constructs typhoons vortex structures and predicts typhoons paths and strength by applying a trained deep learning model to real-time meteorological data, and updates and improves the prediction capability of the deep learning model by continuous data collection and model training. The method can realize more accurate typhoon vortex initialization, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of typhoon path and strength prediction, and provide effective technical support for typhoon early warning and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Mobile terminal emergency alarm method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile terminal emergency alarm method and device. In one aspect, there is provided a mobile terminal emergency alert method, including: setting triggering alarm conditions; storing personal information of a user, and acquiring fingerprint information of the user according to the triggering alarm condition; inputting a fingerprint; identifying fingerprint information; judging whether the trigger signal is consistent with the stored user fingerprint information; and if the trigger signal is consistent with the stored user fingerprint information, sending an alarm signal, wherein the alarm signal contains the personal information of the user. According to the invention, the fingerprint information is set according to the needs of the user, the updated real-time geographical position information is obtained, the site is really recorded, and the problem that the information of the alarm person cannot be effectively identified is solved.

title_en: Fusion processing method, device, equipment and storage medium for multi-disaster early warning information
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fusion processing method, a fusion processing device and a fusion processing device of multi-disaster early warning information, and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early warning information report, and acquiring the early warning stage type of the previous disaster early warning information report of the same disaster type of the monitoring area corresponding to the current disaster early warning information report; under the condition that the early warning stage type of the current disaster early warning information report is the report ending, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the early warning stage type of the current disaster early warning information report is non-end report, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is an updated report or an end report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the previous disaster early warning information report according to the current disaster early warning information report and the early warning end condition. The disaster early warning event fusion method can fuse disaster early warning events to the received disaster early warning information report, and is beneficial to updating, responding and disposing of the current disaster early warning information by a user.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Safety type multifunctional mining safety helmet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety type multifunctional mining safety helmet, which relates to the technical field of safety helmets and comprises a helmet shell, wherein a safety warning structure and an adjustable illumination structure are sequentially arranged on the helmet shell, the safety warning structure comprises a mounting plate fixedly connected to the front edge of the helmet shell, a gas sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, a singlechip and an alarm which are sequentially and fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the front edge of the mounting plate, and the adjustable illumination structure comprises a lifting assembly, an angle adjusting assembly and a miner lamp. The invention has the function of safety warning, and can detect carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, methane and temperature and humidity in the mine environment in real time through the cooperative cooperation of the gas sensing sensor and the temperature and humidity sensor, and when any item exceeds the standard, the singlechip controls the alarm to operate, so that the potential safety hazard of miners can be timely warned, the miners can withdraw in time, and the use safety of the mining safety helmet can be well improved.

title_en: Semi-supervised landslide early warning method integrating concept drift detection and marker migration
