abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised landslide early warning method integrating concept drift detection and marker migration, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a source domain history data set and current landslide data of a target domain; performing feature derivation on the two-domain data, clustering the source domain data, performing feature derivation on clusters generated by clustering, and finally storing the clusters and the features thereof as an initial early warning model; taking the cluster centroid as a training set to train K KNN models; EMD filtering is used for the target domain data stream, and ADWIN algorithm is used for detecting concept drift points of the filtered data, namely data points to be migrated; taking the reciprocal speed and tangential angle characteristics closely related to the landslide curve as the historical label migration basis; and aiming at the classified data, judging the consistency of the migration label and the classification label to update the model. According to the method, the characteristics and the labels of the historical landslide data are utilized to transfer the historical labels to the current data, and the semi-supervised learning is used for carrying out classified early warning, so that the accuracy of landslide early warning is improved.

title_en: Rock slope stability assessment and early warning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope risk early warning based on slope data processing, in particular to a rock slope stability assessment and early warning method, a system, equipment and a medium; the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining initial instability scores and slope stability types of rock slopes based on slopes, rock-soil body shear strength and structural surface development, then updating the initial instability scores of the slopes to obtain initial comprehensive instability scores of the slopes in consideration of the stability influence of hidden danger slopes in the rock slope groups on the neighborhood slopes, then calculating environment instability score increment of the rock slopes caused by rainfall, updating the initial comprehensive instability scores to obtain updated comprehensive instability scores of the rock slopes, finally carrying out rock slope risk early warning according to the comparison result of the updated comprehensive instability scores of the slopes and the instability score threshold values, and improving accuracy and timeliness of rock slope safety early warning when the method is applied to rock slope safety early warning.
assignees: BEIJING ANKEZHIXING SECURITY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring wearing of safety helmet and safety helmet validity period indication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the wearing of a safety helmet and a system for indicating the validity period of the safety helmet, which comprises a sensor unit for collecting the motion data of the safety helmet, and transmitting the motion data to a control unit, and analyzing the motion data by the control unit to judge whether the safety helmet is in a wearing state. The safety helmet wearing state is accurately judged and early-warned in real time through cooperation of the sensor and the control unit, the supervision blind area is eliminated, the safety distance grading accurate early-warning is realized by means of a positioning and distance algorithm, manual visual inspection is replaced, the operation safety is improved, the effective period is automatically managed by utilizing the timing and storage unit, the false judgment of manual missed detection is avoided, the protection performance is ensured, the multifunctional module performs data interaction and cooperative operation, the function fragmentation is broken, and the integrated safety supervision chain is constructed, so that the whole-flow management requirement is met.

title_en: Mobile terminal, server, system, method, and recording medium for crime prevention
title_ko: 범죄 예방을 위한 이동 단말, 서버, 시스템, 방법, 및 기록 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A portable terminal for preventing the occurrence of a crime, server, system, method, and recording medium are provided to effectively reduce the occurrence of a false alarm by enabling a user to establish an alarm system according to temporal and spatial information. CONSTITUTION: An information transmission and reception unit(250) transmits the created information to a crime prevention server. The information transmission and reception unit receives the alarm information corresponding to the sensing information. An alarm unit(270) generates alarm according to the received alarm information. An alarm information establishment unit(290) is connected to a crime prevention server. The alarm information establishment unit updates or establishes the alarm information according to wireless signal sensing environment. The wireless signal sensing environment includes the distance and time for sensing a wireless signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 이동 단말 및 통신망 등을 이용하여 전자팔찌를 착용한 범죄자로부터 아동이나 유부녀 등 범죄 대상자를 안전하게 보호하고 범죄를 예방하도록 하는 기술에 관한 것으로, 일 예로 본 발명에 따른 범죄 예방을 위한 시스템은 전자발찌로부터 방출되는 무선 신호를 감지하는 신호감지부, 상기 감지된 무선 신호 및 그 무선 신호의 세기에 따른 거리 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 감지 정보를 생성하는 정보생성부, 상기 생성된 감지 정보를 전송하고 이에 대응하는 경보 정보를 수신하는 정보송수신부, 상기 수신된 경보 정보에 따라 경보를 발생하는 경보부, 및 적어도 무선 신호 감지에 대한 거리, 시간 및 장소를 포함하는 무선신호 감지환경에 따라 상기 경보 정보를 설정 또는 갱신하는 경보정보설정부를 포함하는 이동 단말; 및 상기 이동 단말로부터 상기 감지 정보를 수신하고, 이에 대응하는 경보 정보를 상기 이동 단말로 전송하는 정보송수신부, 상기 전송된 경보 정보에 대응하는 경보 메시지를 보호자와 신고 센터 중 적어도 하나로 전송하는 메시지전송부, 및 적어도 무선 신호 감지에 대한 거리, 시간 및 장소를 포함하는 무선신호 감지환경에 따라 상기 경보 정보를 설정 또는 갱신하는 경보정보설정부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A vehicle cooperation communication system sending a agent message
title_ko: 긴급메시지의 전송이 가능한 차량 협력 통신 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a vehicle cooperation communications system capable of preferentially processing an urgent message. The vehicle cooperation communications system of the present invention comprises a receiving module which is installed in a second vehicle to receive an urgent message including sending cycle information and a message valid time from a peripheral first vehicle; a control module to control the urgent message to be sent to at least one peripheral third vehicle according to the sending cycle information during the message valid time; and a sending module to send the urgent message to the third vehicle according to the control of the control module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 긴급메시지를 우선적으로 처리할 수 있는 차량 협력 통신 시스템을 개시한다. 
본 발명의 차량 협력 통신 시스템은 제2차량에 설치되며, 주변의 제1차량으로부터 송신 주기 정보 및 메시지 유효 시간을 포함한 긴급메시지를 전달받는 수신 모듈; 상기 메시지 유효 시간 동안 상기 긴급메시지를 상기 송신 주기 정보에 따라 주변의 적어도 하나의 제3차량으로 송출하도록 제어하는 제어 모듈; 및 상기 제어 모듈의 제어에 따라 상기 긴급메시지를 상기 제3차량으로 송출하는 송신 모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Public transportation notification system for the transportation disadvantaged
title_ko: 교통약자를 위한 대중교통 알림 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 교통약자를 위한 대중교통 알림 시스템은 대중교통내에 제어부가 좌석과 근접한 거리에 대상자 뱃지를 인식하여 상기 대상자 뱃지를 통해 교통약자에 대한 정보를 수신하는 A단계, 제어부를 통해 상기 대상자 뱃지의 유효성이 인정되는 경우 상기 대상자 뱃지와 접속하는 B단계, 상기 제어부가 상기 대상자 뱃지와 근접한 위치의 좌석이 알림 신호를 제공하는 C단계, 상기 제어부가 상기 교통약자가 착석한 상태에서 알림 신호를 해제 요청했는지 파악하는 D단계 및 상기 제어부가 기 설정된 시간 또는 거리를 초과한 상기 대상자 뱃지와 접속을 해제하는 E단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of earthquake alarm system and its device based on wireless internet of things
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake alarm system and its device based on wireless internet of things, it is characterised in that：The system and its apparatus includes Internet of Things control unit, several earthquake prompting with wireless transmitter module, warning devices；The Internet of Things control unit is established on 4G wireless network platforms, and the Internet of Things control unit includes：MCU module, Zigbee wireless network terminals, Zigbee wireless network coordinators, Short message alarm, central controller, 4G modules and mobile terminal device and power supply, the Zigbee wireless network coordinators are connect with central controller, the central controller is connect with Short message alarm, and the Short message alarm is connect by 4G modules with mobile terminal device.The configuration of the present invention is simple, high sensitivity can send out wireless alarm signal or sound, visual alarm in time to relevant staff, people allowed to have time enough to withdraw, reduce injury of the earthquake to people before earthquake arrival.
assignees: DALIAN XINCHENG CREDIT MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Alert line position identification method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for identifying the position of a warning line, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring RGB images and depth image information; extracting an interested region; searching the region of interest to obtain a search result; judging whether the retrieval result is an identifier meeting the requirement; if so, acquiring coding information corresponding to the identifier; determining the position of the identifier in the map according to the coded information; acquiring the current position of the robot; judging whether the distance between the current position of the robot and the position of the identifier in the map meets a set threshold value or not; if not, determining that the current robot is lost; determining whether the location identified in the map is available for relocation; if so, the position of the robot is updated. By implementing the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the robot can accurately identify the warning line on the ground, so that the robot can be relocated to the position in the map under the condition of positioning loss, and some safety accidents are avoided.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGZHI YONGHAO ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive early warning method for coal mine water damage risk based on multi-element heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive early warning method for coal mine water damage risk based on multiple heterogeneous data, which comprises a space-time data fusion early warning method and a dynamic data and static data fusion early warning method. The time-space data fusion early warning method comprises a threshold value and change rate threshold value combined early warning mode and/or a threshold value and change value threshold value combined early warning mode in the time dimension, and the combined early warning mode can simultaneously give consideration to slow-change abnormal data and mutant abnormal data; in the space dimension, the accurate position of the monitoring equipment is obtained, and the abnormal situation occurrence place is accurately positioned. According to the dynamic and static data fusion early warning method, dynamic data change is considered to cause static data change, so that the water inrush risk evaluation result is changed. The method and the device can solve the problem that the reliability of the early warning result is low due to the fact that the dynamic data do not fully consider the time dimension factors and the static data are not updated in time.
assignees: SHAANXI BINCHANG WENJIAPO MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and a medium thereof, in particular to the field of electronic commerce, the system comprises a data encryption acquisition module, a data cleaning and integrating module, a data analysis module, a real-time data monitoring module, a visual template customizing module and a dynamic data interaction module. The visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and the medium thereof encrypt target platform data through a data encryption acquisition module to reduce hidden danger of data acquisition, perform real-time data processing operation through a real-time data monitoring module, set a data change rule and an early warning mechanism, acquire and update data in time, receive third key information through a dynamic data interaction module, display the third key information on a visualized interface according to a preset mode, provide autonomous exploration and prediction analysis of dynamic data by a user, and increase interactivity of the system.

title_en: Scheme release method based on emergency state dynamic change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plan release method based on dynamic change of emergency states, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and comprises the steps of activating a pre-built knowledge graph frame according to an emergency type identifier acquired in real time to form an initialized dynamic knowledge graph, capturing a feedback data stream in real time, importing the feedback data stream into a state update layer of a state evolution knowledge graph to generate an updated state evolution knowledge graph, generating an evacuation instruction based on the updated state evolution knowledge graph, switching to Mesh network broadcast path change information through a damaged base station to generate an execution effect, and re-triggering and activating the pre-built knowledge graph frame as a new emergency type identifier. According to the intelligent countermeasures, the dynamic generation of the intelligent countermeasures is realized by implanting the emergency situation disturbance nodes into the state evolution knowledge graph and deducing the diffusion paths.
assignees: CIETS DIGITAL INTELLIGENT TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning information grading automatic pushing system and method based on region division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional division-based earthquake early warning information grading automatic pushing system and a regional division-based earthquake early warning information grading automatic pushing method, which relate to the technical field of intelligent disaster early warning and dynamically divide risk regions according to monitoring data and geographic and population information; the risk is estimated through a decision tree and random forest algorithm, an early warning grade sequence is generated, a personalized early warning information set is generated according to a grade matching template library, coverage is ensured through graded pushing of a broadcasting network and a standby satellite channel, an optimization instruction is generated according to a feedback data comparison standard, and a dividing and estimating model is dynamically updated to form a closed loop. The invention realizes accurate grading, reliable delivery and system self-optimization of the early warning information.

title_en: Automatic teller machine having emergency call function and recognizing information of live body, and method of cash withdrawing the same
title_ko: 생체정보인식 및 긴급상황 알림 기능을 구비한 현금인출기 및 그의 현금인출방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A cash dispenser and a withdrawing method equipped with biometric information recognition and an urgent situation alert function using a face image are provided to permit the use of the automatic teller machine in case the face image of the cash withdrawal person recording in the camera of the cash dispenser. CONSTITUTION: If a card is inputted through a card reader, a controller(160) takes a photograph of the face image of a user with a camera(130). If the face image is stored, the controller compares the bio-information received from the user. If bio-information accords, controller successively receives the transactions function, and the amount of money and password from user through a touch screen(110). If the password of five digits is inputted or one password is in a long queue inputted, the controller confirms emergency through the touch screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체정보인식 및 긴급상황 알림 기능을 구비한 현금인출기 및 그의 현금인출방법에 관한 것으로, 현금인출기에 부착된 카메라에서 촬영된 현금인출자의 얼굴 영상이 정상적으로 입력된 경우에만 현금인출기를 사용할 수 있도록 제어하고, 현금인출기를 사용하는 현금인출자의 얼굴 영상과 지문정보를 입력받아 저장하고 입력한 지문정보가 통장 개설시 등록한 지문정보와 비교하여 일치할 경우에만 현금인출기를 사용할 수 있도록 제어한다. 또한, 현금인출자가 비밀번호 중 하나를 중복 또는 길게 누르거나 정상적인 비밀번호 4자리 외에 숫자나 문자 등의 부호 중 하나를 더 추가로 입력하면 화면을 통해 현금인출자로부터 비상상황인지를 확인한 후 즉시 경찰서와 은행의 담당직원에게 긴급 상황을 알리도록 하며, 비상상황이 발생시 임의의 지정시간 동안 "출금 오류" 메시지를 표시하거나 캐시카드나 신용카드를 강제징수하고 현금인출기를 다운시켜 시간을 지연시킴으로써, 현금인출기를 통해 발생할 수 있는 범죄를 사전에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
     현금인출기, 생체정보(인체정보), 지문, 얼굴 영상, 카메라, 비밀번호

title_en: Apparatus and method for forcing people to withdraw in advance before activating extinguishers and automatic extinguishing system using the same
title_ko: 화재 진압 시에 사전 퇴거 유도 장치 및 방법과 이를 이용한 자동화 소화 시스템
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, an automated fire extinguishing system can comprise: a fire receiver sensing a fire to generate a fire warning linking signal, an odorant emission signal, and a fire extinguish agent emission signal and outputting a delay fire extinguish agent emission signal; and an advance withdrawal guiding device opening a discharge valve of an odorant storage container storing a high-pressure inert gas, a high-pressure gas, and a liquid odorant or a powder odorant in accordance with the odorant emission signal to enable an odorant to be operated to be emitted from a nozzle connected to the discharge valve by expansion of the high-pressure inert gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들에 따른 자동화 소화 시스템은 화재를 감지하여 화재 경보 연동 신호, 부취제 방출 신호 및 소화 약제 방출 신호를 생성하고, 지연 소화 약제 방출 신호를 출력하는 화재 수신기 및 고압의 가스, 액상 또는 분말 형태의 부취제와 고압의 비활성 가스를 저장하는 부취제 저장 용기의 배출 밸브를 부취제 방출 신호에 따라 개방하여, 부취제가 고압의 비활성 가스의 팽창에 의해 배출 밸브에 연결된 노즐로부터 방출되도록 동작하는 사전 퇴거 유도 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent construction site application system based on Internet of things technology and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent construction site application system based on the technology of the Internet of things and a using method thereof, wherein the intelligent construction site application system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data information of personnel, environment, equipment and materials of a construction site; the cloud platform acquires data information; the information processing module processes data; the storage module stores and records data; the display module displays the data condition on a cloud platform interface; detecting and judging abnormal data at a judging module; the learning unit records the abnormal data condition, analyzes the potential change rule of the abnormal data, and updates and modifies the abnormal data judgment condition; and the terminal receives information and logs in the cloud platform. The invention can comprehensively monitor the construction site according to the data information, eliminate potential safety hazards, provide a convenient, rapid and clear management system, and enable operators to remotely and efficiently manage the operation of the construction site, thereby achieving the purposes of early warning, normal monitoring and management regulation.
assignees: GUANGDONG GONGDE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;FOSHAN YUECHI JIANGONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Audible and visual alarm system for power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a sound-light alarm system for a power plant, which comprises: four kinds of alarm types, four kinds the alarm type includes that main equipment tripping operation is reported to the police, auxiliary engine tripping operation is reported to the police, parameter anomaly is reported to the police and automatic mode withdraws from the warning, and four kinds the alarm type passes through light word tablet display at DCS system interface, and four kinds of alarm type correspond through the page of a whole that appears of difference, and every page of a whole that appears all is provided with the warning fence, relates to power plant alarm system technical field. The acousto-optic alarm system for the power plant, provided by the invention, distinguishes alarm types by setting the display of different page surfaces and distinguishes the importance degree of alarm by different colors, the alarm system achieves the effects of practically helping and reminding operators through a reasonable man-machine interaction interface of the alarm system, and invalid alarm rejection is realized by optimizing alarm classification, alarm sound and alarm light-character cards, so that the alarm system is slimmed, and thus more accurate, clear and efficient alarm can be realized.
assignees: HUANENG ZUOQUAN COAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Integrated system and method for preventing and treating potential safety hazards and hazards based on production places
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production safety, in particular to an integrated system and a method for preventing and treating potential safety hazards and hazards based on a production place, which comprises a filing module; a recording module; a timing module; a feedback module; a prompt module; a warning module; a call system and a cancellation module. According to the invention, the position of potential safety hazard and harm in the production place and the name of the object are input into the system, the staff is prompted to carry out regular inspection in a timing mode, the inspection result is input into the feedback module, and the system makes corresponding judgment according to the position information in the feedback module and the state of the name of the object, so that the position of potential safety hazard and harm in the production place and the object can be systematically observed in real time, and the potential safety hazard and harm which are not artificially generated are reduced as much as possible.
assignees: HENAN XINANLI VOCATIONAL HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning device for collapse danger of foundation pit construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foundation pit construction, and discloses an automatic monitoring and early warning device for danger of foundation pit construction collapse, which comprises a shell, wherein a displacement sensor is arranged outside the shell, an alarm clock is arranged inside the shell, a rotating rod II is arranged inside the shell, one end of the rotating rod II is provided with a sliding rod II, the outer wall of one side of the sliding rod II is provided with a knocking rod, and one end of the knocking rod is positioned inside the alarm clock; the utility model discloses a warning clock, including casing, displacement sensor, circuit board, signal line two, motor, dwang one, dwang two, striking pole, alarm clock, the internally mounted of casing has the motor, the motor is used for the drive to strike the pole and removes, through setting up casing, displacement sensor, circuit board, signal line two, motor, dwang one, dwang two for strike the pole, alarm clock, remind the operation personnel to notice, when slide bar one and two separation of slide bar, drive slide bar two under the effect of spiral spring one and reset, thereby make to strike the pole and can repeat to strike alarm clock, make the operation personnel can in time withdraw.
assignees: BEIJING MUNICIPAL CONSTR CO LTD;BEIJING HIGH NEW MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alert signal processing method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a warning signal processing method, a warning signal processing device, warning signal processing equipment, a warning signal processing storage medium and a warning signal processing program product, which can be applied to the technical field of fire information processing. The method comprises the following steps: responding to an alarm condition signal of alarm equipment, and acquiring initial alarm condition information corresponding to the alarm equipment; under the condition that the initial warning information meets a first preset condition, upgrading the initial warning information to obtain an updated warning; under the condition that the initial warning information meets a second preset condition, combining the warning information to obtain a combined warning; generating a target warning condition according to the updated warning condition and the combined warning condition; and generating a fire-fighting early warning prompt according to the target warning condition.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for analyzing vehicle false intrusion data in road construction area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for analyzing vehicle false intrusion data in a road construction area, and relates to the technical field of road construction early warning. According to the invention, the running track of the vehicle in front of the working area is monitored in real time through the main early warning device, whether the target vehicle has a trend of running into the construction area or not is analyzed to perform the prior early warning, so that a driver is prompted to timely make a measure of decelerating or changing the road to drive into a safety lane, constructors are prompted to timely withdraw from the construction area, and the safety protection effect of the constructors is greatly improved.
assignees: JIANGSU BIANSHI SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic discrimination method for rock burst tendency
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a dynamic discrimination method for rock burst tendencies, which aims to solve the limitation caused by the fact that the dynamic evolution process is simplified into quasi-static properties in the traditional rock burst tendencies evaluation. According to the application, rock burst tendency is defined as a hidden state variable evolving along with time, a physical constraint state space model comprising a hidden state dynamics equation and a multi-mode observation equation is constructed, continuous stress strain and discrete acoustic emission data are fused, hidden state probability distribution is estimated in real time through online Bayesian inference, a future state track is predicted and risk probability exceeding a critical threshold is calculated by combining self-adaptive information weight update and physical consistency constraint, and a dynamic rock burst tendency grade is output. Through the scheme, the method and the device realize continuous, dynamic and prospective discrimination of the rock burst tendency, and improve the accuracy and reliability of early warning.
assignees: EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT INFORMATION RESEARCH INST COAL INFORMATION INST

title_en: The service system providing emergency notification using mobile phone and method thereof
title_ko: 모바일폰을 이용한 위급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 방법.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing an emergency notification with a mobile phone which can selectively transmit an emergency signal to a management server when a mobile phone user expects to be exposed to an emergency situation. The emergency notification system of the present invention comprises: a protected person mobile phone; multiple guardian mobile phones; and a management server which relays the protected person mobile phone and guardian mobile phones. The protected person mobile phones includes: an emergency mode setup unit which sets up emergency signal generation conditions in which a protected person can input and transfers the same to the management server when emergency is expected; an emergency signal input unit which inputs information on the protected person according to the emergency signal generation conditions selected through the emergency mode set-up unit; and an emergency signal transmitting unit which transmits the emergency signal to the management server through the user information inputted in the emergency signal input unit. The guardian mobile phone includes a notification signal receiving unit which receives the emergency signal in the case when the emergency signals are relayed on the guardian mobile phones after the management server receives the emergency signals.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모바일폰 사용자가 위급한 상황에 노출된 것으로 예상하는 경우, 관리서버로 전송하고자 하는 위급신호를 모바일폰 사용자가 설정한 시간, 거리, 조건에 따라 관리서버로 선택적인 전송을 이룰 수 있는 모바일폰을 이용한 위급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 구성은, 피보호자모바일폰과, 다수의 보호자모바일폰과, 상기 피보호자모바일폰과 보호자모바일폰을 중계하는 관리서버를 포함하는 위급상황 알림 시스템에 있어서, 상기 피보호자모바일폰은 위급상황 발생위험이 예상되는 경우, 피보호자가 입력할 수 있는 위급신호의 발생조건을 설정하여 관리서버로 전송하는 위급모드설정부; 상기 위급모드설정부를 통하여 선택된 위급신호 발생조건에 따라 피보호자 정보를 입력하는 위급신호입력부; 상기 위급신호입력부에 입력되는 사용자 정보를 통하여 위급상황 발생 시, 상기 관리서버로 위급신호를 전송하는 위급신호전송부;를 포함하고, 상기 보호자모바일폰은 상기 관리서버로 위급신호가 수신된 후 다수의 보호자모바일로 중계되는 경우, 위급신호를 수신하는 알림신호수신부;를 포함하여 구성된다. 
위와 같은 본 발명은, 모바일폰을 이용한 위급상황 알림 시스템은 위급상황 발생이 예상되는 모바일폰 사용자가 위급모드설정부를 통하여 관리서버로 전송하고자 하는 위급신호를 선택적으로 전송할 수 있어 위급상황이 발생되는 경우, 신속하고 정확하게 자신의 위급상황을 알릴 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 위급상황 발생이 예상되는 경우라도 위급신호입력부를 이용하여 위급상황의 해제를 모바일폰 사용자가 이룰 수 있도록 하여 불필요한 위급신호의 오신호가 관리서버로 전송되는 것을 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 모바일폰의 오작동 또는 사용자의 조작미숙 등으로 모바일폰 이용한 위급상황 오신호가 관리서버로 전송되는 것을 효율적으로 방지할 수 있어 불필요한 구조인력과 구조비용이 증대되는 것을 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있는 것이다. 
그리고, 본 발명에 따른 모바일폰을 이용한 위급상황 알림 방법은 위급상황이 발생되는 경우에는 모바일폰 사용자의 위급상황을 신속하고 정확하게 다수의 모바일 사용자 및 관공서 등으로 알릴 수 있는 효과가 있는 것이다.

title_en: Personal alert safety system for calling emergency situation and method thereof
title_ko: 응급 상황 호출을 위한 개인 경보 안전 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a motion sensor to detect movements of a user; a motion determination module to determine whether the movements of the user are not detected above a predetermined time by the motion sensor or not; an alarm signal output module to produce and output an alarm signal if it determines that the movements of the user are not detected above the predetermined time by the motion determination module; an emergency signal production module to produce an emergency signal including an ID of the user and the elapse time after the expiration of the predetermined time in real time if it determines that the movements of the user are not detected above the predetermined time by the motion determination module; and a local area communication module to periodically transmit the emergency signal produced in the emergency signal production module with a local area communication method and to receive a surrounding emergency signal with the local area communication method. According to a personal alert safety system for calling an emergency situation and a method thereof as stated above, a risk signal is mutually shared by firefighters in real time and the firefighters can recognize a risk of a surrounding co-worker and rapidly rescues the co-worker since a mesh topology or an ad-hoc network are formed between personal alert safety systems attached to a body of the firefighters.
abstract_ko: 사용자의 움직임을 감지하는 모션 센서; 상기 모션 센서에 의해 소정 시간 이상 사용자의 움직임이 감지되지 않는지 판단하는 모션 판단 모듈; 상기 모션 판단 모듈에 의해 상기 소정 시간 이상 상기 사용자의 움직임이 감지되지 않는 것으로 판단되는 경우, 알람 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 알람 신호 출력 모듈; 상기 모션 판단 모듈에 의해 상기 소정 시간 이상 상기 사용자의 움직임이 감지되지 않는 것으로 판단되는 경우, 상기 사용자의 ID, 상기 소정 시간의 만료 이후의 경과 시간을 포함하는 응급 신호를 실시간으로 생성하는 응급 신호 생성 모듈; 상기 응급 신호 생성 모듈에서 생성된 응급 신호를 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 주기적으로 송신하고, 주변의 응급 신호를 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 수신하는 근거리 통신 모듈을 구성한다.  상술한 응급 상황 호출을 위한 개인 경보 안전 시스템 및 그 방법에 의하면, 소방관들이 몸에 부착하는 개인 경보 안전 시스템들 간에 메시 토폴로지 내지는 애드-혹 네트워크를 형성하도록 구성됨으로써, 그 위험 신호를 상호간에 실시간 공유하여 현장의 소방관들이 주변 동료의 위험을 인지하고 신속하게 구조를 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of early warning system of geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of early warning systems of geological disaster, comprising: monitoring data for obtaining the geologic data of field monitoring instrument acquisition, and are transmitted to data processing module by data acquisition module；Data processing module, data in abnormality in the monitoring data for identification, and the data in abnormality are rejected；Data management module, for saving treated monitoring data and basic data；Forecast analysis module, for obtaining geological hazards prediction value according to the monitoring data after preset BP neural network algorithm calculation processing；Alarm commander's module, for after hazard prediction value is more than preset geological disaster secure threshold, determine corresponding disaster loss grade according to hazard prediction value, and according to disaster loss grade determine it is corresponding withdraw information, by the disaster loss grade and it is described withdraw information and be sent to mobile terminal show.Solve the problems, such as that prior art geo-hazard early-warning is not accurate enough.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INST;GUANGZHOU GEOLOGIC SURVEY INST

title_en: Laboratory reagent management method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a laboratory reagent management method and system, comprising the following steps: the reagent bottle bar code image acquisition module, the reagent bottle bar code image preprocessing module, the reagent bottle bar code image characteristic extraction module, the reagent shelf life bar code recognition model training module and the system integration module adopt technical means such as the reagent bottle bar code image acquisition module, so that the technical problems in the prior art are effectively solved, and further, the recognition of the shelf life bar code by using the reagent shelf life bar code recognition model is realized by acquiring the bar code image of the reagent when the reagent is stored and managed, the system can automatically check the shelf life of the reagent, and provide a warning or reminding function, and when the reagent is required to be used, the use sequence of the reagent is reasonably arranged, so that the reagent to be expired is ensured to be used first, the shelf life of the reagent is effectively managed, and the reagent used by laboratory staff is ensured to be effective, so that the problem that the experiment result is inaccurate or the result of overdue safety hidden danger is avoided.

title_en: Flood control early warning decision-making system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control early warning decision-making system and method based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of flood control data monitoring and comprise a target monitoring area marking module, a target sensor marking module, a reconstruction sensor group generating module, a priority analysis module and an early warning response switching module; the flood control system comprises a target monitoring area marking module, a target sensor marking module, a reconstruction sensor group generating module, an early warning response switching module and an optimal level redundant sensor function switching module, wherein the target monitoring area marking module is used for marking a flood control monitoring area which is used for storing and recording flood events and is provided with no redundant sensor in all sensor devices, the target sensor marking module is used for outputting and marking a sensor with physical damage as a target sensor, the reconstruction sensor group generating module is used for generating a reconstruction sensor group taking the target sensor as a main sensor, the early warning response switching module is used for carrying out replacement reminding when an isolated sensor responds to damage abnormality in an early warning event, and the optimal level redundant sensor function switching is carried out when a sensor to be updated responds to the damage abnormality in the early warning event.
assignees: Shandong Yellow River Information Center of Shandong Yellow River Bureau

title_en: The cable machine cage for merging D-GPS and RFID causes calamity method for prewarning risk
abstract_en: The cable machine cage for merging D GPS and RFID causes calamity method for prewarning risk, includes the following steps：Judge region residing for construction personnel with prior-warning device, when worker is located in dangerous region, carry out phonetic warning；Real-time spatial position coordinate (the X of measuring cable machine cage 1 , Y 1 , Z 1 ), speed of service v and worker spatial position coordinate (X 2 , Y 2 , Z 2 ), compare the horizontal displacement between cable machine cage and worker and cable machine cage object strike influence area, take the form apart from early warning, early warning is carried out to construction personnel；When worker enters in cable machine cage object strike influence area, buzzer warning is carried out, until worker is withdrawn to safety zone.The method of the present invention calculates the influence area of cable machine cage object strike by location technology, effectively reduces Steric clashes and causes calamity risk, improves operating personnel's safety in work progress.

title_en: A kind of stone pit safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of stone pit safety monitoring system and methods, subsystem is detected including control backstage and landslide, control backstage is connected with landslide detection subsystem communication, prediction and early warning are carried out for receiving detection data and showing million property to disaster, landslide detection subsystem includes stone pit ontology landslide module and dump slide module, stone pit ontology landslide module includes several sensor detection units being arranged in side slope, and dump slide module includes the monitoring unit for detecting roach mobile range.It the advantage is that, the roach situation of the rocky condition and refuse dump of the stone pit ontology of subsystem detection is detected by landslide, and carry out the aobvious million property analysis of disaster by controlling backstage, judge the dangerous situation being likely to occur, and dangerous situation content and the doubtful coordinate of dangerous situation are sent to alarm module in time, it notifies the operating personnel of the doubtful nearby coordinates of dangerous situation to withdraw or reinforce slope monitoring and management in time by alarm module, pinpoints the problems and take preventive measures in time.
assignees: GUANGDONG CHANGHENG STONE IND CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic integrated natural disaster remote sensing monitoring method and system and cloud platform
abstract_en: The dynamic integrated natural disaster remote sensing monitoring method, system and cloud platform can respectively carry out environment updating and early warning degree updating on disaster area remote sensing monitoring information and influence area remote sensing monitoring information, when the environment is updated, a plurality of geological interference states of influence area environment conditions/disaster area environment conditions are obtained through analysis, so that different information updating strategies can be adopted to carry out environment updating on the remote sensing monitoring information in different geological interference states, and the actual monitoring change conditions of all the geological interference states can be obtained through disaster area information and influence area information in the remote sensing monitoring information comprehensively and intelligently as far as possible. Therefore, the updating of the environment angle and the early warning degree angle of the remote sensing monitoring information can be realized, the dynamic remote sensing monitoring updating information can reflect the monitoring result correlation condition among the remote sensing monitoring devices from the actual geological environment change angle as far as possible, and an accurate and reliable decision basis is provided for the subsequent natural disaster early warning.
assignees: GUANGDONG RUZINIU GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and related device for transmitting small amount of data in power saving state
abstract_en: A method of Small Data Transfer (SDT) in a power saving state is provided. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting the SDT on a first SDT bandwidth part (BWP) in a power saving state; receiving at least one of an indication of a change in System Information (SI) and an indication of a Public Warning System (PWS) on the first SDT BWP; and receiving at least one of the updated SI and PWS information based on the received indication. By this method, changes in SI and/or monitoring of PWS information on the associated BWP can be achieved during SDT progression.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for near-surface semi-aviation frequency domain radio frequency magnetotelluric detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle system for near-surface semi-aviation frequency domain radio frequency magnetotelluric detection, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, an airborne receiver, a folding telescopic rod and a three-component radio frequency magnetic sensor group, wherein the airborne receiver is carried on the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, one end of the folding telescopic rod is connected to the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the folding telescopic rod can be controlled to stretch and retract, the three-component radio frequency magnetic sensor group is arranged on the other end of the folding telescopic rod, and the unmanned aerial vehicle system has a first state and a second state. The problems of difficult access, low efficiency, high cost and the like of complex terrain resource detection are solved, the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle interference detection sensors and the like in aviation electromagnetic detection in a frequency domain are solved, and the method has wide application prospects in the fields of geological structure exploration, mineral/oil gas resource exploration, geological disaster early warning and the like.
assignees: CHINA SHIP RES AND DEVELOPMENT ACADEMY NO 7 RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA SHIPBUILDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-function window system
title_ko: 방범기능을 갖는 다기능 창호시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multifunctional window system with a crime prevention function is provided to remotely open and close a glass window when the access of a stranger, a fire, or gas is sensed. CONSTITUTION: A multifunctional window system with a crime prevention function comprises a locking unit, a control unit(20), a window drive unit, and a power generation unit(40). The locking unit is installed in a window frame(4) and locks and unlocks a glass window(3). The control unit transmits a control command to the window drive unit. When the access of a stranger, a fire, or damage to the glass window is sensed, the control unit outputs an alarm signal and transmits a txt message to a cellular phone of a user. The window drive unit locks the glass window depending on the received control command. The power generation unit generates power using the rotation of rollers(7) when the glass window is slid.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방범기능을 갖는 다기능 창호시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 창프레임에 설치되어 창호구동수단의 제어신호에 의해 작동하여 유리창을 록킹/록킹해제시키는 록킹수단과;    실내에 설치되고 사용자의 조작에 따라 록킹 및 개폐를 위한 제어명령을 창호구동수단으로 전송하고, 방범모드시 화재감지 또는 침입자감지 또는 유리창 파손 감지신호가 수신되었을때 경보신호를 출력하면서 사용자 핸드폰으로 경보알림용 문자메세지를 송출하는 콘트롤수단과;   콘트롤수단과 무선 교신하면서 수신되는 제어명령에 따라 록킹수단을 작동시켜 유리창이 록킹되도록하고, 방범모드시 센서에서 감지되는 침입감지정보를 콘트롤수단으로 무선 전송하는 창호구동수단과;   유리창의 프레임 하단에 설치되어 유리창의 슬라이딩 개폐시 발생하는 롤러의 회전력을 이용하여 전기를 생성시켜 충전하는 발전수단; 으로 구성한 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 의하면, 사용자가 콘트롤수단을 이용하여 원격으로 유리창을 개폐할 수 있고, 유리창이 개방된 상태일때 열감지센서와 초음파센서를 이용하여 외부인의 침입을 감지하며, 유리창이 닫혀 록킹상태일때에는 진동센서와 유리파손감지센서를 이용하여 외부인의 침입을 감지하고, 외부인의 침입이 감지되거나 화재 및 가스가 감지되면 경보음을 출력하면서 사용자의 핸드폰으로 경보알림용 문자메세지를 송출하여 사용자가 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 하며, 또한 카메라에서 촬영된 영상을 사용자 단말기에 전송하여 사용자가 발생된 위급상황을 촬영영상으로 보다 정확하게 인지할 수 있도록 하면서 사용자가 무선단말기를 통해 입력하는 음성메세지를 스피커를 통해 출력하여 침입자를 퇴치할 수 있도록 하고, 유리창 프레임 하단에 롤러의 구름이동시 발생되는 회전력을 이용하여 발전하는 발전수단을 더 설치하여 생성되는 전기를 밧데리에 충전시켜 밧데리의 수명을 더 연장시킬 수 있는 효과를 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: Situational adaptive highway alarm system
title_ko: 주변 상황 적응형 고속도로 경보 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a situation adaptive highway alarming system. The situation adaptive highway alarming system according to embodiments of the present invention recommends vehicles behind an accident location to drive slowly by letting multiple alarming devices communicate with each other and finding out surrounding drive speeds, actively prevents a secondary rear-end collision by giving the vehicles driving at high speeds a strong alarm about the current accident location to enable the vehicles to quickly drive out from the road. and supports users around the accident location to be mentally relieved and to concentrate on handling the accident such as giving aid to the wounded by changing the alarm to a lower level alarm or clearing the alarm if possibility of the secondary rear-end collision disappears as surrounding vehicles are backed up or drive slowly.
abstract_ko: 주변 상황 적응형 고속도로 경보 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 주변 상황 적응형 고속도로 경보 시스템은 다수의 경보 장치들이 서로 교신함으로써 주변 주행 속도를 파악하여 후방 차량에 대한 서행 운전 권고 뿐만 아니라 후방 차량들이 빠르게 주행하는 경우에는 현재 사고 지점에 대해 강력한 경고를 줌으로써 도로밖으로 신속하게 대피하도록 2차 추돌을 적극적으로 예방하며, 주변 차량들이 정체 또는 정지되어 2차 추돌 가능성이 사라진 경우에는 보다 낮은 수준의 알람으로 변경하거나 알람을 해제하여 사고 주변의 사용자들이 심리적으로 안정을 취하고 부상자 처리와 같은 사고 주변의 수습에 전념할 수 있도록 지원한다.

title_en: Artificial intelligence risk management and control system based on scene recognition drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk management and control system based on scene recognition driving, which comprises a data resource library, an inspection terminal system, a risk management system and an interface standard specification. The safety production risk grading management and control system is based on a data resource platform, based on SOA architecture design, combines the advanced technologies of wireless communication, geographic information service, big data analysis, computer network safety and the like, realizes system data transmission by relying on local area network (intranet) and 4G/WIFI network communication, forms two functional interfaces of mobile terminal application and platform service application based on application support, adopts a standard multi-level system, strictly defines interfaces among the levels, and realizes seamless integration of the system through overall design deployment. The invention can be applied to multi-platform equipment such as mobile phones, tablets, computers and the like, meets the application in environments or places with higher risks, can be remotely used through a public wide area network or a local area network, collects dangerous point data through mobile inspection equipment and uploads the dangerous point data to the database in time, so that the data resource library can update dangerous information data in time and helps enterprises to dynamically master safe production dynamic information anytime and anywhere. Meanwhile, the risk management system carries out early warning management according to data of the data resource library, and meanwhile, by combining a data mining analysis method, artificial intelligence is adopted to predict the risk accident trend, so that an enterprise is helped to make effective decisions. The invention can also be applied to the field of fire fighting, and helps the emergency department to manage and control risks and respond in time.
assignees: TADUN INFORMATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Forestry environment monitoring method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry environment monitoring, and discloses a forestry environment monitoring method and system based on big data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional environmental parameters such as soil moisture content, vegetation coverage, meteorological factors and the like through a distributed sensor network, and generating real-time weight coefficients through a dynamic weight distribution engine. And 3, finishing abnormal detection by using a space-time correlation analysis model, and triggering a self-adaptive sampling strategy to acquire the abnormal region in high density. And integrating the real-time data and the satellite remote sensing data through a multi-source data fusion algorithm to generate a forestry environment state matrix, and dynamically updating the reference threshold value by combining an incremental learning mechanism. And generating a regulation instruction set for soil improvement, vegetation maintenance and disaster early warning according to the updated threshold value, and executing and collecting feedback data by the edge computing nodes. And comparing the feedback data with the expected index through a bidirectional verification mechanism, generating a system optimization parameter, and transmitting the system optimization parameter back to the dynamic weight distribution engine to realize accurate monitoring and efficient regulation of the forestry environment.

title_en: Voice and flashing guidance lights with locking means
title_ko: 잠금 수단을 구비한 음성 및 점멸 유도등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to voice and flickering guidance lights. In particular, a case locking means is provided so that an upper case and lower case can be operated in a locked and unlocked state, and at the same time, a fixing plate locking means is provided so that a fixing plate for fixing a sign can be operated in a locked and unlocked state. Accordingly, components for voice and flickering guidance lights can be produced separately and then easily manufactured by assembly, and maintenance and replacement of the components provided inside the case can be easily performed. As a result, time, effort and cost for manufacturing and maintenance of the voice and flickering guidance lights can be reduced. According to the present invention, the voice and flickering guidance lights having a locking means comprises: an upper case; a lower case combined with the upper case to form an internal space; and a fixing plate for fixing a sign placed on a lower surface of the upper case and exposed to the outside, wherein a voice output means and a visual warning means are provided in the internal space. In addition, a case locking means is further included to allow the upper case and the lower case to be combined and then operated in a locked and unlocked state. Moreover, a fixing plate locking means is further included to allow the sign to be fixed with the fixing plate and then the fixing plate to be operated in a locked and unlocked state at a lower part of the upper case.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음성 및 점멸 유도등에 관한 것으로, 특히 케이스 잠금 수단을 구비하여 상부 케이스와 하부 케이스를 잠금 상태 및 잠금 해제 상태로 동작시킬 수 있도록 함과 동시에 고정판 잠금 수단을 구비하여 표지판을 고정하는 고정판을 잠금 상태 및 잠금 해제 상태로 동작시킬 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 음성 및 점멸 유도등의 구성품을 별조 제작한 후 조립에 의해 용이하게 제조할 수 있고, 케이스 내부에 구비되는 구성품의 유지 보수 및 교체를 용이하게 할 수 있으며, 결과적으로 음성 및 점멸 유도등의 제조 및 유지보수를 위한 시간, 노력 및 비용을 감축시킬 수 있도록 하는 잠금 수단을 구비한 음성 및 점멸 유도등에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 잠금 수단을 구비한 음성 및 점멸 유도등을 이루는 구성수단은, 음성 및 점멸 유도등에 있어서, 상부 케이스, 상기 상부 케이스와 결합되어 내부 공간을 형성하는 하부 케이스, 상기 상부 케이스의 하부면에 안착되어 외부로 노출되도록 배치되는 표지판을 고정하는 고정판을 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 내부 공간에는 음성 출력 수단 및 시각 경보 수단이 구비되고, 상기 상부 케이스와 하부 케이스를 결합한 후 잠금 상태 및 잠금 해제 상태로 동작시킬 수 있도록 하는 케이스 잠금 수단을 더 포함하며, 상기 표지판을 상기 고정판으로 고정한 후 상기 고정판을 상기 상부 케이스의 하부에 잠금 상태 및 잠금 해제 상태로 동작시킬 수 있도록 하는 고정판 잠금 수단을 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for pre-detecting signs of abnormality in nuclear power plant equipment including process for determining equipment importance and alarm validity
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device, including determination of importance of the device and validity of the alarm. The method for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device includes: the first step is as follows: determining, by the early warning processing means, whether the plant monitoring signal value is outside of a normal operating range using a weighting value based on importance data for each monitoring variable that has been previously analyzed by an operator; the second step is as follows: generating an alarm by the early alarm processing means when the plant monitoring signal value is outside the normal operating range; and a third step of: determining, by an alarm determination device, whether the generated alarm is a valid alarm to be analyzed and tracked.

title_en: Flood disaster risk early warning and evacuation system based on GIS location technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flood disaster risk early warning based on GIS location technology and evacuation system and methods, include: that information storage module is used for: providing the picture of taking photo by plane of river two sides landforms to geography information module, the flood discharge of the particular point in time of prediction is provided to flood dynamic monitoring module, provides the single flood peak maximum stream flow of prediction to big flood region division module.Geography information module is used for: being provided river profile information to flood dynamic monitoring module, is provided river two sides geography information to flood zones division module, these information are all by providing on the public coordinate map in geography information module.Flood dynamic monitoring module is used for: flooding water level to the offer of flood zones division module.Flood zones division module is used for: being withdrawn module to early warning and is provided flood inundation on tracks area, flood influence area range information.The invention has the advantages that: realize three-dimensional feature surface information and three kinds of flood zones range informations combined with public coordinate map, flexible and convenient proactive dissemination warning information and the process for withdrawing scheme.

title_en: Electric power emergency automatic management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power emergency management, and relates to an electric power emergency automatic management system which comprises a real-time monitoring module, a central processing unit and a display module, wherein the real-time monitoring module is used for monitoring the equipment state and the line state in real time; the real-time monitoring module outputs monitoring signals, the monitoring signals are analyzed and processed by the central processing unit and then output control signals, and the central processing unit operates and controls the early warning reminding module, the emergency grade evaluation module, the emergency guarantee module and the display module through the control signals. The invention realizes real-time monitoring of monitoring item data, sets various early warning forms, sets emergency event grade evaluation, and scientifically dispatches emergency resources according to the severity grade of the emergency event; and the emergency resources are updated in real time, so that the capability of the power system for preventing and treating the power emergency is improved.

title_en: Mountain region calamity early warning device of community
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community mountain disaster early warning device which comprises a base station column and monitoring rods arranged on a mountain, wherein a central control module is arranged on the base station column, the input end of the central control module is respectively connected with a wireless receiving module, a monitoring module, a rainfall monitoring module and a river water level monitoring module and a picture synthesis comparison module, the output end of the central control module is respectively connected with a display module, an alarm module and a voice broadcasting module, a data processing module is arranged on the monitoring rods, the input end of the data processing module is respectively connected with a data acquisition module and a power supply module connecting block, the output end of the data processing module is connected with a wireless transmission module, and the wireless transmission module is connected with the wireless receiving module. Data acquisition module on the monitoring pole carries out real-time supervision to mountain body each side data, if data take place unusually, alarm module sends the police dispatch newspaper with the voice broadcast module, and the suggestion community people withdraws fast, has the intelligence to mountain region calamity monitoring, high-efficient and quick early warning's characteristics.

title_en: Compact local operation pannel
title_ko: 콤팩트 현장조작반
abstract_en: Although a conventional industrial site operating panel is intermittently operated, installation costs are too high and installation spaces are too big, thereby a space usability and safety are compromised and the conventional site operating panel is limited in terms of a kind of operator information, availabilities, and distances. To solve the above-mentioned problems, circuits are miniaturized, the size of the site operating panel is reduced, and operator information is diversified. A main frame (41) is added in a motor control panel (20) and information for the site operating panel and an alarm lamp (60) is transmitted to and received from the site operating panel (10) in a digital format via a dedicated cable. Therefore, the motor control panel (20), site operating panel (10), and alarm lamp (60) are integrated in one system. A specialized system, which is 100% compatible with specific sites without modifying conventional circuits and configured to be 1:1 matched with loads, is thus provided according to the present invention, such that construction and maintenance costs are reduced. A machinery room is provided to improve accessibility of operators. The site operating panel is installed in various ways such as on walls or ceilings as well as on grounds, such that installation convenience is improved and negligent accidents are prevented. A voice alarm and the alarm lamp are installed, such that a remote status monitoring is enabled. abstract_ko:
일반적으로 산업용으로 사용되는 현장조작반은 간헐적으로 운전되는 용도에 비하여 시설 비용이 많고 공간차지가 너무 많아서 공간의 활용성과 안전에 문제가 있어왔으며 운전자정보의 종류 및 수단과 거리에 있어서도 극히 제한적이었다. 
위 문제를 해결하기 위하여 회로를 소 세력화하여 선로 및 현장조작반의 크기를 줄이고 운전자 정보를 다양화하였다

그래서 본 발명은 위의 문제점을 개선하기 위하여 부하와 1:1로 구성되고 기존의 회로와도 변경없이 100%호환되는 현장과 꼭맞는 특성화된 시스템을 개발하여 공사비 및 유지관리비를 절감하고 기계실 공간을 확보, 작업자에게 편리한 접근성을 제공하고, 시공방법에서도 지상설치만 가능한 것을 벽걸이 또는 천정걸이 형식 등 다양한 방법으로 설치할 수 있도록 하여 설치의 편리성 및 전기안전사고를 방지하도록 하였으며, 음성경보 및 경광등을 설치할 수 있도록 하여 원거리에서도 상태를 감시할 수 있도록 하는 시스템이다.

title_en: Intelligent rescue bracelet device and method for water area
abstract_en: The invention designs an intelligent rescue bracelet device and method for a water area, belonging to the technical field of self-help rescue of personnel in the water area; the emergency life-saving device comprises a pulse data acquisition module, a body temperature data acquisition module, a water pressure test acquisition module, a data processing module, a life-saving device and release control module, an emergency warning module and a wireless alarm signal transmission module; the modules are integrated on the intelligent bracelet in a compact design mode; the device can collect wearing personnel and water area conditions in real time, and is provided with three versions, so that the device has three rescue modes which can be selected, the device realizes data collection and remote data transmission, effective rescue measures are designed, and the safety of water area workers is ensured.

title_en: Landslide safety early warning method and equipment based on reservoir water level dip
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide safety early warning method and device based on a sudden drop of a reservoir water level, wherein the method establishes the relation between the sudden drop amplitude of the reservoir water level and the penetration rate and the safety coefficient of a landslide plastic region according to an actual water level scheduling scheme and by combining analysis such as geological conditions, engineering experience analogy, numerical calculation, safety coefficient discrimination and the like, and determines a critical drop amplitude value according to the penetration rate and the standard requirement of the design safety coefficient of the sudden drop of the reservoir water level so as to determine the early warning value of the sudden drop amplitude of the reservoir water level. The system is clear in concept, convenient to operate and wide in application range, and can be suitable for the disaster prevention and reduction application of landslide caused by reservoir water level suddenly drop in a watershed reservoir. According to the invention, landslide safety can be checked regularly with the guidance of environmental protection and disaster prevention and reduction, the reservoir water level early warning value is updated, and the reservoir water level early warning signal is issued, so that the landslide safety early warning and forecasting technical method based on reservoir water level suddenly drop is formed.

title_en: Roof subgrade formwork tunnel roof collapse early warning system and disaster-critical safety intelligent control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roof, roadbed, die carrier, tunnel roof collapse early warning system and disaster-critical intelligent control method, comprising the steps of arranging a pressure sensor on the upper surface of a roof/arch shell or the lower end of a vertical rod; and/or a deformation sensor is arranged on the lower surface of the roof/template/arch shell and/or the lower surface of the transverse member, or a deformation sensor is arranged on the guardrail; and/or providing a ranging sensor on the roof/form/arch and/or the lower surface of the cross member and/or the ground; and a loudspeaker and/or a warning lamp and/or a warning applet or APP are arranged; or an invisible door opening and an escape facility are arranged on the wall, and an automatic opening device or an automatic braking device is arranged under the road surface and/or on the vehicle; or simultaneously installing a fire-fighting tool on the wall and/or the roof; when the pressure measured value is more than or equal to the early warning value and/or the deformation measured value is more than or equal to the early warning value and/or the distance decrement measuring value is more than or equal to the early warning value, the system controller starts an acousto-optic alarm to prompt personnel to withdraw or prompt the vehicle to actively stop traveling; or the invisible door opening and the escape facility are opened at the same time to provide quick evacuation.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction and early warning method and system combining monitoring data and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster prediction and early warning method and system combining monitoring data and numerical simulation, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, the invention forms a standardized data matrix by laying a plurality of sensors in a geological disaster prone area and preprocessing the data, constructs a catastrophe structure map, calculates the side weight of each variable as a map node, generates a sparse weighted adjacent matrix through threshold screening, updates node characteristics by adopting a neural network, the current catastrophe state is identified through the probability distribution of the full-connection layer output catastrophe stage, the coupling strength index is calculated, similarity matching is carried out, the coupling strength and the structural similarity are comprehensively evaluated, the graph migration weight is obtained, the critical variable threshold value and the time are further predicted, the critical parameter and the neural network identification result are fused to construct a unified risk index model, early warning information and corresponding measures are issued according to the risk grade division, and the structural fusion and dynamic intelligent identification of the multi-source data are realized.

title_en: Escaping apparatus for tall building
