title_en: In-vehicle Air Cleaning Device for Providing Traffic Accident Emergency Rescue Service
title_ko: 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air purifying device for providing emergency dispatch service in case of a traffic accident and, more specifically, to an air purifying device which is provided with an air purifying module in which a photocatalyst panel and a UV lamp unit are arranged and an operation module including an acoustic wave module and a communication module. To this end, the present invention comprises a near-field module, a position module, a sensor module, and a control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치에 따르면, 광촉매 물질을 코팅한 복수의 규소 성분 구슬들을 패널 형태로 집적 성형한 지정 개수의 광촉매 패널과 UV(UltraViolet)-A 파장 대역의 UV를 방출하는 지정 개수의 UV램프부를 지정된 기하학적 관계로 배치한 공기정화모듈을 구비하고, 상기 공기정화모듈을 통해 차량 내부의 공기 정화를 운영하면서 차량내의 상황을 인식하여 서비스를 제공하기 위해 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 운영모듈이 구비된 공기정화장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보와 상기 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상을 통해 센싱된 방향정보를 하나 이상 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 실제 교통사고 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 교통사고 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보를 발화한 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하고 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Information pushing method and device and fire fighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information pushing method and device and a fire fighting system. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: receiving early warning information, wherein the early warning information is generated by fire early warning equipment during early warning; the method comprises the steps of pushing early warning information to a first preset object, and adding a first expiration mechanism for pushing operation; based on the feedback state of the first predetermined object to the early warning information within the time period corresponding to the expiration mechanism, sending the first predetermined information to the second predetermined object, and adding a second expiration mechanism for the sending operation; and determining whether to send the second predetermined information to the third predetermined object based on the feedback state of the second predetermined object to the first predetermined information within a time period corresponding to the second expiration mechanism. The invention solves the technical problem that the fire monitoring center in the related technology can not efficiently acquire the warning situation because the fire alarm hierarchical pushing can not be realized.
assignees: ZHONG XIAO YUN BEIJING IOT TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting early-warning emergency response coordination method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a fire-fighting early-warning emergency response coordination method and a fire-fighting early-warning emergency response coordination system, which are applied to the technical field of information processing, wherein the platform can understand and process emergency data from different departments by converting original data into a standard data format, so that information islands are eliminated, the information in an emergency resource information base is always updated in real time, an accurate basis is provided for emergency decision, various factors can be comprehensively considered through a resource allocation algorithm based on a mathematical model, and the optimal resource combination, quantity and action path scheme can be calculated, so that the efficiency and accuracy of resource allocation are improved. And by updating the emergency resource information base, the accuracy and the instantaneity of the resource information are ensured, and support is provided for subsequent emergency response. Therefore, the scheme provided by the application has the advantage of realizing centralized and intelligent allocation of cross-department cross-regional emergency resources.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHICHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A method of providing an emergency alert function using smartphone and earphone
title_ko: 스마트폰과 이어폰을 이용한 긴급상황 알림 기능 제공 방법
abstract_en: The method for providing an emergency alerting function using a smartphone and an earphone is performed by interlocking a user terminal (100) with an ear socket wherein the earphone (300) is connected where a user application (110) is installed and a protector terminal (200) wherein a protector application (210) is installed. The method for providing the emergency alerting function using the smartphone and the earphone includes: a connection recognizing step (S111) recognizing that the earphone (300) is normally connected to the ear socket by performing the user application (110); a disconnection recognizing step (S112) of recognizing a timing that the earphone (300) is disconnected from the ear socket; a first distinguishing step (S113) checking whether or not the disconnected earphone is returned to the normal connection state within a predetermined time period; a second distinguishing step (S115) of checking whether or not preset passwords or patterns are accurately inputted within a predetermined time period; an emergency recognizing step (S117) recognizing that a user is in an emergency situation; a coordinate transmitting step (S118) of generating latitude and longitude values and transmitting an SMS to the protector terminal (200); a protector application performing step (S211) of performing the protector application (210); a location information displaying step (S212) extracting information of a users location and displaying a map wherein the users location and address are displayed on a screen; and a reporting step (S213) of transmitting the location information and a reporting message to appropriate authorities. Accordingly, an effect of rapidly ensuring the safety of the user by conveniently determining the emergency situation of the user is obtained.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트폰과 이어폰을 이용한 긴급상황 알림 기능 제공 방법에 관한 것으로서, 이어폰(300)이 접지되는 이어잭이 구비되고 사용자앱(110)이 설치된 사용자측 단말기(100)와, 보호자앱(210)이 설치된 보호자측 단말기(200)를 상호 연동하여 이루어지고; 
상기 사용자앱(110)의 실행으로 이어폰(300)이 이어잭에 정상 접지상태임을 인식하는 접지인식단계(S111); 이어폰(300)이 이어잭에서 접지해제된 시점을 인식하는 접지해제인식단계(S112); 일정 시간 내에 정상 접지상태로 복귀 여부를 확인하는 제1차식별단계(S113); 일정 시간 내에 기설정된 비밀번호 또는 패턴의 정확한 입력 여부를 확인하는 제2차식별단계(S115); 사용자가 긴급상황에 직면한 것으로 인식하는 긴급상황인식단계(S117); 위·경도 수치를 생성하고 보호자측 단말기(200)에 SMS를 전송하는 좌표전송단계(S118); 보호자앱(210)이 실행되는 보호자앱실행단계(S211); 사용자의 위치정보를 추출하고 화면상에 사용자 위치와 주소가 표시된 지도를 디스플레이 하는 위치정보표시단계(S212); 신고기관으로 위치정보와 함께 신고메시지를 전송하는 신고단계(S213)를 포함하여 이루어짐에 따라 사용자의 긴급상황을 간편하게 식별하여 안전을 신속히 확보하도록 하는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Whole-network early warning protection system based on mobile interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a whole-network early warning protection system based on mobile interconnection. The whole-network early warning protection system is formed by a plurality of wireless probes, a server, owner mobile equipment, a property computer, and a fire-fighting department computer, each wireless probe is provided with a camera capable of rotating for 360 degrees and a mobile network communication module, when the probes detect abnormal high temperature or heavy smoke, a communication network is automatically started, alarm information is transmitted to the server, the server confirms the position of the alarm information and sends the information to the property computer or the owner mobile equipment, property personnel or the owner starts the cameras to observe the field, the alarm is cancelled or the alarm instruction to the fire-fighting department is transmitted to a background server via the mobile equipment or the property computer according to the actual condition, and the background server cancels the alarm or transmits the alarm instruction to the fire-fighting department in a wireless manner. According to the whole-network early warning protection system, wireless transmission and real-time communication are realized, line laying is not needed, remote intelligent detection is realized, the owner, the property, and the fire-fighting department can be informed in time when fire alarms occur, and the loss is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Anti-collision system and method based on UE5
abstract_en: The application discloses a collision avoidance system and method based on UE5, which belong to the technical field of port collision avoidance, and comprise a production visualization module, a control module and a control module, wherein the production visualization module is used for carrying out three-dimensional modeling on a scene through a UE5 technical model to obtain a three-dimensional virtual wharf, carrying out management interaction in the three-dimensional virtual wharf and carrying out dynamic update on the motion state of operation equipment according to the acquisition frequency of data of each control system; the platform module of the Internet of things is used for connecting an automatic control system, collecting information data of the PLC and each sensing unit, dividing the wharf into four categories according to the information data, and carrying out merging, classifying and managing so as to form a wharf control data resource pool; the data model analysis module is used for analyzing and obtaining anti-collision early warning information according to the three-dimensional virtual wharf and a pre-constructed AI anti-collision early warning analysis model, feeding the anti-collision early warning information back to a user through a visual means, and constructing the AI anti-collision early warning analysis model according to data provided by a wharf control data resource pool; the application realizes effective anti-collision.

title_en: Low-pressure water-based fire extinguishing system using multi-valve
title_ko: 멀티밸브를 이용한 저압식 수계 소화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a low-pressure water-based fire extinguishing system using a multi-valve, which minimizes damage and malfunction of a sprinkler head, a valve, a pipe, and various firefighting devices, as well as minimizes damage by discharging a minimum flow rate when the sprinkler head is opened due to malfunction. The low-pressure water-based fire extinguishing system using a multi-valve comprises: a spray unit installed in a structure to cause a fire pump to spray water for extinguishing a fire; a flowing water control valve controlling the supply of water from the fire pump to the spray unit; and a multi-control valve installed between the fire pump and the flowing water control valve, allowing the pressure of the front end to maintain the setting pressure of the first pump at normal times, as well as reducing the setting pressure applied from the rear end to the flowing water control valve, and receiving a signal from a fire alarm panel when a fire is detected, and releasing the reduction of the setting pressure applied from the rear end to the flowing water control valve.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 진압을 위해 소방펌프에 의해 물을 분사하도록 구조물에 설치되는 분사부; 상기 소방펌프로부터 상기 분사부에 대한 물의 공급을 제어하는 유수제어밸브; 및 상기 소방펌프와 상기 유수제어밸브 사이에 설치되고, 평상시 전단의 압력이 상기 소방펌프의 세팅압력을 유지하도록 함과 아울러, 후단부터 상기 상기 유수제어밸브 측으로 가해지는 상기 세팅압력을 감소시키며, 화재 감지시 화재 경보 패널로부터 신호를 수신받아 상기 후단부터 상기 유수제어밸브 측으로 가해지는 상기 세팅압력의 감소를 해제시키는 멀티콘트롤밸브;를 포함하도록 한 멀티밸브를 이용한 저압식 수계 소화 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 전자식 감압변에 해당하는 멀티콘트롤밸브를 통해 소방용 밸브에 걸리는 압력을 낮게 유지하여, 소방용 밸브에 걸리는 부하를 종전보다 현격히 줄여 내구성을 향상시키고, 소방용 밸브의 장기간 사용이 가능하도록 수명을 연장시키며, 낮은 압력으로 유지된 상태에서 소방용 밸브가 개방되면 낮은 압력에서 서서히 개방되기에 수충격 현상이 현저히 줄어 소방용 밸브, 각종 기기, 배관 내 시스템이 보호되어 인명 사고 또는 각종 위험성으로부터 벗어날 수 있고, 소방펌프와 소방용 밸브 사이에 전자식 감압변에 해당하는 멀티콘트롤밸브가 설치됨으로써, 이후의 소방용 밸브 및 배관 자재의 사양을 저압력으로 설치할 수 있도록 하여, 자재비와 인건비를 크게 절감시키는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: A kind of subway seismic data information collection and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of subway seismic data information collection and method for early warning and system, including seismic wave information collecting device, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, for the device of reference threshold, the determination device of early warning program starting, positioning device, control vehicle device, storage device and control device for controlling train speed of dynamic generation seismic risk, core of the control module as whole system, on the one hand the operation of aforementioned each device is controlled, on the other hand for being attached realization communication and control with external equipments such as external computer installations.In the present invention, reference threshold for seismic risk assessment is using dynamic generation by the way of, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after newest early warning occurs, to be compared with historical data, risk Pre-Evaluation that is more complete and scientifically considering a certain area.The present invention also provides a kind of subway seismic data information collection and method for early warning and systems.

title_en: Multifunctional electroacoustic calling device and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional electroacoustic calling device and a using method thereof, wherein the multifunctional electroacoustic calling device comprises a microcontroller, a key module, a toxic gas sensor array, a voice prompt module, a Bluetooth audio module, a sound pick-up, a power amplification module, a miniature loudspeaker, a calling main cavity, a power supply module, a battery bin, a sensor assembling cavity, an assembling plate, a charging interface, an expiration cavity, a loudspeaker interface and a positioning module; the invention can monitor and early warn various environmental gases while completing sound amplification, and form gas data sharing through the Bluetooth networking of a plurality of electroacoustic devices, further realize the multi-point dynamic monitoring of the gas concentration in an operation area, and early warn the failure time of a filter by combining a timer, thereby realizing the real-time monitoring and early warning of the gas mask filter; the next moving route of the user can be pre-warned according to the regional gas concentration data of the operation site; rescue and evacuation routes may be effectively indicated when the filter is about to reach or has exceeded a threshold.
assignees: HUBEI HUAQIANG HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional self-retracting type fence rod
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional self-retracting type rail, which comprises: rail subassembly, detection alarm unit and power supply unit. The fence assembly comprises a first telescopic unit and a second telescopic unit which are buried under the site of the live working area, and when the first telescopic unit and the second telescopic unit are both expanded and extend to the upper part of the ground, an isolation fence is formed between the first telescopic unit and the second telescopic unit; the detection alarm units are arranged in two groups, are respectively arranged at the tops of the first telescopic unit and the second telescopic unit and are used for performing sound-light alarm after detecting personnel entering the live working area; the power supply unit is installed on the ground of the live working area. The multifunctional self-recovery type fence rod provided by the invention can be permanently installed on the site of a live working area, and a warning net does not need to be installed and arranged manually in each maintenance operation, so that the investment of manpower and material resources is effectively saved, and the progress of the maintenance operation can be improved.
assignees: MAANSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Cross-machine-room database disaster recovery method and system based on network quality monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery method and a system for a cross-machine room database based on network quality monitoring, which are characterized in that a ping-exporter binary file is distributed to a source host and is modified to serve as a system, a startup self-starting is set, a ping-exporter configuration file is dynamically modified according to monitoring task parameters, monitoring settings are updated, real-time network quality data is pulled by using Prometaus, an alarm is generated according to an alarm rule, and the alarm is pushed to an alert manager; the used components are mature, the deployment mode is simple, users can timely find out network data abnormality to react, loss caused by network faults is effectively reduced, and human resource cost is reduced.

title_en: Material pile real-time monitoring and early warning method in loading process based on 3d point cloud
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of stockpile monitoring, in particular to a stockpile real-time monitoring and early warning method in a loading process based on 3d point cloud, which comprises the following steps: s1: scanning the material pile through a 3D laser scanner to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data of the material pile; s2: calculating according to the three-dimensional point cloud data to obtain optimal material taking and loading positions; s3: in the material taking and loading process, data of material pile deformation and displacement in the material taking process are obtained through a 3d laser scanner, the material pile is monitored in real time, the data of the material pile deformation and displacement are calculated, material pile change trend data are obtained, analysis is carried out according to the material pile change trend data, early warning is sent to technicians according to analysis results, early warning is carried out on site workers through a loudspeaker and an alarm lamp, and therefore the on-site workers can withdraw from a landslide in time conveniently.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG XINJINSHAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for positioning and monitoring hidden danger of landslide of strip mine
abstract_en: The method, the system, the equipment and the medium for positioning and monitoring the landslide hidden danger of the strip mine belong to the technical field of monitoring geological disasters of the mine, and solve the problems of low accuracy of the existing landslide identification and the positioning precision of the core point of the landslide hidden danger; the method and the device have the advantages that the single monitoring unilateral performance is avoided through integrating multidimensional data such as displacement, stress and inclination angle, the landslide hidden danger characteristics can be comprehensively captured, the spatial correlation and time sequence trend characteristics are extracted through the CNN-LSTM model, the identification accuracy of the landslide hidden danger is improved, sub-meter level positioning of the core point of the landslide hidden danger is achieved through combining feature matching and triangular positioning, accurate targets are provided for treatment, early warning information is pushed according to risk level differentiation, the risk level is updated based on real-time monitoring data, and dynamic change of the landslide hidden danger is adapted.
assignees: HEFEI INST FOR PUBLIC SAFETY RESERCH TSINGHUA UNIVERSITY

title_en: Two-factor authentication door lock
title_ko: 이중인증 기반의 도어락 제어 방법 및 이중인증 도어락
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for controlling a door lock based on two-factor authentication and a two-factor authentication door lock, and more particularly, is to allow a locked state of a door to be released when a user′s additional authentication is not conducted, so the user can get help from outsiders (acquaintance, neighbor, guard, security company staff, policeman, fireman, etc.) in emergencies. In particular, if indoor authentication is not conducted for a certain period, the present invention is capable of requesting external help by using an automatic connection function of a voice call along with an alarm, thereby protecting the user′s property and body in emergencies. In particular, the present invention has an advantage in obtaining sufficient security and crime prevention effects by means of a low-cost device for use in areas vulnerable to crime, such as female-only studio apartments where women live alone, of which residents are easily exposed to physical danger and face difficulty when operating expensive crime-prevention systems. Thus, the present invention may enhance reliability and competitiveness not only in door locks and crime prevention fields, especially, security and crime prevention fields using door locks, but also fields similar and related thereto.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이중인증 기반의 도어락 제어 방법 및 이중인증 도어락에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 추가인증이 이루어지지 않을 경우 도어의 잠금상태가 해제상태로 전환되도록 함으로써, 비상상황에서 외부인(지인, 이웃, 경비원, 보안업체직원, 경찰, 소방관 등)에게 도움을 받을 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
특히, 본 발명은 일정시간 동안 실내측인증이 이루어지지 않을 경우에는 경보음과 함께 음성통화의 자동연결기능 등을 이용하여 외부에 도움을 요청함으로써, 비상상황에서 사용자의 재산 및 신체를 보호할 수 있다. 
특히, 본 발명은 여성이 혼자 거주하는 여성전용원룸 등과 같이, 신체적으로 위험에 노출되기 쉬우면서 고가의 방법 시스템을 운용하기에 어려움이 있는 방범취약 거주지역에 대해서도, 저가의 장치로 충분한 보안 및 방범효과를 얻을 수 있는 장점이 있다. 
따라서, 도어락 분야, 보안 및 방범 분야, 특히 도어락을 이용한 보안 및 방범 분야는 물론, 이와 유사 내지 연관된 분야에서 신뢰성 및 경쟁력을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Moving Robot and controlling method
title_ko: 이동 로봇 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile robot and a mobile robot control method. The mobile robot monitors a cleaning region by capturing an image while moving in a plurality of regions based on a map of the cleaning region. With the present invention, monitoring can be performed with a plurality of regions or a specific region designated. It is possible to monitor the entire region by capturing an image while rotating at a monitoring position by designating the monitoring position in the region. It is possible to set a specific position as the monitoring position in the region and perform imaging at a specific imaging angle with a monitoring direction designated at the monitoring position. Monitoring can be performed on a plurality of regions with a minimum movement. It is possible to capture an image of a blind spot by changing or adding the monitoring position based on obstacle information, and thus effective monitoring can be performed. A schedule can be set for monitoring at a specified time, and intrusion can be detected based on image analysis-based obstacle recognition. In the event of intrusion, a warning is output and an intrusion detection signal is transmitted, and thus security can be enhanced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 이동 로봇 및 그 제어방법은, 청소영역에 대한 지도를 바탕으로 복수의 영역을 이동하면서 영상을 촬영하여 청소영역을 감시하는 것으로, 복수의 영역 또는 특정 영역을 지정하여 감시를 수행할 수 있고, 영역 내에서 감시위치를 지정하여 감시위치에서 회전하면서 영상을 촬영하여 영역 전반에 대한 감시가 가능하고, 영역 내에서 특정 위치를 감시위치로 설정할 수 있고, 감시위치에서 감시방향을 지정하여 특정 촬영각도로 영상이 촬영되도록 할 수 있고, 최소한의 이동으로 복수의 영역에 대한 감시를 수행할 수 있으며, 장애물 정보를 바탕으로 감시위치를 변경하거나 추가하여 사각지대에 대한 영상을 촬영할 수 있어 효과적인 감시가 가능하며 지정된 시간에 감시를 수행하도록 스케줄을 설정할 수 있고, 영상을 분석하여 장애물을 인식함으로써 침입 여부를 감지할 수 있고, 침입감지시 경고를 출력하고, 침입감지에 대한 신호를 전송하여 보안기능이 강화되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Safety device for Change lane of two-wheeled vehicle
title_ko: 이륜차량의 차선변경 시 안전장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety device for lane change of a two-wheeled vehicle, which warns a rider of the presence of a vehicle in the case that the vehicle is detected on a rear side or side in a lane changing direction when a turn signal is operated, a handle bar is turned more than a predetermined angle, or the two-wheeled vehicle is laid down in one direction in order to change a lane during riding, such that a collision accident with an adjacent vehicle is prevented in lane change. According to the present invention, the safety device for lane change of a two-wheeled vehicle comprises: a turn signal device (10) to detect an operation direction when operating the turn signal; an inclination sensor (20) to detect a state that the two-wheeled vehicle is inclined to a left or right side more than a predetermined angle; a turning detection sensor (30) to detect a state that the handle bar of the two-wheeled vehicle is turned to a left or right side more than a predetermined angle; a rear sensor (40) installed on the rear side of the two-wheeled vehicle to detect an approaching object; a control unit (50) to operate a vibration means (60) when a detection signal in accordance with the lane change is detected from any one or more of the turn signal device (10), the inclination sensor (20), and the turning detection sensor (30), and at the same time, an adjacent object is detected in a lane change direction through the rear sensor (40); and the vibration means (60) disposed on the handle bar to be vibrated by an operation command of the control unit (50) so as to transfer vibration to the handle bar.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 운행 중 차선을 변경하기 위하여 방향지시등을 작동시킬 때, 또는 일정한 각도 이상으로 핸들을 돌리거나 한쪽 방향으로 차량을 눕힐 때, 차선 변경하는 방향으로 후방 또는 측면에 차량이 감지되는 경우, 운전자에게 이를 경보하여 차선 변경 시 발생되는 인접 차량과의 충돌 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 한 이륜차량의 차선변경 시 안전장치에 관한 것으로, 방향지시등 작동 시 작동방향을 감지하는 방향지시등장치(10); 이륜차량이 좌측 또는 우측으로 일정각도 이상 기울어진 상태를 감지하는 기울기센서(20); 이륜차량의 핸들이 좌측 또는 우측으로 일정각도 이상 회전한 상태를 감지하는 회전감지센서(30); 이륜차량의 후방에 설치되어 근접하는 물체를 감지하는 후방감지센서(40); 상기 방향지시등장치(10), 기울기센서(20) 및 회전감지센서(30) 중 어느 하나 이상에서 차선 변경에 따른 감지신호가 검출되고 동시에 상기 후방감지센서(40)를 통해 차선을 변경하고자 하는 방향으로 인접된 물체가 검출되면 진동수단(60)을 구동시켜주는 제어부(50); 및 핸들에 형성되어 상기 제어부(50)의 구동명령에 따라 진동 동작하여 핸들로 진동을 전달하는 진동수단(60)을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 이륜차량의 차선변경 시 안전장치.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting data visual monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting data visual monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof, relating to the technical field of fire-fighting safety, wherein the system comprises: a data analysis module; a data model comprising a device model and an interface model; wisdom screen. The method comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing and classifying the specific content of the fire fighting equipment in response to the received fire fighting equipment state message; s2, responding to the classified fire fighting equipment status messages to monitor the fire fighting equipment status messages, and triggering early warning when the status messages change or are abnormal; s3, responding to the early warning to update the state of the fire fighting equipment; and S4, displaying the message processed in the step S3. The invention realizes the real-time monitoring of the state of the fire-fighting facility through the remote multi-dimensional visual monitoring technology; the life cycle and the state information of the fire-fighting equipment are analyzed in real time by using a data model analysis technology, so that the safety diagnosis, intelligent early warning and accurate maintenance of the fire-fighting equipment are realized, and the fire-fighting guarantee cost is reduced.
assignees: JIANGXI INTELLIGENT INDUSTRIAL TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Intelligent safety early warning protection signal device system with non-centralized area
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent safety early warning protection signal device system with a non-centralized area, and belongs to the field of railway safety production protection. The system comprises a handheld management terminal, an electronic guard board unit, a station safety control unit and a remote dispatching safety control unit; the invention satisfies the monitoring and file management of the railway safety protection signal installation and withdrawal operation links; the safety mutual control function of the upper road setting and lower road removing state of the protection signal and the safety mutual control function of the wireless car light display device of the railway are realized in an image-text and voice mode, the stock way entrance early warning and the protection are carried out on the upper road setting and lower road removing state of the protection signal, and the safety risk prevention and control are carried out from the source of the device. The real-time protection and control of the safety of vehicles and operators are realized, the property safety of locomotives and vehicles and the life safety of operators are ensured, meanwhile, the safety protection operation efficiency of railway production is improved, the labor cost and the labor intensity of conventional safety protection operation are reduced, and meanwhile, the production safety accidents caused by human factors can be avoided.
assignees: KUNMING JUNXUN SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent movable warning illumination triangular cone autonomous obstacle avoidance system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic control, and discloses an intelligent movable warning lighting triangular cone autonomous obstacle avoidance system and method; the traffic flow data acquisition method comprises the steps of obtaining ideal relative positions corresponding to each triangular pyramid, forming an initial flow guiding line formation by the triangular pyramid groups, activating first light effects, initializing and constructing a local pheromone map by the triangular pyramids, collecting traffic flow data, analyzing and obtaining local traffic pressure, further obtaining broadcasting signals, continuously receiving and analyzing the broadcasting signals of adjacent triangular pyramids in a communication range by the triangular pyramids, carrying out attenuation update to obtain updated pheromone maps, adjusting corresponding warning light effects, further analyzing and obtaining optimal movement warning instructions of the triangular pyramids, and realizing real-time accurate sensing of traffic jam states, dynamic adjustment of the flow guiding line formation to adapt to traffic flow changes, avoiding congestion aggravation, realizing visual congestion early warning through graded light effects, effectively reducing potential safety hazards and remarkably improving traffic guiding efficiency.

title_en: Citizen participating type public order monitoring and warning system and service system using thereof
title_ko: 시민 참여형 공공질서 감시경고시스템 및 이를 활용한 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a citizen participation type public order monitoring and warning system and a service system using the same. The present invention comprises: a terminal for requesting a public institution to install a monitoring device in a place where violations of public order have occurred or are likely to occur, controlling the monitoring device through an application, setting and changing the type of broadcasting and display of a warning sound and a warning message, the type of warning light, the number of times, and the time for violations of public order, and receiving the broadcasting and display of the warning sound and the warning message, lighting of the warning light, and the number and time related thereto from the monitoring device; a control server for providing an application that can set and change the number and time related to the broadcasting and display of the warning sound and the warning message emitted from the monitoring device for the terminal and the lighting of the warning light, receiving a monitoring signal from the monitoring device, and transmitting a set or changed recording file to the monitoring device when a request to set or change the warning message is received from the terminal; a monitoring device installed in a specific place at the request of the public institution from the terminal, monitoring violations of public order to broadcast and display the warning sound and the warning message according to the type and turn on the warning light, and transmitting signals thereof to the terminal and the control server; and a public institution server for receiving the request to install the monitoring device for a specific place through the terminal and receiving information on violations of public order by communicating with the terminal and the control server. Accordingly, it is possible to improve the effect of prohibiting violations of public order.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시민 참여형 공공질서 감시경고시스템 및 이를 활용한 서비스시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 공공기관에 대해 공공질서 위반 행위가 발생하고 있거나 발생할 염려가 있는 장소에 대하여 감시장치를 설치할 것으로 요청하고, 앱을 통해 감시장치를 제어할 수 있으며, 공공질서 위반 행위에 대한 경고음 및 경고멘트 방송 및 디스플레이 종류와, 경고불빛 점등 종류와,  회수, 시간을 설정 및 변경이 가능하며, 경고음 및 경고멘트 방송 및 디스플레이와, 경고불빛 점등과, 이에 관련된 회수 및 시간을 감시장치로부터 전송받는 단말기; 단말기에 대해 감시장치로부터 방출되는 경고음 및 경고멘트 방송 및 디스플레이와, 경고불빛 점등에 관련된 횟수, 시간을 설정 및 변경할 수 있는 앱을 제공하고, 감시장치로부터 감시신호를 전송받으며, 단말기로부터 경고멘트를 설정 또는 변경할 것을 요청받을 경우 설정 또는 변경된 녹음 파일을 감시장치로 전송하는 관제서버; 단말기로부터 공공기관에 대한 요청에 의해 특정 장소에 설치되며, 공공질서 위반 행위를 감시하여 그 종류에 따른 경고음 및 경고멘트 방송 및 디스플레이와, 경고불빛 점등이 이루어지도록 하며, 단말기 및 관제서버에 이들 신호들을 전송하는 감시장치; 및 단말기를 통해 특정장소에 대한 감시장치를 설치할 것을 요청받고, 단말기 및 관제서버와 통신하여 공공질서 위반 행위에 대한 정보를 전송받는 공공기관 서버로 구성된다.

title_en: The system which provides a disater notification contents
title_ko: 재난 알림 콘텐츠 제공시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing disaster notification contents (DNCs). The present invention systematically arranges/provides computer modules that can collect various DNCs by communicating with a sending agency server within a communication structure of a DNC sending agency server, a user information device, and the like. Accordingly, it is possible to select and receive only valid DNCs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 알림 콘텐츠(DNC: Disater Notification Contents) 제공시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 DNC 발송 기관 서버, 사용자 정보기기 등의 통신 구조 내에, <DNC 발송 기관 서버와 통신하여, 각종 DNC를 수집할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <수집 완료된 DNC를 판독하여, DNC 관련 지역을 체크한 후, 체크된 DNC 관련 지역과 기 설정되어 있던 사용자 재난 관심 지역을 비교하여, 기 저장되어 있던 사용자들 중에서, 재난 관심 지역이 DNC 관련 지역과 일치하는 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정된 DNC 발송대상 사용자 목록을 판독한 후, 판독된 DNC 발송대상 사용자 목록에 포함된 사용자들이 보유한 사용자 정보기기로 DNC를 발송/처리할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치/제공함과 아울러, <재난 관심 지역이 DNC 관련 지역과 일치하는 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정하는 국면에서, 기 설정되어 있던 각 DNC 발송대상 사용자들의 '사용자 설정정보'를 판독하여, '사용자 설정 알림 제한 시간 정보'를 체크한 후, 현재의 시간이 '사용자 설정 알림 제한 시간'에 해당하는 일부 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들에서 제외시키는 기술구성>, <재난 관심 지역이 DNC 관련 지역과 일치하는 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정하는 국면에서, 기 저장되어 있던 각 DNC 발송대상 사용자들의 '사용자 DNC 수신 이력정보'를 판독하여, '이전 수신한 사용자의 DNC 버전 정보'를 체크한 후, '이전 수신한 DNC의 버전'이 '현재의 DNC 버전'과 동일한 일부 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들에서 제외시키는 기술구성> 등을 체계적으로 구현하고, 이를 통해, 사용자 측에서, '모든 DNC를 무분별하게 수신하는 것이 아니라, 자신이 설정한 관심 지역과 관련이 있는 유효 DNC만을 선별하여 수신할 수 있는 이점', '동일한 내용(버전)의 DNC를 중복하여 수신하지 않게 되는 이점', '자신이 설정한 알림 제한 시간에는 DNC의 수신을 차단할 수 있게 되는 이점' 등을 효과적으로 향유할 수 있도록 지원함과 아울러, DNC 발송 기관 측에서도, 'DNC 발송 효율 향상 이점(즉, DNC의 불필요한 발송 남발로 인하여, 정작 DNC의 수신이 필요한 사용자에게는 해당 DNC를 발송하지 못하게 되는 문제점의 해결)'을 효과적으로 향유할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Call response system based on public security field
abstract_en: The invention provides a call response system based on the public safety field, which relates to the technical field of public safety and comprises a monitoring module and a data acquisition module, wherein the monitoring module is used for collecting data collected by the monitoring module, the data analysis and processing module is used for analyzing and processing the primarily processed data, the AI intelligent emergency response module is used for automatically issuing accurate and clear information to the public through a preset trained AI model and a real-time updated machine learning algorithm, the early warning and alarm module is used for manually issuing an alarm through various communication channels, and the central control module is used for establishing a control center, the communication module and the management module.
assignees: HUAKE GUOXIN INT CULTURE BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure early warning method of power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure early warning method of a power transmission system, which belongs to the technical field of early warning of power systems and comprises the steps of S1, early warning data preparation, S2, early warning failure screening, S3, early warning grade judgment, S4, early warning execution, S, early warning information output and real-time dynamic update, wherein the early warning data preparation comprises multi-source data acquisition and analysis and quantitative characterization of power grid heterogeneous characteristics, the S2, early warning failure screening comprises simulation model construction and failure searching based on an accident chain, the S3, early warning grade judgment comprises risk value quantitative calculation and risk grade division. According to the cascading failure early warning method of the power transmission system, during operation, the heterogeneous phenomenon of a complex power grid with new energy grid connection in the aspects of operation conditions and grid structures is researched, characterization indexes reflecting the operation conditions of the power grid and the heterogeneous degree of the grid structures are constructed, meanwhile, a cascading failure process analysis model which comprehensively considers new energy and load fluctuation and is suitable for the working condition of a given power grid is built, the influence mechanism of the power grid heterogeneity on the cascading failure is researched, and the problem caused by new energy grid connection is well solved.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Disaster recovery system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster recovery system that keeps the online performance of a main site intact and prevents data loss even in a main site disaster by controlling the flow of transactions in several ten seconds before earthquake arrival with the use of earthquake early warning data.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster recovery system comprises an earthquake information reception means for receiving earthquake early warning data, a management server storing transaction control conditions, and a control agent running on an application server. When receiving the earthquake early warning data, the management server compares it with the preset transaction control conditions, and if any condition is met, instructs the control agent to stop updating transactions. The updating transactions are then stopped several seconds before earthquake arrival, and all the update log data generated by the updating transactions before the stop is transferred to a backup site before earthquake arrival.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: A sensor for tapping of access control system
title_ko: 출입자 경비시스템용 도청감지센서
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A tapping detection sensor for an entry security system is provided to transmit a tapping distrust signal to a central control center by linking the tapping detection sensor with the entry security system. CONSTITUTION: An antenna/sensor(11) receives wireless wave, the infrared wavelength, and laser wavelength. An inspecting line circuit(13) measures the public switched telephone network. If radio frequency having doubts to tapping is captured, or the change of the electrical characteristic of the line is detected, a controller(14) decides the confusion signal and transmits the confusion signal to display lamps(18,19) and output terminals(20,21). A data storage circuit(17) stores the radio frequency detected as the confusion signal, the infrared wavelength, and the laser wavelength or the wire line change value.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Municipal construction is with protection warning fence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protective warning fence for municipal construction, and relates to municipal equipment, which comprises a plurality of longitudinal vertical rods, wherein the bottoms of the longitudinal vertical rods are rotatably connected with a cross rod group through fixed blocks, the tops of the cross rod groups are respectively rotatably connected with sliding sleeves, the sliding sleeves are slidably connected with the longitudinal vertical rods, a fastening bolt is in threaded connection with the rear side of one sliding sleeve, the fastening bolt penetrates through the sliding sleeves to be matched with the longitudinal vertical rods, a warning banner is fixedly connected to the outer side above the middle longitudinal vertical rod, and the outer end of the warning banner is matched with the outer longitudinal vertical rod. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: the novel safety helmet is simple in structure and convenient to use, can play a warning role during use, avoids irrelevant people from crossing the device, meanwhile, adopts the warning banner for warning, effectively avoids safety accidents, can be folded in a retractable mode, greatly reduces occupied space when not in use, and is worthy of popularization.

title_en: Safety early warning method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety early warning method, a safety early warning device, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the received first basic safety information, taking an object within a preset distance of the vehicle as an object to be monitored; determining the early warning type and the early warning grade triggered by the vehicle by the object to be monitored according to the first basic safety information of the object to be monitored and the second basic safety information of the vehicle; updating the early warning type, the early warning grade and the first identification of the object to be monitored into an early warning field of second basic safety information; and performing independent early warning according to the early warning type and the early warning grade, and broadcasting the updated second basic safety information. Therefore, the vehicle can not only give an early warning when a distant vehicle and a pedestrian exist in the dead zone of the vehicle, but also give an early warning when the vehicle is in the dead zone of the distant vehicle and the pedestrian, so that the probability of traffic safety accidents of the vehicle and the pedestrian can be effectively reduced, and the traffic safety is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring early warning threshold self-adaptive generation device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring early warning threshold self-adaptive generation method which comprises the following steps of collecting historical collected data X  t‑n ...X t‑1 ,X t  of observed quantity, calculating an initial early warning threshold th  0  according to extremum theorem fitting, judging that the current state is an early warning state if X  t+1  is larger than the initial early warning threshold th  0  when the latest collected data X  t+1  of the observed quantity is reported, updating the initial early warning threshold th  0  to be th  1  if X  t+1  is smaller than the initial early warning threshold th  0  but larger than a peak value pe, and not performing any special treatment if X  t+1  is smaller than the peak value pe. According to the invention, through automatic updating of the early warning threshold value, in the subsequent monitoring process of geological disasters, if the rule and mode of the observed quantity change, the early warning threshold value generated at first can be updated dynamically and adaptively, so that the effectiveness of the early warning threshold value is effectively improved.

title_en: Early warning method and device for energy equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an early warning method and device for energy equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The early warning method for the energy equipment comprises the steps of collecting monitoring information of the energy equipment, analyzing the monitoring information, determining equipment load rate, equipment temperature abnormal value and equipment aging degree, determining hidden danger coefficient values according to the equipment load rate, the equipment temperature abnormal value and the equipment aging degree through a coefficient adjustment model, adjusting an initial hidden danger threshold range by utilizing the hidden danger coefficient values, respectively determining updated hidden danger threshold ranges corresponding to equipment load quantity and the equipment temperature value, comparing the equipment load quantity and the equipment temperature value at the current moment with the corresponding updated hidden danger threshold ranges, and carrying out early warning under the condition that the updated hidden danger threshold ranges are exceeded.

title_en: Climate change self-adaptive hydrologic prediction framework based on Bayesian deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bayesian deep learning-based climate change self-adaptive hydrologic prediction framework, and belongs to the technical field of hydrologic prediction and climate change adaptation. The framework comprises a multi-source data fusion input module, a Bayesian deep learning core framework, a arid and semi-arid region self-adaptive parameter adjustment algorithm and a prediction result output and decision support module, wherein the multi-source data module provides three-dimensional input of history, real time and climate scenes, the Bayesian LSTM framework realizes dynamic update and uncertainty quantification through probabilistic parameter modeling, the region self-adaptive algorithm pertinently optimizes the arid region parameter adjustment logic, and the output module generates high-precision prediction and hierarchical early warning. Aiming at the trend that the IPCC is wet in a wet area and dry in a dry area, the method solves the problem of prediction accuracy reduction caused by hydrologic rule deviation in the arid and semiarid area, and the actual measurement shows that the runoff prediction NSE is more than or equal to 0.85, the drought early warning accuracy reaches 82 percent, and the method can be widely applied to river basin runoff prediction, drought early warning and water resource optimal allocation and provides reliable technical support for the water resource management in the arid and semiarid area.

title_en: Urban waterlogging weather risk monitoring and early warning system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring and early warning, and discloses an urban waterlogging meteorological risk monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source data of a set monitoring area and preprocessing the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of constructing an urban waterlogging risk assessment index system according to the preprocessed multi-source data, calculating the weight of each specific index in the index system by adopting a DEMATEL-ANP combined method, dividing risk grades for each grid unit in a set monitoring area by utilizing fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, setting an early warning threshold grading table, calculating the area occupation ratio of each risk grade, and searching corresponding early warning grades by combining meteorological data. According to the invention, small-scale fine risk identification is realized by deeply fusing multiple types of data and coupling scientific assessment models, real-time data is combined to dynamically update and early-warn, an affected area and a disaster-bearing body are accurately positioned, the accuracy, the early-warn dynamics and the practicability of waterlogging weather risk monitoring are comprehensively improved, and the urban disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively enhanced.

title_en: Method of transmitting or receiving an updated warning message in mobile communication system
title_ko: 이동통신 시스템에서 갱신 경보 메시지를 송수신 하는 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An updated warning message transceiving method in a mobile communication system is provided to receive a disaster warning message only when the disaster warning message is updated, thereby efficiently using the power of a mobile terminal. CONSTITUTION: An SIB(System Information Block) is received from a network through a BCCH(Broadcast Control Channel). Update information for a disaster warning message is obtained from the received SIB. The update information is compared with update information saved in a mobile terminal. If the obtained update information is different from the saved update information, the warning message is received from the network.
