title_en: A security system for atm using face recognition and the method of using the same
title_ko: 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템 및 보안 방법
abstract_en: A security system for an ATM using a face recognition function according to the present invention includes: a camera which photographs the front image of the ATM; a display unit which is formed on the front of the ATM and displays a financial transaction service screen; and a control unit which controls the operations of the camera and the display unit and recognizes the face of a person from the image obtained through the camera by using a face recognition algorithm. If two or more faces are recognized on the image obtained through the camera, a warning screen is displayed to a user through the display unit. [Reference numerals] (310) Warning/Please note of the personal information leakage; (AA) User; (BB) Rear access; (CC) Transaction in progress; (DD) Deposit withdrawal; (EE) Account transfer; (FF) Additional service; (GG) Cancel
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템 및 보안 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 금융자동화기기의 전면에 구비된 카메라를 이용하여, 사용자가 금융자동화기기를 이용하는 경우, 카메라를 통해 금융자동화기기 전방의 영상을 획득하고, 얼굴인식기능을 통해 획득된 영상에 나타나는 얼굴을 인식하여, 획득된 영상에서 2인 이상의 얼굴이 인식되면, 사용자 이외의 배후접근자와 금융자동화기기 간의 거리를 감지하여, 배후접근자가 금융자동화기기로부터 일정 거리 이내에 일정 시간 이상 존재하는 것이 감지되면, 금융자동화기기의 디스플레이 화면을 통해 사용자에게 배후접근자가 있음을 알리는 경고 메시지를 제공하는 동시에, 경고음을 출력하여 배후접근자가 금융자동화기기, 즉 사용자의 배후로부터 일정 거리 이상 떨어지도록 유도함으로써, 사용자의 개인정보 유출을 방지함은 물론, 배후접근자의 범행 시도를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템 및 보안 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템에 있어서, 금융자동화기기에 구비되어 상기 금융자동화기기 전방의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라; 금융자동화기기 전면에 구비되어 금융거래 서비스화면을 표시하는 디스플레이부; 및 상기 카메라 및 디스플레이부의 동작을 제어하며, 얼굴인식 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 카메라를 통해 획득된 영상에서 사람의 얼굴을 인식하는 제어부;를 포함하여 구성되어, 상기 카메라로부터 획득되는 영상에서 2인 이상의 얼굴이 인식되는 경우, 상기 디스플레이부를 통해 사용자에게 배후접근자의 존재를 알려주는 경고화면을 표시하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Device for automatically deciding of carrying-in/carrying-out proscribed goods using machine learning
title_ko: 머신 러닝을 이용한 반입/반출 금지물 자동 판별 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for automatically distinguishing a carry in-out prohibited item by using machine learning. The present invention includes: a baggage image generation unit generating a transmission image with respect to baggage by scanning the baggage; a generalized image generation unit generating a generalized image of the baggage by machine learning from the transmission image of the baggage generated by the baggage image generation unit; a prohibited item image storage unit storing an image of a carry in-out prohibited item in the baggage; an image determination unit comparing the image of the prohibited item with one among the transmission image of the baggage and the generalized image and determining the baggage as a prohibited item when the degree of similarity between the prohibited item image and the baggage image is equal to or higher than a set value; a prohibited item notification unit notifying a user of the fact that the baggage is a prohibited item when the baggage is determined as a prohibited item; and an image update unit updating the prohibited item image storage unit when the baggage is a prohibited item such that one among the transmission image of the baggage and the generalized image is additionally stored as an image of a prohibited item matching the baggage stored in the prohibited item image storage unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 머신 러닝을 이용한 반입/반출 금지물 자동 판별 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 수하물을 스캔하여 해당 수하물에 대한 투과 이미지를 생성하는 수하물 이미지 생성부; 상기 수하물 이미지 생성부에서 생성된 수하물의 투과 이미지를 머신 러닝을 이용하여 해당 수하물에 대한 일반화 이미지를 생성하는 일반화 이미지 생성부; 상기 수하물 중 반입 및 반출 금지물의 이미지를 저장하는 금지물 이미지 저장부; 상기 수하물의 투과 이미지 및 일반화 이미지 중 어느 하나의 이미지와, 상기 금지물의 이미지를 서로 비교하여 수하물 이미지와 금지물 이미지의 유사도가 설정값 이상인 경우 해당 수하물을 금지물로 판별하는 이미지 판별부; 상기 수하물이 금지물로 판별된 경우, 사용자에게 해당 수하물이 금지물임을 알리는 금지물 알림부; 및 상기 수하물이 금지물로 판별된 경우, 상기 수하물의 투과 이미지 및 일반화 이미지 중 어느 하나를 금지물 이미지 저장부에 저장된 해당 수하물과 매칭되는 금지물의 이미지로 추가 저장하도록 해당 금지물 이미지 저장부를 업데이트하는 이미지 업데이트부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Location information-based railway track continuous welded rail maintenance system and method using augmented reality and method therefor
title_ko: 증강현실을 활용한 위치정보 기반 철도 궤도 장대레일 유지관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a location information-based railway track long rail maintenance system using augmented reality and a method therefor. The present invention is effective in preventing accidents for workers and others during railroad track maintenance because the present invention performs automation of detection, prediction, and warning of the approach of various work vehicles, etc. as well as identification of the location of users, railroad site workers, etc. who periodically perform maintenance such as regular inspection, precise safety diagnosis, maintenance, etc. of a long rail on a railroad track. Through a data platform where various location-based information is updated in real time, the present invention can check inspection items such as a long rail on a railway track immediately at a railway track site, thereby preventing the duplication of maintenance work and improving maintenance efficiency. The present invention enables maintenance workers to intuitively perceive information and make quick decisions. When inspecting and maintaining a long rail on a railway track, recognition of voice information, conversion into text through machine learning, and real-time updates to the data platform are automatically performed, reducing the workload of workers and improving work efficiency. The system comprises a positioning sensor and a portable device for a user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 증강현실을 활용한 위치정보 기반 철도 궤도 장대레일 유지관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 주기적으로 철도 궤도 장대레일의 정기 점검, 정밀안전진단, 유지보수 등의 유지관리를 수행하는 사용자, 철도 현장 작업자 등의 위치 파악 및 각종 작업차량 등의 접근을 감지, 예측 및 경고의 자동화를 수행할 수 있어 철도 궤도 유지보수 시 작업자 등의 안전사고를 예방하는 효과적으며, 위치기반의 다양한 정보가 실시간으로 업데이트 되는 데이터 플랫폼을 통해 철도 궤도 현장에서 즉시 철도 궤도 장대레일 등의 점검 사항을 확인이 가능하여 유지보수 작업의 중복성을 방지함은 물론 유지보수의 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있으며 유지보수 작업자의 직관적인 정보 인지 및 신속한 의사결정이 가능할 뿐만 아니라 철도 궤도 장대레일 점검 및 유지보수 시 음성정보의 인식 및 기계학습을 통한 텍스트화 및 데이터 플랫폼의 실시간 업데이트가 자동 수행되어 작업자의 업무량을 감소시켜 업무능률을 향상시킬 수 있는 증강현실을 활용한 위치정보 기반 철도 궤도 장대레일 유지관리 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Nozzle devide with changeable ejection form and warning system for the nozzle device user
title_ko: 사출 형태의 변경이 가능한 노즐 장치 및 노즐 사용자 경고 시스템
abstract_en: A nozzle device for dividing and ejecting liquid supplied through a fire hose in directions where a plurality of nozzle ends face, respectively, according to an embodiment of the disclosed invention comprises: a plurality of first branch tubes which are detachable from the nozzle device and are configured to deliver the supplied liquid to the nozzle ends; and a plurality of nozzle end units which are connected one by one to the corresponding first branch tubes, receive the liquid from the connected first branch tube, and spray the delivered liquid into the air through the nozzle ends, wherein the ejected form of the liquid can be changed depending on the number of the installed first branch tubes and nozzle end units.
abstract_ko: 개시된 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방호스를 통해 공급되는 액체를 복수의 노즐 끝단 각각이 향하는 방향으로 나누어 사출하는 노즐 장치는, 상기 노즐 장치에 탈착 가능하고, 상기 공급되는 액체를 상기 노즐 끝단에 전달할 수 있도록 구성되는 복수의 제1 분기관; 및 대응되는 상기 제1 분기관에 하나씩 연결되고, 상기 연결된 제1 분기관으로부터 상기 액체를 전달받고, 상기 전달받은 액체를 상기 노즐 끝단을 통해 공기중으로 분사하는 복수의 노즐 끝단부;를 포함하고, 장착되는 상기 제1 분기관 및 상기 노즐 끝단부의 개수에 따라 상기 액체가 사출되는 형태를 변경할 수 있다.

title_en: Updating system of security and protection monitoring information
abstract_en: The invention provides an updating system of security and protection monitoring information, in order to reduce the cost for updating a security and protection warning display device which is propagandized and carries out warning by using a liquid crystal display screen and improve the reliability of updating the security and protection warning information. According to the updating system, the security and protection warning information is distributed to a plurality of movable machines; the plurality of movable machines transmit the security and protection warning information to the security and protection warning display device with the liquid crystal display screen; and the security and protection warning display device updates and displays the security and protection warning information. With the adoption of the updating system, the security and protection warning information can be extremely conveniently updated through utilizing the movable machines including inspection cars or private cars and the like, so that the manpower and the security and protection warning operation and maintenance cost are saved, and the timeliness and reliability of updating the security and protection warning information can be improved under special environments including outdoor fields or forest parks and the like.
assignees: CHENGDU JIAZE SOC GENERALE TECH CO LTD

title_en: fire-prevention system possible earthquake observation
title_ko: 지진 감지가 가능한 소방 방재 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물내 흔들림에 대한 차동분석을 실시간으로 실시하여 지진 발생시 지진 경보 알림을 알려줌과 함께 상시전원 상태를 비상전원 상태로 전환하여 안전한 유효 동작 시간을 증대시키도록 한 지진 감지가 가능한 소방 방재 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건물의 천장이나 벽면에 부착되어 열, 연기, 불꽃 중에서 적어도 어느 하나의 화재 발생 신호를 감지하고 외부의 제어신호를 받아 색상 변화를 통해 시각 경보 기능을 갖는 소방 감지기와, 상기 소방 감지기의 화재 발생 신호를 받아 화재 유무를 판단하여 건물 내의 소방설비를 전체적으로 제어함과 더불어 상기 소방 감지기에 제어신호를 출력하는 화재 수신기와, 상기 소방 감지기로부터 감지된 화재 발생 신호를 상기 화재 수신기가 상기 화재 발생 신호를 수신받아 처리하도록 증폭하여 전송하는 소방 중계기와, 상기 소방 중계기내에 설치되어 상기 건물내 흔들림에 정보를 검출하여 상기 소방 중계기를 통해 상기 화재 수신기로 전송하는 지진 감지부와, 상기 화재 수신기로부터 화재 또는 지진이 발생하여 상기 소방 감지기로 제어신호를 출력할 때 상기 화재 또는 지진 정보를 무선으로 받아 상위 관리자에게 전송하는 단말기를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SMART POWER CO LTD;Z HOME LED CO LTD

title_en: Driver assistance system and control method for the same
title_ko: 운전자 보조 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A vehicle in accordance with one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a camera arranged in the vehicle so as to have an external field of view of the vehicle and capturing image data; a radar arranged in the vehicle so as to have an external sensing field of view with respect to the vehicle and acquiring radar data; and a control unit including at least one processor which processes the image data captured by the camera and the radar data acquired by the radar, wherein the control unit, in the case of sensing a lane change attempt of the vehicle, senses the other vehicle on a change target lane side based on the radar data, determines whether the vehicle may collide with the other vehicle based on driving information received from the other vehicle through a communication module of the vehicle, and in the case that a collision with the other vehicle is predicted, transmits a warning signal for controlling the warning system of the vehicle to the vehicle. The present invention can prevent vehicles from colliding.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 차량은, 차량의 외부 시야를 갖도록 상기 차량에 마련되고, 영상 데이터를 획득하는 카메라; 상기 차량에 대한 외부 감지 시야를 갖도록 상기 차량에 마련되고, 레이더 데이터를 획득하는 레이더; 및 상기 카메라에 의해 획득된 영상 데이터 및 상기 레이더에 의해 획득된 레이더 데이터를 처리하는 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하는 제어부;를 포함하되, 상기 제어부는, 상기 차량의 차선 변경 시도가 감지되는 경우, 상기 레이더 데이터에 기초하여 변경 대상 차선 측의 타차량을 감지하고, 상기 차량의 통신 모듈을 통하여 상기 타차량으로부터 수신되는 주행 정보에 기초하여 상기 타차량과의 충돌 가능 여부를 결정하고, 상기 타차량과의 충돌이 예상되는 경우 상기 차량의 경고 시스템을 제어하는 경고 신호를 상기 차량에 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Power cable connector and connecting method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a power cable connector and a connecting method thereof, wherein the connector comprises a shell, a wiring module and a line pressing module, wherein the wiring module is arranged in the shell, and the line pressing module is arranged on the wiring module; the shell comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, the front side wall of the lower shell is provided with an upper wire inlet, the left side of the lower shell is provided with a left wire inlet, and the right side of the lower shell is provided with a right wire inlet; the wiring module comprises a wiring terminal, a sheath is sleeved outside the wiring terminal, and the wiring terminal comprises an upper wiring port, a left wiring port and a right wiring port; its connector passes through line ball module and compresses tightly the cable, realizes preventing the cable to withdraw from through the locking clamp, plays automatic locking function, prevents the not hard up problem of cable that leads to because of the reason of vibration, and the terminal is "T" font terminal structure, can realize the multi-direction connection of cable, makes things convenient for power cable wiring more, through the temperature of temperature measuring device control cable joint, provides the warning, reduces the potential safety hazard.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning device and a using method thereof, the geological disaster early warning device comprises a box shell, a sensing motor is arranged in the box shell, a fixed rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the sensing motor, one end of the fixed rod, which is far away from the sensing motor, is fixedly connected with a worm, one side of the worm is fixedly connected with a coarse gear, the coarse gear is in meshed connection with a sliding rack, an early warning device body is fixedly connected above the sliding rack, when a disaster such as debris flow occurs, the worm is meshed with the worm, the coarse gear is driven to rotate, the sliding rack is retracted into the box shell, a folding plate is folded above the box shell, a positioning block, a collision plate and a buffer spring are arranged in the box shell to buffer, and a first soft block and a second soft block wrap the early warning device body, so that the impact resistance of the device in a severe disaster environment is greatly enhanced, the loss probability of the device due to collision, flushing and the like is effectively reduced, and the input waste caused by the abandonment of the device is reduced.
assignees: LANZHOU RESOURCES & ENVIRONMENT VOC TECH UNIV

title_en: Transportation risk optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and road disaster early warning, in particular to a transportation risk optimization method and system, comprising the following steps of S1 multimode event-infrared-optical fiber data acquisition and synchronous generation of a unified index data packet; the method comprises the steps of S2, combining energy conservation and causal inference assimilation, outputting a digital twin state tensor, S3, performing forward noise scheduling and reverse denoising by a conditional diffusion model, generating an icing probability field and extracting a high-frequency attention spectrum, S4, calculating road structure factors according to the probability field and the attention spectrum, constructing a binary unconstrained optimization model, mapping to an optical coherence Ising machine for solving, forming an interference scheduling scheme by strategy network soft update and safety verification, and performing effect write-back cyclic update. The invention realizes sub-second risk identification and millisecond optimization decision, and reduces accident rate and salt spraying cost.

title_en: Alarm to prevent drowsy driving by using pupil perceptions sensor
title_ko: 동공인식 센서를 통한 졸음운전 방지 알람
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drowsy driving preventing alarm using a pupil scanning sensor capable of preventing traffic accidents or casualties by awaking a driver by determining whether the driver is drowsy or not after scanning a pupil of the driver using the pupil scanning sensor. To achieve this, accidents and casualties are prevented by using the machine with a principle of awaking the driver by generating alarming sound inside the machine if it is determined that the driver is drowsy after determining whether the driver is drowsy or not by using the scanning sensor when the driver is drowsy by mistake during a drive by attaching the pupil scanning sensor with an attached alarming sound speaker with a shape which does not influence to a visual field of the driver and automatically stopping the alarming sound if the machine is able to scan the pupil of the driver again after the driver awaken. Additionally, the duration of sounding the alarm for preventing drowsy driving by scanning the pupil of the driver can be adjusted by the driver. In addition, the driver is able to directly stop the alarm to prevent the alarm caused by scanning the unstable pupil due to an external factor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동공인식 센서 카메라를 통해 졸음운전을 예방 하는 것으로 동공 센서를 이용해 운전자의 동공인식 후 졸음 여부를 판단하여 운전자를 깨워 교통사고나 인명피해를 방지하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 운전자의 운전 시야에 방해되지 않는 모양의 경보음 스피커가 부착된 동공 인식 센서를 차안에 부착하여 운전자가 실수로 운전도중 졸음 상태가 와도 인식 센서를 이용하여 운전자의 졸음 유무를 판단 후, 운전자가 졸음 상태로 판단되면 기계 내에서 경보음을 작동 시켜 운전자의 졸음을 쫓아내고, 운전자가 졸음에 깨어 기계가 운전자의 동공이 다시 인식되어 진다면 경보음이 자동으로 해제 되는 원리의 기계를 통해 운전자의 교통사고와 인명피해를 방지한다. 덧붙여, 운전자의 동공 인식 졸음 여부 알람 시간을 운전자가 직접 조절 할 수 있으며 외부 요인에 의해 불안정한 동공 인식으로 인한 경보알람을 방지하기 위해 운전자가 직접적으로 경보기를 중지 할 수 있다.

title_en: Alarm method, monitoring device, monitoring system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an alarm method, a monitoring device, a monitoring system and a readable storage medium, which are based on the acquisition of an initial trend data template; acquiring to-be-analyzed monitoring parameter data for alarm analysis monitored in a to-be-analyzed time window; processing the monitoring parameter data to be analyzed to construct trend data to be analyzed; matching the trend data to be analyzed with the initial trend data template to obtain a matching result; comparing the matching result with a preset condition to obtain a comparison result; presenting the matching result and/or the comparison result; or, the matching result satisfies when predetermineeing the condition, control guardianship equipment produces the warning, not only can prevent the emergence of wrong report police, and has improved the security and the validity of guardianship to reduce medical personnel's working strength and the degree of difficulty, can also effectively and select patient's key alarm information fast in addition, thereby reduced the risk of state of an illness delay.
assignees: SHENZHEN MAIREI BIOMEDICAL ELECTRONIC STOCK CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous dynamic early warning method applied to regional landslide disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to a dangerous dynamic early warning method applied to regional landslide disasters. And collecting multisource data of a research area, and establishing a geographic information database of landslide disasters based on a GIS platform. Constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system, carrying out regional landslide susceptibility evaluation to obtain a regional landslide susceptibility static evaluation result, and comparing the static result by adopting various precision evaluation indexes, wherein an optimal regional landslide susceptibility region is preferably obtained. And (3) carrying out data mining on the meteorological information and landslide disaster information to obtain multiple rainfall threshold grading curves of regional landslide occurrence, and preferably obtaining an optimal landslide critical rainfall threshold. Dividing the optimal region landslide risk area into five sections, simultaneously integrating the optimal critical rainfall threshold value divided by probability, and establishing a landslide risk early warning model by means of a fuzzy evaluation matrix. And inputting real-time dynamic rainfall data, and realizing dynamic early warning of regional landslide hazard dangers through continuously updated hour rainfall data.

title_en: Satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a temporary special satellite communication link, conducting parameter optimization on the temporary special satellite communication link to obtain an optimized communication link, conducting three-dimensional reconstruction on site environment, analyzing severity description of illness state, predicting illness state development to generate illness state prediction results, conducting optimization processing on distribution strategies of special medical materials by considering factors of weather change and ocean current direction to obtain an optimal distribution path plan, conducting pattern recognition and trend prediction to generate potential risk early warning to form updated medical requirements, and reevaluating and optimizing the optimal distribution path plan to generate the updated optimal distribution path plan. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the efficiency and accuracy of the response of the offshore emergency, and ensures that medical materials can be timely and accurately delivered to the emergency site.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion safety production supervision and inspection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safe production supervision and inspection method and system for multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a standardized data set; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a cross-modal feature matrix according to a standardized data set, inputting a dynamic risk perception model to perform time sequence and space association modeling according to the cross-modal feature matrix to obtain a risk candidate index set, performing multi-source data weighted fusion calculation on the risk candidate index set to obtain a fusion risk index, comparing the fusion risk index with a preset multi-level threshold value library according to the fusion risk index to obtain a corresponding early warning level, generating a supervision inspection trigger instruction matched with the early warning level, performing self-adaptive optimization configuration on a follow-up supervision inspection task according to the supervision inspection trigger instruction by combining historical hidden danger data with a treatment result to obtain an optimization configuration result, and feeding the optimization configuration result back to the dynamic risk perception model to update the dynamic risk perception model. The invention can improve the accuracy of data inspection.
assignees: BEIJING PINGAN YOUDAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fusion data set and determining risk evolution parameters; triggering a vegetation difference analysis function if the risk evolution parameter exceeds a preset threshold value to obtain a section heterogeneity label, carrying out space-time heterogeneity compensation correction on historical data through a time sequence change tracking method after the section heterogeneity label is obtained, calculating the risk transition probability of each section, judging potential critical points, activating a difference early warning mechanism if the potential critical points are judged to be high probability, generating a targeted risk grade map according to the section heterogeneity label and the risk transition probability to obtain a dynamic early warning signal, carrying out iterative verification on the dynamic early warning signal by adopting a real-time update flow in a fusion data set, and combining the prediction output of a long-term and short-term memory network to adjust the risk grade to determine a final risk prediction result. The method and the device improve the timeliness and accuracy of fire risk prediction.

title_en: Emergency notification system using a portable black box And That way
title_ko: 휴대용 블랙박스를 이용한 위급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency notification system using a portable black box and a method thereof. The emergency notification system using a portable black box according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a portable black box electronic device; a portable electronic device; and a server. The portable black box electronic device releases a sleep state of the portable electronic device at a help request start reference point and transmits video and audio data information photographed by a photographing unit when a user asking for help inputs a command for driving an application to the portable black box electronic device indicating than an emergency has occurred. The portable electronic device transmits an emergency help request message to an external server through a communication network. The server stores user identification information for each portable electronic device, searches and selects information capable of communicating with other electronic devices located within a predetermined radius from a relevant agency or a portable electronic device located within a search range which is converted temporally or spatially based on the current location information of the portable electronic device of the user upon receipt of the emergency help request message, and transmits information capable of asking for help to other electronic devices by type through the communication network. Therefore, the user can get help quickly from relevant agencies and members nearby the emergency.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 실시 예들은 도움을 요청하고자 하는 사용자가 위급상황이 발생했음을 나타내는 휴대용 블랙박스 전자장치로 어플리케이션 구동을 위한 명령을 입력하면, 도움요청 개시 기준점의 휴대용 전자장치의 슬립상태를 해제하여 실행할 수 있도록 하며 촬영부에 의해 촬영된 영상 및 음성 데이터 정보를 전송할 수 있는 휴대용 블랙박스 전자장치와 위급상황 도움요청 메시지를 통신망을 통해 외부의 서버에 전송하는 휴대용 전자장치; 및 
상기 휴대용 전자장치별로 사용자 식별정보가 저장되며, 위급상황 도움요청 메시지의 수신 시 상기 사용자 휴대용 전자장치 현재 위치정보를 기준으로 시간적 또는 공간적으로 변환하는 탐색범위 내에 위치하는 관계기관 또는 휴대용 전자장치로부터 사전 설정된 반경 내에 위치한 다른 전자장치로 연락할 수 있는 정보를 검색하여 선택하고 다른 전자장치별로 도움요청 할 수 있는 정보를 통신망을 통해 전송하는 서버를 포함하는 휴대용 블랙박스를 이용한 위급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공하는데 있다.

title_en: A kind of ddos attack detecting system
abstract_en: DoS (refusal service) and the integrated detection system of the class security attacks of DDoS (distributed denial of service) two are combined the present invention relates to one kind：TCP Attack monitorings can recognize DoS attack (i.e. SYN Flood are attacked in a small amount of source) by analyzing the connection procedure of TCP three-way handshake, TCP abnormality detections analyze the flow and switching performance at client and server end, identification SYN Flood flood tides source attack detecting and the detection of Tsunami flow attackings by full flow；UDP attack detectings include NTP and reflect scale-up version attack detecting and DNS reflection scale-up version attack detectings；HTTPS attack detectings include SSL Flood detections, SSL Alert detections and SSL and consult detection again；HTTP attack detectings include Slow loris detections, Get Flood detections, Slow post detections and Hash Dos detections.The present invention can recognize that the attack stream in backbone network, filters out the flow of attacker's transmission, prevents that it from causing harm to destination host.

title_en: The high tower comprehensive monitoring system that technology of Internet of things is integrated with 3D
abstract_en: Include wind energy superelevation tower, cooling tower and ancient tower etc. the present invention relates to high tower class building, health status is influenced by natural calamity, Architectural Structure Design itself and maintaining, growing day by day to the concern of its angle of inclination, administration of the prevention and control.The present invention is using supporting multi-platform comprehensive development of games tool Unity 3D to build high tower building and its ambient enviroment model, by by technology of Internet of things and the fusion of 3D virtual technologies, realizing high tower comprehensively monitoring.The system includes that intellectual monitoring module, aggregation of data gateway module, aggregation of data processing message system module, d engine module, alarm module and application terminal module six are most of.Data transmission based on publication registration message mechanism can ensure handheld device or the 3D virtual platform real time data synchronizations update of PC, effectively promote high tower building health and fire fighting problem early warning and alarm efficiency, reduce the loss that building safety problem is brought.

title_en: Network security monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security monitoring system, which comprises an acquisition unit, a component unit and a monitoring and protecting unit, wherein the acquisition unit comprises a data updating module and a data processing module, wherein the data updating module is used for downloading updated security protection codes and firewall codes in a network, and the data processing module is used for processing data downloaded by the data updating module; the component module comprises a data building module for receiving the primarily processed data output by the data processing module, and the data building module is used for building the received data into a network framework; by the design of the invention, multi-point early warning monitoring can be carried out in network security, security problems occur, the position of a fault can be timely and accurately reflected, automatic virus killing and firewall construction can be simultaneously carried out, the security problems are rapidly solved, the protection module can be updated in real time through the designed updating module, and special protection codes can be input, so that the overall security is improved.
assignees: HEBEI HONGLIAN 95 INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Mine microseism early warning method, device and equipment based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine microseismic early warning method, device and equipment based on a space-time diagram neural network, and relates to the technical field of diagram neural networks. By describing each area of the mine as a node network, the nodes are mutually linked to form an associated graph, and the correlation between the nodes based on the influence of the microseismic event is discussed. Based on microseismic events occurring at different moments, three factor weights based on time, space and strong information are formed, the attention weights of GAT are updated, a multi-head attention mechanism is used for obtaining the weights of edges between final nodes, and the microseismic times, average energy and maximum energy occurring in the next time period of each node are predicted through processing of a space-time diagram neural network, so that the safety accidents possibly occurring in mining are pre-warned. The correlation between the microseismic event and the geological structure is captured through the method, the weight is dynamically updated in real time, and the method has good generalization performance and dynamic updating capability, so that the accuracy and timeliness of prediction are improved.

title_en: Pacing ventricular tachycardia detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to pacing ventricular tachycardia detection. The physiological monitoring system collects electrocardiogram ("ECG") data from the passing monitoring sensors via the sensor interface. The machine learning model identifies characteristics of the ECG data attributable to the cardiovascular device used by the patient. The machine learning model will create and continuously update at least one normal ECG template for the individual patient. An abnormal ECG data set is analyzed using a knowledge-based heartbeat classifier to identify a particular arrhythmia. The data structure stores responses to specific arrhythmias based on their likely impact on the patient. For example, the response to a dangerous arrhythmia may be an emergency alert, while the response to a temporary arrhythmia being rapidly corrected by the patient's pacemaker may be a non-urgent message or annotation to archive.

title_en: Intelligent situation management and decision support system and method for wide-area disaster situation support
title_ko: 광역 재난 상황 지원을 위한 지능형 상황 관리 및 의사 결정 지원 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for providing integrated situation management when a wide area disaster situation occurs through a big data management system, a first device for controlling a platform of a disaster management agency, and a second device for controlling a platform of a local government. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, the method may include the steps of: generating and constructing, by the big data management system, a database related to disaster situation management based on receiving disaster report information related to a specific disaster; transmitting, by the big data management system, a notification message including the disaster report information to the first device and the second device; updating, by the first device and the second device, the database based on a change in the disaster situation; transmitting, by the big data management system, the disaster termination information to the first device based on reception of the disaster termination information of the local government from the second device; and updating, by the first device, the disaster termination information on the database based on termination of all disasters caused by the specific disaster.
abstract_ko: 빅데이터 관리 시스템, 재난관리주관기관의 플랫폼을 제어하는 제1 장치, 및 지역자치단체의 플랫폼을 제어하는 제2 장치를 통해 광역 재난 상황 발생시 통합 상황 관리를 제공하는 방법이 개시된다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른, 상기 방법은, 상기 빅데이터 관리 시스템이 특정 재난과 관련된 재난 신고 정보를 수신함에 기반하여 재난 상황 관리와 관련된 데이터베이스를 생성 및 구축하는 단계; 상기 빅데이터 관리 시스템이 상기 재난 신고 정보가 포함된 알림 메시지를 상기 제1 장치 및 상기 제2 장치로 전송하는 단계; 상기 제1 장치 및 상기 제2 장치가 재난 상황이 변경됨에 기반하여 상기 데이터베이스를 업데이트하는 단계; 상기 제2 장치로부터 상기 지역자치단체의 재난 종료 정보가 수신됨에 기반하여, 상기 빅데이터 관리 시스템은 상기 재난 종료 정보를 상기 제1 장치로 전송하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 장치는 상기 특정 재난에 의해 발생된 모든 재난이 종료됨에 기반하여, 상기 데이터베이스 상에 재난 종료 정보를 업데이트하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Rainfall monitoring and early warning device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rainfall monitoring, and discloses a rainfall monitoring and early warning device and system, which comprises a shell, wherein a display screen is fixedly arranged on the left side of the outer wall of the shell, a horn mouth is formed in the right side of the outer wall of the shell, and a storage battery is fixedly arranged on the left side of the inner wall of the shell; the inside of shell still is provided with main control chip, location chip, wireless transmission chip and storage chip, the output end signal connection of wireless transmission chip has the server, the output end signal connection of server has meteorological monitoring website. The longitude and latitude position of the user can be acquired in real time through the positioning chip, the weather rainfall data of the weather monitoring station can be acquired through the server according to the longitude and latitude position wireless transmission chip of the user, the weather rainfall data are displayed on the display screen in real time, the user can conveniently know the weather information, the weather information is updated more timely, the user is not required to screen in a large amount of weather information, and the information acquisition efficiency is improved.

title_en: Risk assessment and monitoring early warning system for shallow landslide of line engineering corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a system for assessing, monitoring and early warning the risk of shallow landslide of a line engineering corridor. Firstly, determining a line engineering corridor evaluation area, comprehensively analyzing and determining landslide and disaster pregnancy key influence factors of a corridor area by combining basic and comprehensive data such as terrain and landform, remote sensing information, seismic geology, soil, vegetation, hydrology, climate, regional investigation and the like, and constructing a corridor slope stability evaluation model; and then, carrying out initial landslide risk assessment on the line corridor area. And secondly, aiming at the precipitation of main characteristic factors inducing the shallow landslide hazard, performing sectional evaluation on the risk of the shallow landslide of the line corridor under different precipitation conditions, and determining key monitoring and early warning line sections in the landslide hazard area. And finally, establishing a WebGIS system for evaluating and early warning the geological disaster risk of the line engineering corridor shallow landslide, and realizing data query, update and information publishing, intercommunication and sharing of the multi-platform terminal.

title_en: Elevator emergency rescue system and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator emergency rescue system and a rescue method, relates to the technical field of elevator emergency rescue systems, and aims to solve the technical problems that the warning condition in an elevator cannot be evaluated and the comprehensiveness and timeliness of rescue cannot be guaranteed according to actual conditions in the prior art. The rescue system comprises a system management module, an elevator management module, an alarm rescue module, a communication module and a control center; the system management module is used for managing basic information of the system and comprises a user management unit and a role management unit, wherein the functions of the user management unit comprise adding a user, modifying the user and canceling the user, and the functions of the role management unit comprise adding a role, modifying the role and deleting the role. According to the rescue system and the rescue method, the alarm condition in the elevator is evaluated, and then the response level of the elevator is judged, so that the waste of public resources can be avoided while the comprehensiveness and timeliness of rescue are ensured.

title_en: Two-factor authentication door lock
title_ko: 이중인증 기반의 도어락 제어 방법 및 이중인증 도어락
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a double authentication-based door lock control method, and a double authentication door lock. More specifically, when additional authentication of a user is not performed, a locking state of a door is converted into a release state, and thus a help can be provided from an external person (acquaintance, neighborhood, guard, security company staff, police, fire fighter, or the like) in an emergency situation. In particular, according to the present invention, when indoor authentication is not performed for a predetermined period of time, a help is requested to the outside by using an automatic connection function of a voice call together with an alarm sound, and thus it is possible to protect a user′s property and his/her body in an emergency situation. In particular, the present invention has an advantage of obtaining sufficient security and security effects with a low cost device even for a crime prevention vulnerable area which is difficult to operate an expensive method system while being easily exposed to a dangerous risk, such as a woman only room in which a woman lives alone. Therefore, reliability and competiveness can be improved not only in the door lock filed, the security and crime prevention filed, in particular, the security and crime prevention field using a door lock, but also in the fields similar or related thereto.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이중인증 기반의 도어락 제어 방법 및 이중인증 도어락에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 추가인증이 이루어지지 않을 경우 도어의 잠금상태가 해제상태로 전환되도록 함으로써, 비상상황에서 외부인(지인, 이웃, 경비원, 보안업체직원, 경찰, 소방관 등)에게 도움을 받을 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
특히, 본 발명은 일정시간 동안 실내측인증이 이루어지지 않을 경우에는 경보음과 함께 음성통화의 자동연결기능 등을 이용하여 외부에 도움을 요청함으로써, 비상상황에서 사용자의 재산 및 신체를 보호할 수 있다. 
특히, 본 발명은 여성이 혼자 거주하는 여성전용원룸 등과 같이, 신체적으로 위험에 노출되기 쉬우면서 고가의 방법 시스템을 운용하기에 어려움이 있는 방범취약 거주지역에 대해서도, 저가의 장치로 충분한 보안 및 방범효과를 얻을 수 있는 장점이 있다. 
따라서, 도어락 분야, 보안 및 방범 분야, 특히 도어락을 이용한 보안 및 방범 분야는 물론, 이와 유사 내지 연관된 분야에서 신뢰성 및 경쟁력을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Image processing system for fire monitoring
title_ko: 화재발생 감시 복합 영상처리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operation method of a complex image processing system for fire monitoring, the method including: a step (S100) of acquiring image information and thermal image information of a monitoring target area; a step (S200) of converting the information obtained in the step (S100) into a digital signal and calculating the signal strength of each pixel; a step (S300) of calculating an overall average value by summing each pixel value of the thermal image information calculated in the step (S200); a step (S400) of comparing the overall average value calculated in the step (S300) with the overall average value in a preset normal state; a step (S500) of generating an alarm if the value compared in the step (S400) is greater than the preset overall average value; a step (S600) of checking whether the network is operating normally if the value is equal to or less than the preset overall average value; a step (S700) of transmitting the calculated overall average value to the central control center and personal terminal if the network is operating normally; and a step (S800) of automatically switching to LTE mode if the network does not operate normally, transmitting information to the central control center and personal terminal and storing in its own memory, and, when the network operates normally again, transmitting the stored information to the central control center and personal terminal. Therefore, even when network conditions are poor, events that occur in the field can be reliably sent to the central control center.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감시 대상 지역의 영상정보와 열영상정보를 획득하는 단계(S100), 상기 단계(S100)에서 획득된 정보를 디지털 신호로 변경하고 각 픽셀의 신호의 세기를 산출하는 단계(S200), 상기 단계(S200) 단계에서 산출된 열상정보의 각각의 픽셀 값을 합하여 전체 평균값을 계산하는 단계(S300), 상기(S300) 단계에서 계산된 전체평균값과 미리 설정된 정상상태의 전체평균값과 비교하는 단계(S400), 상기 단계(S400)에서 비교된 값이 미리 설정된 전체평균값 일정한 범위보다 클 경우에는 경보를 발생하고(S500) 네트워크가 정상으로 작동하는지를 확인하고(S600), 미리 설정된 전체 평균값보다 같거나 적을 경우에는 네트워크가 정상으로 작동 하는지를 확인하여(S600) 네트워크가 정상으로 작동할 경우에는 계산된 전체평균값을    중앙관제센터 및 개인단말기로 정보를 전송하고(S700), 네트워크가 정상작동이 안될 경우에는 LTE모드로 자동전환 되어(S800) 중앙관제센터 및 개인단말기로 전송하고 자체메모리에 저장하고, 네트워크가 다시 정상으로 동작될 시 저장된 정보를 중앙관제센터 및 개인단말기로 전송하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 화재발생 감시 복합 영상처리시스템의 작동방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster early warning method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster early warning method, terminal equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problem that a user cannot accurately and timely receive disaster early warning information in the related technology. If the appointed message is received, determining an operation mode of the position label based on the message type of the appointed message, wherein the operation mode comprises that the position label is not updated or the updating time of the position label is determined, and the appointed message is ticket class information or cross-market reminding information; executing positioning operation when the updating time is up to obtain a position label of the current position and sending the position label to the server; and receiving disaster early warning information of the position label of the current position sent by the server. Therefore, regional distribution of the early warning information is achieved by reporting the position tags, the cost of sending the information is saved, the position tags of the current position can be timely and accurately updated by using the ticket information or the cross-market reminding information, the influence of position change is reduced, and the accuracy and the real-time performance of receiving the disaster early warning information can be improved.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIXIN MOBILE COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic updating of cable identification and grading warning method for hidden danger of cable external breakage
abstract_en: The invention provides a cable identification automatic updating and cable external damage hidden danger grading alarm method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a template image with a cable identification and an image to be updated; performing image matching on the template image and the image to be updated to obtain a perspective transformation matrix; obtaining an updated cable identification on the image to be updated according to the perspective transformation matrix, and taking the image to be updated by the cable identification as an updated template image; generating a three-level alarm area on the updated template image based on the updated cable identification for alarm; the invention can effectively cope with monitoring deviation caused by camera lens movement in complex scenes, automatically update the trend of the cable or the electronic fence, and improve the accuracy of monitoring alarm.
assignees: JINAN XINTONGDA ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network lightning protection method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network lightning protection method and system based on big data analysis, which relate to the technical field of lightning protection and comprise the following steps: the system collects lightning electrical big data from different sources and performs data preprocessing on the lightning electrical big data; extracting key features from the preprocessed fusion data set by utilizing a big data analysis technology, and training the reinforcement learning algorithm model by using the extracted feature data; predicting the position and probability of lightning occurrence, and automatically triggering an alarm when the probability of lightning occurrence reaches a preset threshold value; and the system updates the lightning prediction model in real time by utilizing the latest big data analysis result, and sends out preset early warning protection measures to the power distribution network operators through the visual platform. According to the invention, the lightning disaster protection capability of the power distribution network is improved, and a powerful guarantee is provided for ensuring the safe operation of the power system and the public safety.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: AI-based method and system for identifying potential safety hazards of hoisting machinery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of potential safety hazard identification, in particular to a method and a system for identifying potential safety hazards of hoisting machinery based on AI, comprising the following steps: and collecting operation data of the hoisting machinery, including position, speed and carrying capacity, integrating information of meteorological conditions and near-field obstacles, and generating comprehensive real-time data by combining real-time transmission data. According to the invention, the comprehensive evaluation and early warning of potential risks are realized by integrating the hoisting machinery operation data and the environment variables, the operation environment can be more accurately simulated, the occurrence of risk conditions is predicted, the early warning accuracy and the operation safety are effectively improved by timely adjusting the operation strategy through the dynamic risk score, the real-time updated state definition and the probability model can continuously adapt to the environment change, the hoisting machinery operation strategy is ensured to be always kept in an optimal state, the probability of accident occurrence is reduced, and meanwhile, the economic loss caused by equipment failure or misoperation is also reduced.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CHAMPION SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: The ship safety navigation system by ecdis processing wave information
title_ko: 파랑정보를 구비하는 ｅｃｄｉｓ에 의한 선박 안전운항방법
abstract_en: A ship safety navigation system by an ECDIS(Electronic Chart Display and Information System) is provided to improve safety of a ship by informing the ship of dangerous waves. A wave measuring unit is activated(S100). Radar signals outputted from a radar are measured and transferred to and stored in an ECDIS(S200). The stored signal is converted to a 2D image signal(S300). The wave information is analyzed from the image signal and the analyzed wave information is displayed on an ECDIS display screen(S400). The analyzed wave information is compared with an alarm setting value, and it is determined whether a dangerous wave occurs(S500). When the dangerous wave occurs, a navigation direction of a ship and a propagation direction of the wave are confirmed and the navigation direction of the ship is changed(S600). When the dangerous wave fades away, an alarm state is released(S700).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파랑정보를 구비하는 ＥＣＤＩＳ에 의한 선박 안전운항방법에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 레이더를 통해 파랑정보를 정확하게 계측하고, 이러한 정보를 ＥＣＤＩＳ를 통해 표시함과 동시에 서로 공유하며, 파랑정보와 ＥＣＤＩＳ 정보를 통해 선박운항의 안정성을 향상시킬 수 있는 파랑정보를 구비하는 ＥＣＤＩＳ에 의한 선박 안전운항방법을 제공하는 것이다.  
     본 발명은 파랑계측수단을 작동시키는 단계; 레이더에서 출력되는 레이더 신호를 계측하여 ＥＣＤＩＳ로 전송 저장하는 단계; 상기 저장된 신호를 이용하여 2차원의 영상신호로 변환하는 단계; 상기 영상신호로부터 파랑정보를 해석하여 ＥＣＤＩＳ 표시화면을 통해 표시하는 단계; 상기 해석된 파랑정보와 경보설정치를 대비하여 위험경보 파고의 발생여부를 판단하는 단계; 상기 위험경보 파고의 발생시, 선박과 파고진행방향을 확인하여 선박의 진행방향을 변경하는 단계; 상기 위험경보 파고의 위험성 해제시 알람경보를 해제하는 단계;로 이루어져 있다. 
       
     파랑, 파고, 선박, ＥＣＤＩＳ, 레이더
assignees: HYUN DAI HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: Access the coal mine safety monitoring system of explosion-proof pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses the coal mine safety monitoring systems of access explosion-proof pressure sensor, it is related to mine supervision technical field, including ground monitoring system and underground monitoring system, the ground monitoring system includes intelligent terminal module, central processing module, display module and alarm module one, and the central processing module is to be electrically connected with the intelligent terminal module, the display module and the alarm module one.The present invention can not only monitor coal mining safety in real time, and it can explode to coal mine underground and carry out multistage early warning, remind coal mine underground staff and ground monitoring personnel, simultaneously when coal mine underground early warning explosion data are more than warning value, the power supply of electronic equipment can be cut off in time, underground activities personnel is supervised to withdraw as early as possible, reduce damage, and production safety supervisory department and safety accident can be notified to rescue department, know explosion dangerous situation as early as possible, while rescue action is unfolded.

title_en: Multi-point monitoring visual phased array type fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of fire alarm, and provides a multipoint monitoring visual phased array type fire alarm system, when at least one smoke concentration data exceeds a preset concentration, first alarm information is generated based on the current smoke concentration data, and a heat source in the current environment is detected in real time; when the temperature of the heat source is higher than the preset temperature, second alarm information is generated based on the current temperature of the heat source, and the intelligent alarm is used for determining an alarm instruction according to the alarm information and executing the alarm instruction when the first alarm information and/or the second alarm information are/is received. According to the fire alarm system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the smoke concentration and the heat source are detected, the on-site warning and the remote alarm can be timely carried out, the warning in on-site personnel and the notification of the off-site workers can be timely processed on site, the alarm strategy can be timely updated according to the situation of the fire scene, and the situation of false alarm after the dangerous case is processed is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG NEW SCIENCE AND TECH INDUSTRY LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and early warning convective strong precipitation based on satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring and early warning convective strong precipitation based on satellite remote sensing, which comprise the following steps: based on the detection data of GPM, FY-3G and H8 satellites, calculating the change of the bright temperature of the cloud top of the streaming cloud cluster in the image data, and analyzing the time sequence of the bright temperature of the cloud top according to the dynamic tracking data of the cloud cluster to obtain a cloud top temperature characteristic set. According to the invention, by utilizing time series analysis of the cloud top bright temperature, tiny weather changes can be rapidly captured, the capability of early identifying potential rainfall risks is enhanced, the introduction of main component analysis optimizes the classification process of weather conditions, the accuracy of risk assessment is improved, dynamic tracking of cloud clusters is more accurate by applying a Kalman filter, a VAR model provides higher reliability in predicting future weather thresholds, and a depth Q network is combined with real-time satellite data, so that early warning information is updated in real time, and timely and effective disaster prevention countermeasures are provided.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Intelligent three-dimensional distance measurement method for power transmission line based on multidimensional space topology analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent three-dimensional distance measurement method for a power transmission line based on multidimensional space topology analysis, which relates to the technical field of power transmission line distance detection, and comprises the following steps: executing data acquisition of a transmission line and a transmission environment, and establishing a multidimensional space data set; carrying out three-dimensional mapping fusion on the multidimensional space data set, and establishing a three-dimensional model of the transmission line and the transmission environment; establishing a topological relation model, and establishing key topological nodes of the topological relation model; performing potential safety hazard analysis of the updated topological relation model through a spatial distance analysis network; and updating the early warning grade in real time based on the potential safety hazard analysis result, and executing early warning. The technical problems that the existing power transmission line three-dimensional ranging is difficult to cover complex and changeable power transmission environments on the whole, and the power transmission line distance measurement accuracy is insufficient are solved, the potential safety hazard identification early warning is not accurate enough in time, and the technical effects of improving the power transmission line ranging accuracy, the potential safety hazard early warning accuracy and the instantaneity are achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU HAOHAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accurate monitoring and early warning device of grating roof separation layer volume
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining equipment monitoring, and particularly discloses a grating roof separation layer quantity accurate monitoring and early warning device. The device comprises a measuring vertical cylinder and a measuring steel wire rope in the cylinder, wherein a grating ruler is arranged in the measuring horizontal cylinder, a reading head is pulled by the steel wire rope to generate relative displacement with the grating ruler, an led lamp is arranged below the reading head, an optical signal generated by movement is converted into an electric signal through illumination, the signal is transmitted to a roof separation monitoring and early warning device arranged outside the cylinder by a transmission cable, the roof separation monitoring and early warning device records and analyzes roof separation data in the stope propelling process, a separation early warning value can be preset in advance, and when separation occurs on a roof, the device gives an alarm when the relative displacement generated by the reading head pulled by the steel wire rope and the grating ruler exceeds the preset roof separation early warning value, and reminds operators to safely withdraw from the roadway. The invention can monitor the displacement of the top plate with high precision, early warn potential safety hazards in time and ensure the operation safety of staff.
assignees: CHINAU COAL DATONG ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Coal seam three-dimensional trend identification method and system based on working face bottom plate modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal seam three-dimensional trend identification method and system based on working face bottom plate modeling, and aims to solve the problems of insufficient precision and poor instantaneity of a traditional coal seam trend prediction method. According to the method, through technical means such as laser scanning, geological radar, drilling data and the like, the mining height, position and attitude data of a real-time coal mining machine are combined, a three-dimensional space model of the coal seam is constructed, and the coal seam trend is predicted and dynamically updated in real time by utilizing a data analysis and prediction algorithm. Through trend analysis and change identification, the system can timely find abnormal changes of the coal seam, such as rapid increase of thickness or abnormal fluctuation of the top and bottom plates, and send out early warning signals, and automatically adjust the operation path and parameters of the coal mining machine, so that potential safety hazards such as bottom cutting and top cutting are avoided. The invention realizes automatic adjustment in the coal mining process through the intelligent feedback and decision support system, improves the accuracy and safety of coal mining operation, and has higher application value.
assignees: CHANGZHOU LIANLI AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for emergency stop signal
title_ko: 급제동 경보시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency stop warning system is provided to automatically shift the emergency stop warning by adding the automatic release function and classifying and the emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: A brake device(40) is supplied with the power from the switch part of power supply. A body control module(60) decides whether to perform the supplementary feature after the sudden brake situation. A gateway(50) is inputted with the information on the emergency situation from the brake device and transfers the information to a body control module(60).
