title_en: The system informs the driver signal change
title_ko: 신호등 신호 감지에 의한 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for informing a driver about signal change by sensing of a traffic light signal. The preset invention comprises: a mount unit (110) attached with a front glass of a vehicle; a signal aspect sensor having a sensing angle; a speaker; an alarm lamp which turns off a lamp when the signal is changed; and a transceiver which receives a signal of the outside. The present invention has an effect of informing the driver of the remaining time of the signal to a display unit (240) so that the user can previously prepare for the signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 신호등 신호 감지에 의한 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템은, 차량의 대쉬보드 상단 또는 차량의 전면유리에 부착되는 마운트부(110); 상기 마운트부(110)의 상면에 고정되고, 차량의 주행방향 상단을 지향하는 감지각을 가지는 신호현시 감지센서(100); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어, 신호 변경시 알람을 송출하는 스피커(210, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되며, 차량의 핸들 내부에 장착되어 신호 변경시 진동을 발생하는 진동 발생기(220, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어, 신호 변경시 램프를 점등하는 알림 램프(230, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어 외부의 신호를 수신하는 송수신기(300); 상기 스피커(210, 미도시), 진동 발생기(220, 미도시), 알림 램프(230, 미도시)는 알림부(200)로 통칭할 수 있으며, 상기 알림부(200) 및 송수신기(300)와 연결되어 제어명령을 수행하는 제어부(400); 를 포함하여 구성되며, 또한 신호등에 장착되고 신호등 제어판(500)과 연결되어 신호등의 신호변경 시간을 신호등 전방의 차량에 송출하는 신호 송출기(510); 를 더 포함하고, 상기 송출기(510)에서 송출하는 신호변경 시간 데이터를 상기 송수신기(300)에서 제어부(400)로 전송하여 현재 신호의 남은 시간을 파악할 수 있도록 사용자에게 시각적으로 표출하는 디스플레이(240)를 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 신호등의 신호변경을 감지하는 신호현시 감지센서(100)를 장착하고, 신호등의 신호 변경을 운전자에게 진동, 알람, 플리커링으로 알려 주지시킴으로써 신호대기 동안의 운전자의 행동에 제약을 없애고 신호변경에 대비할 수 있게 하는 효과를 부여하며, 상기와 같이 신호등의 신호변경 시간을 신호등 전방의 차량에 송출하는 신호 송출기(510)에 의하여, 신호등에 근접한 차량의 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템의 송수신기(300)에서 이를 감지하여 운전자에게 신호의 남은 시간을 디스플레이(240)로 알려 줌으로써 신호에 미리 대비할 수 있도록 하는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: A kind of quick evacuation method of virtual machine based on the disaster early warning time
abstract_en: A kind of quick evacuation method of the virtual machine based on the disaster early warning time is claimed in the present invention, belongs to field of cloud computer technology.This method is seriously threatened caused by backbone network physical node for mass disaster, according to disaster early warning time, virutal machine memory size and virtual machine downtime, the virtual net and its interdependent node that are on the hazard is reconstructed and is withdrawn.The present invention replicates migrating technology after using, optimal evacuation path and initial bandwidth are distributed in the case where migrating flow equalization principle for virtual machine to be withdrawn, and the bandwidth on evacuation path is adjusted according to network resource conditions dynamic, virtual machine withdraws completion rate in maximization pre-warning time.

title_en: Lignite upgrading and drying environment monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lignite upgrading and drying environment monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things, wherein the lignite upgrading and drying environment monitoring system comprises the following steps: s1: monitoring the lignite upgrading and drying environment, and capturing node environment information of each processing link of lignite upgrading and drying; acquiring real-time conditions of the corresponding lignite in each treatment link of lignite upgrading and drying; s2: analyzing node environment information and lignite corresponding area conditions in each processing link; s3: monitoring operation requests sent in each processing link in real time, and sending out early warning when abnormal lignite-related data in processing nodes corresponding to the operation requests are monitored; s4: according to the abnormal judgment result, the relevant data of the lignite upgrading and drying environment are adjusted and updated; the whole operation process of upgrading and drying the lignite is ensured not to damage the nutrient value components of the lignite, the potential safety hazards of inflammability, explosiveness and the like caused by the chemical properties of the lignite are avoided, resources are fully utilized, and environmental pollution is reduced.
assignees: LINGYANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD;MILE LINGYANG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Regional landslide vulnerability updating and evaluating method
abstract_en: Firstly, acquiring data such as DEM, landslide, soil parameters and the like of a research area according to site survey investigation; performing sensitivity analysis of input parameters based on the physical model; a Bayesian updating method is adopted, new landslide information is used as observation information to respectively construct likelihood functions of a landslide region and a stable region, and update of sensitive parameters is realized; and (3) carrying out regional slope stability analysis and failure probability calculation through a physical model, and drawing a landslide failure probability distribution map. And finally, fusing the landslide susceptibility result with the failure probability result by adopting a matrix analysis method to obtain an updated regional landslide disaster early-warning level distribution map, thereby realizing regional landslide susceptibility update. The method has the advantages of definite physical meaning, strong pertinence, low cost, easy operation, accurate result, good visualization and the like, overcomes the defect that the mechanical mechanism and timeliness cannot be considered in the traditional landslide susceptibility evaluation, and can present the dynamic distribution condition of landslide disasters.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning information closed loop response calling method based on position calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning information closed-loop response calling method based on position calculation, which comprises the following steps: s1: designing a data structure, an early warning information data state and an intelligent calling interface of a geological disaster early warning position model; s2: building a geological disaster early warning position model, analyzing hidden danger points of the geological disasters by using meteorological data of a meteorological observation site, and sending early warning information; s3: developing an application program to interact with the intelligent call interface to develop closed loop call of early warning information; s4: after the intelligent call sends the early warning short message, the early warning short message information is uploaded to an early warning position model, and the data state of the early warning short message information is updated; s5: after the intelligent caller shall send the early warning voice, uploading the early warning voice information to an early warning position model, and updating the data state of the early warning voice information; s6: after the intelligent call starts the manual call, the manual call information is uploaded to the early warning position model, and the early warning information data state is updated.
assignees: Sichuan Rural Economic Comprehensive Information Center

title_en: Natural gas pipeline leakage monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a natural gas pipeline leakage monitoring system applied to the field of gas monitoring, which comprises a gas pipeline management platform body, wherein the gas pipeline management platform body comprises a gas pipeline monitoring network system, a monitoring data transmission system, an emergency management system and a remote control system, an early warning valve well lid is additionally arranged on the basis of the existing monitoring system, the early warning valve well lid adjacent to the natural gas pipeline is immediately triggered to warn outwards when the natural gas pipeline leaks, firstly, the concentration of leaked gas is effectively reduced by utilizing the water spraying effect of a water spraying head, the probability of natural gas deflagration is effectively reduced, the water spraying head can also warn the passing pedestrians and vehicles when spraying water, prompt the passing pedestrians and vehicles to withdraw to a safe area as soon as possible, meanwhile, the probability of accidental ignition of the leaked natural gas can also be effectively avoided, in addition, the lifted protective cover and the light effect of a warning lamp can also warn the people and the vehicles, residents around the valve well are warned as soon as possible, and the casualties are effectively reduced.
assignees: YIZHOU TANGSHAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detection instrument, detection system and detection method for distribution and transformation tapping point gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection instrument for a distribution and transformation tapping point gear. The detection instrument is mainly formed by mutually coupling and electrically connecting a tapping point winding coil resistance detection circuit part and a 485 data communication part of a distribution and transformation terminal. The invention further discloses a detection system for the distribution and transformation tapping point gear, and data interaction is carried out between the detection instrument for the distribution and transformation tapping point gear and the distribution and transformation terminal, so as to fulfill the function of remotely monitoring the state of the tapping joint gear of a transformer in real time. The invention provides a detection method on the basis of the detection system for the distribution and transformation tapping point gear to acquire and display the state and the resistance of the tapping point gear of the transformer and update the state and the resistance of the tapping point gear of the transformer to a terminal system. According to the invention, the state of the tapping point gear of the transformer is remotely monitored in real time on the site, and an abnormal warning is given when the state of the tapping point gear of the transformer is abnormal to notify an engineer to carry out on-site overhaul. The safety accidents caused to abnormity of the tapping point gear are avoided.
assignees: Changxing county power supply bureau;ZHEJIANG CREAWAY AUTOMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Platform is supported in a kind of power network repairing operation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to power distribution network area of maintenance,Platform is supported in a kind of power network repairing operation,By expert system,It is wirelessly transferred and moves the technological means such as operation end,Compile fault message,With reference to repairing resource information,Operation of power networks state and failure distribution etc. are judged,Assist that center personnel there may be to power network or the hidden danger that occurs exercises supervision early warning,According to the utilization information of various resources,Repairing task is issued to corresponding region,Simultaneously by the analysis that exercised supervision to the process for the task of repairing,Reasonable distribution is carried out to repairing resource,Aid in repair personnel preferably selection and execution repairing task,To improve first-aid repair efficiency,By the judgment rule of expert system,Utilize online or offline mobile terminal,Repair personnel is helped to determine specific trouble point or equipment faster,Improve first-aid repair efficiency during practical operation,While by rushing to repair the feedback mechanism of operation,Expert system is updated perfect,Be advantageous to ensure the whole efficiency of power network repairing.
assignees: STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY HAINAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twinning-based lightning protection combined insulator insulation coordination detection and structure optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based lightning protection combined insulator insulation coordination detection and structure optimization method, which comprises the steps of obtaining structural parameters, real-time environmental parameters and operation electrical parameters of the lightning protection combined insulator to be detected, constructing a digital twinning simulation field model, establishing a preliminary digital twinning simulation platform, obtaining an updated preliminary digital twinning simulation platform, establishing an insulation coordination equivalent model to obtain an optimized design scheme, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning on the insulation coordination condition of the lightning protection combined insulator according to the insulation coordination equivalent model. The invention can monitor the insulation state of the insulator and the lightning arrester in real time, realize real-time tracking of the insulation performance, immediately send out early warning once the insulation performance is abnormal, remind operation and maintenance personnel to take measures in time, effectively avoid equipment faults or safety accidents caused by insulation failure, be favorable for finding out the performance bottleneck and potential problems of the equipment in time, and provide targeted maintenance advice for the operation and maintenance personnel.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent substation equipment state sensing and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a state sensing and early warning system and method for intelligent substation equipment, and relates to the technical field of industrial early warning; the method comprises the steps of fitting a historical state of equipment based on a long-short-term memory neural network model, outputting a reference aging trend item, calculating an event-driven disaster variation item under operation vibration by using a damage model based on a physical mechanism, calculating a difference value between the event-driven disaster variation item and the reference aging trend item to obtain a transient disturbance deviation degree, constructing an orthogonal fusion state vector containing the reference aging trend item and the transient disturbance deviation degree, carrying out state update on a time axis by adopting a recursive algorithm, and calculating a dynamic safety margin index and the residual hidden trouble-free running time of the equipment based on the updated orthogonal fusion state vector. The invention solves the problem of systematic missing report of the vibration hidden danger by the model.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION CO LTD

title_en: A method for transmitting of users emergency information and alarming sleep time
title_ko: 사용자의 응급 상황 정보 전송 및 수면 시간 알람 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 신호 측정기와 사용자의 휴대용 단말기를 동기화시켜 사용자의 생체 신호 측정값과 기 저장된 건강 기준값 범위 비교에 따라 사용자 상황의 응급 상태 여부를 판단하고, 응급 상태인 경우 기 설정되어 있는 긴급 연락처가 생체 신호 측정기의 화면에 팝업되어 사용자의 터치로 선택된 연락처에 응급 구호 요청 신호가 전송되는 사용자의 응급 상황 정보 전송 방법을 제공한다. 또한, 목표 수면 시간 및 알람 시간이 입력되면 알람 해제에 필요한 소정의 운동량을 설정하고, 취침 개시 후 기 설정된 목표 수면 시간 또는 알람 시간에 도달된 경우 알람을 경보한 후에 소정의 시간 동안 수행되는 사용자의 운동량을 측정하여 소정의 운동량 초과인 경우에만 알람이 정지되는 사용자의 수면 시간 알람 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: FOUND RES & BUSINESS SEOUL NAT UNIV SCIENCE & TECH;JEONG JIN MAN

title_en: Intelligent fence laser column, intelligent anti-intrusion system and safety protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fence laser column, an intelligent anti-intrusion system and a safety protection method, and aims to solve the technical problems of inconvenience in movement, poor protection warning effect and insufficient durability of the existing protection fence. The intelligent gate control system comprises an intelligent authorized door lock, an electronic fence and an LED display terminal, wherein a gate control unit comprises a mechanical lock and a recognizer for controlling the opening and closing of the mechanical lock, the fence comprises a boundary line and a warning line, the boundary line is connected end to form a closed protection area, the gate control unit is arranged on a path formed by the boundary line, intelligent fence laser columns are arranged on the boundary line at intervals and used for forming the warning line in the protection area, and an electronic display screen is arranged and used for playing warning information in a rolling mode. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the structure is light, the management is fine, the real-time recording is realized, and the content can be updated in time.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU JINGCHENG ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Patrol management equipment, method, system, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides inspection management equipment, an inspection management method, an inspection management system, a server and a storage medium. The device comprises a main control module, an image acquisition module, a positioning module, a data analysis monitoring server, a warning information sending module and a warning information receiving module, wherein the main control module is used for acquiring a map marked with line information to be inspected and triggering the display module to display, the image acquisition module is used for acquiring audio and video data of the line to be inspected, the positioning module is used for acquiring current position information of the inspection management device, the main control module is used for sending the audio and video data and the current position information to the data analysis monitoring server through the communication module, when the data analysis monitoring server determines that a warning event exists, the generated warning information is sent to the inspection management device, the state of a warning point on the line to be inspected is updated according to the current position information, the updated state of the warning point is sent to the inspection management device, the map marked with the line information to be inspected is correspondingly updated and displayed through the display module, and the warning light warning module is touched according to the warning information to carry out warning.

title_en: Real-time monitoring system for deformation of coal mining and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring system for coal mining deformation, which comprises a physical layer, a transmission layer, a processing layer and an application layer, wherein the using method of the system comprises the steps of laying a main optical fiber and a branch optical fiber, connecting a data processing unit with an optical fiber sensing head, collecting strain data, denoising, normalizing and constructing a sequence on the data, predicting the strain time sequence data of the optical fiber, carrying out discriminant analysis and hierarchical early warning on predicted value and actual value residual errors, triggering a three-dimensional visualization platform to update abnormal labels, inquiring historical deformation records, and practicing an emergency response plan. The system has the characteristics of strong continuous monitoring capability, strong real-time performance, high deployment flexibility and good visualization effect, and the safety and the production efficiency of the coal mine are obviously improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL XIAN DESIGN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Flood early warning simulation method based on dynamic self-adaptive differential algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood early warning simulation method based on a dynamic self-adaptive differential algorithm, which comprises the steps of simulating a flood process based on a flood inundation model in a target time step, obtaining real-time water flow data and terrain elevation model data of a target area, determining a spreading state coefficient of the flood according to the flow rate of the flood and the interval distance between the target area and a block dike opening, clustering the terrain elevation model data to obtain a first clustering result, determining a stagnation area in a preset area according to the first clustering result, updating the target time step according to the area and the spreading state coefficient of the stagnation area to obtain an updated target time step, simulating the flood process by taking the updated target time step as the target time step of the next moment, and determining to send out early warning in response to the fact that the simulation result of the flood process reaches preset early warning conditions. The invention updates the time step of the model and solves the problem of unbalanced simulation precision and efficiency.

title_en: Camera potential safety hazard inspection and identification method based on video frame image segmentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camera potential safety hazard inspection and identification method based on video frame image segmentation, which belongs to the technical field of image processing, the method obtains data through a video cloud storage system and classifies the data into a basic data pool, and selecting a target video source set by combining a daily safety inspection mechanism and a special safety inspection mechanism, performing image segmentation and feature extraction by adopting a region growing algorithm and a U-Net network, and executing judgment and identification operation based on different selection mechanisms. Meanwhile, the potential safety hazard list items and the time period of easy occurrence are dynamically evaluated and updated, hidden trouble reporting records are generated, and the patrol strategy is optimized. The method can comprehensively and automatically identify potential safety hazards in the construction environment of the construction site, and improve the early warning accuracy and efficiency.

title_en: Centralized control station side equipment state early warning method and system based on general algorithm architecture
abstract_en: The architecture comprises an early warning algorithm basic configuration, early warning data acquisition, effective equipment data judgment, equipment early warning algorithm analysis, early warning monitoring display, early warning auxiliary analysis, early warning information cross-region synchronization and equipment early warning visual analysis. According to basic configuration information of various algorithms of equipment early warning, real-time data, historical data and warning information of subscribing early warning objects are collected to obtain data required by equipment early warning, invalid equipment and measuring point data are filtered through equipment data validity judgment, various early warning algorithms are used for periodic scheduling analysis, early warning real-time warning is pushed, and early warning result data are stored. The structure is used for realizing the active early warning of equipment hidden danger, and auxiliary equipment monitoring operation and maintenance professionals discover equipment problems in advance and timely treat the equipment hidden danger through an early warning monitoring interface, an early warning monitoring assistant, early warning information cross-region synchronization and early warning visual analysis.
assignees: BEIJING SIFANG ENG CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: Mobile phone, safety information server, and safety confirmation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technique capable of transmitting safety information on a mobile phone with its access regulated to a safety information server without providing an exclusive communication function or communication facility.SOLUTION: A safety information creation unit 8 creates safety information on a user of a mobile phone 1 after access regulation is imposed after receiving an emergency warning.
