title_en: Apparatus, method and computer program for providing information based on Air-quality index
title_ko: 대기 지수 기반 정보 제공 장치, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an air pollution index based information providing device comprises: an information collecting unit configured to receive location information of a user terminal and air pollution index information at the location from the user terminal; an information managing unit configured to update an air pollution index map including air pollution index information with regard to a plurality of locations based on the location information and the air pollution index information; and an information providing unit configured to generate an alarm including a message to be provided to a user based on the air pollution index map and the location information of the user terminal and provide the alarm to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는 사용자 단말로부터 상기 사용자 단말의 위치 정보 및 상기 위치에서의 대기 지수 정보를 수신하는 정보 수집부; 상기 위치 정보 및 상기 대기 지수 정보에 기초하여, 복수의 위치에 대한 대기 지수 정보를 포함하는 대기 지수 지도를 갱신하는 정보 관리부; 및 상기 대기 지수 지도 및 상기 사용자 단말의 위치 정보에 기초하여 사용자에게 제공할 메시지를 포함하는 알림을 생성하여 상기 사용자 단말에 전송하는 정보 제공부;를 포함하는 대기지수 기반 정보 제공 장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning system using beacon
title_ko: 비콘을 이용한 화재 재난 조기 경보 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for fire disaster early warning using beacon capable of spreading an urgent situation and supporting a fire report. According to an embodiment, the method for fire disaster early warning using beacon comprises the steps of: receiving a beacon signal from at least one or more beacon device through a near field communication; identifying the beacon device from the received beacon signal; determining whether specific information included in the beacon signal corresponding to the identified beacon device is changed; and generating a warning in accordance with determining that the specific information included in the received beacon signal is change.
abstract_ko: 비콘을 이용한 화재 재난 조기 경보 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 단말에서 수행되는 경보 발생 방법은, 근거리 무선 통신을 통하여 적어도 하나 이상의 비콘 장치로부터 비콘 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 수신된 비콘 신호로부터 비콘 장치를 식별하는 단계; 상기 식별된 비콘 장치에 대응되는 비콘 신호에 포함된 특정 정보가 변경되었는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 수신된 비콘 신호에 포함된 특정 정보가 변경됨을 판단함에 따라 경보를 발생시키는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA RES & BUSINESS FOUNDATION SEJONG CAMPUS

title_en: Intelligent detection alarm equipment for gas environment
abstract_en: The invention provides intelligent detection alarm equipment for a gas environment, which detects the gas concentration, smoke, the ambient temperature, the existence condition and the activity state of personnel in the environment in real time, and sends detection data to an upper computer at regular time through an RS485 bus or a voice and 4G communication module. When the gas concentration, smoke and environmental temperature of the environment exceed warning values, the equipment reports instant alarm information to an upper computer, and meanwhile, the information is directly sent to a platform server and/or a mobile phone client, and whether personnel in the alarm environment have rescue requirements or not is known at the first time; the distress personnel can carry out voice communication with the control center, and meanwhile, the control center can also send group broadcasting to all users to inform the users whether or not to withdraw and how to withdraw. When the equipment provided by the invention is used for obtaining the dangerous situation, the equipment can be used for obtaining whether personnel needing rescue exist in the environment where the equipment is located, so that limited rescue resources are preferentially used for personnel rescue, and the casualties are avoided to the greatest extent.

title_en: Disaster emergency treatment method and system based on large event awareness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency treatment method and a disaster emergency treatment system based on large event awareness, which relate to the technical field of disaster emergency treatment in the sanitation industry and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data according to a set collection period; the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data corresponding to historical large disaster events, extracting disaster abnormal characteristics, training a large disaster event perception model based on the disaster abnormal characteristics, constructing a large disaster event knowledge base, obtaining large disaster event early warning information according to the acquired multi-source heterogeneous data, the large disaster event perception model and the large disaster event knowledge base, matching a corresponding emergency treatment plan from a pre-constructed emergency treatment plan base according to the large disaster event early warning information, re-planning an environmental sanitation vehicle route, obtaining a corresponding emergency treatment plan according to the re-planned environmental sanitation vehicle route and the corresponding emergency treatment plan, monitoring the corresponding emergency treatment plan in real time, and generating feedback information to update the corresponding emergency treatment plan.

title_en: A kind of security system of coal mining
abstract_en: The invention belongs to technical field of mine safety, the security system of specifically a kind of coal mining, including gas management unit, fire detection unit, floods detection unit, vital signs body detection unit, prewarning unit, security protection control host, remote monitoring unit, blowing unit, fire extinguishing unit, drainage cell and urgent danger prevention unit.Flexible arrangement of the present invention, it can easily be mounted in coal mine, coal mine unusual condition is notified related personnel in advance by realization, related personnel is reminded to pay attention to and check coal mine situation, when fire, floods occur, warning related personnel's emergency shutdown in time is simultaneously withdrawn rapidly, simultaneously, this system can be monitored automatically for floods, fire and the gas density situation in coal mine, automatic alarm realizes the early prevention of the condition of a disaster and controllable, long-range monitoring and control are realized, targetedly to eliminate safe hidden trouble early.
assignees: FEICHENG MINING GROUP MINING INDUSTRY MAN SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Portable river flood early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment, in particular to a portable river flood early warning device. According to the invention, the water level signal acquisition and transmission device is erected on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and is thrown to a proper position through the unmanned aerial vehicle. When flood comes, the control terminal at the downstream side sends out an alarm to prompt the flood of the flying personnel to withdraw as soon as possible, and meanwhile, the unmanned plane autonomously returns to the river along the river at a height which is as close to the personnel in the river as possible, attractive and ensures the safety of the personnel in the river, and simultaneously sends out sound, light and smoke alarm signals to prompt the personnel along the river to withdraw from the river before the flood comes, so that personnel loss is avoided.

title_en: Landslide prediction and early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of landslide early warning and risk management and control research, and particularly discloses a landslide prediction and early warning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of dividing rainfall events, marking positive events and negative events, and dividing historical landslide data into an initial landslide set and a newly-added landslide set; generating an initial landslide vulnerability map, updating the initial landslide vulnerability map based on a new landslide set, generating an updated landslide vulnerability map, constructing a deep learning sample set, training and predicting a comprehensive sample set by using a deep learning model, wherein the deep learning model comprises a convolutional neural network and a long-short-period memory network, the deep pregnancy disaster environment characteristic in multidimensional static space data of the convolutional neural network is used for extracting dynamic time sequence characteristics, and the long-short-period memory network is used for outputting landslide probability through a classifier after fusing the two characteristics. The application can realize high-precision and dynamically updated rainfall landslide probability prediction and provides direct decision support for landslide early warning.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;ZHEJIANG GEOLOGICAL INST

title_en: Landslide digital twin frame construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide simulation, and discloses a landslide digital twin frame construction method, which is used for carrying out simulation on slope instability conditions with different soil properties and different slopes to form a digital twin body construction foundation, constructing a three-dimensional scene substrate, merging a instability threshold value and a rainfall field to form a landslide digital twin body, constructing a landslide three-dimensional scene visualization scene, and carrying out visualization monitoring and early warning on a landslide process. The frame technology constructed by the method supports the dynamic update and response of measured data, and can provide theoretical technical support for the accurate prediction and intelligent early warning of landslide process. The technology has the function of updating the physical properties of the ground surface in real time, can realize the visualization of the whole landslide process, provides theoretical basis for landslide control decision, realizes the real-time monitoring of the landslide easily-occurring area, saves a large amount of manpower and material resources compared with the traditional monitoring, and has important significance for intelligent monitoring and management of landslide.

title_en: Ultra-temperature pyrolysis electric fire extremely early monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-temperature pyrolysis electric fire extremely early monitoring and early warning method and a device, which belong to the technical field of electric equipment safety monitoring and fire early warning, and comprise the steps of acquiring multidimensional environmental parameters in a power distribution facility in real time; the method comprises the steps of inputting multidimensional environmental parameters into a pre-trained neural network model, outputting early warning probability reflecting real pyrolysis hidden danger and false alarm probability reflecting environmental interference, dynamically updating weights of the environmental parameters based on the early warning probability and the false alarm probability, inputting the environmental parameters with updated weights into the neural network model again to obtain updated early warning probability and false alarm probability, comprehensively judging by combining preset multilevel judgment rules to distinguish real pyrolysis from interference factors, and outputting early warning signals when judging the real pyrolysis. According to the invention, through a neural network and dynamic weight cooperative mechanism, the false alarm rate is obviously reduced, and the extremely early accurate early warning of the electric fire is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Emergency command system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem that since map data showing a building or a road or the like recorded in an emergency command system in a fire department headquarters are updated once a year, any building may not be registered in the address of a notification destination on the map data when receiving emergency notification, and that since the member of a fire station manually operates a maintenance device, and adds information such as a building at the notification destination to the map data while looking at the content of a letter of instruction, it is time-consuming.SOLUTION: Disclosed is an emergency command system configured to automatically determine whether or not a building is registered in the address of a notification destination on map data, and to, when determining that any building is not present, add the information of the notification destination to the map data.

title_en: Alert control program, information processing device, and alert control method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suppress the occurrence of an unnecessary alert.SOLUTION: Provided is an alert control program which causes a computer to execute processing of: assigning a work W to a first responder X; setting, as a first time limit L1 of the work W, a timing going back from a processing time limit DL of the work W by a time corresponding to a predicted time TY1 which is required for a second responder Y whose processing of the work W is faster than the first responder X to execute the processing of the work W; executing an assignment 22 of the work W to the second responder Y by outputting an alert 21 when it is detected that the first time limit L1 has expired before completion of the processing of the work W; and setting, as a second time limit L2, a timing going back from the processing time limit DL of the work W by a time corresponding to a predicted time TY2 which is required for the second responder Y to execute the processing of the remaining work W while the work X is assigned to the first responder X, when it is detected that the processing of the work W has been progressed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Rainfall information collecting and early-warning method and system for high speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall information collecting and early-warning system for a high speed railway. The rainfall information collecting and early-warning system comprises a rainfall information collecting device, a current signal/numerical signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating rainfall disaster risk reference threshold values, an early-warning program starting deciding deice, a locating device, a train control device for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device; a control module serves as the kernel of the whole system, on one hand, the control module controls operation of all the mentioned devices, and on the other hand, the control module is used for being connected with an external computer device and other external equipment to achieve communication and control. According to the system, the reference threshold values for evaluating rainfall disaster risks are dynamically generated, and combined with historical disaster occur conditions which are continuously updated after the newest early-warning occurs, risk beforehand evaluation of a certain region is considered more completely and scientifically through comparison with historical data. The invention further provides a rainfall information collecting and early-warning method for the high speed railway.

title_en: Security and protection monitoring information updating method
abstract_en: In order to reduce the cost required for updating a security and protection warning display device utilizing a liquid crystal display screen for publicizing and warning, and improve the reliability of security and protection warning information updating, the invention provides a security and protection monitoring information updating method. The security and protection warning information updating method comprises the steps that security and protection warning information is distributed to a plurality of movable machines, the plurality of movable machines send the security and protection warning information to the security and protection warning display device provided with the liquid crystal display screen, and the security and protection warning display device is updated and displays the security and protection warning information. By utilizing the movable machines such as patrol vehicles or private vehicles, the updating of the security and protection warning information is greatly facilitated, manpower and security and protection warning operation-maintenance costs are saved, and the timeliness and reliability of security and protection warning information updating in special environments such as field or forest parks are improved.
assignees: CHENGDU JIAZE SOC GENERALE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of register one's residence early warning and response tracking system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of register one's residence early warning and response tracking system based on Internet of Things, including a key Forewarning Terminal machine, the one key Forewarning Terminal machine communication link is connected to early warning response terminating machine of registering one's residence, the one key Forewarning Terminal machine includes the first controller, first controller is connected with communication module, trigger key-press module, voice sending module and display module, the early warning response terminating machine of registering one's residence includes second controller, the second controller is connected with communication module, display module, alarm module, voice broadcast module, microphone input module and the response key-press module for confirming/cancelling early warning.The present invention is using GPRS, NB IOT, Lora communications, with reference to issue warning information such as mountain torrents person liable APP, a key Forewarning Terminal machine and early warning of registering one's residence response terminating machines and track the feedback information for response terminating machine of registering one's residence, the mode that text information and voice messaging combine is employed, avoids that advice method is single and personnel omit.

title_en: Early warning device for roof collapse disaster of coal mine tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mining, and particularly discloses a coal mine roadway roof fall disaster early warning device, which comprises a base and further comprises: the setting is in the shifting chute on the base upper surface, the top of base is provided with the connecting plate, the top of connecting plate is provided with the backup pad, the inside of shifting chute is provided with the elevating system who is used for the connecting plate to go up and down, be provided with the supporting mechanism who is used for supporting the backup pad on the upper surface of connecting plate, be equipped with the power unit who is used for providing power on the side of base, be provided with on the upper surface of base and be used for controlling supporting mechanism moving control mechanism, through elevating system, be favorable to adjusting the height of the early warning device of colliery tunnel roof fall calamity, be convenient for detect the tunnel, through supporting mechanism, be favorable to taking place the back in roof fall calamity, can block and support the tunnel through the object that the backup pad will drop, the workman of being convenient for withdraws from the tunnel.
assignees: SICHUAN HUAYINSHAN LONGTAN COAL CO LTD

title_en: Wearable protective device with help calling function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective devices, in particular to a wearable protective device with a help calling function. The invention provides a wearable protective device with a help calling function, which can perform high-temperature early warning on firefighters. The wearable protective device with the help calling function comprises a clamping ring and an early warning mechanism, wherein the front side of the clamping ring is rotationally connected, and the clamping ring is provided with the early warning mechanism; the breathing mechanism, the early warning mechanism and the clamping ring are provided with the breathing mechanism. According to the invention, the temperature of the rescue site is increased to reach the critical point of gas thermal expansion, the gas in the gas sealing tank expands to drive the piston rod to move upwards, so that the prompting rod moves inwards to squeeze the neck of the firefighter, thus the firefighter can be reminded of the possibility of overhigh temperature and bombing in the space, the firefighter can timely withdraw from the site, the situation of no fear of sacrifice is avoided, and when accidents happen, a button can be pressed, so that the distress call device can give out sound and light to give an alarm, thereby attracting the partner to help and improving the safety of the firefighter.
assignees: GUANGZHOU S AIRBAG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent security management system based on community
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security management, in particular to an intelligent security management system based on communities, which comprises: the risk index quantifying module collects community security data sources, extracts invasion frequency and emergency call times, classifies environment sensing data, and generates quantified risk indexes. According to the method and the system, the risk weight is adjusted in real time according to the change rate and the frequency of various data, and more accurate risk assessment is provided for community safety management. The security level is updated by comparing the current data with the historical trend, so that the security measures of communities are ensured to be closely connected with the actual conditions. Through deep analysis and behavior pattern prediction of personnel flow data, potential concentrated areas and change time in communities can be identified, and the prospective and pertinence of community safety early warning are further enhanced. The emergency notification flow is optimized by matching with the real-time risk assessment, so that the occurrence rate and influence of safety events are reduced, and the overall safety management efficiency of the community is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG MINGYANG INFORMATION & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line external damage prevention monitoring and early warning device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission line monitoring, in particular to an external damage prevention monitoring and early warning device and method for a power transmission line, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle monitors the power transmission line according to a set route, meanwhile, a laser radar scans the environment of the power transmission line, collects position and distance information to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data, a three-dimensional point cloud model is built through the three-dimensional point cloud data, an unmanned aerial vehicle is used for inspection, a picture is shot, the three-dimensional point cloud model is updated in real time to conduct real-time monitoring, the distance in the three-dimensional point cloud model is monitored, a preset value is set, and an alarm is given after the distance is lower than the preset value, so that external damage prevention monitoring and early warning are conducted on the power transmission line based on the three-dimensional point cloud technology, the accuracy and timeliness of hidden danger identification are greatly improved, the manpower investment is reduced, and the operation and maintenance inspection efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHANGJI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHONGQING NANDIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-point off-site synchronous geological disaster early warning method and system based on rainfall observation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipoint off-site synchronous geological disaster early warning method and system based on rainfall observation, belonging to the disaster early warning field, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of monitoring nodes, arranging a rainfall detection station and a soil humidity sensor at each monitoring node, and installing a gradient sensor in a landslide sensitive area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time coupling on collected data, then sending the collected data to a cloud platform, decompressing the data after the cloud platform receives sensor data, inputting the collected sensor data into a comprehensive prediction model to dynamically update soil humidity, and evaluating geological disaster risks based on the change of the soil humidity and the data of the geological condition database in various geological disaster prone areas in the cloud platform. The method and the system can fully utilize multi-source heterogeneous data so as to comprehensively evaluate the risk of geological disasters.
assignees: INST OF AGRICULTURAL RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT SICHUAN ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: Mining earthquake early warning method, device and system based on microseism monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine earthquake early warning method based on microseism monitoring, which comprises the steps of converting a current time monitoring signal into a frequency domain by adopting Fourier transformation to obtain current time frequency point data, judging whether the current time monitoring frequency point data is normal or not according to whether the energy value of the current time frequency point data and the stored change amplitude value of the energy value of the background field frequency point data of the current time exceed a set threshold value, judging whether a microseism event occurs or not according to the change amplitude value, and determining the position of the microseism event. According to the mining earthquake early warning method, the background field frequency point data are updated in real time, other gentle background field changes except sudden microseism time can be ignored in monitoring, and the small changes are added into the background field in time, so that the effect of continuously suppressing noise is achieved, and early warning judgment is more accurate.
assignees: FANKOU LEAD ZINC MINE SHENZHEN ZHONGJIN LINGNAN NONFEMET CO LTD;BEIJING PETROSOUND GEOSERVICES CORP

title_en: An Emergency Warning System For A Small Size house
title_ko: 댁내 비상 경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to home emergency alarm system. The home emergency alarm system according to the present invention comprises: an unauthorized intrusion detection module for detecting an emergency situation caused by intrusion into a house; an alarm device for generating an alarm in operation of the unauthorized intrusion detection module; and a home smartphone for receiving a signal from the alarm device by short-distance wireless communication and performing an automatic trespass report if a release signal is not input to the alarm device after a predetermined time elapses after the operation of the alarm device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 댁내 비상 경보시스템에 대한 것이다.  본 발명에 의한 댁내 비상 경보시스템은, 댁내 무단 침입에 의한 비상상황을 검출하는 무단침입 감지모듈과; 상기 무단침입 감지모듈의 동작시 경보를 발생시키는 경보장치와; 상기 경보장치의 동작 후 일정시간이 경과해도 상기 경보장치로 해제신호가 입력되지 않는 경우에는 근거리무선통신에 의해 상기 경보장치로부터 해당 신호를 전달받아 자동 무단침입 신고를 수행하는 댁내 스마트폰을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Charger loss prevention adapter
abstract_en: A reminder system for a portable device charger is designed to determine when the charger is likely to be left behind. The detection, which may be in real time, may pertain to a disconnection of the portable device from the charger and/or a movement of the portable device out of wireless range of the charger or charger adapter, according to embodiments. In some versions, the start of the reminder is temporarily deferred until a predetermined criterion is met, such as expiration of a predetermined time period, upon detection of the disconnection. Or the criterion may be the detection of an out-of-range condition based on the distance between the portable device and the adapter or charger. In some embodiments the detection and alert issuance is incorporated into the unit, e.g., the plug-in wall adapter or the charger itself. The adapter may be generic rather than dedicated to a particular make or model of charger. The system may be non-intrusive and sensitive to charger connection status, power savings, and power outages.

title_en: GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) wireless intelligent household gas safety system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) wireless intelligent household gas safety system, which is composed of two components including an electronic intelligent valve and a gas detection alarm.. The electronic valve is internally provided with an electronic receiving module and further provided with an on/off key, and the components are connected with gas input and output pipes; a microprocessor of the alarm is internally provided with a gas detector, a GSM SIM (Subscriber Identity Module) card and an alarm buzzer, when the components detect that the gas concentration in a region reaches an alarm set vaue, the safety system automatically alarms, sends a mobile phone alarm short message and simultaneously sends a valve closing instruction; and after receiving the closing instruction, the electronic valve immediately closes the valve; therefore, the dangerous case can be known in time and the valve can be closed automatically, and the potential safety hazard is eliminated completely. Users can change the system original passwords and set the short message number for alarm by a mobile phone short message. When the components are in a low-battery state, the safety system generates sound and light to remind users of charging or changing batteries. When the alarm sounds, the warning can be terminated by pressing a cancel key on the alarm or sending a cancel short message to a system GSM card through the mobile phone.

title_en: Method and related device for transmitting small amount of data in power saving state
abstract_en: A method of Small Data Transfer (SDT) in a power saving state is provided. The method comprises the following steps: the UE applies at least one SDT-related timer on a first SDT bandwidth part (BWP) during SDT in a power saving state; and if the at least one SDT-related timer is not running on the first SDT BWP, switching from the first SDT BWP to the second SDT BWP to receive at least one of updated System Information (SI) and Public Warning System (PWS) information from the network. By this method, changes in SI and/or monitoring of PWS information on the associated BWP can be achieved during SDT progression.

title_en: Mine geological disaster automatic monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic monitoring and early warning device for mine geological disasters, which belongs to the field of automatic monitoring and early warning devices and comprises a carriage, wherein an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the carriage, the output end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a first telescopic rod, and one end, far away from the electric push rod, of the first telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a first supporting plate. According to the invention, the first telescopic rod can lift up and down to drive the early warning device on the first supporting plate, the third rotary shaft drives the first box door to rotate, and the first box door can rotate through the connecting plate to enable the second box door to be opened and closed, so that the first box door and the second box door can be opened to extend out of a carriage when the early warning device is used, the first box door and the second box door are retracted in the carriage when the early warning device is not used, and then the first box door and the second box door are automatically closed, so that the early warning device is prevented from being influenced by dust and humidity in a mine all the year round outside, and the service life of the early warning device is shortened.
assignees: WUGANG RESOURCE GROUP CHENGCHAO MINING CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-edge cooperation-based intelligent safety monitoring and diagnosis system for water conservancy facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud edge coordination, in particular to an intelligent safety monitoring and diagnosing system for water conservancy facilities based on cloud edge coordination. The system comprises a filtering prediction unit, an early warning risk unit and an error optimization unit. According to the invention, the original water level data is denoised to obtain filtered water level data, adjacent 2-minute speed-up data is calculated and packaged, the LSTM time sequence prediction model feature set is constructed by the packaged data, the phenomenon that the edge end only uploads the original data is avoided, the uploaded data amount is reduced, the data transmission efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the load of cloud processing data is reduced, the cloud can concentrate on the analysis of key data, and when the analysis of the key data is concentrated, the time forgetting gate output, the input gate, the candidate cell state update value, the cell state and the output gate are calculated, so that the cloud processed data is more refined, the unnecessary calculation amount is reduced, the response can be made faster, and the cloud analysis efficiency is improved.
assignees: NINGBO HONGTAI WATER CONSERVANCY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Server, program, monitoring assistance system, and monitoring assistance method
abstract_en: To provide a server or the like capable of ensuring safety of patrol monitors.SOLUTION: A server is a server that communicates with a sensor terminal carried by a monitor and includes a storage unit that stores the monitor's patrol route, a zone information acquisition unit that acquires information on an alert zone, an update unit that updates the patrol route so as not to include the alert zone when the information on the alert zone is acquired while the monitor patrols the patrol route, and a notifying unit that notifies the monitor of the updated patrol route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Oil lever control system using the ground
title_ko: 접지를 이용한 저유소의 유류레버 단속시스템
abstract_en: An oil lever secure system of an oil reservoir using the earth connection is provided to prevent the flame from generating by operating a discharging pump with a valve handle. An oil lever secure system of an oil reservoir using the earth connection comprises: an earth sensor(2) sensing the connection of an earth conductor ejecting an external electric shock to the underground; a handle locking part(3) freely operating an valve handle if the earth connection is sensed by the earth sensor, or locking the valve handle if not; a handle operation detection part(4) sensing whether the valve is opened or not; an alarming part(5) warning that the earth connection does not realize; a discharging pump operation part(6) controlling the power of a discharging pump(6a); and a controller(1) controlling all elements.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 접지가 이루어지지 않으면 유류공급관에 설치된 밸브는 물론 펌프가 작동되지 않게 차단함으로서 접지가 이루어지지 않은 상태에서는 유류가 유조차에 공급되지 않게 함으로서 정전기 등의 충격전기에 의해 발생된 불꽃이 유류에 점화되어 화재 및 폭발사고가 발생되는 것을 방지할 수 있게 한 접지를 이용한 저유소의 유류레버 단속시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     이러한 본 발명의 접지를 이용한 저유소의 유류레버 단속시스템은 저유소에 저장되고 펌프를 통해 펌핑하여 유조차에 유류를 적재하는 유류공급관의 중단에 설치된 밸브를 개폐하는 밸브손잡이를 단속하는 레버단속 시스템에 있어서, 외부의 전기 충격을 지중으로 배출하는 접지선의 접속여부를 감지하는 접지감지부와 ; 상기 접지감지부에서 접지가 감지되면 밸브손잡이가 자유롭게 작동될 수 있게 하고, 접지가 이루어지지 않으면 손잡이가 작동되지 않도록 잠그는 손잡이잠금부와 ; 상기 손잡이잠금부가 해제되어 밸브손잡이가 작동되어 밸브가 개방되었는지 여부를 감지하는 손잡이작동감지부와 ; 접지가 안된 상태에서 밸브손잡이가 작동되면 접지가 이루어지지 않았음을 경고하는 경고부와 ; 접지가 이루어진 상태에서 밸브손잡이가 작동되어 밸브가 개방되면 상기 출하펌프에 전원을 인가하여 유류가 펌핑되도록 출하펌프에 공급되는 전원을 제어하는 출하펌프구동부 및 ; 상기 각 구성요소를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     접지, 저유소, 접지감지부, 손잡이잠금부, 경고부

title_en: Venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance, which relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control management and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a venue building based on BIM and Internet of things, and constructing a fire monitoring model by using the digital twin model and fire emergency event instance data; acquiring real-time multi-source security data through fire control equipment of a venue building to perform fire detection and early warning, determining fire scene dynamic parameters to update a fire monitoring model, and acquiring fire dynamic characteristics of different venue building areas; and acquiring key factors influencing evacuation efficiency, planning evacuation paths by combining an improved mouse swarm algorithm, and visually displaying the optimal evacuation paths of different venue building areas according to a preset mode. According to the invention, evacuation path planning and overall monitoring and management of fire safety of a venue are dynamically performed in real time according to the development situation of a fire disaster, so that loss in emergency situations such as the fire disaster is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: In-vehicle Air Cleaning Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Battery Charging
title_ko: 배터리 충전 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air purifying device for providing emergency dispatch service for battery charging and, more specifically, to an air purifying device which is provided with an air purifying module in which a photocatalyst panel and a UV lamp unit are arranged and an operation module including an acoustic wave module and a communication module. To this end, the present invention comprises a near-field module, a position module, a power module and a control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 배터리 충전 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치에 따르면, 광촉매 물질을 코팅한 복수의 규소 성분 구슬들을 패널 형태로 집적 성형한 지정 개수의 광촉매 패널과 UV(UltraViolet)-A 파장 대역의 UV를 방출하는 지정 개수의 UV램프부를 지정된 기하학적 관계로 배치한 공기정화모듈을 구비하고, 상기 공기정화모듈을 통해 차량 내부의 공기 정화를 운영하면서 차량내의 상황을 인식하여 서비스를 제공하기 위해 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 운영모듈이 구비된 공기정화장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 차량 전원을 공급받아 인가하는 전원 공급부와 상기 차량 전원에 대응하는 전원을 충전하는 전원 충전부를 구비한 전원모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 전원 공급부를 통해 차량 전원이 인가되는지 상기 전원 충전부에 충전된 충전 전원이 인가되는지 확인하는 전원 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 전원 확인부를 통해 확인된 차량 전원과 충전 전원 중 어느 한 전원의 인가 상태에 대한 전원인가정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 배터리 방전 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 배터리 방전 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보에 대응하는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하면서 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Next-generation forecast and alarm integrated control module
title_ko: 차세대 예/경보 통합관제 모듈
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a next-generation forecast/alarm integrated control module capable of transmitting disaster information using a plurality of mediums, wherein provided is a graphic user interface (GUI) capable of reviewing, changing, and approving disaster contents generated from a disaster content generation module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복수의 매체들을 이용하여 재난 정보를 전송할 수 있는 차세대 예/경보 통합관제 모듈에 관한 것으로, 재난 콘텐츠 생성 모듈로부터 생성된 재난 콘텐츠들을 검토, 변경 및 승인할 수 있는 그래픽 유저 인터페이스(GUI; Graphic User Interface)를 제공한다.

title_en: Electric power operation environment monitoring system, method and equipment based on AI identification
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an electric power operation environment monitoring system, an electric power operation environment monitoring method and electric power operation environment monitoring equipment based on AI (automatic identification) recognition. This electric power operation environment monitoring system based on AI discernment gathers the three-dimensional data of electric power operation in real time based on data acquisition unit, calculate the space distance between obtain power equipment and the human body according to three-dimensional data through distance calculation unit, judge whether the space distance exceeds the distance threshold value through early warning suggestion unit and send the early warning at last, realize the monitoring to electric power operation environment, this monitoring mode does not need artifical the participation, response is ageing fast, also can in time discover the hidden danger of electric power operation, avoid causing the incident, the existence manual check of current electric power operation environment monitoring has been solved, response timeliness and management and control validity can't obtain the technical problem of guarantee.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Anorectal ward monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anorectal department ward monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and comprises an acquisition module, an analysis module, an early warning module and a query module, wherein first illness state development information is judged through emotion information of a patient, relevant information of the patient is compared with an electronic fence to obtain a first comparison result, an illness state early warning signal is sent out according to a second comparison result, an environment early warning signal is obtained according to a third comparison result, a sign early warning signal is sent out according to a third comparison result, the illness state early warning signal is updated according to a detection result, and ward information is updated in real time according to authority of a medical care account. The invention is beneficial to improving the comfort level of the patient by monitoring and early warning the emotion and disease development of the patient in real time, the system can quickly respond, effectively cope with various emergency situations, more accurately formulate personalized treatment schemes, improve the treatment success rate and the recovery speed of the patient, realize high automation and reduce the overall cost of medical service.

title_en: Method and system for informing parking area using portable wireless terminal having radio frequency identification tag
title_ko: 알에프 태그를 가진 휴대용 무선단말기를 이용한 주차 영역안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and a system for informing a parking area using a portable wireless terminal having a radio frequency identification tag are provided to allow a driver to find out his vehicle easily through light and voice by using a portable wireless terminal having an RF tag. CONSTITUTION: A wireless access point device(100) receives an ID and position information of a portable terminal(300). The wireless access point device transmits the ID and position information to a management server(500). A plurality of parking area recognition apparatuses receives one of information related to searing a parking vehicle and an emergency dispatch. The plural parking area recognition apparatuses transmits the ID of a portable wireless terminal and oneself to the wireless access point device. The plural parking area recognition apparatuses outputs a request of confirmation of vehicle parking and emergency dispatch through a light and a voice.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RF 태그를 가진 휴대용 무선단말기를 이용한 주차 영역 안내를 포함하는 각종 편의를 제공할 수 있는 휴대용 무선단말기를 이용한 주차 영역 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  이와 같은 본 발명 RF 태그를 가진 휴대용 무선단말기를 이용한 주차 영역 안내 시스템은, 주차영역인식장치로부터 휴대용 무선단말기의 식별정보와 위치정보를 수신하여 관리서버로 전송하는 무선액세스포인트장치; 상기 휴대용 무선단말기로부터 차량의 주차확인, 주차조회 및 긴급호출 정보 중 하나를 수신하여 해당 휴대용 무선단말기의 식별정보와 자신의 식별정보를 포함하여 상기 무선액세스포인트장치로 무선 전송하고, 상기 휴대용 무선단말기 또는 다른 주차영역인식장치로부터 주차확인 요청, 긴급호출이 오면 이를 음성출력 및 발광출력하는 다수의 주차영역인식장치; RF태그에 자신의 식별정보와 운전자 정보 중 하나 이상을 저장하고, 주차확인, 주차조회 및 긴급호출 신호 중 하나를 공중으로 전송하며, 설정된 주기로 자신의 위치를 알리기 위한 자신의 식별정보를 위치알림 신호로 하여 공중으로 전송하는 휴대용 무선단말기; 상기 다수의 주차영역인식장치와 휴대용 무선단말기가 등록한 차량한 위치정보를 상기 다수의 주차영역인식장치와 휴대용 무선단말기를 관리하는 관리서버로부터 수신하여 화면으로 표시하거나, 음성으로 출력하는 주차영역안내장치; 그리고, 상기 휴대용 무선단말기 정보를 데이터베이스로 저장하고, 상기 무선액세스포인트장치로부터 전송되는 상기 휴대용 무선단말기의 단말기 정보, 위치정보 및 긴급구난 호출 정보를 갱신 및 저장하며, 상 기 주차영역안내장치로 휴대용 무선단말기가 등록한 차량의 위치정보를 제공하는 관리서버;를 포함하여 구성된다. 
     이와 같은 본 발명 RF 태그를 가진 휴대용 무선단말기를 이용한 주차 영역 안내 시스템 및 방법에 따르면,별도의 휴대용 무선단말기에 의해 운전자는 자신이 주차한 위치를 음성안내나 발광되는 불빛에 의해 용이하게 찾을 수 있고, 위급한 상황 발생시 위급한 상황이 발생되었음을 외부로 쉽게 알릴 수 있으며, 위급상황이 접수된 주차영역인식장치에서 해당 접수 내용을 음성으로 안내함으로써 위험으로부터 벗어날 수 있고, 위급상황을 인식한 관리자에 의해 빠른 후속조치가 가능한 효과가 있다. 
       
     주차 영역 안내

title_en: Safety apparatus for CO2 fire extinguishing facility
title_ko: 이산화탄소 소화설비의 안전장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a safety apparatus installed on a fire extinguishing facility of a carbon dioxide medium comprises: an olfactory means (20) to accommodate an odorizer (23) on a chemical container (21) coupled to a fire pipe (10), and cause withdrawal of the odorizer (23) through a rupture film (25); and a visual means (30) to accommodate the rupture film (25) on a storage container (31) coupled to the fire pipe (10), and cause withdrawal of a color adding agent (33) through a rupture film (35). The visual means (30) uses the color adding agent (33) formed in at least one of gas and powder while having noninflammability and harmlessness to a human body. The safety apparatus further comprises an acoustic means (40) linked to the fire pipe (10) as a modified example of the present invention. Accordingly, even if a defect is present on the pipe or carbon dioxide is leaked by malfunction, a warning is olfactorily created by the odorizer and a color identified by naked eyes is added to notify whether carbon dioxide exists to induce quick escape to promote safety improvement by preventing a suffocation accident or the like.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이산화탄소 매개의 소화설비에 설치되는 안전장치에 있어서: 소화배관(10)에 결합되는 약제통(21) 상에 부취제(23)를 수용하고, 파열막(25)을 통하여 부취제(23)의 인출을 유발하는 후각수단(20); 및 소화배관(10)에 결합되는 저장통(31) 상에 파열막(25)을 수용하고, 파열막(35)을 통하여 부색제(33)의 인출을 유발하는 시각수단(30);을 포함하여 이루어진다. 상기 시각수단(30)은 인체무해성과 불연성을 지니면서 기상 및 분말상 중 적어도 하나로 구성되는 부색제(33)를 사용한다. 본 발명의 변형예로서, 상기 소화배관(10)에 연동하는 청각수단(40)을 더 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라, 배관의 결함이 있거나 오작동으로 이산화탄소가 누출되는 경우에도 부취제를 통해 후각적으로 경보하는 동시에 눈으로 식별되는 색 등을 부가하여 이산화탄소의 존재여부를 알려 신속한 대피를 유도하므로 질식사고 등의 방지에 의한 안전성 향상을 도모하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Smart carrier with automatic opening and closing function
title_ko: 자동 개폐 기능을 갖는 스마트 캐리어
abstract_en: A smart carrier with an automatic opening and closing function, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a bag body in which things can be accommodated; a sensor part which measures the weight of the carrier and measures information about location; a control part which controls a locking device and an alarm part through the weight information and the location information measured from the sensor part and information received from a smartphone; an opening and closing part capable of locking or unlocking; an alarming part which receives a signal and gives visual or auditory notification; and a mobile application or remote controller which checks the information measured from the sensor part, remotely controls the opening and closing part, and operates the alarming part as well. According to the embodiment of the present invention, it is possible to provide a smart carrier which is convenient to use with a remote control and solves the problems of loss of a bag, inability to locate the bag accurately, and inconvenience of the locking function.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 자동 개폐 기능을 갖는 스마트 캐리어는, 물건을 넣을 수 있는 가방본체; 캐리어의 무게를 측정하고 위치에 대한 정보를 측정하는 센서부; 센서부에서 측정된 무게 정보와 위치정보, 스마트폰으로부터 받은 정보를 통해 잠금장치 및 알람부를 제어하는 제어부; 잠금/해제가 가능한 개폐부; 신호를 받아 시각/청각 알림을 주는 알람부; 센서부에서 측정된 정보를 확인하며 개폐부를 원격제어하고 알람부 또한 작동시키는 모바일 어플리케이션 또는 리모컨을 포함한다.  상기와 같은 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 원거리 조작으로 편리한 사용과 가방의 분실 및 정확한 위치파악 불가능, 잠금기능의 불편한 문제를 해결하는 스마트 캐리어를 제공하는 것이다.
assignees: JUNG JAE HOON;JANG SANG BEOM;LEE SANG JUN;KIM HAN BIN

title_en: A kind of first aid information broadcasting method and broadcast system
abstract_en: A kind of first aid information broadcasting method and broadcast system, the first aid information broadcasting method are applied to the electronic equipment with communication function, include the following steps：Source device generates warning message, and the warning message includes geographical location information；Target device obtains the warning message, and after the geographical location information is converted to geographic coordinate information, generates first aid information；The target device screens the push object for meeting and imposing a condition in gathering from target group according to the geographic coordinate information；And the first aid information is pushed to the push object by the target device.The invention also discloses the broadcast systems applied to above-mentioned first aid information broadcasting method, including warning device, reception device, screening plant and pusher.The present invention improves the promptness and validity of relief, and is not limited by external web environment.
assignees: JINGZHUN EMERGENCY TECH HAINAN CO LTD

title_en: Early warning method, device, equipment and medium for 5G network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G network early warning method, a device, equipment and a medium. Sending a detection strategy to the 5G base station, wherein the detection strategy comprises the perception frequency of the 5G base station to the user equipment; receiving sensing data acquired by a 5G base station, wherein the sensing data is the sensing data of at least one user equipment in an operation environment; determining a perceived distance between two user devices based on perceived data of any two user devices; and generating distance early warning information for the user equipment based on the perceived distance, and/or obtaining a detection strategy based on the perceived distance update, so that the user equipment in the operation environment can be subjected to timely distance early warning, and the safety of the operation environment is improved.
assignees: NANJING BESTWAY INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Suspension platform buoy integrated pier warning system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a floating platform buoy integrated pier warning system and method, which relate to the field of pier safety warning, and comprise the steps of acquiring information data of a target river channel through a detection device, acquiring water level information data through a water level detection mechanism, carrying out ship identification according to image data to obtain an identification result, controlling the warning device to be turned off if the identification result is that no ship exists, determining the visible distance of the ship according to signal data, controlling the warning device to be turned on or turned off according to the visible distance of the ship and environment information data, judging whether limit processing is triggered according to the water level information data, determining movement state data of a floating platform main body according to the water level information data if the limit processing is triggered, and controlling an anchor cable retraction mechanism to release or retract according to the movement state data. The application aims to realize high-efficiency warning so as to provide continuous and reliable safety guarantee.

title_en: Communication device, emergency information notification system, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a communication device that can quickly and smoothly notify a user of emergencies that can continuously occur, an emergency information notification system, and a program.SOLUTION: A communication device 40 receives an earthquake early warning distributed from a distribution server 20 and performs notification based on the earthquake early warning. The communication device 40 comprises a control part, a communication part, a display part 42, and a voice output part. The communication part performs communication via the Internet network 30. The display part 42 and voice output part output information based on the earthquake early warning. When receiving the earthquake early warning from the distribution server 20 via the communication part, the control part 41 suspends update processing on a preset program excluding processing related to the reception and notification of the earthquake early warning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: SANYO TECHNO SOLUTIONS TOTTORI CO LTD

title_en: Battery embedded edge-lighting fire extinguisher sign system
abstract_en: To provide a fire extinguisher sign system maintaining stable visibility even at the time of power failure or disaster, and to provide a system having a function of managing the expiration date of a fire extinguisher and notifying it at an appropriate timing.SOLUTION: A structure in which a thin light guide plate using an edge lighting technique and an LED are combined with each other is adopted, the light guide plate is turned on by an AC100V power source at a normal time, and is automatically switched to a blinking mode by a built-in battery at a power failure. Further, by utilizing PWM control by an electronic circuit, the consumption of a battery is suppressed to the minimum while improving visibility in an emergency. The fire extinguisher also has a function of managing the expiration date of the fire extinguisher by incorporating a microcomputer. To promote appropriate maintenance by displaying a warning on an LCD panel when a time limit approaches. The system can be directly mounted on a fire extinguisher installation bracket, and simplification of installation work and stable operation can be achieved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: An safety device for heavy construction equipment
title_ko: 건설중장비 안전장치
abstract_en: A safety device for heavy construction equipment is provided to prevent accidents by sounding an alarm to the outside for the appointed hours when a driver releases a safety lever to operate heavy construction equipment. A safety device for heavy construction equipment comprises a safety lever installed to one side of a consol box to be movable in a cabin of an excavator, a limit switch(15) installed to the lower part of the safety lever and switching on or off a power supply by the operation of the safety lever, a control valve(14) controlling working oil supplied from a hydraulic pump(11), a solenoid valve(12) converted when the limit switch is turned on or off to open and close a supply passage(L) between the hydraulic pump and the control valve selectively, a timing switch(16) connected to the limit switch in series and turned on for the appointed hours when releasing the safety lever, and an alarm device(18) installed to the outside of the cabin and operated by the power supply when the timing switch is turned on to make alarm sound to the outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건설중장비 안전장치에 관한 것이며, 더욱 상세하게는 운전실 내부에서 콘솔박스 일측에 회동가능하게 설치된 안전레버; 상기 안전레버 하측에 설치되며, 상기 안전레버의 조작에 의하여 전원을 온/오프시키는 리미트 스위치; 유압펌프로부터 공급되는 작동유를 제어하는 컨트롤밸브를 구비하며, 붐이나 아암등 작업장치 및 중장비를 구동시 외부에 알려주는 건설중장비 안전장치에 있어서, 상기 리미트 스위치가 온 또는 오프 작동시 절환되어 상기 유압펌프와 컨트롤밸브 사이의 공급유로를 선택적으로 개방 및 폐쇄하는 솔레노이드 밸브; 상기 리미트 스위치에 직렬로 연결되며, 상기 안전레버를 정상 조작시 소정 시간동안 온 상태로 구동되는 타이밍 스위치; 및 상기 운전실 외부 일측에 설치되며, 상기 타이밍 스위치의 온 구동시 전원을 인가받아 작동하여 외부에 경보음을 발생하는 경보수단;을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 본 발명에 의하면, 운전자가 안전레버를 해제 상태로 조작시 이를 즉시 감지하여 조작레버의 작동 이전에 소정 시간 동안 외부에 경보를 제공하므로서 안전사고를 방지할 수 있으며, 운전자가 안전레버를 해제상태로 조작시 솔레노이드 밸브의 절환에 의하여 유로가 개방되어 작동유가 유압펌프로부터 컨트롤 밸브에 공급됨으로서 운전자가 작업에 집중하여 조종레버를 안전하게 조작할 수 있는 등 그 효과가 매우 뛰어난 장점이 있다.

title_en: Respiration training machine having a bio-feedback function
title_ko: 바이오 피드백 기능을 구비한 호흡 훈련기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A respiration training machine having a bio-feedback function is provided to display respiration volume together with a set training goal, thereby capable of controlling training level and preventing accidents through alarming control. CONSTITUTION: A respiration training machine having a bio-feedback function comprises a respiration volume detecting part(20), a key input unit(40), a calculation treatment part(50), and a display part(70). The respiration volume detecting part measures respiration volume of an examinee. The key input part generates key signal for setting and saving a training goal. The calculation treatment part set the training goal by a key signal generated from the key input part. The calculation treatment part analyzes the strength of respiration from the measured respiration volume, and transfers the same to the display part. The display part displays the accumulated the strength of respiration and a accumulated number together with the training goal.
abstract_ko:

이를 위하여 본 발명은 피검자의 호흡량을 측정하는 호흡량 검출부, 호흡 훈련의 강도와 횟수를 포함하는 훈련 목표치의 설정 및 저장을 위한 키신호를 발생시키는 키입력부, 키입력부에서 발생되는 키신호로 훈련 목표치를 설정하고 호흡량 검출부에서 측정되는 호흡량으로부터 호흡의 강도를 평가하고 그 평가 결과에 따라 호흡의 횟수를 누적하여 훈련 목표치와 함께 표시부로 전달 및 그 출력을 제어하고 훈련 목표치를 갱신하여 저장하며 심박수 이상여부를 판단하여 경보를 구공하는 연산처리부, 및 연산처리부에서 평가 및 누적된 호흡의 강도와 횟수를 훈련 목표치와 함께 표시하는 표시부를 포함하여 구성되는 바이오 피드백 기능을 구비한 호흡 훈기를 제공하여, 호흡 훈련의 강도 조절, 안전사고의 예방이 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Construction for Hydroelectric Project potential safety hazard monitoring method based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of Construction for Hydroelectric Project potential safety hazard monitoring method based on Internet of Things, terminal and potential safety hazard monitoring terminal are detected including potential safety hazard, potential safety hazard detects terminal by the information transmission of detection to potential safety hazard monitoring terminal, specific aim sets corresponding potential safety hazard to detect terminal construction environment, it is to avoid the blindness that detection means is laid increases the validity of monitoring simultaneously；The positioning early warning of potential safety hazard is carried out by detection information, staff can obtain the relevant information of potential safety hazard in time, and be stored information in by potential safety hazard monitoring terminal in database.Collection from potential safety hazard data, the feedback monitor, recognize, navigating to potential safety hazard information, a kind of programmable is provided, the scheme of the monitoring of long-range, comprehensive Construction for Hydroelectric Project potential safety hazard and positioning, the major safety risks of objective reality in construction are made to be completely in slave mode, the generation of all kinds of security incidents in construction can effectively be prevented, guaranteed safe production.

title_en: A kind of sensing control robot based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of sensing control robot based on artificial intelligence, including robot body, data acquisition module, Data Analysis Services module and intelligent decision module, when Infection probability reaches certain threshold value, robot can issue automatically alarm using combined aural and visual alarm, and further according to the analysis to different zones air quality and Infection probability, intelligent decision module can be robot planning route automatically, keep it intelligently poor to air quality, the high region of Infection probability is mobile, sensing control processing is carried out to the panel region, distributed storage and calculating can be carried out to sensing control monitoring data simultaneously, so that medical staff grasps environment in institute whenever and wherever possible, infection control situation, realize the real-time of sensing control work, validity and the accuracy present invention intelligently can carry out decision to data analysis result, in time to the infection state of an illness potential in institute It is effectively controlled and is alerted, avoid huge medical treatment loss and casualties caused by Epidemic outbreak of disease.

title_en: Deep soft rock roadway deformation control method under dynamic pressure influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep soft rock roadway deformation control method under the influence of dynamic pressure, which particularly relates to the technical field of measurement and monitoring, and effectively identifies abnormal conditions in the operation of a total station by judging the degree of abnormality of real-time measurement data of the total station and counting abnormal data in the process of real-time acquisition, and triggers an emergency response mechanism when an alarm signal is generated, so that the accuracy of deformation monitoring in the process of withdrawing the deep soft rock roadway to the ground is ensured; the deformation monitoring state early warning coefficient is calculated through the normalization processing of the total station error correction frequency, the output fluctuation variation value and the total station electromagnetic influence index, and the deformation monitoring state early warning coefficient is used for analyzing the running state of the total station, so that the deformation condition of the supporting structure in the deep soft rock roadway can be timely captured under the condition of good state, control measures can be timely taken under the action of dynamic pressure, and the stability of the supporting structure is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL XINJI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Cluster type electric potential safety hazard pre-judging method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cluster type electric potential safety hazard pre-judging method, system, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a real-time data stream, carrying out data processing on the real-time data stream to obtain a first data stream, carrying out feature extraction by utilizing an edge computing node, and screening abnormal features to obtain an abnormal feature set; the method comprises the steps of analyzing an abnormal feature set by using a deep learning model, modeling time sequence features in the abnormal feature set by using a neural network model to obtain potential risk probability of electric potential hazards, optimizing parameters of the deep learning model by using an updating algorithm to obtain updated model parameters, extracting neural network model parameters related to edge computing nodes, transmitting the neural network model parameters back to the edge computing nodes to obtain an optimized edge model, reasoning real-time data flow to obtain real-time potential hazard early warning results, judging the real-time potential hazard early warning results to obtain electric potential hazard early warning instructions, and providing powerful guarantee for safe and stable operation of an electric power system.

title_en: High-brightness projection light with acousto-optic warning fence
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-brightness projection light band acousto-optic warning enclosure which comprises a fence and an isolation band, wherein the fence is provided with a bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is sequentially provided with a lower stand section, a supporting seat, a middle stand section, a supporting seat and an upper stand section, two connecting seats are symmetrically arranged on the supporting seat and are in rotary connection with the supporting seat, each connecting seat is provided with a sleeve, one side of each sleeve is fixedly provided with a slot, the isolation band is provided with a band body, two ends of each band body are fixedly provided with connectors matched with the slots, the connectors are detachably and fixedly connected with the slots, the sleeves on two sides of each slot are fixedly provided with a spot lamp, the isolation band and the fence are detachably connected, the isolation band is convenient to retract and release, the isolation band is made of flexible materials, the isolation band is convenient to carry after being detached, and the spot lamps on the sleeves are irradiated on two sides of the isolation band, so that strip-shaped bright areas can be formed on two sides of the isolation band, and the isolation band is more striking at night, pedestrians and vehicles can be found and dodge timely.

title_en: Local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-source geological data; the method comprises the steps of extracting 3-5Hz soil body frequency domain characteristics through wavelet packet decomposition, fusing DEM and historical liquefaction thermodynamic diagram to divide a deposition phase control unit, adopting a Bayesian constrained improved Kriging algorithm to generate a three-dimensional voxel model, combining real-time vibration main frequency offset to construct four-dimensional space-time tensors, inputting the tensors into a local self-adaptive graph rolling network, dynamically adjusting convolution kernel weights through a space-time attention mechanism, synchronously outputting a prediction result, triggering increment learning based on MEMS acceleration and FBG strain data, correcting unliquefaction area prediction values and feeding back to the voxel model, and finally generating a probability disaster chain scene tree through space pattern matching. The invention solves the technical bottleneck that the traditional model has poor adaptability in complex deposition environment and can not be updated in real time, and provides intelligent early warning support for the engineering safety of the earthquake active region.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Display device, portable terminal, display system and map display method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To update a map indicating a route to an evacuation site easily and at low cost, and thereby safely evacuate a user at disaster occurence.SOLUTION: A display device connected to a portable terminal 200 comprises: a first communication part 110 for transmitting/receiving data to/from the portable terminal 200; a first acquisition part 112 for acquiring from the portable terminal 200 map data which is data of a map indicating a route from a specified point of the display device 100 to an evacuation site at disaster occurence; a detection part 104 for detecting a warning signal from a broadcast signal; and a display control part 108 for displaying a map indicated by the map data on a screen when the detection part 104 detects the warning signal.

title_en: Monitoring method for landslide and slump stones on side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method for landslide and falling rocks of a side slope, which relates to the technical field of monitoring of the falling rocks of the side slope. According to the invention, through the multi-source sensor real-time monitoring and the signal filtering technology based on the environmental noise model, false alarm caused by natural interference and non-dangerous interference is effectively reduced, the multi-mode data fusion algorithm combines sensor data and camera images, the authenticity of risk signals is verified from multiple dimensions, and the reliability of the system is improved. By combining the dynamically updated slope collapse feature library and the intelligent algorithm, the system can accurately identify key parameters of slope instability and predict risks, flexibly respond based on a hierarchical early warning mechanism, improve disaster prevention and control capability, reduce resource waste caused by false alarm, simultaneously reduce threat of disasters to lives and properties, and provide sufficient time for managers to take measures.
assignees: CHANGRUI SHUZHI TECH SICHUAN CO LTD

title_en: Sea filling engineering three-dimensional geological data processing method and system integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sea filling engineering and digitalization, and discloses a sea filling engineering three-dimensional geological data processing method and system for fusing multi-source data, wherein the method determines first subsidence data by generating four-dimensional geological bodies, and (3) fusing the three-dimensional drilling data, the geophysical prospecting data, the oblique photography model and the real-time sedimentation data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological model to determine second sedimentation data, and reflecting the geological deformation accumulation process of the sea-filled area in real time according to the first sedimentation data and the second sedimentation data. The crossing of the geological model from 'static snapshot' to 'dynamic deformation' is realized, the space-time deformation effect is improved, the risk prevention and control efficiency of the sea-filling engineering is improved, the engineering geological disaster early warning aging is advanced, and technical support is provided for engineering safety early warning.
