title_en: Safety hanger for vibration proof
title_ko: 내진 행거
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake-proof safety hanger including a pipe band (1100) transversely separable to support or disassemble a pipe and a support bracket (1200) formed above the pipe band (1100). The present invention provides an earthquake-proof safety hanger having a structure in which the support bracket (1200) is provided in an upper end thereof with a through hole (1210), and the diameter of the through hole (1210) is greater than that of a spring holder (1300) so that the spring holder (1300) can freely move within the through hole (1210) of the support bracket (1200) in every direction. A spring (1400) is inserted onto the outer circumference of the spring holder (1300). The lower end of the spring (1400) is locked to a locking step (1310) of the spring holder (1300), and the upper end of the spring (1400) elastically supports the bottom surface of the support bracket (1200). According to the present invention, in the earthquake-proof safety hanger, the diameter of the through hole is significantly greater than that of the spring holder coupled with a ceiling of a building. Accordingly, even if the building is moved back and forth, left and right in the state that the pipe is fixed, the spring holder is moved within the diameter range of the through hole of the earthquake-proof safety hanger, so that the movement of the building is not transmitted to the pipe. Therefore, the pipe and the pipe holder can be prevented from being broken. In this regard, the present invention is very advantageous.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배관의 지지 및 해제를 위해 좌우로 분리가능한 배관밴드(1100)와, 상기 배관밴드(1100)의 상부에 형성되는 지지 브래킷(1200)으로 이루어지는 내진 행거에 있어서, 상기 지지 브래킷(1200) 상단 수평면에 통공(1210)을 형성하되, 상기 통공(1210)의 직경은 스프링 홀더(1300)의 직경보다 크게 형성되어 스프링 홀더(1300)가 지지 브래킷(1200)의 통공(1210) 내에서 전후좌우로 자유롭게 놀 수 있도록 하고, 상기 스프링 홀더(1300)의 외주에는 스프링(1400)이 삽입되되 스프링(1400)의 하단은 스프링 홀더(1300)의 걸림턱(1310)에 걸리도록 하고, 스프링(1400)의 상단은 지지 브래킷(1200)의 저면을 탄력적으로 지탱하도록 구성되는 내진 행거를 제공하기 위한 것으로, 본 발명은 내진 행거의 통공 직경이 건물의 천정과 결합되어 있는 스프링 홀더의 직경보다 훨씬 큰 구성을 갖는 것이어서 배관은 고정된 상태에서 건물이 전후좌우로 움직이더라도 대개 스프링 홀더의 움직임이 내진 행거의 통공 직경 범위내에서 이루어지게 되어 사실상 배관에는 건물의 전후좌우 움직임이 전달되지 않게 되어 배관 및 배관 홀더의 파손을 방지할 수 있는 매우 유용한 발명인 것이다.
assignees: KIM SUN GGU;KIM KUN AH;KIM SOO HYUK;KIM SOO YUN;YOU HYUN NAM

title_en: powerless patch device announcing position of safty tool in disaster status, and method of the same
title_ko: 재난상황에서 안전도구의 위치알림 무전원 패치 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology, reporting a position of a safety tool (example: a fire extinguisher, an oxygen mask) to prevent secondary damage in an area, shaded by a disaster situation. The technology is capable of attaching a patch, operated by generating power from surrounding environmental energy (example: light energy, temperature energy) without an extra power supply unit, to a safety tool, and reporting a disaster situation in an externally recognizable format (example: voice alarm, light source blinking) by identifying the patch when the disaster situation occurs. According to the present invention, since the patch device, attached to a safety tool, generates operational power from surrounding environmental energy without an extra power supply unit, the device is able to be used without expiration date unless the device is broken. Moreover, since the formation of power supply and the formation of disaster detection are integrated, malfunction occurs in power supply when malfunction occurs in a disaster detecting function, and then the display of the patch device becomes abnormal, and therefore, the malfunction of the disaster detecting function is not hidden and is determined to be immediately repaired.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난상황 발생으로 음영 상태가 된 지역에서 2차 피해 방지를 위해 안전도구(예: 소화기, 산소마스크)의 위치를 알려주는 기술로서, 별도의 전원공급수단 없이 주변 환경에너지(예: 빛에너지, 온도에너지)로부터 전원을 생성하여 동작하는 패치를 안전도구에 부착하고 이 패치에서 재난상황시 이를 식별하여 외부에서 인식가능한 형태(예: 음성 알람, 광원 블링킹)로 알리도록 하는 기술에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 안전도구에 부착되는 패치 장치가 별도의 전원공급수단 없이 주변 환경에너지로부터 동작 전원을 생성하기 때문에 패치 장치가 망가지지 않는 한 유효 기간 없이 사용할 수 있는 장점이 있다.  또한, 본 발명에 따르면 전원공급 구성과 재난검출 구성이 일체화되어 있어 재난검출 기능에 고장이 발생한 경우에는 전원공급에도 장애가 발생하여 패치 장치의 표시에 이상이 나타나게 되므로 재난검출 기능의 고장이 숨겨지지 않고 그때그때 판별하여 즉시 수리할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: System architecture that high-speed emergency vehicle withdraws fast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system structure for quickly evacuating high-speed emergency vehicles, which comprises an emergency lane, wherein an evacuation box and at least two warning boxes are respectively arranged on the emergency lane, a safety channel is arranged below the emergency lane, and a plurality of support rods are symmetrically arranged in the safety channel. According to the emergency evacuation system, the evacuation box and the warning box are arranged on the emergency lane, so that vehicles can be directly evacuated through the evacuation box, the accident handling time and the personnel transferring time are saved, evacuation behind the vehicles can be prompted, secondary accidents are prevented, the emergency evacuation system is safer, the structure is simple, the construction difficulty is low, and the implementation is convenient.

title_en: Mobile service system, method, equipment and storage medium based on nucleic acid sampling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nucleic acid service technology, and discloses a mobile service system, a method, equipment and a medium based on nucleic acid sampling. In the system, an information acquisition module acquires nucleic acid reservation information, detected information, a nucleic acid sampling point, a nucleic acid material library and a user sampling image of a user; the mobile nucleic acid scheduling module generates a nucleic acid sampling scheduling route according to the nucleic acid reservation information and the mobile nucleic acid sampling point, and performs nucleic acid sampling on a user according to the nucleic acid sampling scheduling route; the nucleic acid sampling module carries out identity authentication according to the detected information and the user sampling image, and samples the user after the identity authentication passes; after the identity verification is passed, the nucleic acid material demand management module updates data in the nucleic acid material library and generates a material demand scheme according to the updated nucleic acid material library and the early warning requirement; and the nucleic acid sampling monitoring module generates nucleic acid sampling data according to the nucleic acid reservation information and the number of nucleic acid sampling times. The invention can improve the flexibility of nucleic acid sampling of a user and reduce potential safety hazards.
assignees: SHENZHEN SENXUNDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation penetrating type slope deformation monitoring radar system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetation penetrating type slope deformation monitoring radar system and a monitoring method thereof, which belong to the field of radar detection, and the system is smaller in size and better in portability compared with a conventional radar system, can realize vegetation penetrating detection and complete a slope landslide early warning function of slope topography in a covered area by designing an arc scanning deformation monitoring radar working in an L-band, sending signals to a monitoring area, receiving echo signals, preprocessing the echo signals, imaging according to the echo signals, selecting and updating PS points of imaging results, and then carrying out deformation inversion on an updated PS set.
assignees: SUZHOU RACO SENSOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Overhead manned device safety early warning system and method based on target tracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety, and discloses an overhead man-riding device safety early warning system and method based on target tracking, wherein the system comprises the following steps: inputting the current video frame into YOLOv target detection model to obtain first detection result; acquiring an initial state of a first target frame corresponding to a target object; inputting the frame number difference v, the time interval between frames and the initial state into a state transition model to predict the predicted position of the corresponding first target frame, and obtaining a second detection result of the i+v video frame; searching a corresponding second target frame optimally matched with the first target frame, and taking the optimally matched corresponding second target frame as an updating target frame; performing audible and visual alarm according to the category of the first target frame or the updated target frame; repeating the above process until the class of the updated target frame is non-illegal, and ending the cycle; the invention can effectively and safely monitor and pre-warn the riding behavior of the overhead passenger device.
assignees: HUNAN ZHAOYI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean disaster risk assessment method based on multi-parameter observation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of multi-parameter observation disaster early warning, and discloses a multi-parameter observation based marine disaster risk assessment method which is used for solving the problem that a fixed sampling frequency cannot react to an emergency in time, once a weather mutation or a marine environment abnormality occurs, a disaster assessment result is difficult to update in time by a traditional method, so that disaster early warning and emergency response are delayed. The method has high-efficiency disaster early warning and response capability, can maximally improve the data acquisition efficiency, optimize the system performance and reduce the resource waste.
assignees: SECOND INST OF OCEANOGRAPHY MNR;CHINA JILIANG UNIV COLLEGE OF MODERN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Transmitter, receiver and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 송신 장치, 수신 장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a transmitter. The transmitter comprises: a frame generation unit for generating a frame including data to be transmitted; and a preamble insertion unit for inserting a preamble into the frame, wherein when the predetermined emergency alert event is occurred, the preamble insertion unit inserts at least a portion of emergency alert service (EAS) messages to notify an emergency alert event to the preamble, adds an additional preamble including the rest of the EAS messages to the preamble, and changes an indicator value provided in the preamble so as to indicate whether the additional preamble is inserted or not. Accordingly, only EAS-related main information is transmitted in a preamble form, thereby guaranteeing a robust transmission. Also, by directly transmitting L1 information of the related data, power consumption can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 송신 장치가 개시된다. 송신 장치는 전송할 데이터를 포함하는 프레임을 생성하는 프레임 생성부 및 프레임에 프리앰블을 삽입하는 프리앰블 삽입부를 포함하며, 프리앰블 삽입부는, 기 설정된 긴급 경고 이벤트(Emergency Alert Event)가 발생하면, 긴급 경고 이벤트를 알리기 위한 EAS(Emergency Alert Service) 메시지의 적어도 일부를 프리앰블에 삽입하고, 나머지 일부의 EAS(Emergency Alert Service) 메시지를 포함하는 부가 프리앰블을 프리앰블에 추가하고, 프리앰블 내에 마련된 인디케이터 값을 변경하여 부가 프리앰블의 삽입 여부를 표시할 수 있다. 이에 따라, EAS 관련 주요 정보만을 프리앰블 형태로 전송함으로써 로버스트한 전송을 보장할 수 있고, 관련 데이터의 L1 정보를 직접 전송함으로써 전력 소모량을 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: System for controlling signal lamp and the method thereof
title_ko: 교통신호등 제어 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a traffic light control system and a method thereof. The traffic light control system which allows a connection between a mobile device of a vehicle in which an emergency has occurred and a traffic light controller, comprises: a mobile device for receiving an emergency notification message and destination information from a user through an application; a traffic control application server for setting a current location of the mobile device as a starting point when the emergency notification message is received from the mobile device, and relaying a connection between a traffic light controller located within a predetermined distance from the starting point and the mobile device; and a traffic light controller for changing a mode into a traffic signal control mode for supporting a movement of the vehicle in which an emergency has occurred when connected to the mobile device through the traffic control application server. Therefore, an emergency response time of a vehicle in case of emergency can be shortened by controlling a traffic signal to a destination using a smartphone application.
abstract_ko: 교통신호등 제어 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 교통신호등 제어시스템은 응급상황이 발생한 차량의 모바일 기기와 신호등 제어기 사이의 접속을 허가하는 교통신호등 제어 시스템으로서, 어플리케이션을 통해 사용자로부터 응급상황알림 메시지와 목적지정보를 입력받는 모바일기기, 모바일기기로부터 응급상황알림 메시지가 입력되면, 해당 모바일기기의 현재위치를 출발지로 설정하고, 출발지로부터 소정 거리 내에 위치한 신호등 제어기와 해당 모바일 기기 사이의 접속을 중계하는 교통제어 앱서버 및 교통제어 앱서버를 통해 모바일 기기와 접속되면, 응급상황이 발생한 차량의 이동을 지원하기 위한 교통신호 제어모드로 변경하는 신호등 제어기를 포함한다. 따라서, 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 이용하여 목적지까지 교통신호 제어를 통해 응급상황시 차량의 응급출동시간을 단축시킬 수 있다.
assignees: KIM NAM HUN;KIM MIN GYU;LEE SANG MIN;NOH JIN SEO;PARK CHAN HUCK;PARK JUNG HYUN

title_en: Safety alarm method, device, control system and storage medium
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of safety alarm method, device, control system and storage mediums.Method includes obtaining security alarm signal, and according to the security alarm signal, determine warning location information, according to the warning location information, obtain the device identification of indicating equipment to be controlled, it generates and pushes more new signal to the indicating equipment to be controlled, the more new signal is used to the instruction information update of the indicating equipment to be controlled be predetermined warning information.By obtaining the device identification of indicating equipment to be controlled and the instruction information of update instruction equipment, it can be to avoid under dangerous or emergency, due to the phenomenon that indicating the misleading of information, personnel is caused to enter danger zone generation, the reliability and security of instruction information is improved.
assignees: HUNAN HUIBO ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The application discloses a smart forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle groups, and relates to the technical field of forest fire prevention monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a patrol topological graph, real-time map information, starting positions of unmanned aerial vehicles and current observation states of the unmanned aerial vehicles of a current environment; the method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle environment space model based on acquired information, inputting the current observation state of the unmanned aerial vehicle into a trained multi-agent reinforcement learning model, determining optimal patrol nodes of each unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment, controlling each unmanned aerial vehicle to execute patrol tasks, updating the position and the current observation state of each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle environment space model, and re-determining the optimal patrol nodes at the next moment based on the updated current observation state of each unmanned aerial vehicle until all patrol nodes in a patrol topological graph are covered. The application solves the problems of low patrol efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle and non-robust patrol algorithm, and improves patrol efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SHANXI;SHANXI LINGXIAOXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine slope displacement monitoring device and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, in particular to a mine slope displacement monitoring device and method, which solve the problems of single data dimension, low prediction precision and insufficient early warning pertinence in the prior art. The device comprises units of multi-source data acquisition, historical data adaptation, data preprocessing, machine learning models, early warning output and the like, acquires InSAR, GNSS-RTK, environmental geology and other data, weights and fuses similar mine historical data, predicts the displacement of 1-7 days of slopes through a random forest+LSTM+attention model after preprocessing, and adopts the method of acquisition, processing, prediction, early warning and iteration, sets three-level displacement early warning thresholds and dynamically updates model parameters. The invention realizes the comprehensive fusion of multi-source data, displacement prediction error is less than or equal to 10%, grading early warning is timely and accurate, slope disasters are effectively prevented, and mine production safety is ensured.

title_en: A Fire Evacuees' Context- Information Providing Method and A System therefor
title_ko: 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a CCTV; a flame/smoke sensor; a server which includes a person detection module, a context information module, a fire dynamics simulator (FDS), and a building exodus, receives images from the CCTV, and transmits the context information on evacuees in a building to an emergency operation center; a person characteristic information database which has person detection information, such as person patterns; a building information database which has information on the building, such as the drawing of the building; a detection information database which stores the person detection information by areas in the building; and an emergency operation center which receives the context information from the server in a fire and sends a rescue team to the building.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피자의 상황정보를 종합방재 센터의 구조대에게 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, CCTV, 화염/연기 감지 센서,  상기 CCTV의 영상에서 사람을 검출하고 대피자의 수와 위치를 확인하는 사람 검출 모듈, 상기 사람 검출 정보와 상기 센서의 정보를 기반으로 대피자의 상황정보를 생성하는 상황 정보 모듈, 화재의 현상을 가상 모델링하는 시뮬레이션하는 FDS(Fire Dynamics Simulator), 건물 상주 인원들의 대피경로를 계산하는 Building Exodus를 포함하며, 상기 CCTV로부터 영상을 수신 받고 화재시 상기 건축물의 대피자에 대한 상황정보를 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 Server, 상기 사람 패턴과 같은 사람 검출 정보를 가지고 있는 사람 특징 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 건축물의 도면과 같은 건축물의 정보를 가지고 있는 건물 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 사람 검출 모듈에서 검출된 사람 검출 정보를 건축물 내부의 지역별로 저장하는 검출 정보 데이터베이스, 화재시 상기 Server로부터 상황정보를 수신 받고 구조대를 상기 건축물로 보내는 종합방재 센터로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템과,  
상기 CCTV으로부터 영상을 입력받는 영상 입력 단계, 상기 CCTV의 동작여부를 확인하는 CCTV 작동 여부 확인 단계, 상기 CCTV가 동작하지 않을 경우 경보를 제공하는 사람 검출 오류 경보 단계, 사람을 검출하는 사람 검출 단계, 화재가 발생하였는지 확인하는 화재 발생 확인 단계, 평시에 종합 방재 센터로 정보를 전송한 전송 주기를 확인하는 전송 주기 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보를 상기 검출 정보 데이터베이스에 저장하는 사람 검출 정보 갱신 단계, 화재가 발생한 지역을 확인하고 FDS를 통해 화재 현상, 화재 위험 지역 및 인명 사상 지역 정보를 계산하여 화재 상황 정보를 계산하는 화재 상황 정보 확인 단계, Building Exodus를 통해 인명 가상 대피 정보와 잔류 인원에 대한 정보를 계산하는 화재 인명 정보 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보와 화재 상황 정보, 화재 인명 정보들을 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 인명 상황 정보 전송 단계로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법으로, 기존 건축물의 CCTV를 통해 화재시 대피인원 및 잔류 인원에 대한 상황정보를 획득하기 때문에 종래의 시스템들이 시스템 구축을 위해 생체 신호를 수집하는 센서, 위치 정보를 제공하는 센서, 상기 센서들로부터 정보를 수신 받는 PDA와 같은 장치들로 인해 시스템 구축이 어렵고 시스템 사용이 복잡한 종래의 문제점들을 해결할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 상기 건축물의 대피인원 및 잔류인원들에 대한 가상의 대피 정보를 정확하게 시뮬레이션하고 화재 현상 모델링을 기반으로 화재 상황을 정확하게 시뮬레이션하기 때문에 보다 정확한 인명 구조를 위한 정보의 수집이 가능하며, 상기 시뮬레이션정보, 사람 검출 정보를 실시간으로 종합방재 센터로 전송하여 구조대가 인명을 구조하기 위한 구조 시간의 단축과 정확한 구조를 하는데 효과적이다. 
또한, 평시에도 사람 검출정보를 전송하기 때문에 화재시 본 발명에 의한 시스템이 문제가 발생하게 될 경우 평시에 전송되어진 최근 정보를 기반으로 보다 신속하게 상기 건축물의 구조를 수행할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Wall pad with intergrated reater for fire receiver
title_ko: 화재수신기를 위한 중계기가 통합된 월패드
abstract_en: Disclosed is a wall pad with an integrated repeater for a fire receiver. According to the present invention, the wall pad is connected to a front door phone, a wired/wireless door lock, a contact security device, a moving body monitoring device, a gas valve linking device, a wired fire detector, a transmitter, an alarm, a repeater, and Ethernet. The fire detector of the wall pad monitors a fire state to output a signal. If a fire is recognized by the wall pad, when integrated control is notified, a situation dissemination control system notifies a householder through an application or a text message. The situation dissemination control system sounds a fire alarm, outputs a control signal for shutting off a gas valve to the gas valve, outputs a signal for unlocking a door lock to the door lock, and switches a crime prevention state to a cleared state. Whether a person remains inside is transferred to the situation dissemination control system through a signal outputted by a motion detection sensor, and image information photographed by a front door camera is transferred to the situation dissemination control system to monitor the fire situation such as smoke.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 화재수신기를 위한 중계기가 통합된 월패드를 개시한다.  본 명세서에 따른 월패드는 현관 도어폰, 유무선도어록, 점점보안장치, 동체감시장치, 가스벨브연동장치, 유선화재감지기, 발신기, 경종, 중계기 및 이더넷과 연결되며, 상기 월패드는 화재 감지기는 화재 상태를 감시하여 신호를 출력하고, 월패드에서 화재가 인식된 경우, 통합관제에 통보를 하면, 상황전파 관제시스템은 어플리케이션 또는 문자를 통해 세대주에 통보하고, 상황전파 관제시스템은 화재경보를 울리며, 가스 벨브를 차단시키는 제어 신호를 가스 벨브에게 출력시키고, 도어록을 해제시키는 신호를 도어록에 출력하고, 방범 상태를 해제로 전환시키고, 동작 감지센서에서 출력된 신호를 통해 내부에 사람이 남아 있는지 여부를 상황전파 관제시스템에 전달하고, 현관 카메라에서 촬영된 영상 정보를 상황전파 관제시스템에 전달하여 연기 등 화재 상황을 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters. The method includes the following steps that: a temperature tester, a humidity tester, a wind speed tester and a wind direction tester are arranged in an area to be measured; minimum temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and wind direction in the area are measured, and a meteorological factor prediction field data matrix related to an icing gallop risk analysis model is established; icing gallop risk prediction is performed on a corresponding area with measuring points which satisfy conditions that minimum temperature ranges from -4.0 to 0.5 DEG C, relative humidity ranges from 70% to 100%, wind speed ranges from 5.8 to 13.7 meters per second and wind direction is northeast; the data of each prediction lattice point is circulated, so that gallop risk trend analysis data of all prediction measuring points at current time can be obtained. With the method of the invention adopted, whether icing gallop distribution exists in a prediction area can be judged, and real-time update can be realized by means of numerical value prediction data. The meteorological early warning method has the advantages of high accuracy, high practicability, high reliability and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;WUHAN REGION CLIMATE CT

title_en: Landslide surge prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster related fields. The method comprises the following steps of 1, realizing a digital model of a physical entity by a physical layer L1, 2, calculating the stability of a landslide and landslide surge by the model layer based on related data of the physical layer, 3, carrying out early warning prediction decision on a calculation result of a decision layer base model layer, and 4, carrying out new prediction calculation to evaluate an updated plan and disaster prevention measure effect. According to the invention, the physical layer is used for sensing the states of the rock mass and the water body of the landslide surge hidden danger point in real time, and the model layer is updated in real time by utilizing the information interaction capability of the digital twin model, so that the calculation model can perform simulation calculation according to the real working condition of the landslide surge hidden danger point, and further, the landslide surge hidden danger point can be more accurately early-warned and predicted. The invention also relates to a landslide surge prediction system based on digital twinning.

title_en: LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and pedestrian safety service and information providing system
title_ko: 실시간 위치 추적 및 보행자 안전 서비스를 위한 LoRa 기반 휴대용 경보기 기술과 그 장치를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an information providing system using a LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and a pedestrian safety service and a device thereof. The information providing system using a LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and a pedestrian safety service and a device thereof comprises: a LoRa-based alarm device for a pedestrian to collect sensor data, use the sensor data to acquire a current location of a pedestrian, continuously update to monitor an emergency situation at all times and use monitoring in pedestrian safety data, generate pedestrian safety data based on such information, and transmit the pedestrian safety data to a pedestrian safety control server via LoRa communication; the pedestrian safety control server to store and manage corresponding pedestrian safety data, perform a process for an emergency situation if the emergency situation occurs, and check whether the LoRa-based alarm device for a pedestrian successfully communicates; and a smartphone application for a user and a protector which is an application used in registration and management of the LoRa-based alarm device for a pedestrian, and performs configuration for protector contact information and a report agency. Each component is connected to a network via a backbone network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시간 위치 추적 및 보행자 안전 서비스를 위한 LoRa 기반 휴대용 경보기 기술과 그 장치를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 센서 데이터를 수집하고 이를 활용하여 현재 보행자의 위치를 파악하고, 항상 위기상황 여부를 감시하고 이를 보행자 안전 데이터에 활용할 수 있도록 지속적으로 갱신하며, 이런 정보를 바탕으로 보행자 안전 데이터를 생성하고 이를 LoRa 통신을 통해 보행자 안전 관제 서버로 전송하는 보행자용 LoRa 기반 경보기 장치와, 해당 보행자 안전 데이터를 저장 및 관리하며, 응급상황이 발생할 경우 이에 대한 처리를 수행하고, 상기 보행자용 LoRa 기반 경보기 장치가 통신 성공 여부를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 보행자 안전 관제 서버와, 보행자용 LoRa 기반 경보기 장치의 등록 및 관리에 사용되는 어플리케이션으로 보호자 연락처와 신고처에 대한 설정을 수행하는 사용자용 및 보호자용 스마트폰 어플리케이션으로 구성되고, 이때, 각 구성들은 백본망을 통한 네트워크 연결되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Overhead power transmission line running state assessment method based on bidirectional Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overhead power transmission line running state assessment method based on a bidirectional Bayesian network. The method can be used for conducting a real-time assessment on the running state of an overhead power transmission line. According to the method, a Bayesian network structure for the assessment of the running state of the power transmission line is constructed with various factors which influence the running state of the power transmission line serving as a condition attribute set and the running state of the line serving as a decision attribute, a conditional probability table is obtained according to sample training, and by utilizing the bidirectional reasoning technology dedicated to the Bayesian network, the running state of the line can be judged by means of causal reasoning, and the hidden danger of the state can also be recognized by means of diagnostic reasoning; when an assessment error exists, a self-feedback system can be used for conducting early warning and correction, an assessment database, the network structure and parameters can be modified dynamically in real time so as to be adapted to an update, and therefore healthy running of the power transmission line is truly guaranteed.
assignees: EXAMING & EX CT ULTRAHIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANSMISSION CO CHINA SOUTHEN POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGZHOU ANDIAN MEASUREMENT CONTROL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Temperature information collection and early warning method and system for high speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature information collection and early warning system for a high speed railway. The system comprises a temperature information collecting device, a current signal/value signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold of temperature disaster risks, a determining device started by an early warning program, a locating device, a train controlling device for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device. A control module serves as a core of the whole system, controls operation of the devices on one hand, and is used for being connected with external devices including an external computer device and the like to achieve communication and control. In the system, the dynamic generating mode is adopted in the reference threshold for evaluating the temperature disaster risks, the historical disaster situations are combined, and the historical situations are continuously updated after new early warning is given, so that the risk pre-evaluation of a certain region is considered more completely and scientifically with contrast to historical data. The invention further provides a temperature information collection and early warning method for the high speed railway.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing risk distribution of power distribution network tower under flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing the risk distribution of a power distribution network tower under flood, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a tower flood disaster evaluation index system; establishing a historical data evaluation rule base according to a pole tower flood disaster evaluation index system and historical characteristic disaster information; responding to the disaster data index information of a certain tower obtained in real time, and inputting the disaster data index information of the certain tower into a historical data evaluation rule base to enable a risk factor of the certain tower to be output; updating the risk factor of a certain tower according to the risk factor of at least one tower associated with the certain tower; and judging whether the updated risk factor of a certain tower is greater than a preset threshold value or not, so as to determine the risk level of the certain tower. Risk grids are screened out by calculating risk factors according to a historical flood disaster information base, disaster risk information around the line tower can be mastered accurately, and a basis is provided for analyzing and early warning of flood disaster risks of the power distribution network line tower.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NANCHANG HANGKONG

title_en: Dynamic assignment method for microseism analysis task for multiple coal mines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic assignment method of microseismic analysis tasks for multiple coal mines, which is used for solving the problems of low distributed processing efficiency and high delay rate of the traditional microseismic analysis tasks. The method generates microseismic analysis tasks based on microseismic events uploaded in real time by each mine, and establishes a heterogeneous parallel machine assignment scheduling model aiming at minimizing the number of delay tasks by combining the available time window and processing capacity of analysts. And generating a scheduling scheme by adopting a scheduling algorithm based on the task sequence, and optimizing the scheduling scheme by adopting a genetic algorithm. After the task is completed, the system updates the analyst load and the time window. The method has the advantages of obviously reducing the task delay rate and improving the calculation efficiency while ensuring the rationality of task scheduling, has good expansibility and practicality, and can be widely applied to the scenes such as coal mine microseism monitoring, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Method for reporting emergency using cable settop box
title_ko: 케이블 셋탑박스를 이용한 긴급상황 알림 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency recording method is provided to notify an emergency, occurring in or outside a house, to request help using a cable set-top box. CONSTITUTION: Input units(400) and a cable set-top box(200) continuously communicate with each other(S910). An emergency is recognized by one of the input units during continuous communication(S920) The cable set-top box transfers the emergency situation to a cable broadcasting station(500)(S930). The cable broadcasting station transmits an emergency situation alarm messages to a set-top box of a subscriber existing in the same cell as the corresponding subscriber, a police office(600), a fire station(700), and a hospital(800) according to the emergency station(S940-S970).
abstract_ko: 케이블 셋탑 박스를 이용한 긴급상황 알림 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은 제1 케이블 셋탑박스가 해당 가정 내에 긴급 상황이 발생했는지의 여부를 알 수 있는 신호를 지속적으로 수신하여 긴급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 결정하는 단계; 긴급 상황이 발생된 것으로 결정되면 이를 케이블 방송국으로 전달하는 단계; 상기 긴급 상황의 사안에 따라 그 긴급 상황을 해제시켜줄 수 있는 기관들에게 상기 긴급 상황 발생 상태 정보를 전달하는 단계; 및 상기 긴급 상황이 발생한 가정과 같은 셀에 위치한 하나 이상의 케이블 셋탑 박스에게 상기 긴급 상황 발생 상태 정보를 전달하는 단계를 포함하여, 긴급사항 발생시 신속하게 대처할 수 있다.

title_en: Gas type fire-fighting apparatus for a ship with double detective function
title_ko: 이중감지식 선박용 가스소화설비
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 내부의 방호구역에서 발생한 화재를 연기감지수단으로 감지하여 이산화탄소 등의 소화가스를 방호구역으로 공급시키는 가스소화설비에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 배풍기유닛의 작동에 따라 방호구역의 내부공기를 연기감지유닛으로 공급하는 샘플링파이프와 함께, 방호구역의 환기와 방폭(妨爆) 목적으로 제공된 또 다른 공기배출통로상에 화재감지용 센서로서의 스모크디텍터를 설치하여, 상기 스모크디텍터가 연기감지유닛과 추가적으로 접속되도록 함으로서, 방호구역에서의 화재발생여부를 이중으로 신속.정확하게 감지할 수 있도록 하며, 이로 인하여 선박 내부의 방호구역에서 발생한 화재를 보다 안전하게 진압할 수 있도록 함은 물론, 기존에 설치된 가스소화설비의 구조적인 변경이나 추가적인 배관설비를 수행하지 않더라도, 최근에 들어 안전규정이 보다 엄격하게 제시되고 있는 선박용 가스소화설비의 요구사항을 충분히 만족시킬 수 있도록 한 이중감지식 선박용 가스소화설비에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 배풍기유닛(5)의 작동에 따라 방호구역(1)의 내부공기를 연기감지유닛(4)측으로 공급시키는 샘플링파이프(2)와, 화재진압용 소화가스가 압축 저장되는 소화가스용기(6)와, 상기 소화가스용기(6)로부터 연장되어 샘플링파이프(2)와 연결 설치되는 가스공급관(6a)과, 상기 샘플링파이프(2) 및 가스공급관(6a)의 연결부위에 설치되어 공기통로와 소화가스통로를 선택적으로 개방시키는 삼방밸브장치(8)를 포함하여서 이루어지는 선박용 가스소화설비(10)에 있어서, 상기 각각의 방호구역(1)에는 배풍팬(12)이 설치된 배풍팬덕트(11)가 구비되고, 상기 배풍팬(12)의 상부 또는 하부측에 해당하는 배풍팬덕트(11)의 내부에는 화재감지용 센서로서의 스모크디텍터(Smoke detector)(13)가 설치되며, 상기 각각의 스모크디텍터(13)는 케이블(13a)에 의하여 연기감지유닛(4)과 접속 설치되고, 상기 연기감지유닛(4)은 케이블(4a)에 의하여 화재경보패널(7a)과 접속 설치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Wireless fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a wireless fire alarm system, which comprises a monitoring end, a server and a management end, wherein the monitoring end is connected with the server; the monitoring end comprises a smoke acquisition unit and a thermal imaging unit, and the smoke acquisition unit is used for acquiring the environmental smoke concentration and sending the environmental smoke concentration to the server; the server is used for judging whether a fire exists according to the received smoke concentration, sending an early warning signal to the management terminal when the fire exists, and sending a detection signal to the monitoring terminal; the monitoring end is also used for starting the thermal imaging unit and sending the detection data to the server after receiving the detection signal; the server is also used for analyzing whether a fire exists according to the feedback data of the thermal imaging unit, and sending an alarm signal to the management terminal when the analysis result shows that the fire exists; and when the analysis result is that the early warning cancellation signal does not exist, the server sends an early warning cancellation signal to the management terminal. By using the system, the condition that the working personnel do too much idle work due to false alarm can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Rainfall-induced landslide prediction and early warning method and system
abstract_en: In order to improve the spatial and time resolution of rainfall type landslide prediction and early warning, the invention discloses a rainfall induced landslide prediction and early warning method and system, which adopts the fact that a side slope is stable through multiple rainfall fields, and converts historical rainfall into a large number of rainfall paths, thereby establishing a critical rainfall intensity-duration curve as a rainfall threshold of a side slope unit, and realizing single-side slope unit scale landslide prediction and early warning. The method is convenient to implement, does not need to measure any soil parameters or establish a slope stability analysis calculation model, avoids high cost of rock and soil investigation and errors existing in slope analysis, and can dynamically update the rainfall threshold established by the method along with actual observation, thereby improving landslide prediction early warning precision.

title_en: Tunnel gushing water automatic identification method and system based on gushing water target detection model
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel water inrush target detection model-based automatic identification method and system, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel water inrush disaster monitoring, prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of extracting video image features in a tunnel, mixing the spatial attention weight and the channel attention weight of the features, updating the features, fusing the updated features, and decoding the fused features to obtain a target frame and a category result. The method and the system have the advantages that through a content-aware attention mechanism and coupling with the context characteristics, the generalization force of the monitoring model is improved, the accurate identification of the tunnel surge water under various tunnel conditions is guaranteed, the omnibearing high-precision detection and statistical analysis of the tunnel surge water are further realized, whether early warning prompt in the tunnel is carried out or not is judged, the evolution condition of the surge water is predicted, and the guarantee is provided for the tunnel safety construction.

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system, comprising the steps of acquiring sensor installation parameters and large-dip-angle stope geological environment information, establishing a correction model, and correcting large-dip-angle stope geological exploration data acquired by a sensor; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a large dip angle stope according to corrected parameters, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning index system based on historical coal-rock disaster case data and expert experience, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model based on a machine learning algorithm, integrating the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model into the digital twin model, and carrying out real-time evaluation and early warning on the large dip angle stope dynamic disaster risk by the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model when the digital twin model is updated. The invention effectively reduces the occurrence risk of coal and rock dynamic disasters, ensures the life safety of stope operators and the normal operation of equipment, and improves the safety and economic benefit of coal exploitation.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;TAIPING COAL MINE OF SICHUAN CHUANMEI HUARONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for analyzing dangerous chemical accident investigation report based on large model
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing a dangerous chemical accident investigation report based on a large model, belonging to the technical field of dangerous chemical accident investigation report analysis; the method comprises the steps of carrying out entity labeling and relation labeling on a historical dangerous chemical accident investigation report, converting the historical dangerous chemical accident investigation report into an enumeration label sequence, constructing a training data set by combining the historical dangerous chemical accident investigation report, constructing a report analysis model by adopting a BiLSTM-CRF architecture, training by using the training data set, analyzing the dangerous chemical accident investigation report by using the report analysis model to obtain an analysis result characterized by the enumeration label sequence, and periodically optimizing the report analysis model. According to the method, the enumeration topology is constructed, unstructured text is converted into an enumeration label sequence, analysis accuracy is improved, the analysis model is reported to be related to accident elements and rule terms, and the model is updated regularly, so that accurate risk early warning and safety management are realized.
assignees: INSPUR CLOUD INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transmission tower method for early warning under a kind of typhoon weather
abstract_en: The present invention relates to transmission tower method for early warning under a kind of typhoon weather, the method comprises the following steps: step 1: determining that early warning starts point；Step 2: point Short-term Forecast information is started according to early warning and issues initial early warning result；Step 3: according to meteorological observatory during typhoon conduct by when the nowcasting information issued constantly update real-time early warning result.This method sufficiently combines the Short impending information of meteorological department's typhoon forecast to provide the initial early warning and real-time early warning result of shaft tower failure for grid company, to ensure the accuracy of early warning result and improving early warning result computational efficiency, in entire prealarming process, the present invention has comprehensively considered the Flood inducing factors such as mima type microrelief, shaft tower material, typhoon cumulative function time and wind speed, it is ensured that the reasonability and validity of early warning result.

title_en: Rapid escape method for deep foundation pit or pit-in-pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid escape method for a deep foundation pit or a pit in a pit, which adopts an escape system, wherein the escape system comprises a steel frame, an upper basket, a winch and an alarm device of the Internet of things; when the foundation pit monitoring data exceeds the early warning value, the foundation pit monitoring data source is transmitted to an Internet of things platform through the Internet of things, the platform automatically sends information to an Internet of things alarm device, a rapid escape system alarm is triggered, red light flashes and gives out sharp alarm sounds, and foundation pit constructors are reminded to rapidly withdraw to a safety zone through the escape system; at the moment, the evacuee enters the basket, the winch is started, and the basket is pulled through the steel wire rope until the basket rises to the ground; when the density of the evacuees in the foundation pit is too high, under the condition that the upper basket is fully loaded, the evacuees escape through an emergency ladder; when the escape device is braked or powered off emergently, trapped personnel in the hanging basket climb over the hanging basket to the emergency ladder for ascending and descending. The invention has the advantages of good safety, rapid escape, strong operability and the like.
assignees: HUAHUI ENG DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;Huahui construction group co ltd

title_en: Cloud disaster recovery backup method and system for big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud disaster recovery backup method and system for big data, which relate to the technical field of cloud disaster recovery backup and comprise a backup data acquisition module, a first acquisition unit, a backup engine module, a backup storage module, a second acquisition unit, a server, an anomaly sensing unit, an accidental anomaly removal unit, an early warning unit and a cloud disaster recovery module. According to the invention, the process of carrying out data backup on the cloud capacity backup system is monitored, when the abnormal hidden danger of incomplete or lost data backup exists in the data backup of the system, an early warning prompt is sent out to prompt backup personnel to know the situation, and related measures are taken to deal with the situation in advance, so that the data integrity of the data backup of the system is ensured, the latest data version can be recovered through the system in the data loss, and the serious damage to the service caused by the incomplete data backup is avoided.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning and discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and device, which comprise two groups of fixed columns, wherein the top ends of the fixed columns are provided with mounting grooves, the inner bottom wall of each mounting groove is fixedly connected with an electric push rod III, the top ends of the electric push rods III are provided with clamping mechanisms, the clamping mechanisms are clamped with mounting seats, the side walls of the two mounting seats are respectively and fixedly provided with two landslide retractors connected through a pull rope, and a protection assembly is arranged above the pull rope and comprises two shielding covers and a connecting rope. According to the invention, the shielding cover is protected on the outer side of the pull rope, so that the situation that the pull rope is pulled by the weather and the falling of the branches is avoided or lightened, the probability of false alarm of the landslide telescopic instrument is reduced, and the shielding cover is driven to rotate upwards by stretching of the electric push rod three, so that the branches pressed above the shielding cover are pushed to two sides to fall, and the effect of automatically cleaning the branches is achieved.
assignees: HENAN RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT INVESTIG THIRD INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_ko: 스마트 배리어 경보 장치
abstract_ko: 가정용 또는 사업용 보안 시스템에서 발생할 수 있는 허위 경보의 수를 줄이기 위한 배리어 경보 장치를 제공한다.  하나의 실시례에서는, 문 또는 창문 센서와 같은, 배리어 경보 장치가 문 또는 창문과 같은 배리어가 개방되어 있는지 여부를 판단하고, 사람이 문 또는 창문에 근접하여 구내의 안에 사람이 있는지 여부를 판단한다.  문 또는 창문이 개방되어 있을 때 사람이 감시되는 구내의 안에 있으면, 이것은 그 사람이 감시되는 구내의 안에 있는 것을 허가받은 것을 나타내며, 배리어 경보 장치가 시한 경보 신호를 중앙 보안 패널에 전송하여, 사용자가 보안 대응을 취소하지 않고 미리 결정된 기간이 경과하면 중앙 보안 패널에 의해 보안 대응이 생성되게 한다.

title_en: Intelligent display system based on enterprise production management data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent display system based on enterprise production management data, which comprises a server, an intelligent display, a data acquisition module, an interface module and an intelligent algorithm module, wherein the server comprises a dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and early warning system, an electronic operation ticket system, an intelligent inspection system, a notification announcement system, an enterprise propaganda language system and an access control system/attendance system. According to the invention, by integrating the dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and early warning system, the inspection system, the electronic operation ticket system and the like with the enterprise propaganda system, the information which needs to be shown by an enterprise can be displayed more flexibly, the diversified centralized display of enterprise public information data sources is realized, a manager can know the on-duty condition of the current personnel conveniently, the old public version and public column are replaced, the paperless public of the enterprise key index information is realized, the environment-friendly performance is realized, the running state of the current enterprise is observed more intuitively, and the management of the enterprise is promoted more.
assignees: SHENYANG JINCHENG ELECTRONIC NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital dynamic management system and method for special equipment
abstract_en: A digital dynamic management method and system for special equipment comprises the following steps: collecting and processing various data of special equipment, generating a digital twin model, performing intelligent analysis and decision by using a C4.5 decision tree model, and optimizing an operation strategy; performing simulation operation by using the optimized digital twin model, verifying the feasibility of actual operation, and providing simulation data for operation management references; the running condition of special equipment is monitored in real time, and analysis and decision-making are carried out by combining real-time data and simulation data; early warning is carried out on potential dangerous situations, and all operation data are recorded and checked; and storing all the operation data, exchanging information with a third-party platform, and updating the equipment model and the operation parameters. The data is updated in a centralized and real-time manner, so that the management efficiency is improved, potential dangerous situations are early-warned, all operation data are recorded, the occurrence of safety accidents is reduced, the data utilization efficiency is improved, the problem of data island is solved, and the omnibearing digital dynamic management is carried out on special equipment.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH

title_en: Gear machining equipment remote fault diagnosis system based on wireless communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote fault diagnosis system of gear processing equipment based on wireless communication, which relates to the field of gear processing and comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a fault diagnosis module, an early warning and feedback module, an equipment state evaluation module, a big data analysis module and a remote control module, wherein the acquisition module acquires data at a key part by using an intelligent sensor, the transmission module adaptively retransmits the data according to link quality by means of a wireless communication technology, the diagnosis module judges the fault type and degree by combining with transfer learning, the early warning and feedback module performs multi-form early warning, the evaluation module evaluates the integral state of the equipment by using a formula, the analysis module models, stores and analyzes operation and fault data, and the control module operates and controls the equipment through a remote server. The invention efficiently diagnoses faults, quickly locates problems, shortens diagnosis time, has high diagnosis accuracy, identifies complex and early faults, maintains power assisting equipment, predicts hidden danger in advance, supports remote operation and model update, and comprehensively ensures stable operation of equipment.

title_en: Goods expiration early warning method and system based on supply chain management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning of a commodity in a temporary period based on a supply chain management system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional dynamic feature vector by acquiring key features of the commodity in the supply chain system, carrying out standardized processing on the multidimensional dynamic feature vector, and then encoding the multidimensional dynamic feature vector into qubits; the method comprises the steps of constructing an energy function by utilizing a quantum-element model, solving and screening a candidate solution set through a quantum annealing algorithm to generate an early warning threshold value of the temporary period of goods, applying the threshold value to a lightweight neural network model, realizing model switching through loss function comparison, reducing calculation cost, avoiding dimension disasters through feature dimension reduction and selection, reducing model training complexity, improving real-time response capability, and meanwhile, dynamically optimizing model parameters to enhance generalization performance, adapting to market environment changes, thereby reducing the temporary period risk of goods, reducing inventory loss and improving economic benefit and market competitiveness of enterprises.
assignees: NANJING MUSHU HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency situation message system and the method which use the wireless communication terminal
title_ko: 무선통신 단말기를 이용하는 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and a system for informing an emergency situation using a wireless communication terminal are provided to gain control authority of a wireless communication terminal in a device informing emergency situation which is connected to the wireless communication terminal and to transmit character or voice message to an opponent in an emergency situation, thereby performing request of crime and emergency rescue rapidly. CONSTITUTION: An emergency notification unit recognizes a connection of a wireless communication terminal(S310). According to an emerge signal, the wireless communication terminal provides control right to the emergency situation informing device. The emergency situation informing device transmits an emergency message. The emergency transmitting emergency message(S340). If a voice recording is set, the emergency situation informing device transmits a recorded message by controlling the wireless communication terminal(S350,S355).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선통신 단말기를 이용하는 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 무선통신 단말기에 연결되는 긴급상황 알림 장치를 이용하여, 무선통신 단말기 소지자의 위급상황을 신고하고, 무선통신 단말기의 제어를 수행함으로써, 현장상황을 녹취, 전송함은 물론 지정 번호로 통화를 시도하여, 통화가 개시되는 경우, 주변 상황의 현장실황음을 전송할 수 있는 무선통신 단말기를 이용하는 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 무선통신 단말기를 이용하는 긴급상황 알림 방법은 무선통신 단말기의 연결을 인식하는 제1단계와 버튼입력 신호에 대응하여 무선통신 단말기의 제어권을 획득하는 제2단계와 긴급 전화번호로 긴급상황 발생 메시지를 전송하는 제3단계와 음성녹취를 수행하는 제4단계 및 긴급 전화번호가 수신되는 경우, 무선통신 단말기를 통화모드로 변경하는 제5단계를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
       
     신변안전, 긴급상황, 무선통신 단말기, 음성녹취

title_en: Smart surfaces for visuo-haptic notifications
title_ko: 시각-촉각 알림을 위한 스마트 표면
abstract_en: Disclosed are examples of a device, a system, and a method for providing a visuo-haptic notification. In one example, a visuo-haptic notification is provided using a surface. A signal for causing an actuator to change a position of a notification unit on the surface from an original position to a notification position is generated and outputted to the actuator to provide the visuo-haptic notification. In some examples, the notification unit on the surface has a display. The display may be visible when the notification unit on the surface is in the notification position and may not be visible when the notification unit on the surface is in the original position. At least a part of the visuo-haptic notification may be provided on the display.
abstract_ko: 시각-촉각 알림을 제공하기 위한 장치, 시스템, 및 방법의 예가 개시된다.  일 예에서, 표면을 사용하여 시각-촉각 알림이 제공된다.  액추에이터로 하여금 상기 표면의 알림부의 위치를 원래 위치로부터 알림 위치로 변경하게 하기 위한 신호가 생성되어 액추에이터에 출력되어 상기 시각-촉각 알림을 제공한다.  일부 예에서, 상기 표면의 알림부는 디스플레이를 갖는다.  상기 디스플레이는 상기 표면의 알림부가 상기 알림 위치에 있을 때 보이고 상기 표면의 알림부가 상기 원래 위치에 있을 때 보이지 않을 수 있다.  상기 시각-촉각 알림의 적어도 일부가 상기 디스플레이 상에 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency warning display apparatus for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 비상 경고 표시 장치
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an emergency warning display apparatus for a vehicle that can be easily installed by a driver in a short time at the location of an accident vehicle and has a sufficient height to easily recognize a vehicle approaching from behind at a distance. The emergency warning display apparatus for a vehicle comprises a light source module including a plurality of light source units that are high-brightness LEDs or laser diode elements; a support assembly including a plurality of support units and a plurality of elastic units; and a casing part including an accommodation space for accommodating the support assembly in a state where the light source module and the support units are mutually inserted.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도로를 주행하던 자동차가 앞서가던 자동차와 추돌하거나 또는 주행하던 자동차 자체의 결함으로 인한 동작 불능 등의 원인으로 인해 부득이 도로에 정차하는 경우, 주행방향 뒤쪽에서 접근하는 차량과의 2차 사고를 예방하기 위한 차량용 비상 경고 표시 장치에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 차량용 비상 경고 표시 장치는, 복수의 고휘도 LED 또는 레이저 다이오드 소자인 광원유닛들을 포함하는 광원모듈; 상기 광원모듈이 상측에 연결되며, 상호 간에 삽입 및 인출 가능하도록 서로 다른 단면적을 갖는 복수의 지지 유닛과, 가압력이 해제된 상태에서 상기 지지유닛들을 상방으로 인출시키기 위한 복수의 탄성 유닛들을 포함하는 지지 어셈블리; 및 상기 지지 어셈블리의 최하단 측에 위치된 상기 지지 유닛의 하단이 고정되며, 상기 광원 모듈 및 상기 지지유닛들이 상호 삽입된 상태의 지지 어셈블리가 수용되는 수용 공간을 포함하는 케이싱부;를 포함하고,상기 지지 어셈블리의 상기 지지유닛들이 인출된 상태에서, 상기 광원유닛들이 발광 동작을 수행한다.

title_en: Process management system using blockchain based on stakeholder agreement
title_ko: 블록체인을 이용한 관계자 합의 기반의 공정관리 시스템
abstract_en: A process management system based on a related party agreement using a blockchain comprises: a registration terminal for establishing a process plan; a use terminal for discussing the established process plan; and a process management server for providing a solution for the process plan to the use terminal. An object of the present invention is to maximize the quality of the process according to more careful decision-making by performing an agreement of related parties on items requiring consultation, such as changing the schedule of the process.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공정 계획을 수립하기 위한 등록 단말, 수립된 공정 계획을 협의하는 사용 단말 및 사용 단말에 공정 계획에 관한 솔루션을 제공하는 공정관리 서버를 포함하고, 공정관리 서버는 등록 단말로부터 수집된 공정 정보를 기반으로 사용 단말에 제1합의 문의 알림을 제공하고, 제1합의 문의 알림에 대응하여 형성된 초기 합의 정보를 기반으로 등록 단말에 업무 지시 알림을 제공하는 블록체인을 이용한 관계자 합의 기반의 공정관리 시스템을 제공한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 공정의 일정 변경 등 협의가 필요한 항목을 대상으로 관련자의 합의를 거치기 때문에 보다 신중한 의사결정에 따른 공정의 품질 극대화가 가능하고, 무리한 공정 강행 등 리스크에 노출되는 것을 방지할 수 있어 공정의 갑작스러운 중단 등에 따른 인명피해 및 물적피해를 최소화할 수 있으며, 최종 합의된 공정 정보는 블록체인에 기록됨으로써 사후 조작 및 임의 변경이 불가하기 때문에, 해당 공정에 관한 기록의 불변성을 제공하고, 추후 동일 또는 유사한 공정의 수행 시 공정 효율의 극대화 방법을 모색할 수 있는 참고자료로 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of traffic alarm stake dispensing vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of traffic alarm stake dispensing vehicle, including warning pile, is warned for being placed in the section for needing to warn；Vehicle body, vehicle body are provided with the inner chamber that can accommodate warning pile；Delivery device, it is connected with inner chamber, for launching warning pile when needed；Retracting device, it is connected with inner chamber, for being reclaimed when needed to the warning pile placed.By being provided for being placed in the warning pile for needing the section warned to be warned, and the inner chamber that can accommodate warning pile is provided with vehicle body, delivery device is connected with inner chamber, for launching warning pile when needed, retracting device is connected with inner chamber, for being reclaimed when needed to the warning pile placed.So as to realize the automatic dispensing of traffic alarm stake and automatic recovery, while being brought convenience to staff, potential safety hazard is decreased.

title_en: A kind of closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope and its side slope pre-add solid method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope and its side slope pre-add solid method, the closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope includes slope protection cast, mobile jib, pillar, connection bar, warning device；Supporting rod piece and ground level are installed at less than 30 degree angles, supporting is carried out to tall and big side slope with nearly horizontal supporting way, shearing resistance greatly reinforces, and improves the barrier effect to landslide；And entire support system is pre-installed in mining activity area before mining, plays the role of protection and pre- landslide-proofing in advance, is made tall and big side slope not occur to come down or occur to issue clear early warning before landslide, is withdrawn personnel and the equipment of lower part in time；In the environment, without burying underground, design, construction, maintenance are easy for entire support system leakage；In addition, fast, easily group is built up at the construction field (site) by support system the present invention also provides a kind of side slope pre-add solid method, under the major premise for guaranteeing production safety, construction efficiency is turned up.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on KPCA-FOA-LSSVM
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on KPCA-FOA-LSSVM, initially set up slip mass real-time system for monitoring and pre-warning, the real time data for obtaining monitoring section filters out landslide with core principle component analysis method and major influence factors occurs as input variable after its standardization；Building is based on LSSVM landslide disaster forecasting model；Then parameter optimization is carried out with drosophila algorithm, updates network parameter；The landslide disaster forecasting model optimized is finally reconstructed, output Landslide corresponds to plague grade, completes forecast.Method disclosed by the invention obtains monitoring data by establishing slip mass real-time system for monitoring and pre-warning, training output Landslide in the least square support vector machines model based on drosophila algorithm optimization is utilized after core principle component analysis filters out major influence factors, forecast efficiency is promoted, accuracy is increased.

title_en: Electric power communication intelligence fortune dimension device based on multidirectional interactive mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power communication intelligent operation and maintenance device based on a multidirectional interaction mechanism, which relates to the field of electric power communication operation and maintenance, and comprises the following components: the system comprises an electric power communication intelligent operation and maintenance system, an electric power communication fault alarm acquisition system, a resource management system, a hidden danger library system, a plurality of operation and maintenance terminals, a plurality of scheduling terminals and a plurality of management terminals; the power communication fault warning acquisition system is used for acquiring power communication fault warning information; the resource management system is used for managing the power communication resource data and the corresponding service; each component in the device can carry out multiple interaction, multiple interaction pieces are mutually matched, fault information can be effectively and accurately processed conveniently, the device can update corresponding analysis algorithms according to the fault information, variable fault data can be adapted to the device, and the accuracy of a final analysis result is guaranteed.
assignees: INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent building remote fire-fighting early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent building fire-fighting early warning, in particular to an intelligent building remote fire-fighting early warning system which comprises a monitoring module, a detection module, an early warning module and an alarm module, wherein the monitoring module is in signal connection with the detection module, the detection module is in signal connection with the early warning module, the alarm module is in signal connection with the early warning module, monitoring equipment, a temperature sensor and a master control room are arranged in the monitoring module, the temperature sensor is in signal connection with the monitoring equipment, and the master control room is respectively in signal connection with the monitoring equipment and the temperature sensor. This long-range fire control early warning system of intelligence building monitors the building inner space through supervisory equipment and temperature sensor to start early warning module the very first time that takes place the condition of a fire, can reduce the speed of stretching of conflagration the very first time, thereby make the inside pedestrian of building have sufficient time to withdraw, thereby the condition that has reduced the casualties appears.
assignees: ZHEJIANG THREE MOUSE INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by gradient lifting regression optimization model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by a gradient lifting regression optimization model. The method comprises the steps of training a gradient lifting regression optimization model according to multi-factor sample data to predict landslide settlement, wherein the gradient lifting regression optimization model is formed by a plurality of gradient lifting regression trees in parallel, the model improves model classification strength by training a plurality of weak classifiers, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, in order to enable parameters of each weak learner to be different, a training set is updated in the training process of the model, the plurality of weak learners are learned, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, landslide settlement prediction is carried out according to current multi-factor sample data to obtain a current landslide settlement prediction value, a threshold value of a landslide risk level is determined based on landslide history data, geological conditions, soil types and the like, and the landslide risk level is accurately estimated by comparing the threshold value with the prediction value.
assignees: JIANGSU NANJING GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INST;UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Vehicle with automatic notification function
abstract_en: To provide a method of immediately transmitting emergency notification to a server device using alternative means other than normal communication means of a vehicle itself in the vehicle in which an emergency situation has occurred.SOLUTION: In an automatic emergency notification system, a vehicle with automatic notification function collects emergency information ST3 when an emergency situation occurs ST1Y; determines whether or not it is possible to transmit the collected emergency information through a base station using normal communication means ST4 when transmitting the collected rich emergency information to a server device of the automatic emergency notification system; and transmits the rich emergency information to the server device by the normal means ST5 when it is possible ST4Y. When it is not possible ST4 N, the vehicle uses other communication means that performs restricted communication with an external device other than the base station to cancel communication restriction of the other communication means ST6, and transmits the rich emergency information to the server device via the other external device ST8.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Qr code application system for expiry date notification
title_ko: Ｑｒ코드를 활용한 유통기한 알림시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An expiration data notification system using quick response code is provided to enable a consumer to manage the product prior to the expiration data, by generating QR code using a mobile terminal and by scanning the generated QR code and by implementing an expiration data notifying setup. CONSTITUTION: A QR code of a purchased product is scanned through a mobile terminal. The scanned information is displayed in a screen. A user sets an expiration data notification of the purchased product on basis of the displayed information. The notification is reported once more at the expiration date of the product. Various medium-using modes or vibration modes are set according to the expiration date notification set, which the user selects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 이동통신 단말기에 특정 제품이름 및 해당 제품에 대한 유통기한을 등록해 놓으면, 등록된 유통기한이 되는 시간에 이를 사용자에게 알려주는, 이동통신단말기를 이용한 유통기한 알림방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여 본 발명은, 이동통신 단말기를 이용하여 특정 제품에 대한 유통기한을 알려주는 방법에 있어서, 특정 제품에 대한 제품이름 및 유통기한 정보를 입력하는 제품정보 입력과정과, 상기 입력된 유통기한이 되면 해당 제품에 대한 유통기한 알림정보를 출력하는 알림정보 출력과정을 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 유통기한 알림방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast
title_ko: 비상 방송중 주 오디오로부터 보조 오디오로의 자동 전환
abstract_en: An audio video display device (AVDD) includes: a display, a processor controlling the display, and a computer readable storage medium that is accessible to the processor. The computer readable storage medium includes instructions which, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to present, on the AVDD, AV content that is not associated with information pertaining to an emergency. The instructions cause the processor to receive, at the AVDD, data associated with an emergency alert and, to be responsive to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert, to change audio presented on the AVDD from a first audio presented on the AVDD and associated with the AV content to a second audio associated with the data to present the second audio. The second audio is presented on the AVDD automatically without receiving user input to change from the first audio to the second audio subsequent to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert.
abstract_ko: 오디오 비디오 디스플레이 디바이스(audio video display device: AVDD)는 디스플레이, 디스플레이를 제어하는 프로세서, 및 프로세서에 액세스될 수 있는 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체를 포함한다.  컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체는 프로세서에 의해 실행될 때, 프로세서가, AVDD 상에 비상 사태에 관련된 정보와 연관되지 않은 AV 콘텐츠를 제시하도록 하는 명령어들을 포함한다.  명령어들은 프로세서가, AVDD에서 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하도록 하고, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 응답하여, AVDD 상에 제시되는 오디오를, AVDD 상에 제시되고 AV 콘텐츠와 연관된 제1 오디오로부터 그 데이터와 연관된 제2 오디오로 변경하여 제2 오디오를 제시하도록 한다.  제2 오디오는, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 후속하여 제1 오디오로부터 제2 오디오로 변경하기 위한 유저 입력을 수신하지 않고 자동으로 AVDD 상에 제시된다.

title_en: Method for informing location of immersed device and electronic device thereof
title_ko: 침수에 대응하여 알람을 발생시키기 위한 방법 및 그 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure is to inform a user of a location of an electronic device which has been flooded. An operating method of the electronic device comprises the processes of: detecting whether the electronic device is flooded; displaying a notification notifying flooding when the flooding is detected and operating a timer which expires within a predetermined time; and operating an alarm when the timer expires.
abstract_ko: 본 개시(disclosure)는 사용자에게 침수된 전자 장치의 위치를 알리기 위한 것으로, 전자 장치의 동작 방법은 상기 전자 장치의 침수 여부를 감지하는 과정과, 침수가 감지되면 침수 여부를 알리는 알림(notification)을 표시하고 소정 시간 내 만료되는 타이머를 동작시키는 과정과, 상기 타이머가 만료되면, 알람(alarm)을 동작시키는 과정을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method of controlling a proximity sensor of a construction machine apparatus for performing the same
title_ko: 건설 기계의 근접 센서 제어 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 장치
abstract_en: According to a method for controlling a proximity sensor of a construction machine, it is possible to detect the positions of an upper body of the construction machine and the at least one working machine. It is possible to selectively change the detection degrees of the proximity sensors of the construction machine according to the detected positions of the upper body and the working machine. Accordingly, it is possible to prevent an unnecessary alarm sound from being generated by the proximity sensor detecting the work machine, or, conversely, a safety accident due to the proximity sensor failing to detect an object around the construction machine.
abstract_ko: 건설 기계의 근접 센서 제어 방법에 따르면, 건설 기계의 상부체 및 적어도 하나의 작업기의 위치들을 감지할 수 있다. 상기 상부체와 상기 작업기의 감지된 위치들에 따라 상기 건설 기계의 근접 센서들의 감지도들을 선택적으로 변경시킬 수 있다. 따라서, 근접 센서가 작업기를 감지하는 것에 의해서 불필요한 경보음이 발생되거나, 역으로 근접 센서가 건설 기계 주위의 물체를 감지하지 못하여 안전 사고가 발생되는 것을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Rural industrial digital comprehensive service system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural industrial digital comprehensive service system, which comprises a comprehensive service platform; the system comprises a plurality of sub-service platforms, a plurality of service platform modules and a plurality of service platform modules, wherein the user terminals are used for collecting comprehensive information of villagers in the current administrative village, the comprehensive information comprises agricultural product information, travel product information and monitoring information, and each sub-service platform module is respectively communicated with the comprehensive service platform module; the electronic commerce sales platform is electrically connected with the comprehensive service platform, and the product on-shelf condition in the electronic commerce sales platform is updated through the supply information provided by the comprehensive service platform regularly; the travel information of each administrative village is perfected through the travel information provided by the comprehensive service platform at regular intervals; the emergency monitoring platform is electrically connected with the comprehensive service platform and distributes disaster early warning information through environment information provided by the comprehensive service platform regularly; the method has the advantages that various data are collected uniformly through digital platform management and control, and powerful support is provided for village vibration.

title_en: Substation safety early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation safety early warning device which comprises a chassis, wherein stabilizing assemblies are arranged on two sides of the chassis, a connecting column is fixedly connected to the top of the chassis, and infrared thermometers are connected to the periphery of the connecting column through protection assemblies in a transmission mode. According to the infrared thermometer, the protective assembly is arranged, the fourth bevel gear drives the movable screw rod to rotate through the third bevel gear, the movable screw rod drives the second screw rod seat to move, the screw rod seat drives the infrared thermometer to retract into the groove body, meanwhile, the lifting screw rod drives the first screw rod seat to move, the second screw rod seat drives the protective shell to move downwards through the sliding rod, and the protective shell drives the protective glasses and the groove body to be in the same vertical position, so that the infrared thermometer can be timely retracted into the connecting column when a disaster occurs, and the external situation is continuously monitored through the protective glasses, so that the damage of the infrared thermometer is avoided, and the service life of the infrared thermometer is prolonged.

title_en: Mine geological disaster early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a mine geological disaster early warning method based on artificial intelligence, wherein dynamic changes of state variables and multi-physical field coupling effects in a disaster evolution process are described by constructing a dynamic model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out discrete solution on a model by a numerical method to obtain a disaster evolution path, combining a bifurcation theory and Lyapunov stability analysis to accurately identify a disaster instability critical point, designing an optimal early warning strategy by a reinforcement learning algorithm, dynamically selecting an alarm signal triggering time, fusing monitoring data and the model in real time to dynamically update disaster states and risk grades, outputting alarm signals and providing emergency suggestions. The method realizes accurate disaster prediction and real-time response of early warning, and improves the mine geological disaster prevention and control capability.

title_en: Aviation weather early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aviation weather early warning device, and belongs to the technical field of weather monitoring equipment. The device comprises an air bag, a steady flow plate connected with the air bag through a first connecting rope, a mounting plate arranged below the steady flow plate, a multi-element weather sensor fixedly arranged on the mounting plate, a first controller fixedly arranged on the mounting plate, a wireless signal generator and an air bag retraction device arranged on the ground; the multi-element weather sensor and the wireless signal generator are electrically connected with the first controller, and the wireless signal receiver and the alarm are electrically connected with the second controller. The invention solves the problems of inaccurate and untimely meteorological data measurement on the ground in the prior art.

title_en: Method and system for setting emergency bell of communication terminal
title_ko: 통신 단말기의 비상벨 설정 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and a system for setting an emergency bell of a communication terminal are provided to change an alarm state mode of a communication terminal at a level that a user of the communication terminal easily recognizes. CONSTITUTION: A system(100) for setting an emergency bell of a communication terminal includes a signal checking unit(110) and a mode changing unit(120). The signal checking unit checks whether a mode changing signal is generated in the first terminal. When the mode changing signal is generated, an alarm state mode of the first terminal is changed.
abstract_ko:
통신 단말기에서 모드 변경 신호가 발생될 경우 통신 단말기의 사용자가 용이하게 인지할 수 있는 수준으로 통신 단말기의 알림상태모드를 변경하도록 하는 통신 단말기의 비상벨 설정 방법 및 시스템을 개시한다.  본 발명에 따르는 통신 단말기의 비상벨 설정 방법은, 제1 단말기에서 모드 변경 신호가 발생하는지 확인하는 단계, 및 상기 확인 결과, 상기 모드 변경 신호가 발생하는 경우, 상기 제1 단말기의 알림상태모드를 변경하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
