title_en: A kind of novel forest fire early-warning system and fire alarm method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of novel forest fire early-warning system and fire alarm method, the cruise and judge fire behavior that the unmanned plane of this system can be entirely autonomous do not need artificial interference；This system is based on infrared thermal imaging module and judges fire behavior, and false alarm rate is very low, and the accuracy of fire source judgement is high；This system is by infra-red thermal imaging system in conjunction with laser ranging system, it can fire units provide fire location, fire source shape, the relevant informations such as three-dimensional geographical conditions, fire spreading speed around fire source to the ground at the first time after finding fire behavior, fire-fighting efficiency is improved, validity of putting out the fire is improved.

title_en: The method that coal mine fully-mechanized mining face based on SLAM technology is maked an inspection tour unmanned vehicle and independently maked an inspection tour
abstract_en: The method that the coal mine fully-mechanized mining face that the invention discloses a kind of based on SLAM technology is maked an inspection tour unmanned vehicle and independently maked an inspection tour, first initializes fully mechanized coal face SLAM module, and obtain coal mine initial environment map；Feature Points Matching will be carried out in the collected coal mine environment image information in current location and initial environment map, if successful match, unmanned vehicle constantly adds the environmental map point of new position during tour, current coal mine environment map is constituted, while current coal mine environment map is ceaselessly updated；After the completion of fully mechanized coal face makes an inspection tour unmanned vehicle to the corresponding tour task in current mine position, fully mechanized coal face tour unmanned vehicle will be reached next target point with optimal path and be maked an inspection tour.The actual change situation and geographical location and environmental change below entire mine that the present invention can make staff easily grasp fully-mechanized mining working very much, and the work such as can give warning in advance to the condition of a disaster, largely save manpower and financial resources.

title_en: Interactive ground wire control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive ground wire control method, which is characterized in that a control server acquires information of a switch and ground wire operation corresponding to the switch from an electronic operation ticket, and judges whether to give a closing early warning according to grounding information of the switch when the switch is to execute closing operation. The management and control server is associated with the electronic operation ticket, the management and control server updates and feeds back the current grounding attribute of the switch in real time, the switch grounding wire is managed and controlled by adopting the method, an intelligent grounding cabinet is not required to be configured, the management and control server can be even realized by using an Excel data table, and the cost is relatively lower; the switch grounding condition is updated by the control server in real time, and the staff can directly acquire the switch grounding condition from the control server without secondary judgment, so that the use is relatively more convenient; the management and control server can give the early warning of closing a floodgate by oneself, prevents that the staff from appearing the negligence and leading to the switch to carry out the operation of closing a floodgate under the ground connection state, has reduced the potential safety hazard.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID XINYUAN COMPANY LTD;ZHEJIANG XIANJU PUMPED STORAGE CO LTD

title_en: Transmission line overhauls warning sign with tower
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transmission line overhauls warning sign with tower, this warning sign is installed in electrified side cross arm, including L type support, alternates in the connecting piece of L type support top side to and install the solar panel at L type support top; one end of the connecting piece is elastically connected with the inner cavity of the L-shaped bracket through a reset spring, and the other end of the connecting piece is connected with a vertically arranged shell, so that when the warning sign is installed, the L-shaped bracket, the connecting piece and the shell can be adaptively adjusted according to the width of the live side cross arm, and the warning sign can be stably hung on the live side cross arm; the front of casing embedding has the LED display screen, can set up corresponding warning sign indicating number that has warning color on the LED display screen in advance, and maintainer can see the warning sign indicating number that shows on the LED display screen like this to avoid the search personnel mistake to go into electrified cross arm, the circuit can not need to withdraw from reclosing, so as to ensure net maintenance time and promote electric wire netting security.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Engineering safety supervision device
abstract_en: The invention provides an engineering safety supervision device, and relates to the field of engineering safety supervision. The engineering safety supervision device comprises a mounting seat, a communication device and a sub-fixing support, wherein a central female support is arranged at the bottom of the mounting seat. This engineering safety supervision device detects the change of the height on the ground of two point positions through the water level in the water pipe to can also trigger and send out the alarm through the inside water of intercommunication hose when taking place the subsidence of less height, thereby can play the effect of early warning, provide more escape time for the staff, through the cooperation between a plurality of intercommunication devices, alarm generator and the connecting device, can realize the ground to a plurality of directions and supervise, can learn whether corresponding position takes place to collapse, be convenient for in time discover subsides and suggestion staff and withdraw, and can avoid the direction of subsideing before withdrawing, further improved the security of withdrawing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GONGBU CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow formation mechanism analysis and risk assessment method based on multi-modal data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow forming mechanism analysis and risk assessment method based on multi-modal data fusion, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting debris flow multi-modal data and preprocessing, S2, constructing a condition vector, S3, generating debris flow risk scene data according to the condition vector, S4, utilizing a condition to generate authenticity probability of data generated by evaluating a discriminator in an antagonism network, S5, carrying out layering modeling on the generated debris flow risk scene data by adopting a multi-scale graph convolution layer, obtaining updated node characteristic representation, S6, calculating a global debris flow risk prediction result, generating a debris flow risk assessment report, S7, carrying out fine adjustment on a generator and the discriminator according to the occurrence condition of an actual debris flow event, and S8, carrying out real-time assessment and early warning on the debris flow risk. The method can provide an efficient and scientific optimization scheme in debris flow formation mechanism analysis and risk assessment, and brings remarkable technical value and economic benefit for practical application.

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning management and control integrated control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control and discloses a fire control early warning management and control integrated control method and a fire control early warning management and control integrated control system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring global multi-mode data of a coverage target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out initial situation assessment on fire according to the overall multi-mode data, generating an initial fire state vector, establishing and online updating a dynamic fire extinguishing efficiency model based on the initial fire state vector, and executing a self-adaptive optimal control process based on dynamic fire extinguishing efficiency model prediction to generate a control instruction for controlling fire resources in real time. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a control instruction generation module. According to the invention, by constructing the dynamic fire extinguishing efficiency model capable of being updated on line and combining the self-adaptive optimal control strategy, the technical span from passive early warning to active intelligent control is realized, a real-time optimal control instruction can be generated, and the accuracy of fire treatment and the final fire extinguishing efficiency are obviously improved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDE QIRUI SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for assigning a temporary directory number to a roaming mobile unit
title_ko: 로밍 모바일 유닛에 긴급 임시 디렉토리 번호를 할당하는방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for assigning an emergency temporary directory number to a roaming mobile unit (103). A request is received from a mobil unit (103) for an emergency temporary directory number. The communication system (100) determines if the request is a valid request. If the request is a valid request, the communication system (100) grants an emergency temporary directory number for the mobile unit (103). The communication system (100) then alerts the mobile unit (103) of the emergency temporary directory number.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 로밍 모바일 유닛(103)에 긴급 임시 디렉토리 번호를 할당하는 방법을 제공한다.  모바일 유닛(103)으로부터 긴급 임시 디렉토리 번호에 대한 요구가 수신된다.  통신 시스템(100)은 요구가 유효한 요구인지를 판정한다.  요구가 유효한 요구인 경우, 통신 시스템(100)은 모바일 유닛(103)에 대해 긴급 임시 디렉토리 번호를 허여한다.  그 다음에 통신 시스템(100)은 모바일 유닛(103)에게 긴급 임시 디렉토리 번호를 경보한다.

title_en: Learning type emergency detection system with multi-sensor and that method
title_ko: 학습형 다중센서 재난감지 시스템과 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a learnable emergency detection system which detects a fire, an earthquake and others, and transmits alarm messages. An emergency detecting server receives data from various types of sensors. When a signal equal to or more than a value set by an administrator of spaces and facilities is transmitted, the server transmits the alarm message. When the alarm message is transmitted, the facility administrator connects the message to an input value of the multi-sensor, evaluates the kinds and the degree of risks, inputs and saves the evaluated result, repeatedly updates conditions of the alarm message generation, a setting value and others, and controls the content of the alarm message and a transmission range according to the degree of risks.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재, 지진 등을 감지하고 경보 메시지를 전송하는 재난감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난감지서버는 여러 종류의 센서를 통하여 데이터를 수신하고, 공간 및 시설 관리자가 설정한 값 이상의 신호가 입력될 경우 경보 메시지를 전송하고, 경보 메시지가 전송될 경우 시설 관리자가 다중센서의 입력값과 연동하여 위험의 종류, 정도를 평가하여 입력 저장하여 경보 메시지 발생 조건, 설정값 등을 반복 갱신하고, 위험의 정도에 따라 경보 메시지 내용, 전송 범위를 조정할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 학습형 다중센서 재난감지 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Non-slip paint and method for manufacturing
title_ko: 노면표지용 논슬립 도료 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road marker formed on a road for a smooth vehicle induction, a driving order, and the safe driving. According to the present invention, a friction enhancer formed by pigmentizing a friction enhancing raw material made of a waste resource or an aggregate in a hard granule shape, is mixed with a conventional paint for a road marker to be applied on the road so as to form the road marker. Accordingly, the road marker can be formed through the same process as the conventional paint formed on the road, and also, the friction interference force such as the road marker, a tire, and the like is increased by the friction enhancer included in the paint. As a result, an accident caused by the slippiness of tires of a vehicle and a motorbike or a pedestrian in transit can be prevented even in a state that the road is slippery due to snow or rain. Also, the friction enhancer mixed with the paint raw material is in a state of being colored through a water-soluble pigment to be consistent with a color of the conventional road marker so as to prevent degradation of chromaticity. Furthermore, the friction enhancer exposed to or protruding from a surface of the road marker induces predetermined interference sound upon interference with the tire to be acted as an auditory warning sound during a lane change or the drowsy driving so as to allow more safe driving. Furthermore, a hard friction interference agent included in the paint performs a function as an aggregate for preventing cracks or detachment of the road marker, such that a service life of the road marker can be more extended.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원활한 차량 유도 및 운행 질서와 안전 운행을 위해 도로면에 형성되는 노면 표지에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 기존의 노면 표시용 도료에 경질의 알갱이 형태로 된 폐자재 또는 골재 등으로 된 마찰증진원료를 착색하여 만들어진 마찰증진제를 혼합 형성하여 이를 노면에 도포하여 노면 표지를 형성함에 따라, 기존의 노면에 형성되는 도료와 마찬가지의 과정을 거쳐 노면 표지가 이루어지도록 하면서도, 도료에 포함되어 있는 마찰증진제에 의해 노면 표지와 타이어 등의 마찰 간섭력을 증대시킬 수 있어 비가 오거나 눈이 내리는 등 노면이 미끄러운 상태에서도 자동차 및 오토바이 타이어 또는 보행자의 통행시 노면 표지로부터 미끄러져 안전사고가 발생하는 것을 방지할 수 있는 것이며, 도료 원료에 혼합되는 마찰증진제는 수용성 안료를 통해 착색된 상태이므로 기존 노면 표지의 색상과 일치하여 색도가 저하되는 것을 방지할 수 있는 것이고, 노면 표지의 표면으로 노출 또는 돌출되는 마찰증진제는 타이어와의 간섭시 소정의 간섭음을 유발하여 차선 변경시 또는 졸음 운전시 청각적인 경고음으로 작용하여 더욱 안전한 운행이 이루어지도록 하는 것이고, 도료에 포함된 경질의 마찰간섭제는 노면 표지의 균열이나 탈락을 예방하는 골재로서의 기능도 함께하므로 노면 표지에 대한 사용 수명이 더욱 연장되는 효과가 있는 것이다.

title_en: Child location monitoring method and system using beacons
title_ko: 비콘을 이용한 아동 위치 모니터링 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 비콘을 이용한 아동 위치 모니터링 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 비콘을 이용한 아동 위치 모니터링 시스템은, 아동이 휴대하는 아동단말, 비콘신호를 이용하여 유효범위 내의 아동단말을 식별하는 복수개의 비콘기기, 아동단말을 식별한 비콘기기로부터의 정보를 기반으로 아동단말의 위치를 모니터링하는 메인서버 및 아동단말이 유효장소를 이탈한 비상상황 시 메인서버로부터 알림정보를 수신하는 보호자단말을 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 아파트 단지와 같은 특정한 공간에서 아동의 위치 현항을 실시간으로 모니터링할 수 있어 아동에 대한 안심 서비스를 제공할 수 있고, 이동형 비콘기기들을 활용함으로써 음영지역 위치 또는 외부로의 이탈과 같은 문제발생 시에도 재빠르게 아이의 위치를 확인하여 안내할 수 있다.

title_en: Security alarm and guidance system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to management system of protection of security, in order to solve in existing security system, it concentrates on some region of exit passageway since personnel will appear when withdrawing and causes the exit passageway congestion to reducing the problem of withdrawing speed, provide a kind of security alarm and guidance system, including alert sub-system, guide subsystem and control module, guiding subsystem includes green indicating lamp, alert sub-system includes the first induction module, second induction module and alarm module, when alert occurs, alert inductive signal is sent control module by first induction module, control module control alarm module is alarmed；Guiding subsystem further includes having luminance adjustment module and optical filtering part, when the second induction module senses exit passageway congestion, the congestion signal is sent to control module, control module controls luminance adjustment module movement, reduces the brightness of the green indicating lamp in the exit passageway；Optical filtering part can mask the green indicating lamp other than particular color.
assignees: GUIZHOU RENHUA XIKE COMPUTER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cover body formula multifunctional kite line wheel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of cover body formula multifunctional kite line wheel, the fabulous line wheel that solves is overflow the security hidden trouble that line tangled up and knotted, kite string are brought, and belongs to kite reel manufacture technology field.Including annular cover body, concave tracks, crank, reel, holder, brake bar, wire inlet/outlet hole, colored line shape flexible pipe etc.；It is characterized in that reel outer rim is placed in annular cover body, reel rotates along annular cover body concave tracks, realize retractable cable function, cover body effectively prevents line from overflowing tangled up and knotted, in kite reel wire hole, colored line shape flexible pipe is set, and colored line shape kite string is equipped with, anti-scratch and safe warning function are served, greatly reduces potential safety hazard；The present invention is simple in construction, be readily produced, enhances the enjoyment for playing kite.

title_en: A kind of environmental information method for exhibiting data and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of environmental information method for exhibiting data and terminal, including: obtain environmental information data from high in the clouds environment data base, terminal database is updated, described environmental information data include that the environmental data of regional location, zone name, update date and corresponding region, described high in the clouds environmental data library storage have real-time environmental information data；Check instruction according to user, from described terminal database obtain described in check the environmental information data in region of instruction instruction, described environmental information data are shown, including the environmental data of position, viewing area, zone name, update date and correspondence.Environmental information method for exhibiting data of the present invention and terminal, achieve the environmental information data enabling user terminal to show user selected areas, enable users to grasp environmental information, can can take measures in time when unusual circumstance, overcome existing early warning and problem that emergency command mode has retardance, hysteresis quality.
assignees: INSPUR (BEIJING) ELECTRONIC INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning system and method based on cloud edge end cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning system and a deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning method based on cloud edge end cooperation, and relates to the technical field of foundation pit engineering monitoring informatization, wherein the deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning system comprises a cloud layer, an edge end and a terminal; the edge ends and the terminals are respectively arranged in a designated area of the foundation pit project; the terminal comprises a data acquisition terminal and an acousto-optic early warning terminal, and for the same foundation pit project, the cloud layer is in bidirectional communication connection with the edge end, the edge end is in communication connection with the terminal, the cloud layer is used for transmitting the updated early warning model to the edge end, the acquisition terminal is used for transmitting the acquired original data to the edge end, the edge end is used for transmitting detailed early warning information obtained by analyzing the updated early warning model of the original data to the acousto-optic early warning terminal, and the acousto-optic early warning terminal is used for carrying out visual display and voice prompt based on the detailed early warning information, so that real-time and accurate feedback of the safety state of the foundation pit are improved.
assignees: FIRST CONSTR ENG CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTR 3RD ENG BUREAU

title_en: Safety information early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a security information early warning system based on a large model, and belongs to the field of enterprise security management. The system automatically processes enterprise qualification certificates, equipment monitoring reports and management of hidden trouble investigation records through the integration of certificate management, equipment monitoring, potential safety hazard investigation, early warning and intelligent question-answering modules. The system can remind certificates, monitoring reports and expiration dates of investigation records in advance, and notify related personnel in a short message mode and the like, so that timely updating is ensured, and legal and operation risks caused by expiration are avoided. In addition, the system integrates an intelligent question-answering function, can answer the questions of enterprise users in the aspect of safety production and laws and regulations, and provides 24-hour online support. The system improves the intelligent level of enterprise safety management, is beneficial to reducing risks and ensures the compliance operation of enterprises.

title_en: Method and system for braking train in earthquake
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and a system for braking a train in an earthquake which can optimize the braking of the train when the report of the earthquake is incorrect and warning cancel information is received or safety is confirmed early by the conventional configuration of train braking in which the feeding is not stopped.SOLUTION: In this method for braking a train in an earthquake, an earthquake detection side control device 10 to which a seismograph 13 is connected is installed, and earthquake information is transmitted from the radio transmitter 11 of the earthquake detection side control device 10 to the radio receiver 6 of the on-vehicle control device 5 of the train 1 to operate a power mode control device based on the earthquake information. Then a master controller and an inverter control device are operated to switch over a power mode to a train stop control mode so that a train brake control device can be operated.

title_en: Bridge water level warning system using LED lighting
title_ko: Led 조명을 통한 교량의 수위 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른  LED 조명을 통한 교량의 수위 경보 시스템은, 교량의 보행자 통행 공간의 일 측에 설치된 LED 조명 장치; 상기 교량이 설치된 하천의 수위를 감지하는 수위 감지 센서; 및, 상기 수위 감지 센서에서 감지한 수위의 고저에 따라 상기 LED 조명 장치의 점등 색상을 변경 제어하는 컨트롤러;를 포함한 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 LED 조명을 통한 교량의 수위 경보 시스템에 의하면, 간단한 구조를 기반으로 실시간으로 하천 수위를 감지하고 즉각적인 시각적 경고를 제공하여 보행자와 운전자가 위험 상황에 빠르게 대응할 수 있는 효과를 가진다.
assignees: SEOWON UNIV INSTITUTE OF INDUSTRY ACADEMY COLLABORATION

title_en: A kind of disaster alarm management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster alarm management system, the system includes communication main control unit, for the warning information of receive information source issue, and sends the warning information；Display unit, it is connected with the communication main control unit, for receiving the warning information of the communication main control unit transmission and showing, and the operation interface of display user；Alarm unit, it is connected with the communication main control unit, for sending alarm sound and/or alarm light according to the warning information of the communication main control unit；Receiving terminal, communicated to connect with the main control unit that communicates, for receiving the warning information.The warning information that the present invention is issued by the main control unit receive information source that communicates, and fully released the warning information by display unit, alarm unit and receiving terminal, comprehensive validity of disaster early-warning information issue is ensure that using the published method of above-mentioned three kinds of information.

title_en: Marine information early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and electronic equipment for early warning marine information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ocean data acquired by shipborne equipment in real time through a communication unit; based on a preset data processing algorithm, carrying out data processing on the ocean data to obtain data keywords; obtaining a prediction rule matched with the data keyword based on the data keyword and the real-time prediction model; the real-time prediction model is updated in real time based on data collected by each channel; generating target early warning information according to the prediction rule and the ocean data; and sending the target early warning information to the shipborne equipment. The invention can improve the accuracy of the early warning information.
assignees: CMA PUBLIC METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTRE NAT EARLY WARNING INFORMATION PUBLISHING CENTER

title_en: Underground coal mine smoke concentration early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning the concentration of underground smoke of a coal mine, and belongs to the technical field of fire disaster early warning. According to the method, the target Soxhlet particle size is calculated by adopting a statistical method through acquiring the first wavelength signal and the second wavelength signal of the underground coal mine, so that the data precision is improved. The first threshold value and the second threshold value are set, the section where the target Soxhlet particle size is located is judged, whether a roadway where the detection unit is located is normal is judged according to the section where the target Soxhlet particle size is located, a plurality of groups of continuous first gas concentration and second gas concentration are collected by combining the gas detector, the first concentration change rate and the second concentration change rate are calculated, and therefore the underground state of a coal mine is determined, and the accuracy of smoke alarm is improved. Further, the parameters of the smoke detector are updated periodically in combination with the equipment noise, so that the accuracy of the equipment for collecting data is improved, and the probability of false alarm is reduced.
assignees: SHANXI WANGJIALING COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Control system of distance between cars
title_ko: 차간거리 제어시스템
abstract_en: A system for controlling the distance between vehicles is provided to make a warning sound or automatically touch a brake in a moment if the distance to the front vehicle gets shorter below the set distance or the other vehicle suddenly jumps into the line in front of own vehicle. A system for controlling the distance between vehicles is composed of a laser sensor(LS) installed at the predetermined position of the front center of the vehicle and composed of a laser transmitter(LD) and a laser receiver; ultrasonic sensors(S1) mounted at the front left and right sides or left and right corners of the vehicle and composed of an ultrasonic transmitter(SD1) and an ultrasonic receiver(SS1); and ultrasonic sensors(S2) installed at both rear sides of the vehicle to detect a bicycle or a motorcycle running from the rear side in opening a door of the vehicle and composed of an ultrasonic transmitter(SD2) and an ultrasonic receiver(SS2). The laser sensor and the ultrasonic sensors transmit data to a main controller by RF(Radio Frequency) or a wire to control the distance between the vehicles from the inside of the vehicle. A GPS(Global Positioning System) and a navigation detect speed of own vehicle and the distance to the front vehicle during driving. Safe distance from the front vehicle is calculated in proportion to the speed of own vehicle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차간거리 제어시스템에 관련된다. 
     보다 상세하게는 레이저발신기와 레이저수신기로 이루어져 주행중 앞차와의 거리를 감지하기 위한 레이저센서와, 초음파발신기 및 초음파수신기로 이루어져 좌우방향전환시 전환방향쪽으로 장애물 또는 주행차량을 감지하는 초음파 센서와, 또 초음파발신기 및 초음파수신기로 이루어져 차량 주정차 후 도어개방시 후방에서 근접하는 오토바이나 차량, 자전거 등의 이동물체를 감지하는 초음파센서, 그리고 주행중 급차선변경, 끼어들기, 급정차 등의 돌발상황시 순간적으로 경고음 발생 또는 경고음과 더불어 유압실린더를 작동시켜 브레이크를 터치시킴으로서 자동으로 차량의 속도제어를 이룰 수 있게 하는 등의 구성으로 이루어진다. 
     또, 주행중 앞차와의 거리감지 및 제어를 위해서는 위성항법장치인 GPS기능을 탑제하여 자차의 속도검출을 정확하게 할 수 있게 하는 시스템을 더 포함할 수 있으며, 더불어 네비게이션을 통한 경보나 알람으로 인식할 수 있게 하는 시스템을 더 포함하는 것도 바람직하다 하겠다. 
     이와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 주행중 앞차 와의 거리를 항상 안정적으로 확보할 수 있게 함으로서 안전주행을 유도할 수 있게 되고, 동시에 도어개방시 뒤에서 불시에 달려오는 오토바이나 자전거, 차량을 감지할수 있음에 따라 추돌사고 등을 비롯한 안전사고를 예방할 수 있음은 물론, 고속도로나 국도 또는 시내도로를 주행하는 과정에서 불시에 끼어드는 타 차량 등으로 인한 돌발상황 발생시 순간적으로  브레이크를 원텃치 방식으로 터치시켜 속도를 줄일 수 있게 함으로서 돌발상황에 따른 안전사고 또한 예방할 수 있는 등의 다양한 특징이 따르게 되는 차간거리 제어시스템을 제공한다.          
       
     차간거리, 차속측정, 거리제어, 차간거리 검출장치.
assignees: KIM SEOK JO;KIM BYEONG JO;YEU SANG TAE

title_en: Method and apparatus for edge-based notification through crowd-sourced real-time fleet flow communication
abstract_en: An apparatus, method and system of an edge server that communicates with vehicles by continuously receiving messages including data of state transitions of Electronic Control Units (ECUs) included in each vehicle; monitoring flow message data from each vehicle in real time to detect data updates regarding state transitions of the ECUs used in vehicle operation; crowdsourcing data of state transitions of the ECUs in real time during vehicle operation to combine state transition data having commonality as crowdsourcing transition data; processing the crowdsourcing transformation data using a machine learning model to classify the crowdsourcing transformation data for the anomalous events; and sending a warning of the abnormal event to the identified vehicle in advance so that the driver or the ADAS performs a response.

title_en: Natural disaster early warning device convenient to install and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural disaster early warning device convenient to install and a using method thereof, relating to the technical field of natural disaster early warning, comprising a connecting plate, a movable seat, an installation component and an early warning component, wherein a connecting rope is fixedly connected between a retractor and a fixed ring, a power supply module is embedded in the middle position on the right side of the connecting plate, a charging module is embedded in the left side of the movable seat and is at the same height with the charging module, an electromagnet is arranged below the connecting plate, and an electric universal wheel is arranged at the bottom of the movable seat. So that the entire device can be used continuously.

title_en: Chemical industry storage fire disaster early warning method based on data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical storage fire early warning method based on data fusion, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data fusion module and a data transmission module. The data acquisition module is composed of a plurality of sensor terminals, uploads data acquired by the sensors to a OneNET platform through a core chip and a WiFi module, and gives an alarm when detecting that the data is abnormal or does not meet a preset value, the data fusion module is composed of the sensor terminals needing to be acquired and a data fusion algorithm LHEA-CNN-DELM-SE_Attention, the data fusion algorithm carries out fire prediction on acquired chemical storage real-time environment data, and the established LHEA-CNN-DELM-SE_Attention model is trained to verify the validity of the model in chemical storage fire prediction. Compared with the prior art, the invention improves the accuracy and the reliability through the cooperative work of a plurality of modules, reduces the requirement of artificial monitoring and reduces the risk of human errors.

title_en: Geological investigation safety monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological exploration safety monitoring method and a geological exploration safety monitoring system, which relate to the technical field of geological exploration monitoring, and are characterized in that a data collection monitoring module is utilized to conduct exploration monitoring on a current geological region, an early warning calculation module is utilized to sequentially calculate and output a ground settlement rate CJ, a landslide early warning index HP and a debris flow early warning grade NL, in the process of calculating the landslide early warning index HP and the debris flow early warning grade NL, critical values of parameters are required to be updated in real time according to the latest geological disasters, and an early warning display module is utilized to display and early warn the recent debris flow early warning grade NL in the form of a line graph and judge the dangers of the current geological region.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering construction operation parameter optimization and data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering construction operation parameter optimization and data management method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, multi-source data access and vectorization; step 2, time sequence feature extraction and multi-mode fusion, step 3, interpretive influence factor identification, step 4, multi-task dynamic anomaly prediction, step 5, risk weighted fusion and uncertainty quantification, step 6, digital twin simulation verification, step 7, treatment strategy optimization and safety audit, and step 8, feedback acquisition and model self-adaptive update. The method has the advantages that the multi-mode unified characterization is constructed by fusing structured data such as water level, flow and the like with unstructured information such as meteorological images, operation and maintenance logs and the like, and the time sequence characteristic extraction is carried out by combining a space-time diagram neural network, so that the dynamic sensing and prediction capability of a complex hydrologic process is remarkably improved, the transition from static threshold alarming to multi-task and prospective abnormal early warning is realized, and the adaptability of the system to multiple scenes is enhanced.
assignees: HENGLONG GAOLU CONSULTING YINGJIANG CO LTD

title_en: The radio warning apparatus for a prevention of theft
title_ko: 보관함 도난방지 무선경보장치
abstract_en: A wireless burglar alarm apparatus of a locker is provided to allow a user to recognize abnormal opening of the locker by generating an alarm through an alarm display unit. A wireless burglar alarm apparatus of a locker(100) includes transmitters(200), a repeater(300), and receivers(400). The transmitter is installed in the locker, stores a unique number of the locker, and transmits the unique number of the locker at a predetermined frequency by sensing opening of the locker. The repeater is located within a transmission range of the transmitter, changes the unique number of the locker into a predetermined frequency, amplifies the modulated signal, and re-transmits the amplified signal. The receiver is carried by a user(500) within a transmission range of the repeater, stores the same unique number of the locker as the unique number stored in the transmitter, and generates a predetermined alarm when the stored unique number is identical to the unique number received from the repeater.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공공장소에 설치되어 있는 보관함 도난방지 무선경보장치에 관한 것이다. 
     더욱 상세하게는 공공장소에 설치되어 있는 보관함 도난방지 무선경보장치에 있어서, 보관함에 구비되고 보관함의 고유번호를 저장하고 있으며, 보관함의 문이 열리는 경우를 감지하여 소정 주파수로 고유번호를 송신하는 송신기, 상기 송신기의 송신범위 내에 위치하며, 상기 송신기로부터 수신된 고유번호를 소정 주파수로 변경하여 증폭한 후 재송신하는 중계기 및 상기 중계기의 송신범위 내에 있는 보관인이 휴대하고, 상기 송신기와 동일한 보관함 고유번호를 저장하고 있으며, 상기 중계기로부터 수신된 고유번호와 비교하여 일치하는 경우 소정의 경보를 발생하는 수신기로 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 보관함 도난방지 무선경보장치에 관한 것이다. 
       
     보관함, 도난방지, 무선경보

title_en: Integrated middleware apparatus for managing animal based on radio frequency identication/ubiquitous sensor newtwork/global positioning system, system for managing animal, and method of managing animal using thereof
title_ko: 알에프아이디/유에스엔/지피에스 기반의 통합 미들웨어장치 및 동물관리시스템 및 이들을 이용한 동물 관리 방법
abstract_en: An integrated middleware apparatus based on RFID/USN/GPS, an animal management method and an animal management system are provided to correspond the medical team or the rearing cage by confirming an emergency situation. A GPS receiver(101), an RFID tag(102), and a temperature sensor(103) are adhered to an animal in a zoo. The state of the animal is monitored by on a real time basis and it transmits with the integration middleware apparatus(110). An application module transmits and generates a message about an emergency message. By using the mobile terminal, the people connected to the animal management receives the message about the urgent situation.
abstract_ko: 알에프아이디/유에스엔/지피에스 기반의 통합 미들웨어 장치 및 동물관리시스템 및 이들을 이용한 동물 관리 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 동물관리시스템은 동물의 상태 정보를 획득하기 위한 RFID, GPS, 및 센서 기반의 센싱 노드와, RFID, GPS, 및 센서 기반의 센싱 노드에서 획득한 상태 정보를 통합 미들웨어를 통해 실시간으로 데이터베이스로 전달함과 동시에 RFID, GPS, 및 센서 기반의 센싱 노드에서 획득한 상태 정보를 종합적으로 처리하여 상태 정보를 포함한 동물관련정보를 실시간으로 웹 서비스를 통해 제공하기 위한 통합 미들웨어 장치와, 통합 미들웨어 장치로부터 전달된 동물 관련 정보를 실시간으로 저장 및 갱신하는 데이터베이스와, 웹 서비스를 통해 데이터베이스에 저장된 동물 관련 정보를 공통 응용 인터페이스를 이용하여 접근 가능하도록 구성된 애플리케이션모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이를 통해 동물원 내의 동물들을 통합 관리할 수 있으며, 공용의 웹 서비스를 사용함으로써, 여러 응용 서비스를 통해 동물의 다양한 정보를 쉽고 편하게 관리할 수 있다. 특히, 동물의 위치나 체온 등에 기초한 긴급상황이 발생하면 이를 사육사 등에게 메시지를 통해 실시간으로 알림으로써, 의료진이나 사육사 등에게 긴급한 대처를 가능하게 한다.
assignees: CHEJU NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Digital security system, method and program
abstract_en: Provided are a digital security system, method and program that are capable of reporting an emergency in terms of security without allowing a suspicious person to become aware of the reporting, even when the report is made right in front of the suspicious person, and to do so while also improving reliability by preventing report errors and failures. The digital security system is provided with: an abdominal muscle pressure signal acquisition unit (101) that acquires an abdominal muscle pressure signal from an abdominal muscle pressure sensor (10) which detects the abdominal muscle pressure of a user, and that also acquires a respiratory signal from a respiratory sensor (20) that detects the respiration of the user; an abdominal muscle pressure signal extraction unit (102) that cancels out the respiratory signal component from the acquired abdominal muscle pressure signal and extracts an abdominal muscle pressure signal for which the impact of respiration is suppressed; an abnormality determination unit (112) that determines whether there is an abnormality on the basis of the abdominal muscle pressure signal from which the respiration signal component has been cancelled out; and a warning transmission unit (203) that reports an abnormal state on the basis of the abnormal state occurrence determination results.

title_en: High speed railway crosswind information collection and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high speed railway crosswind information collection and early warning system. The system comprises a crosswind information collection device, a current signal/numerical signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold value of a crosswind disaster risk, an early warning program starting decision-making device, a positioning device, a train controlling device used for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device, wherein the control module serves as the core of the whole system, controls operation of all the devices, and also is used for being connected with external equipment such as an external computer device to achieve communication and control. The reference threshold value of the crosswind disaster risk is dynamically generated, and the historical conditions are continuously updated after the latest early warning happens in combination with the historical disaster occurrence conditions, so that compared with historical data, the risk pre-evaluation of a certain area is considered more completely and scientifically. The invention further provides a high speed railway crosswind information collection and early warning method.

title_en: A kind of monitored by personnel's system and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of personnel monitoring system and method, and described system includes: user terminal, is worn on user personnel, the data message of detection user personnel；Management server, receives the data message of described user terminal；Receive terminal system, open by the way of at least one platform device is with browser, obtain all of data message of user personnel to described management Server remote.Present invention can apply to multi-platform equipment, remotely can be used by public wide area network or LAN, provide powerful guarantee for lacking network environment under emergent occasion.The personnel monitoring system of the present invention can be applicable to the fields such as fire-fighting emergent, and according to the multi-parameter fusion pre-alerting ability of the personnel monitoring system of the present invention, commanding can quickly assign the instruction of next stage, quickly withdraws personnel at risk and succour.The 3-D view that the personnel monitoring system of the present invention provides and the location of two dimension view, can accurately find the position at indoor and outdoor personnel place, provides strong information support to the personal scheduling of rescue site and rescue.

title_en: A kind of automatic alarm background music system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automatic alarm background music systems, it is related to a kind of background music system, including Safety defence detector and background music alarm, Safety defence detector includes the first ZigBee chip, security protection probe, reset button, first antenna and the first power module, and background music alarm includes the 2nd ZigBee chip, audio-frequency module, the second antenna and second power supply module；It is used to receive the warning message that the security protection probe issues by the 2nd ZigBee chip, and it controls audio-frequency module and carries out background music alarm casting, 2nd ZigBee chip is also used to receive the alarm that the reset button issues and cancels message, and it controls audio-frequency module and stops background music alarm casting, audio-frequency module can carry out personal settings, according to alarm needs, customization instruction audio.The classification that the present invention pops one's head according to security protection allows users to fast resolution type of alarm and makes corresponding counter-measure.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIER INTELLIGENT HOME APPLIANCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power plant equipment fault early warning method and system based on dual networks
abstract_en: The invention provides a power plant equipment fault early warning method and system based on dual networks, which comprises the following steps: determining working condition parameters of real-time operation of power plant unit equipment; inputting the working condition parameters into the trained double-network model to calculate sample energy corresponding to the working condition parameters; the dual network model includes: a self-encoding network and an estimation network; the self-coding network is used for extracting depth characteristic data of working condition parameters; estimating the distribution probability of the network estimation depth feature data under the Gaussian mixture model, updating the parameters of the Gaussian mixture model based on the distribution probability, and determining the sample energy corresponding to the working condition parameters based on the updated parameters of the Gaussian mixture model; and when the sample energy is greater than the early warning threshold value, the corresponding power plant unit equipment is considered to be in fault. The method can extract the characteristics of the high-dimensional data so as to avoid the dimension disaster problem which is difficult to process by the traditional machine learning method; the time cost of network training and use is reduced without affecting the decoding capability.

title_en: Risk processing method, processing device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a risk processing method, a risk processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The risk processing method comprises the following steps: constructing a space-time dynamic knowledge graph based on the time-related features and the space-related features of the continuously collected historical burst cases and the monitoring elements of the urban lifeline possessed by the historical burst cases; responding to the obtained emergency, updating a space-time dynamic knowledge graph based on the emergency, and obtaining a candidate case matched with the emergency based on the updated space-time dynamic knowledge graph; searching the associated cases associated with the candidate cases in the space-time dynamic knowledge graph to perform risk early warning by combining the associated cases; and generating a treatment plan for the incident based on the historical treatment plan corresponding to the candidate case. Through the technical scheme, the method and the device are beneficial to finding the event possibly having a chain reaction with the emergency and carrying out subsequent risk early warning and processing plan recommendation.
assignees: JINGDONG TECHNOLOGY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Digital broadcast receiver and digital broadcast reception method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide detailed operation of a transmitter and a receiver capable of minimizing delay in reproduction of an emergency earthquake alert transmitted by digital broadcasting.SOLUTION: A digital broadcast receiver comprises: a receiving part for receiving a transmitted signal; broadcast demodulation part which demodulates a digital broadcast signal from the transmitted signal received by the receiving part; an earthquake motion alert information signal demodulation part which demodulates an earthquake motion alert information signal from the transmitted signal received by the receiving part; and a discrimination part which generates and outputs a video signal relating to the earthquake motion and when detecting that earthquake center information includes information cancelling earthquake motion alert, generates and outputs a video signal indicating that the earthquake motion alert had been cancelled.

title_en: A system of preventing a human-accident with a pressure sensor for a vehicle
title_ko: 압력 센서를 구비한 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템
abstract_en: A system for preventing accidents in a vehicle, which is equipped with a pressure sensor, is provided to ensure the safety of a passenger when the passenger is detected from the vehicle in an ignition off state of the vehicle. A system for preventing human accidents in a vehicle comprises as follows. A headrest pressure sensor(11a) for measuring the pressure applied from a passenger to a headrest(11). A seatback pressure sensor(13a) measures the pressure applied from the passenger to a seatback(13). A seat pressure sensor(15a) measures the pressure applied from the passenger to a seat(15). An analog process module converts pressure data, which are detected by the headrest pressure sensor, the seatback pressure sensor and the seat pressure sensor, into digital data. A body control module controls the operation of a warning alarm and a window(51).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 압력센서를 구비한 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 주행중의 탑승자를 보호하는 전장 시스템과 더불어 미주행시에도 발생하는 탑승자의 안전을 위하여 미주행시 시스템이 동작함으로써, 탑승자의 탑승을 감지하며, 위험 사항을 판단하여 운전자에게 알람 경고 및 위험 상황을 알려 인명 사고를 방지하고, 미주행 상태에서의 탑승자의 잔류가 감지될 시, 자동적으로 차량 내부 상태 감시 모드가 구동됨으로써, 위험 임계치에 도달할 시, 바디 컨트롤 모듈에서 내부 경고음 발생 및 위험 상태 회피를 위한 도어 모터 액츄에이터를 구동시켜 도어의 윈도우 다운을 제어하고, 좌석에 압력센서를 구비 및 소프트 웨어의 추가로 안전 사고를 방지할 수 있는 저비용 고효율의 압력센서를 구비한 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 그 기술적 구성은 자동차의 실내 온도를 측정하는 내기 온도 센서를 포함하는 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템에 있어서, 좌석의 머리받이에 구비되어 승객으로부터 압박되는 머리받이의 압력을 측정하는 머리받이 압력센서; 좌석의 등받이에 구비되어 승객으로부터 압박되는 등받이의 압력을 측정하는 등받이 압력센서; 좌석의 시트에 구비되어 승객으로부터 압박되는 시트의 압력을 측정하는 시트 압력 센서; 상기 머리받이 압력센서, 등받이 압력센서 및 시트 압력 센서로부터 감지된 압력 데이터를 디지털 데이터로 변경시키는 아날로그 프로세스 모듈; 그리고 상기 아날로그 프로세스 모듈로부터 상기 내기 온도 센서의 센서값 및 머리받이 압력 센서, 등받이 압력센서, 및 시트 압력센서의 센서 값으로 알람 및 도어의 도어의 윈도우의 구동을 제어하는 바디 컨트롤 모듈;을 바람직하게 포함하여 이루어짐으로써, 상기 내기 온도 센서 및 상기 각 압력센서로부터 감지된 데이터로 승객의 탑승 여부를 감지하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     인명 사고 방지 시스템, 압력센서, 아날로그 프로세스 모듈(Analog Process Module), 바디 컨트롤 모듈(Body Control Module,BCM), 공조 시스템

title_en: Emergency alerting system and method including low-power set-top box that controls operation modes depending on context information
title_ko: 상황 별 동작 모드 제어가 가능한 저전력 셋톱박스를 포함하는 재난 경보 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster alarm system including a low-power set-top box capable of context-based operation mode control, and a method thereof. The disaster alarm method performed by a set-top box can comprise the steps of: switching to a network-assisted passive standby mode among operation modes of a set-top box in accordance with preset conditions; transmitting information on an operation mode of the set-top box and context information around the set-top box to a wake-up server; receiving a wakeup data packet generated based on the transmitted information; and switching the operation mode of the set-top box based on the received wakeup data packet.
abstract_ko: 상황 별 동작 모드 제어가 가능한 저전력 셋톱박스를 포함하는 재난 경보 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 셋톱박스(set-top box)가 수행하는 재난 경보 방법은 미리 설정된 조건에 따라 상기 셋톱박스의 동작 모드 중 네트워크 연동 수동대기 모드(Network-Assisted Passive Standby Mode)로 전환하는 단계; 상기 셋톱박스의 동작 모드에 대한 정보 및 상기 셋톱박스 주변의 상황 정보를 웨이크업 서버로 전송하는 단계; 상기 전송된 정보들에 기초하여 생성된 웨이크업 데이터 패킷을 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 수신된 웨이크업 데이터 패킷에 기초하여 상기 셋톱박스의 동작 모드를 변경하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Stage setting apparatus of motor control method
title_ko: 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하량 변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for load fluctuation monitoring and comparative analysis for a motor-driven stage setting. According to the present invention, an algorithm is applied for constant motor load monitoring and comparative analysis in a motor-driven stage setting. As a result, pre-inspection and pre-repair can be performed for the stage setting, persons can be protected from an accident, inconvenience and performance cancelation attributable to sudden mechanical malfunction can be prevented, and a contribution can be made to a successful performance. The motor-driven stage setting management method of the present invention includes a step in which the presence or absence of a batten movement command is determined. In a case where the command is present, movement direction confirmation, position movement commanding, and remaining distance calculation are performed, and then it is determined whether or not the position of the moved batten is a specified position. In the case of the specified position, a temporary stop is performed and then the presence or absence of a batten movement command is determined again. According to the present invention, load monitoring starts at batten ascent or descent initiation and an average or maximum value is calculated and backed up. In a case where a value that exceeds a preset load rate is measured, a stage director or a stage setting manager is pre-notified of the fact so that regular inspection, emergency inspection, and forced stop can be performed in the case of mild, heavy, and serious warnings, respectively.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모터구동방식 무대장치에서 항상 모터의 부하량을 모니터링 및 비교 분석하는 알고리즘을 적용하여 사전에 무대장치를 점검 및 정비를 유도함으로써 갑작스런 기계 고장으로 인한 불편과 공연의 취소, 안전사고 등으로부터 인명을 보호하고 성공적인 공연에도 기여할 수 있도록 한 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하량 변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은  배튼의 이동지령 여부를 판단하여 배튼의 이동 지령이 있는 경우 이동방향 확인, 위치이동 지령 및 잔여 거리 연산을 실행한 후 이동한 배튼 위치가 규정위치인가 여부를 판단하여 규정위치이면 일단 정지한 후 배튼의 이동지령 여부를 재차 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 모터구동방식 무대장치의 관리방법에서, 배튼이 상승 또는 하강을 시작할 때부터 부하량을 모니터링하고 평균값 또는 최대값을 연산 및 백업하여 미리 설정된 부하율 보다 높은 값이 측정될 경우 무대 감독이나 무대장치 관리자에게 이 사실을 사전에 경고하여 경경고일 경우 정기점검의 유도를, 중경고일 경우는 긴급 점검의 유도를, 중대경고일 경우에는 강제정지를 실행하도록 이루어진 것이다.

title_en: Solar power plant with wireless automatic module power cut-off function by earth leakage detection
title_ko: 누전감지로 모듈전원 무선 자동차단하는 태양광발전장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solar power generation device for wirelessly and automatically cutting off module power using detection of a leakage current. The solar power generation device includes a function for automatically cutting off a leakage current by measuring, by sensors provided at the front end of a junction box, a leakage current due to the remaining magnetic flux corresponding to a difference between the magnetic fluxes of the positive (+) and negative (-) currents of a DC power circuit after the magnetic fluxes are canceled, wirelessly transmitting a cut-off signal when a leakage current of 20 mA or more that can affect the human body is generated, and wirelessly receiving DC power to a cut-off relay installed near solar modules, to detect, in the early stage, electrical accidents caused by poor connection, insulation breakdown, or current leakage in positive (+) or negative (-) wires or the related equipment in the DC power circuit that transmits, to an inverter, the power generated from the solar modules and prevent the spread, a notification function, and a monitoring function, to suppress, in the early stage, the electrical accidents due to current leakage, thereby preventing the spread of the electrical accidents and minimizing damage to life and property.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태양광 모듈에서 발생한 전력을 인버터로 전달하게 되는 직류전원회로에서 양극(+)이나 음극(-) 배선로나 관련설비에 접속불량, 절연파괴, 누전으로 인한 전기사고를 초기에 감지하고 확산을 미연에 방지하기 위해 직류회로의 양극(+)과 음극(-)전류의 자속이 상쇄되고 남는 차이의 자속에 의한 누설전류를 측정하는 센서를 접속함 전단에서 측정하고, 인체에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 20mA 이상의 누설전류가 발생 시 차단신호를 무선으로 송신하고, 직류전원을 모듈 가까이에 설치된 차단릴레이에서 무선으로 수신하여 자동적으로 차단하는 기능과 알림 기능 및 모니터링기능을 포함하여 누전으로 인한 전기사고를 초기진압을 실현하여 전기사고의 확대방지, 인명 및 재산 피해 최소화가 가능한 누전감지로 무선자동차단기능을 갖는 태양광발전장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Conditional Access Right Verification and Digital Token Issuance/Management System and Method Based on Zero-Meter Altitude Exclusion Zones
title_ko: 고도 0미터 제외구역 기반 조건부 통행권 검증 및 디지털 토큰 발급·관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for limiting ground and sea passage in real time and performing condition verification and management with a digital token based on an excluded area set at a reference altitude of 0 meters. It consists of a main server, a verification unit, a blockchain-based distributed verification server, a map information and altitude limit information table, a user operation unit, and a distributed storage, and the altitude, location, and time conditions are comprehensively determined to issue tokens when the conditions are met, and the history is recorded in the distributed ledger. Tokens will be automatically updated and discarded according to changes in situations such as policies and disasters, and warnings, route avoidance, and movement blocking functions will be performed when entering restricted areas. It can be applied to various moving objects such as autonomous vehicles, drones, uam, and autonomous ships.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기준 고도 0미터로 설정된 제외구역을 기반으로, 지상·해상 통행을 실시간 제한하고 디지털 토큰으로 조건 검증·관리를 수행하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 메인 서버, 검증부, 블록체인 기반 분산 검증 서버, 지도정보 및 고도제한정보 테이블, 사용자 조작부, 분산 저장소로 구성되며, 고도·위치·시간 조건을 종합 판단하여 조건 충족 시 토큰을 발급하고, 이력을 분산원장에 기록한다. 정책·재난 등 상황 변화에 따라 토큰은 자동 갱신·폐기되며, 제한구역 진입 시 경고, 경로 회피, 이동 차단 기능이 수행된다. 자율주행차, 드론, UAM, 자율운항 선박 등 다양한 이동체에 적용 가능하다.

title_en: A kind of building intelligent the monitoring system of fire protection and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to fire protection warning technical fields, a kind of building intelligent the monitoring system of fire protection and method are disclosed, the building intelligent the monitoring system of fire protection includes: fire detection module, life detection module, alarm module, photographing module, central control module, cutting module, evacuation module, emergency fire fighting module, elevator forced landing module, access door detection module, fire Safety Assessment module, display module.Access door detection module of the present invention without keeping a public place clean and Security Personnel etc. makes an inspection tour, reduces human cost, and improve the monitoring efficiency for monitoring passageway for fire apparatus door state according to the automatic state of monitoring passageway for fire apparatus door in real time of visual identification algorithm；Meanwhile by fire Safety Assessment module using simulated annealing as search strategy, Bayesian network optimum structure is found；In Bayesian Estimation method, by updated Bayesian network analysis tool, analysis obtains security risk assessment result.

title_en: Landslide deformation stage self-adaptive judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive judging method and a self-adaptive judging system for a landslide deformation stage, which take a global average displacement rate as a sample, calculate a landslide deformation displacement rate threshold sequence by using a mean value and a standard deviation from the perspective of statistics, dynamically update thresholds in the sequence along with the increase of monitoring data, and indicate that the current landslide displacement rate is obviously larger than the global average displacement rate when the displacement rate exceeds a corresponding threshold value, and perform self-adaptive landslide deformation grading early warning by combining an improved tangential angle. The method takes the global average displacement rate and the standard deviation as statistical references, so that threshold setting has statistical basis and can reflect geological condition differences of individual landslide features, and meanwhile, the improved tangent angle is calculated through dynamic mixing processing of displacement data fitting and original data, so that landslide stages are identified, and the robustness and instantaneity of discrimination results are improved.
assignees: SHAOXING KEZHU EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;ZHEJIANG SHUZHI JIAOYUAN TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: The ship safety navigation system using wave information according to radar measurement
title_ko: 레이더 계측에 따른 파랑정보를 이용한 선박 안전운항방법
abstract_en: A ship safety navigation system using wave information is provided to improve safety of a ship by informing the ship of the wave information containing height of waves. A wave measuring unit is activated(S100). Radar signals which are outputted from a radar are measured and stored in a memory(S200). The stored signal is converted to a 2D image signal(S300). The wave information is analyzed from the image signal and the analyzed wave information is displayed(S400). The analyzed wave information is compared with an alarm setting value, and it is determined whether a dangerous wave occurs(S500). When the dangerous wave occurs, a navigation direction of a ship and a propagation direction of the wave are checked and the navigation direction of the ship is changed(S600). When the dangerous wave fades away, an alarm state is released(S700).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레이더 계측에 따른 파랑정보를 이용한 선박 안전운항방법에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 레이더를 통해 파랑정보를 정확하게 계측하고, 이러한 정보를 서로 공유하며, 이를 통해 선박의 안정성을 향상시킬 수 있는 레이더 계측에 따른 파랑정보를 이용한 선박 안전운항방법을 제공하는 것이다.  
     본 발명은 파랑계측수단을 작동시키는 단계; 레이더에서 출력되는 레이더 신호를 계측하여 처리부에 저장하는 단계; 상기 저장된 신호를 이용하여 2차원의 영상신호로 변환하는 단계; 상기 영상신호로부터 파랑정보를 해석하여 표시하는 단계; 상기 해석된 파랑정보와 경보설정치를 대비하여 위험경보 파고의 발생여부를 판단하는 단계; 상기 위험경보 파고의 발생시, 선박과 파고진행방향을 확인하여 선박의 진행방향을 변경하는 단계; 상기 위험경보 파고의 위험성 해제시 알람경보를 해제하는 단계;로 이루어져 있다. 
       
     파랑, 파고, 선박, 안전운항, 레이더
assignees: HYUN DAI HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: A kind of textile fabric transmission warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of textile fabrics to transmit warning device, including workbench, the top both sides of the workbench are equipped with the light emitters being symmetrical set and light receiver, workbench is rotatably connected to retracting roller close to the side side wall of light receiver by the identical plate body of two structures, the moving track that the both sides side wall of the workbench is provided symmetrically, mobile device is connected on moving track, it is connected with holder between the top of two mobile devices, holder is arranged in reverse U-shaped structure, and the top of holder is connected with cylinder, the piston rod of cylinder is arranged downward, and the piston rod of cylinder passes through the top of holder to be connected with push plate.The present invention can timely remind the operator on textile fabric transmission production line to handle emergency situations, and can the textile cloth of fold be effectively subjected to pressing processing, the service life of transmitting mechanical is not only increased, production efficiency is also improved, structure novel, suitable for promoting.

title_en: Disaster risk assessment method, early warning equipment and system based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster risk assessment method, early warning equipment and a disaster risk assessment system based on a big data model, and relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring and early warning; the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic area parameters of a target monitoring area, determining a bearing base line of each risk factor by combining cloud historical disaster data, deploying early warning equipment according to acquisition density, dividing a coverage unit, cleaning multi-source data according to a sampling period, performing time alignment and space aggregation to form the environmental existence quantity of the coverage unit, generating a bearing interval by combining soil, vegetation, gradient and rainfall characteristics, calculating a normalized change index in a preset time window, marking a risk unit by a super threshold, and performing regional assessment and early warning according to the area ratio of the risk unit and the change quantity thereof. The invention realizes end cloud coordination and threshold rolling update, and is suitable for multi-disaster scenes such as waterlogging, landslide and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH;GUIZHOU BEIDOU SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA BROADCASTING & TELEVISION SICHUAN NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: System and Method for Measuring and Monitoring Seismic data Applied to the City Building
title_ko: 건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a building, which can rapidly inspect rapidity of seismic event detection and effectiveness of an occurrence event and prevent wrong detection and wrong warning in order to construct a rapid seismic warning system for alleviation of a seismic disaster of the building, wherein the system for measuring and monitoring the seismic data comprises: multiple seismic data measurement systems positioned at different distances from a monitoring object, each including a GPS receiving module and a seismic accelerometer, and performing previous detection for a seismic event; and a seismic monitoring system processing visual synchronization for data transmitted by the multiple seismic data measurement systems to remove noises and reconfigure the data into single merged data, performing post-process detection for checking whether the seismic event occurs and finally determining whether a seismic event occurs by using the previous detection result for the seismic event in each seismic data measurement system and the post-process detection result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 지진재해경감을 위한 지진신속경보체계 구축을 위하여 지진 이벤트 감지의 신속성 및 발생 이벤트의 유효성을 빠르게 검사하고 오검출 및 오경보를 방지할 수 있도록 한 건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시 대상물과 서로 다른 거리에 위치하고, GPS 수신모듈과지진가속도센서를 포함하고 지진이벤트의 사전 검출을 수행하는 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들 상기 복수개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들로부터 전송된 데이터를 시각 동기화 처리하여 잡음제거 및 단일 중합데이터로 재구성하고, 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하기 위해 후처리 검출을 하여 각각의 지진 데이터 측정시스템에서의 지진이벤트 사전검출 결과와 후처리 검출결과를 활용하여 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 최종 판별하는 지진 감시시스템 을 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent vehicle-carried fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire-fighting equipment technical fields, specifically, being related to a kind of intelligent vehicle-carried fire extinguisher.Start the intelligent controller of fire extinguisher spraying fire-extinguishing agent including fire extinguisher and by sense temperature variation.The present invention is not necessarily on duty, round-the-clock detection, and occurring to give warning in advance when fire behavior withdraws personnel in time, and disposes in time, self-extinguishing, to avoid vehicle burning, trample or burn the event of dying.Through experimental results demonstrate the present invention can effectively put out the fire behaviors such as the mechanical equipment in horizontal, longitudinal or bus rear engine and electric box, ship.
assignees: ZIBO YUYAN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting aircraft water-drawing takeoff alarming method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of circuit design of an airplane system and discloses a water drawing takeoff warning method of a fire-fighting airplane.A data acquisition device provides interfaces of various data types to be crosslinked with a fire-fighting task computer, an engine console, a fuel computer, an undercarriage position/retraction unit, an atmospheric data computer, a radio altimeter, a warning lamp and a sound device, and converts and outputs the acquired working state data of a crosslinking system to a core processing unit; the core processing unit is cross-linked with the information acquisition device and the comprehensive display unit through a bus data interface, carries out comprehensive processing on data converted by the information acquisition device according to a water drawing takeoff warning judgment process of the fire-fighting aircraft, outputs a processing result to the comprehensive display unit and the information acquisition device, drives an alarm lamp and a sound device through display characters of the comprehensive display unit or the information acquisition device, and provides a visual and auditory multiple alarm mode for the flight unit when the fire-fighting aircraft takes off in a water drawing mode.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA AIRCRAFT IND CO LTD OF CHINA AVIATION IND GENERAL AIRCRAFT CO LTD

title_en: Safety management information sharing system and method for power enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management information sharing system and a safety management information sharing method for an electric power enterprise, wherein the safety management information sharing system comprises an identity authority management module, a safety monitoring early warning module, a device state management maintenance module, an employee training knowledge management module, an emergency response disaster backup management module, a vulnerability management safety update module, a real-time communication notification service module and a compliance audit supervision module.
assignees: CHINA SUNTIEN GREEN ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method, and belongs to the technical field of gas monitoring. In order to solve the problems that the lack of an effective early warning and response mechanism and the incapability of providing effective evacuation guidance in emergency result in personnel evacuation confusion and panic, a real-time monitoring module compares the concentration of dangerous gas with a preset safety threshold value, once the dangerous gas is found to leak, dangerous marks can be immediately carried out, an alarm is triggered through the dangerous early warning module, the timely early warning and response mechanism is helpful for reducing the possibility of accidents, the evacuation guidance module can simulate the layout of a monitoring area, forecast the trend and range of dangerous gas diffusion, plan a safe evacuation route based on the forecast result, provide scientific basis for personnel evacuation in emergency, help reduce personnel casualties, and the system can adjust and update the evacuation route in real time by continuously receiving data in a gas diffusion forecast unit so as to adapt to the continuously-changed dangerous situation.
assignees: ZHONGKAIDA ELECTRONIC TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Deformation monitoring system and method for engineering measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformation monitoring system and method for engineering measurement, which relate to the technical field of engineering measurement and comprise the following steps: acquiring basic parameters of an engineering structure, setting a deformation control threshold, deploying a static monitoring terminal and a mobile inspection vehicle to acquire multi-source monitoring data, constructing a historical deformation database, correcting the historical data through a linear regression model based on real-time environment parameters, fusing the static data and the dynamic data to obtain a deformation index value, and triggering grading early warning and emergency response through the comparison of the index value and the threshold. According to the invention, through a distributed monitoring and data fusion technology, comprehensive and efficient collection and intelligent analysis of engineering structure deformation are realized, monitoring precision and early warning prospective are improved by utilizing a historical database and an environment update model, and accurate risk assessment and decision are supported by a quantized index value and hierarchical response mechanism.

title_en: Theft warning system
title_ko: 매설 침입자 경보기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A buried type alarming device with respect to intruders is provided to reduce cost and time required for operating the device and maximize the intruder detecting effect of the device. CONSTITUTION: An impact pressure sensor(2) detects an intruder. A battery(1) supplies power to a sensor controller(3). The sensor controller transmits intrinsic data from a sensor wireless transferring part(4) to a central controlling part(30) through an antenna. The central controlling part receives the intrinsic data. A microcomputer controlling part(13) reads the intrinsic data. A displaying part(15) displays installed position information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 외부 침입자를 감지하기 위한 경보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 군사 및 국가 중요시설에 침입하는 침입자를 초병이나 경비원에게 사전에 알려주고 각종 시설물이나 야적장 또는 농축산물 등의 어느 장소든지 침입자를 사전에 감지하기 위하여 누구든지 경보장치시설 전문기술이나 공구 또는 연장이 없이도  단시간에 손쉽게 경보시스템을 시설, 철수, 변경할 수 있는 지하 매설 침입자 경보시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent fire alarm system and management method based on fire location information
title_ko: 화재발생 위치정보를 포함한 화재 알림 경보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire informing and alarming data providing method and a system capable of including the fire occurrence location information are provided to enable a quick and safe escaping. CONSTITUTION: A location based intelligent fire alarm system comprises a fire receiver operating protocol processer, a generation server operating protocol processor, a management monitoring unit, and a communication unit. The fire receiver operating protocol processer performs the fire location information processing by operating with the fire receiver which includes the fire sensor. The generation server operating protocol processor starts or cancels the fire alarm to a generation server which manages a home network device for the fire alarm within the generation. The management monitoring unit displays and controls the fire occurrence location expression or the processing status on a screen in the graphic. The communication unit provides a communication protocol for sending and receiving the fire occurrence location information by the wire/wireless communication and a communication port. [Reference numerals] (100) Fire alarm system; (115) Management monitor; (120) Receiver synchro protocol S/W; (130) Complex server synchro protocol S/W; (140) Fire alarm driving S/W; (150) Fire alarm starting S/W; (160) Fire alarm stopping S/W; (170) DEMS; (180) GUI; (200) Complex server; (210) Fire alarm synchro S/W; (300) Wall pad; (320) Voice alarm device; (340) Virtual alarm device; (400) Fire receiver; (500) Fire detecter
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생에 의한 경보 알림 문제점을 해결하여 입주자 안전을 위한 화재발생 알림 경보를 제공하는 것으로, 현재 보급 중인 홈 기기에 첨단 IT 기술을 실현하여 음성경보 및 시각 경보 기능을 적절하게 동작하게 함으로써 화재발생 후 입주자들에게 신속하게 화재발생을 알리며 안전한 대피를 할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 위해 홈기기, 경보장치, 유/무선 통신 네트워크 및 관리 서버를 구성으로 하고, 관리 서버에 화재위치정보 처리 프로세스를 구현하여 공동 주거지 역 내 또는 세대 내 입주자에게 신속한 화재 경보가 가능하도록 하는 화재알림 경보를 제공한다. 특히 본 발명에 따른 시스템 및 방법은 화재발생 위치정보를 포함한 화재 알림 경보를 제공하여 입주자가 화재위치를 파악하여 안전한 대피로로 이동할 수 있도록 함을 특징으로 한다.
