abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fusion data set and determining risk evolution parameters; triggering a vegetation difference analysis function if the risk evolution parameter exceeds a preset threshold value to obtain a section heterogeneity label, carrying out space-time heterogeneity compensation correction on historical data through a time sequence change tracking method after the section heterogeneity label is obtained, calculating the risk transition probability of each section, judging potential critical points, activating a difference early warning mechanism if the potential critical points are judged to be high probability, generating a targeted risk grade map according to the section heterogeneity label and the risk transition probability to obtain a dynamic early warning signal, carrying out iterative verification on the dynamic early warning signal by adopting a real-time update flow in a fusion data set, and combining the prediction output of a long-term and short-term memory network to adjust the risk grade to determine a final risk prediction result. The method and the device improve the timeliness and accuracy of fire risk prediction.

title_en: SAM-based remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device based on SAM, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a proper SAM model version, configuring an operation environment, then carrying out pit target detection on a remote sensing image pit based on a YOLOv model after training, generating a target detection frame, and inputting the generated target detection frame as a boundary frame prompt (box prompt) and a remote sensing image into the SAM model together to obtain a remote sensing image pit segmentation result. The method can not only improve the precision and efficiency of pit extraction, but also adapt to the pit extraction requirements of different scales and complexity, provides powerful support for the fields of water resource management, environment monitoring, disaster early warning and the like, has higher accuracy in pit detection, has good robustness and high running speed, is light in weight and easy to deploy, and provides an innovative application for the field of pit water surface extraction.

title_en: A kind of rail traffic construction personnel safety pre-warning system and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of rail traffic construction personnel safety pre-warning system and methods, the system includes the range finder module of real-time detection construction point safe construction range boundary and row vehicle headway in traveling, safe construction range boundary between train in traveling at a distance between distance reach safety distance threshold when to warning module send out alarm evacuation order, and it sends personnel to construction point safety clearance module and goes out the clear message processing module for checking order, the warning module of alarm prompt is sent out according to the alarm evacuation order received and the construction point safety clearance module of situation is withdrawn according to the personnel within the scope of detection safe construction.This method installs ranging and source of early warning respectively in vehicle and construction point, reminds personnel and vehicle distances in real time when vehicle is close.This system and method are in such a way that complete and automatic construction personnel's pre-alarming system is alerted instead of protoplast's work, and prealarming process is accurate, timely and reliable, effectively prevent safety accident caused by neglecting due to personnel.

title_en: Multi-source data dynamic threshold approach alarm method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for dynamic threshold approach alarm of multi-source data, comprising the following steps: according to preset source monitoring equipment, multi-source data are obtained, the multi-source data are subjected to data fusion, standardized data are output, disaster influence conditions are obtained according to monitoring carrier characteristics corresponding to each standard set in the standardized data, disaster threshold rule bases matched with the corresponding standard sets are constructed, disaster dynamic thresholds are configured for the corresponding standard sets according to weather change conditions and combined with the disaster threshold rule bases and updated in real time, first reminding service strategies are set for different disaster dynamic thresholds, second reminding service strategies are set for the corresponding disaster dynamic thresholds according to updating conditions of the same disaster, adjacent reminding service strategies of the corresponding disaster dynamic thresholds are obtained according to the first reminding service strategies and the second reminding service strategies, and corresponding reminding operations are executed. The accuracy of warning to the calamity is convenient for effectual improvement.

title_en: Disaster monitoring system and method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster monitoring system and a disaster monitoring method for data analysis, wherein the disaster monitoring system comprises a landslide data storage module, a three-dimensional visualization module, a slope crack detection module, a crack propagation speed analysis module, a landslide slip surface prediction analysis module, a slip surface inclination angle analysis module, a landslide volume prediction analysis module, a landslide early warning grade evaluation module and a landslide early warning module, and the disaster monitoring system has the beneficial effects that: the method comprises the steps of obtaining crack data on a slope, screening the data, carrying out inclination analysis on cracks meeting the conditions, predicting a landslide surface of the landslide through inclination analysis, predicting the volume of the landslide and the inclination angle of the landslide surface according to the landslide surface, calculating the time for the crack to expand to the landslide surface according to the expansion speed of the crack, evaluating the early warning grade through the landslide volume, the landslide inclination angle and the shortest expansion time, timely issuing early warning, and taking preventive and therapeutic measures according to the early warning grade or informing people to withdraw as soon as possible, so that the life and property safety of people is ensured.

title_en: Flood risk early warning and evacuation system based on GIS positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk early warning and evacuation system and method based on a GIS positioning technology, which comprises the following steps: the information storage module is used for: aerial pictures of landforms on two sides of the river channel are provided for the geographic information module, predicted flood flow at a specific time point is provided for the flood dynamic monitoring module, and predicted single-flood peak maximum flow is provided for the flood area division module. The geographic information module is used for: river channel section information is provided for the flood dynamic monitoring module, and geographical information on two banks of the river channel is provided for the flood area dividing module, and the information is provided on a public coordinate map in the geographical information module. The flood dynamic monitoring module is used for: and providing the flooding water level for the flood area dividing module. The flood area division module is used for: and providing flood inundation area and flood influence area range information for the early warning evacuation module. The invention has the advantages that: the three-dimensional characteristic curved surface information, the three kinds of flood area range information and the public coordinate map are combined, and the processes of actively releasing the early warning information and withdrawing schemes are flexible and convenient.

title_en: Mountain crack geological disaster information monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The application provides a mountain crack geological disaster information monitoring and early warning method which comprises the steps of obtaining crack form data of a mountain crack area, wherein the crack form data comprise crack length, width, depth and trend, acquiring geological feature parameters of the crack area in real time through a preset sensor network, wherein the geological feature parameters comprise lithology, structure and stress state, acquiring data through a pre-arranged geological sensor network, transmitting the crack form data and the geological feature parameters acquired in the wild to a monitoring platform in real time, designing a visual display module according to a dynamically updated crack dividing result, generating a crack space distribution map and an attribute feature map, and performing correlation analysis on the visually displayed crack dividing result and monitoring information such as rainfall, earth surface displacement and the like in the monitoring platform to generate a disaster early warning report.

title_en: Fracturing construction monitoring and early warning system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and intelligent early warning of fracturing engineering, in particular to a fracturing construction monitoring and early warning system and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initializing equivalent system resistance and flow state correction index; the method comprises the steps of constructing a reference physical model, calculating a theoretical pressure value, calculating a deviation index, triggering inversion of a geological state in response to the deviation index being larger than a preset dynamic judgment threshold, returning to execute the step of collecting the current real-time pressure value and the current real-time discharge value of the high-pressure grouting pump in real time in response to the deviation index being smaller than or equal to the dynamic judgment threshold, reversely solving to obtain updated equivalent system resistance, calculating to obtain a risk index, generating a grading early warning and decision instruction, and updating the initialized equivalent system resistance in the reference physical model to the updated equivalent system resistance in response to confirmation of an early warning event.

title_en: Safety monitoring information updating method
abstract_en: Required cost when being updated to reduce to the safety protection warning display device for being publicized and being warned using LCDs, and the reliability of safety protection warning information updating is improved, the invention provides a kind of safety monitoring information updating method, including：Safety protection warning information is distributed to multiple movable mechanicals, the multiple movable mechanical sends safety protection warning information to the safety protection warning display device with LCDs, and makes safety protection warning display device update and show safety protection warning information.The present invention can be by using the renewal of the greatly convenient safety protection warning information of the inspection mechanically moving such as vehicle or private vehicle, manpower and safety protection warning O＆M cost are saved, and improves the promptness and reliability of safety protection warning information updating under the particular surroundings such as field or Forest Park.

title_en: Method for monitoring and pre-warning and emergency command and dispatch system communication link optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, and particularly discloses a method, a device and a system for monitoring, early warning and optimizing a communication link of an emergency command and dispatch system. According to the method for monitoring, early warning and emergency command and dispatch system communication link optimization, the communication links are initialized, the communication link library is established, the states of the communication links are monitored, the scoring coefficient of the communication links is updated, the reliability value of the communication links is calculated, the communication links are selected according to the reliability value or the communication code value of the communication links, data transmission is completed through the selected communication links, after disasters occur, the emergency rescue and dispatch and command communication system can automatically calculate the communication link with highest reliability or low transmission cost according to the communication links supported by the system to communicate, manual intervention is not needed, and the normal condition of the communication links under extreme conditions is ensured.

title_en: Digital twinning-based lightning protection combined insulator insulation coordination detection and structure optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based lightning protection combined insulator insulation coordination detection and structure optimization method, which comprises the steps of obtaining structural parameters, real-time environmental parameters and operation electrical parameters of the lightning protection combined insulator to be detected, constructing a digital twinning simulation field model, establishing a preliminary digital twinning simulation platform, obtaining an updated preliminary digital twinning simulation platform, establishing an insulation coordination equivalent model to obtain an optimized design scheme, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning on the insulation coordination condition of the lightning protection combined insulator according to the insulation coordination equivalent model. The invention can monitor the insulation state of the insulator and the lightning arrester in real time, realize real-time tracking of the insulation performance, immediately send out early warning once the insulation performance is abnormal, remind operation and maintenance personnel to take measures in time, effectively avoid equipment faults or safety accidents caused by insulation failure, be favorable for finding out the performance bottleneck and potential problems of the equipment in time, and provide targeted maintenance advice for the operation and maintenance personnel.

title_en: Visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and a medium thereof, in particular to the field of electronic commerce, the system comprises a data encryption acquisition module, a data cleaning and integrating module, a data analysis module, a real-time data monitoring module, a visual template customizing module and a dynamic data interaction module. The visualized data information acquisition system based on big data and the medium thereof encrypt target platform data through a data encryption acquisition module to reduce hidden danger of data acquisition, perform real-time data processing operation through a real-time data monitoring module, set a data change rule and an early warning mechanism, acquire and update data in time, receive third key information through a dynamic data interaction module, display the third key information on a visualized interface according to a preset mode, provide autonomous exploration and prediction analysis of dynamic data by a user, and increase interactivity of the system.

title_en: BIM-based ultra-wide deep large foundation pit monitoring method and system for deep soft soil area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metering, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring ultra-wide deep large foundation pit in deep soft soil areas based on BIM, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the deformation degree of a construction process at a target depth by utilizing the geological survey data and displacement monitoring data of a construction influence area; the method comprises the steps of determining a deformation abnormal range of a construction influence area by utilizing deformation degree of a corrected construction process, determining a soil deformation mutation risk degree by utilizing the deformation abnormal range, obtaining an adjusted monitoring frequency by utilizing the soil deformation mutation risk degree and an initial monitoring frequency, obtaining updated displacement monitoring data based on the adjusted monitoring frequency, obtaining a target soil deformation mutation risk degree by utilizing the updated displacement monitoring data of the construction influence area and combining with geological survey data, and determining a risk area. By the technical scheme, the early warning capability of safety accidents possibly occurring in the construction process is improved, and the method is beneficial to timely finding out dangerous areas and timely taking treatment measures.

title_en: Slope landslide early warning method based on NPR cable slip force monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope landslide early warning method based on NPR cable slip force monitoring. Firstly, constructing an evidence reasoning model for predicting the sliding force of the side slope, wherein input variables of the evidence reasoning model are a sliding force monitoring value acquired by an NPR anchor cable sensor at the current moment and a difference value between the sliding force monitoring value at the current moment and a sliding force monitoring value at the historical moment, and output variables of the evidence reasoning model are predicted values of the future sliding force of the side slope; then constructing a Reference Evidence Matrix (REM) to model a mapping relation between input and output variables; when the input variable samples are acquired online, the evidence of activation of the input variable samples is obtained through REM, all the evidences of activation of the input variable samples are fused through an evidence reasoning algorithm to obtain a fusion result, the predicted value of the slope sliding force at the future moment is calculated through the fusion result, and an alarm threshold value is set to implement out-of-limit alarm; by utilizing a sequential linear programming method, REM is updated in real time for predicting the sliding force at the next moment, and the predicted value of the method has higher prediction precision.

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system, comprising the steps of acquiring sensor installation parameters and large-dip-angle stope geological environment information, establishing a correction model, and correcting large-dip-angle stope geological exploration data acquired by a sensor; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a large dip angle stope according to corrected parameters, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning index system based on historical coal-rock disaster case data and expert experience, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model based on a machine learning algorithm, integrating the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model into the digital twin model, and carrying out real-time evaluation and early warning on the large dip angle stope dynamic disaster risk by the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model when the digital twin model is updated. The invention effectively reduces the occurrence risk of coal and rock dynamic disasters, ensures the life safety of stope operators and the normal operation of equipment, and improves the safety and economic benefit of coal exploitation.

title_en: Hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain, torrential flood and flood in small watershed of mountainous area
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain and torrential flood in small watershed of mountainous area, which divides actual measurement flood and flood simulated by adopting a hydrological model into an expansion section, a steep expansion section, a disaster forming section and a water withdrawal section, screens the hydrological model by comparing the calculation results of the hydrological model on the steep expansion section and the disaster forming section with the actual measurement flood, fully considers the early catching capacity of the hydrological model on certain key disaster-causing early warning moments of the steep expansion section, can catch the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster-causing moment in advance, can avoid alarm leakage, improves the accuracy and reliability of the forecasting and early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood in the small watershed of mountainous area, and can provide more scientific guidance and technical support for the forecasting and early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster in the small watershed of mountainous area.

title_en: Coal mine water flood rescuer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of coal mine water flood rescuer.When colliery occurs permeable, utilize the buoyancy that institute's water produces, make the floating block 15 made by EVA material in mechanism under buoyancy of water effect, drive push rod 19 to move up, push rod 19 is driven to drive lever 17 to move in the direction of the clock, lever 17 rotates to drive downwards poke rod 6 to leave behind to stir catch 4 and makes it to rotate around its alignment pin, eject spring stack 18, thus open self-rescuer cabinet door, automatically life saving system is sent, life saving system comprises apparatus of oxygen supply, food, water forms, be supplied to personnel in the pit to save oneself, touch sensor simultaneously and send signal, turn-on current, open warning system, gain time for other personnel in the pit withdraws in time.

title_en: Lignite upgrading and drying environment monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lignite upgrading and drying environment monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things, wherein the lignite upgrading and drying environment monitoring system comprises the following steps: s1: monitoring the lignite upgrading and drying environment, and capturing node environment information of each processing link of lignite upgrading and drying; acquiring real-time conditions of the corresponding lignite in each treatment link of lignite upgrading and drying; s2: analyzing node environment information and lignite corresponding area conditions in each processing link; s3: monitoring operation requests sent in each processing link in real time, and sending out early warning when abnormal lignite-related data in processing nodes corresponding to the operation requests are monitored; s4: according to the abnormal judgment result, the relevant data of the lignite upgrading and drying environment are adjusted and updated; the whole operation process of upgrading and drying the lignite is ensured not to damage the nutrient value components of the lignite, the potential safety hazards of inflammability, explosiveness and the like caused by the chemical properties of the lignite are avoided, resources are fully utilized, and environmental pollution is reduced.

title_en: Mobile terminal early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile terminal early warning method and device. The method comprises the following steps: position information of a mobile terminal and a potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information are acquired in real time; if the potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information is equal to or greater than a preset value corresponding to the position information, the mobile terminal is triggered to give an alarm; the position information and the potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information are stored; the preset value corresponding to the position information is updated according to the stored potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information. According to the mobile terminal early warning method and device, the position information of the mobile terminal and the potential safety hazard parameter corresponding to the position information are acquired in real time, the preset value corresponding to the position information is updated according to the stored potential safety hazard parameter, as a result, the preset value can change along with positions of a user or change along with practical situations of the position where the user is located, and the accuracy of the early warning function is improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Cable damage prevention early warning device and cable damage prevention early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable damage prevention early warning device and a cable damage prevention early warning method, wherein the cable damage prevention early warning device comprises a marker pile and an early warning module which are arranged in a cable laying area, wherein an installation cavity is formed in the marker pile, the early warning module comprises an alarm, an air cylinder and an air pipe, the alarm is arranged on the outer side of the marker pile, the alarm is connected with a power supply, a first switch is connected between the alarm and the power supply, the air cylinder is inflated to extend out of a piston rod of the air cylinder and keep the first switch pressed, the alarm is powered off by closing the first switch, the air pipe is buried in the laying area and is positioned above an underground cable, one end of the air pipe is plugged and arranged, the other end of the air pipe is communicated with the interior of the air cylinder, and when the air pipe is damaged, the interior of the air cylinder can be decompressed to retract the piston rod so as to open the first switch to enable the alarm to be powered on to send out early warning. The cable anti-damage early warning device disclosed by the invention can be fully covered above the underground cable through the air pipe so as to early warn and protect the underground cable, and is low in cost and small in occupied ground space.

title_en: Port infrastructure marine environment disaster early warning platform construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early warning platform construction, and discloses a method and a system for constructing a harbour infrastructure marine environment disaster early warning platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the current time point, the current position and the current speed of typhoons, and the air density and the gravity acceleration of the height of the typhoons; the method comprises the steps of constructing a motion equation, calculating the speed of typhoon at the next time point, calculating the adjacent value between the current time point and the next time point of typhoon, updating the position and the speed between the current time point and the next time point of typhoon occurrence to obtain an updated position and an updated speed to obtain a typhoon path, calculating the typhoon wave height according to the typhoon path and typhoon intensity, and more accurately reflecting the actual movement condition of typhoon by updating the typhoon path in real time, so that the fine change of the typhoon path can be captured, real-time monitoring is realized, and strong data support is provided for construction of an early warning platform.

title_en: Edge notification-based method and apparatus for real-time fleet communication through crowd sourcing
abstract_en: An apparatus, method and system of an edge server that communicates with vehicles by continuously receiving messages including data of state transitions of Electronic Control Units (ECUs) included in each vehicle; monitoring flow message data from each vehicle in real time to detect data updates regarding state transitions of the ECU used in vehicle operation; real-time crowdsourcing data of state transitions of the ECU during vehicle operation to combine state transition data having versatility together as crowdsourcing transition data; processing the crowd-sourced conversion data using a machine learning model to classify the crowd-sourced conversion data for the abnormal event; and pre-sending an alert of the abnormal event to the identified vehicle for the driver or ADAS to perform a response.

title_en: Safety monitoring information update system
abstract_en: Required cost when being updated to reduce to the safety protection warning display device for being publicized and being warned using LCDs, and the reliability of safety protection warning information updating is improved, the invention provides a kind of safety monitoring information update system, including：Safety protection warning information is distributed to multiple movable mechanicals, the multiple movable mechanical sends safety protection warning information to the safety protection warning display device with LCDs, and makes safety protection warning display device update and show safety protection warning information.The present invention can be by using the renewal of the greatly convenient safety protection warning information of the inspection mechanically moving such as vehicle or private vehicle, manpower and safety protection warning O＆M cost are saved, and improves the promptness and reliability of safety protection warning information updating under the particular surroundings such as field or Forest Park.

title_en: Dynamic elastic power supply recovery method and system for urban power system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic elastic power supply recovery method of an urban power system under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps that a V2G system performs an operation period and collects road network EV traffic data during disaster early warning; providing electric energy support for the urban power grid by adopting EV resources at a temporary V2G interaction station in the disaster, and dispatching maintenance teams according to traffic data to carry out rush repair operation on a fault line; the maintenance team updates the rush-repair scheme in real time by adopting an optimized scheduling method considering the V2G data and repairs the next fault equipment; repeating the steps until all the fault devices are salvaged. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the dynamic elastic power supply recovery method of the urban power system under typhoon disasters. The invention is beneficial to realizing the quick recovery of the post-disaster system and improving the elasticity of the system; the invention has high reliability, good accuracy and higher efficiency.

title_en: TDMA time slot allocation method for underground and underwater wireless Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-overhead TDMA time slot allocation method for underground and underwater wireless Internet of things, which mainly solves the problems of overlong time of time slot allocation process and larger allocation overhead in the underground severe environment in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of constructing an underground Internet of things network model, enabling sensor nodes to establish a self time slot table, a one-hop node table and a same-layer two-hop node table to finish initialization of each table item, enabling all nodes to update own hop count information through interaction of time slot frames, establishing a network layered structure to finish update of related table items, enabling the sensor nodes to select a time slot group to which the sensor nodes belong according to hop count values, enabling a first layer node to uniformly assign a sending time slot by a data aggregation node, enabling the first layer node not to participate in a time slot distribution process, enabling other layer nodes to mutually send time slot frames to negotiate application sending time slots. The method improves the transmission reliability of the underground wireless internet of things, reduces the additional communication overhead and reduces the network energy consumption, and can be used for underground environment monitoring, pipeline facility monitoring and disaster early warning.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning index correction method under non-stationary condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning index correction method under a non-steady condition, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting rainfall, river water level and branch inflow port water flow movement data in real time and preprocessing; step three, further calculating a hydrologic state model, predicting whether tributaries impact a bank, updating the threshold and early warning if impact, otherwise, returning to the step two. The invention adopts the ultrasonic sensor and the electromagnetic flow velocity meter to collect multiple data, models the prediction jacking effect, dynamically updates the critical rainfall, avoids the adaptation failure of the traditional fixed threshold value, prevents the aggravation of disasters caused by early warning lag, disassembles water flow data and partition differentiation weighting, improves hydrologic evaluation accuracy, combines data preprocessing, and provides reliable support for mountain torrent early warning and flood control decision under non-steady conditions.

title_en: Local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-source geological data; the method comprises the steps of extracting 3-5Hz soil body frequency domain characteristics through wavelet packet decomposition, fusing DEM and historical liquefaction thermodynamic diagram to divide a deposition phase control unit, adopting a Bayesian constrained improved Kriging algorithm to generate a three-dimensional voxel model, combining real-time vibration main frequency offset to construct four-dimensional space-time tensors, inputting the tensors into a local self-adaptive graph rolling network, dynamically adjusting convolution kernel weights through a space-time attention mechanism, synchronously outputting a prediction result, triggering increment learning based on MEMS acceleration and FBG strain data, correcting unliquefaction area prediction values and feeding back to the voxel model, and finally generating a probability disaster chain scene tree through space pattern matching. The invention solves the technical bottleneck that the traditional model has poor adaptability in complex deposition environment and can not be updated in real time, and provides intelligent early warning support for the engineering safety of the earthquake active region.

title_en: Marine information early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine information early warning method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ocean data acquired in real time by the shipborne equipment through a communication unit; performing data processing on ocean data based on a preset data processing algorithm to obtain data keywords; based on the data keywords and the real-time prediction model, obtaining a prediction rule matched with the data keywords; the real-time prediction model is updated in real time based on the data collected by each channel; generating target early warning information according to the prediction rules and the ocean data; and sending the target early warning information to the on-board equipment. The invention can improve the accuracy of the early warning information.

title_en: Method for providing low power IoT communication based geofencing services based on context aware information of location tracking devices
abstract_en: A method of providing low power IoT communication based geofence services based on situational identification information for location tracking devices, comprising: allowing a situational analysis engine of the location tracking device to measure situational identifying information obtained from peripheral sensors capable of accepting signals from the periphery, such as the user's heart rate, body temperature, and movement status; determining whether the detected condition is an emergency condition or a normal condition based on condition identifying information measured by a condition analysis engine of the location tracking device; transmitting an emergency notification message and the detected location tracking data to a server through a low power IoT communication method when the situation is an emergency situation; selecting a module capable of stably tracking a location among Global Positioning System (GPS), WIFI sniffing, bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and Ultra Wideband (UWB) modules of a location tracking device for location tracking after transmitting an emergency notification message; measuring mobile location information of a location tracking device user using the selected location tracking module; checking whether the measured mobile location information and situation recognition information are obtained from a peripheral sensor capable of receiving signals from the periphery, for example, the heart rate and body temperature of the user can be transmitted by being converted through real-time communication; if the transmission can be performed through real-time communication, the situation identification information can be transmitted to the server through real-time communication at a higher data rate than usual and at frequent transmission cycles; receiving an emergency cancel message from the server manager based on the mobile location information and the situation identification information; an emergency cancellation message is received and then transmitted to a server, situation identification information is obtained from peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from a location tracking device user periphery, such as heart rate, body temperature, and mobility status, and the situation identification information is converted by low power IoT communication at a reduced transmission period and lower data rate compared to an emergency.

title_en: Disaster early warning system and method based on gateway equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning system based on gateway equipment, which comprises a disaster early warning issuing system front end: the system comprises a sub-control center of a disaster early warning release system or a private early warning system which can be accessed by a network in a certain area; information table update server: the disaster early warning issuing system is used for issuing the front-end information table of the disaster early warning issuing system after digital signature and providing information table updating service for gateway equipment; the Web server: a server providing a web service through HTTP/HTTPs; gateway device: the network access equipment is used for enabling a user to access the Internet through the gateway equipment in daily life; and (5) surfing equipment: any device capable of accessing the Internet can be used by a user for web browsing and video playing operations; the invention also discloses a disaster early warning method based on the gateway equipment, which has great significance for disaster early warning and has extremely high advancement and application popularization value.

title_en: Ocean disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of marine disaster monitoring and early warning. A marine disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data comprises a multi-source data fusion module, an intelligent modeling module and a real-time early warning module, wherein the method comprises the steps of cleaning and storing multi-source data after wavelet transformation downsampling through edge computing nodes, extracting space-time characteristics through a space-time transducer network, calibrating predicted values through a Coriolis force correction equation to generate future 24-hour disaster risk probability and tide level and wind speed key parameters, triggering hierarchical early warning based on a dynamic risk map, and pushing through a mobile network, emergency broadcasting and other multi-channel seconds. The method reduces the tide level prediction error to less than or equal to 0.2 meter, and effectively solves the problems of high false alarm rate and update hysteresis of the traditional system due to early warning response delay of <10 seconds.

title_en: Lithium battery energy storage management system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery energy storage management system and a method thereof, which relate to the technical field of lithium battery management and comprise a cloud service platform, an EMS energy management module, a BMS battery management module, a converter, a fire control management module, a temperature control module, a warning module and an intelligent terminal. According to the invention, the lithium battery for fire protection is reserved every day, the lithium battery for fire protection is exchanged every day, and two groups of lithium batteries for fire protection are reserved every day; the position of the lithium battery for fire protection is ensured to be randomly updated every day, the lithium battery for fire protection also participates in normal charge and discharge work, the running state of the lithium battery for fire protection can be mastered in time, and the situation that the lithium battery for fire protection is full of or is in a non-electric state is avoided; the design space distance of the fire-fighting standby lithium battery ensures that the lithium battery is damaged in any direction, and at least one group of fire-fighting standby lithium batteries are available.

title_en: Encryption traffic safety detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for detecting the safety of encrypted traffic, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting and classifying the traffic of the network equipment, storing a TLS/SSL handshake protocol data packet in HTTPS traffic, extracting IP and domain name in the handshake protocol data packet, storing a TLS/SSL certificate, extracting basic information of the certificate, and calculating and acquiring an MD5 value of the TLS/SSL certificate; the MD5 value of the TLS/SSL certificate is matched with the MD5 values in the MD5 library of the malicious certificate and the MD5 library of the legal certificate, and the TLS/SSL certificate is subjected to static analysis; responding to the determination that the MD5 value of the TLS/SSL certificate is different from the MD5 value in a malicious certificate MD5 library or a legal certificate MD5 library, and the TLS/SSL certificate is a certificate which is not self-issued and is in the validity period, preprocessing the TLS/SSL certificate and mapping the TLS/SSL certificate into a picture to obtain a TLS/SSL certificate image; and detecting and classifying the TLS/SSL certificate portrait by a deep learning detection model, identifying a malicious TLS/SSL certificate and generating potential safety hazards and threat early warning.

title_en: Urban waterlogging prevention and control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for preventing and treating urban waterlogging, which are applied to the technical field of rainwater systems. Inverting the global liquid level and flow of a rainwater system pipe network, generating a ground flooding water depth map and a binary flood flooding map at monitoring time, performing rationality check on the global liquid level and ground flooding water depth map and the binary flood flooding map of the rainwater system pipe network, performing fusion processing based on hydraulic connection between a one-dimensional (1D) node and a two-dimensional (2D) ground to obtain a label, generating a new dataset according to the label and forecast rainfall, mixing the historical dataset with the new dataset to obtain a mixed dataset, updating parameters of a urban flooding prediction model, predicting urban flooding by using the model with updated parameters, determining urban flooding early warning grades according to a prediction result, generating a drainage scheme, regulating corresponding drainage facilities according to the scheme, and improving urban flooding prevention and control effects.

title_en: Energy-saving tunnel safety lighting control system and intelligent dimming control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving tunnel safety lighting control system and an intelligent dimming control method thereof, and belongs to the field of traffic lighting. According to the invention, the moving object at the entrance of the tunnel is remotely detected and collected and transmitted to the central control unit in real time so as to control the lighting unit in the tunnel to be turned on and off, so that the energy loss can be effectively reduced, and the purpose of energy saving is realized; simultaneously, the scene detection unit is utilized to update the scene in the middle section of the tunnel in real time, if accidents or disasters occur, the scene is timely transmitted to an early warning module outside the tunnel through the central control unit to play a role in prompting, and the traffic safety of the tunnel can be effectively ensured.

title_en: A kind of indoor emergency response context aware navigationsystem and navigation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of indoor emergency response context aware navigationsystem and navigation method. Described navigationsystem at least comprises positioned sensor network, server and early warning sensor, and described positioned sensor network is by the locating base station of the wired or wireless connection of same server, form with the mobile terminal of locating base station wireless connections and/or positioning label and the LED screen with locating base station wired connection; Described early warning sensor is with server wireless connections. The multiple context of described navigation methods combining indoor environment calculates guidance path, and sight residing for user presents guidance path to user in several ways adaptively, it is provided that real-time, accurate, personalized navigation Service. The present invention can be used for large complicated indoor venue personnel positioning, emergency evacuation, Post disaster relief, the security control such as hospital, market, office building, station etc., it is possible to the science of raising public place emergency response disposal, promptness, validity.

title_en: Electric power operation environment monitoring system, method and equipment based on AI identification
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an electric power operation environment monitoring system, an electric power operation environment monitoring method and electric power operation environment monitoring equipment based on AI (automatic identification) recognition. This electric power operation environment monitoring system based on AI discernment gathers the three-dimensional data of electric power operation in real time based on data acquisition unit, calculate the space distance between obtain power equipment and the human body according to three-dimensional data through distance calculation unit, judge whether the space distance exceeds the distance threshold value through early warning suggestion unit and send the early warning at last, realize the monitoring to electric power operation environment, this monitoring mode does not need artifical the participation, response is ageing fast, also can in time discover the hidden danger of electric power operation, avoid causing the incident, the existence manual check of current electric power operation environment monitoring has been solved, response timeliness and management and control validity can't obtain the technical problem of guarantee.

title_en: Coal mine environment safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine environment safety monitoring system and a method, wherein environment information acquisition terminals are arranged at different monitoring positions, and a user terminal server is used for preprocessing, so that the analysis and recognition accuracy of the safety level corresponding to the environment information is improved, the environment information exceeding the limit of the preset safety level is selectively selected and transmitted to a host server at an upper level, the monitoring workload is reasonably distributed, and the processing problem caused by excessive data is reduced. And simultaneously, the main server is utilized to store and analyze the environment information exceeding the limit of the preset security level, the security level matched with the environment information and the personnel position identity information, and the environment information is processed into the three-dimensional space security information updated according to the monitoring period. By using the system and the method, the underground safety problem of the coal mine can be effectively monitored, accurate and timely automatic informatization prediction and early warning are realized, and effective help is provided for processing safety accidents.

title_en: A kind of weighting markov landslide method for early warning based on mean-standard deviation
abstract_en: A kind of weighting markov landslide method for early warning based on average value standard deviation, belongs to landslide disaster forecasting and warning field；This method includes：Landslide monitoring point velocity of displacement is collected, forms velocity of displacement set；Each affiliated state of velocity of displacement in velocity of displacement set is determined using average value standard deviation method, and build velocity of displacement status switch；Use weighted Markov chain predictive displacement speed next day predicted state；Landslide early warning is carried out to judge；Update velocity of displacement set；Landslide early warning result is evaluated；The stochastic behaviour of displacement parameter that the present invention is obtained from the evolution process of landslide, based on Markov chain theory, integrated use Landslide Evolution three-stage theory and average value standard deviation classification have surmounted understanding of the previous engineering circles to early warning of coming down；Specific prealarming process is given, available for the landslide early warning from displacement monitoring data Angle.

title_en: A kind of emergency maintenance based on target following and renewal integral system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency maintenance based on target following with update integral system and method, include speedily carrying out rescue work, patrol and examine, safeguard mobile terminal and speedily carry out rescue work accordingly, send work, statistical analysiss, the early warning service system integrated with data renewal；The method passes through 1）To mobile object（Including vehicle, personnel）Dynamic tracking, speedily carries out rescue work, patrols and examines, dynamically the reporting of maintenance task, and 2）The generation of job order, distribution, transmission, 3）The automatic classification of work order performance, 4）O＆M business datum according to patrolling and examining, keeping in repair, speedily carry out rescue work generation dynamically updates pipeline facility data base, and 5）Data updates the integrated management with business such as statistical report form generations, the potential safety hazard of facility can be eliminated in time, strengthen its security reliability, improve the Up-to-date state of basic data and the Ability of emergency management of pipe network facilities rescue and relief work, and then improve corresponding enterprise labor efficiency, and enterprise management level.

title_en: Multi-parameter internet of things monitoring system and method for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter internet of things monitoring system and method for a power transmission line, wherein the system comprises a three-dimensional model construction module, an error factor generation module and an early warning and inspection module; the three-dimensional model construction module acquires parameters to construct a three-dimensional model and judges whether the distance between the tower and the reference table is deviated or not, so that the tower is in a settlement state; the error factor generation module acquires local topography and weather factors, establishes a distance vector according to the distance between the tower and the reference table, and analyzes whether the local topography and the weather factors are the reasons for causing the offset distance, so as to update the distance vector; the early warning and inspection module acquires a distance vector when the history is affected by weather, compares the distance vector stored in the history with the updated distance vector, and analyzes whether the tower can generate large-scale settlement and early warning; therefore, the problem that the tower is not overhauled due to the fact that the sudden sedimentation of the tower is greatly prevented.

title_en: Oil vapor treatment station intelligent early-warning system based on Internet of Things sensing data
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of oil vapor treatment station intelligent early-warning system based on Internet of Things sensing data, including：Sampling instrument, real-time data base, data memory module, early warning rule settings module, state recognition module, modes of warning selecting module, early warning expert knowledge library, direct Reason-Machine, warning module, correcting module, early warning logging modle and update module.Oil vapor treatment station intelligent early-warning system provided by the invention based on Internet of Things sensing data, can effectively solve current oil vapor treatment station DCS and manually observe monitoring parameters or instrument instruction, micro-judgment runs the problem of health status, available for auxiliary DCS control systems, it is set to understand production status much sooner, note abnormalities, know hidden danger and corresponding treatment measures, grasp the adjustment direction of output and quality.

title_en: Earthquake data information release system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic data information release system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of seismic data processing. According to the earthquake data information release system and the storage medium, users can be divided into multiple release object grades from near to far by taking a seismic source as a center, so that the earthquake release sequence can release notifications according to the release object grades, the user closest to the seismic source can acquire earthquake early warning notification information in the shortest time, important users who really need to withdraw from danger can be locked to a great extent through the earthquake release notification, meanwhile, the earthquake early warning notification can be carried out on users who have access to the earthquake range or live in the earthquake range and are registered as non-earthquake ranges, the pertinence of the earthquake release is stronger, and the earthquake release is more comprehensive.

title_en: Dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and dynamic early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and dynamic early warning system, which particularly relates to the technical field of industrial safety monitoring, and is used for solving the monitoring failure problem caused by signal interference or cancellation in a mixed leakage scene of various dangerous chemicals in the prior art, acquiring multisource monitoring data such as gas concentration and temperature in real time through a data acquisition module, detecting reverse fluctuation characteristics of sensor data by a conflict recognition module, reversely positioning a leakage source and verifying path shielding interference by a leakage verification module based on production pipe network topology and real-time flow data, analyzing signal cancellation characteristics of a dangerous chemical combination and verifying matching performance of a diffusion path and sensor layout by a materialization analysis module after physical shielding is eliminated, dynamically correcting the monitoring data by a dynamic compensation module according to a materialization reaction mechanism, generating a mixed leakage risk level and triggering a grading emergency response instruction by a risk assessment module, and realizing accurate recognition and dynamic early warning of the mixed leakage risk.

title_en: Method and system for emergency notification
abstract_en: Method and apparatus for notifying an emergency responder of a vehicle emergency. Communication is established with a cellular telephone located within the vehicle. The communication link is monitored and the vehicle occupant is notified of link loss. The apparatus monitors vehicle safety systems for detection of an emergency condition. Upon detection, the occupant is notified that an emergency call will be made. If no cancellation is received, vehicle location information is obtained from a global position system, synthesized into voice signals, and communicated to an emergency responder using the cellular telephone. A plurality of occupant and vehicle emergency information may also be provided. Emergency responders may be provided with a touch tone menu to select among the available information. Vehicle and occupant information may be communicated to the apparatus from external sources, such as a web server database via cellular telephone connection, or removable memory.

title_en: Geological environment and monitoring information management method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological environment and monitoring information management method, which comprises the following steps of obtaining investigation and detection information of new hidden danger points; executing hidden danger point judgment operation, and screening and inputting newly added hidden danger points according to investigation detection information of the new hidden danger points; inputting newly-added hidden danger points and integrating the hidden danger points with survey detection information of original hidden danger points to generate hidden danger point information and form a hidden danger point distribution map; determining hidden danger points needing to be processed, determining a processing scheme of the hidden danger points according to the hidden danger point information, and performing monitoring operation on the hidden danger points which are not processed temporarily; acquiring reporting information when acquiring early warning information corresponding to newly increased hidden danger points which are not processed temporarily, importing the reporting information to a hidden danger point distribution map, and determining an emergency processing scheme according to the hidden danger point distribution map after importing the reporting information; and collecting and determining the processing result of the hidden danger point, and verifying and canceling or re-inputting the information of the hidden danger point. The method has the effects of dynamically monitoring the geological environment and orderly managing the geological hidden danger points.

title_en: Flood inundation range prediction method, flood inundation range prediction system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation range prediction method, a flood inundation range prediction system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of determining a new basic flooding range according to a real-time SAR image and water surface fluctuation data when the new real-time SAR image is acquired, determining a current real-time water volume according to the new basic flooding range and a terrain digital elevation model, determining an actual water volume increment according to the current real-time water volume and a previous real-time water volume, updating a dynamic coefficient according to the actual water volume increment and the precipitation in a revisit period, determining a predicted water volume increment according to the acquired predicted precipitation volume and the updated dynamic coefficient, and determining a flood flooding prediction range according to the predicted water volume increment and the terrain digital elevation model by taking the new basic flooding range as an initial flooding range. The evolution of the flood inundation range can be predicted in time in the revisit period, the timeliness and the accuracy of prediction are considered, and early warning is carried out on a disaster-stricken area in advance.

title_en: Visual fire data monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual fire data monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a monitoring module and a data pushing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring basic information of fire-fighting equipment and is configured to monitor equipment states of the fire-fighting equipment installed in a corridor to acquire monitoring data, the preprocessing module is used for classifying and preprocessing the basic information and carrying out distortion preprocessing on the monitoring data, the monitoring module is used for judging whether the states of the fire-fighting equipment installed in the corridor change according to the monitoring data, if so, the visualization module is triggered to execute alarm operation, the visualization module is configured to construct an equipment layout according to the basic information, respond to the alarm operation of the monitoring module and update the equipment layout and generate alarm information, and the data pushing module is used for sending the equipment layout and the alarm information to terminal equipment. The invention solves the problem that fire-fighting equipment cannot be used normally because early warning cannot be performed when the fire-fighting equipment is moved or shielded.

title_en: Remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method. According to the invention, the accuracy of geological risk prediction is improved by analyzing various geological features, the understanding of soil erosion mechanism and landslide risk is improved by simulating water-soil interaction, the effectiveness of disaster early warning is optimized, the identification capacity of landslide areas is enhanced by comparing with historical data patterns, the disaster spatial association information is analyzed, the disaster diffusion trend prediction and risk level adjustment are optimized, the dynamic update of real-time disaster risk assessment and disaster risk monitoring is combined, the timeliness and accuracy of early warning information are improved, and comprehensive technical support is provided for geological disaster early warning.

title_en: Urban waterlogging monitoring platform real-time waterlogging early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and particularly relates to a real-time waterlogging early warning method of an urban waterlogging monitoring platform based on deep learning, comprising the following steps of S1, acquiring live video stream data of a camera from a video platform; the method comprises the steps of S2, capturing pictures from live video stream data of a camera to construct a waterlogging identification data set, S3, creating a deep neural network model based on MobileNetV and loading model weights, S4, configuring an SGD optimizer and a learning rate scheduling function in a training process so as to update parameters and adjust the learning rate when the deep neural network model is trained, and S5, training the deep neural network model in a freezing stage. According to the invention, by adopting a deep learning-based method and taking MobileNetV as a basic model, the urban waterlogging is monitored rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Grating displacement testing system and method based on ten-axis sensor
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a grating displacement testing system and method based on a ten-axis sensor, comprising the following steps: the ten-axis sensor chip is embedded in the geogrid; the ten-axis sensor chip collects various data information of the monitoring point and uploads the data information to the management monitoring cloud platform; the management monitoring cloud platform obtains the change of the deformation and displacement of the geogrid of the monitoring point through comprehensive analysis according to the collected data information, performs error correction processing on the data information, reduces the data error rate and improves the data integrity rate; the management monitoring cloud platform synchronously updates data information acquired by the ten-axis sensor chip and an analysis result to the monitoring database server; the remote monitoring center extracts data in the monitoring database server, obtains the width of cracks generated by the whole structure of the geogrid and the extending trend thereof after further processing, monitors the damage trend of the whole geogrid in real time, and finally realizes automatic monitoring and geological disaster early warning of the whole state of the geogrid.

title_en: Indication and transmission method for system message update of earthquake and tsunami early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indication and transmission method for updating system messages of an earthquake and tsunami warning system ETWS; the indication method comprises the following steps: when the ETWS secondary notification message is updated, the base station indicates the updating of the ETWS secondary notification message in the paging message by the paging identifier outside the existence field of the primary notification message of the earthquake and tsunami warning system. Through the technical scheme provided by the invention, the terminal can distinguish the update of the main notification message of the ETWS and the secondary notification message of the ETWS.

title_en: Stress behavior monitoring system and method for armored steel wire of marine flexible riser
abstract_en: A stress behavior monitoring system and method for an armored steel wire of a marine flexible riser belong to the field of marine riser monitoring. The system comprises a monitoring module, a transmission module, a control processing module and an early warning module which are connected in sequence. The monitoring module acquires signal source information of the ship body and the vertical pipe, the signal source information is transmitted to the control processing module through the transmission module, a preset system early warning threshold value is further generated, the corrected system threshold value is updated and generated according to the signal source information, the maximum stress value of the armored steel wire is calculated, whether the maximum stress value exceeds the early warning threshold value is judged, and the judgment result is transmitted to the early warning module. And transmitting the obtained maximum stress value and position of the armored steel wire of the vertical pipe at any moment to an early warning module, and carrying out early warning if the maximum stress value and position exceeds a threshold value. The real-time monitoring of the stress safety of the vertical pipe is realized by indirectly measuring the signal source information of the ship body and the vertical pipe, the technical paths are integrated together, the realization is convenient, and the safety of the catenary type vertical pipe and the lazy type vertical pipe in the service process is greatly improved.

title_en: Dynamic disaster method for early warning based on roadway surrounding rock rupture via hole monitoring
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of dynamic disaster method for early warning based on roadway surrounding rock rupture via hole monitoring, belongs to mining engineering, the monitoring of Geotechnical Engineering dynamic disaster and early warning technology field.Dynamic disaster is bred the roadway surrounding rock rupture process in evolutionary process by laying via hole and is revealed in via hole periphery by this method, useful signal decay is reduced by way of laying monitoring holes and sensor is installed in monitoring holes to disturb with construction noise, via hole hole wall country rock micro rupture state is directly monitored, dynamic disaster is monitored in real time.Instant invention overcomes drilling cuttings method (being directed to coal mine rock burst early warning) it is cumbersome, can not monitor in real time and acoustic-emission useful signal is weak, noise jamming causes monitoring result to owe the defects of accurate by force, improve mining engineering, the security and validity of the monitoring of Geotechnical Engineering dynamic disaster.

title_en: Indoor multifunctional disaster prevention early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor multifunctional disaster prevention early warning device, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention early warning equipment. Including the equipment shell, wherein the fixed shell support that is provided with of equipment shell upside, be provided with the driver in the equipment shell, the driver both sides are connected with the drive wheel, the drive wheel is located the equipment shell outside, still be provided with the subassembly and the transport subassembly of soaking in the equipment shell, the subassembly that soaks is connected with the driver, be provided with the early warning subassembly on the shell support, be provided with thermal imaging system on the equipment shell to and temperature detector, be provided with smoke detector in the front side of shell support. The invention can carry out inspection, determine the goods with abnormal temperature in the current warehouse through the functions of the thermal imaging system, the temperature detector and the like, withdraw the goods to an open area, send a signal to the monitoring end to alarm, and carry the goods and prevent the equipment from being soaked in water.

title_en: Satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a temporary special satellite communication link, conducting parameter optimization on the temporary special satellite communication link to obtain an optimized communication link, conducting three-dimensional reconstruction on site environment, analyzing severity description of illness state, predicting illness state development to generate illness state prediction results, conducting optimization processing on distribution strategies of special medical materials by considering factors of weather change and ocean current direction to obtain an optimal distribution path plan, conducting pattern recognition and trend prediction to generate potential risk early warning to form updated medical requirements, and reevaluating and optimizing the optimal distribution path plan to generate the updated optimal distribution path plan. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the efficiency and accuracy of the response of the offshore emergency, and ensures that medical materials can be timely and accurately delivered to the emergency site.

title_en: Venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance, which relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control management and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a venue building based on BIM and Internet of things, and constructing a fire monitoring model by using the digital twin model and fire emergency event instance data; acquiring real-time multi-source security data through fire control equipment of a venue building to perform fire detection and early warning, determining fire scene dynamic parameters to update a fire monitoring model, and acquiring fire dynamic characteristics of different venue building areas; and acquiring key factors influencing evacuation efficiency, planning evacuation paths by combining an improved mouse swarm algorithm, and visually displaying the optimal evacuation paths of different venue building areas according to a preset mode. According to the invention, evacuation path planning and overall monitoring and management of fire safety of a venue are dynamically performed in real time according to the development situation of a fire disaster, so that loss in emergency situations such as the fire disaster is reduced.

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.

title_en: Powerline ice-covering early warning system based on video surveillance
abstract_en: It is specially the powerline ice-covering early warning system based on video surveillance the present invention relates to powerline ice-covering early warning system, the problem of solving shortage powerline ice-covering early warning system at present, technical scheme is：Including video acquisition module, image processing and analyzing module, data memory module and status display warning module；Video acquisition module includes multiple cameras and wireless data transmission chip, and camera is connected with wireless data transmission chip；Image processing and analyzing module includes Wireless data receiving device and PC, and Wireless data receiving device is connected with PC；Data memory module includes CPU and storage device；Status display warning module includes sound prior-warning device, and light prior-warning device；The PC of image processing and analyzing module is connected with data memory module, and data memory module is connected with status display warning module.Advantage：1st, without manual inspection, the generation of work safety accident is reduced；2nd, it is real-time；3rd, it is scalable to update；4th, fault-tolerance is strong.

title_en: Flood early warning simulation method based on dynamic self-adaptive differential algorithm
