abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood early warning simulation method based on a dynamic self-adaptive differential algorithm, which comprises the steps of simulating a flood process based on a flood inundation model in a target time step, obtaining real-time water flow data and terrain elevation model data of a target area, determining a spreading state coefficient of the flood according to the flow rate of the flood and the interval distance between the target area and a block dike opening, clustering the terrain elevation model data to obtain a first clustering result, determining a stagnation area in a preset area according to the first clustering result, updating the target time step according to the area and the spreading state coefficient of the stagnation area to obtain an updated target time step, simulating the flood process by taking the updated target time step as the target time step of the next moment, and determining to send out early warning in response to the fact that the simulation result of the flood process reaches preset early warning conditions. The invention updates the time step of the model and solves the problem of unbalanced simulation precision and efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent mine water disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and method for mine water damage, and relates to the technical field of mine water damage monitoring. The early warning method comprises water inrush risk early warning, well flooding risk early warning and water environment risk early warning, wherein the water inrush risk early warning is used for processing water inrush time sequence data through a sliding window, three-level water inrush risk early warning is excited continuously for three times in an abnormal mode, the water inrush quantity can be updated and predicted, the well flooding risk early warning is used for setting three-level thresholds based on the double ratio of water inrush quantity to water drainage capacity and water sump volume, the water environment risk early warning is used for monitoring water quality according to national standards, and early warning is carried out according to pollution risk indexes in three levels. The early warning system comprises a monitoring unit, a data management unit, a water damage early warning unit and a visualization unit. According to the invention, through multi-parameter collaborative monitoring, intelligent analysis and expert judgment, the accuracy, timeliness and intelligent level of water damage early warning can be obviously improved.

title_en: Equipment network access management method in network scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device network access management method under a network scene, when an access terminal is connected with a network, a device network access management system divides the current network scene into a plurality of departments, and the device network access management system sends corresponding device information to a monitoring unit, the invention has the advantages that: the network topology map and the organization architecture map can be updated according to the marking sequence of the IP address of the appointed access terminal by the setting analysis unit, and the updated network topology map and the updated organization architecture map are stored in the map library of the storage unit after being marked with the updating time; early warning information is sent out according to the specific type and the access target of the access terminal to the strange access terminal, so that potential safety hazards are eliminated in time, and meanwhile, the permission setting can be carried out on a new access terminal, so that the requirements of adding and deleting access equipment or adjusting the permission of the accessed terminal by current enterprises are met.

title_en: System for having access to flood-prevention early warning service based on Android tablet terminal and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for having access to a flood-prevention early warning cloud service based on an Android tablet terminal and a construction method. The construction method includes the steps of real-time data acquiring of the flood-prevention early warning cloud service, early warning rule management and setting, early warning analysis, early warning information pushing and message noticing and data acquiring, storage and display of a flood-prevention early warning client side system of the Android tablet terminal. Rain condition, water condition, weather, dangerous circumference situation and disaster situation system service interfaces and other system service interfaces are packaged by the flood-prevention early warning cloud services to acquire real-time data, early warning service modules are partitioned according to flood-prevention work needs, corresponding early warning rules are made, data format content is formed, real-time information is analyzed accordingly, and early warning information is pushed to the tablet terminal; message notice pushed by the flood-prevention early warning cloud services is monitored based on the flood-prevention early warning client side system of the Android tablet terminal, latest early warning information data are downloaded from the cloud services or early warning information is acquired in an active request mode and is classified, updated and displayed according to different early warning modules.

title_en: Internet of things monitoring equipment with meteorological early warning function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of internet of things monitoring, in particular to internet of things monitoring equipment with a weather early warning function, which aims at the problems that when the current weather monitoring is used, a wind force sensor is subjected to external unexpected conditions, such as sand storm or typhoon unexpected conditions, and the wind force sensor is easy to break and cannot protect, and meanwhile, the use is not flexible enough. When the invention encounters strong wind, the blocking cylinder is automatically controlled to move upwards and protect the weather early warning monitor, the height of the weather early warning monitor can be conveniently adjusted, the roller can be conveniently retracted and released, and the use is flexible.

title_en: Dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method, and belongs to the technical field of gas monitoring. In order to solve the problems that the lack of an effective early warning and response mechanism and the incapability of providing effective evacuation guidance in emergency result in personnel evacuation confusion and panic, a real-time monitoring module compares the concentration of dangerous gas with a preset safety threshold value, once the dangerous gas is found to leak, dangerous marks can be immediately carried out, an alarm is triggered through the dangerous early warning module, the timely early warning and response mechanism is helpful for reducing the possibility of accidents, the evacuation guidance module can simulate the layout of a monitoring area, forecast the trend and range of dangerous gas diffusion, plan a safe evacuation route based on the forecast result, provide scientific basis for personnel evacuation in emergency, help reduce personnel casualties, and the system can adjust and update the evacuation route in real time by continuously receiving data in a gas diffusion forecast unit so as to adapt to the continuously-changed dangerous situation.

title_en: Virtual battlefield scene simulation system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual battlefield scene simulation system and a method thereof, in particular to the technical field of scene simulation, which are characterized in that various information in the scene tree updating process, including data loading information, event triggering information and hardware platform performance information, are acquired, abnormal conditions in the updating process are perceived in time, an updating hidden danger analysis model is established according to the acquired various information, and the updating hidden danger of the scene tree is evaluated by comprehensively analyzing factors such as data loading speed, event triggering response and hardware performance, so that whether the updating hidden danger exists in the scene tree is judged more accurately, abnormal virtual battlefield scene images caused by the abnormal conditions in the updating process are avoided, and the real-time monitoring and judgment of the scene tree updating process is realized. And classifying and early warning the update states of the scene tree according to different update state signals, and timely adjusting the update strategy to ensure the stability and fluency of the virtual battlefield scene.

title_en: code detection method and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of code detection method and device, including：For each test environment, if receiving the code of user's submission, the submission list of the code under the test environment is generated, the submission is single to include the mark of each file and version number in the code；According to each submission list under each test environment, the code to be measured submitted to user under environment to be measured detects, and is handled accordingly according to testing result.By code detection method provided by the invention and device, based on the submission list of each code under each test environment, detected according to different testing conditions, find out the various hidden danger in test process in time and alert, so as to effectively improve the efficiency and reliability of test.

title_en: Network security monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security monitoring system, which comprises an acquisition unit, a component unit and a monitoring protection unit, wherein the acquisition unit comprises a data updating module and a data processing module, wherein the data updating module is used for downloading updated security protection codes and firewall codes in a network, and the data processing module is used for processing data downloaded by the data updating module; the component module comprises a data building module for receiving the primarily processed data output by the data processing module, and the data building module is used for building the received data into a network framework; by the design of the invention, multi-point early warning monitoring can be carried out in network security, security problems occur, the position of a fault can be timely and accurately reflected, automatic virus killing and firewall construction can be simultaneously carried out, the security problems are rapidly solved, the protection module can be updated in real time through the designed updating module, and special protection codes can be input, so that the overall security is improved.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting emergent evacuation method and system
abstract_en: Intelligent fire-fighting emergent evacuation method comprises the following steps：A, control system establishes visualization emergency escape model；B, when a disaster occurs, control system inputs disaster alarm signal in emergency escape model；C, control system calculates and stored each node to the most short best-effort path of extra exit, while sets the evacuation direction of each node in most short best-effort path；D, control system designer's evacuation direction in each passage of the most short best-effort path of emergency escape model；E, control system controls the switch of each escape and evacuation instruction equipment and direction to indicate according to each passage evacuation direction of most short best-effort path in emergency escape model.Present invention also offers a kind of system for realizing the above method.The most short emergency evacuation best-effort path of the present invention is according to live the condition of a disaster Automatic generation of information, the personnel when the condition of a disaster occurs can be achieved to be withdrawn safely, quickly, in an orderly manner according to the direction indication of escape and evacuation instruction equipment, have the characteristics that evacuation efficiency is high and safe.

title_en: Earthquake alarming instrument
abstract_en: The present invention relates to earthquake pre-warning technical field, in particular to earthquake alarming instrument.This earthquake alarming instrument, including: shock detection circuit, control circuit and warning circuit；Shock detection circuit, for producing vibration signal according to the geology vibrations detected；Control circuit, for generating alarm control signal according to vibration signal；Warning circuit, is used for performing alarm control signal and carrying out earthquake alarm.This earthquake alarming instrument that the present invention provides, utilize the progressive time of earthquake, when earthquake tentatively occurs, shock detection electric circuit inspection in earthquake alarming instrument goes out vibration signal, control circuit utilizes this vibration signal to send rapidly alarm, being achieved in effective early warning of earthquake, prompting personnel withdraw rapidly when earthquake occurs, and thus reduce the loss brought because of earthquake.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing
abstract_en: A distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing is characterized in that space-time two-dimensional vibration signals are mapped into gray images, a multi-mode fusion technology is utilized, a lightweight convolutional neural network is combined to achieve efficient classification, a dynamic increment learning mechanism and a spatial propagation attenuation correction algorithm are introduced, and the problems of single characteristic representation, model update lag and insufficient positioning accuracy of a traditional method are solved. The method is suitable for the fields of perimeter security protection, pipeline monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like, and can be used for screening and target recognition of mass vibration data under complex environment interference in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of traditional time-frequency domain analysis through signal imaging characterization, obviously improves the distinguishing capability of similar events, simultaneously reduces the false alarm rate and the operation and maintenance cost by depending on a dynamic model optimization technology, effectively suppresses the influence of optical fiber attenuation on the positioning precision by combining a space correction algorithm, and provides reliable technical support for intelligent upgrading of a distributed optical fiber sensing system.

title_en: Camera potential safety hazard inspection and identification method based on video frame image segmentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camera potential safety hazard inspection and identification method based on video frame image segmentation, which belongs to the technical field of image processing, the method obtains data through a video cloud storage system and classifies the data into a basic data pool, and selecting a target video source set by combining a daily safety inspection mechanism and a special safety inspection mechanism, performing image segmentation and feature extraction by adopting a region growing algorithm and a U-Net network, and executing judgment and identification operation based on different selection mechanisms. Meanwhile, the potential safety hazard list items and the time period of easy occurrence are dynamically evaluated and updated, hidden trouble reporting records are generated, and the patrol strategy is optimized. The method can comprehensively and automatically identify potential safety hazards in the construction environment of the construction site, and improve the early warning accuracy and efficiency.

title_en: Method for forecasting real-time measurement of spatial geometrical information of coal rock dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for forecasting the real-time measurement of spatial geometrical information of a coal rock dynamic disaster, comprising the following steps of: regarding a tunnel or a working surface as an early warning centre, and dividing a monitoring region into different early warning units; carrying out real-time measurement on the early warning unit through a laser three-dimensional scanner to obtain deformation error of the coal rock spatial geometrical information in the early warning unit; transmitting the measurement values of all the early warning units to a computer center and displaying in the graphic form; judging as a high stress danger unit when the measured deformation error is more than the early warning critical value; judging as a high stress increasing unit when the deformation error increasing ratio in the time is more than the critical increasing ratio; and judging as a high stress gradient unit when two or more adjacent early warning units are increased or reduced sharply. The district that the disaster is possible to take place is analyzed according to the early warnings under different situations, much more time is provided so that an operator can withdraw and take necessary measures, and a convenient way is provided for accurately forecasting the coal rock dynamic disaster.

title_en: Power transmission line tree obstacle risk level evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating tree obstacle risk level of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting the amplitude I of tree barrier discharge pulse Measuring And frequency f Measuring (ii) a Step 2, waveform validity judgment: when the amplitude value I Measuring Exceeding the threshold value I of the discharge amplitude of the hidden danger m1 And the discharge waveform has periodic repeatability compared with power frequency, namely the discharge waveform is judged to be an effective waveform, and the discharge waveform is judged to be I of the effective waveform Measuring And f Measuring Entering a history library for storage; step 3, taking the weight coefficient k of the middle amplitude N ＝I m2 /I m Intermediate frequency weight coefficient l N ＝f 2 /f m According to formula A Measuring ＝k N I m side +α/(l N f Measuring ) For the amplitude I of the effective pulse Measuring And frequency f Measuring Calculating to obtain a calculation result A Measuring Step 4, according to the calculation result A Measuring Judging the risk level; the technical problems that the evaluation process of the power transmission line tree obstacle early warning is multiple in operation steps, large in implementation difficulty, complex and multiple in information processing, inconvenient to actual operation and the like are solved.

title_en: Meteorological prediction method, electronic device, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a weather prediction method, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The embodiment of the application can combine good fitting capability of the weather prediction model, and accurately calculate the target weather data at the target moment according to the initial weather data, thereby improving the accuracy of weather prediction. In addition, the embodiment of the application can calculate the target weather data at the target moment, and the target moment can be any moment, so that the embodiment of the application can update the target weather cloud image with higher frequency, so that the electronic equipment can control and display the latest weather cloud image, thereby improving the response speed of weather disaster early warning and alarming.

title_en: High-speed railway rainfall information gathers and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high-speed railway rainfall information collection and early warning system, including rainfall information harvester, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, for dynamically generating the device of reference threshold of rainfall calamity source, determination device that early warning program starts, positioner, for controlling the control car device of train speed, storage device and controlling device, control module is as the core of whole system, on the one hand control the operation of aforementioned each device, be on the other hand used for the external equipments such as the computer installation with outside and be attached realizing communication and control.In the present invention, reference threshold for the assessment of rainfall calamity source uses the mode dynamically generated, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after up-to-date early warning occurs, thus contrast with historical data, more completely and scientifically consider the risk Pre-Evaluation in a certain area.The present invention also provides for a kind of high-speed railway rainfall information collection and method for early warning.

title_en: Active power failure early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power failure active early warning method and device based on a Kafka message queue, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of terminal devices monitor power outage and restoration real-time messages at different nodes of a power grid and issue the power outage and restoration real-time messages to a Kafka cluster; the Kafka cluster server receives the power-off and power-on real-time message and pushes the power-off and power-on real-time message to a consumer subscribing the power-off and power-on real-time message; the dispatching automation platform subscribes to the power outage real-time message, generates an early warning power outage event and a power outage event according to the power outage real-time message, matches the early warning power outage event and the power outage event with the power outage event in the current power outage market, and if the matching is successful, combines the early warning power outage event with the matched power outage event to update the current power outage market; or deleting the power failure event corresponding to the power restoration event to update the current power failure bazaar, generating power restoration notification information, and sending the power restoration notification information to the mobile terminal of the corresponding power utilization client. According to the invention, the electricity consumption experience of the user can be improved.

title_en: High-speed railway beam wind information gathering and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high-speed railway beam wind information gathering and early warning system, including beam wind information collecting device, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, for dynamically generating the device of reference threshold of beam wind calamity source, determination device that early warning program starts, positioner, for controlling the control car device of train speed, storage device and controlling device, control module is as the core of whole system, on the one hand control the operation of aforementioned each device, be on the other hand used for the external equipments such as the computer installation with outside and be attached realizing communication and control.In the present invention, reference threshold for the assessment of beam wind calamity source uses the mode dynamically generated, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after up-to-date early warning occurs, thus contrast with historical data, more completely and scientifically consider the risk Pre-Evaluation in a certain area.The present invention also provides for a kind of high-speed railway beam wind information gathering and method for early warning.

title_en: Mariculture area risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a risk assessment method and a risk assessment device for a mariculture area, which are used for realizing the joint simulation of various power elements such as deep water topography, an atmospheric forced field, a typhoon moving path, a tide boundary, sea water temperature and salt flow and the like by constructing a multi-dimensional power element coupling simulation model, so that more real and fine marine environment characteristic information can be obtained. By carrying out bidirectional data exchange between the wind wave model and the hydrodynamic model, key parameters such as wave radiation stress, tide speed, tide level and the like can be synchronously updated, so that the simulation precision under extreme sea conditions is remarkably improved. On the basis, the method combines the differential characteristics of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities to respectively determine the risk levels of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities, and further generates the comprehensive risk assessment result facing the target area, so that the actual risk condition can be reflected more accurately, and the scientificity and reliability of disaster early warning and management decision of the mariculture area are improved.

title_en: Disaster early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on multiple sensors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning method, a disaster early warning system, disaster early warning equipment and a storage medium based on multiple sensors, wherein firstly, time sequence data acquired by each sensor is subjected to noise elimination processing, so that the interference of the noise measured by the sensor is reduced, the standard deviation of the noise is calculated, and the precision and the effectiveness of subsequent deviation judgment are improved; the gross error, the slow speed change and the offset are used as parameters to be estimated to construct an estimation model, so that the influence of the gross error and the slow speed change on offset judgment is avoided, and the accuracy of the offset judgment of the time sequence data can be greatly improved; the estimation model effectively estimates an offset parameter, a slow speed parameter and a gross error parameter according to a stage iteration estimation mode, and the estimated parameters are subjected to validity check, so that the reliability of parameter estimation is improved; obtaining estimated time sequence data by using the qualified parameters; and finally, judging whether obvious deviation exists or not according to the residual error between the de-noised time sequence data and the estimated time sequence data and the noise standard deviation.

title_en: Condition of Overhead Transmission Lines Based appraisal procedure based on two-way Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Condition of Overhead Transmission Lines Based appraisal procedure based on two-way Bayesian network, Condition of Overhead Transmission Lines Based can be carried out real-time assessment.It using the various factors that affects transmission line of electricity running status as conditional attribute collection, circuit running status as decision attribute, build the bayesian network structure of transmission line of electricity running status assessment, conditional probability table is obtained according to sample training, utilize Bayesian network distinctive bidirection reasoning technology, the running status of circuit can not only be judged, moreover it is possible to by diagnostic reasoning identification state hidden danger by causal reasoning；Can pass through self feed back system early warning and correction when there is evaluation error, Real-time and Dynamic correction assessment data base and network structure and parameter, to adapt to update, ensure the healthy operation of transmission line of electricity conscientiously.

title_en: Natural disaster early warning device convenient to install and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural disaster early warning device convenient to install and a using method thereof, relating to the technical field of natural disaster early warning, comprising a connecting plate, a movable seat, an installation component and an early warning component, wherein a connecting rope is fixedly connected between a retractor and a fixed ring, a power supply module is embedded in the middle position on the right side of the connecting plate, a charging module is embedded in the left side of the movable seat and is at the same height with the charging module, an electromagnet is arranged below the connecting plate, and an electric universal wheel is arranged at the bottom of the movable seat. So that the entire device can be used continuously.

title_en: Low orbit early warning satellite mission planning model
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-orbit early-warning satellite mission planning model, which comprises the following steps: a high orbit reconnaissance satellite and a plurality of low orbit early warning satellites; the high-orbit reconnaissance satellite reconnaissance the video field range, and sends first target tracking information to the low-orbit early warning satellite; under the condition that the tracked target is positioned in the field of view of the low-orbit early warning satellite, acquiring second target tracking information of the tracked target, and transmitting the second target tracking information to the high-orbit reconnaissance satellite; and the high orbit reconnaissance satellite iteratively updates the first target tracking information according to the second target tracking information, and sends the updated first target tracking information to the low orbit early warning satellite. According to the low-orbit early-warning satellite task planning model provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem of the high dynamic property of the tracked target in the early-warning task can be well solved by adopting a high-orbit general survey and low-orbit detailed survey mode, and the early-warning task can be timely adjusted, so that the tracked target is always in the field of view of a certain low-orbit early-warning satellite.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling data optimization and early warning method based on data warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed disaster recovery exercise data optimization and early warning method based on a data warehouse, which comprises the steps of deploying a real-time data warehouse based on an iceberg data lake technology in a central server, carrying out online and offline management on data in the form of a Flink and Spark stream data, calculating the occupancy rate of a process pool in real time, carrying out distributed training central early warning model, when the occupancy rate of the process pool is lower than a set value, preferentially carrying out operation on the cross-local privacy disaster recovery exercise data, realizing real-time tracking and capturing of memory anomalies and early warning based on the central early warning model, submitting training results of all models to a central server to update a headquarter exercise result database, storing exercise results after each training and storing privacy data into the real-time data warehouse. The invention can effectively overcome the problem of model deviation and reduce the calculation complexity.

title_en: Trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster warning analysis, and particularly relates to a trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data. According to the invention, the accuracy and timeliness of disaster prediction are obviously improved through optimizing the matching rules and the threshold values in real time, the deep fusion and the efficient utilization of multi-source data are realized, scientific basis and technical support are provided for disaster early warning and emergency response, meanwhile, the system has self-adaptive learning capability, a model can be continuously optimized in continuously updated data, the dynamic accuracy of a prediction result is ensured, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively improved.

title_en: Movable safety fence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a movable safety fence, which comprises a fence main body, a driving assembly and a movable base, wherein the fence main body comprises a soft fence and a control cabinet, the soft fence is arranged in the control cabinet, a retraction opening for the soft fence to extend out is formed in the control cabinet, the driving assembly comprises a rotating rod and a motor, the rotating rod is in transmission connection with an output shaft of the motor, the movable base comprises a bottom plate and a driving wheel, the driving wheel is arranged below the bottom plate, the control cabinet is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, the soft fence is wound on the rotating rod, and the rotating rod is vertically arranged in the control cabinet. The safety fence has the functions of automatically winding and unwinding a net, alarming, prompting, moving and using and the like, one person can complete the layout and the retraction of the safety fence, the efficiency of manual carrying, layout and retraction of the safety fence can be improved, and the alarming function can give out early warning to the person mistakenly entering an electrified area, so that the person is prompted to be far away, and the safety is guaranteed.

title_en: YOLOv 7-based intelligent identification and early warning method for landslide of dam slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a YOLOv 7-based intelligent identification and early warning method for a side slope landslide of a dam, which comprises the following steps: collecting image data of landslide hazard of the dam slope, and labeling the screened image data; preprocessing image data, dividing a data set, and sending a training set into a network model for training; the verification set verifies the training result and updates the weight file of the network model to obtain the optimal weight file of the dam slope landslide detection model; and performing high-resolution processing on the test set, and then testing the network model to evaluate the performance. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the accuracy of identifying the landslide of the dam side slope is improved, the automation level of identifying and early warning the landslide of the dam side slope is improved, the dangerous situation of collapse and landslide of the dam side slope can be automatically identified and positioned, real-time monitoring and early warning of the landslide of the dam side slope are realized, and the safety and stability of the landslide of the reservoir side slope are improved.

title_en: The control method and its warning device and system of intelligent Acousto-optic warning device
abstract_en: The control method and its warning device and system, published method of a kind of intelligent Acousto-optic warning device disclosed by the invention be：The control method is：Power supply be transported in different environments power supply line voltage or frequency it is also not identical, acoustic-optic alarm detects the voltage or frequency of power supply line by built-in detection unit automatically, then according to the voltage value of detection or frequency values in different ranges, the automatic acousto-optic alert operation that starts is in different states.Also disclose corresponding warning device and system.Present invention warning function capable of fast starting, save causes delay to be withdrawn since accident review delay or lag occurs, and greatly improves the warning effect of caution device, preferably effect is played, to mitigate the generation of accident.

title_en: Management system and method are intelligently sent in a kind of miniature fire station
abstract_en: Management system is intelligently sent the invention discloses a kind of miniature fire station, including receive a crime report information distribution platform, group's early warning processing platform, neighbourhood committee, detachment sends platform and miniature fire station website；Its method is: access alert information, and alert information is distributed to group's early warning processing platform；Alert information based on the received, the neighbourhood committee searched in the pre-set radius of alert position sends platform and miniature fire station website, and distributes alert information；It sends local miniature fire station security personnel and rushes for alert center；Information is sent to set out fire fighter and equipment and feed back.The present invention can visualize completion to operations such as the precise positioning of alert, Response project, command scheduling and equipment information records, and real-time communication, command deployment, scene feedback and water source can be carried out with front fireman and is fed back, timeliness, the validity for guaranteeing information greatly improve the efficiency of control alert dangerous situation.

title_en: Earthquake broadcasting method, system, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an earthquake broadcasting method, an earthquake broadcasting system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, wherein the embodiment of the invention updates the current earthquake early warning information into the Nth earthquake early warning information according to the received Nth earthquake early warning information, wherein N is a positive integer greater than or equal to 1; and then generating an Nth report voice broadcast content aiming at the updated Nth report earthquake early warning information, and broadcasting the Nth report voice broadcast content, so that more accurate earthquake early warning content can be broadcast to users in real time within earthquake early warning time, and more reasonable risk avoidance measures can be taken for people within a short time.

title_en: Data backup and disaster recovery method and system based on data lake platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data backup and disaster recovery system based on a data lake platform, which comprises a data backup module, a snapshot module, a disaster recovery module and a control module, wherein the data backup module is used for backing up data in the data lake, the snapshot module is used for generating corresponding snapshots when the data in the data lake is changed, the disaster recovery module is used for recovering the backed up data and the snapshots, the control module is used for judging whether to send information early warning according to the abnormal judgment of the data backup process and the disaster recovery process, and also is used for adjusting the data backup mode according to the average time length of backup data recovery or executing the judgment function of marking validity of metadata information according to the judgment result of marking validity according to the data difference byte quantity ratio of metadata information. The invention realizes the improvement of the effectiveness of data backup.

title_en: Comprehensive energy operation simulation method and system based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy operation simulation method and system based on multi-objective optimization, belongs to the technical field of energy, and aims to solve the problem of equipment overload and discontinuous power supply caused by unbalance of supply and demand in extreme climates. The model is simulated by adopting an improved NSGA-III algorithm, and a scheduling scheme is generated, wherein the scheduling scheme comprises a start-stop time sequence of hydrogen production equipment. When typhoon warning signals are received, the seawater electrolysis hydrogen production equipment is locked forcibly, and the output power of the diesel generator is fixed in a preset interval. During the operation of the hydrogen production equipment, output fluctuation data of the wave energy generator are collected in real time, and the operation power of the reverse osmosis sea water desalination unit is adjusted through a dynamic correction algorithm. When the hydrogen storage amount of the hydrogen production equipment reaches a threshold value, the power locking of the diesel generator is released, the diesel generator is switched to a multi-energy coupling control mode, and the charging and discharging strategies of the energy storage equipment are synchronously updated.

title_en: Multi-dimensional monitoring and early warning method and device for geological disaster risk of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides a multidimensional monitoring and early warning method and device for geological disaster risk of an oil and gas pipeline, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a target disaster risk based on a knowledge graph of the geological disaster risk of the oil and gas pipeline; acquiring a first multi-dimensional feature of a preset reference image, acquiring a second multi-dimensional feature of each frame of monitoring image, and inputting the first multi-dimensional feature and the second multi-dimensional feature into a preset association relation identification model to acquire a corresponding relation matrix between the monitoring image and the reference image; based on the corresponding relation matrix, acquiring the pose of a target object in each frame of monitoring image, and fusing the pose with the coding data corresponding to the monitoring image in the initial coding video stream to obtain a target coding video stream; and playing the target coded video stream through a preset video playing device so as to display the target disaster risk existing in each frame of monitoring image. This scheme is through the validity that can guarantee disaster risk monitoring, accuracy, timeliness.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning information closed loop response calling method based on position calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning information closed-loop response calling method based on position calculation, which comprises the following steps: s1: designing a data structure, an early warning information data state and an intelligent calling interface of a geological disaster early warning position model; s2: building a geological disaster early warning position model, analyzing hidden danger points of the geological disasters by using meteorological data of a meteorological observation site, and sending early warning information; s3: developing an application program to interact with the intelligent call interface to develop closed loop call of early warning information; s4: after the intelligent call sends the early warning short message, the early warning short message information is uploaded to an early warning position model, and the data state of the early warning short message information is updated; s5: after the intelligent caller shall send the early warning voice, uploading the early warning voice information to an early warning position model, and updating the data state of the early warning voice information; s6: after the intelligent call starts the manual call, the manual call information is uploaded to the early warning position model, and the early warning information data state is updated.

title_en: Mobile terminal fire alarm method and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mobile terminal fire alarm method, comprise the following steps: detection of fires danger also sends detection signal; In described detection signal saltus step and send when exceeding predetermined value alerting signal with control mobile terminal report to the police, cancel when obtaining feedback in the given time and reporting to the police, communication preset number when not obtaining feedback in Preset Time also sends fire signal and clawback signal to described preset number, to make described preset number clawback mobile terminal; Clawback according to described preset number sends alerting signal and reports to the police to control mobile terminal, and obtains rejection feedback in the given time or when not obtaining feedback, send rescue signal to described preset number.Compared with prior art, the present invention can send clawback signal while sending fire signal to preset number, makes preset number clawback mobile terminal, and optionally connected the passing to of user illustrates concrete the condition of a disaster or maloperation to rescuer, prevent false alarm further, and be convenient to the expansion of rescue work.

title_en: A kind of landslide alarm system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of landslide alarm system, including ultrasonic monitor device, infrared monitoring device, PLC controller and acousto-optic alarm, the ultrasonic distance measurement device includes some ultrasonic range finders, and with the corresponding monitoring feedback mechanism of ultrasonic range finder, the infrared monitoring device includes bottom plate, side plate, top plate, baffle ring, elastic threads and active infrared alarm, ultrasonic range finder, wireless data receiver, sound-light alarm instrument is connected with PLC controller, early warning can be made to landslide phenomenon in time, prompting personnel withdraw in time, it ensure that the safety of people's lives and properties.

title_en: Early warning method and device for fusion representation of multiple ocean physical fields based on graph convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for early warning fusion representation of multiple ocean physical fields based on graph convolution, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing a three-layer graph convolution neural network to update characteristics on multiple physical fields, and excavating interrelationships among different physical fields so as to update integral characteristic representations with comprehensive characteristics of different physical fields; the method comprises the steps of inputting integral characteristic representations with different physical field comprehensive characteristics and position coding information corresponding to the integral characteristic representations into double-layer time sequence attention by utilizing double-layer time sequence attention operation to obtain time period multi-physical field data characteristic coupling representation, taking the time period multi-physical field data characteristic coupling representation as global characteristic, mining time sequence information to predict Nino3.4 index, fusing Nino3.4 index with input typhoon observation data, and predicting typhoon intensity. The apparatus includes a processor and a memory. The method solves the problem that the prediction of the typhoon intensity in the sea area near the communication base station in the coastal area is not accurate enough in the prior art.

title_en: Ocean early warning intelligent question-answering method based on large language model and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a large language model-based ocean early warning intelligent question-answering method and a related device, which relate to the technical field of ocean early warning intelligent question-answering, match a question input by a user with each type of task chain and each vectorized corpus in a vector database, fill the question and target vectorized corpus into a prompt word template of a target task chain, output answers to the question by utilizing an ocean early warning large language model, be applied to ocean early warning business work, realize the ocean early warning intelligent question-answering, vectorize the ocean early warning corpus, construct the vector database, search and reorder the question input by the user in the vector database to obtain the target vectorized corpus, restrict and trace the answer of the ocean early warning large language model, update the vector database when the ocean early warning corpus is updated, and meet the accuracy and timeliness requirements of the ocean early warning business.

title_en: Important hidden danger prediction method and system based on transmission line visualization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission line fault monitoring, in particular to a key hidden danger prediction method and a key hidden danger prediction system based on power transmission line visualization, wherein an operation and maintenance layer hidden danger early warning information feedback module in the system combines weather forecast information received in historical data, dynamically analyzing the risk thermodynamic evolution process of the power transmission line in the period corresponding to the weather forecast, dynamically marking the hidden danger prediction area of the power transmission line, constructing hidden danger early warning information, and transmitting the hidden danger early warning information to a display end for visual presentation. According to the method, the continuous updating of the power transmission line model is realized in a mode of static data and dynamic data, the static data in the updated model is kept unchanged all the time, the data acquisition quantity is effectively reduced, the response speed of the updating of the power transmission line model is improved, meanwhile, fusion analysis is carried out according to multi-source data, the simulation of the power transmission line risk thermal evolution process is realized, the hidden danger prediction area of the power transmission line is dynamically locked, and the accurate prediction of the key hidden danger of the power transmission line is realized.

title_en: Intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system, which comprises a cloud server, a data processing end, a controller, a plurality of indoor sensor assemblies, lighting indicating lamps and a warning indicator, wherein the cloud server is connected with the data processing end; the indoor sensor assembly comprises a temperature sensor and a smoke sensor; the data processing end is used for receiving the data of the indoor sensor assembly and the illumination indicator lamp, analyzing the data to obtain corresponding control instructions, and then transmitting the data and the control instructions to the cloud server; the system can be applied to fire alarm prompts in different places, can meet the requirements on different use scenes, is strong in system adjustability, easy to install and regulate, can be updated in real time according to the change of external environment, and solves the problem that the conventional system is easy to generate error warning; the whole system architecture is convenient for the adjustment of the user, so that the user can adjust the hardware configuration, divide the monitoring area and the like according to the use requirement, the flexibility is high, and the system architecture is suitable for a plurality of scenes.

title_en: Fusion processing method, device and equipment for multi-disaster early warning information and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fusion processing method, device and equipment for multi-disaster early warning information and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early-warning information report, and acquiring the early-warning stage type of the previous disaster early-warning information report of the same disaster category of the monitoring area corresponding to the current disaster early-warning information report; under the condition that the type of the early warning stage of the early warning information report of the previous disaster is the end report, determining the early warning information report of the current disaster as the first report of the early warning event of the new disaster; and under the condition that the type of the early warning stage of the previous disaster early warning information report is not the end report, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is the update report or the end report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the previous disaster early warning information report according to the current disaster early warning information report and the early warning end condition. The invention can fuse the received disaster early warning information, and is beneficial to the updating, responding and disposing of the current disaster early warning information.

title_en: CAE mechanical simulation method based on BIM information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CAE mechanical simulation method based on a BIM information model, which comprises the steps of reconstructing a BIM building three-dimensional geometric model through a grid simplification system, and importing the simplified BIM three-dimensional model into a CAE mechanical simulation system; extracting data information in a BIM information model system, judging the attribute of the change information, transmitting data influencing the mechanical simulation to a CAE mechanical simulation system, and driving the CAE mechanical simulation system to update; and feeding back the mechanical information obtained by the updated CAE mechanical simulation model to the BIM information model, and displaying the calculated mechanical information from the BIM information model. When building designers design on the BIM by applying the method, the mechanical information can be referred to, the design efficiency is improved, in addition, the effective early warning can be carried out on the disasters caused by stress damage in the construction process in the later period, meanwhile, the repeated modeling is avoided, and the cost is saved.

title_en: High speed rail earthquake data information acquisition and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: A kind of high speed rail earthquake data information acquisition of present invention offer and early warning system, determination device, positioning device, control vehicle device, storage device and the control device for controlling train speed started including seismic wave information collecting device, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, the device of reference threshold for dynamic generation seismic risk, early warning program, core of the control module as whole system, on the one hand the operation of aforementioned each device is controlled, is on the other hand used for and the external equipments such as external computer installation is attached realization communication and control.In the present invention, reference threshold for seismic risk assessment is using dynamic generation by the way of, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after newest early warning occurs, to be compared with historical data, risk Pre-Evaluation that is more complete and scientifically considering a certain area.The present invention also provides a kind of high speed rail earthquake data information acquisition and method for early warning.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, control method, and non-transitory recording medium
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle, a control method, a non-transitory recording medium, and a control program, the unmanned aerial vehicle flying in an unmanned manner, comprising: a memory storing the acquired 1 st information and the acquired 2 nd information, the 1 st information representing a current position of the aircraft, the 2 nd information representing a current position of a manipulator that transmits an instruction for remotely maneuvering the aircraft; a receiving unit that receives information transmitted from a transmission source, the information including an emergency alert; a processing section; and a control unit that controls the aircraft, wherein the processing unit compares a current position of the aircraft with a target region of the emergency alert indicated by the information and a current position of the manipulator with the target region, and wherein the control unit retracts the aircraft based on a result of the comparison.

title_en: Gas Disaster method for early warning based on normal distribution-test identification gas effusion intensity
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Gas Disaster method for early warning based on normal distribution-test identification gas effusion intensity, comprising: the time series of driving face in coal mine gas density is obtained from safety monitor and control system；Lilliefors normal distribution-test and Shapiro-Wilk normal distribution-test are carried out to the time series of driving face in coal mine gas density；Judge gas density time series whether Normal Distribution: be that then current time driving face in coal mine Gas is in normal phase, take subsequent time update after gas concentration time series carry out normal distribution-test；Otherwise current time driving face in coal mine Gas is in the abnormal stage, further determines whether driving face in coal mine Gas has entered the abnormal stage.The present invention monitors pre-procedure risk state in real time, and the abnormal point that discovery face gas is gushed out issues warning information with this, is conducive to gas accident prevention and control.

title_en: Method and device for processing early warning information of multiple disasters based on space-time correlation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for processing early warning information of various disasters based on space-time correlation, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. Comprising the following steps: responding to the received disaster early-warning information report, and acquiring early-warning stage types of the first historical disaster early-warning information report and at least one second historical disaster early-warning information report; under the condition that the acquired early warning stage types are all end reports, when the current disaster early warning risk level is higher than a threshold value, determining the current disaster early warning information report as the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the acquired early warning stage type is determined to be non-ending report, determining the current disaster early warning information report as the updated report or ending report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the first historical disaster early warning information report or the second historical disaster early warning information report according to the information generation type and the early warning ending condition of the current disaster early warning information report. The invention can realize the time-space correlation of disaster early warning information report of different monitoring areas and fusion of disaster early warning events.

title_en: Cable crane tank-hanging disaster-causing risk early warning method integrating D-GPS and RFID
abstract_en: A cable crane tank-hanging disaster risk early warning method integrating D-GPS and RFID,the method comprises the following steps: judging the area where the constructor is located by using an early warning device, and carrying out voice warning when the constructor is located in an unsafe area; measuring real-time spatial position coordinates (X) of a cable crane tank 1 ，Y 1 ，Z 1 ) The running speed v and the worker spatial position coordinate (X) 2 ，Y 2 ，Z 2 ) Comparing the horizontal displacement between the cable crane tank crane and workers with the impact influence area of the cable crane tank crane object, and performing early warning on constructors in a distance early warning mode; when a worker enters a cable crane tank lifting object hitting affected area, buzzing warning is carried out until the worker withdraws to a safe area. The method of the invention calculates the impact area of the cable crane tank-hanging object by positioning technology, effectively reduces the risk of space conflict and disaster, and improves the safety of operators in the construction process.

title_en: Overhead manned device safety early warning system and method based on target tracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety, and discloses an overhead man-riding device safety early warning system and method based on target tracking, wherein the system comprises the following steps: inputting the current video frame into YOLOv target detection model to obtain first detection result; acquiring an initial state of a first target frame corresponding to a target object; inputting the frame number difference v, the time interval between frames and the initial state into a state transition model to predict the predicted position of the corresponding first target frame, and obtaining a second detection result of the i+v video frame; searching a corresponding second target frame optimally matched with the first target frame, and taking the optimally matched corresponding second target frame as an updating target frame; performing audible and visual alarm according to the category of the first target frame or the updated target frame; repeating the above process until the class of the updated target frame is non-illegal, and ending the cycle; the invention can effectively and safely monitor and pre-warn the riding behavior of the overhead passenger device.

title_en: Tunnel gushing water automatic identification method and system based on gushing water target detection model
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel water inrush target detection model-based automatic identification method and system, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel water inrush disaster monitoring, prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of extracting video image features in a tunnel, mixing the spatial attention weight and the channel attention weight of the features, updating the features, fusing the updated features, and decoding the fused features to obtain a target frame and a category result. The method and the system have the advantages that through a content-aware attention mechanism and coupling with the context characteristics, the generalization force of the monitoring model is improved, the accurate identification of the tunnel surge water under various tunnel conditions is guaranteed, the omnibearing high-precision detection and statistical analysis of the tunnel surge water are further realized, whether early warning prompt in the tunnel is carried out or not is judged, the evolution condition of the surge water is predicted, and the guarantee is provided for the tunnel safety construction.

title_en: Temporary protection withdrawing method for intelligent security and protection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temporary protection withdrawing method for an intelligent security and protection system. The method comprises the steps that main control computer software sets a global variable for recording the current mode, and the current temporary protection withdrawing state is recorded; after the system receives an effective temporary protection withdrawing request, the configuration state information of the current system can be firstly stored, in addition, a piece of access record information is inserted, the temporary protection withdrawing state is changed into an effective state, a state update notice is sent to an authorized user side, then, a corresponding warning linkage output code is sent to a linkage card according to the current time, next, the set temporary protection withdrawing time starts to count down, after the time is out, the original warning linage code is taken out to be sent to the linkage card, then, the temporary protection withdrawing state variable is set as the non-temporary protection withdrawing, in addition, a state update notice is sent out, and the system recovers to a previous protection setting mode. Convenience is provided for clients to go into or go out of self corresponding protection regions, and meanwhile, the potential safety hazard and the disturbing on families and neighbors are also avoided.

title_en: Integral nipple air breathing device and whistle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integral nipple air breathing device and whistle which is designed to use together with a miniature nostril plug cover and an oxygen supply apparatus. When a disaster suddenly occurs, dense smoke and dust are generated and the device of the invention is used together with the miniature nostril plug cover and the oxygen supply apparatus, the miniature nostril plug coveris used to take in oxygen for human body through the oxygen supply apparatus and an oxygen catheter; the user holds an expiration nipple (1) in the mouth, a lip cover (3) covers lips naturally, the turbid qi is discharged in a bellows (4) through an expiration hole (2) to drive a jump ball (5) to move violently and push a bellows door (7) to open; the turbid qi is expired from a whistle opening (9) to generate loud whistle sounds for warning and locating, thus an accurate direction can be provided for rescuers so as to help the rescuers to rescue successfully; and the bellows door (7) uses a bellows door shaft (8) to be connected with the bellows (4) through a bearing (6); the bellows door (7) is opened during expiration and returns and is closed after expiration under the action of gravity, thus the toxic smoke can be effectively prevented from inhaling and a respiratory circulation can be completed through one inspiration process and one expiration process.

title_en: Public early warning broadcasting method, system and base station equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a public early warning broadcasting method, a public early warning broadcasting system and base station equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: enabling the AMF to send a write-in replacement early warning request message to the gNB-CU-CP through the NG interface; enabling the gNB-CU-CP to generate an F1 interface message according to the replacement indication written in the replacement early warning request message and the new public early warning information, and sending an F1 interface message to the gNB-DU, wherein the F1 interface message comprises a replacement indication bit and the new public early warning information; and enabling the gNB-DU to replace the current public warning broadcast information by the new public warning information in the F1 interface message according to the replacement indication bit in the F1 interface message. By the scheme, F1 interface signaling can be reduced, repeated cancellation and restarting of resource scheduling are avoided, and the problems of early warning information transmission delay and the like can be reduced.

title_en: Experimental method and device for dynamic disaster of rock burst in roadway excavation
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for dynamic disaster experiment of tunnel driving rock burst is characterized in that the experiment method includes an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under normal geological conditions and an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under abnormal geological conditions; both of them comprise (1) preparing a sample; (2) applying a static load to the sample, and simulating the actual stress environment of rock mass around the underground tunneling working face of the coal mine; (3) controlling the motion track of a cutter to simulate tunneling through a computer program, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the tunneling process of a sample; (4) withdrawing the cutter from the sample, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the process of stopping digging the sample; (5) respectively in step 2 and step 3, applying dynamic load, and controlling dynamic loading waveform characteristics and application time parameters by a computer; (6) and changing the form and the strength of the dynamic load waveform until the sample is subjected to impact damage, obtaining the condition criterion of the roadway impact damage and the like. The method can provide theoretical reference and scientific countermeasures for early warning and prevention of coal mine roadway excavation rock burst.

title_en: The anti-breaking electrical protective device of tower crane
abstract_en: The anti-breaking electrical protective device of tower crane of the present invention, is related to construction hoisting machinery control technology field.For existing tower crane because power-off suddenly is easily caused security incident, there is flimsy security hidden trouble using battery continued power.It includes the brake and little gear being arranged on turning motor, the revolution bull gear being meshed with little gear, electric pushrod and the rotary control system being connected electrically；Rotary control system includes the ac-dc converter circuit and A.C. contactor being serially connected with respectively in AC power, the revolution control circuit and voltage detecting circuit being connected respectively with ac-dc converter circuit, and the warning circuit being connected respectively with ac-dc converter circuit and AC power；The purpose braked and discharged is turned round to tower crane by turning round the control that the controlling switch of control circuit is released and withdrawn to electric pushrod, and then being reached by brake, and then eliminates potential safety hazard, construction safety has been ensured.

title_en: Ground surface displacement gridding dynamic monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method for ground surface displacement gridding, which comprises the steps of setting a gridding layout structure according to the geological condition of a slumping body, acquiring on-site data, analyzing and judging the on-site data, selecting a working mode and processing the data to issue early warning; synthesize wireless sensor network technique, computer control technique, inertial navigation technique, data fusion technique, acquire landslide body full chain earth's surface displacement monitoring data comprehensively, realize the monitoring of landslide body calamity whole area full coverage, satisfy landslide body earth's surface displacement monitoring completely, utilize this technique greatly reduced monitoring cost, and monitoring devices volume is dexterous, it is convenient to lay, easily operation, the data processing unit of design not only can realize sending audible and visual alarm at the scene, also can carry out real time monitoring to the scene at the background, utilize the data fusion algorithm can realize that the multi-angle is diversified carries out real time monitoring to the landslide body, the validity, stability and the accuracy of data are guaranteed to the at utmost, provide new technical support for the monitoring of the landslide body.

title_en: Disaster early warning method, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster early warning method, terminal equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problem that a user cannot accurately and timely receive disaster early warning information in the related technology. If the appointed message is received, determining an operation mode of the position label based on the message type of the appointed message, wherein the operation mode comprises not updating the position label or determining the updating time of the position label, and the appointed message is ticket information or cross-market reminding information; when the update time is reached, positioning operation is executed, and a position label of the current position is obtained and sent to a server; and receiving disaster early warning information of the position label of the current position sent by the server. Therefore, regional distribution of the early warning information is realized by reporting the position label, the cost of sending the information is saved, the position label of the current position can be timely and accurately updated by using ticket information or cross-market reminding information, the influence of position change is reduced, and the accuracy and instantaneity of receiving disaster early warning information can be increased.

title_en: Method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by gradient lifting regression optimization model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by a gradient lifting regression optimization model. The method comprises the steps of training a gradient lifting regression optimization model according to multi-factor sample data to predict landslide settlement, wherein the gradient lifting regression optimization model is formed by a plurality of gradient lifting regression trees in parallel, the model improves model classification strength by training a plurality of weak classifiers, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, in order to enable parameters of each weak learner to be different, a training set is updated in the training process of the model, the plurality of weak learners are learned, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, landslide settlement prediction is carried out according to current multi-factor sample data to obtain a current landslide settlement prediction value, a threshold value of a landslide risk level is determined based on landslide history data, geological conditions, soil types and the like, and the landslide risk level is accurately estimated by comparing the threshold value with the prediction value.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted head-up display system oriented to safety auxiliary function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle-mounted head-up display system oriented to a safety auxiliary function, which comprises: the mainboard is used for providing a serial port and calculating; a projection screen connected with the main board for providing a reverse image; the display screen is a semi-transparent semi-reflective screen and displays safety auxiliary information, wherein the safety auxiliary information comprises lane change warning, pedestrian collision warning, construction area early warning and the like; the camera is connected with the main board, is arranged in the vehicle, shoots the face image of the driver and transmits the face image of the driver to the main board; during operation, the mainboard receives road side information and the driver face image transmitted by the camera, the mainboard updates the safety auxiliary information on the display screen according to the road side information, and simultaneously the mainboard identifies the driving state of the driver and adjusts the safety auxiliary information on the display screen according to the driving state of the driver so as to adapt to the state of the driver. Compared with the prior art, the occurrence of road safety accidents can be obviously reduced.

title_en: Network version digital ocean ball public application and development integration method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a network version digital ocean ball public application and development integration method and system. The intelligent buoy provided with the laser communication device, the scanning device and the processor is used as a dynamic node to construct an self-organizing communication network to share underwater position and ocean current data. When multiple nodes detect abnormal targets at the same time, a cooperative authentication mechanism is triggered. The system drives the nodes to adjust the layout by using a dynamic sphere model, and controls at least three nodes to move towards the center of the target along a spiral path, so that a multi-layer spherical monitoring structure is formed. And finally, uploading the three-dimensional coordinate data code to a shore-based platform to generate an updated digital ocean ball map. The technical scheme provided by the application realizes the accurate positioning and three-dimensional visual monitoring of the abnormal targets of the marine environment, obviously improves the sex and space coverage precision of marine ecological monitoring, and provides three-dimensional data support for marine environment protection and disaster early warning.

title_en: Wisdom community data management platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and particularly discloses a smart community data management platform, which comprises: the system comprises a community basic information importing module, a fire control monitoring information importing module, a fire control patrol correction judging module, a fire control patrol update confirming module and a fire control patrol update feedback terminal.
