According to the invention, the firefighting inspection correction judgment is carried out according to the firefighting hidden danger tracking log, firefighting monitoring information and regional weather information of the target community, and the corrected firefighting hidden danger inspection clearing information corresponding to the target analysis community is confirmed, so that the problem of insufficient attention to the firefighting hidden danger processing at present is effectively solved, the defect that the firefighting hidden danger monitoring and early warning are only focused at present is avoided, the defect of the firefighting hidden danger processing at present is overcome, the processing capacity and coping capacity after the subsequent firefighting hidden danger occurs are improved, the prejudging and processing capacity of fire risks can be improved, and the optimization of resource allocation is realized.

title_en: Emergency information sending method for mobile multimedia broadcast system
abstract_en: The method comprises: 1) mobile multimedia broadcast system acquires an emergency information data, and packages the emergency information data into the multiplexing frames comprising an emergency information indication flag bit, emergency information type flag bit, emergency level flag bit, and one or more bit in the update serial number flag bit of emergency information; 2) when there is an emergency message needing to be transmitted, setting one or more value of said flag bits in the multiplexing frame, and transmitting said multiplexing frame through mobile multimedia broadcast system. By the invention, all kinds of emergency messages can be transmitted to the user through multimedia broadcast system.

title_en: Power transmission line forest fire dynamic prediction early warning method based on time sequence change
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to a dynamic prediction and early warning method for power transmission line forest fires based on time sequence change. It is characterized by that firstly, according to the initial position F of mountain fire point 0 Wind direction, wind speed and gradient information, and constructing an initial moment t 0 Calculating the maximum spreading speed V of the mountain fire at the current moment by using the mountain fire spreading elliptic model max (ii) a Calculating t 0 Time F 0 The shortest distance D from the transmission line L 0 And a propagation velocity V in that direction L0 Determining t 0 The early warning level of the power transmission mountain fire at the moment; determining the next time t 1 Fire point F 1 Speed in the direction of propagation to the transmission line; calculate from t 1 A mountain fire spreading model after delta t time from moment; repeating the steps until a series of mountain fire point positions related to the time sequence are obtained; when receiving the fire point F at any time 0 And the information of spreading and the change of the surrounding environment updates a new mountain fire spreading path diagram from the moment in time. The method can correct the forest fire spreading predicted path in time, has the characteristics of small calculated amount and clear target, and avoids the simulation of irrelevant directions.

title_en: User psychological state assessment method and system for meta universe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user psychological state assessment method and system for meta-universe, in particular to the technical field of user psychological state assessment, which comprises the steps of quantifying whether abnormal fluctuation exists in a user psychological state by acquiring virtual scene update data in meta-universe, judging whether the user is an unstable user, acquiring unstable information of data acquisition, fluctuation information of data transmission and calculation resource allocation uneven information of a user psychological state assessment model to construct an assessment result timeliness monitoring model, the method comprises the steps of identifying and responding to potential problems, guaranteeing timeliness of a continuous monitoring evaluation result, providing basic data for subsequent risk early warning, further obtaining timeliness monitoring data information, establishing a timeliness monitoring data set, carrying out risk early warning on the influence depth of timeliness hidden danger through analysis and moving average calculation of the timeliness monitoring data set, and guaranteeing intervention before or at the early stage of the occurrence of the problems, so that overall performance and user experience are improved.

title_en: Method and system for realizing unmanned tunneling working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for realizing an unmanned tunneling working face, which comprise the steps of dividing equipment groups working on the tunneling working face into N rigid body groups which independently operate, installing an inertial navigation and a laser target on main rigid body equipment of each rigid body group, designing and installing a measuring and positioning robot, wherein the measuring and positioning robot comprises an inertial navigation and N automatic target-seeking total stations, establishing a digital twin platform of the unmanned tunneling working face, realizing pose calculation, fault diagnosis, disaster early warning, cooperative control, scene update, equipment start-stop and maintenance decision-making, and providing remote intervention and man-machine interaction interfaces to realize unmanned operation of the tunneling working face. The invention can realize the accurate measurement, positioning and attitude control of all equipment such as digging, drilling, anchoring, supporting, transporting, passing and the like in the tunneling working face, realize the unmanned operation of zero accident and zero fault of the tunneling working face, and provide technical support for avoiding personal injury and death and greatly improving the tunneling efficiency.

title_en: Prediction evaluation method and related equipment for fault tunnel damage
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a fault tunnel damage prediction and assessment method and related equipment. The prediction evaluation method comprises the steps of constructing a fault tunnel model, wherein the fault tunnel model comprises at least one solid particle and at least one fluid particle, parameters of the solid particle and the fluid particle are respectively endowed with corresponding initial values, the parameters comprise target parameters, the target parameters are circularly updated until the preset times according to a preset time step and a preset target parameter control equation, and the impact pressure of a water body is determined according to the target parameters after the fluid particle updating. The scheme provides effective basis for disaster prevention and disaster early warning in tunnel construction.

title_en: Scheme release method based on emergency state dynamic change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plan release method based on dynamic change of emergency states, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and comprises the steps of activating a pre-built knowledge graph frame according to an emergency type identifier acquired in real time to form an initialized dynamic knowledge graph, capturing a feedback data stream in real time, importing the feedback data stream into a state update layer of a state evolution knowledge graph to generate an updated state evolution knowledge graph, generating an evacuation instruction based on the updated state evolution knowledge graph, switching to Mesh network broadcast path change information through a damaged base station to generate an execution effect, and re-triggering and activating the pre-built knowledge graph frame as a new emergency type identifier. According to the intelligent countermeasures, artificial disturbance simulation nodes are implanted in the state evolution knowledge graph, and the diffusion path is deduced, so that the intelligent countermeasures are dynamically generated.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural meteorological disaster early warning method and system, the system applies the method, the method comprises: the method comprises the steps of acquiring meteorological data, and acquiring meteorological grid data and forecast grid data of the day of meteorological data generation; the method comprises the steps of configuring agricultural meteorological disaster rules, forming a series of meteorological disaster rule set configuration data of various crops and each growth and development period according to national standards, industry standards and agricultural meteorological disaster classification and disaster degree evaluation documents, and configuring the data into a rule base; the method comprises the steps of carrying out early warning analysis on agricultural weather disasters, acquiring weather disaster rule set configuration data of crops in a current development period according to the current development period of the crops, and judging whether the acquired weather data and weather forecast data accord with the weather disasters or not to obtain weather disaster early warning information; and updating the weather disaster analysis result, writing the early warning information into a weather disaster analysis result database, checking all early warning information in the validity period, and updating the early warning information state.

title_en: City VANET multi-hop broadcasting method based on competition and finite state machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a competition and finite state machine based urban VANET multi-hop broadcasting method, wherein the state of each node comprises the following steps: n is a message which is not received; p is a possible received message; and R is the confirmed received message. A source node which learns the emergency constructs an emergency message with a sending node list and broadcasts the emergency message, and the state of the source node is set as R; if the state of the neighbor node is N, the state is changed to P; the node receiving the emergency message finds the message sending node and the nodes in the sending node list contained in the message in the local neighbor table, and if the nodes exist, the states of the nodes are set to be R. The receivers then calculate their own latencies based on the relative distances to the last hop node, the quality of the communication, etc. The node whose waiting time is first ended updates the urgent message and broadcasts it, and the new message can be regarded as an implicit ACK. If there is a neighbor with a state other than R, the sender will retransmit overtime. The invention is suitable for various network topologies, and ensures the real-time reliable transmission of the emergency message in the whole network.

title_en: Method and system for pre-checking for signs of abnormality of a nuclear power plant device including a process to determine device importance and alarm validity
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device, including determination of device importance and alarm validity. The method for early warning of abnormal signs of equipment includes a first step of determining, by an early warning processing means, whether an equipment monitoring signal value is out of a normal operation range using a weighted value based on importance data for each monitoring variable that has been previously analyzed by an operator, a second step of generating, by the early warning processing means, a warning when the equipment monitoring signal value is out of the normal operation range, and a third step of determining, by a warning determining means, whether the generated warning is a valid warning to be subjected to warning analysis and tracking.

title_en: Intelligent three-dimensional distance measurement method for power transmission line based on multidimensional space topology analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent three-dimensional distance measurement method for a power transmission line based on multidimensional space topology analysis, which relates to the technical field of distance detection of the power transmission line, and comprises the steps of executing data acquisition of the power transmission line and a power transmission environment and establishing a multidimensional space data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out three-dimensional mapping fusion on a multi-dimensional space data set, establishing a three-dimensional model of a transmission line and a transmission environment, establishing a topological relation model, establishing key topological nodes of the topological relation model, carrying out potential safety hazard analysis of the updated topological relation model through a space distance analysis network, updating early warning levels in real time based on potential safety hazard analysis results, and carrying out early warning. The technical problems that the existing power transmission line three-dimensional ranging is difficult to cover complex and changeable power transmission environments on the whole, and the power transmission line distance measurement accuracy is insufficient are solved, the potential safety hazard identification early warning is not accurate enough in time, and the technical effects of improving the power transmission line ranging accuracy, the potential safety hazard early warning accuracy and the instantaneity are achieved.

title_en: Region-based multi-industry object global weather risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional-based multi-industry object global weather risk early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring boundary data of a target area and all meteorological factor data at a certain time point; dividing a target area into a plurality of grid areas according to boundary data and the calibrated spatial resolution, and processing meteorological factor data into meteorological factor grid data; constructing a gridding time data layer of each meteorological factor at a certain time point; acquiring position information of a multi-industry object in a target area and a risk threshold value of a meteorological factor corresponding to the position information; and respectively determining the grid areas according to the position information, calling grid data corresponding to the grid areas in grid time data layers with different weather factors and the same time, comparing the grid data with a corresponding industry object weather factor risk threshold value, and simultaneously carrying out weather risk early warning on multiple industry objects. The method and the system can perform global real-time rolling update weather risk early warning on multi-industry objects in the target area.

title_en: Method and apparatus for notifying SI update, EAB update and PWS messages in a wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for receiving System Information (SI) in a wireless communication system are provided. A User Equipment (UE), which may be in an enhanced coverage area or operating with a bandwidth narrower than a cell bandwidth, receives an indication of at least one of SI update, Earthquake and Tsunami Warning System (ETWS) notification, Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) or Extended Access Barring (EAB) modification from a network via a Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH), and receives system information from the network according to the received indication.

title_en: Task scheduling management system, method, device and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a task scheduling management system, a task scheduling management method, a task scheduling management device and a storage medium thereof, which are compared with the prior art: the visual interface configures task parameters and task scheduling; the standard task interface is standardized, a task scheduling center at a platform level is provided, and the development efficiency of engineers is improved; the task execution log is recorded, so that the related responsible person can conveniently track the log, an early warning threshold value is provided, different early warning mechanisms are dynamically configured, and the method is flexible and universal; the cluster deploys a task executor to ensure high availability of tasks; independently developing a disaster recovery mechanism, monitoring the state of a task executor through a heartbeat packet, automatically processing a disaster recovery server by a platform, transferring faults and improving the usability of a program; the method realizes a gray scale upgrading mechanism, provides a concept of version number, enables a developer to smoothly upgrade task versions, enables a bottom layer to configure a dynamic routing strategy through Socket communication, achieves the purpose of smooth upgrading, and avoids the occurrence of conditions such as task execution missing caused by upgrading.

title_en: Method and system for pre-detecting signs of abnormality in nuclear power plant equipment including process for determining equipment importance and alarm validity
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device, including determination of importance of the device and validity of the alarm. The method for early warning of signs of abnormality of a device includes: the first step is as follows: determining, by the early-alert processing arrangement, whether the plant monitoring signal value is outside of a normal operating range using a weighted value based on the importance data for each monitoring variable that has been previously analyzed by the operator; the second step: generating an alarm by the early alarm processing means when the plant monitoring signal value is outside the normal operating range; and a third step of: determining, by an alarm determination device, whether the generated alarm is a valid alarm to be analyzed and tracked.

title_en: Deep soft rock roadway deformation control method under dynamic pressure influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep soft rock roadway deformation control method under the influence of dynamic pressure, which particularly relates to the technical field of measurement and monitoring, and effectively identifies abnormal conditions in the operation of a total station by judging the degree of abnormality of real-time measurement data of the total station and counting abnormal data in the process of real-time acquisition, and triggers an emergency response mechanism when an alarm signal is generated, so that the accuracy of deformation monitoring in the process of withdrawing the deep soft rock roadway to the ground is ensured; the deformation monitoring state early warning coefficient is calculated through the normalization processing of the total station error correction frequency, the output fluctuation variation value and the total station electromagnetic influence index, and the deformation monitoring state early warning coefficient is used for analyzing the running state of the total station, so that the deformation condition of the supporting structure in the deep soft rock roadway can be timely captured under the condition of good state, control measures can be timely taken under the action of dynamic pressure, and the stability of the supporting structure is ensured.

title_en: Gust front automatic identifying method based on Doppler weather radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Gust front automatic identifying methods based on Doppler weather radar data, the described method comprises the following steps: 1) extracting Narrow-Band Echo suspicious region using local binarization algorithm according to the radar performance characteristic of Gust front；2) Narrow-Band Echo suspicious region is split, connected and Screening Treatment, obtain the corresponding skeleton image of weak carinate band；3) optical flow field is obtained by two low elevation angle radar images of current time and previous moment, front and back moment matched skeleton in the corresponding skeleton image of weak carinate band that step 2) obtains is drafted as doubtful Gust front, Gust front is gone out according to the relationship and the trend of the doubtful Gust front of the position and speed of the doubtful Gust front and the position and speed of storm monomer and the relation recognition of speed.This method realizes the automatic detection of Gust front, carries out timely early warning to disaster, reduces economic loss and casualties；And pass through the experimental verification validity of this method.

title_en: Building secondary collapse monitoring and early warning system under aftershock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system for monitoring and early warning secondary collapse of a building under a residual earthquake, which comprises a building structure monitoring module and an early warning module, wherein the building structure monitoring module comprises a plurality of sensors, the sensors are arranged at target monitoring points of the local collapse building and are used for monitoring structural response of the local collapse building under the effect of the residual earthquake, a dynamic early warning threshold algorithm is built in the early warning module, different initial early warning thresholds are set for characteristic collapse modes of the local collapse building on site, and data screening processing and sensitivity analysis are carried out by collecting residual earthquake source signals and structural response signals, and accurate and timely early warning is provided, and meanwhile the collapse early warning thresholds are dynamically updated and used for next collapse judgment and early warning. Compared with the prior art, the method considers two factors of aftershock and structural response, and enables monitoring and early warning of secondary collapse of the building to be more scientific and accurate through the early warning threshold value of dynamic iteration.

title_en: Digital dynamic management system and method for special equipment
abstract_en: A digital dynamic management method and system for special equipment includes such steps as collecting and processing the data of special equipment, generating digital twin model, intelligent analysis and decision by C4.5 decision tree model, optimizing operation strategy, simulating operation by optimized digital twin model, providing simulated data to operation management reference, real-time monitoring the operation condition of special equipment, analyzing and deciding by combining real-time data and simulated data, early warning, recording and checking all operation data, storing all operation data, exchanging information with third-party platform, and updating equipment model and operation parameters. The data is updated in a centralized and real-time manner, so that the management efficiency is improved, potential dangerous situations are early-warned, all operation data are recorded, the occurrence of safety accidents is reduced, the data utilization efficiency is improved, the problem of data island is solved, and the omnibearing digital dynamic management is carried out on special equipment.

title_en: Three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system based on autonomous control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring, in particular to an autonomous controllable three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous geological, hydrologic and construction data, fusing and obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological-construction coupling digital twin model after alignment coding, conducting water gushing evolution rolling prediction through multi-scale physical-AI mixed modeling and correcting real-time data, outputting prediction data, constructing a three-dimensional visual platform, starting multi-level linkage early warning based on a risk threshold, and enabling the system to comprise a data fusion module, a water gushing evolution rolling prediction module and a multi-level linkage early warning module, and meet the requirements of rapid early warning and timely decision making of water gushing disasters in the tunnel construction process by combining three-dimensional visual rendering and deep learning fluid simulation technology through fusion of geological data, hydrologic monitoring data and construction parameters.

title_en: Strong wind disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou GNSS-R
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong wind disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou GNSS-R, which comprises the steps of 1, carrying out wind speed detection operation of the inner water surface of an unmanned aerial vehicle on the periphery of a strong water fall area by carrying out GNSS-R receiving equipment, carrying out data calculation on acquired satellite observables, 2, constructing an LSTM wind speed inversion model integrating double-factor decoupling, carrying out inversion prediction on the water surface wind speed of a reflection point area by inputting the received satellite observables and calculation results and carrying out error correction, obtaining future time step wind speed prediction based on the past time step wind speed inversion results, 3, establishing a boundary self-adaptive grid and a dynamically updated Kriging interpolation model, obtaining wind speed data of a specific signal reflection point missing area, assisting wind speed data supplement of the reflection point missing area, and 4, constructing a double-effect strong wind early warning strategy of the coordination of wind speed time sequence extrapolation and inversion stability, judging whether strong wind is about to appear or not, and carrying out early warning.

title_en: Arm type terminal comprehensive sensing and intelligent interaction emergency disposal method based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The position of each arm type interactive terminal is interacted with real-time information of a central server side, global monitoring and data acquisition based on a disaster situation site are carried out, the acquired data are sent to a rear server, an early warning grade is given based on meteorological information and environmental information of the site, a nearest withdrawing point and a withdrawing path are given based on longitude, latitude, altitude and direction of the site, and emergency disposal of emergency events is facilitated. The wireless communication module is provided with communication modes such as 4G, 5G, WIFI, DMR and LORA, and the design has the advantage that in places without networks and base stations, field personnel can contact other equipment through the communication module under any emergency.

title_en: Intelligent identification and early warning method and system for air-space-ground universe monitoring during emergency electric power emergency disposal
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-space-ground universe monitoring intelligent recognition early warning method and system for electric emergency handling of emergency events, which are used for carrying out universe detection and data acquisition based on disaster sites, sending the acquired data to a server of a rear command center, giving out early warning levels based on meteorological information and environmental information of the sites, and giving out nearest withdrawing points and withdrawing paths based on longitude, latitude and altitude of the sites, so that field emergency handling personnel can master the surrounding environment conditions of the sites, risk pre-control of the emergency handling personnel is facilitated, and emergency handling of the emergency events is facilitated.

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning device for collapse danger of foundation pit construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foundation pit construction and discloses an automatic monitoring and early warning device for the collapse risk of foundation pit construction, which comprises a shell, wherein a displacement sensor is arranged outside the shell, a warning clock is arranged inside the shell, a rotating rod II is arranged inside the shell, a sliding rod II is arranged at one end of the rotating rod II, a knocking rod is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the sliding rod II, and one end of the knocking rod is positioned inside the warning clock; the inside mounting of casing has the motor, the motor is used for driving to strike the pole and removes, through setting up casing, displacement sensor, circuit board, signal line two, motor, dwang first, dwang second, strike pole, alarm for strike the pole and strike the alarm, remind the operating personnel to pay attention to, when slide bar first and slide bar second separation, drive slide bar second under the effect of spiral spring first and reset, thereby make to strike the pole and strike the alarm repeatedly, make the operating personnel can in time withdraw.

title_en: Training method of magnitude estimation model, magnitude estimation method and magnitude estimation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake prediction and early warning, in particular to a training method of an earthquake magnitude estimation model, an earthquake magnitude estimation method and an earthquake magnitude estimation model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a sample set, wherein the sample set comprises an earthquake signal and a real result corresponding to the earthquake signal, obtaining a prediction result through a magnitude estimation model based on the sample set, calculating an error between the prediction result and the real result, calculating an error gradient, wherein the calculated error gradient is obtained through calculation by using a back propagation algorithm, and updating weights by constructing a weight optimizer based on an Adam algorithm, wherein the weights are updated by setting a weight learning rate and a regularization parameter given by the magnitude estimation model based on the negative direction of gradient descent. The invention combines the transducer with the ResNet and RNN structures, and adopts the time-of-arrival and time-of-arrival information as the data enhancement means, so that the shock level estimation system has better precision, wider application range and stronger robustness.

title_en: Urban flood risk point prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting urban flood risk points, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood risk point identification and prediction, and comprises the steps of obtaining and establishing a rainfall event library according to historical daily rainfall data of a rainfall station and accumulated water data of an urban water collecting area; according to the rainfall event library, calculating the occurrence condition probability of the ponding; obtaining rainfall probability prediction data, predicting future flood risk occurrence probability according to the ponding occurrence condition probability and the rainfall probability prediction data, completing urban flood risk point prediction, and sending out early warning according to the flood risk occurrence probability; and carrying out error analysis on the occurrence probability of the flood risk to obtain an error analysis result, updating a rainfall event base according to the error analysis result, and carrying out urban flood risk point prediction based on the updated rainfall event base. The method solves the problem that the existing urban flood risk point prediction method is low in efficiency.

title_en: PWS key updating methods, network side equipment and terminal in wireless communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses PWS key updating methods, network side equipment and terminal in a kind of wireless communication system, the renewal update method performs following steps by network side equipment：Two public warning system (PWS) keys and the identification information of the two PWS keys are issued to terminal in initial access process, one of them is currently used PWS keys, another is next PWS keys used；Key configured information is issued, wherein at least includes：The identification information for the PWS keys that network side equipment is being currently used；After the message for the carrying key updating configured information that the terminal is sent is received, the PWS keys of the terminal request are issued to the terminal.The present invention need not increase new signaling process, it is not required that individually trigger signaling process, only can complete the renewal of PWS keys on stream existing.

title_en: Method for early warning of urban rainfall flood inundated area
abstract_en: A method for early warning of urban rainfall flood inundated areas is characterized by comprising the following steps: the system comprises four functional modules: (M1) real-time observing water level in urban rainfall flood inundation area; (M2) a sensor layout module for municipal pipelines in urban rainfall flood flooding areas; (M3) an early warning indicator calculation module; (M4) a live and early warning plane domain output module. The invention has the beneficial effects that: 1. during the rain flood period, a city manager can mutually verify the water level data and the water surface image of the rain flood submerging area, so that the measured data is more convincing and effective; 2. a novel device and a method for measuring the water level of an urban rainfall flood flooding area are provided; 3. the water withdrawal process line of the rain flood inundated area can be accurately predicted.

title_en: Fire safety monitoring system capable of starting emergency lighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire safety monitoring system capable of starting emergency illumination, which comprises: the fire control safety intelligent supervision unit monitors the operation, faults and alarm conditions of the fire control facilities in the monitoring area in real time, the manager checks the real-time monitoring data through the fire control monitoring terminal, and if an alarm or an early warning prompt occurs, the fire control emergency lighting control unit starts an emergency lighting channel to guide the personnel in the monitoring area to withdraw rapidly and safely. The fire safety monitoring system with the emergency lighting effectively monitors the fire disaster in the monitoring area, and guides the escape path of the evacuee more accurately, safely and effectively when the fire disaster occurs, so that the larger loss caused by the situation that personnel enter the accident place by mistake is prevented.

title_en: Power grid early warning and scheduling method and system based on extreme disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid early warning and scheduling method and system based on extreme disaster weather, which relate to the field of power grid scheduling and aim to solve the problem that the scheduling has one-sidedness caused by the fact that the current power grid scheduling method cannot comprehensively consider the influence factors of the extreme disaster weather; judging whether to send out power grid early warning according to the fault condition of the power grid equipment and the using time of the power grid equipment and predicting load reduction amount, acquiring position distribution information and energy information of the power grid energy storage equipment, determining an executed power grid energy storage equipment scheme according to a first execution strategy, constructing an energy storage execution model according to the historically executed power grid energy storage equipment scheme, and judging whether the energy storage execution model is updated or not. The invention carries out targeted adjustment and scheduling on the fault power grid equipment, and ensures the objectivity and comprehensiveness of the scheduling result.

title_en: Automatic analysis device for power grid alarm
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic power grid alarm analysis device which comprises a host, an indicator light, a display screen, a key and a power socket, wherein the internal components of the host comprise a cable pipe, a main block, a core bar, a gate valve, a gate row block and an internal groove, the cable pipe is arranged at the top end of the outer wall of the host, the main block is arranged below the cable pipe, the core bar is arranged in the main block, the gate valve is arranged below the main block, and wiring ports and communication cable fastening mechanisms are arranged at two ends of the cable pipe. The substantial effects of the invention are as follows: 1) the whole power system flow structure updated in real time is stored in the cloud, the influence degree of the fault on the power system can be automatically analyzed when the fault occurs, and the technical problem that the existing power system warning device cannot analyze the severity degree of the influence of the abnormal condition causing the warning on the power grid according to the power grid condition is solved; 2) a cable fastening mechanism is introduced to solve the technical problem of interruption or misinformation of power grid detection caused by poor contact at a wiring position.

title_en: Safety early warning method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety early warning method, a safety early warning device, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: taking an object within a preset distance of the vehicle as an object to be monitored according to the received first basic safety information; determining an early warning type and an early warning level of the object to be monitored for triggering the vehicle according to the first basic safety information of the object to be monitored and the second basic safety information of the vehicle; updating the early warning type, the early warning grade and the first identification of the object to be monitored into an early warning field of the second basic safety information; and performing independent early warning according to the early warning type and the early warning grade, and broadcasting the updated second basic safety information. Therefore, the vehicle can not only perform early warning when far vehicles and pedestrians exist in the dead zone of the vehicle, but also perform early warning when the vehicle is in the dead zone of the far vehicles and pedestrians, so that the probability of traffic safety accidents of the vehicle and the pedestrians can be effectively reduced, and the traffic safety is improved.

title_en: Slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm and system based on deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a standardized state characterization vector and establishing a state quality evaluation index; the method comprises the steps of receiving a state characterization vector as input, constructing a dual-mode strategy architecture, generating a preliminary decision and confidence level assessment thereof to form a quantitative index of decision reliability, forming a final early warning instruction and strategy updating suggestion, generating a strategy performance assessment report, continuously tracking the change trend of state feature distribution, constructing a strategy degradation early warning system, triggering a model reconstruction mechanism, feeding back updated strategy network parameters to the dual-mode strategy architecture, and feeding back optimized feature extraction suggestion to an established state quality assessment index. The system comprises an index establishment module, a report generation module and a reconstruction mechanism module. The slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm realizes a monitoring-decision-optimizing end-to-end closed-loop control system through a deep reinforcement learning framework.

title_en: A kind of method of inspection, device and the limiter of moment of Car Crane Retractable Arms operating condition
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of methods of inspection of Car Crane Retractable Arms operating condition, device and limiter of moment, pass through the boom pressure sensor being arranged on boom hydraulic control circuit, it can be when autocrane carries out lifting operation, boom value of electrical signals is got in time, and then when judging that the boom value of electrical signals is more than preset electric threshold value, the corresponding boom operating condition of the boom value of electrical signals is compared with the preset boom operating condition being manually arranged in limiter of moment in advance, judge whether consistent, if inconsistent, then prove that the boom actually used during lifting operation with the boom being arranged in limiter of moment is manually entered is not same, the boom operating condition actually used is not consistent with the boom operating condition in advance set by limiter of moment, at this time, warning alert is carried out to achieve the purpose that remind staff in time, The effectively generation of prevention safety accident.

title_en: Early warning device and method for unsafe behaviors of foundation pit construction site
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsafe behavior early warning device and method for a foundation pit construction site, and the device comprises a main body rod, wherein the lower end face of the main body rod is fixedly connected with a first round seat, a second round seat is also arranged below the first round seat, the central position of the lower end face of the first round seat is fixedly connected with a ball sleeve, the upper end face of the second round seat is fixedly connected with a universal ball, the universal ball is arranged in the ball sleeve, springs are arranged between the side positions of the first round seat and the second round seat, and a fixing assembly is arranged on the second round seat and used for installing and fixing the second round seat; according to the invention, the safety of the foundation pit can be detected in real time through the arranged copper ball and the conductive cylinder, when the soil layer around the foundation pit collapses, the main body rod can be deflected to realize an early warning function, and an alarm can be given out at the first time when the soil layer around the foundation pit collapses to remind foundation pit constructors to withdraw or reinforce the foundation pit in time, so that the safety of foundation pit construction is greatly improved.

title_en: Landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering. And after big data fusion is carried out on the heterogeneous data, the heterogeneous data is stored in a landslide geological disaster sample library, so that the data of the sample library is updated, and the aim of improving the landslide geological disaster monitoring and early warning data quality is fulfilled. According to the method, the timeliness of large-data acquisition of landslide disaster points is improved, the problem that the existing geological disaster reporting site is not accurate enough is solved, the accuracy of obtaining the topographic data of the disaster point area is improved, and large-area and low-cost calculation processing of the surface deformation data of the disaster point area is realized.

title_en: Urban flood control early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an urban flood control early warning system and method, which relate to the technical field of urban meteorological data processing and comprise the following steps: obtaining terrain data of a target city, and constructing a waterlogging dangerous point set of the target city; constructing association relations of waterlogging dangerous points in the waterlogging dangerous point set based on the topographic data of the target city; establishing a plurality of prediction models based on the historical flood data of the target city and the corresponding weather data; collecting future weather related prediction information of the target city according to a preset rule; and matching a corresponding prediction model from each prediction model according to the future weather related expected information, and predicting and updating the waterlogging risk of the waterlogging risk point set by combining the association relation of the waterlogging risk points. According to the method, the terrain influence relationship is considered, the weather related conditions are introduced to predict and update the waterlogging risk, and the accuracy of flood control prediction is improved.

title_en: Traveler's alert system
abstract_en: A method and a system for producing an updated status of users, associated with an MSISDN number in a mobile network, who are staying in a specific geographical area abroad, where it is desirable to be able to send information and warn of an undesirable event by sending a message to persons concerned.

title_en: Method for monitoring on-line quality and updating prediction model of rubber hardness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the on-line quality and updating a prediction model of rubber hardness, which comprises the following steps of: building a hardness online predicting model according to a training data set, and computing an alarm limit, a warning limit and a selecting limit; inputting a reheological parameter new sample into the hardness online predicting model, and automatically outputting a rubber hardness value; and according to relationship between the Q statistics value of the reheological parameter new sample Xnew and the alarm limit, the warning limit and the selecting limit, confirming whether the hardness online predicting model to be updated or not or whether a quality monitoring system alarms or not, checking the working condition of a production line by operation workers, and carrying out corresponding technical adjustment, so that the current working condition can be recovered to be the normal status. The model is constantly updated by the method, so that the exact rubber hardness value can be obtained, the quality of the rubber can be improved, the practical test verifies that the higher precision can be obtained by the method, and the potential safety hazards can be reduced; and along with the reduction of the number of the samples, the memory space of a computer can be reduced, and the computing speed can be observably improved.

title_en: Dam safety multi-source data sensing and early warning terminal with multi-monitoring element acquisition function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dam safety early warning, and particularly relates to a dam safety multi-source data sensing and early warning terminal with a multi-monitoring element acquisition function. The interior of the monitoring terminal is provided with a containing cavity and a driving mechanism, so that the position of the radar water level sensor can be dynamically adjusted to update real-time water level data. When the dam is abnormal, the system automatically sends out an early warning signal and transmits an alarm to a remote monitoring center through a communication module. In addition, the structural design of the monitoring terminal adopts an elastic connecting piece and a special-shaped connecting rod, so that the stability and the anti-interference capability of the equipment are enhanced. Through first touch switch and second touch switch and alarm lamp linkage, the system can in time send out the warning at sensor adjustment in-process, improves emergency response ability. The method effectively solves the problems of low data precision, slow response, inflexible monitoring equipment and the like in the traditional dam monitoring system.

title_en: Typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence, which provides more comprehensive typhoon behavior information by combining various meteorological data sources, preprocesses data and converts the data into a data set suitable for a machine learning model, performs feature learning and pattern recognition on the data by applying a deep learning model comprising a contraction path and an expansion path and jump connection, extracts key features and patterns of typhoons, constructs typhoons vortex structures and predicts typhoons paths and strength by applying a trained deep learning model to real-time meteorological data, and updates and improves the prediction capability of the deep learning model by continuous data collection and model training. The method can realize more accurate typhoon vortex initialization, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of typhoon path and strength prediction, and provide effective technical support for typhoon early warning and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine disaster early warning method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial data in the GIS system; inputting updated data of the GIS system in the mine operation process into a preset digital twin mine system, wherein the preset digital twin mine system is obtained by modeling digitally based on initial data of the GIS system, and the modeling is used for simulating mine disasters based on the preset digital twin mine system; and carrying out early warning on the mine disasters which possibly occur through the simulation result of the preset digital twin mine system. The method solves the technical problem that real-time monitoring and management and control cannot be carried out on the mine disaster early warning. The safety monitoring and early warning of mine disasters are realized through the method and the device.

title_en: Intelligent gas monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gas monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: the gas acquisition module is used for acquiring gas to be detected in a target monitoring area based on a preset monitoring probe; the gas component analysis module is used for analyzing the collected gas to be detected and determining the gas type and the corresponding gas concentration in the gas to be detected; and the early warning module is used for judging whether dangerous gas leakage exists or not based on the gas type and the corresponding gas concentration and carrying out early warning operation when the dangerous gas leakage occurs. The realization is monitored the regional gas of monitoring in succession, and when taking place dangerous gaseous leakage, transmits alarm signal in real time to command center and carries out the early warning operation to the scene, has improved the accuracy and the validity of gas monitoring, avoids major incident hidden danger, stops dangerous emergence.

title_en: Mine microseism early warning method, device and equipment based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine microseismic early warning method, device and equipment based on a space-time diagram neural network, and relates to the technical field of diagram neural networks. By describing each area of the mine as a node network, the nodes are mutually linked to form an associated graph, and the correlation between the nodes based on the influence of the microseismic event is discussed. Based on microseismic events occurring at different moments, three factor weights based on time, space and strong information are formed, the attention weights of GAT are updated, a multi-head attention mechanism is used for obtaining the weights of edges between final nodes, and the microseismic times, average energy and maximum energy occurring in the next time period of each node are predicted through processing of a space-time diagram neural network, so that the safety accidents possibly occurring in mining are pre-warned. The correlation between the microseismic event and the geological structure is captured through the method, the weight is dynamically updated in real time, and the method has good generalization performance and dynamic updating capability, so that the accuracy and timeliness of prediction are improved.

title_en: Landslide safety early warning method and equipment based on reservoir water level dip
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide safety early warning method and device based on a sudden drop of a reservoir water level, wherein the method establishes the relation between the sudden drop amplitude of the reservoir water level and the penetration rate and the safety coefficient of a landslide plastic region according to an actual water level scheduling scheme and by combining analysis such as geological conditions, engineering experience analogy, numerical calculation, safety coefficient discrimination and the like, and determines a critical drop amplitude value according to the penetration rate and the standard requirement of the design safety coefficient of the sudden drop of the reservoir water level so as to determine the early warning value of the sudden drop amplitude of the reservoir water level. The system is clear in concept, convenient to operate and wide in application range, and can be suitable for the disaster prevention and reduction application of landslide caused by reservoir water level suddenly drop in a watershed reservoir. According to the invention, landslide safety can be checked regularly with the guidance of environmental protection and disaster prevention and reduction, the reservoir water level early warning value is updated, and the reservoir water level early warning signal is issued, so that the landslide safety early warning and forecasting technical method based on reservoir water level suddenly drop is formed.

title_en: Method and system for observing earthquake response of existing building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an existing building earthquake response observation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting building vibration response data under micro vibration and strong vibration and high-definition video data under the strong vibration of a building in real time, carrying out second-level early warning and minute-level early warning based on the building vibration response data, calculating displacement of an observation floor relative to the ground based on the high-definition video data, constructing an adjacent matrix based on the building vibration response data, updating the adjacent matrix by utilizing real-time data and a graph convolution neural network when the minute-level early warning occurs, carrying out hour-level early warning based on edge characteristics of the updated adjacent matrix, and simultaneously updating a digital twin model of the existing building based on a finite element model based on the calculated displacement, and evaluating the earthquake resistance and the security of the structure after the earthquake. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the state identification precision of the building strong earthquake response stage, the earthquake resistance evaluation efficiency after earthquake and the like.

title_en: Fire rescue marker light
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire rescue marker lamp which comprises a base, a shell, a warning device and a switch, wherein the shell is arranged on the base, an adhesion device is arranged at the lower part of the base, an electric storage device is arranged at the upper part of the base, the warning device is arranged at the shell, the electric storage device is electrically connected with the warning device, and the switch is in control connection with the electric storage device. The fire-fighting and rescue marker lamp has the marker guiding function, can facilitate the exploration of rescue and the retraction of fire-fighting and rescue workers when a large amount of smoke gas causes the condition that the fire-fighting and rescue workers cannot see the surrounding clearly when the fire-fighting workers enter the strange environment for rescue, and has the advantages of simple structure, easiness in manufacturing and operation and the like.

title_en: Electric power emergency automatic management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power emergency management, and relates to an electric power emergency automatic management system which comprises a real-time monitoring module, a central processing unit and a display module, wherein the real-time monitoring module is used for monitoring the equipment state and the line state in real time; the real-time monitoring module outputs monitoring signals, the monitoring signals are analyzed and processed by the central processing unit and then output control signals, and the central processing unit operates and controls the early warning reminding module, the emergency grade evaluation module, the emergency guarantee module and the display module through the control signals. The invention realizes real-time monitoring of monitoring item data, sets various early warning forms, sets emergency event grade evaluation, and scientifically dispatches emergency resources according to the severity grade of the emergency event; and the emergency resources are updated in real time, so that the capability of the power system for preventing and treating the power emergency is improved.

title_en: Landslide safety monitoring system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide safety monitoring system and an early warning method thereof, and relates to the technical field of safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of connecting a control end of a cloud server and landslide sensors buried in a soil slope to be monitored, wherein the landslide sensors are uniformly distributed on the soil slope to be monitored, soil layer tightness data and soil layer deviation data of different depths of installation points of the landslide sensors are obtained, the control end obtains the soil layer tightness data and the soil layer deviation data sent by the landslide sensors and combines a three-dimensional image of a region of the soil slope to be monitored, which is obtained in advance, to construct a three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model of the soil slope to be monitored, the control end obtains the data sent by the landslide sensors in real time and updates the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, if the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change exceeds a preset threshold value, the control end sends out landslide warning alarms, and the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change is a comparison value of the three-dimensional real-time soil layer monitoring model and an initial three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, and the three-dimensional soil layer deviation is obtained.

title_en: Temperature information collection and early warning method and system for high speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature information collection and early warning system for a high speed railway. The system comprises a temperature information collecting device, a current signal/value signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold of temperature disaster risks, a determining device started by an early warning program, a locating device, a train controlling device for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device. A control module serves as a core of the whole system, controls operation of the devices on one hand, and is used for being connected with external devices including an external computer device and the like to achieve communication and control. In the system, the dynamic generating mode is adopted in the reference threshold for evaluating the temperature disaster risks, the historical disaster situations are combined, and the historical situations are continuously updated after new early warning is given, so that the risk pre-evaluation of a certain region is considered more completely and scientifically with contrast to historical data. The invention further provides a temperature information collection and early warning method for the high speed railway.

title_en: Visual safety risk early warning system for archaize building mixed structure construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a visual safety risk early warning system for archaize building mixed structure construction, in particular to the field of safety risk early warning for archaize building construction, which remarkably improves construction safety risk management and control capability through cooperation of multi-source data fusion and an intelligent algorithm, acquires mechanics and environment data of key nodes of a high-branch formwork body in real time, dynamically updates load distribution by combining a building information model to generate high-precision space-time tag data stream, predicts short-term instability risk based on a dual-channel neural network, constructs a complex network model quantification node failure linkage effect to generate visual risk propagation thermodynamic diagram, finally realizes augmented reality visual warning and equipment linkage control through a dynamic threshold triggering hierarchical warning strategy, breaks through the traditional manual monitoring limitation, realizes full-flow closed-loop management of risk perception, archaize prediction, positioning and response, effectively reduces the safety accident rate, and ensures the safety and reliability of construction of the complex structure of the building.

title_en: Array type early warning system for landslide collapse of reservoir bank hydro-fluctuation belt
abstract_en: The application discloses an array type early warning system for landslide collapse of a reservoir bank hydro-fluctuation belt, which comprises an array of 3*3 specifications formed by inclined alarms, wherein each inclined alarm is connected with a general control device through a wire; the inclination alarm comprises a shell, wherein a power supply device and a monitoring device which are connected with each other are sequentially arranged in the shell from top to bottom, and the lower end of the shell is connected with a fixing part. This application array early warning system, when the reservoir water level is minimum, namely the hydro-fluctuation belt is in the biggest area of exposing, can arrange in the reservoir bank hydro-fluctuation belt region that has landslide or collapse danger, in case the soil body takes place slope or displacement, the light intensity that the photoresistor resistance will lead to because of the slope changes, microcurrent signal of telecommunication receiver will transmit information for processing module this moment, just can release early warning information through transmitting module after handling discernment, help resident in time withdraw and inform reservoir manager to handle, avoid life and property's loss.

title_en: Dynamic integrated natural disaster remote sensing monitoring method and system and cloud platform
abstract_en: The dynamic integrated natural disaster remote sensing monitoring method, system and cloud platform can respectively carry out environment updating and early warning degree updating on disaster area remote sensing monitoring information and influence area remote sensing monitoring information, when the environment is updated, a plurality of geological interference states of influence area environment conditions/disaster area environment conditions are obtained through analysis, so that different information updating strategies can be adopted to carry out environment updating on the remote sensing monitoring information in different geological interference states, and the actual monitoring change conditions of all the geological interference states can be obtained through disaster area information and influence area information in the remote sensing monitoring information comprehensively and intelligently as far as possible. Therefore, the updating of the environment angle and the early warning degree angle of the remote sensing monitoring information can be realized, the dynamic remote sensing monitoring updating information can reflect the monitoring result correlation condition among the remote sensing monitoring devices from the actual geological environment change angle as far as possible, and an accurate and reliable decision basis is provided for the subsequent natural disaster early warning.

title_en: Moving ring fault prediction and linkage control method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, and particularly discloses a dynamic ring fault prediction and linkage control method and system based on machine vision. The method comprises the steps of extracting feature information from early warning information to obtain early warning feature information, extracting feature information from alarm information to obtain alarm feature information, generating fault prediction strategy information according to the early warning feature information and the alarm feature information, judging whether the fault prediction strategy information is in preset strategy library information, and updating the fault prediction strategy information into the preset strategy library information if the fault prediction strategy information is not in the preset strategy library information, so that the existing database can be continuously updated in real time, the machine room fault can be comprehensively predicted according to the database updated in real time, and meanwhile, the real-time updated database can also comprehensively link emergency equipment which needs to be timely linked after the occurrence of a problem, so that the risk of the machine room after the occurrence of safety fire fighting safety can be reduced through timely linkage.

title_en: A kind of alert message notice system and Notification Method and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of alert message notice system and Notification Method and mobile terminal, the communication subsystem in the system includes alert message buffer process module and module is presented in end side message；Alert message buffer process module, for caching the alert message from alert message sender, receives after belonging to the new alert message of same alarm events with the alert message of caching, performs the one or more in following operation：Delete the alert message of the caching, updated according to the alert message of the new alert message and the caching after alert message, the alert message after module sends the renewal, the alert message after the caching renewal are presented to the end side；End side is presented module and is used to received alert message be presented to terminal device.This programme can solve the problems, such as the alert messages of same alarm events to same user terminal repeatedly the bad experience of unnecessary alert message to repeatedly receiving same alarm events of unnecessary notice and user the problem of.

title_en: Potential safety hazard investigation method and system for power transformation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential safety hazard investigation method and system for power transformation equipment, which particularly relate to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power equipment and are used for solving the hidden operation risk problem caused by equipment aging characteristic and generalized strategy mismatch in the prior art, and early warning and accurate intervention of hidden danger are realized by collecting multisource operation state data of the power transformation equipment and constructing an asynchronous data set, differential weight distribution is carried out on the abnormal parameters based on equipment structural characteristics, risk grades of different areas are quantified, time sequence relevance of contact resistance and electric field response is analyzed, breakdown risk caused by insulation degradation is judged, a maintenance period optimization scheme and an electric field compensation parameter are generated by combining the risk grades, an aging model is dynamically updated based on execution feedback, and the problem of control mismatch caused by material degradation characteristic of the traditional method is effectively solved by carrying out early warning and accurate intervention of hidden danger.

title_en: Server, vehicle terminal and method for providing emergency notification
title_ko: 서버, 차량용 단말 및 이를 이용한 긴급 상황 알림 방법
abstract_ko: 서버의 긴급 상황 알림 방법이 개시된다. 본 방법은 차량의 긴급 상황 이벤트 발생시, 차량에 대한 차량용 단말로부터 긴급 상황 정보를 수신하는 단계, 차량용 단말에 대하여 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트를 시작하는 단계, 긴급 상황 취소용 대기 카운트가 종료될 때까지 긴급 상황에 대한 취소가 이루어지는지 여부에 따라 긴급 상황 여부를 판단하는 단계, 긴급 상황으로 판단되면, 수신된 긴급 상황 정보를 이용하여 긴급 신고 기관으로 차량의 긴급 상황에 대한 신고를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Vehicle entry management system to tunnel or underground road
title_ko: 터널 또는 지하차도 진입차단시스템
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a tunnel or underpass entry blocking system for integrally controlling an alarm means, an entry blocking means and the like according to an emergency situation occurring in a tunnel or an underpass, thereby enabling a driver of a vehicle attempting to enter the tunnel or underpass to easily and rapidly recognize the emergency situation. Provided is a tunnel or underpass entry blocking system comprising: an entry blocking device (10) in which a blocking film (40) unwound in a vertical length is installed in a blocking unit (30) when a danger signal is received, and an alarm means (80) for notifying prohibition of entry of a vehicle attempting to enter a tunnel or underpass in the event of danger is provided on the blocking unit (30) or a post (20), and performs an entry blocking operation and a release operation for the tunnel or the underpass; an information acquisition device (100) for detecting the approach of the vehicle approaching the entry blocking device or the tunnel and photographing an image; a control unit (200) for controlling the operation of the blocking film (40) of the entry blocking device (10) and the alarm means (80); and a management unit (300) for managing and monitoring a dangerous area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재나 교통사고 등이 발생된 터널 또는 지하차도의 차량 진입을 차단하는 차량진입차단수단과 이와 함께 위험경보를 표현하는 경보수단 및 터널 또는 지하차도 내 진입하는 차량의 속도를 표현하는 예보수단 등을 통합적으로 제어하여 터널 또는 지하차도 내의 사고를 예방함과 더불어 터널 또는 지하차도 내 사고시 운전자에게 돌발상황을 용이하고 신속하게 인지시키고 돌발상황의 원활한 초기대응으로 인해 2차 사고를 방지하고 인명피해 및 재산피해를 감소시킬 수 있는 터널 또는 지하차도 진입차단시스템에 관한 것으로서, 터널 또는 지하차도 전방에 위치하여 도로 양측면에 각각 설치된 포스트(20)의 상부를 연결하여 도로를 가로지르는 차단부(30)로 구성되어 위험신호를 수신받을 경우에 차단부에 수직길이로 권출되는 차단막(40) 또는 포스트에서 수평으로 권출되는 차단막(40)이 설치되며, 상기 차단부(30) 또는 포스트(20)에 터널 또는 지하차도 위험시 진입되는 차량의 진입금지를 알리는 경보수단(80)이 마련되어 터널 또는 지하차도에 대한 차량의 진입 차단 동작 및 해제 동작을 수행하는 진입차단장치(10);와, 상기 진입차단장치 또는 터널로 접근하는 차량의 접근 감지 및 영상 촬영을 수행하는 정보획득장치(100);와, 상기 진입차단장치(10)의 차단막(40)과 상기 경보수단(80)의 구동을 제어하는 제어부(200); 및, 상기 진입차단장치(10)과 정보획득장치(100) 중의 적어도 하나 이상과 무선 통신을 수행하며 위험 지역에 대한 관리 및 모니터링을 수행하는 관리부(300);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for auto recording of Digital television receiver
title_ko: 디지털 티브이 수신기의 자동 녹화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
개시된 본 발명은 긴급경보(EAS) 또는 인터럽트 발생시 자동 녹화 기능을 수행하는 디지털 TV 수신기의 자동 녹화 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 디지털 방송을 수신하고; 긴급경보 또는 인터럽트 발생시 현재 수신되는 방송을 저장시킴과 동시에 해당 재난방송으로 전환하고; 상기 긴급경보 해제시 해당 재난방송을 종료하고 상기 단계에서 정지된 시점으로부터 저장된 방송을 재생한다. 상기 현재 수신되는 방송을 저장시키는 기능은, 타임 시프트(Time Shift) 기능에 의하여 저장되고, 상기 긴급경보는, 현재 시청중인 방송으로 수신되는 비디오 또는 오디오 신호의 인터럽트에 의하여 발생하거나, 현재 시청중인 방송으로 수신되는 PSIP(Program and System Information Protocol) 데이터에 의하여 발생한다. 따라서, 긴급경보 또는 인터럽트 발생시 해당 재난방송을 출력함과 아울러, 자동으로 현재 시청중인 방송의 녹화 기능을 수행하고, 재난방송 종료후 녹화된 방송으로부터 현재 시청하던 방송을 이어서 재생하여 본 방송을 끊김 없이 시청할 수 있다. 
       
     긴급경보, 인터럽트, EAS, 녹화, 타임 시프트, TS, TV, PVR, 재난방송

title_en: Method and apparatus for broadcasting alert service message in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선통신시스템에서 경보 서비스 메시지 방송 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 무선통신시스템의 기지국에서 상용 모바일 경보 서비스(Commercial Mobile Alert Service, CMAS) 메시지를 방송하는 방법이 제공된다. CMAS 메시지 방송 방법은 CMAS 비상 상황 발생 시, CMAS 메시지를 포함한 SIB8(System Information Block 8)을 구성하는 단계, 현재 시스템 정보 변경 주기에서 현재 SFN(System Frame Number)과 가장 가까운 디폴트 페이징 사이클 값에 해당하는 SFN을 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점으로 결정하는 단계, 상기 SIB8의 방송을 알리는 단문메시지를 생성하는 단계, 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점에서 상기 SIB8을 포함하는 시스템 정보를 방송하는 단계, 그리고 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점에서 상기 단문메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor and Method thereof
title_ko: 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유선통신과 DMB 방송으로 이중화된 매체를 이용하여 경보신호를 수신한 후, 이에 따른 경보 상황을 건물 내 사람들에게 전달하는 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 외부의 경보신호를 수신받는 경보신호수신부 및 상기 경보신호수신부를 통해 수신된 경보신호를 분석하여 유효성 판단과 중복성 판단의 검증과정을 거친 후, 유효한 경보신호라고 판단되면 상기 수신된 경보신호를 미리 설정된 수행 시나리오에 따라 건물 내부로 알리도록 하는 메인제어부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명의 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 따르면, 기존방식의 경보 전파에 음영지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전파하기 위한 옥내 경보 방송수신기를 설치하고, 건물 내에 구비하고 있는 옥내 비상 방송설비나 구내 방송시설을 이용하여 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전달함으로써, 경보상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Street light with CCTV Drone on head part for crime prevention and security
title_ko: Cctv 드론이 헤드부에 구비된 방범 치안용 가로등
abstract_en: Provided is a lamppost for crime prevention and security which includes a ring shaped head unit coupled to the top of a lamppost support and a drone mounted to be able to take off and land on the heat unit. According to the present invention, by installing a CCTV drone for crime prevention and security on the heat unit of the lamppost, a basically monitoring and lighting function in a state of the lamppost can be performed, and the drone is operated in case of emergency to track criminals along with warning signals, so that the lamppost can be effectively utilized for crime prevention and criminal arrests.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가로등 지주의 상단에 결합되는 환형 헤드부, 및 상기 헤드부에 이착륙 가능하도록 탑재되는 드론을 포함하는 방범 치안용 가로등을 제공한다. 상기 드론은 헤드부에 탑재된 상태에서 충전배터리에 무선 충전되고, 헤드부 중앙 하부로 드론의 영상 촬영부가 노출된 상태에서 CCTV 기능을 수행하며, 비상 상황이 발생되면 헤드부로부터 드론이 이륙하여 비행과 함께 영상 촬영을 수행한 후 비상 상황 해제 시 헤드부로 복귀한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 가로등의 헤드부에 방범 치안용 CCTV 드론을 설치하여 평상시에는 기본적인 감시와 가로등 본연의 조명 기능을 수행할 수 있고, 비상상황 발생시 드론을 동작시켜 경고 신호와 함께 범인을 추적하여 범죄 예방 및 범인 검거에 효과적으로 활용할 수 있다.
assignees: JEJU NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Multifunctional Fire Fighting Equipment
title_ko: 안전기능 탑재형 다기능 소방기기
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a firefighting device that helps evacuees safely evacuate to the location of a controlled descent device, alerts the operation of the controlled descent device, and facilitates evacuation by promptly suppressing fires and breaking windows. The firefighting device includes a fire suppression device (100), a fire detection sensor (200), a controlled descent device installation device (300), a control unit (400), a voice guidance device (500), multiple laser projectors (600), and multiple batteries (700). According to the present invention, when a fire occurs, evacuees can safely evacuate using the laser projector (600) and the controlled descent device installation device (300). Furthermore, the present invention provides various functions for rapid fire suppression, formation of escape routes, and the safety of evacuees.

title_en: Detaching apparatus for an alarm device
title_ko: 경보장치용 고정장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 센서의 눌림상태 해제시 경보를 발생시키는 경보장치를 설치위치에 고정설치되게 하는 고정장치에 있어서,  설치위치에 밀착 배치되는 설치대상접촉덮개,  설치대상접촉덮개에 장착된 상태로 상기 경보장치에 결합되며, 일 측부에는 센서에 대향되게 결합된 누름부와, 자력에 의해 설치위치에 탈부착 가능하게 고정되도록 자기발생부재가 마련된 장치결합부,  장치결합부가 경보장치 방향으로 유동이 가능하도록 설치대상접촉덮개 상에 장착되게 하며, 경보장치에 외부로 향하는 당김힘이 가해지지 않을 경우에는 탄성팽창력에 의해 장치결합부를 설치대상접촉덮개 방향으로 밀어 누름부가 센서에 접촉된 상태로 누름상태가 되게 하며,  경보장치가 설치위치에 고정 설치된 상태에서 경보장치를 이탈시키려는 힘이 가해질 경우, 장치결합부가 경보장치 방향으로 이동할 수 있도록 하여, 장치결합부와 설치대상접촉덮개 사이의 간격을 증대시키며 누름부에 의한 센서의 누름상태가 해제되면서 경보가 발생되게 하는 유동결합수단을 포함하는 경보장치용 고정장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring flooding using a fusion sensor
title_ko: 융합 센서를 이용한 침수 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
수위 센서를 이용하여 기 설정된 수위 측정 주기에 기초하여 획득한 수위 정보를 서버에게 전송하는 단계; 수위 정보에 기초하여 침수 경보 발령 여부를 결정하는 단계; 를 포함하고, 수위 측정 주기는 수위 정보에 기초하여 변경되는 방법 및 전자 장치가 제공된다.
